1979 年 11 月,Hans Moravec 在斯坦福 AI Lab 完成 Stanford Cart 的标志性演示:在充满障碍物的房间内,小车靠双摄像头立体视觉“看 9 张图 - 选关键点 - 算视差 - 建 3D 地图 - 规划路径 - 走 1 米”循环,花了约 5 小时走完 20 米,中途没撞到任何椅子。
Cart 用一台 DEC KI-10 远程遥控,每轮计算要 15 分钟。
这是 AI 史上第一次让移动机器人在真实 cluttered 室内空间里完成自主导航。
events.source_name: Moravec, H. (1980). Stanford AIM-340; (1983) Vision Robot Navigation
events.card_summary_zh: 这是 AI 史上第一次让移动机器人在真实 cluttered 室内空间里完成自主导航；Stanford Cart 是自动驾驶和移动机器人的共同起点。
events.summary_en: In November 1979, Hans Moravec completed a landmark demonstration of the Stanford Cart at the Stanford AI Lab, steering it through an obstacle-filled room using a dual-camera stereo vision loop of taking 9 pictures, selecting keypoints, calculating disparity, building a 3D map, planning a path, and moving 1 meter. Remotely controlled by a DEC KI-10 that required 15 minutes of computation per round, the Cart took about 5 hours to travel 20 meters without hitting any chairs. This marked the first time in AI history that a mobile robot successfully achieved autonomous navigation in a real, cluttered indoor space.
events.card_summary_en: The Stanford Cart crossed a room alone in five hours, root of self-driving and mobile robots.
events.why_it_matters_en: It was the first time a mobile robot navigated a real cluttered indoor space autonomously, and the Cart is the common origin of autonomous driving and mobile robotics, its perceive-map-plan-control pipeline still running inside Waymo, Tesla FSD, and ROS navigation stacks. Moravec's paradox explains why chess fell in 1997 before driving in the 2020s and why the robot butler never arrived: physical perception-action loops are vastly harder than symbolic reasoning.
events.behind_scenes_en: Twenty meters in five hours reads like a joke today and was an engineering marvel in 1979. Moravec kept overnight vigils beside the cart while debugging, because a single collision meant recalibrating cameras. Across the 1970s machine vision was widely assumed a decade from solution; this cart first quantified the gap between seeing and understanding, 100 milliseconds to capture a frame versus hours of compute to label every pixel in it, the empirical starting point of the famous paradox that sensorimotor skills are far harder than reasoning.

events.title_zh: XCON/R1:专家系统首次大规模商用
events.title_en: XCON/R1: First Large-Scale Commercial Expert System
events.summary_zh:
1978-1980 年,John McDermott 在 CMU 为 DEC 公司开发 R1(后改名 XCON,eXpert CONfigurer)。
1980 年 4 月正式上线,任务是自动配置 VAX-11/780 计算机订单,把销售员勾选的硬件清单转成可投产的连接方案。
R1 用 OPS5 产生式规则编写,初始约 500 条规则,到 1986 年膨胀到上千至上万条。
DEC 报告每年节省约 2500 万美元,几乎消灭了订单配置错误。
XCON 是专家系统商业化时代的旗舰案例,直接催生 1981 年 DEC 内部 40+ 个专家系统项目,以及全球企业跟风上马专家系统的浪潮。
events.source_name: McDermott, J. (1982). R1: A rule-based configurer of computer systems. Artificial Intelligence 19(1):39-88
events.card_summary_zh: XCON 自动配置复杂计算机订单，每年为 DEC 节省数千万美元，专家系统第一次真正实现大规模商业回报。
events.summary_en: Between 1978 and 1980, John McDermott developed R1 (later renamed XCON, or eXpert CONfigurer) at CMU for DEC, launching it in April 1980 to automatically configure VAX-11/780 computer orders by converting salesperson-selected hardware lists into production-ready connection schemes. Built using OPS5 production rules, the system expanded from about 500 initial rules to thousands to tens of thousands by 1986, saving DEC an estimated $25 million annually and virtually eliminating order configuration errors. As the flagship success story of the commercial expert system era, XCON directly spawned 40+ internal expert system projects at DEC in 1981 and triggered a global wave of enterprises rushing to deploy their own expert systems.
events.card_summary_en: XCON configured complex computer orders automatically, saving DEC tens of millions yearly.
events.why_it_matters_en: XCON was AI history's first industrial deployment paying back in hard cash, proving AI can generate quantifiable economic value inside enterprises rather than demonstrations on paper. Yet its conditions for success were ignored and its conditions for failure underestimated, and the script of success story, blind imitation, collective crash replayed in the 2023-2025 LLM adoption wave.
events.behind_scenes_en: XCON succeeded under specific circumstances. Configuring VAX orders was highly structured, with crisp rule boundaries and no gray-area judgment. DEC's own engineers were the domain experts, so knowledge acquisition flowed. Order volumes were large enough that saving even five minutes per configuration repaid the effort. None of these conditions held in medicine, law, or prospecting, so the more XCON succeeded the more companies believed expert systems replicated without limit, and the mass failures after 1985 planted the seeds of the second AI winter.

events.title_zh: IBM PC:个人计算机标准化
events.title_en: IBM Personal Computer Released
events.summary_zh:
1981 年 8 月 12 日,IBM 发布 5150 Personal Computer,采用 Intel 8088 处理器(4.77 MHz)、微软 PC DOS 1.0 操作系统、16-256KB 内存。
售价 1565 美元起步,开放架构(open architecture)允许第三方厂商制造兼容机和扩展卡。
Don Estridge 带领的 IBM Boca Raton 实验室用 12 个月完成项目,打破 IBM 内部多年大型机研发节奏。
1982 年 IBM PC 成为《时代》年度机器,1983 年 PC 兼容机市场全面爆发。
events.source_name: IBM 5150 announcement (1981-08-12); Estridge, D. IBM Boca Raton
events.card_summary_zh: IBM PC 与开放兼容架构迅速形成行业标准，计算能力由少数机构进一步扩散到办公室与家庭。
events.summary_en: On August 12, 1981, IBM released the 5150 Personal Computer starting at $1,565, featuring an Intel 8088 processor (4.77 MHz), Microsoft PC DOS 1.0, 16-256KB of memory, and an open architecture that allowed third-party manufacturers to build compatible machines and expansion cards. Don Estridge led the IBM Boca Raton lab to complete the project in 12 months, breaking IBM's internal mainframe development pace of many years. The IBM PC became *Time*’s "Machine of the Year" in 1982, and the PC-compatible market fully exploded in 1983.
events.card_summary_en: An open, clonable architecture made the IBM PC the standard, pushing compute to office and home.
events.why_it_matters_en: The IBM PC was the hinge of compute democratization. Without PC standardization there are no 1990s graduate students training neural networks in dorm rooms and no indie AI laboratories in the 2000s. The hardware base letting anyone run LLM inference today traces back to the 1,565-dollar IBM 5150 of August 1981.
events.behind_scenes_en: The decisive choice was open architecture: IBM monopolized neither motherboard design, BIOS, nor operating system, taking off-the-shelf Intel CPUs and Microsoft DOS, converting the PC into a standard any third party could clone. Compaq, Dell, and HP rose as clone makers while Microsoft and Intel emerged as the greatest winners of the 1980s-90s. For AI, the IBM PC widened personally owned computing from the hacker circle to offices and families, creating soil for home experiments, independent developers, and open-source toolchains.

events.title_zh: Hopfield 网络:神经网络复苏的火花
events.title_en: Hopfield Network: Revival of Neural Networks
events.summary_zh:
1982 年 4 月,Caltech 物理学家 John Hopfield 在 PNAS 79(8):2554-2558 发表《Neural networks and physical systems with emergent collective computational abilities》。
他构造了一个对称全连接的二值神经元网络,并引入“能量函数”的概念,证明网络状态会沿能量梯度下降,最终收敛到吸引子(局部极小)。
把一个记忆存进网络 = 把吸引子刻进能量地形;给网络一个残缺输入 = 让小球滚回最近的洼地。
这一刻神经网络突然有了物理直觉,不再只是心理学模型。
events.card_summary_zh: Hopfield 用能量函数解释神经网络如何收敛到稳定记忆，连接主义由此重新获得数学上的可信度。
events.summary_en: In April 1982, Caltech physicist John Hopfield published "Neural networks and physical systems with emergent collective computational abilities" in *PNAS* 79(8):2554-2558. By constructing a symmetrically fully connected binary neural network and introducing an "energy function," he proved that network states would descend along the energy gradient to converge at an attractor (local minimum). Storing a memory meant carving an attractor into the energy landscape, while feeding the network a partial input was like letting a ball roll back into the nearest depression—suddenly giving neural networks physical intuition, rather than just psychological modeling.
events.card_summary_en: Hopfield used an energy function to explain how networks settle into stable memories.
events.why_it_matters_en: Hopfield networks were never the engineering workhorse, but they put the claim that neural networks can compute back on the table. Without that kick, Rumelhart-Hinton-Williams's 1986 backpropagation might have found no audience. Much of today's deep learning world has forgotten the line, yet Hopfield shared the 2024 Nobel Prize in Physics with Hinton precisely for this reconnection of physics and neural networks.
events.behind_scenes_en: Timing was decisive. 1982 sat near the end of the first AI winter, with neural networks all but forgotten in mainstream AI circles. Hopfield was a physicist, not an AI insider, and publishing in PNAS instead of an AI journal neatly bypassed the biases of symbolic reviewers. His continuous Hopfield network of 1984 and optimization-computation papers with Tank in 1985 brought networks back into mainstream view, paving the road straight to 1986's PDP volumes and backpropagation.

events.title_zh: 日本第五代计算机计划:国家级 AI 投入的范式样本
events.title_en: Japanese Fifth Generation Computer Systems Project
events.summary_zh:
1982 年 4 月,日本通产省(MITI)正式启动"第五代计算机系统(FGCS)"计划,由 ICOT(新一代计算机技术开发研究所)执行,总投入约 570 亿日元(约 3-4 亿美元),为期 10 年。
目标是用 Prolog 作为核心语言,把并行推理硬件化,造出能直接处理知识推理的"第五代计算机",超越冯诺依曼架构。
计划在 1992 年结束,达成硬件原型(PSI、PIM)和 KL1(Kernel Language 1)等 Prolog 编译器,但没有实现预期的"知识信息处理"突破。
events.source_name: Feigenbaum, E. A. & McCorduck, P. (1983). The Fifth Generation; ICOT Final Report 1992
events.card_summary_zh: 日本第五代计算机计划：国家级 AI 投入的范式样本；FGCS 是“国家级 AI 大投入 ≠ 技术路线正确”的典型样本。
events.summary_en: In April 1982, Japan's Ministry of International Trade and Industry (MITI) launched the 10-year "Fifth Generation Computer Systems" (FGCS) initiative, executed by the Institute for New Generation Computer Technology (ICOT) with a total investment of roughly 57 billion yen (about $300-400 million). The goal was to bypass the Von Neumann architecture by using Prolog as the core language to implement parallel inference in hardware, building a "fifth-generation computer" capable of directly processing knowledge inference. Although the project concluded in 1992 and yielded hardware prototypes (PSI, PIM) and Prolog compilers like KL1 (Kernel Language 1), it failed to deliver the anticipated breakthrough in "knowledge information processing."
events.card_summary_en: Japan poured national funding into logic-based AI hardware, and the Fifth Generation project became the classic lesson that big budgets do not guarantee the right technical route.
events.why_it_matters_en: FGCS is the textbook case of national-scale AI investment backing the wrong paradigm. It holds three warnings for today's government AI strategies: policy should not dictate technical routes, hardware bets should not be locked to one architecture, and concentrated resources do not always beat distributed exploration in basic research.
events.behind_scenes_en: FGCS is one of the most dramatic episodes in 1980s AI politics. When MITI opened the first FGCS conference in Tokyo in 1981, Western AI researchers felt a wave of panic about being overtaken, which directly pushed DARPA to launch its Strategic Computing Initiative in 1983 as a counterattack. The root cause of failure was a wrong technical bet: hardwiring symbolic inference was unrealistic given 1980s computing power and compiler technology, while Rumelhart's 1986 backpropagation work had already shifted the field toward statistical learning. The symbolic-inference-hardware line was simply abandoned by the times.

events.title_zh: DARPA 战略计算计划:美国国家级 AI 反击
events.title_en: DARPA Strategic Computing Initiative
events.summary_zh:
1983 年 10 月,DARPA 启动 Strategic Computing Initiative(SCI),为期 10 年,总预算 10 亿美元,是美国对日本 FGCS 计划的直接回应。
SCI 三个支柱:1. 智能武器(自主巡航导弹、坦克火控系统)2. 智能飞行员助手(语音交互、战术规划)3. 智能自主载具(Naval Battle Management)项目资助 CMU、MIT、斯坦福、SRI 等核心 AI 实验室,并推动 MIPS RISC、Warp 并行机、CMU 自主驾驶 Navlab 等硬件平台。
events.source_name: Kahn, R. (1983). Strategic Computing Plan, DARPA; Roland & Shiman (2002) Strategic Computing
events.card_summary_zh: DARPA 战略计算计划：美国国家级 AI 反击；SCI 是“国家级 AI 投入怎么有效、怎么失效”的早期样本。
events.summary_en: In October 1983, DARPA launched the Strategic Computing Initiative (SCI), a 10-year, $1 billion program serving as America’s direct response to Japan's FGCS project. The initiative targeted three pillars: autonomous weapons (autonomous cruise missiles, tank fire-control systems), an intelligent pilot associate (voice interaction, tactical planning), and smart autonomous vehicles (Naval Battle Management). It funded core AI labs at CMU, MIT, Stanford, and SRI, while driving hardware platforms like MIPS RISC, the Warp parallel machine, and CMU's autonomous driving Navlab.
events.card_summary_en: DARPA answered Japan's AI push with its own national program, and the Strategic Computing Initiative became an early case study in when state AI funding works and when it fails.
events.why_it_matters_en: SCI is an early sample of how national AI investment both succeeds and fails. It worked by funding a generation of AI researchers and pushing RISC hardware and autonomous-driving prototypes. It failed through grandiose goals and a fixation on symbolic AI at the expense of statistical learning. Today's national AI strategies across the US, EU, and China all repeat SCI's pattern, making its success and failure conditions worth studying.
events.behind_scenes_en: SCI was born under combined Cold War and economic pressure. After Japan announced FGCS in 1981, the American AI community panicked. Robert Kahn, then director of DARPA IPTO, led the writing of the SCI strategy document, elevating AI to a strategic technology on par with SDI. SCI's lavish funding from 1983 to 1988 carried the field through the approach of the second winter, but the Cold War ended in 1991 and SCI's evaluation came back poor. The deep cuts from 1991 to 1993 triggered the darkest phase of the second AI winter.

events.title_zh: Cyc 项目:常识知识库的漫长实验
events.title_en: Cyc Project: Long Experiment on Common Sense Knowledge Base
events.summary_zh:
1984 年 9 月,Douglas Lenat 在 MCC(Microelectronics and Computer Consortium)启动 Cyc 项目,目标是手工构建覆盖人类常识的百万级知识库。
Cyc 用谓词逻辑表达事实(“水是液体”“人会死”),用规则表达推理(“如果 X 是液体,则 X 会流动”)。
1995 年 Cyc 分拆出 Cycorp 公司,继续独立维护。
到 2024 年 Cyc 累计录入约 250 万条公理、3 万谓词,覆盖日常物理、生物、社会、法律等领域。
events.source_name: Lenat, D. B. & Guha, R. V. (1989). Building Large Knowledge-Based Systems; Cycorp 2024
events.card_summary_zh: Cyc 项目：常识知识库的漫长实验；Cyc 是“符号 AI 路线能做到什么程度”的极限测试。
events.summary_en: In September 1984, Douglas Lenat launched the Cyc project at the Microelectronics and Computer Consortium (MCC), aiming to manually build a million-scale knowledge base of human common sense. Cyc used predicate logic to represent facts (like "water is liquid" and "humans die") and rules to represent reasoning (such as "if X is a liquid, then X flows"). Spun off into Cycorp in 1995 for independent maintenance, the project had accumulated about 2.5 million axioms and 30,000 predicates by 2024, covering domains like everyday physics, biology, society, and law.
events.card_summary_en: Douglas Lenat began building Cyc, a commonsense knowledge base, and turned it into a forty-year stress test of how far symbolic AI can actually go.
events.why_it_matters_en: Cyc is the ultimate test of what the symbolic AI route can achieve. Its core failure was not weak technology but the discovery that common sense is fundamentally statistical rather than rule-based. Today's debates about knowledge bases versus neural networks and explicit versus implicit knowledge still lean on Cyc's four decades of comparative data. Understanding Cyc explains why mainstream AI pivoted entirely to data-driven methods after 2012.
events.behind_scenes_en: Cyc was the most ambitious engineering project of symbolic AI. In 1984 Lenat estimated it would take 30 years and 25 million rules to cover human common sense, a timetable never met. Through the 1990s Cyc faced repeated criticism: rule counts did not translate into reasoning quality, common sense resisted decomposition into discrete rules, and maintenance costs grew exponentially with scale. After 2000, LLMs solved the commonsense problem with big data and statistics, marginalizing Cyc in mainstream research. But Cycorp kept maintaining and extending it, now positioning Cyc as a knowledge-alignment tool for LLMs.

events.title_zh: 专家系统商业化受挫:规则维护成本失控
events.title_en: Expert System Commercialization Stalls: Rule Maintenance Costs Explode
events.summary_zh:
1985 年前后,大量模仿 XCON 的企业级专家系统项目开始集中暴露问题。
核心瓶颈是“知识获取瓶颈(Knowledge Acquisition Bottleneck)”:让工程师坐在医生、律师、地质学家身边,试图把他们的隐性经验拆成规则,几乎不可行。
领域专家自己说不清自己怎么判断,工程师抄出来的规则上线后,遇到边缘案例就崩溃。
XCON 自己的规则库到 1986 年已膨胀到上千至上万条,每条新规则都要检查和旧规则是否冲突,维护成本指数级上升。
events.source_name: Feigenbaum, E. A. (1977) IJCAI Keynote; Crevier (1993); Russell & Norvig AIAMA 1.4
events.card_summary_zh: 专家系统在真实环境中遭遇规则爆炸和维护失控，行业开始意识到把专家经验写成规则远比预想困难。
events.summary_en: Around 1985, numerous enterprise expert system projects mimicking XCON began to face widespread issues, driven by the "Knowledge Acquisition Bottleneck"—the near-impossible task of having engineers shadow doctors, lawyers, and geologists to translate their tacit experience into rules. Domain experts struggled to explain their own decision-making, and the rules engineers transcribed frequently crashed when encountering edge cases in production. By 1986, XCON’s own database had bloated to thousands to tens of thousands of rules, sending maintenance costs soaring exponentially as every new rule had to be checked for conflicts with existing ones.
events.card_summary_en: Expert systems hit a wall of exploding rule counts and maintenance costs, and the industry learned that encoding expert knowledge is far harder than expected.
events.why_it_matters_en: The knowledge acquisition bottleneck was the fatal flaw of symbolic AI, and the very reason connectionism and statistical learning rose. Today's LLM-based knowledge extraction, RAG systems, and agent toolchains are all detours around the trap of having humans hand-write rules. Seeing the 1985 failure clearly explains why the LLM route scales better in engineering than expert systems ever did.
events.behind_scenes_en: The bottleneck was not new. Feigenbaum had flagged knowledge engineering as AI's central obstacle in his 1977 IJCAI lecture, but XCON's success buried the warning. After 1985 companies discovered that a version-1.0 expert system could ship in three months, yet versions 2.0 and 3.0 demanded endless rule additions, edits, and conflict checks, with total costs blowing past budgets. The same trap later caught IBM Watson, Cyc, and other large-scale knowledge engineering projects.

events.title_zh: Quinlan ID3:决策树机器学习的工程起点
events.title_en: Quinlan ID3: Engineering Origin of Decision Tree Learning
events.summary_zh:
1986 年 3 月,Ross Quinlan 在 Machine Learning 1(1):81-106 发表《Induction of Decision Trees》。
ID3 用信息增益(Information Gain)选择分裂属性,递归构造决策树,把表格数据自动转成可解释的判断规则。
1993 年 Quinlan 扩展为 C4.5,处理连续属性、缺失值、剪枝,C4.5 成为基础机器学习教科书的核心算法。
决策树路线后来在 2001 年 Breiman Random Forest、2014 年 Chen XGBoost、2017 年 Ke LightGBM 上达到工业顶峰。
events.source_name: Quinlan, J. R. (1986). Machine Learning 1(1):81-106; (1993) C4.5: Programs for Machine Learning
events.card_summary_zh: ID3 用信息增益自动选择判断条件，让决策树成为易解释、可复现并能处理真实数据的机器学习工具。
events.summary_en: In March 1986, Ross Quinlan published "Induction of Decision Trees" in *Machine Learning* 1(1):81-106, introducing ID3, which used Information Gain to select splitting attributes and recursively construct decision trees that automatically converted tabular data into interpretable decision rules. Quinlan expanded this in 1993 into C4.5 to handle continuous attributes, missing values, and pruning, cementing it as a foundational algorithm in machine learning textbooks. The decision tree lineage eventually reached its industrial peak with Breiman's Random Forest in 2001, Chen's XGBoost in 2014, and Ke's LightGBM in 2017.
events.card_summary_en: Ross Quinlan's ID3 used information gain to pick decision conditions automatically, turning decision trees into interpretable machine learning that handles real data.
events.why_it_matters_en: ID3 was an early pillar of practical machine learning. During the second AI winter of the 1990s, decision trees became the most widely deployed models in banking, insurance, and retail precisely because they were explainable and easy to ship. Today's debates about black-box versus interpretable models still treat decision trees as the reference standard for explainable AI.
events.behind_scenes_en: Quinlan did this work at the University of Sydney, drawing on Hunt's 1979 CLS concept-learning system and his own frustration in a 1983 expert-system project where hand-extracting rules was painfully slow. His key insight: rather than having people write rules, let the machine induce them from examples. The idea fit the connectionist revival of 1986 but took a middle path of symbols plus learning, later growing into an important branch of explainable AI.

events.title_zh: PDP 两卷本:连接主义的认知科学宣言
events.title_en: Parallel Distributed Processing: Connectionism Manifesto
events.summary_zh:
1986 年 7 月,MIT Press 出版两卷本《Parallel Distributed Processing: Explorations in the Microstructure of Cognition》(Rumelhart, McClelland, PDP Research Group)。
Volume 1: Foundations, Volume 2: Psychological and Biological Models。
PDP 把认知建模、神经网络、心理实验、神经科学统一在一个框架下:知识分布在大量简单单元的连接里,学习 = 调整连接权重,记忆 = 网络状态吸引子,思维 = 多个模块并行协作。
这是连接主义对符号主义的一次正面宣言。
events.source_name: Rumelhart, D. E., McClelland, J. L., PDP Research Group (1986). MIT Press, 2 vols
events.card_summary_zh: 《并行分布式处理》为神经网络建立完整的认知科学叙事，连接主义不再只是零散算法。
events.summary_en: In July 1986, MIT Press published the two-volume *Parallel Distributed Processing: Explorations in the Microstructure of Cognition* (Rumelhart, McClelland, PDP Research Group), consisting of *Volume 1: Foundations* and *Volume 2: Psychological and Biological Models*. The PDP framework unified cognitive modeling, neural networks, psychological experiments, and neuroscience under a single premise: knowledge is distributed across connections of simple units, learning is adjusting connection weights, memory is network state attractors, and thinking is the parallel collaboration of multiple modules. This served as connectionism’s direct manifesto against symbolism.
events.card_summary_en: The two-volume Parallel Distributed Processing gave neural networks a full cognitive-science narrative, turning connectionism from scattered algorithms into a coherent movement.
events.why_it_matters_en: PDP gave neural networks an entire cognitive-science story, not just engineering tricks. It shaped every post-1990s research paradigm of distributed representation, learning, and emergence, including the emergence capabilities, representation alignment, and chain-of-thought discussions around today's LLMs. Understanding PDP explains why Hinton held onto the belief that intelligence is learned connection patterns for his entire career.
events.behind_scenes_en: PDP was not a paper collection but a paradigm revolution. Rumelhart and McClelland assembled the PDP Research Group at UCSD in the 1980s, with members including Hinton, Sejnowski, Smolensky, and Cleeremans, who would become connectionism's core force. The two most consequential chapters: Volume 1 Chapter 8, where Rumelhart, Hinton, and Williams published backpropagation months before the Nature paper, and Volume 2 Chapter 19, where McClelland simulated children overregularizing language with a PDP model. The latter directly challenged Chomsky's innate-grammar hypothesis, igniting the 1988-1990 connectionism-versus-symbolism war in cognitive science.

events.title_zh: Rumelhart-Hinton-Williams 反向传播:深度学习的工程起点
events.title_en: Rumelhart-Hinton-Williams Backpropagation Paper
events.summary_zh:
1986 年 10 月 9 日,Nature 323:533-536 发表《Learning representations by back-propagating errors》(Rumelhart, Hinton, Williams)。
论文把反向模式自动微分明确应用在多层神经网络上,给出干净的可计算梯度公式,让隐藏层权重可以用 SGD 更新。
虽然 Linnainmaa 1970 给过算法、Werbos 1974 在 PhD 里用过,但这篇 Nature 论文让 BP 成为 AI 圈共同语言,是深度学习工程化的真正起点。
events.source_name: Rumelhart, D. E., Hinton, G. E., Williams, R. J. (1986). Nature 323:533-536
events.card_summary_zh: 反向传播让多层神经网络能够系统地修正误差，沉寂已久的连接主义终于获得可训练的工程方法。
events.summary_en: On October 9, 1986, *Nature* 323:533-536 published "Learning representations by back-propagating errors" (Rumelhart, Hinton, Williams), which explicitly applied reverse-mode automatic differentiation to multilayer neural networks, providing a clean, computable gradient formula to update hidden layer weights via SGD. Although Linnainmaa had proposed the algorithm in 1970 and Werbos used it in his 1974 PhD, this paper made BP the common language of the AI community, marking the true starting point of deep learning engineering.
events.card_summary_en: Rumelhart, Hinton, and Williams published backpropagation in Nature, giving multilayer neural networks a systematic way to fix their errors and reviving connectionism.
events.why_it_matters_en: This four-page paper was ground zero for deep learning engineering. The training pipelines behind GPT, Stable Diffusion, and AlphaFold all extend that 1986 move of fitting reverse-mode automatic differentiation into neural networks. Tracing the three-step line of Linnainmaa 1970, Werbos 1974, and RHW 1986 shows why inventing backpropagation and making it matter were two different events.
events.behind_scenes_en: Before 1986 Rumelhart studied cognitive models within the PDP framework; backpropagation was originally meant to solve how multilayer networks learn internal representations. Hinton was working on Boltzmann machines and Williams on reinforcement learning when the three co-wrote the short paper as a byproduct of the PDP project. Publishing in Nature was decisive: it bypassed the symbolic bias of AI journal reviewers and pulled neural networks back into mainstream science. Hinton's 2024 Nobel Prize in Physics, shared with Hopfield, cited precisely this line of work.

events.title_zh: 第二次 AI 寒冬:LISP 机崩盘与专家系统时代结束
events.title_en: Second AI Winter: LISP Machine Collapse and End of Expert System Era
events.summary_zh:
1987-1993 年是 AI 史上最长的寒冬,起点是 1987 年下半年 LISP 机市场崩盘。
Symbolics、LMI 两家 LISP 机厂商销售额断崖式下跌,到 1988 年 Symbolics 破产保护,LMI 关闭;通用工作站(Sun、DEC、SGI)在性能价格比上全面碾压专用 LISP 硬件,AI 公司的硬件护城河一夜消失。
顶点是 1991 年 DARPA SCI 计划大幅削减 AI 通用资助,日本 FGCS 1992 年结算失败,结束点是 1993 年专家系统产业产值跌回 1980 年水平。
这六年间,CMU、MIT、斯坦福、SRI 的 AI 实验室经费腰斩,毕业生就业困难,大批研究者转向其他领域。
events.source_name: Crevier, G. (1993). AI: The Tumultuous History; Russell & Norvig AIAMA 4th ed Ch 1.4
events.card_summary_zh: LISP 机器市场崩盘、专家系统维护成本失控，AI 再次从资本宠儿跌入长期降温期。
events.summary_en: Triggered by the late-1987 collapse of the LISP machine market, the longest winter in AI history (1987–1993) saw sales at Symbolics and LMI plummet—leading to Symbolics' 1988 bankruptcy filing and LMI's closure—as general-purpose workstations from Sun, DEC, and SGI wiped out AI hardware moats overnight by dominating on price-performance. The crisis peaked when DARPA drastically cut general AI funding for its SCI program in 1991 and Japan’s FGCS concluded in failure in 1992, before finally ending in 1993 when the expert systems industry's output value fell back to 1980 levels. Over these six years, budgets at AI labs across CMU, MIT, Stanford, and SRI were halved, leaving graduates struggling to find jobs and driving a mass exodus of researchers to other fields.
events.card_summary_en: LISP machine prices collapsed and expert systems became unsustainable, dropping AI from capital-market darling into a long cooling period known as the second winter.
events.why_it_matters_en: The second winter moved AI's center of gravity from expert systems plus symbolic reasoning toward statistical learning and neural networks, and forged the low-profile culture of 1990-2010: no grand promises, prove a small use case first. That culture let Hinton's 2006 DBN and AlexNet in 2012 build up solidly instead of being hyped to death. Today's generative AI narrative looks nearly identical to the 1984 expert-system bubble, so understanding this winter helps recognize today's risk signals.
events.behind_scenes_en: It was a triple blow hitting simultaneously. Hardware: general workstations crushed LISP machines on price-performance, turning specialized hardware into dead weight. Business: XCON-style systems had been copied en masse into medicine, law, and finance by 1984-1986, where maintenance costs exploded, rule bases aged, and errors resisted diagnosis, so ROI failed and investors withdrew. Policy: DARPA settled accounts on SCI in 1991 and Japan's FGCS wound up unsuccessfully in 1992. The winter ran deeper than 1974 because the first was about unkept promises while this one was about broken business models. But seeds survived: LeCun's 1989 CNN, Scholkopf's 1995 SVM, and Hochreiter's 1997 LSTM were all written inside it.

events.title_zh: Pearl 贝叶斯网络:让概率推理进入 AI
events.title_en: Pearl Bayesian Networks: Probabilistic Reasoning Enters AI
events.summary_zh:
1985-1988 年,UCLA 的 Judea Pearl 系统化提出贝叶斯网络(Bayesian Network),1988 年 9 月由 Morgan Kaufmann 出版《Probabilistic Reasoning in Intelligent Systems: Networks of Plausible Inference》。
贝叶斯网络用有向无环图(DAG)表达变量间的条件依赖,节点 = 随机变量,边 = 条件概率关系。
推理 = 在 DAG 上做信念传播(Belief Propagation)。
这把概率推理从模糊的“不确定性”变成可计算、可可视化的结构。
events.source_name: Pearl, J. (1988). Probabilistic Reasoning in Intelligent Systems. Morgan Kaufmann; Turing Award 2011
events.card_summary_zh: 贝叶斯网络让机器能够在信息不完整时更新判断，概率推理从此进入 AI 的核心工具箱。
events.summary_en: Between 1985 and 1988, UCLA’s Judea Pearl systematized the Bayesian Network, culminating in the September 1988 publication of *Probabilistic Reasoning in Intelligent Systems: Networks of Plausible Inference* by Morgan Kaufmann. By representing conditional dependencies among variables using directed acyclic graphs (DAGs)—where nodes are random variables and edges represent conditional probability relationships—inference is executed through belief propagation on the DAG. This transformed probabilistic reasoning from a vague concept of "uncertainty" into a computable, visualizable structure.
events.card_summary_en: Judea Pearl's Bayesian networks let machines update judgments under incomplete information, bringing probabilistic reasoning into AI's core toolbox.
events.why_it_matters_en: Bayesian networks were the workhorse of probabilistic AI from 1990 to 2010, widely used in medical diagnosis, fault localization, language understanding, and recommendation. LLMs have absorbed many of those applications, but in high-stakes domains like healthcare, law, and insurance, Bayesian networks remain the first choice for explainable inference. Pearl's causal framework is also the theoretical coordinate system for today's debates about whether LLMs can do causal reasoning.
events.behind_scenes_en: Pearl introduced the Bayesian network framework at the UAI conference in 1985 and spent 1986-1988 publishing a dense series of papers completing the theory. His core insight: uncertainty in expert systems could not be fixed by bolting on confidence scores; causal structure and probabilistic reasoning had to be modeled separately. He later extended the framework into causal inference with do-calculus, winning the Turing Award in 2011. Much of the current discourse on correlation versus causation in LLMs still speaks Pearl's language.

events.title_zh: Watkins Q-learning:强化学习的核心算法
events.title_en: Watkins Q-learning: Core Algorithm of Reinforcement Learning
events.summary_zh:
1989 年,Christopher Watkins 在剑桥大学提交博士论文《Learning from Delayed Rewards》。
提出 Q-learning 算法:智能体在状态 s 下采取动作 a,观察到奖励 r 和下一状态 s',更新 Q(s,a) ← Q(s,a) + α[r + γ max Q(s',a') - Q(s,a)]。
这是 off-policy 时序差分学习的关键形式,在足够探索和衰减学习率下可证明收敛到最优 Q 函数。
Q-learning 与 Sutton 1984/1988 的 TD(λ) 同属时序差分家族,但二者有别:Q-learning 是 off-policy 的动作价值迭代,TD(λ) 是状态价值预测。1992 年 Tesauro 的 TD-Gammon 用的是 TD(λ)(而非 Q-learning)在西洋双陆棋上达到接近顶尖选手水平,让主流重新关注强化学习。
events.source_name: Watkins, C. J. C. H. (1989). PhD thesis, University of Cambridge; (1992) Machine Learning 8(3-4)
events.card_summary_zh: Q-learning 让智能体不必知道环境模型，也能通过试错逼近最优策略，成为强化学习最经典的起点之一。
events.summary_en: In 1989, Christopher Watkins submitted his University of Cambridge PhD thesis, *Learning from Delayed Rewards*, introducing the Q-learning algorithm, where an agent in state s takes action a, observes reward r and next state s', and updates Q(s,a) ← Q(s,a) + α[r + γ max Q(s',a') - Q(s,a)]. This key form of off-policy temporal difference learning provably converges to the optimal Q-function given sufficient exploration and a decaying learning rate. Though sharing the temporal difference family with Sutton’s 1984/1988 TD(λ), Q-learning differs as an off-policy action-value iteration rather than a state-value prediction; indeed, it was TD(λ) (not Q-learning) that revived mainstream interest in reinforcement learning when Tesauro’s TD-Gammon used it in 1992 to play backgammon at a level close to top-tier players.
events.card_summary_en: Chris Watkins' Q-learning let agents approach optimal strategies through trial and error without any model of the environment, becoming reinforcement learning's most classic starting point.
events.why_it_matters_en: Q-learning was ground zero for reinforcement learning engineering. PPO, the core algorithm of AlphaGo, AlphaStar, and ChatGPT's RLHF stage, all build on Q-learning's temporal-difference framework. Tracing Watkins' 1989 line makes clear that DQN in 2015 and PPO in 2017 were not sudden arrivals but the eruption of thirty years of RL engineering.
events.behind_scenes_en: Watkins wrote his 1989 thesis at the deepest point of the second AI winter, when reinforcement learning was a backwater built mainly on Bellman's 1957 dynamic programming, Sutton's 1984 TD(lambda), and Barto's 1983 actor-critic. Q-learning's key contribution was cleanly separating exploration from exploitation: off-policy learning lets an agent collect data with any behavior policy while the Q function still converges to optimal. DeepMind's DQN breakthrough on Atari from 2013 to 2015 was essentially Q-learning plus a neural network.

events.title_zh: Berners-Lee 提出万维网:AI 的语料基础
events.title_en: Berners-Lee Proposes the World Wide Web
events.summary_zh:
1989 年 3 月 12 日,Tim Berners-Lee 在 CERN 提交《Information Management: A Proposal》备忘录,提出用超链接把 CERN 内部散落的研究文档连成可浏览网络。
1990 年 12 月他与 Robert Cailliau 提交正式立项书,同月完成第一个 Web 服务器(info.cern.ch)和第一个浏览器(WorldWideWeb)。
1991 年 8 月 6 日 Web 正式对外公开,1993 年 CERN 宣布 Web 免费开放,1994 年 W3C 成立。
events.source_name: Berners-Lee, T. (1989). Information Management: A Proposal, CERN; (1990) WorldWideWeb: Proposal
events.card_summary_zh: Berners-Lee 提出万维网：AI 的语料基础，并成为这一阶段值得追踪的关键变化。
events.summary_en: On March 12, 1989, Tim Berners-Lee submitted his "Information Management: A Proposal" memo at CERN, proposing to link the organization's scattered research documents into a browsable network using hyperlinks. In December 1990, he and Robert Cailliau submitted a formal proposal, completing the first Web server (info.cern.ch) and first browser (WorldWideWeb) that same month. The Web officially went public on August 6, 1991, followed by CERN announcing it would be free to everyone in 1993, and the founding of the W3C in 1994.
events.card_summary_en: Tim Berners-Lee proposed the World Wide Web at CERN, laying the corpus foundation that large-scale AI would depend on decades later.
events.why_it_matters_en: Without the Web there is no Google, Wikipedia, or Stack Overflow, and none of the massive corpora LLM training requires. Today's debates about data scarcity, open versus closed models, and scraping compliance all rest on this infrastructure layer. The 1989 memo remains badly underrated in AI history: it was ground zero for the next thirty years of the AI data ecosystem.
events.behind_scenes_en: Berners-Lee's pain point was concrete: CERN's thousands of researchers came and went, with documents scattered across different machines, directories, and hands, so finding one experimental dataset often meant emailing half the lab. His manager called the proposal vague but exciting, and it only formally launched in 1990 after he hand-built a server and browser on a NeXT machine. Openness was the decisive choice: CERN dropped patent claims in 1993, making the Web public infrastructure, which is what later allowed search engines, Wikipedia, open-source code, and large-scale corpora to exist.

events.title_zh: LeCun 卷积网络:神经网走进银行与邮局
events.title_en: LeCun Convolutional Network for Handwriting Recognition
events.summary_zh:
1989 年冬,Yann LeCun 等人在 Neural Computation 1(4):541-551 发表《Backpropagation Applied to Handwritten Zip Code Recognition》。
这是第一个真正可用的工业级卷积神经网络,用于 USPS 邮政编码识别,输入 16×16 像素,3 个卷积隐藏层,约 1000 个神经元。
1993 年 LeCun 团队进一步在 AT&T 部署商业版本 LeNet,用于 NCR 的支票自动读取,美国 90% 的支票金额识别都跑在 LeNet 上。
这是神经网络第一次大规模进入生产环境。
events.source_name: LeCun, Y. et al. (1989). Neural Computation 1(4):541-551; (1998) Proc. IEEE 86(11)
events.card_summary_zh: LeCun 的卷积网络开始真实识别银行支票和邮政编码，神经网络第一次从论文走进日常工业系统。
events.summary_en: In the winter of 1989, Yann LeCun et al. published "Backpropagation Applied to Handwritten Zip Code Recognition" in *Neural Computation* 1(4):541-551, introducing the first truly usable, industrial-grade convolutional neural network, which recognized USPS zip codes using a 16x16 pixel input, three convolutional hidden layers, and about 1,000 neurons. By 1993, LeCun's team deployed a commercial version, LeNet, at AT&T for NCR's automatic check reading, with 90% of US check amount recognition running on LeNet. This marked the first time neural networks entered a production environment on a large scale.
events.card_summary_en: Yann LeCun's convolutional network started reading bank checks and postal codes in production, moving neural networks from papers into everyday industrial systems for the first time.
events.why_it_matters_en: LeCun's 1989 paper was ground zero for CNN engineering. It proved backpropagation-trained networks could run inside real businesses, giving connectionism a lifeline at the coldest moment of the second AI winter. AlexNet in 2012 was essentially LeNet scaled up and trained on GPUs; the technical route was already set in 1989 and simply waited for compute to catch up.
events.behind_scenes_en: LeCun finished his PhD under Hinton and joined AT&T Bell Labs in 1988, which had a USPS contract for handwritten ZIP code recognition. The traditional pipeline of hand-crafted features plus a classifier managed roughly 80% accuracy. LeCun fed raw pixels straight into a convolutional network trained with RHW backpropagation, and the first version hit above 95%, far beyond anything prior. The conv-pooling-fully-connected structure became the template for AlexNet and ResNet. When LeCun won the Turing Award in 2018, this line was the core citation.

events.title_zh: TD(λ) 与游戏强化学习路线确立
events.title_en: TD(λ) and Game Reinforcement Learning Established
events.summary_zh:
1990 年,Gerald Tesauro（IBM Thomas J. Watson 研究中心）在 IJCNN 发表《Neurogammon: A Neural Network Backgammon Program》,程序还赢得 1989 年首届 Computer Olympiad 西洋双陆棋组。
这是第一个用神经网络 + 监督学习达到中等水平西洋双陆棋的程序。
1992 年 8 月 Tesauro 在 AAAI Fall Symposium 报告 TD-Gammon 1.0,用 Sutton 1984 博士论文提出的 TD(λ) 时序差分学习规则,80 个隐藏单元的两层神经网络通过自我对弈约 30 万局,首次达到与人类专家持平的水平(WR 0.81)。
1993 年 TD-Gammon 2.0 加入监督学习预训练,达到世界级水平;1996 年 TD-Gammon 3.0 与世界冠军 Bill Robertie 对弈 100 局,平均每 100 局仅输 1-2 局,接近顶级人类水平。
TD-Gammon 是强化学习第一次在复杂策略游戏中达到人类顶级水平,为 2015 年 DeepMind DQN、2016 年 AlphaGo 铺平道路。
events.source_name: Tesauro, G. (1989) Computer Olympiad; (1990) IJCNN; (1992) AAAI Fall Symposium; (1995) Communications of the ACM 38(3):58-68; (1995) Machine Learning 15(3):205-230; Robertie, B. (1998) Inside Backgammon
events.card_summary_zh: TD(λ) 与游戏强化学习路线确立；TD-Gammon 是 AlphaGo 的史前版本。
events.summary_en: At IJCNN in 1990, Gerald Tesauro of the IBM Thomas J. Watson Research Center published "Neurogammon: A Neural Network Backgammon Program"—the first system to use neural networks and supervised learning to reach intermediate-level play, which also won the backgammon division at the inaugural 1989 Computer Olympiad. In August 1992, Tesauro presented TD-Gammon 1.0 at the AAAI Fall Symposium; using the TD(λ) temporal difference learning rule from Sutton’s 1984 PhD thesis, its two-layer, 80-hidden-unit neural network played about 300,000 self-play games to match human experts for the first time (WR 0.81), a benchmark later elevated by 1993's world-class TD-Gammon 2.0 (which added supervised pre-training) and 1996's TD-Gammon 3.0, which approached top human levels by losing just 1–2 games per 100 on average against world champion Bill Robertie. As the first instance of reinforcement learning achieving top-tier human performance in a complex strategy game, TD-Gammon paved the way for DeepMind's DQN in 2015 and AlphaGo in 2016.
events.card_summary_en: Gerald Tesauro's TD-Gammon learned backgammon purely by playing itself, proving self-play plus neural networks could master complex games, a preview of AlphaGo.
events.why_it_matters_en: TD-Gammon is AlphaGo's prehistoric ancestor. It proved that self-play, neural networks, and temporal-difference learning could master a strategic game and even discover strategies human experts had missed, the same core recipe behind AlphaGo, AlphaZero, and ChatGPT's RLHF. The 2016 breakthrough was not a sudden arrival but the eruption of twenty-five years of RL engineering.
events.behind_scenes_en: Tesauro built TD-Gammon at IBM Research as something close to a side project. TD(lambda) came from Sutton's 1984 dissertation; Tesauro combined it with a neural network so the program learned its evaluation function from scratch through win-loss feedback. With no human expert rules at all, it taught itself opening moves that experts considered mistakes, until analysis showed TD-Gammon's choices were actually stronger, reshaping human opening theory. That early case of AI surpassing expert intuition structurally resembles AlphaGo's move 37 in 2016. Through the 1990s it was RL's only widely cited success, carrying the field through the second winter.

events.title_zh: Loebner Prize 首届图灵测试竞赛
events.title_en: First Loebner Prize Turing Test Competition
events.summary_zh:
1991 年 11 月 8 日,首届 Loebner Prize 在波士顿计算机博物馆举办。
Hugh Loebner 赞助 10 万美元奖金,目标找一台能在文字对话中骗过人类裁判的机器。
首届冠军是 Joseph Weintraub 的 PC Therapist,靠“心理治疗师”设定回避实质问题,在“陌生人聊天”里骗到 5 名裁判中的 3 名。
Loebner Prize 之后每年举办直到 2019 年,从未有机器达到 Loebner 定义的“完全通过图灵测试”标准。
events.source_name: Loebner, H. (1991). Communications of the ACM 34(2); Shieber, S. (1994) AI Magazine 15(3)
events.card_summary_zh: Loebner Prize 首届图灵测试竞赛；Loebner Prize 是“图灵测试作为评测范式”的长期实验。
events.summary_en: On November 8, 1991, the inaugural Loebner Prize was held at the Boston Computer Museum, offering a $100,000 prize sponsored by Hugh Loebner to find a machine that could fool human judges in text-based conversations. The first winner was Joseph Weintraub's PC Therapist, which avoided substantive issues by adopting a "therapist" persona, fooling three out of five judges in a "stranger chat." The competition ran annually until 2019, but no machine ever met Loebner's criteria for "completely passing the Turing test."
events.card_summary_en: The first Loebner Prize turned the Turing test into an annual contest, beginning a long experiment in whether fooling humans can measure machine intelligence.
events.why_it_matters_en: The Loebner Prize tested the Turing test as an evaluation paradigm and showed its limits: using can-it-deceive-humans as the standard fails because humans are easily manipulated by social engineering. Today's LLMs far exceed Loebner-era programs on such tests, yet the field abandoned the Turing test as a benchmark in favor of quantifiable ones like MMLU, HumanEval, and SWE-Bench.
events.behind_scenes_en: The prize stayed controversial from the start. In 1995 Marvin Minsky joined more than ninety AI researchers signing a petition arguing the contest rewarded clever trickery rather than intelligence, urging Loebner to withdraw it. He refused, and the contest ran until his death in 2019. When the University of Reading organized Turing Test 2014, Eugene Goostman deceived 33% of judges behind a persona of a Ukrainian thirteen-year-old learning English, lowering the bar exactly the way PC Therapist's tricks did back in 1991.

events.title_zh: Mosaic 1.0 发布:Web 走出学术圈
events.title_en: Mosaic 1.0 Released: Web Goes Beyond Academia
events.summary_zh:
1993 年 4 月 22 日,NCSA 发布 Mosaic 1.0 for Windows 浏览器,由 Marc Andreessen 和 Eric Bina 在伊利诺伊大学开发。
Mosaic 是第一个支持图文混排、跨平台(Windows/Mac/Unix)、易安装的图形浏览器,把 Web 从 CERN 学术工具变成大众消费品。
1994 年 Andreessen 离开 NCSA 创办 Netscape,1994 年 12 月 Netscape Navigator 1.0 发布,1995 年 8 月 Netscape 上市,Internet 时代正式开启。
events.source_name: NCSA Mosaic 1.0 announcement (1993-04-22); Andreessen interviews
events.card_summary_zh: Mosaic 1.0 发布：Web 走出学术圈；Mosaic 是 Web 大众化的起点。
events.summary_en: On April 22, 1993, NCSA released the Mosaic 1.0 for Windows browser, developed by Marc Andreessen and Eric Bina at the University of Illinois. As the first easy-to-install, cross-platform (Windows/Mac/Unix) graphical browser to support inline text and images, Mosaic transformed the Web from a CERN academic tool into a mass consumer product. In 1994, Andreessen left NCSA to found Netscape, which released Netscape Navigator 1.0 in December 1994 and went public in August 1995, officially ushering in the Internet era.
events.card_summary_en: Mosaic 1.0 put images, forms, and links into one graphical browser, taking the Web out of academia and starting its path to mass adoption.
events.why_it_matters_en: Mosaic was where the Web went mainstream. Without Web adoption there would be no Google, Wikipedia, or Stack Overflow, and no massive corpora for training LLMs. Today's debates over the open internet versus closed data trace directly back to the premise Mosaic created in 1993 when it carried the Web beyond academic walls.
events.behind_scenes_en: Before Mosaic, browsers were essentially CERN's WorldWideWeb on NeXT and LineMode in plain text. Mosaic integrated pictures, forms, and hyperlinks in one GUI so ordinary users could go online without a command line, which was the key to mass adoption. The team then split in two directions: Andreessen founded Netscape, while NCSA licensed Mosaic to Spyglass, whose technology Microsoft bought in 1995 and evolved into Internet Explorer 1.0. Web popularization paved the way for search engines, Wikipedia, blogging, and social networks, and laid the foundation for the public corpora that LLMs train on.

events.title_zh: FERET 推动人脸识别评测基准
events.title_en: FERET Database Establishes Face Recognition Evaluation
events.summary_zh:
1993-1996 年,美国 DARPA 资助的 FERET(Facial Recognition Technology)项目在 Army Research Lab 收集 14126 张人脸图像,覆盖 1199 人,用于建立人脸识别算法的标准化评测基准。
1996 年 FERET Evaluation Protocol 定义了训练集 / Gallery / Probe 三段评测流程,成为后续 NIST FRVT 评测的母版。
FERET 直接催生 Eigenface、Fisherface、LBP 等经典人脸识别算法,并在 2000 年代演化为 FRGC、FRVT、MegaFace 等大规模评测。
events.source_name: Phillips, P. J. et al. (2000). FERET Database; NIST FRVT reports 2002-2024
events.card_summary_zh: FERET 推动人脸识别评测基准；FERET 是 AI 评测范式从“私有数据集”转向“公共基准”的起点。
events.summary_en: Between 1993 and 1996, the DARPA-funded FERET (Facial Recognition Technology) program collected 14,126 facial images of 1,199 individuals at the Army Research Lab to establish a standardized benchmark for facial recognition. In 1996, the FERET Evaluation Protocol introduced a three-stage evaluation workflow—Training Set, Gallery, and Probe—which served as the blueprint for subsequent NIST FRVT evaluations. This initiative directly catalyzed classic algorithms like Eigenface, Fisherface, and LBP, before evolving into massive 2000s-era benchmarks such as FRGC, FRVT, and MegaFace.
events.card_summary_en: FERET built the first shared face-recognition benchmark, moving AI evaluation from private datasets to public data plus protocol.
events.why_it_matters_en: FERET marked AI's shift from private datasets to public benchmarks. ImageNet, COCO, MMLU, and SWE-Bench all stand on the public-data-plus-protocol framework it established. It was also the earliest arena of surveillance and privacy controversy: today's legal and ethical debates about facial recognition return to this starting point.
events.behind_scenes_en: Before FERET, every face-recognition group tested on its own private dataset, so results were incomparable and reported accuracies mutually unverifiable. FERET bundled three things together, dataset, protocol, and evaluation service, letting DARPA objectively assess funded projects. The paradigm was inherited wholesale by ImageNet, COCO, and GLUE, becoming the source of standardized deep-learning evaluation. FERET was also an early source of AI ethics issues: from 2001 to 2003 its data powered Tampa's Super Bowl face-scanning system, one of the first cases of mass public surveillance by AI.

events.title_zh: Schmidhuber 长期记忆网络:神经网络记忆机制探索
events.title_en: Schmidhuber Long-Term Memory Network Exploration
events.summary_zh:
1995 年前后,Jürgen Schmidhuber 在 IDSIA 团队探索神经网络的长期记忆机制,包括 1991 年 Hochreiter 在他指导下发现梯度消失问题,1995-1997 年 Hochreiter-Schmidhuber 提出 LSTM,1995 年 Schmidhuber 还提出“自指网络(Self-Referential RNN)”让网络能写自己的权重。
Schmidhuber 团队在 90 年代是 RNN 研究的核心之一,和 Sutton、Jordan、Pearlmutter 等少数研究者共同支撑了 RL 和 RNN 的早期工作。
events.source_name: Schmidhuber, J. (1992-1997). IDSIA technical reports; Hochreiter master thesis 1991
events.card_summary_zh: Schmidhuber 长期记忆网络：神经网络记忆机制探索；Schmidhuber 路线是 LLM 时代前 RNN 的核心一支。
events.summary_en: Around 1995, Jürgen Schmidhuber’s team at IDSIA explored the long-term memory mechanisms of neural networks, which included Hochreiter’s 1991 discovery of the vanishing gradient problem under his guidance, Hochreiter and Schmidhuber's proposal of LSTM from 1995 to 1997, and Schmidhuber’s 1995 introduction of the "Self-Referential RNN" that allowed networks to write their own weights. In the 1990s, Schmidhuber's team was a core hub for RNN research, anchoring early work in RL and RNNs alongside a few other researchers like Sutton, Jordan, and Pearlmutter.
events.card_summary_en: Jurgen Schmidhuber's group explored memory mechanisms for recurrent networks, a line of work that became a central branch of sequence modeling before the LLM era.
events.why_it_matters_en: The Schmidhuber line was a core branch of RNN research before LLMs. Today's discussions of long-term memory, context windows, and vanishing gradients all build on the Hochreiter-Schmidhuber LSTM work of 1991-1997. Tracing this line reveals the engineering predicament of sequence modeling before Transformers, and why LSTM gave way so completely after 2017.
events.behind_scenes_en: Schmidhuber's situation in the 1990s reflected how marginal RNN researchers were during the second winter. IDSIA sat in Lugano, Switzerland, far from the CMU-MIT-Stanford core, and his group's papers drew little attention at NIPS and ICML through the decade. Only around 2009, when Sutskever and Hinton's teams broke speech recognition open with LSTM, did mainstream attention arrive. Schmidhuber has long harbored grievances toward the Hinton-LeCun-Bengio camp, arguing LSTM's contribution was undercredited in the 2018 Turing Award and publicly disputing how credit for deep learning was distributed. That dispute has never fully settled.

events.title_zh: Cortes-Vapnik SVM:统计学习的核心算法
events.title_en: Cortes-Vapnik Support Vector Machine
events.summary_zh:
1995 年 9 月,Corinna Cortes 和 Vladimir Vapnik 在 Machine Learning 20(3):273-297 发表《Support-Vector Networks》。
SVM 在特征空间中找一个最大间隔超平面分割两类,由距离边界最近的少数“支持向量”决定分类器。
通过核函数(kernel trick)把数据映射到高维空间,SVM 可以处理线性不可分问题。
常用核:线性、多项式、RBF(Gaussian)。
SVM 在 1996-2010 年是机器学习的主力算法,广泛应用于文本分类、生物信息、图像识别、金融风控。
events.source_name: Cortes, C. & Vapnik, V. (1995). Machine Learning 20(3):273-297; Vapnik (1995) The Nature of Statistical Learning Theory
events.card_summary_zh: 支持向量机用最大间隔寻找分类边界，在深度学习之前长期统治高维、小样本的机器学习任务。
events.summary_en: In September 1995, Corinna Cortes and Vladimir Vapnik published "Support-Vector Networks" in *Machine Learning* 20(3):273-297, introducing a classifier defined by a few boundary-adjacent "support vectors" that separate two classes using a maximum-margin hyperplane in a feature space. By leveraging the kernel trick—typically using linear, polynomial, or Gaussian RBF kernels—to map data into a high-dimensional space, SVM could successfully resolve linearly inseparable problems. This made SVM the workhorse algorithm of machine learning from 1996 to 2010, finding wide application in text classification, bioinformatics, image recognition, and financial risk control.
events.card_summary_en: Cortes and Vapnik's support vector machine found classification boundaries with maximum margin, dominating high-dimensional small-sample machine learning before deep learning.
events.why_it_matters_en: SVM was the mainstay of machine learning from the late 1990s into the 2000s, pushing statistical learning theory to its engineering peak. LLM-era systems no longer train on SVM, but maximum-margin thinking and kernel tricks still run wide in classification, clustering, and anomaly detection. Understanding SVM explains why Hinton's insistence on deep learning faced a decade of mainstream skepticism before acceptance.
events.behind_scenes_en: Vapnik developed SVM at AT&T Bell Labs, the same lab as LeCun, where the two carried on a long-running academic rivalry. Vapnik's statistical learning theory, published in Russian in 1979 and in English as The Nature of Statistical Learning Theory in 1995, proved generalization error bounds for finite samples, arming the small-data-strong-theory school of the late 1990s. The SVM-versus-neural-networks fights recurred at NIPS throughout the 2000s until AlexNet won ImageNet in 2012; SVM then retreated to second-line roles as a baseline model and teaching tool.

events.title_zh: Freund-Schapire Boosting:让弱学习器变强
events.title_en: Freund-Schapire Boosting Algorithm
events.summary_zh:
1996 年 Yoav Freund 和 Robert Schapire 在 COLT 上发表《Game Theory, On-line Prediction and Boosting》,期刊版 1999 年见诸 Games and Economic Behavior 29(1):79-103。
Boosting 算法的核心思想:训练多个“略好于随机”的弱学习器,按错误率加权组合成强学习器。
1997 年 Freund-Schapire 推出 AdaBoost(Adaptive Boosting),论文发表于 Journal of Computer and System Sciences 55(1):119-139。
Viola-Jones 2001 把 AdaBoost 用在人脸检测上,成为 2000-2010 年人脸检测的工业标准。
events.source_name: Freund, Y. & Schapire, R. (1996) COLT; (1997) JCSS 55(1):119-139; (1999) Games and Economic Behavior 29(1):79-103
events.card_summary_zh: Freund-Schapire Boosting：让弱学习器变强；Boosting 是表格数据机器学习的工程主力。
events.summary_en: Following Yoav Freund and Robert Schapire's 1996 COLT paper "Game Theory, On-line Prediction and Boosting" (journal version in *Games and Economic Behavior* 29(1):79-103, 1999), which defined "boosting" as combining multiple "slightly better than random" weak learners into a strong learner weighted by error rate, the duo debuted AdaBoost (Adaptive Boosting) in 1997 in the *Journal of Computer and System Sciences* 55(1):119-139. In 2001, Viola-Jones applied AdaBoost to face detection, cementing it as the industry standard for face detection from 2000 to 2010.
events.card_summary_en: Freund and Schapire's AdaBoost turned weak learners into strong ones, laying the theoretical base for the tree ensembles that still rule tabular data today.
events.why_it_matters_en: Boosting is the workhorse of tabular machine learning. The LLM world may not use AdaBoost directly, but XGBoost and LightGBM still dominate financial risk control, ad click-through, and recommendation systems. Understanding Boosting shows why deep learning took images and NLP after 2012 while tree models kept their grip on tabular problems.
events.behind_scenes_en: The origin is Schapire's 1989 MIT doctoral proof that within PAC learning any weak learner can be converted into a strong one. Freund collaborated with Schapire through the early 1990s, the first Boosting algorithm appeared in 1995, and the 1996 paper delivered the practical version. AdaBoost won the Godel Prize, one of theoretical computer science's highest honors, in 2003. Together with SVM and decision trees, Boosting formed the three mainstreams of late-1990s ML, later evolving into Friedman's gradient boosting in 1999, XGBoost in 2014, and LightGBM in 2017.

events.title_zh: IBM 深蓝击败卡斯帕罗夫:AI 的第一次大众胜利
events.title_en: IBM Deep Blue Defeats Kasparov
events.summary_zh:
1997 年 5 月 11 日,IBM 深蓝(Deep Blue)在纽约衡平中心(Equitable Center)6 局对抗赛中,以 3.5:2.5(2 胜 1 负 3 和)击败国际象棋世界冠军 Garry Kasparov。
深蓝由 Feng-hsiung Hsu、Joe Hoane、Murray Campbell 团队设计,运行在 IBM RS/6000 SP 超级计算机上(30 个节点,480 个专用 VLSI 象棋芯片),每秒搜索 2 亿个局面。
深蓝是“暴力搜索 + 人工评估函数”的极致,不学习,不适应,只靠算力碾压。
events.source_name: Hsu, F.-h. (2002). Behind Deep Blue; Campbell, M. et al. (2002) AI Journal 134(1-2):57-83
events.card_summary_zh: 深蓝在正式比赛中击败世界棋王，AI 第一次以全球公众都能理解的方式展示机器计算的压倒性力量。
events.summary_en: On May 11, 1997, IBM's Deep Blue defeated world chess champion Garry Kasparov 3.5 to 2.5 (with 2 wins, 1 loss, and 3 draws) in a six-game match at the Equitable Center in New York. Designed by the team of Feng-hsiung Hsu, Joe Hoane, and Murray Campbell, the system ran on an IBM RS/6000 SP supercomputer (configured with 30 nodes and 480 custom VLSI chess chips) that searched 200 million positions per second. As the ultimate realization of brute-force search and hand-crafted evaluation functions, Deep Blue did not learn or adapt, relying entirely on raw computing power to crush its opponent.
events.card_summary_en: Deep Blue beat Garry Kasparov in an official match, giving AI its first victory over a human champion that the whole world could understand at a glance.
events.why_it_matters_en: Deep Blue was the first AI event where a machine beat a human champion in full public view. It brought the field a mini-spring from 1997 to 2001 and made ordinary people believe computers could exceed humans on intellectual tasks for the first time. But brute-force search and deep learning are entirely different routes, which is why AlphaGo's 2016 breakthrough was fundamentally a different kind of win rather than Deep Blue's extension.
events.behind_scenes_en: The project began in 1985 when Feng-hsiung Hsu started ChipTest as a CMU PhD student, evolving through Deep Thought before IBM acquired his team in 1989. In February 1996 Deep Blue 1.0 lost its first match to Kasparov four games to two. In May 1997 the upgraded machine won when Kasparov resigned at move 36 of game six. Kasparov later complained the machine played like divine intervention and suspected cheating; IBM refused to release search details and dismantled the machine afterward. In his 2017 book Deep Thinking, Kasparov withdrew some accusations and admitted his own form was poor, though he still questioned IBM's conduct.

events.title_zh: IBM ViaVoice:连续语音识别进入消费市场
events.title_en: IBM ViaVoice Brings Continuous Speech Recognition to Consumers
events.summary_zh:
1997 年 10 月,IBM 发布 ViaVoice Gold,是最早一批面向消费市场的大词汇量连续语音识别(SLVCSR)产品之一(与同年 6–7 月上市的 Dragon NaturallySpeaking 并列,ViaVoice Gold 略晚于 Dragon)。
用户用普通语速说话,无需“字-字-停顿”,ViaVoice 在 Pentium 200MHz PC 上做到每分钟识别 100-140 词,错误率 5-10%(需 5 分钟声纹注册)。
ViaVoice 基于 IBM 30 年 HMM 语音识别积累,从 1971 年 DARPA Speech Understanding Research 项目继承下来。
1999 年 ViaVoice 在中国推出中文版本,是国内第一代语音输入法、银行电话客服的基础。
events.source_name: IBM ViaVoice Gold (1997); Jelinek, F. (1997) Statistical Methods for Speech Recognition
events.card_summary_zh: ViaVoice 让普通用户可以连续说话完成文字输入，语音识别第一次从实验室走进消费软件。
events.summary_en: In October 1997, IBM released ViaVoice Gold, arriving slightly after Dragon NaturallySpeaking's June–July debut to become one of the first consumer-market large vocabulary continuous speech recognition (SLVCSR) products. Powered by IBM’s 30 years of HMM speech recognition research tracing back to the 1971 DARPA Speech Understanding Research project, it enabled users to speak at normal speeds without pausing between words, delivering 100-140 words per minute with a 5-10% error rate on a Pentium 200MHz PC after a 5-minute voice enrollment. In 1999, IBM launched a Chinese version in China, which became the foundation for the country's first-generation voice input methods and bank telephone customer service systems.
events.card_summary_en: IBM ViaVoice let ordinary users dictate continuously to their PCs, moving speech recognition out of the lab and into consumer software for the first time.
events.why_it_matters_en: ViaVoice was AI's first large-scale entry into the consumer market, letting people operate computers by voice at home and paving the user-education path later walked by Siri, Alexa, and Xiao Ai. It also marked the engineering peak of HMM methods; today's end-to-end versus modular debate was already rehearsed in the transition from ViaVoice's modular HMM in 1997 to LSTM end-to-end systems in 2014.
events.behind_scenes_en: IBM had invested thirty years in speech recognition. It was a prime contractor on DARPA's SUR project in 1971, shipped the Tangora voice typewriter at T.J. Watson in 1984, and released VoiceType discrete-word recognition in 1992 before ViaVoice delivered continuous speech in 1997. The GMM-HMM paradigm of that era was the standard from 1980 to 2010, until Hinton's DNN-HMM displaced it around 2009-2011 and LSTM end-to-end models displaced it again in 2014. Whisper and wav2vec all stand on three decades of accumulated speech engineering.

events.title_zh: Hochreiter-Schmidhuber LSTM:序列建模的支柱
events.title_en: Hochreiter-Schmidhuber LSTM
events.summary_zh:
1997 年 11 月 15 日,Sepp Hochreiter 和 Jürgen Schmidhuber 在Neural Computation 9(8):1735-1780 发表《Long Short-Term Memory》。
LSTM 引入“细胞状态 + 输入门 + 输出门 + 恒定误差传送带(CEC)”的结构,解决 RNN 在反向传播中梯度消失问题,让网络能学习跨数百个时间步的长期依赖(1997 年原版只有输入门和输出门;遗忘门由 Gers、Schmidhuber、Cummins 在 2000 年《Learning to Forget》中补充,才形成今天的三门结构)。
LSTM 在 2009-2017 年是序列建模的主力,Google 翻译、Apple Siri、Amazon Alexa 第一代都跑在 LSTM 上,直到 2017 年 Transformer 出现才被替代。
events.source_name: Hochreiter, S. & Schmidhuber, J. (1997). Neural Computation 9(8):1735-1780
events.card_summary_zh: Hochreiter-Schmidhuber LSTM：序列建模的支柱；LSTM 是 Transformer 之前序列建模的支柱。
events.summary_en: On November 15, 1997, Sepp Hochreiter and Jürgen Schmidhuber published "Long Short-Term Memory" in *Neural Computation* 9(8):1735-1780, introducing a "cell state + input gate + output gate + Constant Error Carousel (CEC)" structure that solved the vanishing gradient problem in RNN backpropagation and allowed networks to learn long-term dependencies across hundreds of time steps (the 1997 original had only input and output gates, with the forget gate added by Gers, Schmidhuber, and Cummins in the 2000 paper "Learning to Forget" to form today's three-gate architecture). From 2009 to 2017, LSTM served as the workhorse of sequence modeling, powering the first generation of Google Translate, Apple Siri, and Amazon Alexa until the Transformer arrived in 2017 to replace it.
events.card_summary_en: Hochreiter and Schmidhuber published LSTM, whose gated memory made recurrent networks actually trainable and became the backbone of sequence modeling before Transformers.
events.why_it_matters_en: LSTM was the pillar of sequence modeling before the Transformer era. Long-term memory, attention-style gating, and context handling were all LSTM problems to solve until 2017. Understanding its gated-memory design clarifies why Transformer attention let LLMs cross the language understanding gap.
events.behind_scenes_en: The origin is Hochreiter's 1991 master's thesis, the first systematic description of vanishing gradients in RNNs and their role as the fundamental obstacle to training deep networks. He brought the thesis to Schmidhuber, and the two spent six years completing LSTM, finally publishing in Neural Computation in 1997. Early reception was muted; only after Sutskever and Hinton's teams proved in 2009 that LSTM crushed traditional HMMs on speech recognition and machine translation did industry adopt it widely. In 2024 Hochreiter was repeatedly mentioned alongside Hinton as a Nobel candidate, with LSTM's influence being reevaluated in the Transformer era.

events.title_zh: COMPAS 算法上线:算法治理最早典型案例
events.title_en: COMPAS Deployed: Earliest Landmark of Algorithmic Governance
events.summary_zh:
1998 年 4 月,Northpointe(后改 Equivant)推出COMPAS(Correctional Offender Management Profiling for Alternative Sanctions),用于美国法院量刑建议和假释风险评估。
COMPAS 用 137 个调查问题,把被告分为低/中/高三档再犯风险,法官在量刑时参考 COMPAS 分数。
2013 年 Eric Loomis 案首次把 COMPAS 推上法庭,2016 年 ProPublica 调查报告指出 COMPAS 对黑人被告的误判率是白人的 2 倍,引爆“算法歧视”全球讨论。
events.source_name: ProPublica (2016) Machine Bias; Loomis v. Wisconsin (2017) SCOTUS; Equivant COMPAS
events.card_summary_zh: COMPAS 算法上线：算法治理最早典型案例；COMPAS 是 AI 伦理与算法治理的最早现场。
events.summary_en: In April 1998, Northpointe (later Equivant) launched COMPAS (Correctional Offender Management Profiling for Alternative Sanctions) for sentencing recommendations and parole risk assessments in US courts. Using 137 survey questions, the system categorized defendants into low, medium, or high recidivism risks for judges to reference during sentencing. The Eric Loomis case first brought COMPAS to court in 2013, and a 2016 ProPublica investigative report revealing that its error rate for Black defendants was twice that of white defendants ignited a global debate on "algorithmic bias."
events.card_summary_en: The COMPAS risk-score algorithm entered courtrooms and became the earliest landmark case in AI ethics, exposing bias, opacity, and accountability questions that still shape policy today.
events.why_it_matters_en: COMPAS was the first live arena for algorithmic discrimination, black-box models, trade secrets versus judicial transparency, and statistical versus individual fairness, pushing these questions onto the legal stage. Today's debates about model bias, RLHF values, and algorithmic accountability all have early versions in this case. When the EU AI Act listed judicial sentencing as high-risk AI in 2024, the lesson traces straight back to COMPAS.
events.behind_scenes_en: Northpointe kept COMPAS's internals as trade secrets and refused to publish feature weights. Eric Loomis appealed to the Wisconsin Supreme Court, which upheld the sentence calling COMPAS a commonly used tool; the US Supreme Court declined to hear it. In 2016 ProPublica retro-scored more than 7,000 historical cases: Black defendants were falsely labeled high-risk at 44.9% versus 23.5% for white defendants, while white defendants were falsely labeled low-risk at 47.7% versus 28.0%. Northpointe countered that ProPublica's statistics were wrong, and academia argued the point into 2020 without consensus.

events.title_zh: Brin-Page Google:搜索 + 机器学习早期范式
events.title_en: Brin-Page Google: Early Search + Machine Learning
events.summary_zh:
1998 年 9 月 4 日,Larry Page 和 Sergey Brin 在加州 Menlo Park 车库注册 Google Inc。
Google 核心算法 PageRank 来自两人 1998 年 WWW7 会议论文《The Anatomy of a Large-Scale Hypertextual Web Search Engine》。
PageRank 把网页重要性建模为马尔可夫链的稳态分布,通过迭代计算得到每个页面的“权威度”。
1999-2004 年 Google 把 PageRank + 文本匹配 + 用户行为日志结合,构建了第一个工业级大规模搜索排序系统,直接定义了“机器学习 + 大规模数据 + 在线服务”的工程范式。
events.source_name: Brin, S. & Page, L. (1998). WWW7; Google IPO S-1 (2004)
events.card_summary_zh: PageRank 用链接关系计算网页权威度，Google 由此建立了数据驱动算法改变互联网入口的早期范式。
events.summary_en: On September 4, 1998, Larry Page and Sergey Brin incorporated Google Inc. in a Menlo Park, California garage, utilizing their core PageRank algorithm from their 1998 WWW7 paper, "The Anatomy of a Large-Scale Hypertextual Web Search Engine." PageRank modeled webpage importance as the stationary distribution of a Markov chain, iteratively calculating each page's "authority." From 1999 to 2004, Google combined PageRank with text matching and user behavior logs to build the first industrial-scale search ranking system, establishing the engineering paradigm of "machine learning + large-scale data + online services."
events.card_summary_en: PageRank ranked pages by who linked to them, and Google built the early industrial paradigm of data-driven algorithms reshaping how people find information online.
events.why_it_matters_en: Google was the earliest industrial paradigm of data-driven machine learning. The formula discussed around LLMs today, massive data plus simple architecture plus online optimization, had already been rehearsed inside Google's search and ad systems from 1998 to 2004. Google also became the academy of machine learning talent for 2000-2015; deep ties with Hinton, Sutskever, Dean, Ng, and LeCun directly produced Google Brain in 2012, the DeepMind acquisition in 2014, and Transformer in 2017.
events.behind_scenes_en: PageRank began as Brin and Page's Stanford doctoral project under the name BackRub, running on Stanford servers from 1996 to 1998 and consuming half the university's bandwidth. In 1998 they tried selling the algorithm for one million dollars to AltaVista, Excite, and other search engines, and were rejected across the board; Excite's CEO balked even at $750,000. They founded their own company that September, raised $25 million from KPCB and Sequoia in 1999, and IPOed in August 2004 at a $23 billion valuation. The paradigm of large-scale data plus simple models plus online learning was inherited wholesale by Netflix, LinkedIn, and Facebook, becoming modern internet ML's foundational engineering pattern.

events.title_zh: LeNet-5 论文:卷积网络的工程化文档
events.title_en: LeNet-5 Paper: Engineering Documentation of CNNs
events.summary_zh:
1998 年 11 月,Yann LeCun、Léon Bottou、Yoshua Bengio、Patrick Haffner 在Proceedings of the IEEE 86(11):2278-2324 发表《Gradient-Based Learning Applied to Document Recognition》。
论文系统化描述 LeNet-5 结构(7 层:Conv-Pool-Conv-Pool-FC-FC-Output),用反向传播端到端训练,直接吃原始像素,用于 MNIST 手写数字识别(错误率 0.95%)和银行支票金额识别。
LeNet-5 论文是 CNN 的工程化教科书,定义了 Conv→Pool→FC 的标准范式,2012 年 AlexNet 本质上是 LeNet-5 放大版 + GPU 训练 + ReLU 激活。
events.source_name: LeCun, Y. et al. (1998). Proc. IEEE 86(11):2278-2324; MNIST dataset
events.card_summary_zh: LeNet-5 固化了卷积、池化与全连接的组合方式，后来视觉神经网络的工程骨架由此成形。
events.summary_en: In November 1998, Yann LeCun, Léon Bottou, Yoshua Bengio, and Patrick Haffner published "Gradient-Based Learning Applied to Document Recognition" in *Proceedings of the IEEE* 86(11):2278-2324, systematically describing the 7-layer LeNet-5 architecture (Conv-Pool-Conv-Pool-FC-FC-Output) trained end-to-end via backpropagation to process raw pixels directly for MNIST handwritten digit recognition (0.95% error rate) and bank check amount recognition. As the engineering textbook for CNNs, the paper defined the standard Conv→Pool→FC paradigm; 2012's AlexNet was essentially a scaled-up LeNet-5 utilizing GPU training and ReLU activation.
events.card_summary_en: LeCun's LeNet-5 paper fixed the recipe of convolution, pooling, and fully connected layers, forming the engineering skeleton every later vision network would follow.
events.why_it_matters_en: LeNet-5 is the master template of deep learning engineering. Every CNN today stands on its paradigm of local receptive fields, shared weights, pooling, and fully connected heads. Reading LeNet-5 makes clear that AlexNet's 2012 breakthrough was not a sudden arrival but the eruption of fourteen years of engineering plus GPU compute plus ImageNet-scale data arriving together.
events.behind_scenes_en: The paper landed at the deepest point of the second AI winter. LeCun had already deployed LeNet in NCR check-reading systems at AT&T, with roughly 90% of US checks reading amounts through it, yet mainstream AI treated neural networks as an echo of a failed 1980s route. In the paper he wrote that he believed neural networks had matured into standard tools for pattern recognition, a judgment ignored in 1998 and proven right only in 2012. The paper also recorded hard-won details such as performance dropping without input normalization, lessons AlexNet rediscovered in 2012.

events.title_zh: NIST MNIST 数据集:机器学习标准基准
events.title_en: NIST MNIST Dataset: Standard ML Benchmark
events.summary_zh:
1999 年 9 月,Yann LeCun、Corinna Cortes、Christopher J.C. Burges 发布 MNIST 数据集,源自 NIST SD-3 和 SD-1 手写数字数据,经过混洗、归一化、居中处理,得到 60000 张训练图 + 10000 张测试图,28x28 灰度。
MNIST 把 LeCun 1998 LeNet-5 论文的实验数据集正式独立发布,成为 1999-2015 年机器学习算法的标准入门基准。
MNIST 错误率从 1998 年 LeNet 的 0.95% 一路降到 2012 年 CNN+dropout 的 0.23%,再到 2018 年 Rodriquez-Bengio 团队 0.18%,今天主流模型基本达到 0.20% 以下,MNIST 已基本被“解决”。
events.source_name: LeCun, Y. et al. (1998) Proc IEEE 86(11); MNIST database, LeCun.com
events.card_summary_zh: NIST MNIST 数据集：机器学习标准基准；MNIST 是机器学习基准范式的起点。
events.summary_en: In September 1999, Yann LeCun, Corinna Cortes, and Christopher J.C. Burges released the MNIST dataset, which shuffled, normalized, and centered handwritten digit data from NIST SD-3 and SD-1 to produce 60,000 training and 10,000 testing 28x28 grayscale images. This formal, independent release of the experimental dataset from LeCun's 1998 LeNet-5 paper went on to serve as the standard introductory benchmark for machine learning algorithms from 1999 to 2015. Over the years, the MNIST error rate plummeted from LeNet's 0.95% in 1998 to 0.23% using CNN+dropout in 2012, and reached 0.18% by the Rodriquez-Bengio team in 2018; today, with mainstream models consistently scoring below 0.20%, the dataset is considered essentially "solved."
events.card_summary_en: NIST's MNIST dataset of handwritten digits defined the train-test-error protocol that became machine learning's standard benchmark template.
events.why_it_matters_en: MNIST was the starting point of the machine learning benchmark paradigm. Today's debates about benchmark contamination, overfitting to benchmarks, and benchmark saturation were all rehearsed on MNIST first. Its twenty-five years of evolution explain why LLM evaluation keeps producing new benchmarks: once a benchmark saturates, it loses discriminating power.
events.behind_scenes_en: It defined the three-part protocol of training set, test set, and error rate, later inherited intact by CIFAR-10 in 2009, ImageNet in 2009, GLUE in 2018, MMLU in 2020, and SWE-Bench in 2023. MNIST was also the earliest industrial-grade practice of the public data plus protocol paradigm, reaching general ML algorithms even before FERET did for vision. Criticized today as too easy, it still serves widely as an entry benchmark and algorithm sanity check, cited dozens of times a month as recently as 2024.

events.title_zh: NVIDIA GeForce 256:GPU 时代开启
events.title_en: NVIDIA GeForce 256: GPU Era Begins
events.summary_zh:
1999 年 10 月 11 日,NVIDIA 发布 GeForce 256,售价 199 美元。
NVIDIA 把它宣传为“世界第一款 GPU(Graphics Processing Unit)”,首次把 Transform、Lighting、Setup、Rendering 四阶段整合到单芯片,支持硬件 T&L,集成 2300 万晶体管,核心 120MHz,显存 64MB DDR。
GeForce 256 同时是消费级显卡和并行计算硬件的开端,为 2006 年 CUDA、2012 年 AlexNet GPU 训练、2017 年 Transformer 大模型奠定算力基础。
events.source_name: NVIDIA GeForce 256 press release (1999-10-11); Buck, I. (2004) Stanford PhD
events.card_summary_zh: GeForce 256 把大规模并行图形计算带入消费市场，也为十多年后的深度学习算力革命埋下伏笔。
events.summary_en: On October 11, 1999, NVIDIA released the GeForce 256 for $199, marketing it as the "world's first GPU (Graphics Processing Unit)" for integrating the four stages of Transform, Lighting, Setup, and Rendering onto a single chip for the first time. Packing 23 million transistors, a 120MHz core, 64MB DDR memory, and hardware T&L support, it marked the beginning of both consumer graphics cards and parallel computing hardware. This breakthrough laid the computational foundation for CUDA in 2006, AlexNet GPU training in 2012, and Transformer large models in 2017.
events.card_summary_en: NVIDIA's GeForce 256 brought massively parallel graphics computing to consumers, quietly planting the seed of the GPU revolution deep learning would run on a decade later.
events.why_it_matters_en: Without GPUs there is no deep learning era. Nearly all LLM training compute today runs on NVIDIA GPUs, and GeForce 256 is the origin of that hardware line. Tracing the 1999-2009 transformation from graphics hardware to general parallel computing explains why AlexNet ignited deep learning in 2012 instead of stopping at LeNet's 1998 level.
events.behind_scenes_en: Only the graphics community and a few AI researchers saw the parallel-computing potential early. Ian Buck ran matrix multiplication on GPUs at Stanford in 2004; NVIDIA released CUDA in 2007, turning the GPU from graphics-specific silicon into general parallel compute. In 2009 Rajat Raina and Andrew Ng trained deep belief networks on GPUs at Stanford, cutting training from weeks to days, the direct reason Hinton's team chose GPUs for AlexNet in 2012. Today's H100 and B100 dominate LLM training, with GeForce 256 as the earliest point on this line.

events.title_zh: Nuance Dragon + Google 搜索:语音与机器学习进入消费市场
events.title_en: Nuance Dragon + Google Search: Speech and ML Enter Consumer Market
events.summary_zh:
2001 年前后,语音识别和搜索排序两条机器学习路线同时进入消费市场。
Nuance Dragon NaturallySpeaking 5.0 在 Pentium 4 PC 上做到连续语音听写,错误率 5-8%(英语),售价 199 美元。
Google 2001 年引入 PageRank + 链接分析的机器学习排序,配合 AdWords(2000-10)开始构建数据驱动广告系统,为后续 2011 年 Google Brain 团队铺路。
2001 年也是 MIT OpenCourseWare 启动的年份,AI 教育资源开始大规模开放,推动后续十年 AI 人才扩张。
events.source_name: Nuance Dragon NaturallySpeaking 5.0 (2001); Google AdWords (2000-10); MIT OCW (2001-04)
events.card_summary_zh: Nuance Dragon + Google 搜索：语音与机器学习进入消费市场；2001 年是 AI 从“研究室”转向“产品”的早期节点。
events.summary_en: Around 2001, machine learning entered the consumer market via two parallel tracks: speech recognition—with Nuance Dragon NaturallySpeaking 5.0 delivering continuous English dictation on Pentium 4 PCs with a 5-8% error rate for $199—and search ranking. That same year, Google introduced machine learning ranking combining PageRank and link analysis, pairing it with AdWords (2000-10) to build a data-driven advertising system that paved the way for the Google Brain team in 2011. 2001 also marked the launch of MIT OpenCourseWare, initiating the large-scale opening of AI educational resources that fueled the expansion of AI talent over the following decade.
events.card_summary_en: Dragon NaturallySpeaking and Google Search put speech recognition and web-scale machine learning into daily products, marking AI's early turn from research labs to consumer goods.
events.why_it_matters_en: 2001 was an early inflection point where AI moved from research rooms into products. The concepts debated around LLMs now, narrow AI versus general AI, data flywheels, model iteration, all had early versions in Dragon and Google. Understanding this moment explains why deep learning moved so fast from paper to product after AlexNet: consumers had already accepted the logic of AI products.
events.behind_scenes_en: AI was near the tail end of its second winter in 2001, yet the consumer market had already learned to accept narrow-AI products. Dragon ran GMM-HMM on PCs built on thirty years of speech engineering; Google ran PageRank on Linux clusters built on the algorithm plus massive compute. Together they proved AI did not need general intelligence to make money, that narrow scenarios plus big data plus machine learning could be a real business. That realization directly fueled the machine-learning boom of the Web 2.0 era from 2003 to 2010.

events.title_zh: iRobot Roomba 上市:家用机器人零时刻
events.title_en: iRobot Roomba Released: Home Robots Era Begins
events.summary_zh:
2002 年 9 月 17 日,iRobot 公司推出 Roomba 自动扫地机器人,售价 199 美元。
Roomba 第一代 8 小时充电、1 小时清扫、覆盖 3-4 个房间,用简单的随机游走 + 局部 SLAM 算法 + 红外避障,不需要地图,不需要云端,完全本地决策。
首年销量 50 万台,2004 年突破 100 万台,成为第一款真正大规模进入家庭的机器人。
events.source_name: iRobot Roomba launch (2002-09-17); Brooks, R. (1986) IEEE J. Robotics Automation RA-2(1)
events.card_summary_zh: Roomba 把自主导航机器人卖进普通家庭，具身智能第一次以百万级消费产品证明商业可行性。
events.summary_en: On September 17, 2002, iRobot launched the $199 Roomba automatic vacuum cleaning robot, which could cover 3-4 rooms with 1 hour of cleaning on an 8-hour charge.
