The first-generation device operated entirely on local decision-making without needing maps or the cloud, relying on a simple random walk, a local SLAM algorithm, and infrared obstacle avoidance. Selling 500,000 units in its first year and surpassing 1 million in 2004, it became the first robot to truly enter homes on a massive scale.
events.card_summary_en: iRobot shipped the Roomba vacuum robot, selling autonomous navigation to ordinary households and proving embodied AI could work as a mass-market product.
events.why_it_matters_en: Roomba was the first commercial success of embodied intelligence. It showed robots could enter homes without general intelligence, that narrow scenarios plus engineering polish plus behavior composition could be profitable. The engineering playbook of every household robot since, from floor cleaners to mowers to feeders, builds on Roomba. It also stands as behavior-based AI's last great engineering victory, leaving a reference point for the end-to-end embodied systems of the deep learning era.
events.behind_scenes_en: iRobot was founded by MIT AI Lab alumni Rodney Brooks, Colin Angle, and Helen Greiner, previously focused on military robots like PackBot. Brooks's 1986 paper on the Subsumption Architecture opposed symbolic AI's sense-plan-act pipeline and argued for directly coupling perception to action. Roomba was that philosophy's engineering peak: no elaborate planning, no world model, just composed behaviors completing the cleaning task.

events.title_zh: LinkedIn + Hinton RBM:社交数据与神经网络同时积累
events.title_en: LinkedIn + Hinton RBM: Social Data and Neural Networks Accumulate
events.summary_zh:
2003 年 5 月 5 日,Reid Hoffman 在 Mountain View 创办 LinkedIn,为 Web 2.0 时代的社交数据大爆发拉开序幕。
同年 Hinton 在多伦多发表论文《Modeling high-dimensional data with neural networks》,继续在第二次 AI 寒冬最深处坚持 Restricted Boltzmann Machine(RBM)研究。
Hinton 团队 2002-2006 年开发 Contrastive Divergence(CD)训练算法,为 2006 年 Deep Belief Network 突破做最后准备。
events.source_name: LinkedIn founding (2003-05-05); Hinton (2003) Modeling high-dimensional data
events.card_summary_zh: LinkedIn + Hinton RBM：社交数据与神经网络同时积累；2003 年是 AI 寒冬里最低调但最关键的一年。
events.summary_en: On May 5, 2003, Reid Hoffman founded LinkedIn in Mountain View, ushering in the Web 2.0 social data explosion. That same year in Toronto, Hinton published the paper "Modeling high-dimensional data with neural networks," persisting with Restricted Boltzmann Machine (RBM) research in the depths of the second AI winter. From 2002 to 2006, Hinton's team developed the Contrastive Divergence (CD) training algorithm, making final preparations for the 2006 Deep Belief Network breakthrough.
events.card_summary_en: LinkedIn launched while Hinton pushed restricted Boltzmann machines in Toronto, two quiet seeds of data and algorithms planted during AI winter's most overlooked year.
events.why_it_matters_en: 2003 was the quietest yet most consequential year of the AI winter. The data Web 2.0 would generate and the deep network algorithms LLMs need were both seeded this year. Seeing the accumulation inside the trough clarifies why AlexNet's apparent suddenness in 2012 was really ten years of data, algorithms, and compute maturing together.
events.behind_scenes_en: Statistical learning ruled 2003, SVMs and Boosting above all, while neural networks were written off as a failed 1980s route. Hinton in Toronto scraped by on small NSERC grants and student-built RBM implementations; from 1998 to 2006 his team was nearly the only group still committed to deep neural networks. Meanwhile Web 2.0 had users generating content through blogs, wikis, and social networks, laying the corpus base for future LLMs. The lines converged in 2006 when Hinton published his DBN paper in Science and Facebook opened registration the same year.

events.title_zh: Caltech 101 数据集:ImageNet 的前身
events.title_en: Caltech 101 Dataset: Precursor to ImageNet
events.summary_zh: 李飞飞在加州理工学院创建 Caltech 101 数据集，包含 101 个类别、超 9000 张图像，首次证明数据规模大于算法复杂度。
events.card_summary_zh: 李飞飞在加州理工学院创建 Caltech 101 数据集，包含 101 个类别、超 9000 张图像；Caltech 101 是 ImageNet 的前身。
events.summary_en: At Caltech, Fei-Fei Li created the Caltech 101 dataset, featuring 101 categories and over 9,000 images, proving for the first time that data scale outweighs algorithmic complexity.
events.card_summary_en: Fei-Fei Li built the Caltech 101 dataset at Caltech, 101 categories and over 9,000 images, an early prototype of the data-first thinking behind ImageNet.
events.why_it_matters_en: Caltech 101 was ImageNet's direct predecessor. It tested a proposition that would later reshape AI: what matters more than better algorithms may simply be more diverse data.
events.behind_scenes_en: The dataset's name was a private joke. Her advisor kept raising the count, first ten categories, then fifty, so she picked 101 to tease California's highway numbering. Within six months of release it became a standard industry benchmark.

events.title_zh: Spirit/Opportunity 火星车:AI 自主任务系统
events.title_en: Spirit/Opportunity Mars Rovers: AI Autonomous Systems
events.summary_zh:
2004 年 1 月 4 日,Spirit 火星车在 Gusev 陨石坑着陆,1 月 25 日 Opportunity 在 Meridiani Planum 着陆。
两台火星车设计寿命 90 个火星日,实际运行 6 年(Spirit)和 14 年(Opportunity)。
火星车搭载 NASA JPL 开发的 AI 自主任务系统,包括视觉里程计(Visual Odometry)、自动目标识别(AutoNav)、地形评估和路径规划,能在地球-火星 4-24 分钟通信延迟下自主完成路径选择和科学目标识别。
events.source_name: NASA JPL Mars Exploration Rovers Mission; Maimone, M. et al. (2007) J. Field Robotics 24(3)
events.card_summary_zh: 火星车必须在通信延迟下自主感知、规划和避障，AI 由此在最遥远、最严苛的环境中接受工程考验。
events.summary_en: On January 4, 2004, the Spirit rover landed in Gusev Crater, followed by Opportunity in Meridiani Planum on January 25. While designed for a lifespan of just 90 Martian days, the rovers ultimately operated for 6 years (Spirit) and 14 years (Opportunity). Both were powered by an AI autonomous mission system developed by NASA JPL—incorporating Visual Odometry, automatic target recognition (AutoNav), terrain assessment, and path planning—which allowed them to autonomously select paths and identify scientific targets despite a 4-to-24-minute Earth-Mars communication delay.
events.card_summary_en: The Spirit and Opportunity rovers had to sense, plan, and avoid hazards on their own across minutes-long communication delays, stress-testing AI in the harshest environment available.
events.why_it_matters_en: Mars rover AI was the engineering summit of the perceive-plan-act paradigm under extreme conditions. It proved AI needs no general intelligence to solve communication lag, unknown terrain, and long-duration missions when paired with strong engineering. The AI system designs of SpaceX Starship, interplanetary missions, and deep space probes all build on twenty years of rover engineering.
events.behind_scenes_en: The core challenge was delay plus unknown terrain. One-way Earth-Mars communication takes four to twenty-four minutes, so the rover cannot wait for instructions and must judge each step's safety itself. JPL generated 3D terrain maps from stereo cameras, planned the next meter of path within thirty seconds using automated planners, and accumulated position estimates through visual odometry. That system is why the rovers lasted fourteen years and became the AI foundation for Curiosity and Perseverance. Perseverance added AutoNav and terrain-relative navigation in 2020, reaching genuinely autonomous decision-making on Mars.

events.title_zh: Facebook 上线:社交数据基础设施启动
events.title_en: Facebook Launched: Social Data Infrastructure Begins
events.summary_zh:
2004 年 2 月 4 日,Mark Zuckerberg 在哈佛大学宿舍上线 TheFacebook.com,最初限制哈佛学生注册。
2005-2006 年扩展到 Ivy League、所有大学、所有 13 岁以上人群,2006 年 9 月 News Feed 上线,社交数据流动从“主动浏览”转为“被动推送”。
2012 年 5 月 Facebook IPO,估值 1040 亿美元,成为 Web 2.0 时代最大社交数据基础设施。
events.source_name: Facebook founding (2004-02-04); Zuckerberg Harvard years
events.card_summary_zh: Facebook 将现实关系搬到线上，并逐渐形成史无前例的社交行为数据基础设施。
events.summary_en: On February 4, 2004, Mark Zuckerberg launched TheFacebook.com from his Harvard dorm room, initially restricting registration to Harvard students. Between 2005 and 2006, the platform expanded to the Ivy League, all universities, and everyone over 13, shifting the flow of social data from "active browsing" to "passive push" with the launch of the News Feed in September 2006. Following its May 2012 IPO at a $104 billion valuation, Facebook became the largest social data infrastructure of the Web 2.0 era.
events.card_summary_en: Facebook moved real-world relationships online and began assembling an unprecedented infrastructure of social behavior data.
events.why_it_matters_en: Facebook was ground zero for social data infrastructure. Without the accumulation from Facebook, Twitter, and Instagram there would be no recommender systems of the 2010s, no corpus at scale for BERT in 2018, and none of today's debates about training on social data, personalized conversation, or filter bubbles. Understanding this role explains why Meta could stand as a third pillar beside Google and Microsoft in the LLM era.
events.behind_scenes_en: Facebook mattered to AI through its social graph plus behavioral data. The Graph API opened in 2007 let outside developers build on the social graph, spawning ecosystems like Zynga and Spotify; Open Graph in 2009 extended social data onto third-party web pages. Internally, Facebook founded FAIR in 2013 under Yann LeCun to compete with Google Brain and Microsoft Research for deep learning talent. Meta's LLaMA series is essentially the monetization of social data accumulation since 2004 plus FAIR's algorithmic investment since 2013.

events.title_zh: W3C OWL 标准:语义网的工程尝试
events.title_en: W3C OWL Standard: Semantic Web Engineering Attempt
events.summary_zh:
2004 年 2 月 10 日,W3C 发布 OWL(Web Ontology Language)推荐标准,由 Tim Berners-Lee 推动的语义网(Semantic Web)项目的核心组件。
OWL 用描述逻辑(Description Logic)在 RDF 三元组之上增加类、属性、约束、推理规则,目标让 Web 内容既能被人读,也能被机器理解。
OWL 2 在 2009 年发布,加入更复杂的表达力。
语义网在 2004-2012 年有过一波工业尝试(Google Rich Snippets、Facebook Open Graph),但大规模机器可读 Web 的愿景最终被 LLM 直接理解自然语言取代。
events.source_name: W3C OWL Recommendation (2004-02-10); Berners-Lee et al. (2001) Scientific American
events.card_summary_zh: OWL 试图让网页知识变得可被机器理解和推理，代表符号 AI 与开放网络结合的重要工程尝试。
events.summary_en: On February 10, 2004, the W3C released the OWL (Web Ontology Language) recommendation, the core component of Tim Berners-Lee's Semantic Web project. Designed to make Web content both human-readable and machine-understandable, OWL used Description Logic to add classes, properties, constraints, and reasoning rules on top of RDF triples, later gaining more complex expressivity with OWL 2 in 2009. While this sparked a wave of industry adoption from 2004 to 2012 through initiatives like Google Rich Snippets and Facebook Open Graph, the vision of a large-scale machine-readable Web was ultimately superseded by LLMs directly understanding natural language.
events.card_summary_en: The W3C published OWL hoping machines could understand and reason over web knowledge, one last major engineering push to fuse symbolic AI with the open web.
events.why_it_matters_en: OWL was the final engineering peak of the symbolic-AI-plus-web route. Its failure proved that asking people to hand-structure data does not scale on the web, clearing the way for machine learning from unstructured text. Today's debates about structured output, knowledge graphs versus LLMs, and RAG versus fine-tuning were all rehearsed in the OWL era.
events.behind_scenes_en: The Semantic Web vision came from Berners-Lee's 2001 Scientific American article: annotate web content with structure so machines can reason automatically, and OWL was that vision's technical skeleton, launched in 2004 amid high expectations. Engineering reality intervened: getting content producers to add structured markup cost too much, while search engines extracted information from raw text more cheaply. Google Knowledge Graph pivoted to machine learning plus entity recognition in 2012, marking the industrial end of the Semantic Web dream. LLMs after 2020 confirmed it further: understanding natural language directly scales far better than reading structured annotations.

events.title_zh: DARPA Grand Challenge 2004:无人驾驶第一次公开挑战
events.title_en: DARPA Grand Challenge 2004: First Public Autonomous Driving Challenge
events.summary_zh:
2004 年 3 月 13 日,DARPA 在 Mojave 沙漠举办第一届 Grand Challenge。
赛道 240 公里,奖金 100 万美元,要求无人驾驶车辆 10 小时内完成。
15 支队伍参赛,无人完成,最远的 Carnegie Mellon Sandstorm 跑了 11.78 公里就翻车。
但这次比赛第一次把"无人驾驶"从研究室推到公开竞技场,直接催生 2005 年 Grand Challenge(Stanford Stanley 夺冠,约 6 小时 54 分跑完 132 英里/约 212 公里)和 2007 年 Urban Challenge(CMU Boss 夺冠)。
events.source_name: DARPA Grand Challenge 2004 official report; Thrun et al. (2006) Journal of Field Robotics 23(9)
events.card_summary_zh: DARPA Grand Challenge 2004：无人驾驶第一次公开挑战；DARPA Grand Challenge 是现代无人驾驶的零时刻。
events.summary_en: On March 13, 2004, DARPA hosted the inaugural Grand Challenge in the Mojave Desert, offering a $1 million prize for autonomous vehicles to complete a 240-kilometer course within 10 hours. Though 15 teams competed and none finished—with the furthest contender, Carnegie Mellon's Sandstorm, rolling over after just 11.78 kilometers—the race successfully thrust "autonomous driving" from the lab into the public arena for the first time. This landmark event directly catalyzed the 2005 Grand Challenge (won by Stanford's Stanley, which completed the 132-mile/approx. 212-kilometer course in about 6 hours and 54 minutes) and the 2007 Urban Challenge (won by CMU's Boss).
events.card_summary_en: DARPA's first Grand Challenge sent autonomous vehicles across the Mojave for a public race, the ground-zero moment of modern self-driving.
events.why_it_matters_en: The Grand Challenge was modern autonomous driving's zero hour. The core engineers at Waymo, Cruise, Tesla FSD, WeRide, Pony.ai, and Mobileye mostly trained through the Grand Challenge series. Seeing the 2004 failure next to the 2005 success explains why self-driving industrialized quickly in the 2010s: the hard engineering problems were cracked inside three races from 2004 to 2007.
events.behind_scenes_en: The backdrop was Congress mandating in 2001 that a third of US ground forces be unmanned by 2015. DARPA program manager Ron Kurjanowicz designed the public-challenge-plus-big-prize format, breaking defense contractors' monopoly and inviting universities and startups. The 2004 failure exposed immature sensor fusion and real-time planning; in 2005 Stanford's Stanley team under Sebastian Thrun combined lidar, vision, and path planning to complete the 132-mile course, proving autonomy viable for the first time. Thrun went on to found Google's self-driving project, Chauffeur, in 2009.

events.title_zh: Boston Dynamics BigDog:动态四足机器人突破
events.title_en: Boston Dynamics BigDog: Dynamic Quadruped Breakthrough
events.summary_zh:
2004 年 12 月,Boston Dynamics 在 DARPA 资助下首次演示 BigDog 四足机器人。
BigDog 重 109 公斤,长 1 米,高 0.7 米,由 Marc Raibert 团队设计(Raibert 1986 年 MIT Leg Lab 创办)。
BigDog 用液压驱动 + 16 个关节 + 姿态控制算法,能携带 50 公斤负载在雪地、碎石、冰面、楼梯上行走,被人侧踢后能恢复平衡。
2008 年 BigDog YouTube 视频超过 1500 万次观看,是 AI 机器人史上第一个 viral 视频。
events.source_name: Raibert, M. et al. (2008) BigDog; Boston Dynamics press releases; Raibert (1986) Legged Robots That Balance
events.card_summary_zh: Boston Dynamics 在 DARPA 资助下首次演示 BigDog 四足机器人；BigDog 是“动态平衡机器人”从理论到工程的转折点。
events.summary_en: In December 2004, DARPA-funded Boston Dynamics first demonstrated the BigDog quadruped robot—a 109 kg, 1-meter-long, and 0.7-meter-tall machine designed by Marc Raibert’s team (Raibert founded the MIT Leg Lab in 1986). Driven by hydraulics, 16 joints, and attitude control algorithms, BigDog could carry a 50 kg payload across snow, gravel, ice, and stairs, and even recover its balance after being kicked from the side. In 2008, a YouTube video of the robot surpassed 15 million views, cementing it as the first viral video in AI robotics history.
events.card_summary_en: Boston Dynamics, funded by DARPA, demonstrated the BigDog quadruped, the turning point where dynamic-balance robots moved from theory into working hardware.
events.why_it_matters_en: BigDog was the turning point that took dynamically balancing robots from theory to engineering. It proved Marc Raibert's 1986 dynamic balance theory could be built, laying the foundation for Spot, Atlas, and Boston Dynamics' entire product line. Today's humanoid robot efforts, from Optimus to Figure to Atlas 2024, run on dynamic balance algorithms that ultimately rest on Raibert's thirty years of legged robotics research.
events.behind_scenes_en: Raibert wrote Legged Robots That Balance at MIT's Leg Lab in 1986, establishing the theoretical basis for dynamic balance in machines. In 1992 he left MIT to found Boston Dynamics, and BigDog in 2004 was the engineering summit of his thirty years of legged robot research. BigDog was driven by a two-stroke internal combustion engine powering hydraulic pumps and produced noise above 100 decibels, which is the direct reason SpotMini switched to electric actuators in 2016. Google acquired Boston Dynamics in 2013, sold it to SoftBank in 2017, and Hyundai took over in 2020 for $1.1 billion. The entire technology tree behind today's Spot and Atlas grows out of BigDog.

events.title_zh: Amazon/Netflix 推荐系统:协同过滤的工业高峰
events.title_en: Amazon/Netflix Recommender Systems: Industrial Peak of Collaborative Filtering
events.summary_zh:
2005 年前后,Amazon 推荐系统和 Netflix Cinematch 推荐系统同时达到工业高峰。
Amazon 用 item-based 协同过滤(Linden et al. 2003 IEEE Internet Computing),在 2005 年处理 2900 万活跃用户 + 数百万商品,推荐贡献 35% 销售额。
Netflix Cinematch 用 100M+ 用户评分预测用户对未看电影的评分,2006 年 Netflix Prize 比赛要求把 RMSE 从 0.9514 降到 0.8563,冠军 100 万美元。
events.source_name: Linden, G. et al. (2003) IEEE Internet Computing 7(3); Netflix Prize (2006-2009)
events.card_summary_zh: Amazon 与 Netflix 把协同过滤用于大规模个性化推荐，机器学习开始直接影响消费选择与平台收入。
events.summary_en: Around 2005, the recommendation systems of Amazon and Netflix's Cinematch simultaneously hit their industrial peaks. Amazon utilized item-based collaborative filtering (Linden et al. 2003 IEEE Internet Computing) to process 29 million active users and millions of products in 2005, with recommendations driving 35% of its sales. Meanwhile, Netflix Cinematch leveraged 100M+ user ratings to predict ratings for unseen movies, culminating in the 2006 Netflix Prize competition, which offered $1 million to the winner who could reduce the RMSE from 0.9514 to 0.8563.
events.card_summary_en: Amazon and Netflix ran collaborative filtering at industrial scale, and machine learning began directly shaping consumer choices and platform revenue.
events.why_it_matters_en: Recommender systems were the main engine of ML commercialization from 2005 to 2015. The data flywheels, personalization, and filter bubbles discussed around LLMs today all had early versions inside Amazon and Netflix recommendations in 2005. Understanding this era's narrow-AI-plus-big-data engineering paradigm clarifies both why deep learning entered recommendation quickly after 2012, and why LLMs have actually progressed slowly in recommendation scenarios since 2020.
events.behind_scenes_en: The key insight of 2005-era recommender systems was that data scale beats algorithmic complexity. Amazon's 2003 paper showed item-based collaborative filtering scales better in engineering than user-based CF, even at slightly lower accuracy. The Netflix Prize from 2006 to 2009 verified that ensembles plus large-scale engineering beat any single algorithm: the winning BellKor team combined over 100 models, including SVD, RBM, kNN, and AutoRec, to reach RMSE 0.8567. Koren's matrix factorization work during the competition, SVD++, became the workhorse of recommender systems from 2008 to 2016. That whole paradigm of data plus ensembles plus massive engineering was inherited intact by Facebook, LinkedIn, and YouTube recommendations, until deep learning recommendation models like Wide&Deep and DeepFM appeared in 2016.

events.title_zh: EPFL Blue Brain:脑模拟的长期工程启动
events.title_en: EPFL Blue Brain Project: Long-term Brain Simulation Launched
events.summary_zh:
2005 年 6 月 15 日,EPFL 神经科学家 Henry Markram 启动 Blue Brain Project,在 IBM Blue Gene 超算上模拟大鼠大脑皮层柱(Cortical Column)。
2005-2015 年项目模拟了约 1 万个神经元、3000 万个突触的皮层柱,2013 年扩展为欧盟 Human Brain Project(HBP),10 亿欧元预算。
HBP 在 2013-2023 年大规模模拟和神经信息基础设施上争议不断,Markram 2018 年离开 HBP,但 Blue Brain 至今仍在 EPFL 运行。
events.source_name: Markram, H. (2006) Nature Reviews Neuroscience 7(2); HBP 2013-2023 reports
events.card_summary_zh: EPFL Blue Brain：脑模拟的长期工程启动；Blue Brain 是“脑模拟路线”最雄心勃勃的工程。
events.summary_en: On June 15, 2005, EPFL neuroscientist Henry Markram launched the Blue Brain Project, simulating a rat cortical column on an IBM Blue Gene supercomputer. From 2005 to 2015, the project simulated a cortical column of about 10,000 neurons and 30 million synapses, expanding in 2013 into the European Union's €1 billion Human Brain Project (HBP). While the HBP was mired in controversy over its large-scale simulations and neuroinformatics infrastructure from 2013 to 2023—leading to Markram's departure in 2018—the Blue Brain Project continues to run at EPFL today.
events.card_summary_en: EPFL launched the Blue Brain Project, the most ambitious engineering attempt yet to simulate a brain digit by digit.
events.why_it_matters_en: Blue Brain is the most ambitious project on the brain-simulation route. Its core failure revealed that biological complexity exceeds what engineering can simulate, showing that intelligence does not necessarily require biological fidelity. The debates now running through LLM circles about emergence, scaling laws, and whether intelligence needs a body were all rehearsed in the Blue Brain era. Tracing this line explains why mainstream AI abandoned biological simulation entirely after 2012 and turned to statistical learning.
events.behind_scenes_en: Blue Brain represents one strand in AI history: biological reductionism. Markram claimed in his 2009 TED talk that a simulated human brain would arrive within ten years, drawing sharp criticism from neuroscience and AI alike. Critics pointed out that the brain is more than neurons and synapses; there are glial cells, neuromodulators, molecular dynamics, and even simulating every detail might not produce intelligence. The Human Brain Project saw constant internal conflict from 2013 to 2015, with eight neuroscientists publishing an open letter attacking Markram's route until the EU forced a management reorganization. Blue Brain and Hinton's distributed-representation-and-learning route were the two parallel paths of twenty-first-century AI, and the latter won decisively after AlexNet in 2012.

events.title_zh: Dartmouth AI@50 大会:AI 半世纪集体盘点
events.title_en: Dartmouth AI@50 Conference: Half-Century Collective Retrospective
events.summary_zh:
2006 年 7 月 13-15 日,Dartmouth College 举办 AI@50 大会,纪念 1956 年达特茅斯会议 50 周年。
会议邀请 McCarthy、Minsky、Simon、Newell 等 1956 原班人马,加上 Hinton、LeCun、Bengio、Russell、Norvig 等新一代领军,回顾 AI 50 年的命名、热潮、寒冬、专家系统、统计学习、机器人和重新升温。
会议讨论重点包括:深度学习是否可信、概率 AI vs 符号 AI、AI 伦理、AI 寒冬周期律等。
events.source_name: Dartmouth AI@50 Conference (2006-07); McCarthy et al. (2006) AI Magazine 27(4)
events.card_summary_zh: 会议讨论重点包括:深度学习是否可信、概率 AI vs 符号 AI、AI 伦理、AI 寒冬周期律等；AI@50 是 AI 圈承前启后的关键节点。
events.summary_en: From July 13 to 15, 2006, Dartmouth College hosted the AI@50 conference to commemorate the 50th anniversary of the 1956 Dartmouth conference. The event brought together the original 1956 cohort, including McCarthy, Minsky, Simon, and Newell, alongside a new generation of leaders like Hinton, LeCun, Bengio, Russell, and Norvig to reflect on 50 years of AI's naming, hypes, winters, expert systems, statistical learning, robotics, and resurgence. Key discussions focused on the trustworthiness of deep learning, probabilistic AI vs. symbolic AI, AI ethics, and the cyclical patterns of AI winters.
events.card_summary_en: Fifty years after Dartmouth 1956, AI researchers gathered for AI@50 to take stock of half a century of failures and quiet progress.
events.why_it_matters_en: AI@50 was the hinge moment where the field looked back before moving forward. It systematically inventoried fifty years of failures and accumulation from 1956 to 2006, letting a new generation see clearly which roads were dead ends, symbolic AI and expert systems, and which roads had been quietly accumulating, neural networks, statistical learning, GPUs. The similar retrospectives at AI@60 and AI@70 all stand on the collective-reflection tradition that AI@50 established.
events.behind_scenes_en: The mood was delicate. When McCarthy coined the term artificial intelligence in 1956 he predicted a summer would solve machine intelligence; fifty years later AI remained stuck at narrow tools. Hinton presented DBN pretraining results and drew skepticism from mainstream symbolic researchers asking whether neural networks were back again. Minsky held firm to the symbolic line and tensions with Hinton's group ran high. Moore was still pitching GPU general-purpose computing inside NVIDIA in 2006, and nobody attending foresaw that AlexNet would overturn everything six years later. AI@50's real significance was the stocktaking itself, a bridge summary ahead of the great explosion after 2012.

events.title_zh: Hinton-Salakhutdinov DBN:深度学习复兴起点
events.title_en: Hinton-Salakhutdinov DBN: Deep Learning Revival
events.summary_zh:
2006 年 7 月 28 日,Geoffrey Hinton 和 Ruslan Salakhutdinov 在Science 313(5786):504-507 发表《Reducing the Dimensionality of Data with Neural Networks》。
论文用 Restricted Boltzmann Machine 预训练 + 反向传播微调,在 MNIST 上把自编码器降维错误率从 PCA 的 14.8% 降到 6.4%。
这是 Deep Belief Network(DBN)的工程化论文,重新证明多层神经网络可以训练,也正式让“deep learning”一词进入主流。
同年 Hinton 在 NIPS 发表《A Fast Learning Algorithm for Deep Belief Nets》,进一步推广 DBN 训练方法。
events.source_name: Hinton, G. E. & Salakhutdinov, R. (2006) Science 313(5786):504-507; Hinton et al. (2006) NIPS
events.card_summary_zh: 深度置信网络证明多层神经网络仍然可以有效训练，“深度学习”由此重新回到主流研究视野。
events.summary_en: On July 28, 2006, Geoffrey Hinton and Ruslan Salakhutdinov published "Reducing the Dimensionality of Data with Neural Networks" in *Science* 313(5786):504-507, using Restricted Boltzmann Machine pre-training and backpropagation fine-tuning to slash the autoencoder dimensionality reduction error rate on MNIST from PCA's 14.8% to 6.4%. As the engineering paper for Deep Belief Networks (DBN), it proved once again that multi-layer neural networks could be trained, officially pushing the term "deep learning" into the mainstream. That same year, Hinton further popularized the DBN training method by publishing "A Fast Learning Algorithm for Deep Belief Nets" at NIPS.
events.card_summary_en: Hinton and Salakhutdinov published deep belief networks in Science, proving multilayer networks could still be trained effectively and bringing deep learning back into mainstream view.
events.why_it_matters_en: The 2006 DBN paper was ground zero for the deep learning era. The technology trees behind GPT, Stable Diffusion, and AlphaFold all grow from this breakthrough. Following the line of DBN 2006, DBN speech recognition in 2009, AlexNet in 2012, GAN in 2014, Transformer in 2017, and GPT-3 in 2020 makes clear that deep learning did not erupt from nowhere in 2012; it was the result of eight years of persistence by Hinton's team meeting maturing compute and data.
events.behind_scenes_en: Hinton's team developed the Contrastive Divergence training algorithm in Toronto from 2002 to 2006, solving the problem of slow RBM training. Getting published in Science mattered enormously: it bypassed the neural-networks-are-dead bias of AI journals and carried deep learning back into mainstream scientific view. In 2009 the team worked with Microsoft and Google to apply DBNs to speech recognition, and DNN-HMM cut TIMIT error rates from 24.8% to 16.0% across 2010-2011, directly setting up AlexNet's ImageNet breakthrough in 2012. When Hinton won the Nobel Prize in Physics with Hopfield in 2024, this line was the core citation.

events.title_zh: Netflix Prize 启动:机器学习众包比赛范式
events.title_en: Netflix Prize Launched: Crowdsourced ML Competition Paradigm
events.summary_zh:
2006 年 10 月 2 日,Netflix 启动 Netflix Prize,公开 1 亿条匿名电影评分(48 万用户 × 1.8 万电影),目标把 Cinematch 的 RMSE 0.9514 降低 10%(到 0.8563),冠军奖金 100 万美元。
比赛历时 3 年,吸引 5169 支队伍、186 个国家 4.1 万参与者,提交 4.4 万次预测。
2009 年 7 月 26 日 BellKor's Pragmatic Chaos 团队(Yehuda Koren、Robert Bell、Chris Volinsky + Martin Chabbert)以 0.8567 RMSE 险胜 The Ensemble,赢得 100 万美元。
events.source_name: Netflix Prize (2006-10-02 to 2009-09-21); Bell, Koren, Volinsky (2009) IEEE Computer 42(8)
events.card_summary_zh: Netflix Prize 启动：机器学习众包比赛范式；Netflix Prize 是“公开数据 + 众包比赛”范式的源头。
events.summary_en: On October 2, 2006, Netflix launched the Netflix Prize, releasing 100 million anonymous movie ratings (480,000 users × 18,000 movies) and offering a $1 million grand prize to anyone who could improve its Cinematch algorithm's RMSE of 0.9514 by 10% (to 0.8563). The three-year competition attracted 41,000 participants across 5,169 teams from 186 countries, yielding 44,000 prediction submissions. On July 26, 2009, the BellKor's Pragmatic Chaos team (Yehuda Koren, Robert Bell, Chris Volinsky, and Martin Chabbert) narrowly defeated The Ensemble with an RMSE of 0.8567 to claim the $1 million reward.
events.card_summary_en: Netflix put a million dollars and its movie ratings data on the table, launching the crowd-sourced ML competition format that evaluation still follows today.
events.why_it_matters_en: The Netflix Prize was the origin of the public-data-plus-crowd-competition paradigm. Kaggle, Hugging Face leaderboards, Chatbot Arena, and SWE-Bench rankings in LLM circles all stand on the format Netflix Prize established. Following the line from Netflix Prize 2006 to Kaggle 2010 to ImageNet 2010 to GLUE 2018 to Chatbot Arena 2024 shows how AI benchmarking evolved from private datasets into open competition.
events.behind_scenes_en: Netflix's internal Cinematch algorithm was an ensemble of SVD and kNN, and the final winning solution was an ensemble of more than 100 models including SVD, RBM, kNN, and AutoRec. Koren developed matrix factorization, SVD++, during the competition, which became recommender systems' mainstay algorithm from 2008 to 2016. Netflix cancelled the second Prize in 2010 over an FTC privacy lawsuit, but the competition format was inherited whole by Kaggle in 2010, ImageNet in 2010, KDD Cup, NIPS competitions, and NeurIPS 2020's RL track. Kaggle itself was founded in 2010 and acquired by Google in 2017, becoming the standard platform for machine learning competitions.

events.title_zh: NVIDIA CUDA 预览:GPU 通用计算开放给开发者
events.title_en: NVIDIA CUDA Preview: GPU General Computing Opens to Developers
events.summary_zh:
2006 年 11 月 8 日,NVIDIA 在 G80 芯片(GeForce 8800 GTX)发布时同步推出 CUDA(Compute Unified Device Architecture)预览版,让开发者用 C 语言直接编程 GPU 通用计算。
GeForce 8800 GTX 集成 128 个流处理器,核心 575MHz,显存 768MB GDDR3,是第一代支持 CUDA 的硬件。
CUDA 1.0 正式版 2007 年 2 月发布,配合 NVIDIA cuBLAS、cuFFT、cuDNN 等库逐步成熟,成为深度学习算力基础设施。
events.source_name: NVIDIA CUDA announcement (2006-11-08); Buck, I. (2004) Stanford PhD BrookGPU
events.card_summary_zh: CUDA 把 GPU 的并行能力开放给普通程序，后来训练深度神经网络所需的算力基础由此形成。
events.summary_en: On November 8, 2006, NVIDIA launched a preview of CUDA (Compute Unified Device Architecture) alongside its G80 chip (GeForce 8800 GTX), allowing developers to program GPUs directly for general-purpose computing using C. Packing 128 stream processors, a 575MHz core, and 768MB of GDDR3 memory, the GeForce 8800 GTX was the first-generation hardware to support CUDA. Following the official release of CUDA 1.0 in February 2007, the platform matured alongside libraries like NVIDIA cuBLAS, cuFFT, and cuDNN to become the foundational infrastructure for deep learning compute.
events.card_summary_en: NVIDIA previewed CUDA at SC06, opening the GPU's parallel power to ordinary programmers and forming the compute foundation deep learning would later train on.
events.why_it_matters_en: Without CUDA there is no deep learning era. Ninety-nine percent of LLM training today runs on NVIDIA GPUs through CUDA, and PyTorch, TensorFlow, and JAX are all built on top of it. Tracing CUDA's transformation from graphics-hardware add-on between 2006 and 2012 into AI-compute monopoly explains both NVIDIA's three-trillion-dollar market cap in 2024 and why LLM circles discuss compute chokepoints almost entirely in terms of the CUDA ecosystem.
events.behind_scenes_en: CUDA's development lead was Ian Buck, now NVIDIA's head of accelerated computing, who built BrookGPU during his Stanford PhD starting in 2004, turning GPU general-purpose computing into serious academic work. From 2004 to 2006 NVIDIA restructured its G70/G80 chip architecture, replacing fixed-function pipelines with unified shaders to give CUDA its hardware base. Early reception was lukewarm: game developers found it complex, and academia only discovered GPU training's value for neural networks between 2007 and 2009. When Rajat Raina and Andrew Ng trained deep belief networks on GPUs in 2009, cutting training time from weeks to days, that became the direct source of AlexNet's decision to use GPUs in 2012.

events.title_zh: ImageNet 项目启动:1400 万张图像的赌注
events.title_en: ImageNet Project Launched: 14M Images Bet
events.summary_zh: 2007 年李飞飞在普林斯顿大学启动 ImageNet 项目,计划构建 2.2 万个类别、1400 万张图像的巨型数据集,2009 年在 CVPR 正式发表论文。
events.card_summary_zh: ImageNet 以千万级标注图像建立视觉知识库，这场看似笨重的数据工程后来引爆深度学习革命。
events.summary_en: In 2007, Fei-Fei Li launched the ImageNet project at Princeton University, aiming to build a massive dataset of 14 million images across 22,000 categories. The paper was officially published at CVPR in 2009.
events.card_summary_en: Fei-Fei Li launched ImageNet, betting that tens of millions of labeled images would matter more than any clever algorithm.
events.why_it_matters_en: ImageNet's launch represented a fundamental wager: vision is the first step toward machine intelligence, and data is the key to winning that wager.
events.behind_scenes_en: Almost nobody supported it at the start. Li needed to download nearly a billion candidate images for screening, and her PhD student Jia Deng calculated that manual labeling would take nineteen years. They turned to Amazon Mechanical Turk crowdsourcing instead. Princeton professor Kai Li was the only one who extended a hand, donating a workstation.

events.title_zh: iPhone 发布:移动互联网与移动 AI 的起点
events.title_en: iPhone Launched: Mobile Internet and Mobile AI Era Begins
events.summary_zh:
2007 年 1 月 9 日,Steve Jobs 在 Macworld 发布 iPhone,6 月 29 日正式上市。
初代 iPhone 集成多点触控、3.5 英寸屏、Wi-Fi、EDGE、200 万像素相机、iOS 1(基于 Mac OS X),售价 499 美元(4GB)/599 美元(8GB)。
2008 年 7 月 App Store 上线,2010 年 iPhone 4 + Retina 屏,iPhone 成为移动互联网时代标准终端。
iPhone 对 AI 的意义在“移动 AI 推理”和“移动端数据采集”两件事:2017 年 Apple A11 仿生芯片集成 Neural Engine,2018 年 Core ML 让 iOS 开发者可以直接跑深度学习模型。
events.source_name: Apple iPhone announcement (2007-01-09); Apple A11 Bionic Neural Engine (2017)
events.card_summary_zh: iPhone 把传感器、网络和计算装进口袋，为语音助手、移动视觉和个性化 AI 创造了最大入口。
events.summary_en: On January 9, 2007, Steve Jobs unveiled the iPhone at Macworld before its official release on June 29, packing multi-touch, a 3.5-inch screen, Wi-Fi, EDGE, a 2-megapixel camera, and iOS 1 (based on Mac OS X) for $499 (4GB)/$599 (8GB). The July 2008 launch of the App Store and 2010's iPhone 4 with a Retina display solidified it as the standard terminal of the mobile internet era. The iPhone's significance to AI lies in "mobile AI inference" and "on-device data collection"—driven by the Apple A11 Bionic chip integrating the Neural Engine in 2017, and the release of Core ML in 2018, which allowed iOS developers to run deep learning models directly.
events.card_summary_en: The iPhone packed sensors, networking, and computing into a pocket device, creating the biggest single entry point for voice assistants, mobile vision, and personal AI.
events.why_it_matters_en: The iPhone was ground zero for mobile AI. The topics circulating in LLM circles today, on-device inference, model compression, privacy protection, edge AI, were all rehearsed along the line from the iPhone's 2007 launch through the Neural Engine in 2017 and Core ML in 2018. Grasping what the iPhone meant for AI clarifies why Apple insists on an on-device-first, cloud-supplement route in the LLM era, standing opposite Google's and Microsoft's cloud-first strategies.
events.behind_scenes_en: At launch in 2007 the iPhone had no SDK and only built-in apps. Jobs initially opposed third-party apps, fearing quality would spin out of control. Through 2007 and 2008 developers wrote third-party software via jailbreaks until Jobs opened the SDK and App Store in March 2008, transforming the iPhone into a platform for mobile AI compute plus data collection. Apple rolled out Core ML, Vision API, and Natural Language API across 2015-2017, integrated the Neural Engine into the A11 Bionic chip in 2017, and ran Face ID's CNN-based facial recognition entirely on-device in 2018. The iPhone also became the hardware foundation for Apple Intelligence in iOS 18 in 2024, with A17 Pro and M-series chips supporting on-device LLM inference.

events.title_zh: NVIDIA CUDA 1.0 正式发布:GPU 走入通用计算
events.title_en: NVIDIA CUDA 1.0 Released: GPU Goes General Purpose
events.summary_zh:
2007 年 2 月 14 日,NVIDIA 发布 CUDA 1.0 正式版,支持 GeForce 8 系列、Quadro FX 4600/5600、Tesla C870/G80 等硬件。
CUDA 1.0 包含 nvcc 编译器、CUDA Runtime、cuBLAS、cuFFT、CUDA GDB,让 C 语言开发者可以直接在 GPU 上编程矩阵乘、卷积、FFT 等高并行计算。
2007 年也是 NVIDIA Tesla GPU 计算品牌启动的年份,面向 HPC 和 AI 工作负载的专用产品线开始独立。
2007-2010 年 CUDA SDK 逐步完善,2010 年 cuDNN 前身 cuBLAS-XT、2014 年 cuDNN 1.0,成为深度学习框架的底层依赖。
events.source_name: NVIDIA CUDA 1.0 release (2007-02-14); NVIDIA Tesla brand launch (2007)
events.card_summary_zh: CUDA 让开发者可以直接调用 GPU 进行通用计算，训练神经网络所需的并行算力从此变得可编程。
events.summary_en: On February 14, 2007, NVIDIA officially released CUDA 1.0—supporting GeForce 8 series, Quadro FX 4600/5600, and Tesla C870/G80 hardware—which featured the nvcc compiler, CUDA Runtime, cuBLAS, cuFFT, and CUDA GDB to let C developers program highly parallel computations like matrix multiplication, convolution, and FFT directly on the GPU. That same year, NVIDIA also launched its Tesla GPU computing brand, establishing a dedicated, independent product line for HPC and AI workloads. As the CUDA SDK was gradually refined between 2007 and 2010, it set the stage for cuDNN's predecessor cuBLAS-XT in 2010 and cuDNN 1.0 in 2014, both of which became the foundational dependencies of deep learning frameworks.
events.card_summary_en: CUDA 1.0 shipped to developers, making GPU parallel power programmable for general computing and setting up the hardware story of neural network training.
events.why_it_matters_en: CUDA 1.0 was the pivot where NVIDIA turned from a gaming graphics company into an AI-compute monopolist. NVIDIA's three-trillion-dollar market cap today rests on the CUDA ecosystem as its core moat. Tracing the line from CUDA 1.0 in 2007 through AlexNet in 2012, cuDNN in 2014, and LLMs in 2020 shows why AMD, Intel, and Google TPU have all struggled to shake NVIDIA's grip on the LLM training market.
events.behind_scenes_en: When CUDA 1.0 shipped, NVIDIA's revenue came mainly from gaming graphics. CEO Jensen Huang treated CUDA as a ten-year strategic bet, pouring roughly $100 million a year into the CUDA ecosystem from 2007 to 2012 while commercial returns were nearly zero. The decision was contested inside the company, with investors repeatedly questioning whether the investment was worth it. In 2012 AlexNet trained ImageNet on GTX 580s, proving GPU-based deep network training worked, and the bet began paying off. cuDNN 1.0 in 2014, TensorFlow in 2015, and PyTorch in 2016 locked CUDA in as deep learning's compute monopoly, and Huang's thirty-year strategy cashed out completely in the 2020s.

events.title_zh: DARPA Urban Challenge:无人驾驶进入城市环境
events.title_en: DARPA Urban Challenge: Autonomous Driving Enters Urban Environment
events.summary_zh:
2007 年 11 月 3 日,DARPA 在加州 Victorville 举办 Urban Challenge。
赛道 96 公里城市道路,要求无人车遵守交通规则,在路口、环形交叉、并道、超车场景下与其他车辆和人类司机互动。
11 支队伍进入决赛,CMU Boss(Tartan Racing)第一,Stanford Junior 第二,Virginia Tech Odin 第三,MIT Talos 第六。
Boss 用 6 小时 53 分完成 96 公里,平均时速 14 公里。
这是无人车第一次在城市环境跑通完整交通规则。
events.source_name: DARPA Urban Challenge 2007 official report; Urmson et al. (2008) J. Field Robotics 25(10)
events.card_summary_zh: 无人车第一次在模拟城市道路中处理路口、并线和交通规则，自动驾驶从荒野测试进入真实交通逻辑。
events.summary_en: On November 3, 2007, DARPA held the Urban Challenge in Victorville, California, requiring autonomous vehicles to navigate a 96-kilometer urban course, obey traffic rules, and interact with other vehicles and human drivers at intersections, roundabouts, merging, and overtaking. Out of 11 finalist teams, CMU Boss (Tartan Racing) took first place—completing the 96 km in 6 hours and 53 minutes at an average speed of 14 km/h—followed by Stanford Junior in second, Virginia Tech Odin in third, and MIT Talos in sixth. This marked the first time autonomous vehicles successfully navigated a complete set of traffic rules in an urban environment.
events.card_summary_en: Six driverless cars finished the DARPA Urban Challenge, handling intersections, merges, and traffic rules for the first time in a simulated city.
events.why_it_matters_en: The Urban Challenge was the turning point that took self-driving from open desert into city streets. It proved autonomous vehicles could operate inside a real traffic system, paving the way for Google's 2009 self-driving project, Tesla Autopilot in 2014, Waymo's independence in 2016, and Cruise's venture funding in 2018. Most of today's autonomous driving technical leadership was trained through the three DARPA challenges from 2004 to 2007.
events.behind_scenes_en: The hard part of the Urban Challenge was decision-making in dynamic environments. The progression went: Grand Challenge failure in 2004, five finishers in 2005, six finishers in the urban setting of 2007, three giant strides in three years. CMU's Boss team, led by Chris Urmson, later Waymo's CEO, combined lidar, vision, radar, and path planning to handle intersection yielding, merging, and passing in city scenarios. Stanford Junior under Sebastian Thrun ran a similar approach but stayed more conservative on merge decisions and placed second. Both Urmson and Thrun joined Google Project Chauffeur in 2009; the Urban Challenge is Waymo's technical source.

events.title_zh: Hadoop + MapReduce + 机器学习:大数据工程范式成熟
events.title_en: Hadoop + MapReduce + ML: Big Data Engineering Paradigm Matures
events.summary_zh:
2008 年 4 月 Yahoo 发布 Hadoop 0.16,Apache Hadoop 项目正式独立;9 月 Hadoop 0.18 完善 HDFS + MapReduce,成为大数据处理标准。
同年 Google 在 CACM 51(1):107-113 发表 MapReduce 论文工程回顾,Cloudera(2009)、Hortonworks(2011)、MapR(2009)基于 Hadoop 创业,形成完整的大数据生态。
2008-2012 年 Hadoop + Hive + Pig + Mahout + Spark(2010) 让“大规模数据 + 简单机器学习算法”工程范式在互联网公司普及,Google、Facebook、LinkedIn、Twitter、Amazon 都跑着千节点 Hadoop 集群。
events.source_name: Dean, J. & Ghemawat, S. (2008) CACM 51(1):107-113; Apache Hadoop 0.18 (2008-09)
events.card_summary_zh: Hadoop + MapReduce + 机器学习：大数据工程范式成熟；Hadoop + MapReduce 是大数据机器学习的工程基础。
events.summary_en: In April 2008, Yahoo released Hadoop 0.16 as the Apache Hadoop project officially became independent, followed in September by Hadoop 0.18, which refined HDFS + MapReduce into the standard for big data processing. That same year, Google published its MapReduce paper engineering retrospective in CACM 51(1):107-113, while Cloudera (2009), Hortonworks (2011), and MapR (2009) launched startups based on Hadoop to form a complete big data ecosystem. Between 2008 and 2012, Hadoop + Hive + Pig + Mahout + Spark (2010) popularized the "massive data + simple machine learning algorithms" engineering paradigm across internet companies, with Google, Facebook, LinkedIn, Twitter, and Amazon all running thousand-node Hadoop clusters.
events.card_summary_en: Hadoop brought MapReduce out of Google's papers into open-source infrastructure, maturing the big-data engineering paradigm machine learning would scale on.
events.why_it_matters_en: Hadoop plus MapReduce is the engineering foundation of big-data machine learning. Today's data pipelines, distributed training, and feature stores behind LLM training were all rehearsed in the Hadoop era. Understanding the big-data engineering paradigm of 2008-2014 explains why Spark in 2014, TensorFlow in 2015, and Ray in 2018 could support deep learning engineering so quickly, and why the data flywheels, feature engineering, and online learning discussed around LLMs all stand on data infrastructure built in Hadoop's time.
events.behind_scenes_en: Hadoop came from Doug Cutting's work at Yahoo between 2003 and 2005. Drawing on Google's GFS paper of 2003, MapReduce paper of 2004, and Bigtable paper of 2006, he implemented an open-source version in Java and named it after his son's toy elephant. Yahoo poured engineers into perfecting Hadoop from 2006 to 2008, aiming to escape dependence on Google's closed infrastructure. During Hadoop's explosive growth from 2008 to 2012, Facebook shipped Hive in 2007, Yahoo Pig in 2008, Apache Mahout in 2010, and UC Berkeley Spark in 2010. Spark replaced MapReduce as the mainstream engine in 2014, but Hadoop's paradigm of distributed storage plus massive computation was inherited intact.

events.title_zh: Google Chrome 发布:Web 浏览器再革命
events.title_en: Google Chrome Released: Web Browser Revolution
events.summary_zh:
2008 年 9 月 2 日,Google 发布 Chrome 1.0 浏览器。
Chrome 用 V8 JavaScript 引擎(2010 年引入 Crankshaft JIT 优化编译器)突破 JS 性能瓶颈,用多进程架构隔离 Tab,用 Webkit(2013 年改 Blink)渲染引擎提高兼容性。
Chrome 2009 年 12 月超越 Safari,2010-2012 年超越 Firefox,2016 年超越 IE,2024 年全球市场份额 65%。
Chrome 对 AI 的意义是“Web 作为应用平台 + 数据采集层”:Web 应用从“静态页面”演化到“SPA + 持久化客户端”,为后续 LLM 圈的 Web Agent、ChatGPT Web 客户端、Notion AI 等基于 Web 的 AI 应用提供工程基础。
events.source_name: Google Chrome 1.0 release (2008-09-02); V8 engine (2008)
events.card_summary_zh: Google 发布 Chrome 1.0 浏览器；Chrome 是 Web 作为“AI 应用平台”的工程基础。
events.summary_en: On September 2, 2008, Google released Chrome 1.0, breaking JS performance bottlenecks with its V8 JavaScript engine (which added the Crankshaft JIT optimizing compiler in 2010), isolating tabs via a multi-process architecture, and leveraging the Webkit rendering engine (switched to Blink in 2013) to improve compatibility. The browser went on to overtake Safari in December 2009, Firefox between 2010 and 2012, and IE in 2016, ultimately commanding a 65% global market share by 2024. For AI, Chrome’s true significance lies in establishing "the Web as an application platform + data collection layer," driving the evolution of web apps from "static pages" to "SPAs + persistent clients" and paving the engineering foundation for LLM-era Web Agents, the ChatGPT web client, and Notion AI.
events.card_summary_en: Google launched Chrome 1.0 with the V8 engine, transforming the Web from pages into applications and building the platform layer most AI tools now run on.
events.why_it_matters_en: Chrome is the engineering foundation of the Web as an AI application platform. ChatGPT Web, Claude Web, Google Gemini Web, and Character.AI all run on Chrome and Chromium engines today. Understanding how Chrome turned the Web from documents into applications clarifies why web interfaces suit AI toolchains better than native apps in the LLM era, and why browser-operating paradigms like Browser Use, WebVoyager, and Anthropic Computer Use became mainstream in 2024.
events.behind_scenes_en: Chrome's development was led by Sundar Pichai, later Google's CEO, with a technical team including Lars Bak of the V8 engine plus Firefox veterans Ben Goodger and Darin Fisher. Google's original motive was that Microsoft's IE was dragging down web apps: Search, Gmail, and Google Maps ran painfully slow on IE 6 and 7. V8 lifted JavaScript performance tenfold and turned web applications from documents into programs. Chrome Web Store arrived in 2010, Chrome OS in 2011, Android Chrome in 2012, making Chrome the core of Google's cross-device platform strategy. Today's Web Agents, RPA tools, and browser automation all stand on Chrome and Chromium's universal adoption.

events.title_zh: Google Project Chauffeur:工业级自动驾驶启动
events.title_en: Google Project Chauffeur: Industrial Autonomous Driving Launched
events.summary_zh:
2009 年 1 月 17 日,Google X 启动 Project Chauffeur 自动驾驶项目,Sebastian Thrun(Stanford Junior 团队领军)和 Chris Urmson(CMU Boss 团队领军)共同主导。
团队最初 10 人,包括 DARPA Grand Challenge 老将 Mike Montemerlo、Anthony Levandowski、Bryan Salesky 等。
2010 年 10 月第一代无人车 Toyota Prius 改装版在旧金山公开路测,2012 年 5 月 Nevada 颁发第一张无人车牌照。
2016 年 12 月项目分拆为 Waymo 独立子公司,John Krafcik 任 CEO。
events.source_name: Google Project Chauffeur (2009-01); Waymo 2016 spin-off; Thrun interviews
events.card_summary_zh: Google 把自动驾驶从竞赛原型变成长期工业项目，后来独立成 Waymo 并开启商业无人驾驶路线。
events.summary_en: On January 17, 2009, Google X launched its Project Chauffeur self-driving project, co-led by Sebastian Thrun (leader of the Stanford Junior team) and Chris Urmson (leader of the CMU Boss team) with an initial 10-person crew including DARPA Grand Challenge veterans Mike Montemerlo, Anthony Levandowski, and Bryan Salesky. After public road tests of its first-generation modified Toyota Prius in San Francisco in October 2010, the project secured Nevada's first-ever autonomous vehicle license plate in May 2012. In December 2016, the project spun off into the independent subsidiary Waymo, with John Krafcik serving as CEO.
events.card_summary_en: Google turned Sebastian Thrun's competition success into Project Chauffeur, an industrial-scale self-driving program that would later become Waymo.
events.why_it_matters_en: Project Chauffeur was ground zero for industrial-grade autonomous driving. The technical backbone of Waymo, Cruise, Zoox, Pony.ai, and WeRide mostly came up through Chauffeur's ranks. The debates running through self-driving circles today about L2 versus L4, data flywheels versus algorithmic breakthroughs, incremental versus leapfrog strategies, were all rehearsed inside Google from 2009 to 2014.
events.behind_scenes_en: Larry Page drove the launch personally. After watching the 2007 Urban Challenge, Page invited Thrun to Google X in 2008 to evaluate whether self-driving could be commercialized within five years. Thrun's team concluded ten years, Page committed anyway, and Project Chauffeur started in January 2009. Google chose to go straight for fully driverless L4, skipping the L2/L3 incremental route, a decision that kept Waymo technically ahead from 2009 to 2018 while commercializing slowly, in contrast to Tesla Autopilot shipping L2 early in 2014 to accumulate data. In 2020 Waymo opened its driverless taxi service in Phoenix, reaching L4 commercial operation four years before Tesla FSD, though Waymo's expansion has lagged far behind Tesla FSD's user base.

events.title_zh: Rajat Raina + Andrew Ng:GPU 训练深度信念网络
events.title_en: Rajat Raina + Andrew Ng: GPU-Trained Deep Belief Networks
events.summary_zh:
2009 年 6 月,Stanford 的 Rajat Raina、Anand Madhavan、Andrew Ng 在 ICML 2009(第 26 届国际机器学习大会,6 月 14-18 日)发表论文《Large-scale Deep Unsupervised Learning using Graphics Processors》。
论文用 NVIDIA GTX 280 GPU(1GB 显存)训练 Deep Belief Network,在 MNIST 上把训练时间从 CPU 的约 19 天降到 GPU 的约 1 天,加速约 14 倍。
在稀疏编码/自编码器上加速最高约 70 倍量级。
这是"GPU 训练深度网络"最早的工程化论文,直接启发 2012 年 AlexNet 用 GTX 580 训练 ImageNet。
events.source_name: Raina, R., Madhavan, A., Ng, A. Y. (2009). ICML 2009: Proceedings of the 26th International Conference on Machine Learning; Google Brain cat neuron (2012 NYT)
events.card_summary_zh: Rajat Raina + Andrew Ng：GPU 训练深度信念网络；Raina-Ng 2009 论文是 GPU 深度学习工程化的关键节点。
events.summary_en: In June 2009, Stanford’s Rajat Raina, Anand Madhavan, and Andrew Ng presented their paper "Large-scale Deep Unsupervised Learning using Graphics Processors" at ICML 2009 (the 26th International Conference on Machine Learning, June 14-18). Using an NVIDIA GTX 280 GPU with 1GB of memory to train a Deep Belief Network, they slashed training time on MNIST from about 19 days on CPU to roughly one day on GPU—a 14x speedup—while accelerating sparse coding/autoencoders by up to about 70x. As the earliest engineering paper on training deep networks with GPUs, this work directly inspired AlexNet to train ImageNet using the GTX 580 in 2012.
events.card_summary_en: Rajat Raina and Andrew Ng showed GPUs could train deep belief networks dramatically faster, the key node where GPU-based deep learning became engineering reality.
events.why_it_matters_en: The Raina-Ng 2009 paper was the key node in GPU deep learning engineering. The massive GPU clusters behind LLM training had their early version in Raina and Ng's single-GPU experiments. Following the line from the 2009 GPU lab through Google Brain's thousand machines in 2012, large Transformer models in 2017, and GPT-3 in 2020 shows why NVIDIA could hold its compute monopoly in the LLM era, and why today's compute-chokepoint discussions concentrate on GPU supply.
events.behind_scenes_en: Andrew Ng worked with GPUs for machine learning at Stanford from 2007 to 2009, finding them orders of magnitude faster than CPUs at matrix multiplication. Raina was Ng's doctoral student and began attempting DBN training on GPU in 2008. The engineering difficulty was memory management: Raina's team hand-managed GPU memory, feeding mini-batch slices to the device. CUDA had been out for two years by 2009, yet mainstream academia still used CPU plus MATLAB. Ng's team's paper proved GPU training of deep networks viable, and in 2011 Ng joined the Google Brain project, working with Jeff Dean and Greg Corrado to train deep networks on a thousand servers plus GPU cluster to recognize cat faces, which made the New York Times front page in 2012.

events.title_zh: Fei-Fei Li ImageNet:视觉识别的标准基准
events.title_en: Fei-Fei Li ImageNet: Standard Benchmark for Visual Recognition
events.summary_zh:
2009 年 6 月 20 日,Fei-Fei Li 团队在 CVPR 2009 发表《ImageNet: A Large-Scale Hierarchical Image Database》,正式发布 ImageNet 数据集。
数据集基于 WordNet 名词层级,通过 Amazon Mechanical Turk 众包标注,最终收录 1400 万张图像、21841 个类别,每类约 500-1000 张。
2010 年 ILSVRC(ImageNet Large Scale Visual Recognition Challenge)启动,用 1000 类 + 120 万训练图 + 5 万验证图 + 15 万测试图,成为视觉识别的标准基准。
events.source_name: Deng, J. et al. (2009) CVPR; Russakovsky et al. (2015) IJCV 115(3):211-252
missing_terms: ImageNet 大规模视觉识别挑战赛
events.card_summary_zh: ImageNet 用千万级标注图像建立统一赛场，让计算机视觉第一次能够按同一尺度持续比较和进步。
events.summary_en: On June 20, 2009, Fei-Fei Li's team officially released the ImageNet dataset at CVPR 2009, publishing the paper "ImageNet: A Large-Scale Hierarchical Image Database." Built on the WordNet noun hierarchy and annotated via Amazon Mechanical Turk crowdsourcing, the dataset ultimately compiled 14 million images across 21,841 categories, with about 500-1000 images per category. In 2010, the ImageNet Large Scale Visual Recognition Challenge (ILSVRC) launched with 1,000 categories, 1.2 million training images, 50,000 validation images, and 150,000 test images, becoming the standard benchmark for visual recognition.
events.card_summary_en: Fei-Fei Li's ImageNet gave computer vision a single arena of tens of millions of labeled images, letting the field compare and progress on one scale for the first time.
events.why_it_matters_en: ImageNet was the detonator of the deep learning era. Without it there is no AlexNet breakthrough in 2012 and none of the industrial CNN engineering base built from 2012 to 2020. The debates now standard in LLM circles about dataset scale versus algorithmic complexity, benchmark saturation, and dataset bias all had their first rehearsal in the ImageNet era. Understanding ImageNet shows that today's investment in massive corpora like Common Crawl, C4, and RedPajama is the same class of engineering decision Li's team made about images in 2009.
events.behind_scenes_en: Li started the ImageNet project at Princeton in 2007 with the conviction that no algorithm matters without data. Funding was tight early on; she paid Mechanical Turk labeling costs partly out of her own salary, ultimately using forty-nine thousand workers from 167 countries to annotate fourteen million images over two and a half years. The 2009 CVPR paper was initially ignored by the mainstream vision community, and only after the ILSVRC competition launched in 2010 did ImageNet become vision's public benchmark. In 2012 AlexNet cut the ILSVRC top-5 error rate from 26.2% to 15.3%, becoming the detonation point of the deep learning era. Li later worked at Google Cloud and founded Stanford HAI; ImageNet remains the most important data infrastructure project in the history of visual AI.

events.title_zh: Apple 收购 Siri:语音助手进入大厂战略
events.title_en: Apple Acquires Siri: Voice Assistants Enter Big Tech Strategy
events.summary_zh:
2010 年 4 月 28 日,Apple 以约 2 亿美元收购 Siri Inc.。
Siri 原本是 SRI International 基于 CALO 项目(DARPA PAL 项目)开发的虚拟助手,2007 年独立为 Siri Inc.,2009 年 2 月发布 iOS 助手 App。
Apple 2011 年 10 月 4 日在 iPhone 4S 发布会正式推出 Siri 语音助手,成为第一款大规模消费级 AI 语音助手。
Siri 开启了 Amazon Alexa(2014)、Google Assistant(2016)、Microsoft Cortana(2014)、Samsung Bixby(2017)、Apple Intelligence(2024)等大厂语音助手竞争。
events.source_name: Apple Siri acquisition (2010-04-28); SRI CALO project history
events.card_summary_zh: Apple 收购 Siri：语音助手进入大厂战略；Apple 收购 Siri 是大厂 AI 战略的起点。
events.summary_en: On April 28, 2010, Apple acquired Siri Inc. for approximately $200 million, taking over a virtual assistant originally developed by SRI International under the CALO project (DARPA PAL project) that spun off as Siri Inc. in 2007 and released an iOS assistant app in February 2009. Apple officially launched the Siri voice assistant at the iPhone 4S event on October 4, 2011, making it the first large-scale consumer AI voice assistant. This sparked a wave of voice assistant competition among tech giants, paving the way for Amazon Alexa (2014), Microsoft Cortana (2014), Google Assistant (2016), Samsung Bixby (2017), and Apple Intelligence (2024).
events.card_summary_en: Apple bought Siri, turning a DARPA-born research project into big-tech strategy and starting the acquisition race for AI startups.
events.why_it_matters_en: Apple's purchase of Siri was the start of big-tech AI strategy through acquisition. It opened the wave of Google, Amazon, Microsoft, and Meta buying AI startups: Google's $650 million DeepMind deal in 2014, Facebook buying Wit.ai in January 2015, Microsoft paying $19.7 billion for Nuance in 2022. Siri's productize-and-acquire model reveals the internal logic behind LLM-era investment rhythms like Microsoft's $13 billion into OpenAI, Amazon's $8 billion into Anthropic, and Google's $3 billion into Anthropic.
events.behind_scenes_en: Siri's technology tree traces back to SRI International's CALO project of 2003, itself the product of DARPA's Personalized Assistant that Learns program, driven by Adam Cheyer, Tom Gruber, and Dag Kittlaus. Steve Jobs phoned the three founders personally in 2010, inviting them to his home to persuade them to join Apple. Jobs died on October 5, 2011, the day after the iPhone 4S event, making Siri the last major Apple product of his era. Technical progress crawled between 2011 and 2018 while Apple fought internally over Siri's route, on-device versus cloud, rules versus machine learning, and only in 2024 did Apple Intelligence rebuild Siri around an LLM.

events.title_zh: ILSVRC 首届 ImageNet 挑战赛:深度学习的试炼场
events.title_en: First ILSVRC: ImageNet Challenge Launch
events.summary_zh:
首届 ImageNet 大规模视觉识别挑战赛（ILSVRC）举办。
150 个团队报名，仅 11 个提交算法。
missing_terms: ImageNet 大规模视觉识别挑战赛
events.card_summary_zh: 首届 ImageNet 大规模视觉识别挑战赛（ILSVRC）举办。
events.summary_en: The inaugural ImageNet Large Scale Visual Recognition Challenge (ILSVRC) was held. Although 150 teams signed up, only 11 submitted algorithms.
events.card_summary_en: The first ImageNet Large Scale Visual Recognition Challenge opened for entries and drew almost nobody.
events.why_it_matters_en: ILSVRC's bleak initial participation throws AlexNet's explosive impact in 2012 into sharper relief: it was not gradual warming but overnight detonation.
events.behind_scenes_en: The first two editions were won by traditional SVM methods, with marginal gains. Entry counts started falling in the second year. Fei-Fei Li nearly believed she had lost her bet.

events.title_zh: Microsoft Kinect:深度摄像头进入消费市场
events.title_en: Microsoft Kinect: Depth Cameras Enter Consumer Market
events.summary_zh:
2010 年 11 月 4 日,Microsoft 发布 Kinect for Xbox 360,售价 149 美元。
Kinect 集成红外 + RGB 相机 + 多阵列麦克风,用 PrimeSense Light Coding 技术实时生成 640×480 深度图(30fps)。
首 60 天销量 800 万台,吉尼斯世界纪录最快销售消费电子。
Kinect 把“深度感知 + 实时人体姿态识别”带入消费市场,为后续 ROS、机器人感知、HoloLens、Apple Vision Pro 铺路。
events.source_name: Microsoft Kinect launch (2010-11-04); PrimeSense acquisition by Apple (2013)
events.card_summary_zh: Kinect 让深度感知和人体动作识别进入客厅，也为机器人与计算机视觉研究提供了廉价传感器。
events.summary_en: On November 4, 2010, Microsoft launched the Kinect for Xbox 360 for $149, integrating infrared and RGB cameras with a multi-array microphone to generate 640×480 depth maps at 30fps using PrimeSense Light Coding technology. The device sold 8 million units in its first 60 days, earning the Guinness World Record for the fastest-selling consumer electronics device. By bringing depth sensing and real-time human pose recognition to the consumer market, Kinect paved the way for ROS, robotic perception, HoloLens, and Apple Vision Pro.
events.card_summary_en: Microsoft Kinect put depth sensing and body tracking in living rooms, handing robotics and vision researchers a cheap depth camera in the process.
events.why_it_matters_en: Kinect was the start of depth-sensing consumerization. The depth cameras now required by AR/VR, robot perception, and human-computer interaction passed their first mass consumer validation in the 2010 Kinect. Following the line from Kinect through PrimeSense to Apple Face ID and Microsoft HoloLens shows why depth sensing became standard equipment on smart devices in the 2020s.
events.behind_scenes_en: Kinect's technology came from Israel's PrimeSense, founded in 2005 by Aviad Maizels and Zohar Shpunt. Shpunt developed the Light Coding structured-light technique, using infrared speckle patterns plus a dedicated depth-computing chip to generate depth maps in real time at roughly thirty dollars of cost, far below professional depth cameras at two thousand dollars. After Microsoft released a Windows SDK in 2011, academia used Kinect en masse for 3D scanning, robot navigation, and gesture recognition. Apple acquired PrimeSense for $345 million in 2013, and its technology became the foundation of Face ID's TrueDepth camera.

events.title_zh: IBM Watson 击败 Jeopardy! 冠军:问答 AI 高峰
events.title_en: IBM Watson Beats Jeopardy! Champions: QA AI Peak
events.summary_zh:
2011 年 2 月 14-16 日,IBM Watson 在 Jeopardy! 三集特别节目中以 77,147 美元击败卫冕冠军 Ken Jennings(24,000)和 Brad Rutter(21,600)。
Watson 由 David Ferrucci 2006-2011 年领导开发,用 DeepQA 架构:问题分析 + 候选生成 + 证据检索 + 置信度排序,在 200M 页结构化文档上做并行检索,3 秒内给出答案。
Watson 硬件是 90 台 IBM Power 750 服务器,2880 个 Power7 核心,16TB 内存。
events.source_name: IBM Watson Jeopardy! (2011-02-14-16); Ferrucci, D. (2012) AI Magazine 33(1)
events.card_summary_zh: Watson 在开放领域问答节目中击败两位冠军，展示了搜索、语言处理与工程集成的系统力量。
events.summary_en: From February 14–16, 2011, IBM Watson defeated defending champions Ken Jennings ($24,000) and Brad Rutter ($21,600) with $77,147 on a three-episode *Jeopardy!* special. Developed under the leadership of David Ferrucci from 2006 to 2011, Watson utilized a DeepQA architecture—combining question analysis, candidate generation, evidence retrieval, and confidence ranking—to perform parallel retrieval across 200M pages of structured documents and deliver answers within 3 seconds. The system ran on 90 IBM Power 750 servers, boasting 2880 Power7 cores and 16TB of RAM.
events.card_summary_en: IBM Watson beat the two greatest Jeopardy! champions on live television, showcasing the peak of search, language processing, and brute engineering integration.
events.why_it_matters_en: Watson was the final engineering summit of the symbolic-AI-plus-integration route. Its Jeopardy! victory, like Deep Blue beating Kasparov in 1997, proved narrow-scenario AI could defeat human experts. But Watson's commercial failures equally proved that route could not scale, clearing the ground for the statistical-learning-plus-massive-pretraining line of AlexNet in 2012, BERT in 2018, and GPT-3 in 2020.
events.behind_scenes_en: Watson consumed IBM's largest PR investment in its century of history, with roughly one billion dollars of development spending from 2006 to 2011. Ferrucci's team chose an ensemble-plus-engineering approach, running more than 100 algorithms on each question in parallel and voting for the most confident answer. Watson performed astonishingly on Jeopardy!, but Ferrucci left IBM in 2012 and subsequent commercialization in medicine, finance, and law moved slowly. IBM shut down multiple Watson for Oncology clients in 2018, and Watson Health was sold to Francisco Partners for one billion dollars in 2022. Watson's question-answering approach was thoroughly upended by BERT in 2018 and GPT-3 in 2020.

events.title_zh: Apple Siri 在 iPhone 4S 发布:消费级语音助手诞生
events.title_en: Apple Siri Launched on iPhone 4S: Consumer Voice Assistant Born
events.summary_zh:
2011 年 10 月 4 日,Apple 在 iPhone 4S 发布会推出 Siri 语音助手,10 月 14 日 iPhone 4S 上市,Siri 正式面向消费者。
Siri 1.0 用 Nuance 语音识别 + 自研自然语言理解 + 25 类内置服务(短信、电话、日历、地图、Wolfram Alpha),用户用自然语言对话,Siri 返回结果或调用 App。
Siri 开启了 Alexa(2014)、Google Assistant(2016)、Cortana(2014)、Bixby(2017)的语音助手时代。
events.source_name: Apple Siri on iPhone 4S launch (2011-10-04); Siri Inc. acquisition (2010-04-28)
events.card_summary_zh: Siri 被装进数百万部手机，语音交互第一次从研究演示变成普通人每天都能使用的产品。
events.summary_en: On October 4, 2011, Apple unveiled the Siri voice assistant at its iPhone 4S launch event, officially bringing it to consumers when the device went on sale on October 14. Siri 1.0 combined Nuance speech recognition, proprietary natural language understanding, and 25 categories of built-in services (including SMS, phone, calendar, maps, and Wolfram Alpha), allowing users to converse naturally while Siri returned results or invoked apps. Ultimately, Siri ushered in the voice assistant era of Alexa (2014), Google Assistant (2016), Cortana (2014), and Bixby (2017).
events.card_summary_en: Siri shipped inside millions of iPhone 4S handsets, turning voice interaction from a research demo into a product ordinary people used every day.
events.why_it_matters_en: Siri was the start of the consumer voice assistant. It proved an AI voice assistant could enter the consumer market as a daily tool, paving the way for Amazon Alexa and Echo in 2014, Google Assistant and Home in 2016, and conversational AI hardware like AI Pin and Rabbit R1 in 2024. Tracing Siri to Alexa to Google Assistant to ChatGPT Voice shows why voice interaction carries more commercial upside than text in the LLM era.
events.behind_scenes_en: Siri 1.0's technology came from Apple's 2010 acquisition of Siri Inc. plus its purchase of Polar Rose, a facial recognition company, that same year. Steve Jobs died on October 5, 2011, one day after the iPhone 4S announcement, making Siri the last major AI product of his era at Apple. Siri 1.0 on the iPhone 4S took three to five seconds to respond, relying on Apple's cloud data centers plus third-party cloud services. Progress was slow from 2011 to 2018: Google Assistant overtook Siri in 2016, and Amazon Alexa became the smart speaker market leader starting 2014. In 2024 Apple Intelligence rebuilt Siri around LLMs.

events.title_zh: AlexNet 引爆现代深度学习
events.title_en: AlexNet Ignites Modern Deep Learning
events.summary_zh:
2012 年，AlexNet 在 ImageNet 图像识别竞赛中大幅领先，把深度学习重新推到世界面前。
这次胜利真正震撼的地方，是三件事第一次强力合流。
ImageNet 给了大规模带标签数据，神经网络给了算法路线，GPU 给了能把深层网络跑起来的算力。
很多人从这时才真正意识到，deep and large 有了清晰证据。
只要数据、算法和算力一起到位，AI 能力会突然跃迁。
events.source_name: 英伟达的编年史和城墙整理材料
events.card_summary_zh: ImageNet 给了大规模带标签数据，神经网络给了算法路线，GPU 给了能把深层网络跑起来的算力；AlexNet 是理解现代 AI 的关键节点。
events.summary_en: In 2012, AlexNet dominated the ImageNet image recognition competition, thrusting deep learning back into the global spotlight. The true shock of this victory was the powerful, first-time convergence of three forces: ImageNet's large-scale labeled data, the algorithmic path of neural networks, and the GPU compute required to run deep networks. For many, this was the first clear evidence that "deep and large" worked, proving that when data, algorithms, and compute align, AI capabilities make a sudden leap.
events.card_summary_en: AlexNet fused ImageNet's labeled data, neural network algorithms, and GPU horsepower into one result that marks the key node for understanding modern AI.
events.why_it_matters_en: AlexNet is the key node for understanding modern AI. It connected ImageNet, Ilya, Hinton, GPUs, CUDA, and deep learning into a single line, and it showed NVIDIA the long-term opportunity in AI compute.

events.title_zh: GPU 训练深网成共识
events.title_en: GPU Training Goes Mainstream
events.summary_zh:
2012 年后，AlexNet 等结果让 GPU 成为深度网络训练的核心基础设施。
深层网络要做大量矩阵计算，CPU 像少数工人慢慢算，GPU 像一排工位同时开工。
研究者发现，模型能不能变大、训练能不能跑完，越来越依赖显卡、内存、互联和软件栈。
从这时开始，算力从背景条件走到台前，成为 AI 竞赛里的核心资源。
events.source_name: NeurIPS AlexNet paper
events.card_summary_zh: 2012 年后，AlexNet 等结果让 GPU 成为深度网络训练的核心基础设施；GPU 训练让深度学习从漂亮想法变成可扩展工程。
events.summary_en: After 2012, breakthroughs like AlexNet established the GPU as the core infrastructure for deep network training. To handle the massive matrix calculations required, a CPU behaves like a few workers slowly plugging away, whereas a GPU functions like a row of workstations firing up simultaneously. As researchers realized that scaling models and completing training depended heavily on graphics cards, memory, interconnects, and software stacks, compute stepped out of the background to become the defining resource in the AI race.
events.card_summary_en: After AlexNet, GPU training became the consensus infrastructure for deep networks, turning deep learning from a pretty idea into scalable engineering.
events.why_it_matters_en: GPU training turned deep learning from a beautiful idea into scalable engineering. The ceiling of modern model capability is largely set by compute infrastructure.

events.title_zh: 协作机器人Baxter发布——机器与人并肩工作
events.title_en: Collaborative Robot Baxter Released
events.summary_zh:
2012年，罗德尼·布鲁克斯的Rethink Robotics公司发布了巴克斯特（Baxter）双臂协作机器人。
它被设计成与人类工人安全协作的伙伴——不是取代。
人类可以简单地抓住它的手臂教它动作——它记住后自动重复。
这代表了一种与「取代人类」完全不同的机器人路线。
布鲁克斯是MIT AI Lab的前主任，也是著名机器人学家。
他公开反对把机器人做成取代人类工人的自动化机器——他认为机器人的正确方向是和人类一起工作，做人类不想做的枯燥重复劳动，把创造性留给人类。
Baxter就是这条理念的产物——它有安全传感器，碰到人会立刻停下来。
events.card_summary_zh: 罗德尼·布鲁克斯的Rethink Robotics公司发布了巴克斯特（Baxter）双臂协作机器人。
events.summary_en: In 2012, Rethink Robotics, founded by renowned roboticist and former MIT AI Lab director Rodney Brooks, released Baxter, a dual-armed collaborative robot designed to work safely alongside human workers rather than replace them. Embodying Brooks’ philosophy that robots should handle dull, repetitive tasks while leaving creativity to humans, Baxter could be programmed simply by guiding its arms to make it memorize and repeat movements, stopping instantly upon contact thanks to built-in safety sensors. This cooperative design represented a robotics paradigm entirely different from the traditional industry drive to replace human labor with automation.
events.card_summary_en: Rodney Brooks' Rethink Robotics shipped Baxter, a two-armed cobot built to work beside people instead of replacing them.
events.why_it_matters_en: Baxter represented the IA route, intelligence amplification, applied to robots: not building a machine stronger than you to replace you, but building one that takes your direction and helps you. It failed commercially, with Rethink Robotics closing in 2018, but the collaborative robot idea was carried forward by later companies and lives on today.
events.behind_scenes_en: Brooks is the former director of the MIT AI Lab and a celebrated roboticist. He openly opposed building robots as automation machines that replace human workers, arguing the right direction was machines working alongside people, doing the dull repetitive labor humans do not want while creativity stays human. Baxter embodied that philosophy: fitted with safety sensors, it stopped instantly whenever it touched a person.

events.title_zh: Google Brain 猫神经元:大规模无监督学习首次成功
events.title_en: Google Brain Cat Neuron: First Large-Scale Unsupervised Learning Success
events.summary_zh:
2012 年 6 月 26 日,Quoc Le、Marc'Aurelio Ranzato、Rajat Monga、Matthieu Devin、Kai Chen、Greg Corrado、Jeff Dean、Andrew Ng 在 ICML 2012 发表论文《Building High-level Features Using Large Scale Unsupervised Learning》。
团队用 1000 台服务器 + 16,000 个 CPU 核心训练 9 层稀疏自编码器,在 1000 万张 YouTube 视频帧上做无监督学习,网络自发形成“猫脸神经元”,人脸识别准确率 81.7%,猫脸识别准确率 74.8%。
2012 年 6 月 26 日 NYT 头版报道,Google Brain 项目正式公开。
events.source_name: Le, Q. et al. (2012) ICML 2012; NYT report (2012-06-26)
events.card_summary_zh: Google Brain 从海量视频中自行学出“猫”的概念，大规模无监督学习第一次以直观结果进入公众视野。
events.summary_en: On June 26, 2012, Quoc Le, Marc'Aurelio Ranzato, Rajat Monga, Matthieu Devin, Kai Chen, Greg Corrado, Jeff Dean, and Andrew Ng published the paper "Building High-level Features Using Large Scale Unsupervised Learning" at ICML 2012. That same day, a June 26, 2012 front-page NYT report officially made the Google Brain project public. Training a 9-layer sparse autoencoder on 1,000 servers and 16,000 CPU cores using unsupervised learning on 10 million YouTube video frames, the team watched the network spontaneously form a "cat face neuron" while achieving a human face recognition accuracy of 81.7% and a cat face recognition accuracy of 74.8%.
events.card_summary_en: Google Brain learned the concept of cat from millions of video frames without labels, giving large-scale unsupervised learning its first vivid public proof.
events.why_it_matters_en: The Google Brain cat neuron was early proof that large-scale unsupervised learning works. Self-supervised learning, emergence capabilities, and scaling laws as discussed in LLM circles today all have early versions in the 2012 experiment. Following the line from Google Brain 2012 through TensorFlow in 2014-2016, TPU in 2016, Transformer in 2017, and Gemini in 2024 shows why Google can stand up to Microsoft and OpenAI in the LLM era: its compute, frameworks, algorithms, and data accumulation from 2012 to 2020 were all already in place.
events.behind_scenes_en: Google Brain started in 2011 with Andrew Ng, Jeff Dean, and Greg Corrado, aiming to train deep networks on Google-scale compute. Ng persuaded Larry Page in 2011 to commit a thousand servers to the experiment; Page agreed but demanded Ng prove it could work. Le and colleagues trained on CPU clusters across 2011-2012 rather than GPUs because Google's internal GPU infrastructure was still immature in 2011. After the cat neuron experiment succeeded in 2012, Google Brain pivoted to GPU plus TPU, developed TensorFlow between 2014 and 2016, and released TPU v1 in 2016. Ng left Google Brain in 2014 to found Coursera and Deeplearning.ai; Jeff Dean took over Google Brain, which merged with DeepMind in 2023, with Dean becoming Chief Scientist of Google DeepMind in 2024.

events.title_zh: AlexNet 在 NIPS 2012 引爆:深度学习时代起点
events.title_en: AlexNet at NIPS 2012: Deep Learning Era Begins
events.summary_zh:
2012 年 12 月,Alex Krizhevsky、Ilya Sutskever、Geoffrey Hinton 在 NIPS 2012 论文集发表论文《ImageNet Classification with Deep Convolutional Neural Networks》(ILSVRC 2012 结果于 10 月公布,top-5 错误率 15.3% vs 第二名 26.2%)。
AlexNet 在 ImageNet ILSVRC 2012 把 top-5 错误率从 26.2%(传统 CV)降到 15.3%,领先第二名 10.8 个百分点。
AlexNet 用 8 层 CNN(5 卷积 + 3 全连接)、650K 神经元、60M 参数、630M 连接,在 2 块 NVIDIA GTX 580 GPU 上训练 5-6 天。
关键创新:ReLU 激活、Dropout 正则化、数据增强、GPU 并行训练。
events.source_name: Krizhevsky, A., Sutskever, I., Hinton, G. (2012) NIPS; ILSVRC 2012 results
missing_terms: ImageNet 大规模视觉识别挑战赛
events.card_summary_zh: 关键创新:ReLU 激活、Dropout 正则化、数据增强、GPU 并行训练；AlexNet 是深度学习时代的起点。
events.summary_en: In December 2012, Alex Krizhevsky, Ilya Sutskever, and Geoffrey Hinton published "ImageNet Classification with Deep Convolutional Neural Networks" in the NIPS 2012 proceedings, detailing how AlexNet dominated ILSVRC 2012 (results announced in October) by slashing the top-5 error rate from 26.2% (traditional CV) to 15.3%, leading the second-place entry by 10.8 percentage points. This 8-layer CNN—consisting of 5 convolutional and 3 fully connected layers, 650K neurons, 60M parameters, and 630M connections—was trained on 2 NVIDIA GTX 580 GPUs for 5-6 days. Its landmark success relied on key innovations: ReLU activation, Dropout regularization, data augmentation, and GPU parallel training.
events.card_summary_en: AlexNet detonated at NIPS 2012 on the strength of ReLU activations, Dropout regularization, data augmentation, and parallel GPU training, opening the deep learning era.
events.why_it_matters_en: AlexNet was the starting point of the deep learning era. Everything after 2012, VGG, GoogLeNet, ResNet, Transformer, BERT, GPT, Stable Diffusion, AlphaFold, builds on the paradigm AlexNet fixed: CNN or Transformer plus GPU plus big data plus ReLU and Dropout. Following the line from AlexNet in 2012 through GAN in 2014, ResNet in 2015, Transformer in 2017, BERT in 2018, GPT-3 in 2020, and ChatGPT in 2022 makes clear that deep learning did not erupt from nowhere; it was the engineering result of three conditions maturing together: Hinton's 2006 DBN, GPUs in 2009, and ImageNet in 2009.
events.behind_scenes_en: AlexNet was the engineering payoff of Hinton's Toronto team's 2006 DBN paper. Krizhevsky began training CNNs on GPUs in 2010, drawing on the Raina-Ng 2009 paper, and by 2012 the three ingredients lined up: a mature ImageNet dataset, GTX 580 GPU horsepower, and the ReLU and Dropout tricks. When the team submitted to ILSVRC 2012 they expected flak for CNN's rebellion against mainstream computer vision; instead the gap of top-5 error at 15.3% versus 26.2% for second place was so large that the entire vision community converted within six months. Sutskever joined Google Brain in 2014, co-founded OpenAI in 2015, and co-founded Safe Superintelligence Inc. in 2024. Krizhevsky joined Google in 2015 and left the AI field in 2017; AlexNet is his only blockbuster paper.

events.title_zh: 谷歌大规模收购AI与机器人公司——帝国的构建
events.title_en: Google's Massive AI and Robotics Acquisitions
events.summary_zh:
2013年，在安卓之父安迪·鲁宾的主导下，谷歌秘密收购了八家顶尖机器人公司——包括波士顿动力（大狗机器人）、日本Schaft、Industrial Perception等。
这是AI史上最大规模的集中机器人收购——谷歌试图在下一波AI和机器人浪潮中建立统治地位。（注：Google 收购 DeepMind 是 2014 年 1 月，见 #16，不属本条。）
events.card_summary_zh: 这是AI史上最大规模的集中机器人收购——谷歌试图在下一波AI和机器人浪潮中建立统治地位。
events.summary_en: In 2013, spearheaded by the "father of Android" Andy Rubin, Google secretly acquired eight leading robotics companies—including Boston Dynamics (maker of the BigDog robot), Japan's Schaft, and Industrial Perception. This marked the largest concentrated robotics acquisition in AI history, representing Google's bid to establish dominance in the next wave of AI and robotics. (Note: Google's acquisition of DeepMind occurred in January 2014, see #16, and is not covered in this entry.)
events.card_summary_en: Google ran the largest concentrated shopping spree for AI and robotics companies in history, trying to lock down dominance in the coming wave.
events.why_it_matters_en: The 2013 acquisition wave changed the global AI landscape. DeepMind gave Google a multi-year lead in deep learning. Boston Dynamics' purchase and later sale mirrored how hard industrial robotics found commercialization. The giants vacuumed up academic AI talent wholesale, turning AI from an academic field into an arms race between corporations.
events.behind_scenes_en: Andy Rubin's plan was to consolidate these companies into a mobile-robotics empire spanning factory logistics, home service, and military use.
