But Rubin left Google within a year and the plan stalled with him. Boston Dynamics was later sold to SoftBank and then to Hyundai. DeepMind instead became the jewel in Google's AI crown: AlphaGo and AlphaFold were both born there.

events.title_zh: Mikolov word2vec:词向量与分布式表示普及
events.title_en: Mikolov word2vec: Word Embeddings Popularized
events.summary_zh:
2013 年 1 月 16 日,Tomas Mikolov、Kai Chen、Greg Corrado、Jeff Dean 在 arXiv 发表论文《Efficient Estimation of Word Representations in Vector Space》,后发表于 ICLR 2013。
word2vec 用 100 维向量表示词,在 1000 亿词 Google News 语料上训练,CBOW 和 Skip-gram 两种模型 + Hierarchical Softmax + Negative Sampling 两种训练技巧,训练时间从 RNNLM 的几周降到几小时。
word2vec 的“king - man + woman = queen”类比实验,让“分布式表示 + 向量算术”成为 NLP 标准工具,为 2018 BERT、2020 GPT-3、2022 ChatGPT 的词嵌入层铺路。
events.source_name: Mikolov, T. et al. (2013) ICLR 2013; arXiv:1301.3781
events.card_summary_zh: word2vec 把词语映射成可计算的向量，“国王减男人加女人约等于女王”让语义关系第一次直观可见。
events.summary_en: On January 16, 2013, Tomas Mikolov, Kai Chen, Greg Corrado, and Jeff Dean published the paper "Efficient Estimation of Word Representations in Vector Space" on arXiv, which was later published at ICLR 2013. Representing words as 100-dimensional vectors trained on a 100-billion-word Google News corpus, word2vec combined two models (CBOW and Skip-gram) with two training techniques (Hierarchical Softmax and Negative Sampling) to slash training times from RNNLM's weeks to just hours. The model's famous "king - man + woman = queen" analogy experiment established "distributed representations + vector arithmetic" as standard NLP tools, paving the way for the word embedding layers of 2018 BERT, 2020 GPT-3, and 2022 ChatGPT.
events.card_summary_en: Tomas Mikolov's word2vec mapped words into computable vectors, and king minus man plus woman approximating queen made semantic relations visible for the first time.
events.why_it_matters_en: word2vec was the early engineering realization of distributed representation plus large-corpus pretraining. Word embeddings, contextual representations, and pretraining as discussed around LLMs today all have early versions in 2013's word2vec. Tracing word2vec to GloVe, ELMo, BERT, and GPT shows why pretraining representations on massive corpora became NLP's central paradigm, and why contextual representations after BERT in 2018 proved more powerful than word2vec's static vectors.
events.behind_scenes_en: Mikolov developed RNNLM while a doctoral student at Brno University starting in 2010, training language models with recurrent networks, and kept refining the work after joining Google in 2011. word2vec's core insight was that shallow models plus big data could beat deep models plus small data, diverging from Hinton's camp's mainstream deep-network route. Mikolov left Google for Facebook FAIR in 2014, returned to the Czech Technical University in Prague in 2017, and joined CIIRC in 2020. After word2vec came Pennington's GloVe from Stanford in 2014, Bojanowski's fastText at Facebook in 2014, ELMo in 2018, BERT in 2018, and GPT-2 in 2019, extending the vector route into contextual representations, yet word2vec remains NLP's teaching staple and engineering baseline.

events.title_zh: NVIDIA 全面转向深度学习:Huang 的 10 年战略
events.title_en: NVIDIA Pivots to Deep Learning: Huang's 10-Year Strategy
events.summary_zh:
2013 年 3 月 19 日,NVIDIA CEO Jensen Huang 在 GPU Technology Conference (GTC) 2013 首次公开把 NVIDIA 定位为“AI 计算公司”,而非“游戏显卡公司”。
2013-2016 年 Huang 主导 NVIDIA 三件事:(1) 把 CUDA 生态深度绑定深度学习框架;(2) 2014 年 cuDNN 1.0 + 2015 年 TensorRT 推出;(3) 2016 年 DGX-1 + 2016 年 Tegra Parker 面向自动驾驶。
2017 年 NVIDIA 数据中心营收 19 亿美元,2023 年 475 亿美元,2024 年 1150 亿美元,Huang 2013 年的“AI 计算公司”定位彻底兑现。
events.source_name: NVIDIA GTC 2013 keynote (2013-03-19); NVIDIA annual reports 2013-2024
events.card_summary_zh: NVIDIA 全面转向深度学习：Huang 的 10 年战略；Huang 2013 年的转型决策是 NVIDIA 在 LLM 时代垄断算力的源头。
events.summary_en: On March 19, 2013, at the GPU Technology Conference (GTC) 2013, NVIDIA CEO Jensen Huang first publicly positioned the firm as an "AI computing company" rather than a "gaming graphics card company." Between 2013 and 2016, Huang steered NVIDIA through three key initiatives: deeply binding the CUDA ecosystem with deep learning frameworks; launching cuDNN 1.0 in 2014 and TensorRT in 2015; and debuting the DGX-1 and Tegra Parker for autonomous driving in 2016. That pivot was fully realized as NVIDIA’s data center revenue surged from $1.9 billion in 2017 to $47.5 billion in 2023, and $115 billion in 2024, completely delivering on Huang’s 2013 vision.
events.card_summary_en: Jensen Huang committed NVIDIA fully to deep learning, the strategic pivot that became the source of its LLM-era compute monopoly.
events.why_it_matters_en: Huang's 2013 decision is the origin of NVIDIA's dominance over LLM-era compute. The compute chokepoints, NVIDIA monopoly, and CUDA ecosystem moat discussed across the industry today were all seeded in this strategic turn. Tracing the line from the 2013 pivot through cuDNN in 2016, V100 in 2017, A100 in 2020, H100 in 2022, and B200 in 2024 shows why compute competition in the LLM era is fundamentally NVIDIA versus Google TPU versus AMD MI300 versus domestic Chinese accelerators.
events.behind_scenes_en: Huang founded NVIDIA in 1993; CUDA in 2006 was his first ten-year strategy, and the AI pivot in 2013 was his second. Seeing AlexNet 2012 plus Google Brain 2012, he judged deep learning plus GPU to be a hundred-billion-dollar opportunity and moved NVIDIA's resources decisively from gaming graphics into AI compute. cuDNN 1.0 in 2014, TensorFlow in 2015, and PyTorch in 2016 locked the CUDA ecosystem into deep learning. NVIDIA invested in autonomous driving in 2016 through Project Highway 61 plus Tesla P100 deals, in data centers in 2017 with V100 and DGX-1, in inference in 2018 with T4 and Jetson AGX, and in LLMs from 2020 with A100 and H100. By 2024 NVIDIA reached a three-trillion-dollar market cap, with Huang's personal fortune at one hundred billion dollars.

events.title_zh: DeepMind DQN:深度强化学习首次成功
events.title_en: DeepMind DQN: First Deep Reinforcement Learning Success
events.summary_zh:
2013 年 12 月 19 日,DeepMind 团队(Volodymyr Mnih、Koray Kavukcuoglu、David Silver、Alex Graves、Ioannis Antonoglou、Daan Wierstra、Martin Riedmiller)在 NIPS 2013 Deep Learning Workshop 发表论文《Playing Atari with Deep Reinforcement Learning》。
DQN 用 CNN + Q-learning,从原始像素输入学习 49 种 Atari 游戏,其中 29 种超过人类专家水平。
DQN 关键创新:Experience Replay + Target Network,解决 Q-learning 在深度网络上的训练不稳定问题。
2015 年 2 月 Nature 518:529-533 完整版发表,DQN 在 49 种 Atari 游戏中 22 种超人类。
events.source_name: Mnih, V. et al. (2013) NIPS Deep Learning Workshop; (2015) Nature 518:529-533
events.card_summary_zh: DQN 只看屏幕像素就学会多款 Atari 游戏，深度学习与强化学习第一次形成可扩展的统一方法。
events.summary_en: On December 19, 2013, the DeepMind team (Volodymyr Mnih, Koray Kavukcuoglu, David Silver, Alex Graves, Ioannis Antonoglou, Daan Wierstra, Martin Riedmiller) published the paper "Playing Atari with Deep Reinforcement Learning" at the NIPS 2013 Deep Learning Workshop. By using CNN + Q-learning to master 49 Atari games directly from raw pixel inputs, DQN outperformed human experts in 29 of them, utilizing the key innovations of Experience Replay and Target Network to solve the training instability of Q-learning on deep networks. In February 2015, the full version was published in Nature 518:529-533, demonstrating DQN outperforming humans in 22 of the 49 Atari games.
events.card_summary_en: DeepMind's DQN learned dozens of Atari games from raw screen pixels alone, fusing deep learning and reinforcement learning into one scalable method for the first time.
events.why_it_matters_en: DQN was the starting point of combining deep learning with reinforcement learning. The RLHF, reward models, and policy optimization discussed across LLM circles all trace early versions to DQN in 2013, PPO in 2017, TRPO in 2018, and ILQL in 2020. Following DQN to AlphaGo, AlphaZero, MuZero, and RLHF shows why OpenAI invested deeply in DRL from 2015 to 2019, and why applying RLHF to GPT-3 in 2020 was the monetization of seven years of DRL engineering.
events.behind_scenes_en: DeepMind was founded in London in 2010 by Demis Hassabis, Shane Legg, and Mustafa Suleyman, and Google acquired it in January 2014 for $650 million. DQN was DeepMind's key proof before the acquisition: that deep learning plus reinforcement learning could solve general game-playing AI. David Silver's group pushed DRL relentlessly from 2013 to 2019, from DQN's Nature paper in 2015 through AlphaGo in 2016, AlphaGo Zero in 2017, AlphaZero in 2018, and MuZero in 2019, taking the DRL line to its first summit. From 2015 to 2020 after DQN, DeepMind, OpenAI, and academia extended DRL into robotics, autonomous driving, dialogue, recommendation, and vision, but after 2020 the LLM route plus RLHF displaced pure DRL as the mainstream.

events.title_zh: 对抗样本风险显现
events.title_en: Adversarial Examples Gain Attention
events.summary_zh:
2014 年前后，研究显示深度模型会被很小的扰动误导，暴露出脆弱性。
一张图片在人眼看来几乎没变，模型可能突然认错。
这个现象像给深度学习泼了一盆冷水：模型表现很强，也会在奇怪角落里显得非常脆。
能力上升以后，安全、鲁棒性和评测边界开始变成实打实的技术问题。
events.source_name: General AI history references
events.card_summary_zh: 这个现象像给深度学习泼了一盆冷水：模型表现很强，也会在奇怪角落里显得非常脆；对抗样本让 AI 安全从抽象担忧变成可测试问题。
events.summary_en: Around 2014, research revealed that deep models could be misled by tiny perturbations, exposing a vulnerability where an image virtually unchanged to the human eye could suddenly be misclassified. This phenomenon poured cold water on the deep learning hype, proving that even highly capable models could be incredibly fragile in unexpected corners. As AI capabilities grew, safety, robustness, and evaluation boundaries transitioned into pressing, real-world technical challenges.
events.card_summary_en: Adversarial examples poured cold water on deep learning: models that scored brilliantly also failed bizarrely, turning AI safety from an abstract worry into a testable problem.
events.why_it_matters_en: Adversarial examples turned AI safety from an abstract worry into a testable problem. They remind developers that high accuracy still requires checking whether a model stays reliable under stress and attack.

events.title_zh: 商汤科技成立——中国计算机视觉先驱
events.title_en: SenseTime Founded
events.summary_zh: 2014 年，汤晓鸥教授在香港创立商汤科技（SenseTime）。创始团队来自香港中文大学多媒体实验室。商汤以计算机视觉技术为突破口，在人脸识别、图像分析等领域迅速成长，2018 年成为全球估值最高的 AI 独角兽。
events.source_name: 公开资料
events.card_summary_zh: 商汤以计算机视觉技术为突破口，在人脸识别、图像分析等领域迅速成长，2018 年成为全球估值最高的 AI 独角兽；商汤是中国 AI 视觉创业浪潮的引领者。
events.summary_en: In 2014, Professor Tang Xiao'ou founded SenseTime in Hong Kong, with a founding team hailing from the Multimedia Laboratory at the Chinese University of Hong Kong. Using computer vision as its breakthrough, the company grew rapidly in facial recognition and image analysis, becoming the world's most valuable AI unicorn by 2018.
events.card_summary_en: SenseTime was founded on computer vision and grew fast across face recognition and image analysis, becoming the world's most valuable AI unicorn by 2018.
events.why_it_matters_en: SenseTime led China's AI vision startup wave. It was not just one company but the template for how China's academic computer vision strength flowed into industry.
events.behind_scenes_en: SenseTime's founding team came out of the Multimedia Laboratory at the Chinese University of Hong Kong led by Xiaoou Tang, a lab whose paper output at top computer vision conferences ranked first globally for years running.

events.title_zh: Google 6.5 亿美元收购 DeepMind:AI 军备竞赛开始
events.title_en: Google Acquires DeepMind for $650M: AI Arms Race Begins
events.summary_zh:
2014 年 1 月 26 日,Google 以约 6.5 亿美元收购英国 AI 公司 DeepMind,由 Demis Hassabis、Shane Legg、Mustafa Suleyman 2010 年在伦敦创办。
DeepMind 收购时只有 75 人,主要做 DRL(深度强化学习),没有商业化产品,但 Google 看重其“通用 AI”研究能力。
DeepMind 收购后保持独立运营,2014-2024 年取得多项突破:DQN(2015)、AlphaGo(2016)、AlphaZero(2018)、MuZero(2019)、AlphaFold(2020/2021)、Gemini(2023)、AlphaProof(2024)。
events.source_name: Google acquisition of DeepMind (2014-01-26); DeepMind 2010 founding
events.card_summary_zh: Google 6.5 亿美元收购 DeepMind：AI 军备竞赛开始；Google 收购 DeepMind 是 AI 大厂军备竞赛的起点。
events.summary_en: On January 26, 2014, Google acquired DeepMind, a British AI company founded in London in 2010 by Demis Hassabis, Shane Legg, and Mustafa Suleyman, for about $650 million. At the time of the acquisition, DeepMind had just 75 employees, no commercial products, and focused primarily on DRL (deep reinforcement learning), but Google valued its "general AI" research capabilities. Operating independently post-acquisition, DeepMind achieved a string of breakthroughs from 2014 to 2024: DQN (2015), AlphaGo (2016), AlphaZero (2018), MuZero (2019), AlphaFold (2020/2021), Gemini (2023), and AlphaProof (2024).
events.card_summary_en: Google paid $650 million for DeepMind, opening the big-tech arms race for AI talent and technology.
events.why_it_matters_en: The DeepMind acquisition started the AI arms race among tech giants. It opened the wave of Microsoft's $13 billion into OpenAI, Amazon's $8 billion into Anthropic, Google's $3 billion into Anthropic, and Meta's roughly $10 billion LLaMA compute investment. Following the line from DeepMind in 2014 through Microsoft's $1 billion OpenAI deal in 2019 to its $10 billion follow-on in 2023 shows both why LLM-era investments dwarf 2014's scale and why Big Tech monopolizing AI became a regulatory focus by 2024.
events.behind_scenes_en: Before the acquisition, Facebook had also tried to buy DeepMind and was refused by Hassabis. He chose Google for three reasons: Google promised DeepMind independent operations with no military applications; Google provided compute including TPUs plus data; and Google established the DeepMind Ethics Board, later renamed DeepMind Ethics & Society. After the acquisition Google invested roughly twenty billion dollars keeping DeepMind running between 2014 and 2023; DeepMind lost two billion dollars in 2023 yet kept its independence. In April 2023 Google merged Google Brain with DeepMind to form Google DeepMind, with Demis Hassabis as CEO and Jeff Dean as Chief Scientist.

events.title_zh: Goodfellow GAN:生成式 AI 的早期突破
events.title_en: Goodfellow GAN: Early Generative AI Breakthrough
events.summary_zh:
2014 年 6 月 10 日,Ian Goodfellow 等人在 NIPS 2014 发表论文《Generative Adversarial Nets》。
GAN 用 Generator + Discriminator 对抗训练,Generator 从噪声生成图像,Discriminator 判断图像真伪,两者博弈达到 Nash 均衡时 Generator 能生成逼真图像。
GAN 在 MNIST、TFD、CIFAR-10 上生成质量超过 VAE 和 Boltzmann Machine,为后续 2015 DCGAN、2017 CycleGAN、2018 StyleGAN、2019 BigGAN、2021 StyleGAN-ADA、2024 GAN+Diffusion 混合路线铺路。
events.source_name: Goodfellow, I. et al. (2014) NIPS 2014; arXiv:1406.2661
events.card_summary_zh: Goodfellow GAN：生成式 AI 的早期突破；GAN 是“生成式 AI”的早期突破。
events.summary_en: On June 10, 2014, Ian Goodfellow et al. published the paper "Generative Adversarial Nets" at NIPS 2014, introducing an adversarial framework where a Generator creates images from noise and a Discriminator judges their authenticity, pitting the two in a game to reach a Nash equilibrium where the Generator can produce realistic images. Having outperformed VAE and Boltzmann Machine in generation quality on MNIST, TFD, and CIFAR-10, GAN paved the way for subsequent developments: 2015 DCGAN, 2017 CycleGAN, 2018 StyleGAN, 2019 BigGAN, 2021 StyleGAN-ADA, and the 2024 GAN+Diffusion hybrid approach.
events.card_summary_en: Ian Goodfellow invented GANs overnight, pitting two networks against each other and scoring generative AI's early breakthrough.
events.why_it_matters_en: GAN was the early breakthrough of generative AI. The generative models, adversarial training, RLHF, and AI-content detection discussed around LLMs today all have early versions in the 2014 GAN. Following GAN through StyleGAN, Diffusion, DALL-E 2, Stable Diffusion, and Midjourney v6 explains why image generation shifted from GANs to diffusion after Stable Diffusion arrived in 2022, and why GAN's adversarial-training idea still shapes LLM alignment routes.
events.behind_scenes_en: The inspiration came from a Montreal bar in 2014, where Goodfellow and friends debated whether neural networks could generate images. He went home, wrote the first GAN implementation in a few hours, got it working on MNIST, and told his advisor Bengio the next day; Bengio told him to write it up immediately. The GAN paper accumulated more than fifty thousand citations between 2014 and 2020, yet training instability, mode collapse and convergence trouble, troubled academia for eight years until StyleGAN-ADA stabilized GAN training in 2020. GANs ruled image generation from 2017 to 2022 before diffusion models like Stable Diffusion took over. For the LLM world, GAN's legacy is the adversarial-training concept itself: the reward model in RLHF is essentially GAN's discriminator idea.

events.title_zh: GoogLeNet 夺冠 ImageNet:企业算力碾压学术界的信号
events.title_en: GoogLeNet Wins ImageNet: Corporate Compute Dominance
events.summary_zh: 谷歌 GoogLeNet 以 6.67% 错误率夺得 ImageNet 冠军，人类水平约 5.1%，差距只剩 1.5 个百分点。
events.card_summary_zh: 谷歌 GoogLeNet 以 6.67% 错误率夺得 ImageNet 冠军，人类水平约 5.1%；GoogLeNet 是「企业 GPU 军备碾压学术界」的第一个信号。
events.summary_en: Google’s GoogLeNet won the ImageNet championship with a 6.67% error rate. With the human level at about 5.1%, the gap has shrunk to just 1.5 percentage points.
events.card_summary_en: Google's GoogLeNet won ImageNet at 6.67% error against human-level 5.1%, the first clear signal of corporate GPU firepower crushing academic labs.
events.why_it_matters_en: GoogLeNet was the first signal of corporate GPU arsenals overpowering academia. Universities could no longer compete on compute.
events.behind_scenes_en: Google entering the contest for the first time marked big companies' full commitment to AI. University labs began to panic: Google burned eight hundred GPUs on a single experiment while Stanford had barely a dozen.

events.title_zh: Sutskever Seq2Seq:端到端机器翻译范式确立
events.title_en: Sutskever Seq2Seq: End-to-End Translation Paradigm Established
events.summary_zh:
2014 年 9 月 10 日,Ilya Sutskever、Oriol Vinyals、Quoc Le 在 NeurIPS 2014 发表论文《Sequence to Sequence Learning with Neural Networks》。
Seq2Seq 用 2 个 LSTM(Encoder + Decoder)做端到端机器翻译,在 WMT-14 英法翻译上 BLEU 34.8,超过传统统计机器翻译 33.3(SMT)。
Seq2Seq 关键创新:(1) 端到端训练;(2) Encoder 把输入序列编码为固定长度向量;(3) Decoder 从该向量生成输出序列;(4) 输入序列逆序 + 4 层 LSTM + beam search。
events.source_name: Sutskever, I., Vinyals, O., Le, Q. (2014) NeurIPS 2014; WMT-14 results
events.card_summary_zh: Seq2Seq 用编码器和解码器把完整句子直接映射到另一种语言，机器翻译开始摆脱手工流水线。
events.summary_en: On September 10, 2014, Ilya Sutskever, Oriol Vinyals, and Quoc Le published the paper "Sequence to Sequence Learning with Neural Networks" at NeurIPS 2014. By using two LSTMs (an Encoder and a Decoder) for end-to-end machine translation, Seq2Seq achieved a BLEU score of 34.8 on WMT-14 English-to-French translation, surpassing the 33.3 of traditional statistical machine translation (SMT). The model's key innovations included: (1) end-to-end training; (2) an Encoder encoding the input sequence into a fixed-length vector; (3) a Decoder generating the output sequence from that vector; and (4) reversing the input sequence, using a 4-layer LSTM, and employing beam search.
events.card_summary_en: Its encoder-decoder mapped whole sentences to another language, retiring handmade pipelines.
events.why_it_matters_en: Seq2Seq is the source of the end-to-end sequence modeling paradigm. Everything the LLM world discusses today as Encoder-Decoder, generative models, or translation-plus-summarization-plus-dialogue had an early version in the 2014 Seq2Seq. Tracing Seq2Seq, then Attention, then Transformer, then BERT/GPT shows why the 2017 Transformer was NLP's key turning point, and why both 2018 routes, BERT and GPT, were built on top of Seq2Seq plus Attention.
events.behind_scenes_en: Seq2Seq came out of Sutskever's work at Google Brain, where he and Hinton's team turned to NLP after AlexNet in 2012. It extended end-to-end learning from image classification to sequence generation, paving the way for Bahdanau et al.'s 2015 Attention, the 2017 Transformer by Vaswani et al., BERT in 2018, and GPT-3 in 2020. Sutskever left Google in 2015 to co-found OpenAI as Chief Scientist, left OpenAI in May 2024, and co-founded SSI, Safe Superintelligence Inc. After Seq2Seq, Google shipped GNMT in 2016, switching Google Translate from SMT to NMT with a major quality jump, the route's first mass-market commercial application.

events.title_zh: AI 风险公开信
events.title_en: Open Letter on AI Safety
events.summary_zh:
2015 年，科技界公开呼吁重视 AI 对社会和安全的潜在影响。
深度学习能力快速上升后，问题开始从“能不能做出来”扩展到“应该怎样使用”。
研究者、企业和公众都需要讨论风险、责任、治理和长期影响。
这封公开信像一次提醒：AI 的发展速度越快，安全和社会边界越需要提前进入议程。
events.source_name: Timeline of Artificial Intelligence
events.card_summary_zh: 这封公开信像一次提醒：AI 的发展速度越快，安全和社会边界越需要提前进入议程；让 AI 安全从边缘伦理议题进入更主流的公共讨论。
events.summary_en: In 2015, the tech community issued a public call to confront the potential impacts of AI on society and safety. As deep learning capabilities skyrocketed, the core question shifted from "can we build it" to "how should we use it," forcing researchers, corporations, and the public to grapple with risk, responsibility, governance, and long-term consequences. This open letter served as a stark reminder: the faster AI advances, the sooner safety and societal guardrails must be put on the agenda.
events.card_summary_en: As AI speeds up, the letter argued, safety and social boundaries must reach the agenda early.
events.why_it_matters_en: It moved AI safety from a marginal ethics topic into mainstream public discussion, and later work on alignment, governance, and safety policy all connects back to this line.

events.title_zh: Redmon YOLO:实时目标检测突破
events.title_en: Redmon YOLO: Real-Time Object Detection Breakthrough
events.summary_zh:
2015 年 6 月 8 日,Joseph Redmon、Santosh Divvala、Ross Girshick、Ali Farhadi 在 CVPR 2016 发表论文《You Only Look Once: Unified, Real-Time Object Detection》。
YOLO 把目标检测从“两阶段(区域提议 + 分类)”改为“单阶段(直接回归 bbox + class)”,在 PASCAL VOC 2007 上 mAP 63.4,推理速度 45 FPS(YOLO Fast 155 FPS),比 R-CNN(2 FPS)快 22 倍。
YOLO 后续版本:YOLOv2(2017)、YOLOv3(2018)、YOLOv4(2020,Alexey Bochkovskiy 接手)、YOLOv5(2020,Ultralytics)、YOLOv8(2023)、YOLOv9(2024)、YOLOv10(2024,清华大学)。
events.source_name: Redmon, J. et al. (2015) CVPR 2016; arXiv:1506.02640
events.card_summary_zh: Joseph Redmon、Santosh Divvala、Ross Girshick；YOLO 是“实时目标检测”的工程突破。
events.summary_en: On June 8, 2015, Joseph Redmon, Santosh Divvala, Ross Girshick, and Ali Farhadi published the paper "You Only Look Once: Unified, Real-Time Object Detection" at CVPR 2016. YOLO shifted object detection from a "two-stage (region proposal + classification)" process to a "single-stage (direct regression of bbox + class)" pipeline, achieving a 63.4 mAP on PASCAL VOC 2007 at an inference speed of 45 FPS (155 FPS for YOLO Fast)—making it 22 times faster than R-CNN (2 FPS). This breakthrough paved the way for subsequent versions: YOLOv2 (2017), YOLOv3 (2018), YOLOv4 (2020, taken over by Alexey Bochkovskiy), YOLOv5 (2020, Ultralytics), YOLOv8 (2023), YOLOv9 (2024), and YOLOv10 (2024, Tsinghua University).
events.card_summary_en: YOLO was an engineering breakthrough for real-time object detection.
events.why_it_matters_en: YOLO delivered real-time object detection as engineering fact. Most of the live detection behind today's autonomous driving, security, retail, and robot vision builds on it. Following YOLO through SSD, RetinaNet, and DETR shows why single-stage detection became mainstream after 2015, and why YOLO remained industry's deployment favorite even after DETR brought Transformers to detection in 2020, thanks to engineering stability and speed.
events.behind_scenes_en: Redmon was a PhD student at the University of Washington in 2015, supervised by Ali Farhadi. Inspired by Girshick's 2014 R-CNN but judging two-stage pipelines too slow, he switched to single-stage regression and achieved real-time detection on GPU. YOLO saw mass industrial deployment across autonomous driving, security, retail, and medical imaging, the most-used detection model from 2016 to 2024. In February 2020 Redmon announced he was stopping YOLO research in objection to military applications, and the community took over after YOLOv4. Ultralytics maintained YOLOv5, v8, and v11 from 2020 to 2024 as the ecosystem's mainstream implementation.

events.title_zh: AlphaGo 胜樊麾:围棋 AI 首次击败职业棋手
events.title_en: AlphaGo Beats Fan Hui: Go AI Beats Professional for the First Time
events.summary_zh:
2015 年 10 月 9 日,DeepMind AlphaGo 在伦敦闭门比赛中以 5:0 击败欧洲围棋冠军樊麾二段,这是围棋 AI 首次击败职业棋手。
AlphaGo 用 CNN + MCTS(蒙特卡洛树搜索)+ RL(强化学习),训练分两阶段:(1) 监督学习模仿人类专家走子,达到业余强手水平;(2) 自我对弈强化学习,超过人类专家水平。
2016 年 1 月 27 日 Nature 529:484-489 论文正式发表,2016 年 3 月 AlphaGo 在首尔 4:1 击败李世石九段。
events.source_name: Silver, D. et al. (2016) Nature 529:484-489; AlphaGo vs Fan Hui (2015-10)
events.card_summary_zh: AlphaGo 以五比零击败职业棋手樊麾，围棋这座长期被认为机器难以翻越的高墙第一次出现裂缝。
events.summary_en: On October 9, 2015, DeepMind’s AlphaGo defeated European Go champion Fan Hui 2-dan 5-0 in a closed-door London match, marking the first time a Go AI beat a professional player. AlphaGo utilized CNN + MCTS (Monte Carlo Tree Search) + RL (Reinforcement Learning) in a two-stage training process: first, mimicking human expert moves via supervised learning to reach a strong amateur level, and second, using self-play reinforcement learning to surpass human experts. Following the official publication of its paper in Nature 529:484-489 on January 27, 2016, AlphaGo went on to defeat Lee Sedol 9-dan 4-1 in Seoul in March 2016.
events.card_summary_en: AlphaGo beat professional Fan Hui five games to zero, cracking Go's long-unchallenged wall.
events.why_it_matters_en: AlphaGo was deep learning plus reinforcement learning at its engineering peak on complex decision tasks. It proved DRL could go beyond Atari and defeat Go, long treated as AI's holy grail. Reading AlphaGo through AlphaGo Zero, AlphaZero, and MuZero shows why DeepMind led the DRL route from 2016 to 2020, and why OpenAI's Dota 2 OpenAI Five in 2018-2019 and GPT-3's RLHF in 2020 were the steps extending DRL toward language models.
events.behind_scenes_en: AlphaGo was DeepMind's core project of 2014-2016, driven by David Silver, with Hassabis promising Google after the 2014 acquisition that Go AI would be solved within five years. Silver's team trained AlphaGo in 2014-2015 on Google's GPU clusters, the distributed version running 1202 CPUs plus 176 GPUs. Beating Fan Hui settled it internally, and the March 2016 Lee Sedol match became DeepMind's global PR campaign, with Google putting ten million dollars into livestreaming and press. After defeating Lee Sedol, DeepMind beat then-world-number-one Ke Jie nine-dan three-nil at Wuzten in May 2017, released AlphaGo Zero, self-play with no human data, in October 2017, extended AlphaZero to chess and shogi in December 2018, and shipped MuZero, learning without rules, in November 2019.

events.title_zh: He ResNet:超深网络训练突破
events.title_en: He ResNet: Ultra-Deep Network Training Breakthrough
events.summary_zh:
2015 年 12 月 10 日,Kaiming He、Xiangyu Zhang、Shaoqing Ren、Jian Sun 在 CVPR 2016 发表论文《Deep Residual Learning for Image Recognition》。
ResNet 用“残差连接(Skip Connection)”让 152 层 CNN 可训练,在 ImageNet 上 top-5 错误率 3.57%,首次超过人类(5.1%)。
ResNet 关键创新:(1) 残差块 y = F(x) + x,让梯度直接流过 Skip Connection;(2) 152 层 vs VGG 19 层,参数更少但精度更高;(3) BatchNorm + He 初始化让训练稳定。
ResNet 至今仍是视觉 + NLP + 语音 + RL 的标准组件。
events.card_summary_zh: 残差连接让上百层神经网络稳定训练，深度不再只是负担，而成为视觉模型继续扩展的通道。
events.summary_en: On December 10, 2015, Kaiming He, Xiangyu Zhang, Shaoqing Ren, and Jian Sun published the paper "Deep Residual Learning for Image Recognition" at CVPR 2016. ResNet used "Skip Connections" to make a 152-layer CNN trainable, achieving a 3.57% top-5 error rate on ImageNet and surpassing human performance (5.1%) for the first time. Its key innovations—the $y = F(x) + x$ residual block that lets gradients flow directly through skip connections, a 152-layer architecture vs. VGG's 19 layers that had fewer parameters but higher accuracy, and BatchNorm plus He initialization for stable training—ensure ResNet remains a standard component in vision, NLP, speech, and RL to this day.
events.card_summary_en: Residual connections let networks past a hundred layers train stably, depth becoming an ally.
events.why_it_matters_en: ResNet broke the training barrier for ultra-deep networks. Today's talk of multilayer Transformers, residual connections, and depth versus width all had early versions in the 2015 ResNet. Tracing ResNet through Transformer, BERT, GPT-3, and GPT-4 shows why Transformers stack to 96 layers as in GPT-3's 175B, why residual connections anchor LLM training stability, and why ultra-deep networks became AI mainstream after 2015.
events.behind_scenes_en: He worked at MSRA, Microsoft Research Asia, in 2015, where his team with Zhang, Ren, and Sun attempted ultra-deep CNNs and failed on vanishing and exploding gradients. The insight: if a shallow network can learn f(x), a deeper one can at least learn identity, so let the network learn the residual F(x) = f(x) - x rather than f(x) directly. Skip connections pass gradients straight back, solving training beyond a hundred layers. He spent 2016-2023 across MSRA and Facebook FAIR, joining MIT EECS in 2024. The residual connection was inherited by the 2017 Transformer as the key to stacking layers, and ResNet remains among AI history's most-cited papers at over 200,000 citations.

events.title_zh: OpenAI 成立:非营利 AI 研究实验室启动
events.title_en: OpenAI Founded: Nonprofit AI Research Lab Launched
events.summary_zh:
2015 年 12 月 11 日,OpenAI 在旧金山成立,由 Sam Altman、Elon Musk、Greg Brockman、Ilya Sutskever、Wojciech Zaremba、John Schulman 联合创办。
初始承诺 10 亿美元资金,实际到位约 1.3 亿美元。
OpenAI 宣称目标“构建安全有益的通用人工智能(AGI),为全人类而非单一公司服务”,以非营利形式运营。
2019 年 OpenAI 转型为“有限利润(capped-profit)”公司 OpenAI LP,Microsoft 2019-2023 年累计投资 130 亿美元,OpenAI 从非营利实验室变成 Microsoft 旗下 AI 子公司。
events.source_name: OpenAI founding announcement (2015-12-11); OpenAI LP structure (2019-03)
events.card_summary_zh: OpenAI 以“让通用人工智能造福全人类”为目标成立，后来成为大模型时代最具影响力的实验室之一。
events.summary_en: On December 11, 2015, OpenAI was founded in San Francisco by Sam Altman, Elon Musk, Greg Brockman, Ilya Sutskever, Wojciech Zaremba, and John Schulman as a non-profit dedicated to "building safe and beneficial artificial general intelligence (AGI)" for all humanity rather than a single company. While the organization launched with $1 billion in pledged funding, only about $130 million was actually received. In 2019, OpenAI transitioned into a "capped-profit" company, OpenAI LP, and following a cumulative $13 billion investment from Microsoft between 2019 and 2023, the former non-profit lab effectively became a Microsoft AI subsidiary.
events.card_summary_en: OpenAI began aiming to give AGI to all humanity and became the LLM era's defining lab.
events.why_it_matters_en: OpenAI is the LLM era's central player: ChatGPT, GPT-4, DALL-E, Whisper, and Sora all come from it. Tracing the 2015 founding through the 2019 OpenAI LP shift, GPT-3 in 2020, ChatGPT in 2022, GPT-4 in 2023, and o1 in 2024 shows how a nonprofit research lab turned into effectively a Microsoft-owned AI subsidiary, and why 2023-2024 brought continuous turmoil, from the Altman firing affair to Musk's lawsuit.
events.behind_scenes_en: The direct trigger was Google acquiring DeepMind in 2014. Musk said publicly through 2014 that he feared Google monopolizing AI through DeepMind, and in 2015 talked with Altman and Brockman about building a nonprofit AI lab to counter Google. He sat on OpenAI's board from 2015 to 2018, leaving over disagreements with Altman about whether to commercialize. From 2015 to 2019 OpenAI dug into DRL and game AI including Dota 2's OpenAI Five in 2018; the 2019 GPT-2 paper opened the LLM route; GPT-3 plus exclusive Microsoft licensing in 2020 accelerated commercialization; and ChatGPT in 2022 made it AI's best-known company. After departing, Musk founded xAI with the Grok LLM and sued OpenAI in 2024 for violating its nonprofit promises.

events.title_zh: AlphaGo 4:1 胜李世石:围棋 AI 越过职业九段
events.title_en: AlphaGo 4:1 Beats Lee Sedol: Go AI Crosses Pro 9-Dan
events.summary_zh:
2016 年 3 月 9-15 日,DeepMind AlphaGo 在首尔四季酒店 5 局比赛中以 4:1 击败韩国职业九段李世石(Lee Sedol),李世石在第 4 局(3 月 13 日)唯一胜局被称为“神之一手”(Move 78)。
AlphaGo 用 MCTS + 深度策略网络 + 深度价值网络,176 个 GPU + 1202 个 CPU,每步搜索 0.2 秒。
Nature 2016 年 1 月 28 日论文《Mastering the game of Go with deep neural networks and tree search》预演结果,3 月正式对弈震惊全球。
events.source_name: Silver, D. et al. (2016) Nature 529:484-489; AlphaGo vs Lee Sedol match record
events.card_summary_zh: AlphaGo 战胜李世石把 AI 推到全球公众面前，其中第 37 手也让人第一次感到机器可能产生陌生的创造力。
events.summary_en: From March 9 to 15, 2016, DeepMind’s AlphaGo defeated Korean professional 9-dan Lee Sedol 4:1 in a five-game match at the Four Seasons Hotel in Seoul, with Lee’s sole victory in Game 4 (March 13) dubbed the "divine move" (Move 78). AlphaGo utilized MCTS, deep policy networks, and deep value networks running on 176 GPUs and 1202 CPUs, searching for 0.2 seconds per move. While the results were previewed in the January 28, 2016 *Nature* paper *Mastering the game of Go with deep neural networks and tree search*, the official March showdown shocked the world.
events.card_summary_en: Defeating Lee Sedol put AI before the world, and move 37 hinted at strange machine creativity.
events.why_it_matters_en: AlphaGo's 4:1 win over Lee Sedol was AI history's biggest publicity event. It made the claim that deep learning can solve intuitive problems legible to a global audience and directly ignited the post-2016 surge in AI investment. Reading Lee Sedol 2016, AlphaGo Zero 2017, AlphaZero 2017, MuZero 2019, and AlphaFold2 2020 together exposes DeepMind's route: Go was the training ground for RL plus search, and the real targets were science and industry.
events.behind_scenes_en: Hassabis and David Silver led the project from 2014, with Aja Huang as principal engineer. Hassabis had promised in 2014 to beat a professional within five years; it took eighteen months. AlphaGo had already beaten European champion Fan Hui 5:0 in October 2015, kept secret until the January 2016 Nature paper. Lee Sedol announced after the match he would never play against AI again and formally retired on November 27, 2019, saying AI is an unbeatable entity. The Korea Baduk Association awarded AlphaGo honorary nine-dan status in April 2016.

events.title_zh: Google TPU v1:AI 专用芯片公开
events.title_en: Google TPU v1: AI-Specific Chip Public
events.summary_zh:
2016 年 5 月 18 日,Google 在 Google I/O 2016 主题演讲公开 TPU(Tensor Processing Unit)。
TPU v1 是 Google 2013 年内部立项、2015 年数据中心部署的 ASIC,专为矩阵乘法优化,8-bit 整数 Systolic Array 架构,28nm 工艺,700MHz,92 TOPS,28W TDP。
TPU 在 AlphaGo 与李世石对弈(2016-03)中担任推理硬件,在 RankBrain 搜索排序中已运行 3 年。
2017 年 4 月 Norman Jouppi 等在 ISCA 2017 发表论文《In-Datacenter Performance Analysis of a Tensor Processing Unit》。
events.source_name: Jouppi et al. (2017) ISCA; Google I/O 2016 keynote
events.card_summary_zh: Google TPU v1：AI 专用芯片公开；TPU v1 是大厂自研 AI 芯片的起点。
events.summary_en: At the Google I/O 2016 keynote on May 18, 2016, Google officially unveiled the Tensor Processing Unit (TPU), a custom ASIC initiated internally in 2013 and deployed in datacenters by 2015. Optimized for matrix multiplication, the TPU v1 leveraged an 8-bit integer Systolic Array architecture, a 28nm process, 700MHz clock speed, 92 TOPS, and a 28W TDP, having already run for 3 years in RankBrain search ranking and served as the inference hardware during AlphaGo's match against Lee Sedol (2016-03). In April 2017, Norman Jouppi et al. published the landmark paper "In-Datacenter Performance Analysis of a Tensor Processing Unit" at ISCA 2017.
events.card_summary_en: Google's TPU v1 went public, the starting point of big-tech custom AI silicon.
events.why_it_matters_en: TPU v1 opened the era of hyperscaler in-house AI chips, directly pushing NVIDIA's Tensor Core V100 in 2017, Apple's A11 Neural Engine in 2017, Huawei's Ascend 910 in 2018, and Tesla's FSD chip in 2019. Following TPU through Volta Tensor Core and the A11 Neural Engine shows the hardware basis of AI training costs falling about fifty percent a year after 2016.
events.behind_scenes_en: Jeff Dean drove the project from 2013, targeting lower inference cost for RankBrain. The original plan used FPGAs, but FPGA clock rates were low and inference latency high, so Google's hardware team turned to ASIC in 2014 and deployed the first TPUs into datacenters in 2015. TPU v1 handled inference only; TPU v2 reached 180 TFLOPS FP16 for training in 2017, v3 hit 420 TFLOPS with liquid cooling in 2018, and the 2021 v4 Pod carried 4096 chips. TPUs let Google train BERT, PaLM, and Gemini internally without relying on NVIDIA GPUs.

events.title_zh: Google Magenta 与 AI 艺术开源
events.title_en: Google Magenta: AI Art Goes Open Source
events.summary_zh:
2016 年 6 月 1 日,Google Brain 团队 Doug Eck、Mike Liang 公开 Magenta 项目,目标是用深度学习生成音乐、绘画、文字。
Magenta 第一篇博文《Welcome to Magenta》发布在 Google Research Blog。
Magenta 后续开源工具包括 NSynth(2017 音色合成)、SketchRNN(2017 草图生成)、MusicVAE(2018 音乐序列)。
Magenta 是 Google 在生成式 AI 艺术方向的第一笔投资,直接催生 2021 年 Imagen、2022 年 MusicLM。
events.source_name: Google Magenta launch (2016-06-01); Magenta GitHub
events.card_summary_zh: Magenta 第一篇博文《Welcome to Magenta》发布在 Google Research Blog；Magenta 是生成式 AI 艺术的起点。
events.summary_en: On June 1, 2016, Doug Eck and Mike Liang of the Google Brain team introduced Project Magenta in a Google Research Blog post titled "Welcome to Magenta," aiming to use deep learning to generate music, drawings, and text. The project subsequently released open-source tools including NSynth (2017 timbre synthesis), SketchRNN (2017 sketch generation), and MusicVAE (2018 music sequences). As Google's first investment in generative AI art, Magenta directly spawned 2021's Imagen and 2022's MusicLM.
events.card_summary_en: Its first blog post Welcome to Magenta launched generative AI art as an open project.
events.why_it_matters_en: Magenta is the starting point of generative AI art, pushing AI creativity from academic circles into public view and laying six years of cultural groundwork for the 2022 eruptions of Stable Diffusion, Midjourney, and DALL-E 2. Reading Magenta through GAN art, NFT-plus-AI, and Stable Diffusion shows generative AI did not appear from nowhere in 2022.
events.behind_scenes_en: Magenta ran inside Google Brain as a parallel project, distinct from the TensorFlow and DeepMind lines. The team stayed small, twenty to thirty people from 2016 to 2020, yet produced large numbers of open models and datasets. Team member Anna Huang joined MIT in 2018 and drove MusicTransformer forward. Its cultural influence exceeded its commercial one: the 2018 Edmond de Belamy painting, generated by the Obvious collective with a GAN, sold at Christie's for 432,500 dollars, indirectly connected to the Magenta-plus-GAN lineage.

events.title_zh: DeepMind WaveNet:神经网络生成原始音频波形
events.title_en: DeepMind WaveNet: Neural Network Generates Raw Audio Waveform
events.summary_zh:
2016 年 9 月 8 日,DeepMind 在 arXiv:1609.03499 发表《WaveNet: A Generative Model for Raw Audio》。
WaveNet 用 Causal Dilated Convolution(因果膨胀卷积,膨胀系数 1,2,4,...,512),把音频波形作为时间序列自回归预测下一采样点。
WaveNet 在 TTS(文本转语音)上达到人类级 MOS 评分(4.21 vs 人类 4.55),在钢琴、语音生成上接近真实。
events.source_name: van den Oord, A. et al. (2016) arXiv:1609.03499
events.card_summary_zh: WaveNet 直接逐点生成声音波形，机器语音从拼接录音迈向更自然的神经生成时代。
events.summary_en: On September 8, 2016, DeepMind published "WaveNet: A Generative Model for Raw Audio" on arXiv:1609.03499. WaveNet utilized causal dilated convolutions (with dilation coefficients of 1, 2, 4, ..., 512) to treat audio waveforms as a time series, autoregressively predicting the next sample point. The model achieved a human-level MOS score of 4.21 in TTS (text-to-speech) versus 4.55 for humans, and came close to reality in piano and speech generation.
events.card_summary_en: WaveNet synthesized raw waveforms sample by sample, moving speech toward neural naturalness.
events.why_it_matters_en: WaveNet founded the autoregressive-generation paradigm in audio. Setting WaveNet in 2016 for audio beside PixelCNN in 2016 for images, GPT in 2018 for text, DALL-E in 2021 for text-to-image, and Sora in 2024 for video shows generative AI's cross-modal evolution between 2016 and 2024: one autoregressive-plus-probability-distribution paradigm spanning audio, images, text, and video.
events.behind_scenes_en: First author was Aaron van den Oord of the DeepMind team. The paper appeared in September 2016, and by 2017 Google Translate's TTS and Google Assistant voices ran on WaveNet. Inference was slow, about one minute of CPU per second of audio, until Parallel WaveNet's student-teacher distillation accelerated it a thousandfold in October 2017. Diffusion routes such as AudioLDM and VALL-E displaced the WaveNet line by 2022-2023, though its causal dilated convolution idea shaped WaveGAN and Jukebox.

events.title_zh: Google GNMT:神经机器翻译全面替代 SMT
events.title_en: Google GNMT: Neural Machine Translation Replaces SMT
events.summary_zh:
2016 年 9 月 27 日,Google 发表论文《Google's Neural Machine Translation System: Bridging the Gap between Human and Machine Translation》(arXiv:1609.08144)。
GNMT 用 8 层 LSTM Encoder-Decoder + Attention,128 个 GPU 训练 6 天,在 Google 翻译中把中英翻译错误率降低 58%,接近人类水平。
GNMT 上线后 Google 翻译一夜之间提升一个版本号,2016 年 11 月 Google 翻译完全切换到 GNMT。
events.card_summary_zh: Google GNMT：神经机器翻译全面替代 SMT，并成为这一阶段值得追踪的关键变化。
events.summary_en: On September 27, 2016, Google published the paper "Google's Neural Machine Translation System: Bridging the Gap between Human and Machine Translation" (arXiv:1609.08144). Driven by an 8-layer LSTM Encoder-Decoder + Attention and trained on 128 GPUs for 6 days, GNMT reduced Chinese-to-English translation error rates in Google Translate by 58%, approaching human-level performance. Following its launch, Google Translate upgraded by a version number overnight, and by November 2016, Google Translate had completely switched to GNMT.
events.card_summary_en: GNMT replaced phrase-based SMT wholesale in production with neural machine translation.
events.why_it_matters_en: GNMT was the first large-scale production validation of the Seq2Seq plus Attention paradigm and directly produced the 2017 Transformer. Tracing Sutskever's 2014 Seq2Seq, Bahdanau's 2014 Attention, Google's 2016 GNMT, the 2017 Transformer, BERT in 2018, and GPT-3 in 2020 shows the Transformer was no sudden invention but the product of three years of engineering iteration from 2014 to 2017.
events.behind_scenes_en: Google Brain's Mike Schuster, Yonghui Wu, and Thorsten Brants initiated GNMT in early 2016, engineering Seq2Seq plus Attention up to Google production scale handling over a hundred language pairs and more than a billion user requests a day. At launch Google worried internally about inference costs, but TPUs pressed inference down to a third of SMT's cost. Transformers fully replaced GNMT after 2017, with Vaswani's paper in June 2017 and Google Translate switching over that November.

events.title_zh: PyTorch 开源:动态图框架进入主流
events.title_en: PyTorch Open-Sourced: Dynamic Graph Framework Goes Mainstream
events.summary_zh:
2017 年 1 月 18 日,Facebook AI Research(FAIR)发布 PyTorch 0.1,Adam Paszke、Sam Gross、Soumith Chintala 主导开发。
PyTorch 基于 Torch7,核心创新是动态计算图(Define-by-Run),比 TensorFlow 1.x 静态图更易调试,Python 原生语法接近 NumPy。
2017 年 8 月 PyTorch 0.2 分布式训练,2018 年 4 月 0.4 合并 Variable 与 Tensor,2018 年 12 月 1.0 稳定版。
2019 年 PyTorch 在顶级会议论文使用率超过 TensorFlow,2020 年 HuggingFace 全面转向 PyTorch。
events.source_name: Paszke, A. et al. (2017) PyTorch 0.1 release; NeurIPS 2019 autodiff workshop
events.card_summary_zh: PyTorch 让研究者像写普通 Python 一样构建和调试神经网络，迅速成为 AI 研究最重要的工具之一。
events.summary_en: On January 18, 2017, Facebook AI Research (FAIR) released PyTorch 0.1, a Torch7-based framework led by Adam Paszke, Sam Gross, and Soumith Chintala that featured a dynamic computation graph (Define-by-Run) and a NumPy-like Python-native syntax, making it far easier to debug than TensorFlow 1.x's static graphs. PyTorch 0.2 introduced distributed training in August 2017, version 0.4 merged Variable and Tensor in April 2018, and the stable 1.0 version arrived in December 2018. By 2019, PyTorch’s usage rate in top conference papers surpassed TensorFlow’s, and HuggingFace fully pivoted to PyTorch in 2020.
events.card_summary_en: PyTorch let researchers build and debug neural nets like plain Python, winning research fast.
events.why_it_matters_en: PyTorch decided the tool stack of AI research after 2017. Following open-sourcing in 2017 through HuggingFace Transformers in 2018, PyTorch Lightning in 2019, and PyTorch 2.0 in 2022 explains why nearly all open models of the 2020s LLM era, LLaMA, Mistral, Qwen, DeepSeek, default to PyTorch.
events.behind_scenes_en: FAIR director Yann LeCun championed the project in 2016 to replace Lua Torch, developed by Ronan Collobert in 2011. Paszke's team began the rewrite in August 2016, demoed internally that December, and publicly released in January 2017. Academia adopted it fast: PyTorch appeared in thirty percent of NeurIPS 2018 papers, fifty percent in 2019, and over seventy percent by 2020. Google's 2019 TensorFlow 2.0 copied PyTorch's dynamic graphs through the Keras API, but academia had already turned irreversibly toward PyTorch.

events.title_zh: Asilomar AI 原则:23 条 AI 伦理基准
events.title_en: Asilomar AI Principles: 23 AI Ethics Baselines
events.summary_zh:
2017 年 1 月 23 日,Future of Life Institute 在加州 Asilomar 会议中心召集 23 位 AI 专家(Stuart Russell、Demis Hassabis、Yann LeCun、Fei-Fei Li 等),发布《Asilomar AI Principles》23 条原则,涵盖研究问题(5 条)、伦理价值(13 条)、长期问题(5 条)。
原则包括:AI 目标应与人类价值对齐、AI 设计应可审计、AI 应避免军备竞赛等。
截至 2017 年底,1275 名 AI 研究者签署原则。
events.source_name: Future of Life Institute (2017) Asilomar AI Principles
events.card_summary_zh: Asilomar AI 原则：23 条 AI 伦理基准；Asilomar AI 原则是 AI 治理史第一份跨大厂共识文件。
events.summary_en: On January 23, 2017, the Future of Life Institute convened 23 AI experts (including Stuart Russell, Demis Hassabis, Yann LeCun, and Fei-Fei Li) at California's Asilomar Conference Center to release the 23 "Asilomar AI Principles," covering research issues (5), ethical values (13), and longer-term issues (5). These guidelines dictate that AI goals should align with human values, AI designs must be auditable, and an AI arms race should be avoided. By the end of 2017, 1,275 AI researchers had signed onto the principles.
events.card_summary_en: Twenty-three Asilomar principles formed AI governance's first cross-industry consensus document.
events.why_it_matters_en: They are AI governance history's first consensus document spanning major labs, laying the ethical groundwork for 2020s regulation: the EU AI Act of 2024, China's 2023 generative AI service management measures, and US executive order 14110 of 2023. Reading Asilomar 2017 through the OECD AI Principles of 2019, NIST AI RMF of 2023, and the EU AI Act of 2024 shows 2020s AI regulation was no sudden appearance.
events.behind_scenes_en: The name echoes the 1975 Asilomar Conference on Recombinant DNA, organizers Max Tegmark and Jaan Tallinn deliberately borrowing the 1975 bioethics template. The Asilomar AI Principles influenced GDPR in 2018, the OECD AI Principles in 2019, and the first EU AI Act draft in 2021. Yet although OpenAI and DeepMind both signed in 2017, OpenAI's 2020 turn to the limited-commercial OpenAI LP ignited disputes over principles colliding with commerce.

events.title_zh: TensorFlow 1.0:Google ML 框架成工业主流
events.title_en: TensorFlow 1.0: Google ML Framework Becomes Industry Mainstream
events.summary_zh:
2017 年 2 月 15 日,Google 在 TensorFlow Dev Summit 2017 发布 TensorFlow 1.0。
TF 1.0 提供 Python/C++/Java API、分布式训练、TensorBoard 可视化、TF Serving 部署、移动端 TF Lite。
TF 1.0 在工业部署占主导(2017-2020),Pinterest、Airbnb、Snapchat、Uber、Twitter 都用 TF 生产。
但 TF 1.x 静态图 + Session.run 模型在学术界被 PyTorch 蚕食,2019 年 Google 推出 TF 2.0 + Keras 整合转向动态图。
events.source_name: Abadi, M. et al. (2016) TensorFlow 1.0; TF Dev Summit 2017
events.card_summary_zh: Google 在 TensorFlow Dev Summit 2017 发布 TensorFlow 1.0。
events.summary_en: On February 15, 2017, Google launched TensorFlow 1.0 at the TensorFlow Dev Summit 2017, providing Python/C++/Java APIs, distributed training, TensorBoard visualization, TF Serving deployment, and mobile TF Lite. While TF 1.0 dominated industrial deployment from 2017 to 2020—powering production at Pinterest, Airbnb, Snapchat, Uber, and Twitter—its static graph and Session.run model were steadily eroded in academia by PyTorch, prompting Google to transition to dynamic graphs in 2019 by integrating Keras into TF 2.0.
events.card_summary_en: Google shipped TensorFlow 1.0 at the 2017 Dev Summit, taking ML frameworks industrial.
events.why_it_matters_en: TensorFlow 1.0 started the big-company open-source ML framework era and drove industrial ML adoption through 2016-2019. Reading TF 1.0 in 2017, PyTorch 1.0 in 2018, TF 2.0 in 2019, and JAX in 2020 maps the framework evolution: static graphs, then dynamic graphs, then functional programming with automatic parallelism.
events.behind_scenes_en: Google Brain's Jeff Dean and Rajat Monga led TensorFlow, open-sourcing TF 0.5 on November 9, 2015. Its in-house predecessor DistBelief from 2011 never left Google, and TF was essentially DistBelief open-sourced. TF 1.0 became the industrial mainstream in 2017, but PyTorch rose swiftly in academia across 2018-2019, and Google's 2019 TF 2.0, integrating Keras and moving to eager execution, had already lost the researchers. By 2023 Google began replacing TF with JAX internally.

events.title_zh: AlphaGo 3:0 战胜柯洁:围棋 AI 退役战
events.title_en: AlphaGo 3:0 Beats Ke Jie: Go AI Retirement Match
events.summary_zh:
2017 年 5 月 23-27 日,DeepMind AlphaGo Master 在中国乌镇未来围棋峰会上 3:0 击败中国职业九段柯洁。
AlphaGo Master 用 1 个 TPU v2 单机运行,远少于 2016 年李世石版的 176 GPU。
比赛中 AlphaGo 评分约 4800 ELO,柯洁约 3600 ELO。
赛后 DeepMind 宣布 AlphaGo 退役,不再参加围棋比赛,转而研发 AlphaGo Zero 与 AlphaZero。
events.source_name: DeepMind (2017) Future of Go Summit Wuzhen; AlphaGo Master matches
events.card_summary_zh: AlphaGo 三比零战胜世界第一柯洁后宣布退役，围棋 AI 的胜负悬念就此结束，研究重心转向更通用的问题。
events.summary_en: Between May 23 and 27, 2017, DeepMind's AlphaGo Master defeated Chinese professional 9-dan Ke Jie 3-0 at the Future of Go Summit in Wuzhen, China. Running on a single machine with just 1 TPU v2—a massive reduction from the 176 GPUs used in the 2016 Lee Sedol version—AlphaGo boasted an ELO rating of approximately 4800 during the match, compared to Ke Jie's 3600. Following the victory, DeepMind announced AlphaGo's retirement from Go competition, shifting its focus to developing AlphaGo Zero and AlphaZero.
events.card_summary_en: Three-nil over Ke Jie closed Go's contest, and AlphaGo retired with questions answered.
events.why_it_matters_en: The 3:0 win over Ke Jie was Go AI's closing battle, marking that Go had been fully surpassed by machines. It pushed DeepMind toward scientific applications: AlphaFold in 2018, AlphaFold2 in 2020, AlphaProof in 2024. Reading Lee Sedol 2016, the first professional victory, Master versus Ke Jie 2017, the perfect finish, and AlphaGo Zero 2017, no human knowledge, reveals DeepMind's line: Go was the proving ground, and science problems the commercial goal.
events.behind_scenes_en: China Life sponsored the Wuzhen matches, broadcast live by CCTV. Ke Jie wept afterward, calling AlphaGo like the god of Go. DeepMind also arranged a team match of AlphaGo against five Chinese professionals and a pair match pairing AlphaGo with two players holding colors between them, AlphaGo winning both. On May 27 Hassabis announced AlphaGo's retirement, with DeepMind turning to AlphaZero for general board games in December 2017 and AlphaFold for proteins in 2018.

events.title_zh: Transformer 论文:Attention Is All You Need
events.title_en: Transformer Paper: Attention Is All You Need
events.summary_zh:
2017 年 6 月 12 日,Ashish Vaswani 等 8 位 Google Brain/Google Research 研究员在 NeurIPS 2017 发表《Attention Is All You Need》(arXiv:1706.03762)。
Transformer 抛弃 RNN/CNN,只用 Self-Attention(Q/K/V 点积注意力) + Positional Encoding + Feed-Forward 层 + 残差连接 + LayerNorm。
原论文在 WMT 2014 英德/英法翻译上达到 SOTA,训练成本是当时最好的 RNN 模型的 1/10。
events.source_name: Vaswani, A. et al. (2017) NeurIPS; arXiv:1706.03762
events.card_summary_zh: Transformer 用注意力机制取代循环结构，让模型更容易并行扩展，并成为后来大语言模型的共同底座。
events.summary_en: On June 12, 2017, Ashish Vaswani and 8 other Google Brain/Google Research researchers published "Attention Is All You Need" (arXiv:1706.03762) at NeurIPS 2017. The Transformer ditched RNN/CNN, relying only on Self-Attention (Q/K/V dot-product attention), Positional Encoding, Feed-Forward layers, residual connections, and LayerNorm. The original paper achieved SOTA on WMT 2014 English-German/English-French translation, at just 1/10 the training cost of the best RNN models at the time.
events.card_summary_en: Attention replaced recurrence, letting models scale in parallel and grounding all future LLMs.
events.why_it_matters_en: The Transformer is the base architecture of every LLM after 2017. Reading Transformer 2017, GPT 2018 decoder-only, BERT 2018 encoder-only, GPT-3 2020 scaling, ChatGPT 2022 RLHF, GPT-4 2023 multimodal, and Gemini/Claude/Llama 2024-2025 shows that AI history after 2017 is largely the history of scaling the Transformer.
events.behind_scenes_en: Eight authors signed the paper: Ashish Vaswani, Noam Shazeer, Niki Parmar, Jakob Uszkoreit, Llion Jones, Aidan N. Gomez, Łukasz Kaiser, Illia Polosukhin, declared equal contributors with randomized name order. The core idea grew from Shazeer and Kaiser's discussions that attention could replace the RNN. First submitted to ICML 2017 and rejected, it was accepted at NeurIPS 2017. Within a year of publication BERT and GPT built on it, followed by T5 in 2019 and ViT in 2020. From 2021 onward the authors left Google one after another to found Adept, Character.AI, Essential AI, Sakana AI, and other companies.

events.title_zh: fast.ai 成立:深度学习教育平民化
events.title_en: fast.ai Founded: Democratizing Deep Learning Education
events.summary_zh:
2017 年 8 月 3 日,Jeremy Howard、Rachel Thomas 创办 fast.ai(非营利,旧金山大学 USF Data Institute)。
fast.ai 推出「Practical Deep Learning for Coders」免费 MOOC,7 周 8 节课用 PyTorch + fastai 库教零基础程序员做图像分类、NLP、推荐、表格学习。
fast.ai 2018-2020 年学员超 50 万,2020 年学员 ULMFiT、AWD-LSTM 影响 HuggingFace、Stability AI。
events.source_name: Howard, J. & Thomas, R. (2017) fast.ai launch; Practical Deep Learning MOOC
events.card_summary_zh: fast.ai 成立：深度学习教育平民化，并成为这一阶段值得追踪的关键变化。
events.summary_en: On August 3, 2017, Jeremy Howard and Rachel Thomas founded fast.ai (a non-profit at the USF Data Institute) and launched "Practical Deep Learning for Coders," a free, 7-week, 8-lesson MOOC using PyTorch and the fastai library to teach zero-background programmers image classification, NLP, recommendation, and tabular learning. Between 2018 and 2020, fast.ai amassed over 500,000 students, and by 2020, its students, ULMFiT, and AWD-LSTM had influenced HuggingFace and Stability AI.
events.card_summary_en: fast.ai opened deep learning education to everyone outside the PhD circle.
events.why_it_matters_en: fast.ai is where the democratization of deep learning education began, directly fueling the 2018-2022 explosion of deep learning teaching. Reading fast.ai 2017 through the HuggingFace Course 2021, DeepLearning.AI 2022, and Karpathy's Neural Networks: Zero to Hero 2022 traces the shift from PhD-only knowledge to something every engineer keeps at hand.
events.behind_scenes_en: Jeremy Howard was Kaggle's former president and chief scientist; Rachel Thomas holds a mathematics doctorate from USF. The site launched in August 2017, the fastai library reached v0.7 in January 2018 and v2 on PyTorch 1.x in August 2020. Students included Sebastian Raschka, Sylvain Gugger of HuggingFace, and Gordon Boldini. Its top-down teaching method, get the code running first and explain theory after, shaped every deep-learning course that followed after 2018.

events.title_zh: 阿里巴巴达摩院成立——中国 AI 基础研究重镇
events.title_en: Alibaba DAMO Academy Founded
events.summary_zh: 2017 年 10 月，阿里巴巴宣布成立达摩院（DAMO Academy），计划三年投入超 1000 亿人民币。达摩院在全球设立实验室，覆盖机器视觉、NLP、自动驾驶、量子计算等方向。这是中国互联网公司最大规模的 AI 基础研究投资。
events.source_name: 公开资料
events.card_summary_zh: 阿里巴巴宣布成立达摩院（DAMO Academy），计划三年投入超 1000 亿人民币；达摩院的成立标志着中国科技公司从应用创新走向基础研究的转折。
events.summary_en: In October 2017, Alibaba announced the establishment of the DAMO Academy, planning to invest over 100 billion RMB over three years. Setting up laboratories globally to cover fields like machine vision, NLP, autonomous driving, and quantum computing, this marked the largest investment in basic AI research by a Chinese internet company.
events.card_summary_en: Alibaba announced DAMO Academy, three years and 100 billion yuan, a pivot to fundamental research.
events.why_it_matters_en: Its founding marks the turn of Chinese tech companies from applied innovation toward basic research. Its operating model of corporate funding, academic freedom, and global layout offered a new paradigm for Chinese AI research.
events.behind_scenes_en: The name comes from the Damo Yuan, the scripture-keeping hall of the Shaolin Temple. The first cohort of scholars brought in included world-class computer vision experts and IEEE Fellows, and DAMO's output later directly produced the Tongyi Qianwen Qwen large-model family.

events.title_zh: AlphaGo Zero:从零自学击败旧版 AlphaGo
events.title_en: AlphaGo Zero: Self-Play Beats Old AlphaGo from Scratch
events.summary_zh:
2017 年 10 月 18 日,DeepMind 在 Nature 550:354-359 发表《Mastering the game of Go without human knowledge》。
AlphaGo Zero 完全不用人类棋谱,只用自我对弈 + RL,从随机落子开始 3 天击败 2016 年胜李世石的 AlphaGo Lee,21 天击败 2017 年 60 连胜 Master 版本,40 天训练达到超越所有人类围棋 AI 的水平。
AlphaGo Zero 用单一残差网络同时输出策略和价值,简化了原 AlphaGo 双网络结构。
events.source_name: Silver, D. et al. (2017) Nature 550:354-359; AlphaZero arXiv:1712.01815
events.card_summary_zh: AlphaGo Zero 不再学习人类棋谱，只靠自我对弈超越旧版系统，机器第一次展示出摆脱人类经验上限的路径。
events.summary_en: On October 18, 2017, DeepMind published "Mastering the game of Go without human knowledge" in Nature 550:354-359. Training solely on self-play and reinforcement learning without human game records, AlphaGo Zero started from random moves to defeat the 2016 Lee Sedol-beating AlphaGo Lee in 3 days, conquer the 60-win 2017 Master version in 21 days, and surpass all human and Go AI levels in 40 days. It simplified the original AlphaGo's dual-network structure by using a single residual network to simultaneously output policy and value.
events.card_summary_en: Trained on no human games, Zero beat its ancestor by self-play, escaping the human ceiling.
events.why_it_matters_en: AlphaGo Zero started the self-play-plus-RL paradigm. It proved AI needs no human data to reach superhuman level on complex tasks, directly producing MuZero without rules in 2019 and AlphaProof in 2024. Reading AlphaGo Lee 2016 supervised, AlphaGo Zero 2017 pure RL, AlphaZero 2017 general board games, and MuZero 2019 rule-free shows DeepMind's conviction: stripping away human knowledge is the necessary road toward general intelligence.
events.behind_scenes_en: David Silver was first author of the AlphaGo Zero paper, stressing in Nature that AI can learn from itself without human data. Training used only four TPUv2s, far less than AlphaGo Lee's 176 GPUs plus 1202 CPUs. On December 5 the same year DeepMind published AlphaZero, arXiv 1712.01815, extending the same algorithm to chess and shogi, defeating Stockfish in four hours and Elmo in two.

events.title_zh: NVIDIA V100 Tensor Core:LLM 训练硬件主力
events.title_en: NVIDIA V100 Tensor Core: LLM Training Hardware Workhorse
events.summary_zh:
2018 年 3 月 27 日,NVIDIA 在 GTC 2018 推出 DGX-1 with V100。
V100 是 Volta 架构 GPU,16nm FFET 工艺,815mm² die,21.1B 晶体管,16GB/32GB HBM2,900 GB/s 显存带宽,640 个 Tensor Core(FP16 100 TFLOPS / FP32 15.7 TFLOPS)。
V100 引入 Tensor Core,用混合精度训练(Mixed Precision Training)把 LLM 训练成本降低 2-3 倍。
DGX-1 V100 8 卡版约 149,000 美元,2018-2020 年是 OpenAI、DeepMind、FAIR 训练主力。
events.source_name: NVIDIA Volta whitepaper (2017); NVIDIA DGX-1 V100 (2018)
events.card_summary_zh: NVIDIA 在 GTC 2018 推出 DGX-1 with V100；V100 Tensor Core 是 LLM 训练硬件的起点。
events.summary_en: On March 27, 2018, NVIDIA introduced the DGX-1 with V100 at GTC 2018, featuring a Volta-architecture GPU with a 16nm FFET process, an 815mm² die, 21.1B transistors, 16GB/32GB HBM2, 900 GB/s memory bandwidth, and 640 Tensor Cores (FP16 100 TFLOPS / FP32 15.7 TFLOPS). The V100 introduced Tensor Cores, leveraging Mixed Precision Training to reduce LLM training costs by 2-3 times. Priced at approximately $149,000 for the 8-card version, the DGX-1 V100 served as the primary training workhorse for OpenAI, DeepMind, and FAIR from 2018 to 2020.
events.card_summary_en: NVIDIA's V100 Tensor Cores opened the hardware era of LLM training.
events.why_it_matters_en: V100 Tensor Core was the starting point of LLM training hardware. Reading V100 in 2017-2018 through A100 in 2020, H100 in 2022, and B100/200 in 2024 shows the hardware basis of LLM training costs falling about fifty percent a year. The Tensor Core route directly shaped the hardware investment rhythm of OpenAI, Anthropic, and Google's TPU program alike.
events.behind_scenes_en: V100 actually debuted at GTC on May 10, 2017, reaching volume shipments as the training mainstay in 2018. NVIDIA engineer Jack Choquette's team designed the Volta-architecture Tensor Core, inspired by Google's TPU v1 of May 2016. The Tensor Core uses 4x4 matrix multiply-add units, completing an FP16 multiply plus FP32 add in a single clock cycle. Every LLM from 2018 to 2020 trained on V100s: GPT-2 at 1.5B, BERT-Large at 340M, T5 at 11B, and part of GPT-3's 175B. A100 on Ampere succeeded it in 2020 and H100 on Hopper in 2022.

events.title_zh: GLUE 基准:NLP 任务评测标准化
events.title_en: GLUE Benchmark: NLP Evaluation Standardization
events.summary_zh:
2018 年 4 月 22 日,纽约大学 Alex Wang、Samuel Bowman 等在 arXiv:1804.07461 发表《GLUE: A Multi-Task Benchmark and Analysis Platform for Testing Natural Language Understanding Systems》。
GLUE 包含 9 个 NLU 任务:CoLA、SST-2、MRPC、STS-B、QQP、MNLI、QNLI、RTE、WNLI,涵盖情感、相似度、蕴含、问答。
GLUE 排行榜 2018-2019 年 BERT、RoBERTa、T5、ALBERT 接力刷新,2020 年 1 月 SuperGLUE 诞生,2021 年 GLUE 饱和(模型超过人类)。
events.source_name: Wang, A. et al. (2018) arXiv:1804.07461; GLUE benchmark
events.card_summary_zh: GLUE 排行榜 2018-2019 年 BERT、RoBERTa、T5。
events.summary_en: On April 22, 2018, New York University’s Alex Wang, Samuel Bowman, and others published "GLUE: A Multi-Task Benchmark and Analysis Platform for Testing Natural Language Understanding Systems" on arXiv:1804.07461. The benchmark comprises 9 NLU tasks—CoLA, SST-2, MRPC, STS-B, QQP, MNLI, QNLI, RTE, and WNLI—covering sentiment, similarity, entailment, and question answering. After the GLUE leaderboard was successively shattered by BERT, RoBERTa, T5, and ALBERT between 2018 and 2019, SuperGLUE was born in January 2020, and GLUE reached saturation in 2021 as models surpassed human performance.
events.card_summary_en: GLUE standardized NLP evaluation, and its leaderboard carried BERT, RoBERTa, and T5 in 2018-2019.
events.why_it_matters_en: GLUE started the standardization of NLP evaluation and directly spurred pretrained models like BERT, RoBERTa, and T5. Reading GLUE 2018 through SuperGLUE 2019, MMLU 2021, BIG-bench 2022, and HELM 2022 traces NLP evaluation's evolution from a single benchmark to benchmark suites to multi-task meta-benchmarks.
events.behind_scenes_en: NYU's Sam Bowman team launched GLUE in 2017 to give NLU tasks an ImageNet-style unified benchmark; first author Alex Wang presented it at an ICLR Workshop in 2018. BERT first approached human level on the leaderboard in October 2018, RoBERTa comprehensively exceeded humans in July 2019, and SuperGLUE launched in January 2020. GLUE's saturation triggered NLP's evaluation crisis, and BIG-bench with 208 tasks took over the GLUE route in 2022.

events.title_zh: OpenAI GPT-1:预训练 + 微调范式确立
events.title_en: OpenAI GPT-1: Pre-training + Fine-tuning Paradigm Established
events.summary_zh:
2018 年 6 月 11 日,OpenAI 在论文《Improving Language Understanding by Generative Pre-Training》发布 GPT-1。
GPT-1 用 12 层 Transformer Decoder(768 维隐藏层,12 头,117M 参数),在 BookCorpus(7000+ 本未出版小说)上无监督预训练,然后在 12 个 NLP 任务上微调。
GPT-1 在 9/12 任务上达到 SOTA,证明“无监督预训练 + 有监督微调”范式可行。
events.source_name: Radford, A. et al. (2018) OpenAI blog; GPT-1 paper
events.card_summary_zh: GPT-1 证明同一个预训练语言模型可以适配多种任务，后来大模型“先通学、再专用”的路线由此起步。
events.summary_en: On June 11, 2018, OpenAI introduced GPT-1 in the paper "Improving Language Understanding by Generative Pre-Training." The model, featuring a 12-layer Transformer decoder (with a 768-dimensional hidden layer, 12 heads, and 117M parameters), underwent unsupervised pre-training on BookCorpus (7000+ unpublished novels) before being fine-tuned on 12 NLP tasks. By achieving SOTA on 9/12 tasks, GPT-1 proved the viability of the "unsupervised pre-training + supervised fine-tuning" paradigm.
events.card_summary_en: One pretrained LM adapting to many tasks: GPT-1 started the pretrain-then-finetune road.
events.why_it_matters_en: GPT-1 opened the GPT line and laid the foundation of OpenAI's next six years of technology. Reading GPT-1 117M in 2018 through GPT-2 1.5B in 2019, GPT-3 175B in 2020, InstructGPT with RLHF in 2022, ChatGPT, and GPT-4 in 2023 shows OpenAI's bet: Decoder-only plus Scaling Laws as the core wager of the LLM era.
events.behind_scenes_en: Alec Radford was first author, and the paper skipped conferences entirely, published straight on OpenAI's website. Its inspirations were predecessors like Howard and Ruder's 2018 ULMFiT, the 2017 Transformer, and ELMo from February 2018; note that GPT-1 landed in June 2018, before BERT in October 2018, so it cannot have taken inspiration from BERT. Radford's team chose the Decoder-only route, standing opposite Google's Encoder-only BERT. GPT-1's 117M parameters were far smaller than BERT-Large's 340M, but GPT-2 scaled to 1.5B in February 2019 and GPT-3 to 175B in May 2020, validating the Decoder-only-plus-scaling route.

events.title_zh: 李飞飞国会作证:以人为本 AI 的政策时刻
events.title_en: Fei-Fei Li Testifies to Congress: Human-Centered AI
events.summary_zh: 李飞飞赴美国国会就「以人为本 AI」作证，母亲病危中坚持出席，提出 AI 发展的动机永远应该是以人为本。
events.card_summary_zh: 李飞飞赴美国国会就「以人为本 AI」作证，母亲病危中坚持出席，提出 AI 发展的动机永远应该是以人为本。
events.summary_en: Insisting on testifying before the U.S. Congress on "human-centered AI" even while her mother was critically ill, Fei-Fei Li argued that the motivation behind AI development must always be human-centered.
events.card_summary_en: Fei-Fei Li testified for human-centered AI while her mother lay critically ill at home.
events.why_it_matters_en: The hearing stands as a key moment in AI policy history: a woman scientist standing before Congress, in the middle of personal crisis, defending the humanistic value of AI.
events.behind_scenes_en: The night before testifying she was still keeping vigil at her mother's hospital bedside. Her mother said that barely twenty years after coming to America she could see her own daughter testify before Congress, words that became Fei-Fei Li's reason for attending.

events.title_zh: 华为昇腾 910 发布——国产 AI 训练芯片里程碑
events.title_en: Huawei Ascend 910 AI Chip Released
events.summary_zh: 2018 年 10 月，华为在 HUAWEI CONNECT 大会上首次发布昇腾（Ascend）系列 AI 芯片——昇腾 910 训练芯片和昇腾 310 推理芯片。昇腾基于自研达芬奇（Da Vinci）架构，这是中国在 AI 训练芯片领域从零到一的突破。
events.source_name: 公开资料
events.card_summary_zh: 华为昇腾 910 发布——国产 AI 训练芯片里程碑；昇腾的发布发生在中美科技竞争加剧的背景下。
events.summary_en: In October 2018, Huawei unveiled its Ascend series of AI chips at the HUAWEI CONNECT conference, debuting the Ascend 910 training chip and the Ascend 310 inference chip. Built on the self-developed Da Vinci architecture, the launch marked China's zero-to-one breakthrough in the AI training chip field.
events.card_summary_en: Huawei's Ascend 910 marked a milestone for domestic AI training chips amid rising tech rivalry.
events.why_it_matters_en: The Ascend launch came as US-China tech competition intensified. Once the A100 and H100 were cut off, Ascend became one of the few training chips available for domestic large models. Without Ascend, China's goal of self-sufficient AI training compute would sit much further away.
events.behind_scenes_en: Before Ascend, Huawei had already accumulated NPU experience through its Kirin phone SoCs, first integrating an AI processing unit in the 2017 Kirin 970. Ascend extended Huawei's on-chip AI capability from the device edge to cloud-scale training. Meituan's Longmao 2.0 in 2026 runs fifty thousand domestic compute cards with Ascend as the mainstay.

events.title_zh: HuggingFace 创立:NLP 开源社区中心
events.title_en: HuggingFace Founded: NLP Open Source Community Hub
events.summary_zh:
2018 年 10 月 10 日,HuggingFace(2016 年由 Clément Delangue、Julien Chaumond、Thomas Wolf 在纽约创立,最初做面向青少年的聊天机器人 App)发布 pytorch-pretrained-bert 库(后改名 transformers),把 BERT/GPT 等预训练模型整合为统一接口。
2019-04 与 OpenAI GPT-2、Google BERT 整合。
2020 年 Model Hub 上线,2021 年 5 月 4000 万美元 A 轮,2023 年 2.35 亿美元 D 轮估值 45 亿美元,Google、Amazon、NVIDIA、Salesforce、IBM 全部参投。
events.source_name: HuggingFace founding (2018-10); transformers library (2018-11)
events.card_summary_zh: HuggingFace 创立：NLP 开源社区中心；HuggingFace 是开源 LLM 时代的中心基础设施。
events.summary_en: On October 10, 2018, Hugging Face—founded in New York in 2016 by Clément Delangue, Julien Chaumond, and Thomas Wolf as a teenage chatbot app—released the pytorch-pretrained-bert library (later renamed transformers), unifying pre-trained models like BERT and GPT into a single interface. After integrating OpenAI GPT-2 and Google BERT in April 2019, the company launched its Model Hub in 2020. This set the stage for a $40 million Series A in May 2021 and a $235 million Series D in 2023 at a $4.5 billion valuation, with Google, Amazon, NVIDIA, Salesforce, and IBM all participating.
events.card_summary_en: HuggingFace became the central infrastructure of the open-source LLM era.
events.why_it_matters_en: Reading transformers 2018 through Model Hub 2020, Datasets 2021, Spaces 2022, and the LLaMA/Stable Diffusion/Mistral/Qwen/DeepSeek wave of 2023-2025 explains why the open LLM ecosystem lives on HuggingFace rather than GitHub.
events.behind_scenes_en: The three founders moved from France to New York in 2014 and first built chatbots aimed at teenagers; the 2018 pivot came when Thomas Wolf, using BERT for a chatbot, found the NLP tool chain scattered. In November 2018 Wolf consolidated BERT, GPT, GPT-2, Transformer-XL, and XLNet into the transformers library, adding dual PyTorch and TensorFlow backend support by April 2019. Once Model Hub launched in 2020, open models like LLaMA, Stable Diffusion, and Whisper defaulted to releasing on HuggingFace from 2021. By 2023 it hosted 500,000 models, 50,000 datasets, and 50,000 demos.

events.title_zh: Google BERT:双向预训练 NLP 范式确立
events.title_en: Google BERT: Bidirectional Pre-training NLP Paradigm Established
events.summary_zh:
2018 年 10 月 11 日,Google AI 在 arXiv:1810.04805 发表《BERT: Pre-training of Deep Bidirectional Transformers for Language Understanding》。
BERT 用 24 层 Transformer Encoder(340M 参数),在 BookCorpus + English Wikipedia(3.3B 词)上用 Masked Language Model(MLM) + Next Sentence Prediction(NSP)预训练。
BERT 在 11 个 NLP 任务上刷新 SOTA,包括 GLUE(7.7% 提升)、SQuAD v1.1(1.5% F1)、SQuAD v2.0(4.6% F1)。
events.source_name: Devlin, J. et al. (2018) arXiv:1810.04805; NAACL 2019
events.card_summary_zh: BERT 同时读取词语左右两侧的上下文，一举刷新多项语言任务，并迅速成为 NLP 的标准底座。
events.summary_en: On October 11, 2018, Google AI published "BERT: Pre-training of Deep Bidirectional Transformers for Language Understanding" on arXiv:1810.04805. The model, featuring a 24-layer Transformer Encoder with 340M parameters, was pre-trained on BookCorpus and English Wikipedia (3.3B words) using Masked Language Model (MLM) and Next Sentence Prediction (NSP). BERT went on to set new state-of-the-art benchmarks across 11 NLP tasks, including GLUE (7.7% improvement), SQuAD v1.1 (1.5% F1), and SQuAD v2.0 (4.6% F1).
events.card_summary_en: Bidirectional context lifted BERT past task after task, making it NLP's default foundation.
events.why_it_matters_en: BERT was the standard NLP paradigm of 2018-2020. Reading BERT 2018 through RoBERTa 2019, T5's encoder-decoder in 2019, GPT-3's decoder-only in 2020, and ChatGPT's decoder-only-plus-RLHF in 2022 maps the paradigm shift: BERT mainstream in 2018, GPT-3 overtaking by 2020, ChatGPT winning outright by 2022. BERT still carries heavy deployment in industrial NLU for search, recommendation, and customer service.
events.behind_scenes_en: First author Jacob Devlin led the Google AI Language team. His October 2018 paper stood opposite OpenAI's GPT-1 from June 2018: GPT autoregressive and Decoder-only, BERT bidirectional MLM and Encoder-only. The paper drew over a hundred citations within twenty-four hours, and Google Search shipped BERT on October 25, 2019, affecting roughly ten percent of English search queries. Through 2019 Facebook's RoBERTa, Google's ALBERT, HuggingFace's DistilBERT, and Stanford's ELECTRA all built on BERT, before the GPT route of Decoder-only plus scaling gradually displaced it after 2020.

events.title_zh: AlphaFold 1:CASP13 蛋白质结构预测初突破
events.title_en: AlphaFold 1: CASP13 Protein Structure Prediction Breakthrough
events.summary_zh:
2018 年 12 月 3-7 日,CASP13(第 13 届 Critical Assessment of Protein Structure Prediction)会议在墨西哥 Cancun 举办,DeepMind AlphaFold 1 在 13 届比赛中第一次达到“实验级精度”。
AlphaFold 1 用 Deep Learning 预测蛋白质距离矩阵 + 梯度下降优化 3D 结构。
CASP13 中 AlphaFold 在 GDT_TS 评分中位 60,远超第二名 40。
events.source_name: Senior, A. et al. (2019) Nature 577:706-710; CASP13 results
events.card_summary_zh: AlphaFold 1 用 Deep Learning 预测蛋白质距离矩阵 + 梯度下降优化 3D 结构。
events.summary_en: At the CASP13 (13th Critical Assessment of Protein Structure Prediction) conference in Cancun, Mexico, from December 3–7, 2018, DeepMind’s AlphaFold 1 reached "experimental accuracy" for the first time in the 13th competition. By using deep learning to predict protein distance matrices and gradient descent to optimize 3D structures, AlphaFold achieved a median GDT_TS score of 60 at CASP13, far outstripping the runner-up's score of 40.
events.card_summary_en: Deep learning predicted protein distance matrices, gradient descent assembled the 3D structure.
events.why_it_matters_en: AlphaFold 1 was DeepMind's first battle turning from game AI toward science AI. It proved the RL-plus-DL route could crack biological structure, directly producing AlphaFold2 at experimental-grade accuracy in 2020, the AlphaFold DB of 200 million protein structures in 2021, and AlphaFold 3's protein-small-molecule interactions in 2024. Reading AlphaFold 1 in 2018, AlphaFold 2 in 2020, AlphaFold-Multimer in 2021, and AlphaFold 3 in 2024 reveals DeepMind's commercial route: science problems plus public databases plus commercial APIs.
events.behind_scenes_en: Veteran DeepMind scientist Andrew Senior led the project, credited as Senior et al., Nature 577:706-710, with John Jumper already on the team before taking over as lead for AlphaFold2. The AlphaFold 1 group was small, five to ten people, entering CASP13 anonymously in 2018 and announcing itself as DeepMind after the contest. The paper followed in Nature on January 15, 2020. But AlphaFold 1 still fell short of experimental accuracy, driving Jumper's team to rewrite the architecture through 2019-2020, and at CASP14 AlphaFold2 posted a median GDT of 92.4, experiment-grade precision.

events.title_zh: OpenAI GPT-2:大规模生成预训练首次披露
events.title_en: OpenAI GPT-2: Large-Scale Generative Pre-training Disclosed
events.summary_zh:
2019 年 2 月 14 日,OpenAI 在博客《Better Language Models and Their Implications》发布 GPT-2 论文《Language Models are Unsupervised Multitask Learners》(Radford 等)。
GPT-2 用 48 层 Transformer Decoder,1.5B 参数,在 WebText(4500 万网页,40GB)上训练。
GPT-2 在零样本(zero-shot)下完成翻译、问答、摘要、写作等 7 个任务。
OpenAI 以“恶意使用风险”为由,分阶段发布:2019-02-14 发布 117M 小模型,2019-05 发布 345M,2019-08 发布 774M,2019-11-05 发布完整 1.5B 模型。
events.source_name: Radford, A. et al. (2019) GPT-2 paper; OpenAI blog
events.card_summary_zh: GPT-2 展示连贯长文本生成能力，也因潜在滥用风险分阶段开放，模型发布第一次与安全治理正面相撞。
events.summary_en: On February 14, 2019, OpenAI published the GPT-2 paper "Language Models are Unsupervised Multitask Learners" (Radford et al.) alongside its blog post "Better Language Models and Their Implications." Built with a 48-layer Transformer decoder and 1.5B parameters, GPT-2 was trained on WebText (45 million webpages, 40GB) and demonstrated the ability to perform seven zero-shot tasks, including translation, Q&A, summarization, and writing. Citing "malicious use risks," OpenAI opted for a staged rollout: releasing the 117M model on February 14, 2019, the 345M in May 2019, the 774M in August 2019, and the complete 1.5B model on November 5, 2019.
events.card_summary_en: Coherent generation met staged release over misuse risk, publishing colliding with safety.
events.why_it_matters_en: GPT-2 began the era when AI safety shaped product decisions in the LLM age. Reading GPT-2's 2019 1.5B staged release through GPT-3's 2020 API-controlled 175B, ChatGPT's 2022 RLHF full launch, and GPT-4's 2023 multimodality with red-teaming traces OpenAI's evolution from cautious release to open API to consumer product.
events.behind_scenes_en: Alec Radford was first author on the OpenAI team, and the paper again skipped conferences for direct release on OpenAI's site. The staged rollout was OpenAI's first case of AI safety steering a product decision and set off fierce community argument: AllenAI and HuggingFace attacked it as marketing theater while DeepMind and Anthropic defended cautious release. Sentiment reversed internally by September 2019, the full model shipped in November, and the 2020 GPT-3 paper dropped staging altogether. GPT-2 also ignited 2019 regulatory debate over deepfake-plus-text generation, feeding directly into the EU AI Act's general-purpose AI system category of 2023.

events.title_zh: OpenAI LP 设立: capped-profit 转型
events.title_en: OpenAI LP: Capped-Profit Transition
events.summary_zh:
2019 年 3 月 11 日,OpenAI 宣布成立 OpenAI LP(Limited Partnership),从非营利转为“capped-profit”架构。
原 OpenAI Inc.(非营利)成为 OpenAI LP 的唯一控制方,Microsoft 投 10 亿美元,投资回报上限 100 倍。
架构设计:投资者回报达到上限后,剩余利润归原 OpenAI Inc.(非营利)。
理由是“训练大模型需要超大规模资本,纯非营利无法支撑”。
2019-2023 年 Microsoft 累计投资 130 亿美元。
events.source_name: OpenAI (2019) OpenAI LP announcement; Microsoft investment
events.card_summary_zh: OpenAI LP 设立： capped-profit 转型；OpenAI LP 是 LLM 时代大厂投资的范式模板。
events.summary_en: On March 11, 2019, OpenAI announced the creation of OpenAI LP (Limited Partnership), transitioning from a non-profit to a “capped-profit” structure because training large models requires massive capital that a pure non-profit cannot sustain. Solely controlled by the original non-profit OpenAI Inc., the new entity secured a $1 billion investment from Microsoft with returns capped at 100x, after which any remaining profits revert to OpenAI Inc. Between 2019 and 2023, Microsoft’s cumulative investment reached $13 billion.
events.card_summary_en: OpenAI LP created the capped-profit blueprint for big-tech investment in frontier labs.
events.why_it_matters_en: OpenAI LP became the paradigm template for LLM-era corporate investment. Reading the 2019 LP through Microsoft's thirteen billion dollars in 2023, Amazon's eight billion into Anthropic in 2024, and xAI's six billion in 2024 shows the LLM era's three architectures for routing big money around pure-nonprofit limits: capped-profit, BCORP, and strategic partnership.
events.behind_scenes_en: Before the LP, fundraising under the nonprofit model struggled from 2015 to 2018: Y Combinator, Reid Hoffman, and Peter Thiel contributed about a billion dollars cumulatively, while training GPT-2 and GPT-3 required five hundred million to a billion dollars of compute each year. OpenAI negotiated with Microsoft for six months across 2018-2019 and designed the capped-profit architecture to route around the bar on nonprofit dividends.
