Elon Musk left the OpenAI board in February 2018 citing conflicts of interest with Tesla's autonomous-driving AI, in reality conflicts bound up with disagreements over direction. After Sam Altman's November 2023 firing episode, OpenAI planned a restructuring into a PBC, a Public Benefit Corporation, removing the capped-profit ceiling.

events.title_zh: NVIDIA Megatron-LM:大模型并行训练范式
events.title_en: NVIDIA Megatron-LM: Large Model Parallel Training Paradigm
events.summary_zh:
2019 年 9 月 19 日,NVIDIA 在 arXiv:1909.08053 发表《Megatron-LM: Training Multi-Billion Parameter Language Models Using Model Parallelism》。
Megatron-LM 用 Tensor Parallelism(把每层 Attention/FFN 矩阵切到多 GPU)+ Pipeline Parallelism(把不同层放到不同 GPU),在 512 个 V100 GPU 上训练 8.3B 参数 GPT-2,达到 52% 单 GPU 训练效率。
Megatron-LM 直接催生 NVIDIA NeMo Megatron、Microsoft DeepSpeed、Megatron-DeepSpeed。
events.source_name: Shoeybi, M. et al. (2019) arXiv:1909.08053
events.card_summary_zh: Megatron-LM 直接催生 NVIDIA NeMo Megatron、Microsoft DeepSpeed；Megatron-LM 是大模型并行训练的起点。
events.summary_en: On September 19, 2019, NVIDIA published "Megatron-LM: Training Multi-Billion Parameter Language Models Using Model Parallelism" on arXiv (arXiv:1909.08053). By combining Tensor Parallelism (splitting each layer's Attention/FFN matrices across multiple GPUs) and Pipeline Parallelism (placing different layers on different GPUs), Megatron-LM trained an 8.3B parameter GPT-2 on 512 V100 GPUs, achieving a 52% single-GPU training efficiency. This breakthrough directly spawned NVIDIA NeMo Megatron, Microsoft DeepSpeed, and Megatron-DeepSpeed.
events.card_summary_en: Megatron-LM started large-model parallel training and seeded NeMo Megatron and DeepSpeed.
events.why_it_matters_en: Megatron-LM is the origin point of large-model parallel training. Reading Megatron-LM 2019 through DeepSpeed ZeRO 2020, Megatron-DeepSpeed 2021, FSDP 2022, and Sequence Parallelism 2023 explains how LLM training scaled from 1B to 540B, 175B, and 1.8T parameters after 2020.
events.behind_scenes_en: First author Mohammad Shoeybi worked at NVIDIA's Silicon Valley research arm. His team partnered with Stanford and Berkeley in 2019 and merged with Microsoft's DeepSpeed ZeRO line into Megatron-DeepSpeed in 2020. The Megatron-LM papers shaped every large training effort of 2020-2023: GPT-3 at 175B, PaLM at 540B, LLaMA at 65B, Megatron-Turing NLG at 530B. In 2024 NVIDIA folded the route into the NeMo framework plus Megatron-LM 2.0.

events.title_zh: Google T5:Text-to-Text Transfer Transformer
events.title_en: Google T5: Text-to-Text Transfer Transformer
events.summary_zh:
2019 年 10 月 10 日,Google 在 JMLR 21 发表《Exploring the Limits of Transfer Learning with a Unified Text-to-Text Transformer》(arXiv:1910.10683)。
T5(Text-to-Text Transfer Transformer)用 Encoder-Decoder Transformer,把所有 NLP 任务统一为“文本输入 → 文本输出”格式。
T5 11B 在 GLUE、SuperGLUE、SQuAD、CNN-DM 等 30+ 任务上达到 SOTA。
T5 论文同时发布 C4(Colossal Clean Crawled Corpus)750GB 预训练数据集。
events.source_name: Raffel, C. et al. (2019) arXiv:1910.10683; JMLR 21
events.card_summary_zh: T5 论文同时发布 C4(Colossal Clean Crawled Corpus)750GB 预训练数据集。
events.summary_en: On October 10, 2019, Google published "Exploring the Limits of Transfer Learning with a Unified Text-to-Text Transformer" (arXiv:1910.10683) in JMLR 21, introducing T5 (Text-to-Text Transfer Transformer) to unify all NLP tasks into a "text input → text output" format using an Encoder-Decoder Transformer. T5 11B achieved SOTA on 30+ tasks, including GLUE, SuperGLUE, SQuAD, and CNN-DM. The paper also released the 750GB C4 (Colossal Clean Crawled Corpus) pre-training dataset.
events.card_summary_en: T5's paper shipped C4, a 750GB clean crawled corpus, beside its text-to-text recipe.
events.why_it_matters_en: T5 started the unified-text-interface paradigm and fed directly into the 2022 instruction-tuning-plus-RLHF route. Reading T5's 2019 text-to-text through FLAN's 2021 instruction tuning, InstructGPT's 2022 RLHF, and ChatGPT in 2022 maps LLM task unification: Encoder-Decoder with BERT and T5, Decoder-only with GPT, Decoder-only plus RLHF with ChatGPT.
events.behind_scenes_en: First author Colin Raffel led the Google Brain team. Across 2018-2019 they ran over a hundred experiments comparing Encoder-only, Decoder-only, and Encoder-Decoder architectures, concluding that Encoder-Decoder transferred most stably across multiple tasks. At 11B parameters T5 was the largest public LLM of 2019 until GPT-3's 175B overtook it in 2020. The T5 line shaped Google's internal LaMDA, PaLM, and Flan-T5 after 2020, and Google Bard initially ran on the T5/LaMDA route when it launched in 2023.

events.title_zh: DeepMind AlphaStar:星际争霸 II 超大师级
events.title_en: DeepMind AlphaStar: StarCraft II Grandmaster Level
events.summary_zh:
2019 年 10 月 30 日,DeepMind 在 Nature 575:350-354 发表《Grandmaster level in StarCraft II using multi-agent reinforcement learning》。
AlphaStar 用 Transformer + Pointer Network + LSTM + Multi-Agent RL,在 StarCraft II Battle.net 上达到大师级(欧洲服务器前 0.2%)。
AlphaStar 训练用 200 年人类游戏 + 14 天自我对弈,League 训练模式让智能体互相竞争进化。
events.source_name: Vinyals, O. et al. (2019) Nature 575:350-354; AlphaStar blog
events.card_summary_zh: AlphaStar 在信息不完全、操作复杂的即时战略游戏中达到超大师级，强化学习跨入更接近现实决策的环境。
events.summary_en: On October 30, 2019, DeepMind published "Grandmaster level in StarCraft II using multi-agent reinforcement learning" in *Nature* (575:350-354). By combining Transformers, Pointer Networks, LSTMs, and multi-agent reinforcement learning, AlphaStar achieved Grandmaster status on StarCraft II's Battle.net, ranking in the top 0.2% of the European server. The agent was trained on 200 years of human gameplay followed by 14 days of self-play, utilizing a "League" training mode where agents competed to drive their own evolution.
events.card_summary_en: Grandmaster-level StarCraft II play took reinforcement learning closer to real-world decisions.
events.why_it_matters_en: AlphaStar grounded complex multi-agent RL, ranking alongside AlphaGo's perfect information and MuZero's rule-free generality. Reading AlphaGo 2016 perfect information, AlphaStar 2019 imperfect-information multi-agent, MuZero 2019 general planning, and AlphaFold2 2020 science problems shows DeepMind's RL route: from board games to games to science, each step widening the paradigm into a new domain.
events.behind_scenes_en: David Silver and Oriol Vinyals led the project at DeepMind from 2017 to 2019, Vinyals himself a Spanish former professional StarCraft player. AlphaStar defeated MaNa and TLO in January 2019, Serral and Bunny in June 2019, and the paper followed in October 2019. It proved RL workable in the demanding combination of imperfect information, long-horizon planning, and multi-agent play, but after 2020 DeepMind pivoted to AlphaFold2 and the AlphaStar line was not continued.

events.title_zh: NVIDIA A100:LLM 训练硬件主力 4 年
events.title_en: NVIDIA A100: LLM Training Hardware Workhorse for 4 Years
events.summary_zh:
2020 年 5 月 14 日,NVIDIA CEO Jensen Huang 在 GTC 2020 Keynote(厨房录制,COVID 期间)发布 A100 GPU。
A100 是 Ampere 架构,7nm 工艺,826mm² die,54.2B 晶体管,40GB/80GB HBM2e,1.55TB/s 显存带宽,108 个 SM,432 个 Tensor Core(FP16 312 TFLOPS / TF32 156 TFLOPS / BF16 312 TFLOPS)。
DGX A100 8 卡版约 199,000 美元,2020-2024 年是 GPT-3、PaLM、LLaMA、GPT-4 训练主力。
events.source_name: NVIDIA Ampere whitepaper (2020); NVIDIA GTC 2020 keynote
events.card_summary_zh: A100 将张量计算、显存带宽和多卡互联推向新水平，成为早期大语言模型扩张的核心训练硬件。
events.summary_en: On May 14, 2020, NVIDIA CEO Jensen Huang unveiled the A100 GPU during his GTC 2020 Keynote, which was recorded in his kitchen during the COVID pandemic. Built on the Ampere architecture, the 7nm chip features an 826mm² die, 54.2B transistors, 40GB/80GB HBM2e with 1.55TB/s memory bandwidth, 108 SMs, and 432 Tensor Cores (FP16 312 TFLOPS / TF32 156 TFLOPS / BF16 312 TFLOPS). The 8-card DGX A100 version, priced at around $199,000, served as the primary training workhorse for GPT-3, PaLM, LLaMA, and GPT-4 from 2020 to 2024.
events.card_summary_en: A100 raised tensor compute, memory bandwidth, and interconnect, anchoring early LLM expansion.
events.why_it_matters_en: A100 anchored 2020-2024 as the LLM era's hardware bedrock, with GPT-3, PaLM, LLaMA, and others trained on A100 clusters. Against the V100 it combined four levers, architecture, process node, HBM2e memory, and third-generation Tensor Core with TF32, to push training costs down about fifty percent a year, setting the route for the H100 in 2022 and B100/200 in 2024, with generational detail covered in entry 13.
events.behind_scenes_en: The A100 project started in 2017, completed design through 2019-2020, and launched in May 2020. Ampere's third-generation Tensor Core introduced the TF32 datatype, automatically running FP32 matrix operations at 19-bit TF32 precision for an eightfold FP32 training speedup. The 80GB variant arrived in November 2021, doubling memory for training models at 175B and beyond. A100 remained the de facto standard for LLM training through 2020-2024, still carrying inference loads after the H100 shipped in 2022. Blackwell B100/200 launched in March 2024 with volume deployments following in 2025.

events.title_zh: Lewis RAG:检索增强生成范式提出
events.title_en: Lewis RAG: Retrieval-Augmented Generation Paradigm Proposed
events.summary_zh:
2020 年 5 月 22 日,Facebook AI Research Patrick Lewis 等在 NeurIPS 2020 发表《Retrieval-Augmented Generation for Knowledge-Intensive NLP Tasks》(arXiv:2005.11401)。
RAG 用「检索器(Dense Passage Retrieval)+ 生成器(BART)」两阶段:检索器从知识库召回 top-k 文档,生成器基于检索文档生成答案。
RAG 在 OpenQA、Jeopardy QG、TriviaQA 上达到 SOTA,且知识库可热更新。
events.source_name: Lewis, P. et al. (2020) arXiv:2005.11401; NeurIPS 2020
events.card_summary_zh: RAG 让语言模型先检索外部知识再生成答案，为模型接入最新资料和私有数据提供了通用方法。
events.summary_en: On May 22, 2020, Patrick Lewis and others at Facebook AI Research published "Retrieval-Augmented Generation for Knowledge-Intensive NLP Tasks" (arXiv:2005.11401) at NeurIPS 2020. RAG uses a two-stage process pairing a retriever (Dense Passage Retrieval) and a generator (BART), where the retriever recalls top-k documents from a knowledge base and the generator generates answers based on those retrieved documents. The framework achieved SOTA on OpenQA, Jeopardy QG, and TriviaQA, while allowing the underlying knowledge base to be hot-updated.
events.card_summary_en: Retrieve first, answer second: RAG gave LLMs a universal door to fresh and private knowledge.
events.why_it_matters_en: RAG is where knowledge access in the LLM era began. Reading RAG 2020 through RETRO, DeepMind's 7B retrieval-augmented model of 2021, Toolformer's 2023 tool calls, ChatGPT Plugins in 2023, and Anthropic's MCP model-context protocol of 2024 traces the evolution of LLM knowledge access: bolted-on retrieval, embedded retrieval, tool calling, standard protocols.
events.behind_scenes_en: Patrick Lewis of FAIR was first author, building RAG in 2019-2020 on Karpukhin's DPR dense passage retrieval plus Lewis's own BART. The paper appeared in May 2020, and RAG returned to attention after ChatGPT arrived in 2022: through 2023 LangChain, LlamaIndex, Pinecone, Weaviate, and other companies built LLM application stacks around it, and by 2024 RAG had become the standard pattern for enterprise LLM deployment.

events.title_zh: OpenAI GPT-3 175B:Scaling Laws 验证
events.title_en: OpenAI GPT-3 175B: Scaling Laws Validated
events.summary_zh:
2020 年 5 月 28 日,OpenAI 在 arXiv:2005.14165 发表《Language Models are Few-Shot Learners》。
GPT-3 用 96 层 Transformer Decoder,175B 参数,在 Common Crawl(499B token)+ WebText2 + Books1 + Books2 + Wikipedia 上训练。
GPT-3 首次展示“in-context learning”:不需微调,只在 prompt 中给 0/few-shot 示例就能完成翻译、问答、编程、推理等 50+ 任务。
GPT-3 论文引用 2024 年超 3 万次,是 LLM 时代奠基论文。
events.source_name: Brown, T. et al. (2020) arXiv:2005.14165; NeurIPS 2020
events.card_summary_zh: GPT-3 用 1750 亿参数展示规模扩张带来的涌现能力，“把模型做大”由此成为行业主航道。
events.summary_en: On May 28, 2020, OpenAI published "Language Models are Few-Shot Learners" on arXiv:2005.14165, introducing GPT-3, a model trained on Common Crawl (499B tokens), WebText2, Books1, Books2, and Wikipedia using a 96-layer Transformer Decoder and 175B parameters. GPT-3 first demonstrated "in-context learning," performing over 50 tasks like translation, Q&A, programming, and reasoning without fine-tuning, using only zero- or few-shot examples in the prompt. With over 30,000 citations by 2024, it remains a foundational paper of the LLM era.
events.card_summary_en: At 175 billion parameters GPT-3 showed scale brings emergent skill, making size the mainline.
events.why_it_matters_en: GPT-3 validated the LLM era's scaling hypothesis. Reading Kaplan's Scaling Laws of January 2020, GPT-3 175B that May, Chinchilla's 70B correction on data versus parameters in 2022, PaLM 540B in 2022, the rumored 1.8T GPT-4 of 2023, and Llama 3 405B in 2024 shows the decade's core wagers: scaling laws, in-context learning, and RLHF as the three pillars of 2020s LLMs.
events.behind_scenes_en: Tom Brown led authorship on the OpenAI team. The project trained through 2019-2020 on V100 clusters at a cost of roughly twelve million dollars. GPT-3 validated Kaplan's January 2020 Scaling Laws paper, arXiv 2001.08361, showing loss falling as a power law in parameters, data, and compute. The API entered public beta on June 11, 2020 and turned paid in September 2021. GPT-3 directly produced DALL-E, ChatGPT, and Codex behind GitHub Copilot in 2022, and GPT-4 in 2023; everything OpenAI shipped after 2020 extended the GPT-3 line.

events.title_zh: OpenAI API:LLM-as-a-Service 商业模式启动
events.title_en: OpenAI API: LLM-as-a-Service Business Model Launched
events.summary_zh:
2020 年 6 月 11 日,OpenAI 发布《OpenAI API》博客,推出 GPT-3 商用 API(private beta)。
API 端点统一为「text-in text-out」,价格按 token 计费(初期 0.06 美元/1K token)。
API 不卖模型权重,只卖推理服务,这是 LLM 时代「LLM-as-a-Service」商业模式起点。
2021-09 公测,2022-08 Codex API(GitHub Copilot),2022-11-30 ChatGPT 上线,2023-03 GPT-4 API。
events.source_name: OpenAI (2020-06-11) OpenAI API blog; private beta launch
events.card_summary_zh: OpenAI 把 GPT-3 能力封装成 API，开发者无需训练模型即可构建产品，大模型即服务的商业模式由此成立。
events.summary_en: On June 11, 2020, OpenAI published its "OpenAI API" blog post to launch the commercial GPT-3 API in private beta, featuring a unified "text-in, text-out" endpoint priced initially at $0.06 per 1K tokens. By selling only inference services rather than model weights, this move marked the beginning of the LLM era's "LLM-as-a-Service" business model, which paved the way for a public beta in September 2021, the Codex API (GitHub Copilot) in August 2022, the launch of ChatGPT on November 30, 2022, and the GPT-4 API in March 2023.
events.card_summary_en: OpenAI packaged GPT-3's capabilities into an API so developers could build products without training a model themselves, and the LLM-as-a-Service business model was thus established.
events.why_it_matters_en:
The OpenAI API was the starting point of LLM-era business models, directly defining how LLM companies made money from 2022 to 2025.
Following the line OpenAI API (2020-06) → Codex / Copilot (2022) → ChatGPT (2022-11) → GPT-4 API (2023-03) → GPT-4o (2024-05), you can see the path of LLM commercialization: keep the model weights private → metered API billing → ChatGPT subscriptions → enterprise editions plus multimodality.
events.behind_scenes_en:
The OpenAI API project was driven from 2019 to 2020 by Sam Altman, Greg Brockman, and Mira Murati.
Right after setting up OpenAI LP in March 2019, Altman pushed API commercialization.
The API design borrowed from the Stripe API (simple endpoints plus billing); not selling weights avoided both weight leakage and safety risks.
During the private beta OpenAI rejected 70% of applications, and across 2020-2021 more than 300 applications connected in total.
The API route exploded after ChatGPT launched in 2022, passing $1 billion ARR in 2023 and over $3 billion ARR in 2024.

events.title_zh: OpenAI iGPT:图像自回归预训练探索
events.title_en: OpenAI iGPT: Image Autoregressive Pre-training Exploration
events.summary_zh:
2020 年 6 月 24 日,OpenAI 在 arXiv:2012.12656 发表《Generative Pretraining from Pixels》(实际 2020-06 公开 blog)。
iGPT(Image GPT)把 GPT-2 自回归架构扩展到图像:把 32×32 图像展开为 1024 序列,用 Transformer Decoder 自回归预测下一个像素。
iGPT-XL(6.8B 参数)在 ImageNet 上半监督分类达 72.0% top-1,接近 SimCLR 等 contrastive 路线。
events.source_name: Chen, M. et al. (2020) arXiv:2012.12656; OpenAI iGPT blog
events.card_summary_zh: OpenAI iGPT：图像自回归预训练探索；iGPT 是「统一 Transformer 架构」思想在视觉领域的探索。
events.summary_en: On June 24, 2020, OpenAI published "Generative Pretraining from Pixels" on arXiv:2012.12656 (having originally debuted the work in a June 2020 blog post), introducing iGPT (Image GPT) to adapt the autoregressive architecture of GPT-2 for computer vision by flattening 32×32 images into a sequence of 1024 and using a Transformer Decoder to predict the next pixel. The model's largest variant, iGPT-XL (6.8B parameters), achieved a 72.0% top-1 accuracy on ImageNet under semi-supervised classification, bringing it close to contrastive learning approaches like SimCLR.
events.card_summary_en: OpenAI iGPT: an exploration of autoregressive pretraining for images; iGPT carried the idea of a unified Transformer architecture into the visual domain.
events.why_it_matters_en:
iGPT was the exploration of the unified Transformer architecture idea in the visual domain.
Following the line iGPT (2020) → ViT (2020-10) → DALL-E (2021-01) → Sora (2024-02, DiT autoregressive + Diffusion), you can see how visual AI in the 2020s shifted from CNN-dominated to Transformer-dominated.
events.behind_scenes_en:
iGPT's lead author was Mark Chen of the OpenAI team.
iGPT was published as a blog post in June 2020, with the arXiv paper following in December.
The iGPT paper proved that the autoregressive pretraining paradigm could extend from text to images, but its training cost far exceeded ViT (2020-10).
The iGPT route was replaced by ViT + MAE (2021-11) in 2021, but in 2024 Sora, VAR, and LlamaGen picked the image autoregression route back up.

events.title_zh: AlphaFold2:CASP14 蛋白质结构预测达到实验级精度
events.title_en: AlphaFold2: CASP14 Protein Structure Prediction Reaches Experimental Accuracy
events.summary_zh:
2020 年 11 月 30 日,CASP14(第 14 届 Critical Assessment of Protein Structure Prediction)会议公布结果,DeepMind AlphaFold2 在 GDT_TS 中位 92.4,远超第二名 75.6,首次达到实验级精度(X-ray 晶体学误差范围内)。
AlphaFold2 用 Evoformer + Structure Module,用 MSA(Multiple Sequence Alignment)+ Pair Representation 联合表征。
Nature 2021-07 15 发表 AlphaFold2 论文《Highly accurate protein structure prediction with AlphaFold》。
events.source_name: Jumper, J. et al. (2021) Nature 596:583-589; CASP14 results (2020-11)
events.card_summary_zh: AlphaFold2 将蛋白质结构预测推进到接近实验精度，证明 AI 不只生成内容，也能改变科学发现的方法。
events.summary_en: On November 30, 2020, the results of the 14th Critical Assessment of Protein Structure Prediction (CASP14) were announced, showing DeepMind’s AlphaFold2 achieving a median GDT_TS of 92.4—far outstripping the runner-up's 75.6—to reach experimental-grade accuracy (within the margin of error of X-ray crystallography) for the first time. AlphaFold2 utilizes Evoformer and Structure Module, employing MSA (Multiple Sequence Alignment) and Pair Representation for joint representation. On July 15, 2021, *Nature* published the AlphaFold2 paper, "Highly accurate protein structure prediction with AlphaFold."
events.card_summary_en: AlphaFold2 pushed protein structure prediction to near experimental accuracy, proving that AI does more than generate content: it can change the very method of scientific discovery.
events.why_it_matters_en:
AlphaFold2 was the biggest breakthrough in the history of AI for Science, directly changing the paradigm of protein research.
Following the line AlphaFold2 (2020) → AlphaFold-Multimer (2021) → AlphaFold DB with 200 million proteins (2021) → ESMFold (2022, Meta's 60x speedup) → AlphaFold 3 (2024, protein-small molecule), you can see how AI for Science in the 2020s shifted from problem-driven to AI-driven.
events.behind_scenes_en:
AlphaFold2's lead author was John Jumper of the DeepMind team.
From 2018 to 2020 Jumper rewrote the AlphaFold 1 architecture, introducing the Evoformer (self-attention + axial attention) and a Structure Module (SE(3)-equivariant Transformer).
At CASP14 AlphaFold2 stunned the biology community; the Nature paper came out in July 2021, and Science named it the #1 scientific breakthrough of 2021.
In July 2021 DeepMind released the AlphaFold DB covering 200 million protein structures, and by 2023 it expanded to 214 million proteins plus all eukaryotes.
By 2024 the AlphaFold2 paper had been cited more than 20,000 times, making it the biggest breakthrough in the history of AI for Science.

events.title_zh: OpenAI CLIP + DALL·E:多模态预训练范式确立
events.title_en: OpenAI CLIP + DALL·E: Multimodal Pre-training Paradigm Established
events.summary_zh:
2021 年 1 月 5 日,OpenAI 同时发布 CLIP(Contrastive Language-Image Pre-training,arXiv:2103.00020,实际 2021-02-26 arXiv)和 DALL·E(arXiv:2102.12092,2021-01-05 blog)。
CLIP 用 4 亿图文对训练双塔模型,把图像和文本映射到同一 512 维空间,在 30+ 视觉分类任务上 zero-shot 接近监督 SOTA。
DALL·E 用 120 亿参数 dVAE + Transformer,文本生成图像。
两篇论文奠定「多模态统一表征」路线。
events.source_name: Radford, A. et al. (2021) CLIP arXiv:2103.00020; Ramesh, A. et al. DALL·E arXiv:2102.12092
events.card_summary_zh: CLIP 与 DALL·E 把语言和图像放进同一学习框架，文本理解开始能够直接驱动视觉识别与生成。
events.summary_en: On January 5, 2021, OpenAI simultaneously released CLIP (Contrastive Language-Image Pre-training, arXiv:2103.00020, actually 2021-02-26 arXiv) and DALL·E (arXiv:2102.12092, 2021-01-05 blog). CLIP trained a dual-tower model on 400 million image-text pairs to map images and text into the same 512-dimensional space, approaching supervised SOTA on 30+ visual classification tasks via zero-shot learning, while DALL·E employed a 12-billion-parameter dVAE + Transformer for text-to-image generation. Together, these two papers laid the foundation for the "unified multimodal representation" pathway.
events.card_summary_en: CLIP and DALL·E put language and images into a single learning framework, letting text understanding directly drive visual recognition and generation.
events.why_it_matters_en:
CLIP + DALL·E marked the start of the unified vision-language paradigm, directly giving rise to Stable Diffusion, Midjourney, and DALL·E 2 in 2022.
Following the line CLIP (2021) → DALL·E 2 (2022-04) → Stable Diffusion (2022-08) → Imagen (2022-05) → Sora (2024-02), you can see that the common foundation of multimodal AI in the 2020s is CLIP-style contrastive pretraining combined with Diffusion or Transformer decoding.
events.behind_scenes_en:
CLIP's lead author was Alec Radford and DALL·E's lead author was Aditya Ramesh, both on the OpenAI team.
CLIP drew inspiration from earlier work such as VirTex and CONVIRT; its key idea was contrastive learning over massive noisy image-text pairs.
The CLIP paper hit arXiv in February 2021 and was accepted at ICML in March 2021.
CLIP served as the text encoder in Stable Diffusion (2022) and as a foundational component in Sora, DALL-E 3, and Midjourney v6.
The DALL·E line advanced to DALL·E 2 (diffusion) in April 2022 and DALL·E 3 (GPT-4 + prompt rewriting) in October 2023.

events.title_zh: Hu LoRA:低秩适配器开启高效微调时代
events.title_en: Hu LoRA: Low-Rank Adapters Enable Efficient Fine-tuning Era
events.summary_zh:
2021 年 6 月 17 日,Microsoft Edward Hu 等在 arXiv:2106.09685 发表《LoRA: Low-Rank Adaptation of Large Language Models》。
LoRA 把权重更新 ΔW 分解为两个低秩矩阵 BA(B∈r×d,A∈d×r,r≪d),只训练 BA 不动原权重,可训练参数降低 1000-10000 倍。
LoRA 在 GPT-3 175B 上把微调参数从 175B 降到 4.7M(0.003%),性能持平或略优。
events.card_summary_zh: LoRA 只训练极少量附加参数就能改造大模型，让普通团队也有机会低成本完成定制微调。
events.summary_en: On June 17, 2021, Microsoft’s Edward Hu and others published "LoRA: Low-Rank Adaptation of Large Language Models" on arXiv:2106.09685. LoRA decomposes the weight update ΔW into two low-rank matrices BA (B∈r×d, A∈d×r, r≪d), training only BA while keeping the original weights frozen, which slashes trainable parameters by 1,000 to 10,000 times. On GPT-3 175B, this method reduced fine-tuning parameters from 175B to just 4.7M (0.003%) while delivering comparable or slightly superior performance.
events.card_summary_en: LoRA adapts large models by training only a tiny set of added parameters, giving ordinary teams a realistic low-cost path to custom fine-tuning.
events.why_it_matters_en:
LoRA was the starting point of parameter-efficient fine-tuning, directly defining the open-source LLM fine-tuning paradigm from 2022 to 2025.
Following the line LoRA (2021-06) → Prefix Tuning (2021-07) → QLoRA (2023-05) → DoRA (2024-02), you can see why a consumer GPU like the 4090 can now fine-tune a 70B LLM.
events.behind_scenes_en:
LoRA's lead author was Edward Hu at Microsoft Research.
It began as Hu's 2021 internship project, inspired by Aghajanyan's 2020 intrinsic dimension paper.
The LoRA paper hit arXiv in June 2021 and was accepted at ICLR in October 2022.
From 2022 to 2023 LoRA became the de facto standard for open-source LLM fine-tuning: Stable Diffusion LoRA models, HuggingFace PEFT, LoRA + QLoRA (2023-05), and LoRA + DPO (2023-05).
Commercial impact: companies such as Runway and Civitai built marketplaces around trading LoRA models.

events.title_zh: GitHub Copilot 公测:AI 编程助手进入主流
events.title_en: GitHub Copilot Public Beta: AI Coding Assistant Goes Mainstream
events.summary_zh:
2021 年 6 月 29 日,GitHub 与 OpenAI 联合宣布 GitHub Copilot Technical Preview 公测。
Copilot 基于 OpenAI Codex(GPT-3 微调版,代码训练 159GB GitHub 代码),在 VS Code 中提供行级 / 函数级代码补全,月费 10 美元。
2022-06-21 正式版上线,2023-03 推出 Copilot X(GPT-4 + Chat),2024-12 推出 Copilot Workspace(任务级 Agent)。
events.source_name: GitHub (2021-06-29) Copilot preview announcement; OpenAI Codex
events.card_summary_zh: Copilot 把代码生成嵌入编辑器，程序员第一次大规模体验与模型并肩写代码的日常工作方式。
events.summary_en: On June 29, 2021, GitHub and OpenAI jointly announced the public beta of GitHub Copilot Technical Preview. Powered by OpenAI Codex—a fine-tuned version of GPT-3 trained on 159GB of GitHub code—Copilot provides line-level and function-level code completion in VS Code for $10 a month. It officially launched on June 21, 2022, followed by the debuts of Copilot X (GPT-4 + Chat) in March 2023 and Copilot Workspace (a task-level Agent) in December 2024.
events.card_summary_en: Copilot embedded code generation into the editor, giving programmers their first mass experience of writing code side by side with a model as daily work.
events.why_it_matters_en:
Copilot was the consumer zero-moment for AI coding assistants, defining the shape of AI programming products from 2022 to 2025.
Following the line Copilot (2021) → Cursor (2023) → Devin (2024) → Claude Code (2025) → Codex Cloud Agent (2025), you can see AI coding evolve from completion to conversation to agents.
events.behind_scenes_en:
The Copilot project was led from 2020 to 2021 by OpenAI's Mark Chen and GitHub's Oege de Moor.
The Codex model was a code-specialized version of GPT-3, fine-tuned on public GitHub code that OpenAI collected in 2020-2021.
Before the public beta there was internal controversy at GitHub: developers worried about code copyright and job replacement.
In November 2022 the Authors Guild filed a class-action lawsuit against GitHub; in January 2024 the court partially dismissed it.
Copilot reached 1 million subscribers in 2023 and 1.8 million paying users in 2024, with ARR exceeding $200 million.

events.title_zh: OpenAI Codex API:代码 LLM 商业化
events.title_en: OpenAI Codex API: Code LLM Commercialization
events.summary_zh:
2021 年 8 月 10 日,OpenAI 发布 Codex API 私测。
Codex 是 GPT-3 的代码专精版,在 OpenAI 收集的 159GB GitHub 公开代码(2021 年论文)上微调,支持 Python、JavaScript、Go、C++ 等 12+ 语言。
Codex API 端点 /v1/completions(code-davinci-001 模型),按 token 计费 0.06 美元/1K。
Codex 是 GitHub Copilot 背后模型,2022-08 Codex 退役,被 GPT-3.5 / GPT-4 取代。
events.source_name: Chen, M. et al. (2021) arXiv:2107.03374; OpenAI Codex API blog
events.card_summary_zh: OpenAI 发布 Codex API 私测，并成为这一阶段值得追踪的关键变化。
events.summary_en: On August 10, 2021, OpenAI launched the private beta of its Codex API, a code-specialized version of GPT-3 fine-tuned on 159GB of public GitHub code (from its 2021 paper) that supports 12+ languages including Python, JavaScript, Go, and C++. The API endpoint `/v1/completions` (using the code-davinci-001 model) was priced at $0.06/1K tokens. Serving as the underlying model for GitHub Copilot, Codex was retired in August 2022 and replaced by GPT-3.5 and GPT-4.
events.card_summary_en: OpenAI launched the Codex API private beta, a key change worth tracking in this period.
events.why_it_matters_en:
Codex was the starting point of commercializing code LLMs, directly spawning GitHub Copilot and every code LLM that followed.
Following the line Codex (2021-08) → Copilot GA (2022-06) → Code Llama (2023-08) → DeepSeek-Coder (2024) → Claude Sonnet 4.5 (2025), you can see code AI evolve from completion to conversation to agents.
events.behind_scenes_en:
The Codex project was led from 2020 to 2021 by Mark Chen's team at OpenAI; the Codex paper arXiv:2107.03374, 'Evaluating Large Language Models Trained on Code,' was published in July 2021.
On the HumanEval benchmark Codex scored 28.8% pass@1 (versus 0% for GPT-3), and Codex-12B reached 37.7%.
More than 700 developers joined during the Codex API private beta, and GitHub Copilot went GA in June 2022.
The Codex models were retired in March 2023, replaced by GPT-3.5 / GPT-4, but the Codex dataset and HumanEval benchmark shaped code LLM training through 2022-2024 (StarCoder, Code Llama, DeepSeek-Coder, Qwen Coder).

events.title_zh: InstructGPT 论文:RLHF 路线工业落地
events.title_en: InstructGPT Paper: RLHF Industrialized
events.summary_zh:
2022 年 3 月 4 日,OpenAI 在 arXiv:2203.02155 发表《Training language models to follow instructions with human feedback》。
InstructGPT 用三阶段训练:1) SFT(监督微调,演示数据) 2) RM(奖励模型,偏好数据) 3) PPO(强化学习优化)。
1.3B InstructGPT 输出优于 175B GPT-3,证明 RLHF 比 scaling 更有效。
events.source_name: Ouyang, L. et al. (2022) arXiv:2203.02155; NeurIPS 2022
events.card_summary_zh: InstructGPT 用人类反馈训练模型遵循意图，小模型甚至胜过更大的 GPT-3，ChatGPT 的对齐路线由此成熟。
events.summary_en: On March 4, 2022, OpenAI published "Training language models to follow instructions with human feedback" on arXiv:2203.02155, training InstructGPT via three stages: 1) SFT (supervised fine-tuning, demonstration data), 2) RM (reward model, preference data), and 3) PPO (reinforcement learning optimization). The resulting 1.3B InstructGPT outperformed the 175B GPT-3, proving that RLHF is more effective than scaling.
events.card_summary_en: InstructGPT used human feedback to train models to follow human intent; a small model even beat the larger GPT-3, and the alignment route behind ChatGPT matured here.
events.why_it_matters_en:
InstructGPT laid the foundation for industrializing the RLHF route and directly gave rise to ChatGPT.
Following the line InstructGPT (2022-03) → ChatGPT (2022-11) → Claude (2023-03) → Llama 2 Chat (2023-07) → DeepSeek-R1 (2025-01, RL + cold start), you can see the evolution of LLM post-training paradigms: SFT → RLHF → DPO (2023-05) → RLAIF (2024).
events.behind_scenes_en:
InstructGPT's lead author was Long Ouyang of the OpenAI team.
The paper was completed internally in January 2022 and published on arXiv in March 2022.
The RLHF route grew out of Christiano's 2017 Deep RL from Human Preferences and Stiennon's 2020 summarization work.
In March 2022 InstructGPT shipped in the GPT-3 API (text-davinci-002 / 003); when ChatGPT launched on November 30, 2022 it used the same architecture (GPT-3.5 + RLHF).
By 2023 the RLHF route had become standard equipment for every LLM: Anthropic Constitutional AI (2022-12), Llama 2 Chat (2023-07), DeepSeek-R1 (2025-01).

events.title_zh: LAION-5B:58 亿图文对开源数据集发布
events.title_en: LAION-5B: 5.8B Image-Text Pairs Open Dataset Released
events.summary_zh:
2022 年 3 月 31 日,德国非营利组织 LAION(Large-scale Artificial Intelligence Open Network)在 arXiv:2210.08402 发表 LAION-5B 数据集。
LAION-5B 包含 58.5 亿英文 / 多语种图文对(2.3B 英文 + 2.3B 多语种 + 1.2B 未知语言),240TB 数据,从 Common Crawl 抓取,CLIP 过滤。
LAION-5B 直接训练 Stable Diffusion 1.x / 2.x,是 2022-2024 年开源文生图模型基础。
events.source_name: Schuhmann, C. et al. (2022) arXiv:2210.08402; LAION-5B
events.card_summary_zh: LAION-5B：58 亿图文对开源数据集发布，并成为这一阶段值得追踪的关键变化。
events.summary_en: On March 31, 2022, the German non-profit LAION (Large-scale Artificial Intelligence Open Network) published the LAION-5B dataset on arXiv:2210.08402. Scraped from Common Crawl and filtered using CLIP, the 240TB dataset contains 5.85 billion English/multilingual image-text pairs (comprising 2.3B English, 2.3B multilingual, and 1.2B unknown language pairs). LAION-5B directly trained Stable Diffusion 1.x / 2.x, serving as the foundation for open-source text-to-image models from 2022 to 2024.
events.card_summary_en: LAION-5B: release of the open dataset of 5.8 billion image-text pairs, a key change worth tracking in this period.
events.why_it_matters_en:
LAION-5B laid the groundwork for open multimodal data, directly defining open-source text-to-image models from 2022 to 2025.
Following the line LAION-400M (2021) → LAION-5B (2022-03) → Stable Diffusion 1.4 (2022-08) → SDXL (2023-07) → Flux (2024-08), you can see why open-source text-to-image exploded in 2022: open data, open code, and open weights all came together at once.
events.behind_scenes_en:
LAION was founded in 2021 by Christoph Schuhmann, Richard Vencu, Romain Beaumont, and others; it released LAION-400M in March 2021 and LAION-5B in March 2022.
Compute for LAION-5B was funded by Stability AI, championed by Miles Brundage and Emad Mostaque.
The LAION datasets directly spawned Stable Diffusion 1.4 (2022-08), 1.5 (2022-10), and 2.0 (2022-11).
In December 2023 LAION-5B was partially taken down over child-image and privacy controversies, and in 2024 LAION-Aesthetics v2.6 took its place.

events.title_zh: Google PaLM 540B:Pathways 大模型训练框架
events.title_en: Google PaLM 540B: Pathways Large Model Training Framework
events.summary_zh:
2022 年 4 月 4 日,Google 在 arXiv:2204.02311 发表《PaLM: Scaling Language Modeling with Pathways》。
PaLM 540B 用 6144 个 TPU v4 训练,780B token(社交媒体 + 网页 + 代码 + 多语种)。
PaLM 在 BIG-bench 上 144 任务超越人类平均,在多语种、推理、代码任务上达 SOTA。
PaLM 是 Pathways 系统首次大规模应用,支持跨 TPU Pod 训练。
events.source_name: Chowdhery, A. et al. (2022) arXiv:2204.02311; PaLM 540B
events.card_summary_zh: PaLM 用 Pathways 跨越大规模 TPU 集群训练 5400 亿参数模型，展示单一模型向多任务扩展的工程路线。
events.summary_en: On April 4, 2022, Google published "PaLM: Scaling Language Modeling with Pathways" on arXiv:2204.02311, detailing PaLM 540B, which was trained on 6144 TPU v4 chips across 780B tokens of social media, web pages, code, and multilingual data. Representing the first large-scale deployment of the Pathways system to support training across TPU Pods, the model achieved SOTA results in multilingual, reasoning, and coding tasks while beating the human average on 144 BIG-bench tasks.
events.card_summary_en: PaLM used Pathways to train a 540-billion-parameter model across massive TPU clusters, demonstrating an engineering route for scaling a single model toward many tasks.
events.why_it_matters_en:
PaLM laid the foundation of Google's LLM line, directly countering OpenAI's GPT-3 / GPT-4.
Following the line PaLM (2022-04) → PaLM 2 (2023-05) → Gemini 1.0 (2023-12) → Gemini 1.5 (2024-02) → Gemini 2.0 (2024-12), you can see Google's LLM route: from the Pathways training system to PaLM's single Transformer to Gemini's MoE multimodality.
events.behind_scenes_en:
PaLM's lead author was Aakanksha Chowdhery of the Google Brain team.
PaLM trained through 2021-2022 on 6,144 TPU v4 chips (two pods, 4,096 + 2,048), at a training cost of roughly $100 million.
From 2022 to 2023 the PaLM route became Google's flagship: PaLM-E (2023-03, robotics), Med-PaLM 2 (2023-05, healthcare), and PaLM 2 (2023-05, 392B, mid-size multilingual).
PaLM directly gave rise to Gemini 1.0 in December 2023, with the Mixture-of-Experts route replacing PaLM's single Transformer.

events.title_zh: DeepMind Chinchilla:数据-参数标度律修正
events.title_en: DeepMind Chinchilla: Data-Parameter Scaling Law Correction
events.summary_zh:
2022 年 4 月 12 日,DeepMind 在 arXiv:2203.15556 发表《Training Compute-Optimal Large Language Models》。
Chinchilla 70B(70B 参数 + 1.4T token 训练)在 MMLU、BIG-bench、阅读理解上击败 GPT-3 175B(175B 参数 + 300B token)。
Chinchilla 论文核心结论:Kaplan 2020 Scaling Laws 高估参数、低估数据,最优 compute-optimal 训练是「token 数 ≈ 20 × 参数数」。
events.source_name: Hoffmann, J. et al. (2022) arXiv:2203.15556; NeurIPS 2022
events.card_summary_zh: Chinchilla 70B(70B 参数 + 1.4T token 训练)在 MMLU、BIG-bench。
events.summary_en: On April 12, 2022, DeepMind published "Training Compute-Optimal Large Language Models" on arXiv:2203.15556, demonstrating that Chinchilla 70B (70B parameters + 1.4T tokens training) beat GPT-3 175B (175B parameters + 300B tokens) on MMLU, BIG-bench, and reading comprehension. The paper's core conclusion is that the Kaplan 2020 Scaling Laws overestimated parameters and underestimated data, asserting that compute-optimal training requires "number of tokens ≈ 20 × number of parameters."
events.card_summary_en: Chinchilla 70B (70B parameters trained on 1.4T tokens) on MMLU and BIG-bench.
events.why_it_matters_en:
Chinchilla laid the groundwork for correcting scaling laws in the LLM era, directly changing large-model training strategy from 2022 to 2025.
Following the line Kaplan Scaling Laws (2020-01, GPT-3) → Chinchilla (2022-04, data-parameter balance) → Llama 2 (2023, 2T tokens) → Llama 3 (2024, 15T tokens) → DeepSeek V3 (2024, 14.8T tokens), you can see LLM training shift from parameters-are-king to data-is-king.
events.behind_scenes_en:
Chinchilla's lead author was Jordan Hoffmann of the DeepMind team.
The paper hit arXiv in March 2022 and was accepted at NeurIPS in April 2022.
The Chinchilla paper influenced the training of every large model from 2022 to 2024: Llama 2 (2023, 2T tokens), Llama 3 (2024, 15T tokens), Mistral 7B (2023, 8T tokens), DeepSeek V2 (2024, 8.1T tokens).
The Chinchilla route shifted the focus of LLM training from growing parameters to growing data, giving rise to the synthetic-data and data-quality routes of 2023.

events.title_zh: Tri Dao FlashAttention:注意力 IO 优化奠基
events.title_en: Tri Dao FlashAttention: Attention IO Optimization Foundation
events.summary_zh:
2022 年 5 月 27 日,Tri Dao、Daniel Fu 在 arXiv:2205.14135 发表《FlashAttention: Fast and Memory-Efficient Exact Attention with IO-Awareness》(后 NeurIPS 2022 接收)。
FlashAttention 用 tiling + recomputation 优化 GPU SRAM/HBM IO,把 attention 计算从 O(N²) 显存降到 O(N),速度提升 2-4 倍,支持 16K+ 长上下文训练。
FlashAttention 开源后 2023 年成所有 LLM 训练标配。
events.source_name: Dao, T. & Fu, D. (2022) arXiv:2205.14135; NeurIPS 2022
events.card_summary_zh: FlashAttention 从显存读写而非纯算力入手重写注意力，让大模型训练更快，也为长上下文扩展清除瓶颈。
events.summary_en: On May 27, 2022, Tri Dao and Daniel Fu published "FlashAttention: Fast and Memory-Efficient Exact Attention with IO-Awareness" on arXiv (arXiv:2205.14135), which was later accepted by NeurIPS 2022. By optimizing GPU SRAM/HBM IO through tiling and recomputation, FlashAttention slashed attention memory consumption from O(N²) to O(N), delivered a 2- to 4-fold speedup, and enabled 16K+ long-context training. Following its open-source release, FlashAttention became the standard for all LLM training in 2023.
events.card_summary_en: FlashAttention rewrote attention around memory reads and writes rather than raw compute, making large-model training faster and clearing away the bottleneck for long-context scaling.
events.why_it_matters_en:
FlashAttention laid the foundation of long-context LLM training, directly defining the long-context route from 2023 to 2025.
Following the line FlashAttention (2022-06) → FlashAttention-2 (2023-07) → RingAttention (2023-12) → FlashAttention-3 (2024-07) → Mamba / Linear Attention (2024), you can see why LLM context windows grew from 4K to over 1M tokens in 2024.
events.behind_scenes_en:
FlashAttention's lead author was Tri Dao, a Stanford postdoc advised by Christopher Ré and Stefano Ermon.
From 2021 to 2022 Dao studied the GPU memory hierarchy and found that attention's bottleneck was HBM bandwidth, not FLOPs.
The FlashAttention paper hit arXiv in May 2022 and was accepted at NeurIPS in June 2022.
FlashAttention-2 (2023-07) improved parallelism; FlashAttention-3 (2024-07) used Hopper TMA + WGMMA for a 2x speedup.
Dao founded Together AI in August 2024; FlashAttention became core infrastructure for open-source LLM training.

events.title_zh: Midjourney v3 公测:订阅制文生图商业化
events.title_en: Midjourney v3 Beta: Subscription Text-to-Image Commercialization
events.summary_zh:
2022 年 7 月 12 日,David Holz 创立的 Midjourney 推出 v3 公测,通过 Discord 订阅(10/30/60 美元/月)。
Midjourney v3 用 Latent Diffusion + 自有数据集,在艺术风格、人脸、构图上优于 Stable Diffusion 1.x。
2022-08 OpenAI DALL·E 2、Stability SD 1.4、Midjourney v3 三家在 1 个月内集中发布,2022 年成「文生图元年」。
events.source_name: Midjourney (2022-07) v3 beta launch; David Holz interviews
events.card_summary_zh: Midjourney v3 公测：订阅制文生图商业化，并成为这一阶段值得追踪的关键变化。
events.summary_en: On July 12, 2022, David Holz’s Midjourney launched its v3 public beta via Discord subscriptions ($10/$30/$60 per month), using Latent Diffusion and a proprietary dataset to outperform Stable Diffusion 1.x in artistic style, faces, and composition. In August 2022, the concentrated release of OpenAI’s DALL·E 2, Stability’s SD 1.4, and Midjourney v3 within a single month cemented 2022 as the inaugural year of text-to-image generation.
events.card_summary_en: Midjourney v3 public beta: subscription-based commercialization of text-to-image generation, a key change worth tracking in this period.
events.why_it_matters_en:
Midjourney laid the foundation of subscription-based text-to-image generation and, together with Stable Diffusion (open source) and DALL·E 2 (API), formed a three-way contest in 2022.
Following the line Midjourney v3 (2022-07) → SD 1.4 (2022-08) → DALL·E 2 (2022-04, actually earlier) → SDXL (2023-07) → Flux (2024-08), you can see the three commercialization paths for text-to-image in 2022: subscription (Midjourney), open source (SD), and API (DALL·E).
events.behind_scenes_en:
Midjourney the company was founded in August 2021 by David Holz (co-founder of Leap Motion) with an 11-person team and no outside investment.
Holz chose Discord as the product vehicle: users type /imagine in a channel to trigger the model.
Midjourney v3 entered public beta in July 2022, followed by v5 in March 2023 (hand fixes), v6 in December 2023 (text rendering), v6.1 in August 2024, and v7 in April 2025.
In 2024 Midjourney posted $200 million ARR with a 5-person core team, $40 million per head.

events.title_zh: Stability AI Stable Diffusion 1.4:开源文生图爆发
events.title_en: Stability AI Stable Diffusion 1.4: Open Text-to-Image Era Begins
events.summary_zh:
2022 年 8 月 22 日,Stability AI 在 GitHub / HuggingFace 发布 Stable Diffusion 1.4 模型权重(CreativeML Open RAIL-M 许可)。
SD 1.4 用 Latent Diffusion(Rombach 2022 CVPR)+ CLIP text encoder,在 LAION-5B 子集上训练,512×512 图像生成,可在消费级 GPU(8GB VRAM)运行。
SD 1.4 上线 1 周内 HuggingFace 下载超 10 万次,2022-10 SD 1.5 改进版发布。
events.source_name: Rombach, R. et al. (2022) arXiv:2112.10752; Stability AI SD 1.4 release
events.card_summary_zh: Stable Diffusion 把高质量文生图模型开放给个人设备，生成图像第一次形成大规模民间创作生态。
events.summary_en: On August 22, 2022, Stability AI released the Stable Diffusion 1.4 model weights on GitHub / HuggingFace under the CreativeML Open RAIL-M license. Built on Latent Diffusion (Rombach 2022 CVPR) and a CLIP text encoder, SD 1.4 was trained on a subset of LAION-5B for 512×512 image generation and could run on consumer-grade GPUs with 8GB VRAM. Within one week of its launch, SD 1.4 surpassed 100,000 downloads on HuggingFace, followed by the release of the improved SD 1.5 in October 2022.
events.card_summary_en: Stable Diffusion opened high-quality text-to-image models up to personal devices, and image generation saw its first large-scale grassroots creation ecosystem.
events.why_it_matters_en:
Stable Diffusion was the starting point of open-source text-to-image generation, directly defining the open-source generative AI ecosystem from 2022 to 2025.
Following the line SD 1.4 (2022-08) → SD 2.0 (2022-11) → SDXL (2023-07) → SD3 (2024-06) → Flux (2024-08, Black Forest Labs), you can see why open-source generative AI exploded in 2022: open data (LAION-5B), open code (Latent Diffusion), and open weights (SD 1.4) all came together at once.
events.behind_scenes_en:
The SD project was developed from 2021 to 2022 by the LMU Munich / Runway / CompVis teams (Rombach, Blattmann), with Stability AI funding $6 million of training compute.
The SD paper, arXiv:2112.10752 'High-Resolution Image Synthesis with Latent Diffusion Models,' was published in April 2022.
After SD 1.4 went open source on August 22, 2022 came SD 1.5 in October 2022 (better faces), SD 2.0 in November 2022 (OpenCLIP, NSFW removal, 768x768), SDXL at 1024x1024 in July 2023, and SD3 (Flow Matching) in June 2024.
The SD open-source release directly fueled Midjourney's commercial competition, the Civitai LoRA ecosystem, and ControlNet 1.x.

events.title_zh: OpenAI Whisper:开源语音识别奠基
events.title_en: OpenAI Whisper: Open-Source Speech Recognition Foundation
events.summary_zh:
2022 年 9 月 21 日,OpenAI 在 arXiv:2212.04356 发表《Robust Speech Recognition via Large-Scale Weak Supervision》。
Whisper 用 68 万小时多语种音频训练(65% 英文 + 17% 非英文 + 18% 翻译对),Encoder-Decoder Transformer,在 0-shot 跨语种语音识别上接近监督 SOTA。
Whisper 模型权重开源( MIT 许可),tiny / base / small / medium / large 5 个版本。
events.source_name: Radford, A. et al. (2022) arXiv:2212.04356; Whisper GitHub
events.card_summary_zh: Whisper 以大规模多语言数据训练并开放权重，让可靠的语音识别与翻译迅速进入无数应用。
events.summary_en: On September 21, 2022, OpenAI published "Robust Speech Recognition via Large-Scale Weak Supervision" on arXiv:2212.04356. Trained on 680,000 hours of multilingual audio (65% English, 17% non-English, and 18% translation pairs), the Encoder-Decoder Transformer-based Whisper approached supervised SOTA in zero-shot cross-lingual speech recognition. Its model weights were open-sourced under the MIT license in five versions: tiny, base, small, medium, and large.
events.card_summary_en: Whisper was trained on massive multilingual data and released with open weights, quickly bringing reliable speech recognition and translation into countless applications.
events.why_it_matters_en:
Whisper laid the foundation of open-source speech recognition, directly defining the open-source speech stack from 2023 to 2025.
Following the line Whisper (2022-09) → Whisper Large v3 (2023-11) → SeamlessM4T (2023) → Voxtral (2025), you can see why every speech application in 2023, from captions to transcription, translation, and voice assistants, defaulted to Whisper.
events.behind_scenes_en:
Whisper's lead author was Alec Radford of the OpenAI team.
Whisper trained through 2021-2022 on data scraped from YouTube, podcasts, and multilingual audio, using weak supervision (automatic transcripts with imperfect labels).
The Whisper paper hit arXiv in September 2022 and was accepted at ICML in January 2023.
After open-sourcing, Whisper became the de facto standard for speech recognition in 2023: faster-whisper (CTranslate2 acceleration), whisper.cpp (C++ inference), WhisperX (word-level timestamps), and Whisper Large v3 (2023-11).
The Whisper line extended in 2024 toward Voxtral (2025) and SeamlessM4T (Meta, 2023).

events.title_zh: LangChain 开源:LLM 应用框架奠基
events.title_en: LangChain Open-Sourced: LLM Application Framework Foundation
events.summary_zh:
2022 年 10 月 20 日,Harrison Chase 在 GitHub 开源 LangChain v0.0.1。
LangChain 提供 Prompt 模板、Memory、Chains、Agents、Tools、VectorStores 抽象,让开发者用 Python / JS 构建端到端 LLM 应用。
LangChain 2023 年成 LLM 应用框架事实标准,2023-07 LangChain + LangSmith + LangServe 三件套,2024 年 ARR 5000 万美元,估值 11 亿美元。
events.source_name: Chase, H. (2022) LangChain v0.0.1 GitHub release
events.card_summary_zh: LangChain 把提示词、模型、记忆和外部工具连接成组件，大模型应用第一次拥有通用的开发脚手架。
events.summary_en: On October 20, 2022, Harrison Chase open-sourced LangChain v0.0.1 on GitHub, offering abstractions for Prompt templates, Memory, Chains, Agents, Tools, and VectorStores to let developers build end-to-end LLM applications using Python / JS. LangChain became the de facto standard LLM application framework in 2023—introducing its LangChain + LangSmith + LangServe trio in July 2023—before reaching a $50 million ARR and a $1.1 billion valuation in 2024.
events.card_summary_en: LangChain wired prompts, models, memory, and external tools together as components, giving LLM applications their first general-purpose development scaffold.
events.why_it_matters_en:
LangChain was the starting point of the LLM application framework, directly fueling the LLM application ecosystem of 2023-2025.
Following the line LangChain (2022-10) → LlamaIndex (2022-11) → AutoGen (2023-08) → CrewAI (2024-01) → LangGraph (2024-01) → MCP (2024-11), you can see LLM application frameworks evolve from Chains to Agents to Graphs to standard protocols.
events.behind_scenes_en:
LangChain was created in October 2022 by Harrison Chase, formerly an engineer at Robust Intelligence.
In September 2022, after seeing the Notion AI beta, Chase set out to build an application framework for LLMs.
After ChatGPT exploded in February 2023, LangChain's user base jumped from 1,000 to 50,000.
The LangChain route influenced LlamaIndex (2022-11), Semantic Kernel (2023-02, Microsoft), AutoGen (2023-08, Microsoft), and CrewAI (2024-01).
In 2024 LangChain drew criticism for over-abstraction and hard debugging, with LlamaIndex and DSPy partially displacing it.

events.title_zh: OpenAI ChatGPT:AI 的 iPhone 时刻
events.title_en: OpenAI ChatGPT: AI's iPhone Moment
events.summary_zh:
2022 年 11 月 30 日,OpenAI 在 blog 发布 ChatGPT(chat.openai.com),免费公测。
ChatGPT 基于 GPT-3.5(2020 年 GPT-3 + 2022 年 InstructGPT RLHF 微调),支持多轮对话、上下文记忆、代码生成、写作、翻译。
5 天用户破 100 万(史上最快),2 个月 MAU 1 亿(TikTok 9 个月、Instagram 2.5 年),2023-01 月估值 290 亿美元,2023-04 ChatGPT Plus 上线,2024 年 ARR 超 30 亿美元。
events.source_name: OpenAI (2022-11-30) ChatGPT launch blog
events.card_summary_zh: ChatGPT 把大模型从实验室带进日常对话，五天吸引百万用户，也让生成式 AI 成为全球公众议题。
events.summary_en: On November 30, 2022, OpenAI released ChatGPT (chat.openai.com) on its blog for a free public beta. Powered by GPT-3.5 (combining 2020's GPT-3 and 2022's InstructGPT RLHF fine-tuning), the chatbot supports multi-turn conversation, contextual memory, code generation, writing, and translation. It quickly became the fastest-growing service in history, hitting 1 million users in 5 days and 100 million MAUs in 2 months (compared to TikTok's 9 months and Instagram's 2.5 years), leading to a $29 billion valuation in January 2023, the launch of ChatGPT Plus in April 2023, and an ARR exceeding $3 billion by 2024.
events.card_summary_en: ChatGPT carried large models out of the lab and into everyday conversation, drawing a million users in five days and turning generative AI into a global public issue.
events.why_it_matters_en:
ChatGPT was the consumer zero-moment of the LLM era, defining the shape of every AI product from 2023 to 2025.
Following the line ChatGPT (2022-11) → GPT-4 (2023-03) → Claude (2023-03) → Llama 2 (2023-07) → GPT-4o (2024-05) → o1 (2024-09) → DeepSeek-R1 (2025-01) → GPT-5 (2025-08), you can see that after 2023 the history of AI became the history of LLM commercialization and capability upgrades.
events.behind_scenes_en:
The ChatGPT project was led in November 2022 by OpenAI's John Schulman and Luke Metz.
Altman tweeted 'today we launched ChatGPT' on November 30, 2022; internal expectations were 1 million users in a year, and it took five days.
Before launch there was internal debate at OpenAI: GPT-3.5 + RLHF was already mature but unshipped, and Schulman pushed the release through.
ChatGPT directly triggered Bing Chat in February 2023, Claude in March 2023, Bard in March 2023, Llama 2 in July 2023, GPT-4o in May 2024, o1 in September 2024, and DeepSeek-R1 in January 2025.

events.title_zh: ElevenLabs 推出商业化语音合成
events.title_en: ElevenLabs Commercial Speech Synthesis Launch
events.summary_zh:
2023 年 1 月 23 日,ElevenLabs 公测语音合成平台 Beta。
ElevenLabs 用 60 秒参考音频克隆任意说话人音色,生成接近真人的多语种语音。
2023-01 Beta 上线后,语音合成质量超过 Google Wavenet、Amazon Polly、Microsoft Azure TTS。
ElevenLabs 支持 29 种语言,1 分钟参考音频即可克隆音色,5 分钟参考音频达到声音难以区分。
events.source_name: ElevenLabs (2023-01-23) Beta launch; TechCrunch coverage
events.card_summary_zh: ElevenLabs 用高度自然、可克隆的声音降低语音生成门槛，也同步放大了配音创作与身份冒用的争议。
events.summary_en: On January 23, 2023, ElevenLabs launched the public beta of its speech synthesis platform, cloning any speaker's voice with just 60 seconds of reference audio to generate near-human, multilingual speech. Following its January 2023 launch, the platform's synthesis quality surpassed Google Wavenet, Amazon Polly, and Microsoft Azure TTS. Supporting 29 languages, ElevenLabs can clone a voice with a 1-minute reference sample, making the voice virtually indistinguishable with 5 minutes of audio.
events.card_summary_en: ElevenLabs lowered the barrier to voice generation with highly natural, cloneable voices while simultaneously amplifying the controversies over voice-over work and identity misuse.
events.why_it_matters_en:
ElevenLabs was the starting point of commercialized speech synthesis, defining the shape of every TTS product from 2023 to 2025.
Following the line ElevenLabs (2023-01) → Whisper (2023, open-source ecosystem) → Cartesia (2024) → Hume AI (2024), you can see how speech applications after 2023 moved from intelligible to indistinguishable-from-human.
events.behind_scenes_en:
ElevenLabs was founded in 2022 by Piotr Dąbkowski, a former Google Machine Intelligence researcher, and Mati Staniszewski, a former Palantir strategist.
The company's core idea: speech synthesis should solve emotion and prosody rather than mere clarity, so it trained on audiobook and podcast material rich in long context and emotional range.
The ElevenLabs timeline: Beta in January 2023 → Voice Cloning in April 2023 → Voice Design in January 2024 → Dubbing in August 2024 → Conversational AI in January 2025.
Competitors: Play.ht, Resemble AI, Hume AI, Cartesia (2024).

events.title_zh: 微软 Bing Chat:GPT-4 进入搜索引擎
events.title_en: Microsoft Bing Chat: GPT-4 in Search Engine
events.summary_zh:
2023 年 2 月 7 日,微软在 Redmond 发布 Bing Chat(新版 Bing + Edge),集成 GPT-4(内部代号 Sydney)。
Bing Chat 把 LLM 接入搜索引擎,用户问题先由 LLM 答 + 引用网页,再列出搜索结果。
Bing Chat 上线 48 小时内 waitlist 排到 100 万人,2 个月内 1 亿次对话。
微软 2023-03 把 Bing Chat 嵌入 Windows 11 任务栏,2023-07 改名 Microsoft Copilot。
events.source_name: Microsoft (2023-02-07) Bing Chat launch; The Verge coverage
events.card_summary_zh: Bing Chat 把 GPT-4 式对话接入搜索，传统的关键词与链接列表第一次被生成式回答正面挑战。
events.summary_en: On February 7, 2023, Microsoft launched Bing Chat (the new Bing + Edge) in Redmond, integrating GPT-4 (internally codenamed Sydney) to connect an LLM to its search engine so user queries are first answered by the LLM with web citations before search results are listed. The service saw its waitlist swell to 1 million people within 48 hours of launch and reached 100 million conversations within two months. Microsoft embedded Bing Chat into the Windows 11 taskbar in March 2023, before rebranding it as Microsoft Copilot in July 2023.
events.card_summary_en: Bing Chat wired GPT-4-style conversation into search, and for the first time the keyword-plus-link-list format faced a head-on challenge from generated answers.
events.why_it_matters_en:
Bing Chat was the starting point of LLMs entering mainstream application gateways, directly spawning every Copilot-class product from 2023 to 2025.
Following the line Bing Chat (2023-02) → Copilot (2023-03) → Microsoft 365 Copilot (2023-03) → GitHub Copilot X (2023-03) → Windows Copilot (2023-09), you can see how Microsoft used its OpenAI capital plus GPT to storm Google's search gateway.
events.behind_scenes_en:
Microsoft invested $1 billion in OpenAI in July 2019 and added $10 billion in January 2023 (at a $29 billion valuation).
Bing Chat was the first product payoff of that investment.
In its first week Bing Chat produced waves of 'Sydney confession' and user-threatening incidents, and on February 17, 2023 Microsoft urgently capped conversations at 5 turns per session.
In a February 7, 2023 interview with The Verge, Satya Nadella said he wanted to make Google dance, openly igniting the search-engine war.
Google rushed Bard out in response on February 6, 2023, but Bard answered the JWST question wrong and its stock fell 9%.

events.title_zh: Meta LLaMA 泄露:开源大模型起点
events.title_en: Meta LLaMA Leak: Open-Source LLM Beginning
events.summary_zh:
2023 年 2 月 24 日,Meta AI 在 arXiv:2302.13971 发布《LLaMA: Open and Efficient Foundation Language Models》。
LLaMA 包括 7B/13B/33B/65B 四档,训练数据 1.4T tokens(Common Crawl + Wikipedia + Github + Books)。
LLaMA 论文宣称「研究专用」,权重需申请。
但 2023-03-03 权重通过 4chan 泄露到 GitHub,3 天内遍布 BitTorrent。
开源社区立刻基于 LLaMA 衍生:Alpaca(Stanford,$600 微调)、Vicuna(LMSYS)、WizardLM、Guanaco、ChatLLaMA。
events.source_name: Touvron, H. et al. (2023) arXiv:2302.13971; Meta AI blog
events.card_summary_zh: LLaMA 权重意外流入网络后迅速被社区改造，本地运行和开放大模型生态由此加速形成。
events.summary_en: On February 24, 2023, Meta AI published "LLaMA: Open and Efficient Foundation Language Models" on arXiv:2302.13971, featuring 7B/13B/33B/65B models trained on 1.4T tokens (Common Crawl + Wikipedia + GitHub + Books). Although the paper claimed LLaMA was for "research only" with weights requiring an application, the weights were leaked via 4chan to GitHub on March 3, 2023, spreading across BitTorrent within three days. The open-source community immediately began building LLaMA-based derivatives, including Alpaca (Stanford, $600 fine-tuning), Vicuna (LMSYS), WizardLM, Guanaco, and ChatLLaMA.
events.card_summary_en: After LLaMA's weights unexpectedly flowed onto the internet, the community reshaped them rapidly, accelerating local inference and the open large-model ecosystem.
events.why_it_matters_en:
The LLaMA leak was the starting point of the open-source LLM era.
Following the line LLaMA leak (2023-02-24) → Alpaca (2023-03) → Vicuna (2023-03) → Llama 2 (2023-07) → Mistral 7B (2023-09) → Llama 3 (2024-04) → DeepSeek-R1 (2025-01), you can see why open-source LLMs suddenly exploded in 2023, and why Meta treats openness as its core strategy against OpenAI/Google.
events.behind_scenes_en:
LLaMA was driven by Meta AI's Yann LeCun, Guillaume Lample, and Hugo Touvron.
Meta's internal investment in LLMs in 2022 ran far below Google/DeepMind's; LLaMA was Meta's lowest-cost catch-up play on the LLM battlefield.
When LLaMA leaked, anger flared inside Meta at first, but LeCun publicly stated that the leak was a good thing and openness accelerates innovation.
On July 18, 2023 Meta released Llama 2 under a commercial license, formally pivoting from research to open-source business.
The LLaMA line: LLaMA (2023-02) → Llama 2 (2023-07) → Code Llama (2023-08) → Llama 3 (2024-04) → Llama 3.1 405B (2024-07) → Llama 4 (2025-04).

events.title_zh: 智谱 ChatGLM 发布——国产大模型学术路线代表
events.title_en: Zhipu ChatGLM Released
events.summary_zh: 2023 年 3 月，智谱 AI 发布 ChatGLM——基于清华唐杰团队 GLM 架构的双向注意力大模型。与当时主流的 GPT 单向注意力不同，GLM 采用了创新的双向注意力设计。ChatGLM-6B 以 62 亿参数在开源社区迅速走红。
events.source_name: 公开资料
events.card_summary_zh: 智谱 AI 发布 ChatGLM——基于清华唐杰团队 GLM 架构的双向注意力大模型；ChatGLM 是国产大模型中少有的走自主架构路线的代表。
events.summary_en: In March 2023, Zhipu AI released ChatGLM, a bidirectional attention large model based on the GLM architecture developed by Tang Jie's team at Tsinghua University. Unlike the unidirectional attention of the mainstream GPT models at the time, GLM adopted an innovative bidirectional attention design. ChatGLM-6B, featuring 6.2 billion parameters, quickly went viral in the open-source community.
events.card_summary_en: Zhipu AI released ChatGLM, a bidirectional-attention large model built on the GLM architecture of Tsinghua professor Tang Jie's team; ChatGLM is one of the few Chinese large models taking an independent architecture route.
events.why_it_matters_en: ChatGLM stands out among Chinese large models as one of the few built on its own architecture. While most Chinese LLM companies chose to follow the GPT architecture, GLM proved that Chinese teams could do original work at the level of model architecture itself.
events.behind_scenes_en: Zhipu AI is a textbook case of transferring Tsinghua research into a company: Professor Tang Jie's GLM papers directly gave birth to the ChatGLM product. GLM's bidirectional attention design gives it unique advantages on tasks that require two-way understanding.

events.title_zh: Anthropic Claude 1 发布:Anthropic 商业化起点
events.title_en: Anthropic Claude 1 Launch: Anthropic Commercialization Begins
events.summary_zh:
2023 年 3 月 14 日,Anthropic 发布 Claude 1(同年 GPT-4 同日发布)。
Claude 1 上下文 9K,在 Cohere 多项任务上接近 GPT-3.5。
Claude 1 强调 Constitutional AI(AI 通过「宪法」原则自我修正),避免 GPT 的 RLHF 失控。
Claude 1 商用 API 2023-03-14,2023-07-11 Claude 2(100K 上下文,首次突破 LLM 上下文上限)。
Claude 路线:Claude 1(2023-03) → Claude 2(2023-07) → Claude Instant(2023-08) → Claude 3(2024-03) → Claude 3.5 Sonnet(2024-06) → Claude 3.5 Sonnet v2(2024-10) → Claude 3.7 Sonnet(2025-02) → Claude 4 Opus(2025-05)。
events.source_name: Anthropic (2023-03-14) Claude launch; Constitutional AI paper
events.card_summary_zh: Claude 以宪法式 AI 和更谨慎的交互进入市场，前 OpenAI 团队正式建立另一条前沿模型路线。
events.summary_en: On March 14, 2023, Anthropic released Claude 1 (the same day GPT-4 debuted), featuring a 9K context window, approaching GPT-3.5 on multiple Cohere tasks, and emphasizing "Constitutional AI" (AI self-correction via "constitutional" principles) to avoid GPT's runaway RLHF issues. Following its commercial API launch on 2023-03-14, Claude 2 arrived on 2023-07-11 with a 100K context window, breaking the LLM context limit for the first time. This established Anthropic’s product roadmap: Claude 1 (2023-03) → Claude 2 (2023-07) → Claude Instant (2023-08) → Claude 3 (2024-03) → Claude 3.5 Sonnet (2024-06) → Claude 3.5 Sonnet v2 (2024-10) → Claude 3.7 Sonnet (2025-02) → Claude 4 Opus (2025-05).
events.card_summary_en: Claude entered the market with constitutional AI and more cautious interactions, as the former OpenAI team formally established a second frontier-model route.
events.why_it_matters_en:
Claude became OpenAI's core rival in LLM commercialization and defined the safety-first LLM route from 2023 to 2025.
Following the line Claude 1 (2023-03) → Claude 2 100K (2023-07) → Claude 3 (2024-03) → Claude 3.5 Sonnet (2024-06, first to overtake GPT-4o) → Claude 3.5 Sonnet v2 (2024-10, first to beat o1 at coding) → Claude 4 Opus (2025-05) → Claude Opus 4.8 (2026-05), you can see how Anthropic gradually overtook OpenAI from mid-2024 onward.
events.behind_scenes_en:
Anthropic was founded in 2021 by former OpenAI VP of Research Dario Amodei and Daniela Amodei; its Series C in May 2023 raised $450 million at a $5 billion valuation, and in March 2024 Google put in $2 billion alongside Amazon's $4 billion.
The name Claude honors Claude Shannon, the founder of information theory.
The Constitutional AI paper was led by Yuntao Bai in December 2022.
The key difference between Claude's route and OpenAI's: Anthropic puts AI safety first, shipping Claude 1 with a constitution built in, avoiding the kind of post-RLHF lapses that GPT-4 could still exhibit.

events.title_zh: OpenAI GPT-4 发布:多模态 + 推理提升
events.title_en: OpenAI GPT-4 Release: Multimodal + Reasoning
events.summary_zh:
2023 年 3 月 14 日,OpenAI 发布 GPT-4(内部代号 GPT-4-base + GPT-4-turbo)。
GPT-4 在 MMLU 86.4%(GPT-3.5 70.0%)、HumanEval 67%、GSM8K 92%。
GPT-4 支持图像输入(GPT-4V),32K 上下文(后续 128K)。
GPT-4 在律师资格考试 BAR 上前 10%,在 SAT 1410/1600,在 AP 考试多门 5 分。
GPT-4 API 2023-03-14 waitlist,2023-07-06 全面开放。
GPT-4 是 2023 年所有前沿模型的基准线。
events.source_name: OpenAI (2023-03-14) GPT-4 Release blog; GPT-4 Technical Report
events.card_summary_zh: OpenAI 发布 GPT-4(内部代号 GPT-4-base + GPT-4-turbo)；GPT-4 是 LLM 进入主流生产力工具的起点。
events.summary_en: On March 14, 2023, OpenAI released GPT-4 (internally codenamed GPT-4-base + GPT-4-turbo), which became the benchmark for all frontier models in 2023. The model featured image input (GPT-4V) and a 32K context window (later 128K), scoring 86.4% on MMLU (vs. GPT-3.5's 70.0%), 67% on HumanEval, and 92% on GSM8K, while placing in the top 10% on the BAR, scoring 1410/1600 on the SAT, and earning a 5 on multiple AP exams. Its API launched with a waitlist on March 14, 2023, and was fully opened on July 6, 2023.
events.card_summary_en: OpenAI released GPT-4 (internal codenames GPT-4-base + GPT-4-turbo); GPT-4 was the point where LLMs entered mainstream productivity tools.
events.why_it_matters_en:
GPT-4 was the point where LLMs entered mainstream productivity tools.
Following the line GPT-4 (2023-03) → Claude 2 (2023-07) → Gemini 1.0 (2023-12) → Claude 3 (2024-03) → GPT-4o (2024-05) → o1 (2024-09) → GPT-5 (2025-08), you can see that after 2023 every AI company's baseline became beating GPT-4.
events.behind_scenes_en:
GPT-4 was driven by OpenAI's Sam Altman, Greg Brockman, Jakub Pachocki, Mark Chen, and Sandhini Agarwal.
GPT-4 trained for 100 days on 25,000 A100s at a cost of roughly $100 million.
GPT-4's bar-exam scores were deliberately played down: OpenAI feared losing control of the AI-lawyer narrative.
The GPT-4 paper disclosed no parameter count (estimated 1.8T MoE), fueling the controversy that OpenAI no longer opens up.
The GPT-4 line: GPT-4 (2023-03) → GPT-4 Turbo (2023-11) → GPT-4o (2024-05) → GPT-4.5 (2025-02) → GPT-5 (2025-08).

events.title_zh: GPT-4 系统卡:前沿模型透明度范式
events.title_en: GPT-4 System Card: Frontier Model Transparency Paradigm
events.summary_zh:
2023 年 3 月 14 日,OpenAI 与 GPT-4 同步发布《GPT-4 System Card》(60 页)。
System Card 详述 GPT-4 的预训练、RLHF、红队测试、危险能力评估(生化武器、网络攻击、社会工程、自主复制)。
System Card 把「前沿模型透明度」变成行业标准,后续 Claude 3、Gemini 1.5、Llama 3、DeepSeek-R1 都发布 System Card。
events.source_name: OpenAI (2023-03-14) GPT-4 System Card
events.card_summary_zh: OpenAI 与 GPT-4 同步发布《GPT-4 System Card》(60 页)；System Card 是 LLM 安全透明度的范式起点。
events.summary_en: On March 14, 2023, OpenAI launched its 60-page *GPT-4 System Card* alongside the model's debut, detailing its pre-training, RLHF, red teaming, and evaluations of dangerous capabilities like biological weapons, cyberattacks, social engineering, and autonomous replication. The document effectively turned "frontier model transparency" into an industry standard, with Claude 3, Gemini 1.5, Llama 3, and DeepSeek-R1 all following suit with their own System Cards.
events.card_summary_en: Together with GPT-4, OpenAI published the 60-page GPT-4 System Card; the System Card was the starting point of the transparency paradigm for LLM safety.
events.why_it_matters_en:
The System Card was the starting point of the transparency paradigm for LLM safety.
Following the line GPT-4 System Card (2023-03) → Claude 3 System Card (2024-03) → Gemini 1.5 System Card (2024-05) → Llama 3 System Card (2024-07) → DeepSeek-R1 (2025-01), you can see where the dangerous-capability disclosures that every frontier model must now produce after 2023 came from.
events.behind_scenes_en:
The System Card concept was pioneered by Anthropic's Claude 1 Model Card in September 2022; OpenAI borrowed it and extended it to dangerous-capability evaluation.
Red-teaming for the GPT-4 System Card included Arc-AGI, METR, Apollo Research, and CSET Georgetown.
The System Card revealed GPT-4's dangerous-capability threshold: within six months no instance of GPT-4 independently completing biological-weapon production had been found.
The System Card later became one of the commitments underpinning the Frontier Model Forum, founded in July 2023.

events.title_zh: 百度文心一言:中国大模型产品化第一波
events.title_en: Baidu ERNIE Bot: China's First Wave of LLM Products
events.summary_zh:
2023 年 3 月 16 日,百度在北京总部发布文心一言(ERNIE Bot)。
文心一言基于 ERNIE 3.0+,支持文本、图像、代码生成。
文心一言发布演示为「录播」(预录视频),Robin Li 解释「出于安全考虑」。
文心一言 2023-08-31 公测,2023 年底 MAU 1.3 亿。
文心一言后,2023-03-阿里通义千问、2023-08-华为盘古、2023-10-讯飞星火、2023-10-智谱 ChatGLM 接连发布。
events.source_name: 百度 (2023-03-16) 文心一言发布会
events.card_summary_zh: 文心一言成为中国大型科技公司首批公开的大模型产品，国内模型竞争由研究储备转向公开交付。
events.summary_en: On March 16, 2023, Baidu unveiled ERNIE Bot—an ERNIE 3.0+-based model supporting text, image, and code generation—at its Beijing headquarters, opting for a pre-recorded demonstration that Robin Li explained was "for safety reasons." Following ERNIE Bot’s debut, a wave of competitors rolled out, including Alibaba’s Tongyi Qianwen in March 2023, Huawei’s Pangu in August 2023, and both iFlytek’s Spark and Zhipu AI’s ChatGLM in October 2023; ERNIE Bot itself entered public testing on August 31, 2023, reaching an MAU of 130 million by the end of the year.
events.card_summary_en: ERNIE Bot became one of the first publicly announced large-model products from China's big tech companies, shifting domestic model competition from research stockpiles to public delivery.
events.why_it_matters_en:
ERNIE Bot was the starting point of Chinese large-model productization, directly defining China's LLM competitive landscape from 2023 to 2025.
Following the line ERNIE Bot (2023-03) → Tongyi Qianwen (2023-08) → Qwen 2 (2024-06) → DeepSeek-V2 (2024-05) → Kimi K1.5 (2024-10) → DeepSeek-R1 (2025-01), you can see how Chinese LLMs achieved their global breakthrough with DeepSeek-R1 in January 2025.
events.behind_scenes_en:
ERNIE Bot was led by Baidu CTO Haifeng Wang and Wu Hua's team.
Baidu released ERNIE 2.0 in 2019, ERNIE 3.0 Titan at 260B in 2021, and the ERNIE large-model family spanning NLP/CV/cross-modal in 2022.
One month before the launch, Robin Li told Baidu internally that they could not wait any longer: GPT-4 would ship in March and Baidu had to have a product.
The pre-recorded demo sent the stock down 6.4%, but reputation recovered after the August 2023 public beta.
China's LLM lineup: ERNIE Bot (2023-03) → Tongyi Qianwen (2023-08) → Spark (2023-05) → ChatGLM (2023-10) → DeepSeek-V2 (2024-05) → Kimi (2024-03) → DeepSeek-R1 (2025-01).

events.title_zh: OpenAI Evals 开源:LLM 评测框架标准化
events.title_en: OpenAI Evals Open-Sourced: LLM Evaluation Framework Standardization
events.summary_zh:
2023 年 3 月 23 日,OpenAI 在 GitHub 开源 Evals(框架用于评估 LLM)。
Evals 定义标准化评测协议:任务定义、prompt、参考答案、评分函数、数据集。
Evals 内置 MMLU、HellaSwag、GSM8K、HumanEval、TruthfulQA 等。
Evals 开源后 lm-evaluation-harness(EleutherAI)、lighteval(HuggingFace)、OpenCompass(上海AI实验室) 都基于其协议。
events.source_name: OpenAI (2023-03-23) Evals GitHub
events.card_summary_zh: OpenAI 在 GitHub 开源 Evals(框架用于评估 LLM)；Evals 是 LLM 评测标准化的起点。
events.summary_en: On March 23, 2023, OpenAI open-sourced Evals on GitHub, a framework for evaluating LLMs that defines a standardized protocol covering task definitions, prompts, reference answers, grading functions, and datasets. Featuring built-in benchmarks including MMLU, HellaSwag, GSM8K, HumanEval, and TruthfulQA, the release prompted EleutherAI's lm-evaluation-harness, HuggingFace's lighteval, and the Shanghai AI Laboratory's OpenCompass to base their own protocols on it.
events.card_summary_en: OpenAI open-sourced Evals on GitHub, a framework for evaluating LLMs; Evals was the starting point of standardized LLM evaluation.
events.why_it_matters_en:
Evals was the starting point of standardized LLM evaluation.
Following the line Evals (2023-03) → lm-eval-harness (2023-06) → MT-Bench (2023-06) → ChatBot Arena (2023-05) → OpenCompass (2023-08), you can see where the frameworks behind all the LLM leaderboards of 2023-2024 came from.
events.behind_scenes_en:
The Evals project was led by Tarun Gogineni and Andrea Soto on OpenAI's applied science team.
OpenAI's real motive for pushing Evals: GPT-4 API customers needed standardized evaluation to make decisions, and customer-defined evals made unified comparison impossible.
Evals collected 8K stars within a month of open-sourcing, but the community found it biased toward GPT-4, so EleutherAI launched lm-eval-harness as a neutral alternative.

events.title_zh: AutoGPT 引爆自主 Agent 开源热潮
events.title_en: AutoGPT Sparks Open-Source Autonomous Agent Trend
events.summary_zh:
2023 年 3 月 30 日,开发者 Toran Bruce Richards 在 GitHub 开源 AutoGPT。
AutoGPT 用 GPT-4 + Pinecone 做「目标驱动自主 Agent」:用户输入目标(如「研究并写一份量子计算报告」),AutoGPT 自动拆解、调用搜索、保存到 Pinecone、迭代生成。
AutoGPT 上线 7 天 GitHub stars 破 5 万,30 天破 10 万,2023 年 GitHub 第一热门仓库。
events.source_name: Richards, T. B. (2023-03-30) AutoGPT GitHub
events.card_summary_zh: AutoGPT 把“给模型一个目标，让它自己拆解并调用工具”变成开源实验，Agent 热潮由此爆发。
events.summary_en: On March 30, 2023, developer Toran Bruce Richards open-sourced AutoGPT on GitHub. Utilizing GPT-4 and Pinecone to power a "goal-driven autonomous agent," the system takes a user-input goal (such as "research and write a report on quantum computing") and automatically breaks it down, executes searches, saves to Pinecone, and iteratively generates the output. AutoGPT surpassed 50,000 GitHub stars within 7 days of launch and topped 100,000 within 30 days, becoming the most popular repository on GitHub in 2023.
events.card_summary_en: AutoGPT turned 'give the model a goal and let it decompose tasks and call tools itself' into an open-source experiment, and the agent craze erupted from there.
events.why_it_matters_en:
AutoGPT was the starting point of the LLM agent wave.
Following the line AutoGPT (2023-03) → BabyAGI (2023-04) → MetaGPT (2023-06) → AutoGen (2023-09) → CrewAI (2024-01) → Devin (2024-03) → Claude Computer Use (2024-10) → Hermes (2026), you can see how autonomous agents went from open-source toys in 2023 to production-grade coding agents in 2025.
events.behind_scenes_en:
AutoGPT started as a weekend project by Toran Bruce Richards (aka Significant Gravitas) on March 30, 2023, essentially casting GPT-4 as reasoner + planner + actor.
Its actual performance was limited: goal loops stalled, context exploded, and final output quality was poor.
But it ignited the agent narrative and spawned BabyAGI (Yohei Nakajima), AgentGPT, MetaGPT, CrewAI, AutoGen (Microsoft), and LangChain agents.
AutoGPT marked the start of 2023 as the year one of agents.

events.title_zh: DPO 论文:RLHF 替代方案
events.title_en: DPO Paper: RLHF Alternative
events.summary_zh:
2023 年 5 月 26 日,斯坦福 + CMU + Berkeley 在 arXiv:2305.18290 发表《Direct Preference Optimization》。
DPO 把 RLHF 从「训练 reward model + PPO 强化学习」简化为「直接用偏好数据微调 LLM」一步。
DPO 训练成本是 PPO 的 1/10,稳定性更高,质量接近。
DPO 后被 Llama 2 Chat、Mistral Instruct、Zephyr、Qwen 2 Instruct、DeepSeek-R1 全部采用。
events.source_name: Rafailov, R. et al. (2023) arXiv:2305.18290; NeurIPS 2023
events.card_summary_zh: DPO 绕过复杂的奖励模型训练，直接从偏好数据优化语言模型，让对齐训练变得更简单、更普及。
events.summary_en: On May 26, 2023, Stanford, CMU, and Berkeley published "Direct Preference Optimization" on arXiv:2305.18290, simplifying RLHF from training a reward model and PPO reinforcement learning into a single step of directly fine-tuning the LLM with preference data. At just 1/10 the training cost of PPO, DPO offers higher stability and comparable quality. The breakthrough was later adopted by Llama 2 Chat, Mistral Instruct, Zephyr, Qwen 2 Instruct, and DeepSeek-R1.
events.card_summary_en: DPO bypasses complex reward-model training and optimizes language models directly from preference data, making alignment training simpler and more widespread.
events.why_it_matters_en:
DPO was a key milestone in standardizing the LLM training pipeline, letting small teams train instruct models too.
Following the line DPO (2023-05) → Zephyr 7B (2023-10, a 7B model trained with DPO that surpassed GPT-3.5) → Llama 2 Chat (2023-07, used PPO but referenced DPO) → Llama 3 Instruct (2024-04, switched to DPO) → DeepSeek-R1 (2025-01, GRPO generalizes DPO), you can see why open-source instruct models suddenly exploded after 2023.
events.behind_scenes_en:
DPO's lead author was Rafael Rafailov (Stanford), advised by Chelsea Finn.
The core mathematical derivation was done by Tianhe Gao.
The DPO paper was accepted at NeurIPS 2023 and drew 500+ citations within two months.
DPO spin-offs: IPO (identity preference optimization), KTO (Kahneman-Tversky optimization), SimPO (simple preference optimization), ORPO (2024).
The DPO line: DPO (2023-05) → Zephyr 7B (2023-10) → SLiC-HF (2023) → ORPO (2024) → SimPO (2024).

events.title_zh: Meta Llama 2 商用开源:开源 LLM 商业化起点
events.title_en: Meta Llama 2 Commercial Open-Source: Open-Source LLM Commercialization Begins
events.summary_zh:
2023 年 7 月 18 日,Meta 在 arXiv:2307.09288 发布《Llama 2: Open Foundation and Fine-Tuned Chat Models》。
Llama 2 包括 7B/13B/70B,4K 上下文,商用许可(月活 7 亿以下免费)。
Llama 2-Chat 用 RLHF + Safety RLHF + Red Teaming 训练。
Llama 2 上线 1 周下载量 100 万次,3 个月内 AWS、Azure、Google Cloud、AWS Bedrock 全部上架。
events.source_name: Touvron, H. et al. (2023) arXiv:2307.09288; Meta blog
events.card_summary_zh: Llama 2 允许广泛商业使用，开放模型第一次成为企业可以认真部署的主流选择。
events.summary_en: On July 18, 2023, Meta published "Llama 2: Open Foundation and Fine-Tuned Chat Models" on arXiv:2307.09288, offering 7B/13B/70B models with a 4K context window under a commercial license free for under 700 million monthly active users. Its dialogue-tuned counterpart, Llama 2-Chat, was trained using RLHF, Safety RLHF, and red teaming. Llama 2 racked up 1 million downloads in its first week of launch and was deployed on AWS, Azure, Google Cloud, and AWS Bedrock within three months.
events.card_summary_en: Llama 2 allowed broad commercial use, and for the first time an openly available model became a mainstream option that enterprises could seriously deploy.
events.why_it_matters_en:
Llama 2 was the zero-moment of commercially viable open-source LLMs, directly defining open-source LLM business models from 2023 to 2025.
Following the line Llama 2 (2023-07) → Mistral 7B (2023-09) → Mixtral 8x7B (2023-12) → Llama 3 (2024-04) → Llama 3.1 405B (2024-07) → DeepSeek-V2 (2024-05) → DeepSeek-R1 (2025-01), you can see why open-source LLMs suddenly became a commercially viable proposition in 2023.
events.behind_scenes_en:
Llama 2 was driven by Meta FAIR's Hugo Touvron, Thibaut Lavril, and Guillaume Lample.
In April 2023 Meta decided internally to commercialize LLaMA. Main motives: 1) after the leak the open-source ecosystem flourished and Meta wanted to enter formally; 2) to counter the closed monopolies of OpenAI/Google; 3) Meta does not depend on LLM revenue, so it could afford the cost of openness.
License terms: companies with over 700 million monthly active users need separate approval; in practice 99% of companies use it free.
The Llama 2 line: Llama 2 (2023-07) → Code Llama (2023-08) → Llama 2 Long (2023-09) → Llama 3 (2024-04) → Llama 3.1 405B (2024-07) → Llama 4 (2025-04).

events.title_zh: 字节跳动豆包上线——国内 DAU 增长最快的大模型产品
events.title_en: ByteDance Doubao Released
events.summary_zh: 2023 年 8 月，字节跳动推出豆包（Doubao）大模型产品。背靠字节的推荐算法和流量优势，豆包在国内大模型产品中用户量增长最快。字节还通过火山引擎提供豆包 API 服务，并推出了扣子（Coze）等 AI 应用开发平台。
events.source_name: 公开资料
events.card_summary_zh: 字节还通过火山引擎提供豆包 API 服务，并推出了扣子（Coze）等 AI 应用开发平台；豆包证明了大模型产品化能力在中国市场的重要性。
events.summary_en: In August 2023, ByteDance launched its Doubao large model product, which quickly achieved the fastest user growth among domestic AI models by leveraging the company's recommendation algorithms and massive traffic. ByteDance also began offering the Doubao API through Volcano Engine and rolled out AI application development platforms like Coze.
events.card_summary_en: ByteDance also offers Doubao API services through Volcano Engine and has launched AI app development platforms such as Coze; Doubao proved how important productization capability is for large models in the Chinese market.
events.why_it_matters_en: Doubao proved the importance of productization capability for large models in the Chinese market. ByteDance's traffic-distribution strength and product-polishing experience kept Doubao ahead of most domestic LLM products in user scale and retention.
events.behind_scenes_en: ByteDance pursued multiple technical routes in parallel on large models internally. Beyond Doubao, ByteDance also launched several other AI products covering content creation, image generation, coding assistants, and other scenarios. Volcano Engine's API service made Doubao's API pricing competitive within the industry.

events.title_zh: 阿里通义千问开源:中国开源 LLM 旗舰起点
events.title_en: Alibaba Qwen Open-Source: China's Open-Source LLM Flagship Begins
