events.summary_zh:
2023 年 8 月 3 日,阿里云发布通义千问 Qwen-7B(2023-09-25 开源)。
Qwen-7B 在 C-Eval、MMLU、HumanEval 多项中文评测上超过 Llama 2 7B。
Qwen 后续路线:Qwen-7B(2023-08) → Qwen-14B(2023-09) → Qwen-72B(2023-12) → Qwen 1.5(2024-02) → Qwen 2(2024-06) → Qwen 2.5(2024-09) → Qwen 3(2025-04)。
events.source_name: Bai, J. et al. (2023) Qwen Technical Report; arXiv:2309.16609
events.card_summary_zh: 通义千问开放模型与代码，中国大模型第一次形成持续迭代并面向全球开发者的开源主线。
events.summary_en: On August 3, 2023, Alibaba Cloud released Tongyi Qianwen Qwen-7B (open-sourced on September 25, 2023), which outperformed Llama 2 7B on multiple Chinese benchmarks including C-Eval, MMLU, and HumanEval. The subsequent Qwen roadmap progressed as follows: Qwen-7B (2023-08) → Qwen-14B (2023-09) → Qwen-72B (2023-12) → Qwen 1.5 (2024-02) → Qwen 2 (2024-06) → Qwen 2.5 (2024-09) → Qwen 3 (2025-04).
events.card_summary_en: Qwen opened its models and code, and for the first time a Chinese large model formed a continuously iterating open-source mainline aimed at developers worldwide.
events.why_it_matters_en:
Tongyi Qianwen is China's flagship open-source LLM, repeatedly topping HuggingFace charts across 2024-2025.
Following the line Qwen-7B (2023-08) → Qwen 72B (2023-12) → Qwen 2 (2024-06) → Qwen 2.5 (2024-09, surpassing Llama 3.1) → Qwen 3 (2025-04), you can see how Chinese open-source LLMs moved from catching up to leading through 2024-2025.
events.behind_scenes_en:
Qwen is led by Jingren Zhou and Junyang Lin's team at Alibaba Cloud.
Alibaba put 1 billion RMB into LLM training resources in 2023.
Qwen's open-source strategy matches Llama 2's: commercial license plus no forced open-sourcing of derivatives.
Key innovations along the Qwen line: Qwen 2 MoE (2024-06), Qwen 2.5 Coder (2024-09, overtaking GPT-4o at coding), Qwen 2.5 Math (2024-08), Qwen-VL (2023-08), and Qwen 3 (2025-04, a 32B reasoning model).

events.title_zh: Meta Code Llama:开源代码 LLM 起步
events.title_en: Meta Code Llama: Open-Source Code LLM Begins
events.summary_zh:
2023 年 8 月 24 日,Meta 在 arXiv:2308.12950 发布《Code Llama》。
Code Llama 基于 Llama 2 用 500B code tokens 微调,包括 7B/13B/34B 三档 + Code Llama-Python 专门版 + Code Llama-Instruct。
Code Llama 34B 在 HumanEval 53.7%,超过 GPT-3.5(48.1%)。
Code Llama 用 Apache 2.0 + Llama 2 商用许可开源。
events.source_name: Rozière, B. et al. (2023) arXiv:2308.12950; Meta blog
events.card_summary_zh: Code Llama 用 Apache 2.0 + Llama 2 商用许可开源。
events.summary_en: On August 24, 2023, Meta released "Code Llama" on arXiv:2308.12950, introducing a family of models fine-tuned from Llama 2 on 500B code tokens. The release spans 7B, 13B, and 34B sizes—along with specialized Code Llama-Python and Code Llama-Instruct versions—with Code Llama 34B scoring 53.7% on HumanEval to beat GPT-3.5's 48.1%. Code Llama is open-sourced under the Apache 2.0 and Llama 2 commercial licenses.
events.card_summary_en: Code Llama was open-sourced under Apache 2.0 combined with the Llama 2 commercial license.
events.why_it_matters_en:
Code Llama was the start of open-source code LLMs and defined the open-source coding LLM route through 2023-2024.
Following the line Code Llama (2023-08) → DeepSeek-Coder (2024-01) → StarCoder 2 (2024-02) → Codestral (2024-05) → DeepSeek-Coder V2 (2024-06) → Qwen 2.5 Coder (2024-09), you can see open-source coding LLMs close in on closed-source Codex / GPT-4o during 2024.
events.behind_scenes_en:
Code Llama was led by Baptiste Rozière of Meta FAIR.
Its training data came from GitHub + StarCoder + The Stack.
Code Llama was Meta's open-source answer to GitHub Copilot (2021), StarCoder (2023-05, HuggingFace + ServiceNow + NVIDIA), and CodeT5+ (2023-03, Salesforce).
The Code Llama line: Code Llama (2023-08) → Code Llama 70B (2024-01) → Llama 3 70B Instruct (2024-04, surpassing Code Llama 70B on coding tasks) → Llama 3.1 405B (2024-07) → Codestral (2024-05, Mistral) → DeepSeek-Coder V2 (2024-06).

events.title_zh: ChatGPT 语音 + 视觉:多模态 LLM 落地
events.title_en: ChatGPT Voice + Vision: Multimodal LLM Goes Live
events.summary_zh:
2023 年 9 月 25 日,OpenAI 在 ChatGPT 上线 Voice(语音对话) + Vision(图像理解)。
Voice 用 Whisper + 自己的 TTS,接近真人对话延迟。
Vision 用 GPT-4V,支持用户上传图片提问。
ChatGPT Voice + Vision 让 ChatGPT 从「文本对话」走向「多模态助手」,直接催生 2024 年 GPT-4o(实时多模态)。
events.source_name: OpenAI (2023-09-25) ChatGPT Voice + Vision blog
events.card_summary_zh: OpenAI 在 ChatGPT 上线 Voice(语音对话) + Vision(图像理解)。
events.summary_en: On September 25, 2023, OpenAI rolled out Voice and Vision for ChatGPT: Voice paired Whisper with proprietary TTS for near-human conversational latency, while Vision used GPT-4V to let users upload images and ask questions. Evolving ChatGPT from a text chatbot into a multimodal assistant, this update directly spawned the real-time multimodal GPT-4o in 2024.
events.card_summary_en: OpenAI added Voice (spoken conversation) and Vision (image understanding) to ChatGPT.
events.why_it_matters_en:
ChatGPT Voice + Vision was the starting point of LLM multimodality.
Following the line September 25, 2023 Voice+Vision → May 2024 GPT-4o realtime multimodality → October 2024 Realtime API → March 2025 GPT-4o image generation → August 2025 GPT-5 omni-modal, you can see how ChatGPT moved from text-only toward full multimodality after 2023.
events.behind_scenes_en:
The ChatGPT Voice project was led by OpenAI engineer 'Storm' (Jonah), using Whisper STT + Neural TTS with latency of 0.5-1 seconds.
After launch the 'Sky' voice was said to resemble Scarlett Johansson (from the 2013 film Her), and OpenAI removed Sky in May 2023.
Vision shipped alongside the GPT-4-Vision System Card on September 25, 2023.
The road ahead for Voice + Vision: September 25, 2023 Voice+Vision → May 13, 2024 GPT-4o realtime multimodality (232ms voice latency) → October 2024 Realtime API → March 26, 2025 GPT-4o image generation.

events.title_zh: Mistral 7B 发布:欧洲开源大模型旗舰起点
events.title_en: Mistral 7B Release: European Open LLM Flagship
events.summary_zh:
2023 年 9 月 27 日,Mistral AI 在 arXiv:2310.06825 发布《Mistral 7B》。
Mistral 7B 用 7.3B 参数在所有评测上超过 Llama 2 13B,代码任务上超过 Llama 2 34B。
关键创新:Grouped Query Attention(GQA)、Sliding Window Attention(SWA,4096)、Rolling Buffer Cache。
Mistral 7B 用 Apache 2.0 许可开源权重,首次让欧洲团队进入全球开源 LLM 第一梯队。
events.source_name: Jiang, A. Q. et al. (2023) arXiv:2310.06825; Mistral AI blog
events.card_summary_zh: Mistral 7B 以小体量和开放许可取得强劲表现，证明前沿竞争不只属于拥有巨量算力的美国巨头。
events.summary_en: On September 27, 2023, Mistral AI released "Mistral 7B" on arXiv:2310.06825, presenting a 7.3B-parameter model that outperformed Llama 2 13B on all benchmarks and beat Llama 2 34B on coding tasks. Built on key innovations like Grouped Query Attention (GQA), Sliding Window Attention (SWA, 4096), and Rolling Buffer Cache, the model open-sourced its weights under the Apache 2.0 license, marking the first time a European team entered the top tier of global open-source LLMs.
events.card_summary_en: Mistral 7B delivered strong performance at small size under an open license, proving frontier competition does not belong solely to the compute-rich American giants.
events.why_it_matters_en:
Mistral 7B was the starting point of European open-source LLMs, breaking Llama 2's hold over open-source models in 2023.
Following the line Mistral 7B (2023-09) → Mixtral 8x7B (2023-12) → Llama 3 (2024-04) → Mixtral 8x22B (2024-04), you can see the two great directions of open-source LLMs in 2023-2024: small-and-efficient plus MoE.
events.behind_scenes_en:
Mistral AI was founded in April 2023 by ex-DeepMind Paris researchers Arthur Mensch, Guillaume Lample, and Timothée Lacroix; its seed round in June 2023 raised €105 million (the largest seed round in French history), and its Series A in December 2023 raised €415 million at a $2 billion valuation.
When Mensch left DeepMind he carried engineering experience with MoE and GQA; Mistral 7B scouted the ground before MoE.
Mistral's later line: Mistral 7B (2023-09) → Mixtral 8x7B (2023-12) → Mixtral 8x22B (2024-04) → Mistral Large (2024-02) → Codestral (2024-05).

events.title_zh: MemGPT 提出：用虚拟内存管理突破大模型上下文极限
events.title_en: MemGPT Proposes Virtual Memory to Bypass LLM Context Limits
events.summary_zh: 加州大学伯克利分校团队发表 MemGPT 论文，借鉴操作系统虚拟内存设计，将大模型上下文窗口分为活动内存（Active Memory）和回忆内存（Recall Memory），通过工具自动调度换入换出，实现无限上下文智能体。
events.card_summary_zh: MemGPT 借鉴操作系统虚拟内存，通过工具调用在有限窗口内实现无限上下文，奠定了长周期智能体的内存架构。
events.card_summary_en: MemGPT applies virtual memory concepts from operating systems to LLMs, letting agents sustain long-horizon context through tool calls.
events.why_it_matters_en: It pioneered the 'agent as OS' memory paradigm, which remains the default pattern for production-grade long-running agents.
events.behind_scenes_en: Instead of changing transformer architecture, MemGPT uses prompting and function calling to swap context between fast active memory and local storage, bypassing hard context window limits.
events.source_name: UC Berkeley

events.title_zh: OpenAI DevDay:GPTs + Assistants API + GPT-4 Turbo
events.title_en: OpenAI DevDay: GPTs + Assistants API + GPT-4 Turbo
events.summary_zh:
2023 年 11 月 6 日,OpenAI 在 San Francisco 举办首届 DevDay。
发布:1) GPT-4 Turbo(128K 上下文,知识截至 2023-04,价格降 2.7 倍);2) GPTs(用户可视化搭建 GPT,无需代码);3) Assistants API(状态管理 + 工具调用 + 代码解释器 + 检索);4) DALL·E 3 API;5) Whisper v3;6) Custom Models 计划;7) 版权保护 Copyright Shield。
GPT Store 2024-01 上线。
events.source_name: OpenAI (2023-11-06) DevDay keynote
events.card_summary_zh: OpenAI 同时推出 GPTs 与 Assistants API，让定制助手、工具调用和持久线程开始进入标准产品形态。
events.summary_en: At its inaugural DevDay in San Francisco on November 6, 2023, OpenAI debuted GPT-4 Turbo, boasting a 128K context window, knowledge cutoff of April 2023, and a 2.7x price reduction. The company also unveiled no-code GPTs for visual bot-building, the Assistants API (featuring state management, tool calling, a code interpreter, and retrieval), the DALL·E 3 API, Whisper v3, the Custom Models program, and Copyright Shield protection. Finally, OpenAI announced that the GPT Store would launch in January 2024.
events.card_summary_en: OpenAI launched GPTs and the Assistants API together, bringing custom assistants, tool calling, and persistent threads into standard product form.
events.why_it_matters_en:
DevDay was the starting point of OpenAI's platform play, defining every LLM company's platform strategy in 2024.
Following the line DevDay (2023-11) → GPT Store (2024-01) → Realtime API (2024-10) → Assistants API v2 (2025-03), you can see OpenAI trying to turn GPT into the next-generation operating system.
events.behind_scenes_en:
DevDay was hosted by Altman under the theme of letting everyone build their own GPT.
Users created 3 million GPTs within one month of launch, but most went quiet after the GPT Store opened in January 2024, and revenue sharing arrived in April 2024.
The Assistants API later evolved into Threads + Assistants in August 2024 and the Realtime API in March 2025.
DevDay positioned itself squarely against Apple's WWDC: OpenAI wants GPT to become a developer platform.

events.title_zh: Google Gemini 1.0:原生多模态 LLM
events.title_en: Google Gemini 1.0: Native Multimodal LLM
events.summary_zh:
2023 年 12 月 6 日,Google DeepMind 发布 Gemini 1.0(Ultra/Pro/Nano 三档)。
Gemini 是首个原生多模态 LLM(图像/音频/视频/文本统一编码),非拼接。
Gemini Ultra 在 MMLU 90.0%(GPT-4 86.4%),首次反超 GPT-4。
Gemini Pro 集成到 Bard、Pixel 8 Pro、Google Search。
Gemini Nano 在 Pixel 8 Pro 本地运行。
events.source_name: Google DeepMind (2023-12-06) Gemini 1.0 blog; Technical Report
events.card_summary_zh: Gemini 从训练阶段就统一处理文本、图像和其他模态，Google 正式以原生多模态路线迎战 GPT-4。
events.summary_en: On December 6, 2023, Google DeepMind launched Gemini 1.0 in three tiers (Ultra, Pro, and Nano) as the first natively multimodal LLM featuring unified encoding of image, audio, video, and text instead of a stitched-together system. Gemini Ultra scored 90.0% on MMLU, surpassing GPT-4 (86.4%) for the first time. While Gemini Pro was integrated into Bard, Pixel 8 Pro, and Google Search, Gemini Nano runs locally on the Pixel 8 Pro.
events.card_summary_en: Gemini processed text, images, and other modalities in a unified way from the training stage onward, as Google formally took on GPT-4 with a natively multimodal route.
events.why_it_matters_en:
Gemini was Google's core counterattack against GPT-4 and defined the natively multimodal direction of 2024-2025.
Following the line Gemini 1.0 (2023-12) → Gemini 1.5 with 1M context (2024-02) → Gemini 2.0 (2024-12) → Gemini 2.5 Pro (2025-03) → Gemini 3 (2025-12), you can see how Google gradually overtook OpenAI through 2024-2025.
events.behind_scenes_en:
Gemini was driven by Google DeepMind's Demis Hassabis, Oriol Vinyals, and Jeff Dean.
The Gemini project started in January 2023; Google merged Brain + DeepMind (April 2023) to unify resources.
The Gemini paper was published on December 19, 2023, with 15 co-first authors and more than 200 authors in total.
Gemini 1.0 Ultra did not open up until February 2024, delayed from launch.
The Gemini line: Gemini 1.0 (2023-12) → Gemini 1.5 Pro (2024-02, 1M context) → Gemini 1.5 Flash (2024-05) → Gemini 2.0 Flash (2024-12) → Gemini 2.5 Pro (2025-03, overtaking Claude 3.7).

events.title_zh: Google Imagen 2:Google 文生图升级
events.title_en: Google Imagen 2: Google Text-to-Image Upgrade
events.summary_zh:
2023 年 12 月 7 日,Google DeepMind 在 Vertex AI 发布 Imagen 2。
Imagen 2 用扩散模型 + 文本理解 + RLHF,在图像质量、文字渲染、人脸生成上超过 Imagen 1。
Imagen 2 集成到 Bard、Google Slides、Google Ads。
Imagen 2 不开源权重,只 API。
events.source_name: Google DeepMind (2023-12-07) Imagen 2 blog
events.card_summary_zh: Google DeepMind 在 Vertex AI 发布 Imagen 2；Imagen 2 是 Google 在文生图追赶的关键节点。
events.summary_en: On December 7, 2023, Google DeepMind launched Imagen 2 on Vertex AI, utilizing diffusion models, text understanding, and RLHF to outperform Imagen 1 in image quality, text rendering, and face generation. Now integrated into Bard, Google Slides, and Google Ads, the model's weights remain closed-source, with access offered only via API.
events.card_summary_en: Google DeepMind released Imagen 2 on Vertex AI; Imagen 2 was a key milestone in Google's catch-up race in text-to-image generation.
events.why_it_matters_en:
Imagen 2 was a key milestone in Google's text-to-image catch-up.
Following the line Imagen 2 (2023-12) → Imagen 3 (2024-05) → Veo (2024-05) → Veo 2 (2024-12, overtaking Sora), you can see how Google overtook OpenAI's Sora in video generation in the second half of 2024.
events.behind_scenes_en:
Imagen 2 was Google's response to Stable Diffusion (2022-08) + DALL·E 3 (2023-10) + Midjourney v5 (2023-03).
Google published the Imagen 1 paper in May 2022 but productized slowly; only with Imagen 2 in December 2023 did it ship as an official API.
The Imagen line: Imagen (2022-05, paper) → Imagen 2 (2023-12, product) → Imagen 3 (2024-05) → Veo (2024-05, video) → Veo 2 (2024-12).

events.title_zh: Mixtral 8x7B:开源 MoE LLM 起步
events.title_en: Mixtral 8x7B: Open-Source MoE LLM Begins
events.summary_zh:
2023 年 12 月 11 日,Mistral AI 在 arXiv:2401.04088 发布《Mixtral of Experts》。
Mixtral 8x7B 用 8 个专家(expert),每 token 路由到 2 个专家,总参 46.7B、激活 12.9B。
Mixtral 8x7B 在多数评测上超过 Llama 2 70B,GPT-3.5。
Mixtral 8x7B 用 Apache 2.0 商用开源。
Mixtral 路线:Mixtral 8x7B(2023-12) → Mixtral 8x7B Instruct(2023-12) → Mixtral 8x22B(2024-04) → Mistral Large 2(2024-07)。
events.source_name: Jiang, A. Q. et al. (2023) arXiv:2401.04088; Mistral blog
events.card_summary_zh: Mistral AI 在 arXiv:2401.04088 发布《Mixtral of Experts》。
events.summary_en: On December 11, 2023, Mistral AI published "Mixtral of Experts" on arXiv:2401.04088, detailing Mixtral 8x7B, a model utilizing 8 experts (routing 2 per token) with 46.7B total and 12.9B active parameters. Commercially open-sourced under the Apache 2.0 license, it outperformed Llama 2 70B and GPT-3.5 on most benchmarks, paving the way for a roadmap that evolved from Mixtral 8x7B (2023-12) and Mixtral 8x7B Instruct (2023-12) to Mixtral 8x22B (2024-04) and Mistral Large 2 (2024-07).
events.card_summary_en: Mistral AI published 'Mixtral of Experts' on arXiv:2401.04088.
events.why_it_matters_en:
Mixtral 8x7B was the starting point of open-source MoE LLMs, defining the MoE direction of open-source LLMs in 2024-2025.
Following the line Mixtral 8x7B (2023-12) → DeepSeek MoE 16B (2024-01) → Mixtral 8x22B (2024-04) → DeepSeek-V2 MoE (2024-05) → Llama 4 MoE (2025-04), you can see why every open-source large model turned to MoE in 2024.
events.behind_scenes_en:
Mixtral 8x7B was led by Mistral AI co-founder Guillaume Lample and Albert Jiang.
The MoE concept came from Shazeer's 2017 'Outrageously Large Neural Networks,' but before 2023 MoE stayed inside Google (GShard, Switch Transformer, GLaM).
Mixtral 8x7B was the first open-source commercially usable MoE LLM, directly influencing DeepSeek MoE (2024-01), Qwen MoE (2024-06), and Llama 4 MoE (2025-04).

events.title_zh: OpenAI Sora 公布:视频生成里程碑
events.title_en: OpenAI Sora Reveal: Video Generation Milestone
events.summary_zh:
2024 年 2 月 15 日,OpenAI 公布 Sora(text-to-video 模型,最长 60 秒)。
Sora 用 DiT(Diffusion Transformer)架构,把视频生成从「U-Net 扩散」推向「Transformer 扩散」。
Sora 演示视频质量震惊业界,但 OpenAI 未开源 + 延迟发布。
Sora 2024-12 才开放给 ChatGPT Plus 用户,2024-12-09 Sora 2 发布。
events.source_name: OpenAI (2024-02-15) Sora reveal; Brooks-Peebles DiT paper
events.card_summary_zh: Sora 展示从文字生成长达一分钟连贯视频的能力，视频模型开始尝试学习运动、空间与物理世界。
events.summary_en: On February 15, 2024, OpenAI unveiled Sora, a text-to-video model capable of generating clips up to 60 seconds long. Utilizing a DiT (Diffusion Transformer) architecture, Sora pushed video generation from "U-Net diffusion" to "Transformer diffusion." Although its stunning demo quality shocked the industry, OpenAI kept the model closed-source and delayed its release, only opening it to ChatGPT Plus users in December 2024, followed by the launch of Sora 2 on December 9, 2024.
events.card_summary_en: Sora demonstrated generating coherent videos up to a minute long from text, as video models began trying to learn motion, space, and the physical world.
events.why_it_matters_en:
Sora was a milestone for video generation, defining the DiT architecture direction of 2024-2025.
Following the line Sora (2024-02) → Veo (2024-05) → Kling (2024-06) → Sora 2 (2024-12) → Veo 2 (2024-12), you can see how video generation in 2024 moved from watchable to usable.
events.behind_scenes_en:
Sora was led by OpenAI's Tim Brooks and Bill Peebles (Peebles was lead author of the DiT paper).
Sora used Spatiotemporal Patches, encoding video into transformer tokens.
Within one month of Sora's announcement everyone followed suit: Runway Gen-3 (2024-06), Luma Dream Machine (2024-06), Kling (2024-06, Kuaishou), Hailuo (2024-09, MiniMax), Veo (2024-05, Google), and Vidu (2024-04, Shengshu).
Reasons for Sora's delayed release: 1) safety review; 2) insufficient compute; 3) high cost.
The video-generation line: Sora (2024-02) → Veo (2024-05) → Kling (2024-06) → Sora 2 (2024-12) → Veo 2 (2024-12, overtaking Sora).

events.title_zh: Anthropic Claude 3 发布:首次反超 GPT-4
events.title_en: Anthropic Claude 3: First to Surpass GPT-4
events.summary_zh:
2024 年 3 月 4 日,Anthropic 发布 Claude 3(Haiku/Sonnet/Opus 三档)。
Claude 3 Opus 在 MMLU 86.8%(GPT-4 86.4%),首次反超 GPT-4。
Claude 3 Opus 200K 上下文,vision 多模态。
Claude 3 Sonnet 速度更快,价格更低,实际生产部署最多。
Claude 3 路线:Claude 3(2024-03) → Claude 3.5 Sonnet(2024-06-20) → Claude 3.5 Sonnet v2(2024-10-22) → Claude 3.7 Sonnet(2025-02-24) → Claude 4 Opus(2025-05-22)。
events.source_name: Anthropic (2024-03-04) Claude 3 launch; Model Card
events.card_summary_zh: Claude 3 在多项能力评测中追平或超过 GPT-4，前沿模型竞争第一次形成真正的多强格局。
events.summary_en: On March 4, 2024, Anthropic released its Claude 3 family—spanning the Haiku, Sonnet, and Opus tiers—with the flagship Claude 3 Opus scoring 86.8% on the MMLU to edge out GPT-4 (86.4%) for the first time. While the multimodal, vision-capable Opus boasted a 200K context window, the faster and cheaper Sonnet saw the most actual production deployments. This launched a rapid release cycle: Claude 3 (2024-03) → Claude 3.5 Sonnet (2024-06-20) → Claude 3.5 Sonnet v2 (2024-10-22) → Claude 3.7 Sonnet (2025-02-24) → Claude 4 Opus (2025-05-22).
events.card_summary_en: Claude 3 matched or beat GPT-4 across multiple capability evaluations, and frontier-model competition formed a genuine multi-leader landscape for the first time.
events.why_it_matters_en:
Claude 3 was the starting point of Anthropic overtaking OpenAI.
Following the line Claude 3 (2024-03) → Claude 3.5 Sonnet (2024-06) → Claude 3.5 Sonnet v2 (2024-10) → Claude 3.7 Sonnet (2025-02) → Claude 4 Opus (2025-05) → Claude Opus 4.8 (2026-05), you can see how Anthropic gradually overtook OpenAI in the second half of 2024.
events.behind_scenes_en:
Claude 3 was Anthropic's core counterattack 13 months after GPT-4 had dominated.
Claude 3 Opus trained on 16,000 H100s at a cost of roughly $200 million.
After Claude 3 Anthropic's valuation soared: $15 billion in March 2024 → $60 billion in November 2024.
Claude 3.5 Sonnet shipped on June 20, 2024, overtaking GPT-4o on coding tasks.
Claude 3 Haiku was the fastest variant and was called heavily through Amazon Bedrock.

events.title_zh: 欧盟 AI Act 通过:全球首部 AI 监管法
events.title_en: EU AI Act Passed: World's First AI Regulation Law
events.summary_zh:
2024 年 3 月 13 日,欧洲议会通过《AI Act》。
AI Act 按风险分四档:不可接受(禁)、高风险(限)、有限风险(透明)、最小风险(自由)。
AI Act 对 General Purpose AI(GPAI) + Systemic Risk LLM(>=10^25 FLOPS) 设特殊义务:模型卡、版权披露、红队测试、严重事件报告。
AI Act 2024-08-01 生效,2026-08 全面执行,违规罚 3500 万欧元或营收 7%。
events.source_name: European Parliament (2024-03-13) AI Act adoption; Official Journal
events.card_summary_zh: 欧盟通过全球首部系统性 AI 法案，以风险等级约束模型与应用，技术竞争第一次面对完整法律框架。
events.summary_en: On March 13, 2024, the European Parliament passed the AI Act, which categorizes AI into four risk tiers: unacceptable (banned), high risk (restricted), limited risk (transparency), and minimal risk (free). The Act imposes special obligations on General Purpose AI (GPAI) and Systemic Risk LLM (>=10^25 FLOPS), requiring model cards, copyright disclosures, red-teaming, and serious incident reporting. Taking effect on August 1, 2024, and entering full enforcement by August 2026, the Act penalizes violations with fines of 35 million euros or 7% of revenue.
events.card_summary_en: The EU passed the world's first systematic AI law, constraining models and applications by risk tiers, and technological competition faced a complete legal framework for the first time.
events.why_it_matters_en:
The AI Act was the paradigm starting point of global AI regulation, directly shaping the compliance strategies of every frontier LLM company through 2024-2026.
Following the line AI Act (2024-03) → White House AI executive order (2024-05) → California SB-1047 (2024-09, vetoed) → China's generative AI service measures (2023-08), you can see the regulatory environment every LLM company has had to face since 2024.
events.behind_scenes_en:
The AI Act was proposed by the European Commission in April 2021; Parliament adopted its negotiating position in June 2023, trilogue talks reached consensus in December 2023, and it formally passed on March 13, 2024.
The AI Act is the world's first comprehensive AI law.
Its impact on OpenAI, Google, and Anthropic: GPT-4, Gemini, and Claude all count as Systemic Risk LLMs.
Downstream effects: the White House AI executive order in May 2024, California SB-1047 in September 2024 (vetoed), and Brazil's AI law in January 2025.

events.title_zh: OSWorld 智能体基准发布：真实电脑环境成为 GUI Agent 考场
events.title_en: OSWorld Benchmark Released to Evaluate GUI Agents in Real OS Environments
events.summary_zh: 清华、港大等团队联合发布 OSWorld，首个在真实操作系统环境（Linux/Windows/macOS）中评估 GUI 智能体完成多步复杂任务能力的评测基准，覆盖截图、鼠标、键盘和界面元素操作。
events.card_summary_zh: OSWorld 为 GUI 智能体提供真实桌面虚拟机考场，让智能体接受截图与键盘鼠标操作考验，成为 Computer Use 的行业评测标准。
events.card_summary_en: OSWorld establishes a real desktop OS playground to evaluate GUI agents via screen screenshots and native mouse/keyboard execution.
events.why_it_matters_en: It became the gold-standard benchmark for Computer Use agents, forcing labs to validate actual task completion rates in non-deterministic OS environments.
events.behind_scenes_en: Moving beyond static sandboxes, OSWorld runs agents on real virtual machines driving actual software like VS Code and Chrome to test exception handling.
events.source_name: OSWorld

events.title_zh: Meta Llama 3 发布:开源 LLM 跨过 GPT-3.5
events.title_en: Meta Llama 3 Release: Open-Source LLM Crosses GPT-3.5
events.summary_zh:
2024 年 4 月 18 日,Meta 发布 Llama 3(8B/70B)。
Llama 3 用 15T tokens 训练(比 Llama 2 多 7 倍),8K 上下文。
Llama 3 70B 在 MMLU 82.0%(GPT-4 86.4%),Llama 3 8B 在多数任务上超过 Llama 2 70B。
Llama 3 Instruct 用 SFT + DPO + RLHF 训练。
Llama 3 路线:Llama 3 8B/70B(2024-04) → Llama 3.1 405B(2024-07-23,首个 405B 开源) → Llama 3.2 1B/3B(2024-09,边缘) → Llama 3.3 70B(2024-12) → Llama 4(2025-04-05)。
events.source_name: Meta (2024-04-18) Llama 3 release; Meta AI blog
events.card_summary_zh: Meta 发布 Llama 3(8B/70B)；Llama 3 是开源 LLM 跨过 GPT-3.5 门槛的起点。
events.summary_en: On April 18, 2024, Meta launched Llama 3 (8B/70B)—trained on 15T tokens (7x more than Llama 2) with an 8K context window—employing SFT, DPO, and RLHF for its Instruct version. While Llama 3 70B hit 82.0% on MMLU (against GPT-4's 86.4%) and the 8B model beat Llama 2 70B on most tasks, it also kicked off an ambitious roadmap: Llama 3 8B/70B (2024-04) → Llama 3.1 405B (2024-07-23, the first open-source 405B) → Llama 3.2 1B/3B (2024-09, edge) → Llama 3.3 70B (2024-12) → Llama 4 (2025-04-05).
events.card_summary_en: Meta released Llama 3 (8B/70B); Llama 3 was the point where open-source LLMs crossed the GPT-3.5 threshold.
events.why_it_matters_en:
Llama 3 was the starting point of open-source LLMs crossing the GPT-3.5 threshold.
Following the line Llama 3 8B (2024-04) → Llama 3.1 405B (2024-07) → Llama 3.2 1B/3B (2024-09) → Llama 4 MoE (2025-04), you can see how open-source LLMs closed in on closed-source GPT-4 during 2024, and why Meta treats openness as its core strategy.
events.behind_scenes_en:
Llama 3 was led by Meta FAIR's Hugo Touvron.
Llama 3 trained on 16K H100s; the 70B took six months to train.
Key figures: 15T tokens, with code at 5%.
Llama 3 Instruct used 25M SFT samples + DPO.
After Llama 3, Meta launched Llama Stack (2024-10) to unify APIs.
Llama 3.1 405B was the first open 405B model, at a training cost of roughly $650 million.
Llama 4 in April 2025 switched to a MoE architecture.

events.title_zh: DeepSeek-V2:中国开源 MoE + API 价格战起点
events.title_en: DeepSeek-V2: China's Open-Source MoE + API Price War Begins
events.summary_zh:
2024 年 5 月 7 日,DeepSeek 在 arXiv:2405.04434 发布《DeepSeek-V2: A Strong, Economical, and Efficient Mixture-of-Experts Language Model》。
DeepSeek-V2 用 236B 总参、21B 激活的 MoE,创新 MLA(Multi-Head Latent Attention) + DeepSeekMoE。
DeepSeek-V2 API 价格 ¥1/1M input(同档 Llama 3 70B 的 1/100),直接引爆中国 LLM 价格战。
events.source_name: DeepSeek-AI (2024) arXiv:2405.04434; DeepSeek blog
events.card_summary_zh: DeepSeek-V2：中国开源 MoE + API 价格战起点。
events.summary_en: On May 7, 2024, DeepSeek published "DeepSeek-V2: A Strong, Economical, and Efficient Mixture-of-Experts Language Model" on arXiv:2405.04434, introducing an MoE model with 236B total and 21B active parameters that features innovative MLA (Multi-Head Latent Attention) and DeepSeekMoE architectures. Priced at just ¥1/1M input—1/100 of the cost of the comparable Llama 3 70B—the DeepSeek-V2 API instantly ignited a price war in the Chinese LLM market.
events.card_summary_en: DeepSeek-V2: the starting point of Chinese open-source MoE plus the API price war.
events.why_it_matters_en:
DeepSeek-V2 was the starting point of Chinese open-source MoE and the price war, directly defining China's LLM business models in 2024-2025.
Following the line DeepSeek-V2 (2024-05) → DeepSeek-V3 (2024-12) → DeepSeek-R1 (2025-01, global breakthrough), you can see how DeepSeek stunned the world with R1 in January 2025.
events.behind_scenes_en:
DeepSeek was founded by the quant firm High-Flyer, spinning off as an independent company in July 2023.
Founder Liang Wenfeng trained LLMs on GPU compute accumulated from quantitative trading (10K A100s).
DeepSeek-V2's MLA compressed KV cache to one quarter, sending inference costs plunging.
DeepSeek-V2 triggered a price war: Baidu ERNIE at ¥0.002 per thousand tokens (2024-05-21), Alibaba Tongyi at ¥0.005 (2024-05-21), ByteDance Doubao at ¥0.0008 (2024-05-15).
The DeepSeek line: DeepSeek LLM (2023-11) → DeepSeek-V2 (2024-05) → DeepSeek-V2.5 (2024-09) → DeepSeek-V3 (2024-12) → DeepSeek-R1 (2025-01-20).

events.title_zh: GPT-4o:实时多模态 LLM 起点
events.title_en: GPT-4o: Real-Time Multimodal LLM Begins
events.summary_zh:
2024 年 5 月 13 日,OpenAI 发布 GPT-4o(omni)。
GPT-4o 是首个原生多模态 LLM(文本+图像+音频统一编码),语音对话延迟 232ms(接近人类 200ms)。
GPT-4o 在 MMLU 88.7%(超过 GPT-4 Turbo 86.5%)。
GPT-4o 免费向所有 ChatGPT 用户开放,Plus 5 倍额度。
GPT-4o API 价格降 50%($5/1M input)。
events.source_name: OpenAI (2024-05-13) GPT-4o launch; System Card
events.card_summary_zh: GPT-4o 在同一模型中实时处理文字、声音和图像，人机交互开始从轮流输入走向自然连续对话。
events.summary_en: On May 13, 2024, OpenAI released GPT-4o (omni), the first native multimodal LLM featuring unified encoding for text, images, and audio, boasting a voice conversation latency of 232ms (nearing the human rate of 200ms). Scoring 88.7% on the MMLU to surpass GPT-4 Turbo's 86.5%, the model is available for free to all ChatGPT users, with Plus users receiving 5 times the limit. Additionally, the GPT-4o API price has been cut by 50% ($5/1M input).
events.card_summary_en: GPT-4o handled text, sound, and images in real time inside a single model, moving human-computer interaction from turn-taking input toward natural continuous conversation.
events.why_it_matters_en:
GPT-4o was the starting point of realtime multimodal LLMs, defining the shape of the AI assistant in 2024-2025.
Following the line GPT-4o (2024-05) → GPT-4o mini (2024-07) → Realtime API (2024-10) → GPT-4o image generation (2025-03) → GPT-5 omni-modal (2025-08), you can see why every AI assistant after 2024 pivoted to realtime voice plus vision.
events.behind_scenes_en:
GPT-4o was driven by OpenAI's Mia Glaese, Mark Chen, and Hyung Won Chung.
GPT-4o trained on 25K H100s for six months.
GPT-4o merged the three-stage ASR (Whisper) + LLM (GPT-4) + TTS pipeline into a single model, cutting latency from GPT-4V's 2.8s to 232ms.
The GPT-4o line: GPT-4o (2024-05) → GPT-4o mini (2024-07-18) → GPT-4o-2024-08 (2024-08) → GPT-4o-2024-11 (2024-11) → GPT-4o Realtime API (2024-10) → GPT-4o image generation (2025-03-26).

events.title_zh: Claude 3.5 Sonnet:开源编程模型新基准
events.title_en: Claude 3.5 Sonnet: New Benchmark for Coding
events.summary_zh:
2024 年 6 月 20 日,Anthropic 发布 Claude 3.5 Sonnet。
Claude 3.5 Sonnet 在编程(HumanEval 92.0%)、推理(GPQA 59.4%)、视觉(文档理解)上全面超越 GPT-4o。
Claude 3.5 Sonnet 价格是 GPT-4o 的 1/5。
Claude 3.5 Sonnet 推出 Artifacts(代码 + 文档实时渲染)。
events.source_name: Anthropic (2024-06-20) Claude 3.5 Sonnet launch
events.card_summary_zh: Claude 3.5 Sonnet 推出 Artifacts(代码 + 文档实时渲染)。
events.summary_en: On June 20, 2024, Anthropic released Claude 3.5 Sonnet, which outperforms GPT-4o in coding (HumanEval 92.0%), reasoning (GPQA 59.4%), and vision (document understanding) at one-fifth the price of GPT-4o. The release also introduces Artifacts, a feature enabling the real-time rendering of code and documents.
events.card_summary_en: Claude 3.5 Sonnet launched Artifacts (real-time rendering of code + documents).
events.why_it_matters_en:
Claude 3.5 Sonnet was the starting point of Anthropic overtaking OpenAI in coding.
Following the line Claude 3 (2024-03) → Claude 3.5 Sonnet (2024-06) → Claude 3.5 Sonnet v2 (2024-10) → Claude 3.7 Sonnet (2025-02) → Claude 4 Opus (2025-05), you can see how Anthropic became the first choice for coding LLMs in the second half of 2024.
events.behind_scenes_en:
Claude 3.5 Sonnet was a mid-generation upgrade just three months after Anthropic shipped Claude 3.
Anthropic's engineering team found Claude 3 Sonnet's training had not saturated, so it upgraded quickly via SFT + DPO + long-context optimization.
After Claude 3.5 Sonnet, Cursor, Windsurf, Cline, and Claude Code adopted it en masse.
Claude 3.5 Sonnet v2 shipped on October 22, 2024, further overtaking o1 on system-level programming.

events.title_zh: Meta Llama 3.1 405B:首个 405B 开源模型
events.title_en: Meta Llama 3.1 405B: First 405B Open-Source Model
events.summary_zh:
2024 年 7 月 23 日,Meta 发布 Llama 3.1(8B/70B/405B 三档)。
Llama 3.1 405B 是首个 405B 开源模型,在 MMLU 88.6%(超过 GPT-4o 88.7%)、GSM8K 96.8%。
Llama 3.1 405B 训练用 16K H100,54 天,15T tokens,成本约 6.5 亿美元。
Llama 3.1 把上下文从 8K 扩到 128K,工具调用 + 多语言(8 种)强化。
events.source_name: Meta (2024-07-23) Llama 3.1 release; arXiv:2407.21783
events.card_summary_zh: Meta 发布 Llama 3.1(8B/70B/405B 三档)；Llama 3.1 405B 是开源 LLM 首次追上闭源 SOTA。
events.summary_en: On July 23, 2024, Meta released Llama 3.1 in three sizes (8B/70B/405B), featuring the first-ever 405B open-source model, which scored 88.6% on MMLU (surpassing GPT-4o's 88.7%) and 96.8% on GSM8K. Training the 405B model required 16K H100 GPUs, 54 days, and 15T tokens, costing approximately $650 million. Llama 3.1 expands the context window from 8K to 128K and features enhanced tool use and multilingual support across 8 languages.
events.card_summary_en: Meta released Llama 3.1 in three sizes (8B/70B/405B); Llama 3.1 405B marked the first time an open-source LLM caught up with closed-source SOTA.
events.why_it_matters_en:
Llama 3.1 405B was the first time an open-source LLM caught closed-source SOTA.
Following the line Llama 3.1 405B (2024-07) → Llama 3.3 70B (2024-12, quality equal to 405B) → Llama 4 MoE (2025-04), you can see how the gap between open and closed LLMs narrowed in 2024 from a generational divide to parity.
events.behind_scenes_en:
Llama 3.1 405B was Meta's core counterattack under dual pressure from GPT-4o (2024-05) and Claude 3.5 Sonnet (2024-06).
405B inference is expensive: it takes 8 H100s to run FP8, so Meta shipped a quantized FP8 version to lower the barrier.
After Llama 3.1 the open-source community produced many distillations: NV Llama-3.1-Nemotron-70B, Tulu 3, Hermes 3.
With Llama 3.1 405B, open-source LLMs for the first time overtook GPT-4o on multiple benchmarks.

events.title_zh: 《Nature》发表模型崩溃研究：警示合成数据循环训练的致命局限
events.title_en: Nature Publishes Model Collapse Study Warning Against Recursive Synthetic Training
events.summary_zh: 牛津、剑桥等机构的研究者在《Nature》发表论文，系统论证了模型在使用前代模型生成的合成数据进行循环训练时，会发生「模型崩溃」，导致多样性退化和低频信息不可逆丢失。
events.card_summary_zh: 《Nature》研究指出大模型使用合成数据进行多代循环训练会引发模型崩溃，限定了合成数据的使用边界，确立了人类真实数据的核心地位。
events.card_summary_en: A Nature paper demonstrates model collapse, where LLMs trained recursively on synthetic data suffer irreversible loss of rare tail information.
events.why_it_matters_en: It drew a hard boundary for synthetic data scaling, proving that self-recycling leads to decay unless grounded by human data or formal verifiers.
events.behind_scenes_en: The study cooled down the synthetic data gold rush, proving models decay into gibberish within 5 to 7 loops without new organic human datasets.
events.source_name: Nature

events.title_zh: OpenAI o1:推理模型时代起点
events.title_en: OpenAI o1: Reasoning Model Era Begins
events.summary_zh:
2024 年 9 月 12 日,OpenAI 发布 o1-preview + o1-mini。
o1 用 RL + Chain-of-Thought 训练,在数学(AIME 83.3%,GPT-4o 13.4%)、编程(Codeforces 89%)、博士级科学(GPQA 78%) 上大幅超越 GPT-4o。
o1 推理时输出长 CoT(几千-几万 token),延迟从 GPT-4o 1 秒到 o1 10-30 秒。
events.source_name: OpenAI (2024-09-12) o1 launch; Learning to Reason blog
events.card_summary_zh: o1 在回答前投入更多计算进行推理，模型竞争从即时生成转向愿意花时间解决复杂问题。
events.summary_en: On September 12, 2024, OpenAI released o1-preview and o1-mini. Trained using reinforcement learning and Chain-of-Thought, o1 dramatically outperforms GPT-4o in mathematics (scoring 83.3% on AIME compared to GPT-4o's 13.4%), coding (89% on Codeforces), and PhD-level science (78% on GPQA). During inference, o1 generates a long Chain-of-Thought spanning thousands to tens of thousands of tokens, which increases latency from GPT-4o's 1 second to 10-30 seconds for o1.
events.card_summary_en: o1 invested more computation into reasoning before answering, shifting model competition from instant generation toward a willingness to spend time on hard problems.
events.why_it_matters_en:
o1 was the start of the LLM reasoning era, defining the reasoning-model direction of 2024-2025.
Following the line o1 (2024-09) → o1-mini (2024-09) → o3-mini (2025-01) → DeepSeek-R1 (2025-01-20, open reasoning model) → o3 (2025-04) → GPT-5 (2025-08), you can see why every frontier LLM in 2025 moved onto a dual track of reasoning plus general-purpose.
events.behind_scenes_en:
Project o1 carried the codename Strawberry, led by Noam Brown (hired from Meta in January 2024) and Jakub Pachocki.
o1's core innovation: training chains of thought with RL, letting the model think before answering at inference time.
o1 drew inspiration from internal OpenAI research on test-time compute scaling in August 2024.
The o1 line: o1-preview (2024-09) → o1-mini (2024-09) → o1 full (2024-12) → o1 pro (2024-12) → o3-mini (2025-01-31) → o3 (2025-04) → GPT-5 (2025-08, unifying reasoning and general capability).

events.title_zh: Hassabis 与 Jumper 获诺贝尔化学奖:AI for Science 里程碑
events.title_en: Hassabis & Jumper Nobel Chemistry Prize: AI for Science Milestone
events.summary_zh:
2024 年 10 月 9 日,诺贝尔化学奖一半授予 Demis Hassabis 和 John Jumper(AlphaFold),另一半授予 David Baker(蛋白质设计)。
AlphaFold 2(2020-11) 解决蛋白质结构预测 50 年难题,AlphaFold 3(2024-05-08) 扩展到 DNA/RNA/配体。
Hassabis 是首位获诺贝尔奖的 AI 公司 CEO。
events.source_name: Nobel Prize (2024-10-09) Chemistry announcement; DeepMind AlphaFold
events.card_summary_zh: Hassabis 是首位获诺贝尔奖的 AI 公司 CEO。
events.summary_en: On October 9, 2024, the Nobel Prize in Chemistry was awarded, with one half going to David Baker for protein design, and the other half to Demis Hassabis and John Jumper for AlphaFold, making Hassabis the first AI company CEO to win a Nobel Prize. AlphaFold 2 (2020-11) solved a 50-year challenge in protein structure prediction, while AlphaFold 3 (2024-05-08) expanded the model's capabilities to DNA, RNA, and ligands.
events.card_summary_en: Hassabis became the first AI-company CEO to win a Nobel Prize.
events.why_it_matters_en:
The Hassabis/Jumper Nobel Prize was the moment mainstream science recognized AI for Science.
Following the line AlphaFold 1 (2018) → AlphaFold 2 (2020) → AlphaFold DB 200 million (2022) → AlphaFold 3 (2024) → Nobel Prize (2024-10), you can see how AI moved from language conversation toward scientific discovery.
events.behind_scenes_en:
AlphaFold 1 ranked 21st at CASP13; AlphaFold 2 hit GDT_TS 92.4 at CASP14, reaching experimental accuracy.
AlphaFold 2 was driven by DeepMind's John Jumper and Demis Hassabis.
After AlphaFold 2 came open-sourcing: the source code in July 2021, plus AlphaFold Colab and the AlphaFold DB with 200M+ protein structures.
AlphaFold 3 was released on May 8, 2024 but without open weights, drawing controversy.
Hassabis simultaneously held the Nobel Prize and a nomination for the 2024 Turing Award.

events.title_zh: Claude Computer Use:LLM 直接操作电脑
events.title_en: Claude Computer Use: LLM Directly Operates Computer
events.summary_zh:
2024 年 10 月 22 日,Anthropic 在 Claude 3.5 Sonnet v2 同步推出 Computer Use API(beta)。
Claude Computer Use 让 LLM 通过截图 + 鼠标键盘控制直接操作电脑(浏览器、终端、文件)。
Claude Computer Use 是首个商用 Computer Use Agent,定义 2024-2025 年「GUI Agent」方向。
events.source_name: Anthropic (2024-10-22) Claude 3.5 Sonnet v2 + Computer Use
events.card_summary_zh: Claude 获得观察屏幕、移动鼠标和输入文字的能力，大模型第一次可以像用户一样直接操作通用电脑。
events.summary_en: On October 22, 2024, Anthropic launched the Computer Use API (beta) alongside Claude 3.5 Sonnet v2. Claude Computer Use allows LLMs to directly operate computers (browsers, terminals, files) via screenshots and mouse/keyboard control. As the first commercial Computer Use Agent, it defines the direction of "GUI Agents" for 2024-2025.
events.card_summary_en: Claude gained the ability to observe the screen, move the mouse, and type, letting a large model directly operate a general-purpose computer like a user for the first time.
events.why_it_matters_en:
Computer Use was the point where LLM agents moved from text to operating computers.
Following the line AutoGPT (2023-03) → Devin (2024-03) → Claude Computer Use (2024-10) → OpenAI Operator (2024-11) → Hermes (2026), you can see how agents after 2024 moved from chatting to operating.
events.behind_scenes_en:
Computer Use was driven by Anthropic's engineering team, with three core difficulties: 1) GUI understanding (screenshots into structure); 2) precise mouse and keyboard control (coordinates + keystrokes); 3) consistency over long-horizon tasks.
After Claude Computer Use, OpenAI launched Operator in November 2024, Google launched Project Mariner in December 2024, and Microsoft launched OmniParser in January 2025.
Computer Use is the key node in the chain AutoGPT (2023) → Devin (2024) → Computer Use (2024) → Hermes (2025).

events.title_zh: AI Factory 叙事成型:超大规模训练集群时代
events.title_en: AI Factory Narrative Forms: Massive Training Cluster Era
events.summary_zh:
2024-2025 年,AI Factory 叙事成型。
AI Factory 指 10 万+ GPU 量级 + 数据中心 + 能源 + 散热的「LLM 工厂」。
代表:xAI Colossus(10 万 H100,2024-09 建成,122 天)、Meta 6 万 H100、Microsoft + OpenAI 5 个 AI Factory、Amazon Trainium 2、Google TPU v5p Trillium、字节豆包 8 万 H100。
events.source_name: NVIDIA (2024-08) SIGGRAPH AI Factory; xAI Colossus (2024-09)
events.card_summary_zh: AI Factory 指 10 万+ GPU 量级 + 数据中心 + 能源 + 散热的「LLM 工厂」。
events.summary_en: During 2024–2025, the narrative of the "AI Factory" took shape, defined as LLM "factories" integrating 100,000+ GPUs with data centers, power, and cooling. Key examples include xAI Colossus (100,000 H100s, completed in September 2024 in 122 days), Meta's 60,000 H100s, Microsoft + OpenAI's 5 AI Factories, Amazon Trainium 2, Google TPU v5p Trillium, and ByteDance Doubao's 80,000 H100s.
events.card_summary_en: AI Factory refers to the 'LLM factory' of 100K+ GPU scale combined with data centers, energy, and cooling.
events.why_it_matters_en:
AI Factory is the physical form of LLM competition in 2024-2025, directly defining the compute threshold for LLMs.
Following the line Colossus (2024-09) → Meta 60K (2024-12) → Stargate planning (2025-01) → Blackwell deployment (2025-04), you can see how LLM competition after 2024 shifted from algorithms to capital plus infrastructure.
events.behind_scenes_en:
The AI Factory concept was proposed by NVIDIA's Jensen Huang at SIGGRAPH in August 2024.
xAI's Colossus is the most dramatic case: Elon Musk tweeted in July 2024 that 100K H100s were deployed in 122 days.
The key bottlenecks of the AI Factory shifted from GPUs to energy (1GW per single factory) + cooling (liquid cooling) + networking (InfiniBand).
In 2025 Microsoft + OpenAI's Stargate ($100 billion, by 2029) is the largest AI Factory plan.

events.title_zh: NVIDIA H100:前沿大模型训练主力 GPU
events.title_en: NVIDIA H100: Main GPU for Frontier LLM Training
events.summary_zh:
2024 年,NVIDIA H100 Hopper GPU 成前沿大模型训练主力。
H100 2022-03 GTC 发布,2023-03 出货,2024 年成为 OpenAI GPT-4o、Anthropic Claude 3、Google Gemini 1.5、Meta Llama 3.1 405B、xAI Grok 2 的训练主力。
H100 FP16 算力 1979 TFLOPS(A100 312 TFLOPS 6.3 倍)、HBM3 80GB、3.2TB/s 带宽。
H100 集群最大规模:xAI Colossus 10 万张 H100(2024-09)、Meta 6 万张、Google TPU v5p 8912 块等效。
events.source_name: NVIDIA (2022-03-22) H100 Hopper announcement; 2024 Q4 earnings
events.card_summary_zh: H100 以 Transformer Engine 和更强互联能力成为前沿模型集群主力，算力供应也由此变成产业竞争核心。
events.summary_en: Announced at GTC in March 2022 and shipped in March 2023, the NVIDIA H100 Hopper GPU became the dominant workhorse for training frontier AI in 2024, powering OpenAI’s GPT-4o, Anthropic’s Claude 3, Google’s Gemini 1.5, Meta’s Llama 3.1 405B, and xAI’s Grok 2. The silicon boasts 1,979 TFLOPS of FP16 compute (6.3 times the A100’s 312 TFLOPS), 80GB of HBM3 memory, and 3.2TB/s of bandwidth. The largest H100 clusters reached massive scales, led by xAI’s Colossus with 100,000 H100s in September 2024, Meta with 60,000, and Google’s equivalent deployment of 8,912 TPU v5p chips.
events.card_summary_en: With its Transformer Engine and stronger interconnect, H100 became the workhorse of frontier-model clusters, and compute supply itself turned into the core of industry competition.
events.why_it_matters_en:
H100 was the compute foundation of every frontier LLM in 2024, directly defining that year's compute threshold for LLMs.
Following the line A100 (2020) → H100 (2023) → H200 (2024) → Blackwell B200 (2024-12) → Rubin (2026), you can see why NVIDIA's market cap broke $3 trillion in 2024 and why compute became the core moat of LLM competition.
events.behind_scenes_en:
H100 is built on NVIDIA's Hopper architecture: announced at GTC in March 2022, shipping in September 2022, deployed at scale in March 2023.
Key innovations: Transformer Engine (FP8 training), HBM3, NVLink 4 (900GB/s).
The H100 shortage ran severe through 2023-2024; Elon Musk tweeted in May 2023 that H100s were harder to buy than drugs.
H100 priced at $25K-$40K per card; NVIDIA's data-center revenue reached $47.5 billion in 2024.
The H100 line: H100 (announced 2022-03, shipped 2023-03) → H200 (2024-02) → Blackwell B200 (announced 2024-03, shipped 2024-12) → Rubin (2026).

events.title_zh: 长上下文竞争:1M token 时代
events.title_en: Long Context Race: 1M Token Era
events.summary_zh:
2024 年,LLM 上下文从 32K 突破到 1M-2M。
代表:Gemini 1.5 Pro(2024-02,1M,后 2M)、Claude 3(2024-03,200K)、GPT-4 Turbo(2023-11,128K)、Llama 3.1 405B(2024-07,128K)、Qwen 2.5(2024-09,128K)。
长上下文让 LLM 一次性处理整本书、整个代码仓库、1 小时视频。
events.source_name: Google Gemini 1.5 (2024-02); Anthropic Claude 3 (2024-03)
events.card_summary_zh: 长上下文让 LLM 一次性处理整本书、整个代码仓库、1 小时视频。
events.summary_en: In 2024, LLM context windows surged from 32K to 1M-2M, headlined by Gemini 1.5 Pro (2024-02, 1M, later 2M), Claude 3 (2024-03, 200K), GPT-4 Turbo (2023-11, 128K), Llama 3.1 405B (2024-07, 128K), and Qwen 2.5 (2024-09, 128K). These massive context windows allow LLMs to process an entire book, a whole codebase, or 1 hour of video all at once.
events.card_summary_en: Long context let LLMs process an entire book, a whole code repository, or an hour of video in one pass.
events.why_it_matters_en:
Long context was one of the core battlegrounds for LLMs in 2024, defining the whole-repository-code and whole-book application scenarios of 2024-2025.
Following the line Claude 2 100K (2023-07) → GPT-4 Turbo 128K (2023-11) → Gemini 1.5 1M (2024-02) → Claude 3.5 500K (2024-10) → Gemini 2.0 2M (2024-12), you can see why RAG stopped being a mandatory component in 2024.
events.behind_scenes_en:
Long context's core difficulties: attention's O(n²) complexity plus position-encoding extrapolation.
The 2024 breakthroughs came from RingAttention (2023), Rotary Position Embedding (RoPE), ALiBi, and YaRN.
Gemini 1.5 Pro trained to 1M using RingAttention + Interleaved Attention and served inference with Sliding Window + Global Tokens.
Claude 3 used Native Long Context (no reliance on extrapolation).
The long-context line: Claude 2 100K (2023-07) → GPT-4 Turbo 128K (2023-11) → Gemini 1.5 Pro 1M (2024-02) → Gemini 1.5 Pro 2M (2024-05) → Claude 3.5 500K (2024-10).

events.title_zh: 小模型蒸馏兴起:7B 反超 GPT-3.5 时代
events.title_en: Small Model Distillation: 7B Beats GPT-3.5 Era
events.summary_zh:
2024 年,7B-14B 小模型通过蒸馏 + DPO 在多项任务上反超 GPT-3.5。
代表:Phi-3 mini 3.8B(Microsoft,2024-04)、Qwen 2.5 7B Instruct(2024-09)、Llama 3.2 1B/3B(2024-09)、Mistral NeMo 12B(2024-07)、Gemma 2 2B/9B/27B(Google,2024-06)。
这些模型可在手机、笔记本、边缘设备本地运行,质量超过 2023 年 GPT-3.5。
events.source_name: Microsoft Phi-3 (2024-04); Meta Llama 3.2 (2024-09); Apple Intelligence (2024-06)
events.card_summary_zh: 7B-14B 小模型通过蒸馏 + DPO 在多项任务上反超 GPT-3.5。
events.summary_en: In 2024, small 7B-14B models leveraged distillation + DPO to surpass GPT-3.5 on multiple tasks, led by Microsoft's Phi-3 mini 3.8B (2024-04), Qwen 2.5 7B Instruct (2024-09), Llama 3.2 1B/3B (2024-09), Mistral NeMo 12B (2024-07), and Google's Gemma 2 2B/9B/27B (2024-06). Capable of running locally on phones, laptops, and edge devices, these models exceeded the quality of 2023's GPT-3.5.
events.card_summary_en: Small 7B-14B models surpassed GPT-3.5 on multiple tasks through distillation + DPO.
events.why_it_matters_en:
Small-model distillation carried LLMs onto edge devices, defining the On-Device AI direction of 2024-2025.
Following the line Phi-3 (2024-04) → Llama 3.2 (2024-09) → Apple Intelligence (2024-06) → Gemini Nano on Pixel 8 (2023-12), you can see why every phone maker (Apple, Google, Huawei, Xiaomi) made local LLMs a core selling point in 2024.
events.behind_scenes_en:
The core idea of small-model distillation: synthetic data plus teacher-model distillation lets small models approach large ones.
Phi-3 trained on GPT-4 + textbook-style data.
Qwen 2.5 distilled from Qwen 72B.
Llama 3.2 distilled from Llama 3.1 405B.
The small-model line: Phi-3 (2024-04) → Llama 3.2 1B/3B (2024-09) → Qwen 2.5 7B (2024-09) → Gemma 2 2B (2024-06).
Small models put LLMs into phones: an iPhone 15 Pro's A17 Pro runs Llama 3.2 3B at 4 tokens/s.

events.title_zh: AI 办公全面嵌入
events.title_en: AI Embedded in Productivity Tools
events.summary_zh:
AI 助手全面嵌入搜索、办公、编程、设计与客服产品。
AI 不再只作为独立应用等用户打开，而是进入文档、邮件、会议、代码仓库、设计工具和客服系统。
用户开始在原来的工作流里遇到 AI。
events.source_name: General official product histories
events.card_summary_zh: AI 不再只作为独立应用等用户打开，而是进入文档、邮件、会议、代码仓库、设计工具和客服系统；AI 从独立应用，开始成为软件默认能力层。
events.summary_en: AI assistants have become deeply integrated across search, productivity, coding, design, and customer service products. No longer just standalone apps waiting to be opened, AI is moving directly into documents, emails, meetings, code repositories, design tools, and customer service systems. Users are now beginning to encounter AI right within their existing workflows.
events.card_summary_en: AI stopped waiting as standalone apps for users to open and instead entered documents, email, meetings, code repositories, design tools, and customer-service systems; AI moved from standalone apps to becoming software's default capability layer.
events.why_it_matters_en: AI moved from standalone applications to becoming the default capability layer of software.

events.title_zh: 推理模型竞赛升级
events.title_en: Reasoning Model Competition Escalates
events.summary_zh:
前沿模型竞争重点进一步转向可验证推理、工具调用和复杂任务完成率。
这件事把 industry、reasoning、agent 推到更显眼的位置。
它让研究者和产品团队重新安排下一步投入。
events.source_name: OpenAI / Google / Meta release histories
events.card_summary_zh: 这件事把 industry、reasoning、agent 推到更显眼的位置。
events.summary_en: The competitive focus for frontier models has shifted further toward verifiable reasoning, tool calling, and complex task completion rates. This shift has propelled "industry," "reasoning," and "agents" into the spotlight, prompting researchers and product teams to reallocate their next-phase investments.
events.card_summary_en: This event pushed industry, reasoning, and agents into sharper focus.
events.why_it_matters_en: It changed the yardstick for products, shifting from single-turn answer quality to agent success rates, cost, and controllability.

events.title_zh: 本地模型部署扩散
events.title_en: Local Model Deployment Expands
events.summary_zh:
量化、小模型和端侧推理推动本地部署生态持续扩大。
这些节点讲的是大模型工程路线的变化。
模型变强之后，行业开始围绕成本、可控性、知识更新、上下文长度和部署位置做取舍。
events.source_name: Meta AI / open model ecosystem
events.card_summary_zh: 模型变强之后，行业开始围绕成本、可控性、知识更新、上下文长度和部署位置做取舍。
events.summary_en: Quantization, small models, and on-device inference continue to expand the local deployment ecosystem. These milestones trace the shifting engineering pathways of large models. As these models grew more powerful, the industry began making trade-offs around cost, controllability, knowledge updates, context length, and deployment location.
events.card_summary_en: Once models grew stronger, the industry began making trade-offs around cost, controllability, knowledge freshness, context length, and where to deploy.
events.why_it_matters_en: It made privacy, offline use, and low token cost realistic choices rather than total dependence on cloud APIs.

events.title_zh: NVIDIA AI 硬件平台化
events.title_en: NVIDIA turns AI hardware into a full platform
events.summary_zh:
NVIDIA 从 GPU 厂商，逐步变成 AI 计算平台公司：芯片、CUDA、服务器、互联、软件库和开发者生态一起构成底座。
AI 能力看起来在模型层爆发，底下却是一条算力基础设施线。
CUDA、AlexNet 的 GPU 训练、V100、A100、H100、Blackwell 和 ProjectDIGITS，都应该放在 NVIDIA 二级时间线里看。
events.source_name: NVIDIA AI
events.card_summary_zh: NVIDIA 从 GPU 厂商，逐步变成 AI 计算平台公司：芯片、CUDA、服务器、互联；理解 NVIDIA，才能理解大模型时代为什么会出现算力竞争、芯片管制。
events.summary_en: NVIDIA has evolved from a GPU manufacturer into an AI computing platform company, with chips, CUDA, servers, interconnects, software libraries, and a developer ecosystem forming its foundation. While AI capabilities appear to explode at the model layer, they are driven by this underlying compute infrastructure. Milestones like CUDA, GPU training for AlexNet, the V100, A100, H100, Blackwell, and ProjectDIGITS should all be viewed within this secondary NVIDIA timeline.
events.card_summary_en: NVIDIA evolved step by step from a GPU vendor into an AI computing platform company: chips, CUDA, servers, interconnect; understanding NVIDIA is the key to understanding why the large-model era saw compute races and chip controls.
events.why_it_matters_en: Understanding NVIDIA is the key to understanding why the large-model era produced compute races, chip export controls, data-center expansion, and local AI deployment.

events.title_zh: DeepSeek-R1 发布及技术报告开源
events.title_en: DeepSeek-R1 Release & Technical Report Open-sourced
events.summary_zh:
2025 年 1 月 20 日,DeepSeek 发布 R1 推理模型;1 月 22 日公开技术报告,补充训练、强化学习、蒸馏与评测细节。
R1 以强推理表现和高关注度把推理模型竞争推到全球讨论中心:模型能不能把复杂问题拆开、检查、推演和修正。
它还带来一个更现实的刺激——如果更低成本也能做出强推理模型,前沿模型竞争的经济账就要重新算。
events.source_name: DeepSeek API Docs / Technical Report
events.card_summary_zh: DeepSeek-R1 以开放技术报告和低成本推理震动行业，证明前沿推理能力不必只属于封闭模型。
events.summary_en: On January 20, 2025, DeepSeek launched the R1 reasoning model, following up on January 22 with a technical report detailing its post-training, reinforcement learning, distillation, and evaluation. Driven by strong reasoning performance and immense attention, R1 thrust the reasoning model race into the center of global discussion: can models deconstruct, verify, reason through, and correct complex problems? It also delivered a more pragmatic shock—if powerful reasoning models can be built at a lower cost, the economic math of the frontier model race must be recalculated.
events.card_summary_en: DeepSeek-R1 shook the industry with its open technical report and low-cost inference, proving frontier-level reasoning need not belong only to closed models.
events.why_it_matters_en:
DeepSeek-R1 changed the angle from which the frontier-model race is watched.
Researchers look at the reasoning route, developers look at deployment and cost, and the industry watches how far China's open-source, high-value-for-money model route can go.
events.behind_scenes_en:
On January 20, 2025, DeepSeek released the R1 reasoning model, and on January 22, it published the technical report, detailing its additional training, reinforcement learning, distillation, and evaluation. With its strong reasoning performance and high level of attention, R1 pushed the competition over reasoning models to the center of global discussion: whether a model can break down, verify, deduce, and correct complex problems. It also delivered a more practical jolt—if a powerful reasoning model can be built at a lower cost, the economics of the frontier model race will have to be recalculated.

The viral spread of R1 did not stem solely from leaderboards, but from the question: "Must reasoning capabilities rely on expensive, closed-source models?" The simultaneous release of the technical report, open weights, and highly competitive API pricing enabled developers worldwide to personally deploy, distill, and verify this approach. It also marked the first time a Chinese model entered the center of global discussion through the combined impact of its methodology, cost, and openness.

events.title_zh: Vibe Coding 概念提出
events.title_en: Vibe Coding Coined
events.summary_zh:
2025 年 2 月 Andrej Karpathy 在 X 上发推提出 Vibe Coding——用自然语言描述需求让 LLM 写代码、不再手写。
你在跟 Cursor 或 Claude Code 对话，AI 替你写代码。
跑起来不满意继续描述继续改。
**背后现场**：Karpathy 自己说他的编程方式已经彻底变了——他不写代码了，只在 IDE 里跟 AI 对话。
这个词戳中了千万开发者的共同体验——2024 年以后写代码的方式真的变了。
**为何重要**：据 YC 对该届创业公司的调查统计,约 25% 的公司代码库中 95% 的代码由 AI 生成——这是 Vibe Coding 范式在早期创业团队渗透率的一个调查样本,并非 Vibe Coding 概念本身的定义。
编程的范式从手写转向了跟 AI 对话——Vibe Coding 是这个转变的名字。
**关联卡片**：Vibe Coding、Karpathy
events.card_summary_zh: Vibe Coding 概念提出，并成为这一阶段值得追踪的关键变化。
events.summary_en: In February 2025, Andrej Karpathy tweeted on X to propose "Vibe Coding"—a paradigm shift from hand-coding to describing requirements in natural language so LLMs write the code, allowing developers to converse with tools like Cursor or Claude Code and iteratively modify the output. This struck a chord with millions of developers whose workflows transformed after 2024, with Karpathy himself stating he no longer writes code but only talks to AI in his IDE. Highlighting the paradigm's penetration in early startups rather than defining the concept itself, a YC survey of that batch revealed that about 25% of the companies had 95% of their codebase generated by AI (Related cards: Vibe Coding, Karpathy).
events.card_summary_en: The concept of Vibe Coding was coined, becoming a key change worth tracking in this period.
events.why_it_matters_en: Vibe Coding marks the shift of programming from handwriting to conversing with AI: in 2025, 25% of YC startups had 95% of their code generated by AI.

events.title_zh: GPT-4.5 研究预览
events.title_en: GPT-4.5 Research Preview
events.summary_zh:
OpenAI 于 2025 年 2 月 26 日发布 GPT-4.5 研究预览，并强调预训练与后训练继续扩展。
GPT-4.5 更像一次能力边界测试：继续扩大预训练能带来什么，后训练怎样改善聊天、写作、创造性和复杂任务表现。
前沿竞争仍在探索规模、数据和对齐之间的配比。
events.source_name: OpenAI - Introducing GPT-4.5
events.card_summary_zh: OpenAI 于 2025 年 2 月 26 日发布 GPT-4.5 研究预览，并强调预训练与后训练继续扩展。
events.summary_en: On February 26, 2025, OpenAI released the GPT-4.5 research preview, emphasizing the continued scaling of both pre-training and post-training. The model serves as a test of capability boundaries, exploring what further pre-training can unlock and how post-training improves performance in chatting, writing, creativity, and complex tasks. Meanwhile, the frontier competition continues to search for the optimal mix of scale, data, and alignment.
events.card_summary_en: On February 26, 2025, OpenAI released the GPT-4.5 research preview, stressing that pretraining and post-training both continue to scale.
events.why_it_matters_en: It showed that frontier-model competition still leans on large-scale pretraining while also reinforcing chat and creative capabilities.

events.title_zh: 4o 图像生成上线
events.title_en: 4o Image Generation
events.summary_zh:
OpenAI 于 2025 年 3 月 24 日推出 4o 图像生成，使图像生成进一步融入聊天工作流。
生成式 AI 的扩张已经扩展到文字里。
图像、视频、声音和文本逐步接到同一套模型能力上，创作工具和内容生产流程也跟着被重写。
events.source_name: OpenAI - Introducing 4o Image Generation
events.card_summary_zh: OpenAI 于 2025 年 3 月 24 日推出 4o 图像生成，使图像生成进一步融入聊天工作流；代表生成图像功能正从独立模型品牌转向统一多模态助手体验。
events.summary_en: On March 24, 2025, OpenAI launched 4o image generation, further embedding image creation into chat workflows. The expansion of generative AI has already stretched into text. As images, video, audio, and text are gradually hooked into the same set of model capabilities, creative tools and content production workflows are being rewritten.
events.card_summary_en: On March 24, 2025, OpenAI launched 4o image generation, folding image creation further into chat workflows; it marked image generation moving from a standalone model brand toward a unified multimodal assistant experience.
events.why_it_matters_en: This marked image generation moving from standalone model brands toward a unified multimodal assistant experience.

events.title_zh: Llama 4 发布
events.title_en: Llama 4 Release
events.summary_zh:
Meta 于 2025 年 4 月 4 日发布 Llama 4 开源模型 Scout 和 Maverick，并强调原生多模态与超长上下文。
开放模型继续把战场推向多模态、长上下文和更复杂的任务执行。
Llama 4 的意义在于让开放生态继续参与最前沿的产品能力竞争。
events.source_name: Meta AI - Llama 4
events.card_summary_zh: Meta 于 2025 年 4 月 4 日发布 Llama 4 开源模型 Scout 和 Maverick；显示开放模型在多模态和超长 context 上继续追赶前沿闭源系统。
events.summary_en: On April 4, 2025, Meta released its Llama 4 open-source models, Scout and Maverick, placing a heavy focus on native multimodality and ultra-long context. The release pushes the open-model battlefield further into multimodality, long contexts, and complex task execution. Ultimately, Llama 4's significance lies in keeping the open ecosystem competitive at the absolute frontier of product capabilities.
events.card_summary_en: On April 4, 2025, Meta released the open models Llama 4 Scout and Maverick; it showed open models continuing to chase frontier closed systems on multimodality and ultra-long context.
events.why_it_matters_en: It showed open models continuing to chase frontier closed systems on multimodality and ultra-long context.

events.title_zh: OpenAI 推出 Codex 云端编程 Agent
events.title_en: OpenAI Codex Cloud Coding Agent
events.summary_zh:
2025 年 4-5 月,OpenAI 把 Codex 从模型推进到完整的云端软件工程 Agent 产品线:读取仓库、规划改动、运行命令、改文件、验证结果,把模型、工具调用、沙箱、测试和人类审阅连成一条工程链路。
人提出目标和边界,Agent 读取项目、拆任务、动手改、跑检查,再把结果交回给人审阅。
events.source_name: OpenAI - Introducing Codex
events.card_summary_zh: Codex 从代码补全走向云端代理：它能读取仓库、运行测试并并行处理任务，软件开发开始进入委托模式。
events.summary_en: Between April and May 2025, OpenAI evolved Codex from a standalone model into a complete cloud-based software engineering agent product line, linking models, tool calls, sandboxes, testing, and human review into a unified engineering pipeline that reads repositories, plans changes, runs commands, modifies files, and verifies results. Under this workflow, humans define the goals and boundaries, while the agent ingests the project, breaks down tasks, executes the edits, and runs checks before handing the results back for human review.
events.card_summary_en: Codex went from code completion to cloud agent: it reads repositories, runs tests, and handles tasks in parallel, moving software development into delegation mode.
events.why_it_matters_en:
Codex moved coding agents from demo capability to product lines, turning AI programming from one-off conversations into sustained engineering collaboration.
Permissions, security, testing, handoffs, and traceability will matter more and more.
events.behind_scenes_en:
In April-May 2025, OpenAI advanced Codex from a model to a complete cloud-based software engineering Agent product line: reading repositories, planning changes, running commands, modifying files, and verifying results, linking the model, tool calls, sandboxes, testing, and human review into a single engineering pipeline. Humans set the goals and boundaries, while the Agent reads the project, breaks down tasks, executes the modifications, runs checks, and then hands the results back to humans for review.

The key change for Codex was shifting the work from a chat window to an isolated cloud environment. The agent can read repositories, run commands and tests, and then hand the modifications back to humans for review; this requires the product to simultaneously handle permissions, network access, logging, failure recovery, and code ownership. As a result, programming assistants have evolved from "completing the next line" to "taking on the next task."

events.title_zh: 2025 前沿模型与 Agent 集中显形
events.title_en: Frontier models and agents become unmistakable in 2025
events.summary_zh:
2025 年，前沿模型、推理模型和 Agent 产品密集出现，AI 从聊天窗口继续走向工作流执行。
这一年很多发布都围绕同一个方向展开：模型要更会推理，工具要更会协作，产品要更接近真实工作。
用户看到的变化，是 AI 开始从“回答问题”走向“接住任务”。
events.source_name: OpenAI / Google DeepMind / Qwen / Anthropic
events.card_summary_zh: 模型不再只回答问题，而是开始浏览、编码、调用工具并持续执行，2025 成为 Agent 从概念走向工作流的一年。
events.summary_en: In 2025, a flurry of frontier models, reasoning models, and AI agents arrived, pushing AI past the chat window and into workflow execution. The year’s releases converged on a singular path: models that reason better, tools that collaborate more effectively, and products that mirror real-world work. For users, the shift was unmistakable—AI was moving from answering questions to taking on tasks.
events.card_summary_en: Models stopped merely answering questions and began browsing, coding, calling tools, and executing continuously, making 2025 the year agents moved from concept to workflow.
events.why_it_matters_en: It gathers the frontier names most worth seeing first in 2025 into one place, letting the timeline present the main battlefield of contemporary AI before unfolding the details.
events.behind_scenes_en:
In 2025, frontier models, reasoning models, and AI agents emerged in rapid succession, as AI continued to move beyond the chat window and into workflow execution. Many of the year's releases centered around a single direction: models must reason better, tools must collaborate better, and products must align closer to real-world work. The shift visible to users was AI transitioning from "answering questions" to "taking on tasks."

This milestone was not marked by a single product launch, but rather served as a chronological signpost of the year's shifting direction: browsers, terminals, code repositories, enterprise applications, and long-term memory began to be integrated around the models. Vendors no longer just showcased Q&A benchmark scores, but instead demonstrated whether agents could operate continuously in complex environments. It is best viewed as a defining chapter of an era, rather than product news from any single company.

events.title_zh: AlphaEvolve 发布
events.title_en: AlphaEvolve Announced
events.summary_zh:
2025 年 5 月，Google DeepMind 发布 AlphaEvolve，用 AI 辅助发现和改进算法。
它关注的是算法本身怎样被提出、测试和优化。
系统会生成候选方案，再通过评估筛掉弱结果，把更有希望的方案继续推进。
这个过程像把研究中的试错循环交给机器加速。
events.source_name: Google DeepMind - AlphaEvolve
events.card_summary_zh: Google DeepMind 发布 AlphaEvolve，用 AI 辅助发现和改进算法。
events.summary_en: In May 2025, Google DeepMind released AlphaEvolve, using AI to help discover and refine algorithms by focusing on how they are proposed, tested, and optimized. The system generates candidate solutions, filters out weak results through evaluation, and advances the most promising options. This process is like handing the research trial-and-error loop over to machines for acceleration.
events.card_summary_en: Google DeepMind released AlphaEvolve, using AI to assist in discovering and improving algorithms.
events.why_it_matters_en:
AlphaEvolve advanced AI from using existing algorithms to helping discover them.
This will affect fields that demand long-horizon trial and error, such as compilers, chips, mathematics, and engineering optimization.

events.title_zh: GLM-5.2 发布
events.title_en: GLM-5.2 Released
events.summary_zh:
智谱AI发布GLM-5.2——清华系国产大模型的最新旗舰。
在编程、多模态和Agent能力上全面升级，网上开发者评价普遍高于同期MiniMax-M3。
GLM系列一直走不同于GPT的双向注意力架构路线。
events.card_summary_zh: 智谱AI发布GLM-5.2——清华系国产大模型的最新旗舰；2026年国产大模型集中爆发——MiniMax-M3、GLM-5.2相继发布。
events.summary_en: Zhipu AI has released GLM-5.2, the latest flagship of the Tsinghua-affiliated domestic large models. Boasting comprehensive upgrades in coding, multimodal, and agent capabilities, its reception among online developers has generally surpassed that of its contemporary, MiniMax-M3. Unlike GPT, the GLM series has always carved out a different path by utilizing a bidirectional attention architecture.
events.card_summary_en: Zhipu AI released GLM-5.2, the latest flagship of the Tsinghua-lineage domestic large models; in 2026 Chinese large models burst forth in concentration, with MiniMax-M3 and GLM-5.2 arriving one after another.
events.why_it_matters_en:
Chinese large models burst forth together in 2026, with MiniMax-M3 and GLM-5.2 released one after another.
GLM-5.2 won developer praise for its distinctive architecture (bidirectional attention + autoregression) and well-rounded coding, multimodal, and Agent capabilities, showing that domestic models are not limited to following GPT's road: they are doing their own architectural exploration too.
events.behind_scenes_en:
Zhipu AI was founded by Tsinghua professor Tang Jie; from GLM-130B to GLM-4 and on to GLM-5, it has persisted with an architecture different from GPT's unidirectional one—GLM combines BERT-style bidirectional encoding with GPT-style unidirectional generation, seeking balance between understanding tasks and generation tasks.
GLM-5.2 is what this route has produced upon reaching its fifth major version.

events.title_zh: 聊天转向工作流自动化
events.title_en: Shift to Workflow Automation
events.summary_zh:
到 2026 年，行业重点从单轮聊天转向能调用工具、读写文件、浏览网页、执行多步任务的工作流系统。
用户开始关心模型能不能接住一个真实任务：读资料、做计划、用工具、留记录、遇到问题再回来确认。
这条线把 Deep Research、Codex、Claude Code、Hermes、OpenClaw 等产品和社区线索放到同一张图里：AI 正在从聊天框，走向可执行的工作流。
events.source_name: Current frontier AI product direction
events.card_summary_zh: AI 产品的中心正从“陪你聊天”转向“替你完成一串任务”，模型、工具和权限被编排成连续工作流。
events.summary_en: By 2026, the industry's focus shifted from single-turn chat to workflow systems capable of calling tools, reading and writing files, browsing the web, and executing multi-step tasks. Users began to care whether a model could handle a real-world task: reading materials, making plans, using tools, keeping logs, and looping back to double-check when encountering problems. This trajectory connects products and community projects like Deep Research, Codex, Claude Code, Hermes, and OpenClaw into a single picture: AI is moving out of the chat box and into executable workflows.
events.card_summary_en: The center of gravity of AI products is shifting from keeping you company in chat to finishing a string of tasks for you, with models, tools, and permissions orchestrated into continuous workflows.
events.why_it_matters_en: The standard for evaluating AI began shifting from answer quality to execution success rate, latency, cost, permission boundaries, and auditability.

events.title_zh: OpenClaw 进入开源个人 Agent 线索
events.title_en: OpenClaw enters the open personal-agent track
events.summary_zh:
OpenClaw 把个人 Agent 从聊天框推进到工作台。
以前你问一句，AI 回一句；
答案有用，最后还是你自己开网页、翻文件、接消息、跑流程。
龙虾之后，Agent 开始有手有脚。
它可以接消息入口，可以看你的电脑，可以连浏览器、文件、脚本和工具，把“我给你一个答案”推进到“我替你把这件事往前做”。
这指向生产力入口变化：AI 从对话窗口走进工作现场，连接资料、工具、任务和流程，帮人把事情继续往前推进。
events.source_name: 用户下载材料与本地快讯
events.card_summary_zh: 开源个人 Agent 开始连接文件、浏览器与本地工具，私人工作流不必完全依赖封闭平台。
events.summary_en: OpenClaw pushed personal agents out of the chat box and onto the workbench, moving past the era where AI merely answered questions while leaving the manual labor—opening web pages, digging through files, and running workflows—to the user. After Lobster, agents gained hands and feet, integrating with message feeds, reading screens, and connecting to browsers, files, scripts, and tools to transition from "here is your answer" to "let me get this done for you." This signals a shift in the productivity interface: AI is leaving the chat window to enter the actual workspace, linking data, tools, tasks, and workflows to keep projects moving forward.
events.card_summary_en: Open-source personal agents began connecting files, browsers, and local tools, so private workflows no longer have to depend entirely on closed platforms.
events.why_it_matters_en:
OpenClaw puts the key change of the personal agent plainly: AI must not only chat, it must receive messages, see the computer, connect tools, and run processes.
Whoever hooks this set of hands and feet onto the personal desktop may change how ordinary people use AI.

events.title_zh: Hermes Agent 进入自我改进 Agent 线索
events.title_en: Hermes Agent enters the self-improving agent track
events.summary_zh:
Hermes Agent 代表一种长期协作型 Agent：工具调用、记忆、Skill 和自我改进不再分散，而是在一次次任务里形成循环。
普通 Agent 做完一次任务就结束。
Hermes 这类系统更关心另一件事：这次踩过的坑、形成的流程、用户确认过的偏好，能不能沉淀下来，下次少解释、少犯错、做得更顺。
这和词典里讲的 Learning Loop、Skill、Memory Consolidation 是同一条线。
AI 在长期协作里逐步沉淀工作习惯。
events.source_name: 本地 Hermes 资料与正式词典卡片
events.card_summary_zh: 这和词典里讲的 Learning Loop、Skill、Memory Consolidation 是同一条线。
events.summary_en: Unlike ordinary agents that shut down after a single task, the Hermes Agent represents a long-term collaborative agent where tool calling, memory, Skill, and self-improvement form a continuous loop across tasks. Systems like Hermes focus on whether past pitfalls, established workflows, and user-confirmed preferences can be retained to minimize explanation, prevent mistakes, and run smoother next time—aligning with the concepts of a Learning Loop, Skill, and Memory Consolidation. Through this long-term collaboration, the AI gradually solidifies its own work habits.
events.card_summary_en: This runs along the same line as Learning Loop, Skill, and Memory Consolidation described in the dictionary.
events.why_it_matters_en:
Hermes pushed the focus of agents from being able to call tools to being able to accumulate experience.
If this line works out, personal AI assistants will become more like long-term partners, cutting the repeated explaining that starts from zero every time.

events.title_zh: GPT-5.5 成为 OpenAI 当前主力模型线
events.title_en: GPT-5.5 becomes OpenAI’s current frontier model line
events.summary_zh:
GPT-5.5 是 OpenAI 在 GPT-5 系列之后继续推进的当前主力模型线，连接 ChatGPT、Codex、API、推理、编码和工具使用。
这条主轴不能停在 GPT-5。
GPT-5、5.1、5.2、5.4 更适合放进二级迭代线，GPT-5.5 才能代表当前 OpenAI 模型线的最新方向。
events.source_name: OpenAI
events.card_summary_zh: GPT-5.5 将长程推理、工具调用与专业工作整合进主力模型线，Agent 能力开始成为默认配置。
events.summary_en: GPT-5.5 is OpenAI's current flagship model line succeeding the GPT-5 series, linking ChatGPT, Codex, APIs, reasoning, coding, and tool use. This core trajectory cannot stop at GPT-5; while GPT-5, 5.1, 5.2, and 5.4 are better suited for secondary iteration lines, it is GPT-5.5 that represents the true frontier of OpenAI's current model lineup.
events.card_summary_en: GPT-5.5 folded long-horizon reasoning, tool calling, and professional work into the flagship model line, making agent capability part of the default configuration.
events.why_it_matters_en:
GPT-5.5 shows that frontier-model competition has entered a stage of continuous system iteration.
A timeline must capture the current flagship nodes while avoiding stretching every minor version onto the main axis.

events.title_zh: Claude Opus 4.8 发布——Agent和长程编程再升级
events.title_en: Claude Opus 4.8 Released
events.summary_zh:
2026年5月Anthropic发布Claude Opus 4.8——在编码、Agent任务和长程工作流稳定性上进一步提升。
Opus 4.8特别优化了长时间多步骤任务中的一致性——减少中途丢失上下文和偏离任务的问题。
Opus 4.8的重点不在跑分——在稳定性。
Anthropic的客户反馈说之前的模型在短任务上表现很好但跑几个小时后容易跑偏。
4.8把长程一致性当作第一优先级——这正好是Agent应用最需要的东西——不是一次性的聪明——是持续好几个小时的可靠。
events.card_summary_zh: 2026年5月Anthropic发布Claude Opus 4.8——在编码。
events.summary_en: In May 2026, Anthropic released Claude Opus 4.8, delivering further improvements in coding, agent tasks, and long-range workflow stability. Focusing on stability rather than benchmark scores, the update optimizes consistency in long, multi-step tasks to reduce context loss and mid-way task drift. This addresses customer feedback that previous models performed well on short tasks but drifted after running for hours, prioritizing the sustained, hours-long reliability that agent applications need over one-off cleverness.
events.card_summary_en: In May 2026 Anthropic released Claude Opus 4.8, upgrading agents and long-horizon coding.
events.why_it_matters_en: Opus 4.8 represents AI's engineered evolution from short conversations to long-running tasks: agents are not a party trick, they must run multi-hour jobs stably and without errors.
events.behind_scenes_en: Opus 4.8 continued the Constitutional-AI-plus-long-horizon-tool-calling route Anthropic established with Claude 4 Opus from 2025, adding large amounts of RL data drawn from multi-step agent trajectories on the training side, and introducing context-compression plus mid-run checkpoint mechanisms on the engineering side to suppress drift across hours-long tasks. Internally Anthropic defined this generation as reliability ahead of peak capability, standing in deliberate contrast to the benchmark-chasing lines of OpenAI's GPT-5 and Google's Gemini 2.5 Pro.

events.title_zh: 《史记》开源知识库发布：验证智能体本体构建新范式
events.title_en: Shiji Knowledge Base Released, Validating Agentic Ontology Paradigm
events.summary_zh: 鲍捷正式发布《史记》知识库（shiji-kb），用 AI 智能体将整个《史记》57万字转换为包含 1.4 万个实体、12.6 万次标注和 3,198 个历史事件的交互式知识图谱。项目未用传统代码，完全由 Agent 读写「SKILL」指令并历经 5 轮反思修正构建，验证了「智能体本体构建」的可行性。
events.card_summary_zh: 《史记》开源知识库发布，展示如何利用 AI 智能体与结构化指令（SKILL）在短时间内构建大规模高精度古籍知识图谱。
events.card_summary_en: The Shiji Knowledge Base is released, demonstrating how autonomous agents and structured instructions (SKILLs) can build massive ancient texts into KGs.
events.why_it_matters_en: It provides a reusable framework for digital humanities and agentic knowledge engineering, scaling ancient texts into verified structured networks.
events.behind_scenes_en: Driven by a Butler agent executing 12k runs, the system leveraged multi-layer reflections (workflow, schema, audit) to prune 20k annotation anomalies.
events.source_name: GitHub

events.title_zh: Co-Scientist 公开
events.title_en: Co-Scientist Announced
events.summary_zh:
Google DeepMind 于 2026 年 5 月公开 AI 科研协作系统（Co-Scientist），多智能体科研辅助系统方向已进入公开展示阶段。
Co-Scientist 这类系统把 AI 从单个助手推向科研流程里的多角色协作：提假设、查资料、设计实验、互相质疑。
它的意义是探索科研工作能否被拆成多个 Agent 可以辅助推进的环节。
events.source_name: Google DeepMind - Co-Scientist
events.card_summary_zh: Co-Scientist 用多个专门 Agent 共同提出、批评和筛选假设，AI 开始参与科学研究的完整推理循环。
events.summary_en: In May 2026, Google DeepMind unveiled Co-Scientist, an AI scientific collaboration system that brings multi-agent research assistants into the public demonstration phase. Rather than acting as a single assistant, systems like Co-Scientist push AI into multi-role collaboration across the research workflow—formulating hypotheses, searching literature, designing experiments, and challenging one another. Its significance lies in exploring whether scientific research can be broken down into discrete steps that multiple AI agents can help drive forward.
events.card_summary_en: Co-Scientist let specialist agents propose, critique, and filter hypotheses together.
events.why_it_matters_en: It shows AI upgrading from single-model question answering to multi-agent collaboration, coming closer to real research and the division of labor in complex tasks.
events.behind_scenes_en:
In May 2026, Google DeepMind unveiled its AI scientific research collaboration system, Co-Scientist, signaling that the field of multi-agent scientific research assistant systems has entered the public demonstration stage. Systems like Co-Scientist push AI from a single assistant toward multi-role collaboration within the scientific research process: proposing hypotheses, searching literature, designing experiments, and challenging one another. Its significance lies in exploring whether scientific research work can be broken down into multiple steps that agents can help advance.

Rather than having a single model play the role of a scientist on its own, Co-Scientist distributes generation, criticism, ranking, and validation among multiple agents, with human researchers setting the problems and checking the results. This structure draws on peer discussions in real scientific research, yet it still relies on high-quality tools, experimental feedback, and expert judgment.

events.title_zh: MiniMax-M3 开源发布
events.title_en: MiniMax M3 Open Source Release
events.summary_zh:
MiniMax 发布并开源 M3——把编程能力、100万 token 长上下文和视觉理解放进同一个模型。
国产模型首次在单一开源模型中同时解决代码、长文和看图三个场景，不再需要为不同任务切换模型。
events.card_summary_zh: MiniMax 发布并开源 M3——把编程能力、100万 token 长上下文和视觉理解放进同一个模型。
events.summary_en: MiniMax has released and open-sourced M3, packing coding capabilities, a 1-million-token long context, and visual understanding into a single model. This marks the first time a domestic model has tackled coding, long-text, and image-viewing scenarios within a single open-source model, eliminating the need to switch models for different tasks.
events.card_summary_en: MiniMax open-sourced M3, putting coding, million-token context, and vision in one model.
events.why_it_matters_en: It solved a long-standing pain point of the domestic model ecosystem: strong coders could not read long documents, long-document readers could not process images, and image models could not write code.
