M3 merged all three using its self-developed MSA sparse attention architecture, at a self-hosting cost lower than calling closed-source APIs, delivering practical value for teams facing compound scenarios like contract analysis and codebase comprehension.
events.behind_scenes_en: MiniMax poured long-term R&D into sparse attention architecture: MSA is not a simple variant bolted onto the standard Transformer but a sparse attention mechanism designed from the ground up, holding clear advantages over equally sized dense models in memory use and speed on long texts. Behind it sits the shift of Chinese AI companies from following others to designing their own architectures.

events.title_zh: Claude Fable 5 与 Mythos 5 发布
events.title_en: Claude Fable 5 and Mythos 5 released
events.summary_zh:
Anthropic 发布 Claude Fable 5 和 Claude Mythos 5，把 Mythos-class 能力带入两个不同访问层级。
Fable 5 是面向一般使用的公开版本，带有更保守的 safeguards；
Mythos 5 是同一底层模型的受限访问版本，先面向网络防御者和基础设施提供方，通过 Project Glasswing 推进。
最新补充：2026-06-13，据 The Verge 等媒体报道，Anthropic 在美国政府以国家安全为由发布出口管制指令后，暂停 Fable 5 和 Mythos 5 对外国用户的访问；
这让这条新闻从“分层发布”进一步变成“高能力模型会被政策和安全边界迅速收紧”的案例。
这条线的重点不是多一个模型名，而是强模型发布方式变了：能力、安全护栏、访问资格、用途审计和政策边界开始被一起设计。
events.source_name: Anthropic / The Verge
events.card_summary_zh: Anthropic 将更长程的知识工作与安全边界推向新一代模型，能力提升与部署限制第一次如此紧密地并置。
events.summary_en: Anthropic released Claude Fable 5 and Claude Mythos 5, bringing Mythos-class capabilities to two distinct access tiers: Fable 5, a general-use public version with conservative safeguards, and Mythos 5, a restricted-access version of the same underlying model deployed initially to cyber defenders and infrastructure providers via Project Glasswing. However, on June 13, 2026, outlets including The Verge reported that Anthropic suspended foreign access to both models following a US national security export control directive, shifting the narrative from a tiered release to a case study in how policy and security boundaries are rapidly tightening around high-capability AI. The key takeaway is not just a new model name, but a fundamental shift in how powerful models are deployed, with capability, safeguards, access credentials, usage audits, and policy boundaries now being designed in unison.
events.card_summary_en: Anthropic carried longer-horizon knowledge work and safety limits into its newest models.
events.why_it_matters_en: Fable 5 and Mythos 5 demonstrated high-capability models entering a release structure of public edition plus trusted-access edition. Future frontier competition will weigh not only capability but who can design safety boundaries, access plans, and actual uses most clearly.

events.title_zh: Claude Sonnet 5 发布：Agent 工作流进入更低成本区间
events.title_en: Claude Sonnet 5 Released for Agentic Workflows
events.summary_zh: Anthropic 发布 Claude Sonnet 5，强调其规划、工具调用和自主执行能力。模型面向 Claude、Claude Code 与 Claude Platform 提供，首发优惠价格为每百万输入 token 2 美元、输出 token 10 美元。
events.source_name: Anthropic
events.card_summary_zh: Sonnet 5 把规划、终端和浏览器操作下放到更低成本层级，持续运行 Agent 不再只能依赖最贵模型。
events.summary_en: Anthropic released Claude Sonnet 5, highlighting its planning, tool-use and autonomous execution capabilities. The model is available across Claude, Claude Code and the Claude Platform, with a launch price of $2 per million input tokens and $10 per million output tokens.
events.card_summary_en: Sonnet 5 moved planning, terminal, and browser work to a cheaper tier for always-on agents.
events.why_it_matters_en: Frontier model competition has begun turning away from chasing maximum capability alone, toward balance among capability, cost, and sustainable operation.
events.behind_scenes_en: The point of this release was not benchmark scores but pushing agent workflows that previously required larger models down to Sonnet level, making continuously running coding, browser, and terminal tasks far easier to keep within budget.

events.title_zh: 寒武纪市值突破 1 万亿人民币——科创板首家万亿公司
events.title_en: Cambricon Reaches 1 Trillion RMB Market Cap
events.summary_zh:
2026 年 6 月 30 日，寒武纪股价涨近 8%，突破历史新高，总市值正式突破 1 万亿人民币，成为科创板历史上第一家万亿市值公司。
这一天碰巧和美团长猫 2.0 的发布同一天——模型侧证明了国产芯片能训万亿参数的前沿模型，芯片侧证明了这个市场大到足以撑起万亿市值。
一个万亿是国产算力训出来的模型参数，一个万亿是二级市场给国产算力的估值。
events.card_summary_zh: 寒武纪股价涨近 8%，突破历史新高，总市值正式突破 1 万亿人民币，成为科创板历史上第一家万亿市值公司。
events.summary_en: On June 30, 2026, Cambricon’s stock surged nearly 8% to a record high, pushing its total market cap past 1 trillion RMB and making it the first-ever trillion-yuan company on the STAR Market. This milestone coincided with the debut of Meituan’s Changmao 2.0—proving on the model side that domestic chips can train trillion-parameter frontier AI, and on the chip side that the market is vast enough to sustain a trillion-yuan valuation. One trillion represents the parameters trained on domestic compute; the other is the valuation awarded to domestic compute by the secondary market.
events.card_summary_en: Cambricon shares rose near eight percent to record highs, market cap topping one trillion yuan.
events.why_it_matters_en: Cambricon's trillion-yuan capitalization marks domestic AI chips completing the whole path from laboratory concept to trillion-scale valuation. Intertwined with Meituan's trillion-parameter LongCat, this same-day collision of supply and demand carries a peculiar sense of history.
events.behind_scenes_en: Cambricon was founded in 2016 by brothers Chen Tianshi and Chen Yunji of the Chinese Academy of Sciences' Institute of Computing Technology. It made its name in 2017 when Huawei's Kirin 970 shipped carrying its NPU, listed on the STAR Market in 2020 as the first domestic AI chip stock, and saw its market cap pass one trillion yuan on June 30, 2026. From 2016 to 2026, exactly ten years.

events.title_zh: 美团发布并开源 LongCat-2.0
events.title_en: Meituan Releases and Open-Sources LongCat-2.0
events.summary_zh: 美团发布 LongCat-2.0：总参数 1.6T、平均激活约 48B，原生支持 1M 上下文，并宣布对外开源。官方称其全流程训练与推理运行在五万卡国产算力集群上，重点面向 Agentic Coding。
events.source_name: 美团技术团队
events.card_summary_zh: LongCat-2.0 在国产五万卡集群上完成万亿参数训练并开放权重，展示了另一套前沿模型基础设施路径。
events.summary_en: Meituan released and open-sourced LongCat-2.0: 1.6T total parameters with about 48B activated on average, native 1M-token context. The company said the entire training and inference pipeline ran on a 50,000-GPU domestic compute cluster, with Agentic Coding as the primary focus.
events.card_summary_en: Trained on fifty thousand domestic cards, LongCat-2.0 opened its trillion-parameter weights.
events.why_it_matters_en: It was at once an open-model event and a public demonstration of the engineering capability of China's large-scale AI infrastructure.
events.behind_scenes_en: LongCat-2.0 placed model architecture, domestic compute clusters, and coding-agent scenarios inside a single engineering system, demonstrating ultra-large sparse models put into practice on non-NVIDIA training infrastructure.

events.title_zh: JADEPUFFER：自主 Agent 串联完整勒索攻击链
events.title_en: JADEPUFFER Demonstrates Agentic Ransomware
events.summary_zh: Sysdig 披露 JADEPUFFER：一个由 AI Agent 驱动的数据库勒索行动。研究人员观察到 600 多个具有连贯目的的 payload，攻击过程覆盖初始入侵、横向移动、持久化与数据库破坏。
events.source_name: Sysdig Threat Research Team
events.card_summary_zh: JADEPUFFER 将侦察、横向移动和数据库破坏串成自主攻击链，Agent 的安全风险从辅助工具升级为执行主体。
events.summary_en: Sysdig disclosed JADEPUFFER, a database ransomware campaign driven by AI agents. Researchers observed more than 600 payloads working toward a coherent goal, covering initial intrusion, lateral movement, persistence and database destruction.
events.card_summary_en: JADEPUFFER chained recon, lateral movement, and database damage into autonomous attack.
events.why_it_matters_en: AI security risk advanced from assisted attack to autonomously orchestrated attack chains, requiring defenders to monitor model capability, tool permissions, and runtime isolation all at once.
events.behind_scenes_en: No individual technique was novel; the change was that an agent could chain years-old known vulnerabilities and tools into a complete pipeline, adjusting its next move according to results as it ran.

events.title_zh: GPT-5.6 面向 ChatGPT、Codex 与 API 推出
events.title_en: OpenAI Launches GPT-5.6 Across ChatGPT, Codex, and API
events.summary_zh: OpenAI 发布 GPT-5.6 系列 Sol、Terra 与 Luna，并开始在 ChatGPT、Codex 和 API 中全球上线。三个层级分别面向高难度专业工作、日常平衡型任务和低成本高速推理。
events.source_name: OpenAI
events.card_summary_zh: GPT-5.6 以 Sol、Terra、Luna 三档覆盖能力、速度和成本，前沿模型开始按 Agent 任务精细分层。
events.summary_en: OpenAI released the GPT-5.6 family — Sol, Terra and Luna — rolling them out globally across ChatGPT, Codex and the API. The three tiers target demanding professional work, everyday balanced tasks, and low-cost high-speed reasoning respectively.
events.card_summary_en: GPT-5.6 arrived in Sol, Terra, and Luna tiers spanning capability, speed, and cost.
events.why_it_matters_en: Model competition entered a stage of capability tiering plus agent deployment, and Codex also became an important launch surface for frontier models.
events.behind_scenes_en: OpenAI no longer covers all work with a single flagship model, instead splitting capability, speed, and cost into clean tiers so agent workflows can choose inference resources matched to task difficulty.

events.title_zh: Apple 起诉 OpenAI，指控其窃取商业机密
events.title_en: Apple Sues OpenAI Over Alleged Trade Secret Theft
events.summary_zh: Apple 在加州联邦法院起诉 OpenAI，指控其招募的前 Apple 员工带走与 AI 硬件相关的机密资料。这标志着双方从 2024 年的产品合作进一步走向竞争与法律冲突。
events.source_name: AP News
events.card_summary_zh: Apple 在加州联邦法院起诉 OpenAI，指控其招募的前 Apple 员工带走与 AI 硬件相关的机密资料。
events.summary_en: Apple sued OpenAI in federal court in California, alleging that former Apple employees it recruited walked away with confidential materials related to AI hardware. The suit marks a further slide from the two companies' 2024 product partnership into competition and legal conflict.
events.card_summary_en: Apple sued OpenAI in California federal court over ex-employees leaving with hardware secrets.
events.why_it_matters_en: As AI companies push into hardware and consumer entry points, the fight for talent is evolving into a matter of intellectual property and industrial alliances.
events.behind_scenes_en: The litigation focuses on talent movement, hardware R&D, and the boundaries of trade secrets rather than plain model competition.

events.title_zh: Thinking Machines 发布首个开放权重模型 Inkling
events.title_en: Thinking Machines Releases Open-Weights Model Inkling
events.summary_zh: Thinking Machines Lab 发布 Inkling，这是该实验室首个开放权重模型。团队称模型从头训练，并同时开放原始检查点与面向 NVIDIA Blackwell 的 NVFP4 检查点。
events.source_name: Thinking Machines Lab
events.card_summary_zh: Thinking Machines 以开放权重推出首个模型 Inkling，前 OpenAI 核心成员的新实验室正式进入模型竞争。
events.summary_en: Thinking Machines Lab released Inkling, the lab's first open-weight model. The team said it was trained from scratch, with both the original checkpoint and an NVFP4 checkpoint for NVIDIA Blackwell hardware made public.
events.card_summary_en: Thinking Machines launched its first model Inkling with open weights, entering the model race.
events.why_it_matters_en: Competition among frontier labs no longer happens only through proprietary APIs; it extends to open weights, training tools, and developer ecosystems.
events.behind_scenes_en: The lab founded by Mira Murati chose to release its first model as open weights, paired with inference and reinforcement-learning tooling, emphasizing customizability and reproducibility.

events.title_zh: Kimi K3 发布：首个开放的 3T 级模型
events.title_en: Kimi K3 Introduced as an Open 3T-Class Model
events.summary_zh: 月之暗面发布 Kimi K3：总参数 2.8T、896 个专家中激活 16 个，支持 100 万 token 上下文，面向长程编程、知识工作与推理。官方计划在 7 月 27 日前发布完整权重。
events.source_name: Kimi / Moonshot AI
events.card_summary_zh: Kimi K3 将 2.8 万亿参数、百万上下文和长程编程结合，开放权重模型首次迈入 3T 规模。
events.summary_en: Moonshot AI released Kimi K3: 2.8T total parameters with 16 of 896 experts activated per token, 1M-token context, aimed at long-horizon coding, knowledge work and reasoning. Full weights were slated for release by July 27.
events.card_summary_en: Kimi K3 joined 2.8T parameters, million-token context, and long coding, opening the 3T era.
events.why_it_matters_en: Open-weight models continue advancing toward frontier scale, offering researchers and developers another route besides closed-source APIs.
events.behind_scenes_en: Kimi K3 combined Kimi Delta Attention, Attention Residuals, and Stable LatentMoE to bring together model scale, sparse activation, and long context.

events.title_zh: Claude Opus 5 发布，强化长程 Agent 与研究能力
events.title_en: Anthropic Releases Claude Opus 5
events.summary_zh: Anthropic 发布 Claude Opus 5，重点提升长程 Agent、调试、科学研究和复杂知识工作能力。模型在 Claude 各平台与 API 上线，价格与 Opus 4.8 相同。
events.source_name: Anthropic
events.card_summary_zh: Opus 5 强化验证、调试和长时间持续执行，旗舰模型的竞争焦点进一步转向可靠的长程 Agent。
events.summary_en: Anthropic released Claude Opus 5, with major gains in long-horizon agents, debugging, scientific research and complex knowledge work. The model went live across Claude platforms and the API at the same price as Opus 4.8.
events.card_summary_en: Opus 5 sharpened verification, debugging, and sustained execution for dependable long-run agents.
events.why_it_matters_en: The reliability, cost, and consistency of long-horizon agents are becoming the core metrics of flagship-model competition.
events.behind_scenes_en: Anthropic stressed the model's stability in verifying its own work, iterating continuously, and sustaining complex open-ended tasks, reflecting frontier models shifting from one-shot answers to long-duration execution.

events.title_zh: MCP 2026-07-28 规范发布：核心转向无状态架构
events.title_en: MCP 2026-07-28 Specification Moves to a Stateless Core
events.summary_zh: Model Context Protocol 发布第五版规范，核心传输转向无状态设计，同时强化授权机制，并推动官方扩展进入稳定阶段。Anthropic 同日宣布在 Claude 产品中支持新版规范。
events.source_name: Model Context Protocol / Anthropic
events.card_summary_zh: 新版 MCP 转向无状态核心并强化授权，让 Agent 连接外部工具的开放协议更适合大规模生产部署。
events.summary_en: Model Context Protocol published its fifth specification revision, moving core transport to a stateless design, hardening authorization, and ushering official extensions toward stability. Anthropic announced same-day support for the new spec across Claude products.
events.card_summary_en: The new MCP spec went stateless with hardened authorization, fit for production-scale agents.
events.why_it_matters_en: MCP is growing from a single company's connection scheme into a more scalable open protocol for connecting agents to external tools.
events.behind_scenes_en: A stateless core removes session constraints on MCP servers during load balancing, failure recovery, and large-scale deployment, a key adjustment as the agent tool ecosystem moves from experimentation toward infrastructure.

events.title_zh: OpenAI 大幅下调 GPT-5.6 Luna 与 Terra 价格
events.title_en: OpenAI Cuts GPT-5.6 Luna and Terra Prices
events.summary_zh: OpenAI 将 GPT-5.6 Luna 的价格下调 80%，Terra 下调 20%，并为 Sol API 增加更快的推理选项。
events.source_name: OpenAI
events.card_summary_zh: GPT-5.6 发布数周后即大幅降价，Agent 竞争从能力榜单迅速延伸到每个任务的真实运行成本。
events.summary_en: OpenAI cut the price of GPT-5.6 Luna by 80% and Terra by 20%, and added a faster inference option for the Sol API.
events.card_summary_en: Weeks after GPT-5.6 launched, prices fell sharply, competition spreading to true per-task costs.
events.why_it_matters_en: Lower inference costs directly widen the feasible range of agents, automation, and high-frequency API workflows.
events.behind_scenes_en: Cutting prices significantly just weeks after a frontier model launch shows the competitive focus rapidly extending from capability leaderboards to per-task cost and inference efficiency.

events.title_zh: DeepSeek-V4-Flash-0731 更新开放权重模型
events.title_en: DeepSeek Updates Its Open-Weights V4 Flash Model
events.summary_zh: DeepSeek 更新 V4 Flash 开放权重模型。Hugging Face 官方集合显示 DeepSeek-V4-Flash-0731 已发布，模型规模约 304B 参数。
events.source_name: DeepSeek / Hugging Face
events.card_summary_zh: DeepSeek 继续以开放权重快速迭代 V4 Flash，前沿模型的更新节奏正在接近持续交付的软件产品。
events.summary_en: DeepSeek updated its V4 Flash open-weight model. The official Hugging Face collection shows DeepSeek-V4-Flash-0731 is out, at roughly 304B parameters.
events.card_summary_en: DeepSeek kept iterating V4 Flash in open weights, frontier updates nearing continuous delivery.
events.why_it_matters_en: Continuous iteration of open-weight models lets researchers and developers evaluate, deploy, and improve frontier models on their own.
events.behind_scenes_en: The update continues DeepSeek's route of fast iteration through public weights and model collections, and makes it easy for developers to track version changes directly.

events.title_zh: Claude Code 支持在企业自有基础设施运行云端会话
events.title_en: Claude Code Adds Self-Hosted Cloud Session Environments
events.summary_zh: Anthropic 推出 Claude Code 自托管环境公测，允许团队把云端编码会话路由到自己管理的计算基础设施。
events.source_name: Anthropic / Claude
events.card_summary_zh: Claude Code 可以把云端编码任务路由到企业自有计算环境，Agent 开始进入可控、可审计的生产基础设施。
events.summary_en: Anthropic opened a public beta of a self-hosted Claude Code environment, letting teams route cloud coding sessions to infrastructure they manage themselves.
events.card_summary_en: Claude Code routes cloud coding sessions onto enterprises' own compute, auditable and contained.
events.why_it_matters_en: Coding agents are moving from personal development tools into production environments that enterprise infrastructure and security policy can govern.
events.behind_scenes_en: Enterprises can control network egress, runtime environment, and isolation policies themselves while keeping the asynchronous working style of cloud agents.

events.title_zh: OpenAI 更新 GPT-5.6 Sol，并向免费用户扩展 Luna
events.title_en: OpenAI Updates GPT-5.6 Sol and Expands Luna Access
events.summary_zh: OpenAI 更新 ChatGPT 中的 GPT-5.6 Sol，强调更聚焦的回答、更可靠的事实表现和更一致的推理体验，同时向免费用户扩大 GPT-5.6 Luna 的访问。
events.source_name: OpenAI
events.card_summary_zh: OpenAI 一边提高 Sol 的事实可靠性，一边向免费用户开放 Luna，新一代能力开始从专业层向大众扩散。
events.summary_en: OpenAI updated GPT-5.6 Sol in ChatGPT, touting sharper answers, more reliable factual performance and a more consistent reasoning experience, while expanding free-user access to GPT-5.6 Luna.
events.card_summary_en: OpenAI raised Sol's factual reliability while extending Luna to free users, diffusion downward.
events.why_it_matters_en: Broader free access spreads new-generation model capability from professional users out to everyday use cases.
events.behind_scenes_en: Rapid iteration after a frontier launch shows model releases are no longer one-time events but an ongoing product process of tuning quality, speed, and coverage.

events.title_zh: Mojo 编译器开源——面向 AI 硬件的语言交出完整工具链
events.title_en: Mojo Compiler Open-Sourced: The AI-Hardware Language Ships Its Full Toolchain
events.summary_zh: 2026 年 8 月，Modular 将 Mojo 编译器、工具链和构建所需源代码公开，采用 Apache 2.0 许可证并附 LLVM 例外。此前 Mojo 的标准库已开放，但负责把源码编译为机器代码的核心编译器始终封闭；此次开源使开发者可以从源码构建、审计并 fork 这门面向 CPU、GPU 等异构硬件的语言。
events.summary_en: In August 2026, Modular published the Mojo compiler, toolchain and the sources needed to build it under Apache 2.0 (with an LLVM exception). The standard library had been open before, but the core compiler that turns Mojo source into machine code remained closed; developers can now build, audit and fork the language aimed at CPUs, GPUs and other heterogeneous hardware from source.
events.why_it_matters_en: AI infrastructure depends not only on models but on who controls the compiler layer. Mojo combines Python-like expressiveness, MLIR compilation foundations and GPU-class performance targets; with the compiler open, the language toolchain around AI kernels, inference optimization and heterogeneous hardware finally qualifies as public infrastructure.
events.card_summary_zh: Modular 开源 Mojo 编译器：面向 AI 硬件的语言从可用但不可审计，变成可阅读、可构建、可 fork 的公共基础设施。
events.card_summary_en: Modular open-sourced the Mojo compiler, turning an AI-hardware language that was usable but unauditable into readable, buildable, forkable public infrastructure.
events.source_name: Modular Blog

events.title_zh: Artificial Analysis 发布 Search Index：检索质量第一次按全链路成本排名
events.title_en: Artificial Analysis Launches Search Index, Ranking Retrieval by Total Task Cost
events.summary_zh: Artificial Analysis 上线 Search Index，在固定 harness 中用 GPT-5.6 Luna 驱动开源 Stirrup 评测各家检索服务：Parallel 以 75 分居首，Exa 74 分、Firecrawl 73 分随后，模型直连基线只有 33 分。
events.source_name: Artificial Analysis
events.card_summary_zh: Search Index 把检索从玄学拉回可复现评测，并揭示更好的检索反而压低任务总成本。
events.summary_en: Artificial Analysis launched Search Index, using GPT-5.6 Luna to drive the open-source Stirrup harness in evaluating retrieval providers under fixed conditions: Parallel led at 75, followed by Exa at 74 and Firecrawl at 73, with the model-only baseline at just 33.
events.card_summary_en: Search Index made retrieval measurable again, and showed better search lowers total task cost.
events.why_it_matters_en: Retrieval finally has a reproducible, price-comparable full-pipeline benchmark, letting teams building production agents judge whether searching more accurately beats scaling the model bigger on total cost.
events.behind_scenes_en: The evaluation found stronger retrieval costs more per request but suppressed model token consumption enough to bring total task cost down; wherever retrieval can replace reasoning steps, the money moves from the model to the retrieval stack.

events.title_zh: Public AI Observatory 上线：真实 AI 使用第一次被独立丈量
events.title_en: Public AI Observatory Launches to Measure Real-World AI Use
events.summary_zh: MIT、Stanford 等机构共建的 Public AI Observatory 上线，公开 24,521 段经用户同意的对话、52 个模型、近 10 万轮次与 145 个标注维度，覆盖 2023 至 2026 年的真实使用。
events.source_name: Public AI Observatory
events.card_summary_zh: 公共 AI 观测站用 2.4 万段真实对话给行业一把共同的尺子，AI 使用第一次可被独立丈量。
events.summary_en: Public AI Observatory, built by MIT, Stanford and other institutions, went live — releasing 24,521 consented conversations, 52 models, nearly 100,000 turns and 145 annotation dimensions covering real-world usage from 2023 to 2026.
events.card_summary_en: Twenty-four thousand real conversations gave the industry one shared ruler for actual AI usage.
events.why_it_matters_en: Applied research gained usage-side data infrastructure independent of vendor reporting for the first time, so the real state of AI use can be continuously verified by third parties.
events.behind_scenes_en: The dataset stresses auditability and independence from vendor claims, pulling the question of how AI is actually used out of dueling self-reports and back into publicly checkable measurement.

events.title_zh: Mistral 发布 Agentic Search——企业检索从召回文本变成核验文档
events.title_en: Mistral Ships Agentic Search: Enterprise Retrieval Becomes Document Verification
events.summary_zh: 2026 年 8 月，Mistral 发布 Agentic Search，为已有企业索引加入 search、open、navigate、read、grep 五种工具。模型不再只能依据首次召回的 top-k 文本块作答，而能继续打开文档、定位页码、读取表格、比对多份来源后再回答。官方报告称 FinanceBench 正确率从 26.7% 升至 86%，OfficeQA Pro 较一次性 RAG 提高 45.6 个百分点。
events.summary_en: In August 2026, Mistral released Agentic Search, adding five tools — search, open, navigate, read and grep — to existing enterprise indexes. Instead of answering from first-recalled top-k chunks, the model can open documents, locate pages, read tables and cross-check multiple sources before answering; Mistral reports FinanceBench accuracy rising from 26.7% to 86%, and OfficeQA Pro improving by 45.6 points over one-shot RAG.
events.why_it_matters_en: This moves the object of enterprise-RAG optimization from chunks, embeddings and rerankers to a full retrieve-inspect-verify workflow. For cross-document questions over filings, contracts and scanned PDFs, retrieval stops being context feeding and becomes a tool layer the model can operate repeatedly, leaving evidence trails.
events.card_summary_zh: Agentic Search 把企业检索从一次召回变成多步核验，复杂文档问答的准确率上限被重新定义。
events.card_summary_en: Agentic Search turns enterprise retrieval from one-shot recall into multi-step verification, redefining the accuracy ceiling for complex document QA.
events.source_name: Mistral AI
events.behind_scenes_en: The evaluation found stronger retrieval costs more per request but suppressed model token consumption enough to bring total task cost down; wherever retrieval can replace reasoning steps, the money moves from the model to the retrieval stack.

events.title_zh: 阿里发布 Qwen-UI-Agent——GUI 智能体开始以真实设备为共同基座
events.title_en: Alibaba Releases Qwen-UI-Agent: GUI Agents Get a Real-Device Foundation
events.summary_zh: 2026 年 8 月，阿里发布 Qwen-UI-Agent：统一覆盖手机、电脑、浏览器和 DeepSearch 的 GUI 智能体基座模型，以 Apache 2.0 开源。它面向真实设备上的屏幕理解与点击、输入、滑动操作，而非只在模拟器中执行；官方报告 MobileWorld 得分 82.1%、真机环境 MobileWorld-Real 达 92.2%，训练评测基于 100 多台真实手机、150 多个应用构成的移动环境。
events.summary_en: In August 2026, Alibaba released Qwen-UI-Agent, a GUI agent foundation model unified across mobile, desktop, browser and DeepSearch, open-sourced under Apache 2.0. It targets on-screen understanding and touch, typing and swiping on real devices rather than simulators; the technical report gives 82.1% on MobileWorld and 92.2% on the real-device MobileWorld-Real, trained and evaluated in a mobile environment of 100+ physical phones and 150+ apps.
events.why_it_matters_en: Most software exposes no API for agents; the screen remains the universal interface of the digital world. Putting mobile, desktop and browser operations into one model with a real-device evaluation regime means agent execution boundaries are expanding from calling tools to operating off-the-shelf software.
events.card_summary_zh: Qwen-UI-Agent 用一个模型统一四类屏幕操作并以真机数据验证，GUI 智能体从单平台演示走向通用基座。
events.card_summary_en: Qwen-UI-Agent unifies four kinds of screen operation in one model validated on real devices, moving GUI agents from single-platform demos to a general foundation.
events.source_name: Qwen-UI-Agent Technical Report
events.behind_scenes_en: The evaluation found stronger retrieval costs more per request but suppressed model token consumption enough to bring total task cost down; wherever retrieval can replace reasoning steps, the money moves from the model to the retrieval stack.

timeline.title_zh: 图灵发表《论可计算数》——计算机的理论蓝图
timeline.title_en: Turing's On Computable Numbers
timeline.summary_zh: 1936 年，艾伦·图灵发表《论可计算数及其在判定问题上的应用》。为了证明希尔伯特判定问题无解，他设想了一种假想机器——无限长纸带、读写头、简单规则表——这就是图灵机，所有现代计算机的抽象蓝图。
timeline.source_name: Fireship - 10 Classic CS Papers
timeline.card_summary_zh: 图灵为了回答“什么能被计算”，提出了图灵机，也意外画出了后来所有通用计算机的理论蓝图。
timeline.summary_en: In 1936, Alan Turing published "On Computable Numbers, with an Application to the Entscheidungsproblem." To prove that Hilbert's decision problem was unsolvable, he conceived a hypothetical machine—consisting of an infinite paper tape, a read-write head, and a simple table of rules—which became the Turing machine, the abstract blueprint for all modern computers.
timeline.card_summary_en: Turing asked what can be computed and sketched the blueprint for every future computer.
timeline.why_it_matters_en: The paper defined computation itself. The Turing machine is the common ancestor of every programming language, operating system, and chip architecture. Without it there is no AI, and no computers either.
timeline.behind_scenes_en: Turing was 24 when he wrote it. His real target was Hilbert's 1928 decision problem: is there a universal algorithm that decides the truth of any mathematical statement? Turing proved the answer is no. To complete the proof he first had to define what an algorithm actually is, so he invented the Turing machine. The entire computer age is arguably a byproduct of this 36-page paper. Von Neumann later admitted that the core concept of computers sharing storage for program and data came directly from the Turing machine.

timeline.title_zh: Turing Bombe 在布莱切利园首次部署
timeline.title_en: Turing Bombe First Deployed at Bletchley Park
timeline.summary_zh:
1940 年 3 月 18 日，由艾伦·图灵设计、英国制表机公司（BTM）Harold "Doc" Keen 团队制造的第一台 Bombe 机器（绰号 "Victory"）在布莱切利园 1 号小屋正式投入运行，用于破译德军 Enigma 密码机。
Bombe 通过同时模拟多台 Enigma、用 "crib"（已推测出的明文片段）反向搜索转子设置，把数百万种可能性压缩到可以在数小时内穷举的范围。
timeline.source_name: Bletchley Park Trust - Bombe History / TNMOC Bombe Rebuild
timeline.card_summary_zh: Bombe 通过同时模拟多台 Enigma、用 "crib"（已推测出的明文片段）反向搜索转子设置；Bombe 是机器大规模介入符号推理的最早实战之一。
timeline.summary_en: On March 18, 1940, the first Bombe machine (nicknamed "Victory")—designed by Alan Turing and manufactured by Harold "Doc" Keen's team at the British Tabulating Machine Company (BTM)—officially went into operation in Hut 1 at Bletchley Park to decrypt the German Enigma cipher machine. By simulating multiple Enigmas simultaneously and using "cribs" (guessed plaintext fragments) to reverse-search rotor settings, the Bombe compressed millions of possibilities down to a range that could be exhaustively searched in just a few hours.
timeline.card_summary_en: The Bombe searched Enigma settings via cribs, an early combat debut of machine reasoning.
timeline.why_it_matters_en: The Bombe moved cryptanalysis from mental arithmetic to electromechanical parallel search, a line of thinking that resurfaced repeatedly in AI search, constraint satisfaction, and inference engines.
timeline.behind_scenes_en: Turing built directly on Polish cryptologist Marian Rejewski's 1938 bomba; Rejewski's team had broken early Enigma in 1932 and passed the results to Britain and France in July 1939. Turing's key contribution was recognizing that German signaling procedures had grown more complex, requiring search based on message text rather than indicator procedures. In August 1940 a second machine, Agnus Dei, gained Gordon Welchman's diagonal board, exploiting the symmetry of the Enigma plugboard to compress candidates roughly 26-fold, the improvement that turned the Bombe from barely usable into war-deciding. Around 200 Bombes ran during the war, operated by roughly 2,000 Wrens of the WRNS.

timeline.title_zh: McCulloch-Pitts 神经元：神经活动的逻辑演算
timeline.title_en: McCulloch-Pitts Neuron: A Logical Calculus of Nervous Activity
timeline.summary_zh:
1943 年，神经生理学家 Warren McCulloch 和 20 岁的自学逻辑学家 Walter Pitts 发表 《A Logical Calculus of the Ideas Immanent in Nervous Activity》（Bulletin of Mathematical Biophysics, 5: 115–133）。
他们把神经元抽象为一个简单的二值逻辑单元：接收多个兴奋性输入和抑制性输入，当兴奋性输入之和超过阈值且无抑制性输入时，神经元发放一个全或无的脉冲。
这种抽象让神经系统第一次可以用命题逻辑的形式语言来描述。
timeline.source_name: Bulletin of Mathematical Biophysics, 5:115-133 / Stanford Encyclopedia of Philosophy
timeline.card_summary_zh: 他们把神经元抽象为一个简单的二值逻辑单元：接收多个兴奋性输入和抑制性输入，当兴奋性输入之和超过阈值且无抑制性输入时。
timeline.summary_en: In 1943, neurophysiologist Warren McCulloch and 20-year-old self-taught logician Walter Pitts published “A Logical Calculus of the Ideas Immanent in Nervous Activity” (*Bulletin of Mathematical Biophysics*, 5: 115–133). They abstracted the neuron into a simple binary logic unit that receives multiple excitatory and inhibitory inputs, firing an all-or-none pulse when the sum of excitatory inputs exceeds a threshold and no inhibitory input is present. This abstraction allowed the nervous system to be described in the formal language of propositional logic for the first time.
timeline.card_summary_en: They reduced the neuron to a binary logic unit, making nervous activity computable.
timeline.why_it_matters_en: It was the first building block of neural network research, pulling machine simulation of nervous systems from philosophy into computable models. Perceptrons, backpropagation, and deep learning grew far more complex but all grew along the line of connections plus signals plus thresholds. McCulloch and Pitts also influenced the neuron-like circuit design in von Neumann's 1945 EDVAC report.
timeline.behind_scenes_en: Pitts is the more legendary half of the partnership: at 12 he read Russell's Principia Mathematica in a Chicago library, wrote to point out errors, and was invited to Cambridge, though poverty kept him from going. At 15 he met Carnap in a University of Chicago library and corrected Carnap's logical notation from his own reading notes, and Carnap quietly arranged for him to sit in on graduate classes. McCulloch met Pitts in Chicago in 1942, took him into his home, and the two debated through the night whether the brain could be described by logic. The paper's core claim: any function realizable by a finite network of neurons is equivalent to some expression of propositional logic, and vice versa, the earliest mathematical version of the brain-as-computer hypothesis.

timeline.title_zh: 《行为、目的与目的论》：反馈系统的奠基论文
timeline.title_en: Behavior, Purpose and Teleology
timeline.summary_zh:
1943 年，墨西哥裔生理学家 Arturo Rosenblueth、MIT 数学家 Norbert Wiener 和工程师 Julian Bigelow 在 Philosophy of Science 10(1): 18–24 上发表《Behavior, Purpose and Teleology》。
论文把行为分为 "非目的性"（如自由落体）、"目的性"（受反馈控制）和 "目的论性"（受预期终态驱动）三类，并提出：动物追踪猎物、防空火炮预测飞机轨迹、机器臂修正误差，本质上都是"用反馈缩小当前状态与目标状态差距"的过程，可用同一套数学语言描述。
timeline.source_name: Philosophy of Science 10(1):18-24 / JSTOR
timeline.card_summary_zh: 论文把行为分为 "非目的性"（如自由落体）、"目的性"（受反馈控制）和 "目的论性"（受预期终态驱动）三类，并提出；让 AI 前史同时连到计算机、生物控制、工程反馈三条线。
timeline.summary_en: In 1943, Mexican physiologist Arturo Rosenblueth, MIT mathematician Norbert Wiener, and engineer Julian Bigelow published "Behavior, Purpose and Teleology" in *Philosophy of Science* 10(1): 18–24. The paper categorized behavior into three types: "non-purposeful" (like free fall), "purposeful" (controlled by feedback), and "teleological" (driven by an anticipated final state). It proposed that an animal tracking prey, an anti-aircraft gun predicting a plane's trajectory, and a robotic arm correcting errors are fundamentally the same process of using feedback to narrow the gap between the current state and the goal state, all describable by the same mathematical language.
timeline.card_summary_en: It sorted behavior into three classes and put purpose itself on a mathematical footing.
timeline.why_it_matters_en: It ties AI prehistory to computers, biological control, and engineering feedback all at once. Today's agent loops of observe, act, feedback, and goal, reinforcement learning reward signals, and robot trajectory planning all return to this paper's original attempt to mathematize purpose.
timeline.behind_scenes_en: Designing anti-aircraft fire control for the US military, Bigelow found that guns must predict a plane's future position rather than aim at where it is, and that predictive feedback drove repeated discussions with Wiener. At Rosenblueth's Wednesday evening seminar at MIT the question of whether purposeful behavior could be captured mathematically took shape, and the three unified biological motion, engineering control, and prediction under the feedback loop. The paper is the direct precursor of Wiener's 1948 Cybernetics, which specifically thanks Rosenblueth's seminar for its decisive influence on cybernetic thinking.

timeline.title_zh: von Neumann《EDVAC 报告初稿》：存储程序架构的起源
timeline.title_en: First Draft of a Report on the EDVAC
timeline.summary_zh:
1945 年 6 月 30 日，John von Neumann 完成《First Draft of a Report on the EDVAC》，由 ENIAC 项目安全官 Herman Goldstine 誊成 101 页打字稿并复印约 24 份分发给 EDVAC 项目核心成员（von Neumann 手写了原稿，Goldstine 据此誊写）。
这份打字稿首次系统描述了"存储程序"架构：把程序指令和数据都以数字形式存进同一个可寻址、可重写的内存，中央算术单元（CA）、中央控制单元（CC）、内存（M）、输入（I）、输出（O）五大部件分工明确。
这就是后来被称为"冯·诺依曼架构"的现代计算机基础结构。
timeline.source_name: Moore School / Computer History Archive (Knuth Collection)
timeline.card_summary_zh: 这份打字稿首次系统描述了"存储程序"架构：把程序指令和数据都以数字形式存进同一个可寻址、可重写的内存；没有存储程序架构，就没有可运行的"AI 软件"。
timeline.summary_en: On June 30, 1945, John von Neumann completed the *First Draft of a Report on the EDVAC*, which ENIAC project security officer Herman Goldstine transcribed from von Neumann's handwritten manuscript into a 101-page typescript and distributed in about 24 copies to core EDVAC project members. This typescript offered the first systematic description of the "stored-program" architecture, storing both program instructions and data digitally in the same addressable, rewritable memory with a clear division of labor among five key components: Central Arithmetic (CA), Central Control (CC), Memory (M), Input (I), and Output (O). This became the foundational structure of modern computers, later known as the "von Neumann architecture."
timeline.card_summary_en: Its stored-program design made software possible, the precondition for any runnable AI.
timeline.why_it_matters_en: Without the stored-program architecture there is no runnable AI software. The EDVAC report first made programs-as-data engineering-feasible; every later training loop, model weight, reward signal, and Transformer attention matrix rests on keeping data and instructions in memory together. Its E-element circuits, inspired by McCulloch-Pitts, were also the earliest technical link between computational neuroscience and computer architecture.
timeline.behind_scenes_en: Von Neumann handwrote the draft on trains running between Princeton and Los Alamos and mailed it back to Philadelphia. He worked closely with ENIAC designers Eckert and Mauchly, who later claimed the stored-program idea originated with them, but as the sole named author von Neumann lent the architecture his name, one of the most contested attributions in computing history. The circuit section on E-elements clearly drew on the 1943 McCulloch-Pitts neuron, an influence von Neumann explicitly acknowledged in later letters and writings. The 1946 Moore School Lectures carried these ideas to Maurice Wilkes at Cambridge, whose EDSAC first ran in May 1949 as the first practical full-scale stored-program computer.

timeline.title_zh: ENIAC 公开宣告：第一台通用电子数字计算机
timeline.title_en: ENIAC Public Announcement
timeline.summary_zh:
1946 年 2 月 14 日，宾夕法尼亚大学 Moore 电机工程学院公开宣告 ENIAC（Electronic Numerical Integrator and Computer）建造完成。
这台由 John Mauchly 和 J. Presper Eckert 领导设计的机器重 30 吨、占地 167 平方米、含 17,468 个真空管和 5 百万个焊点，能在一秒内完成 5,000 次加法或 357 次乘法——比当时最快的机电机器快约 1,000 倍。
ENIAC 是历史上第一台通用电子数字计算机：可重编程解决任意可计算问题，且全程电子化、无机械运动部件。
timeline.source_name: University of Pennsylvania ENIAC Archives / IEEE Milestones
timeline.card_summary_zh: ENIAC 公开宣告：第一台通用电子数字计算机；AI 作为"软件"的可能性，建立在通用电子计算机的可用性之上。
timeline.summary_en: On February 14, 1946, the University of Pennsylvania’s Moore School of Electrical Engineering publicly announced the completion of ENIAC (Electronic Numerical Integrator and Computer). Designed under the leadership of John Mauchly and J. Presper Eckert, the machine weighed 30 tons, occupied 167 square meters, and contained 17,468 vacuum tubes and 5 million soldered joints, allowing it to perform 5,000 additions or 357 multiplications in one second—about 1,000 times faster than the fastest electromechanical machines of the era. ENIAC was history's first general-purpose electronic digital computer: reprogrammable to solve any computable problem, it operated entirely electronically with no moving mechanical parts.
timeline.card_summary_en: AI as software rests on having a general-purpose electronic computer, which ENIAC proved feasible.
timeline.why_it_matters_en: The possibility of AI as software depends on the availability of general-purpose electronic computers. ENIAC proved vacuum-tube electronic computing feasible in engineering terms, and its great weakness, hard reprogramming, pushed forward EDVAC's stored-program architecture, verified by Manchester Baby and made practical by EDSAC. That chain is the hardware precondition of AI's birth.
timeline.behind_scenes_en: Funded by the US Army's Ballistic Research Laboratory, ENIAC began as a way to compute artillery firing tables, since wartime desk calculators needed hours per trajectory and frontline firing tables could not keep up. Mauchly proposed electronic calculation in 1942, the project launched with Eckert in 1943, and the machine's first real task in December 1945 was hydrogen-bomb feasibility calculation for Los Alamos, never mentioned at the public unveiling. ENIAC's greatest weakness was programming: retasking meant manually replugging boards and cables, with two operators spending two to three days per complex setup. Exactly that pain point produced EDVAC's stored-program architecture. All six lead programmers were women, including Kathleen McNulty and Betty Snyder Holberton.

timeline.title_zh: Wiener《Cybernetics》出版：动物与机器的控制与通信
timeline.title_en: Norbert Wiener Publishes Cybernetics
timeline.summary_zh:
1948 年，Norbert Wiener 的《Cybernetics: Or Control and Communication in the Animal and the Machine》由巴黎 Hermann 出版社和纽约 John Wiley & Sons 出版（MIT Press 版本是 1961 年第二版）。
书名取自希腊语 κυβερνήτης（舵手），Wiener 把它定义为"在动物和机器中关于控制与通信的研究领域"。
全书核心论点：神经系统、社会机构、自动机器、电子电路都遵循同一套反馈控制原理，可用统计学、信息论、微分方程统一描述。
timeline.source_name: Hermann / Wiley 1948 / Britannica - Cybernetics
timeline.card_summary_zh: 书名取自希腊语 κυβερνήτης（舵手），Wiener 把它定义为"在动物和机器中关于控制与通信的研究领域"；给 AI 时间轴补上前史根系。
timeline.summary_en: In 1948, Norbert Wiener’s *Cybernetics: Or Control and Communication in the Animal and the Machine* was published by Hermann in Paris and John Wiley & Sons in New York (the MIT Press version was the 1961 second edition). Derived from the Greek word κυβερνήτης (steersman), Wiener defined the concept as "the study of control and communication in the animal and the machine." The book’s core thesis was that nervous systems, social institutions, automatic machines, and electronic circuits all follow the same feedback control principles, which can be unified through statistics, information theory, and differential equations.
timeline.card_summary_en: Wiener named a new science of control and communication, giving AI a deep root system.
timeline.why_it_matters_en: Feedback loops and control cycles still shadow today's agents, robots, automation workflows, and reinforcement learning. When Dartmouth named the new discipline in 1956, cybernetics was among the candidates before artificial intelligence won, though the two overlap deeply in substance.
timeline.behind_scenes_en: Wiener's 1943 paper with Bigelow and Rosenblueth was the intellectual seed of the book. From 1943 to 1944, Wiener together with John von Neumann and neurophysiologist Warren McCulloch launched the Macy Foundation's interdisciplinary meetings, later called the Macy Cybernetics Conferences, ten sessions held from 1946 to 1953 with regulars including von Neumann, McCulloch, Pitts, Rosenblueth, Margaret Mead, Gregory Bateson, and Heinz von Foerster. Those gatherings directly helped create cognitive science.

timeline.title_zh: 图灵《Intelligent Machinery》：被冷落的机器学习雏形
timeline.title_en: Turing's Intelligent Machinery Report
timeline.summary_zh:
1948 年夏，图灵在伦敦度假期间为英国国家物理实验室（NPL）写下一份内部报告《Intelligent Machinery》。
这是他第一次系统讨论"机器能否表现出智能"的工程方案：他提出 "B-type unorganised machines"——一种由随机连接的神经元-like 单元组成、可通过 "奖励/惩罚" 信号调整连接的网络，并认为这是"训练机器学习"的最小可行模型。
报告还讨论了搜索、启发式、子程序组合等概念，把"机器智能"从哲学问题拉到工程问题。
timeline.source_name: Turing Digital Archive (AMT/B/4) / Copeland 2004 编辑版
timeline.card_summary_zh: 图灵《Intelligent Machinery》：被冷落的机器学习雏形；提前写下机器学习的雏形——训练、搜索、结构调整、奖励信号。
timeline.summary_en: In the summer of 1948, while on vacation in London, Turing wrote an internal report titled "Intelligent Machinery" for the National Physical Laboratory (NPL). It marked his first systematic proposal of an engineering blueprint for whether "machines can exhibit intelligence," introducing "B-type unorganised machines"—networks of randomly connected, neuron-like units adjusted via "reward/punishment" signals—as the minimum viable model for "training machine learning." The report also discussed concepts like search, heuristics, and the combination of subroutines, dragging "machine intelligence" from a philosophical debate into an engineering problem.
timeline.card_summary_en: In this overlooked report, Turing sketched machine learning years before the term existed.
timeline.why_it_matters_en: Training, search, structural adjustment, reward signals: Turing put machine learning on the table in 1948, long before people spoke of intelligent machines, neural networks, or reinforcement learning. Had NPL adopted his proposals, AI history might have begun eight years before Dartmouth.
timeline.behind_scenes_en: The report was never published in Turing's lifetime. NPL director Sir Charles Galton Darwin, grandson of the naturalist, dismissed it as a student's draft and shelved it. It first appeared only in 1969 in Machine Intelligence 5, co-edited by Bernard Meltzer and Donald Michie, and was re-edited by B. Jack Copeland in 2004's The Essential Turing. Scholars later realized the B-type machine's reward-and-punishment connection tuning anticipated Rosenblatt's 1958 perceptron and modern reinforcement learning by ten to twenty-five years. In the same report Turing called neural networks unorganised machines, the earliest statement of the core image of networks organizing themselves through experience.

timeline.title_zh: Manchester Baby：首台存储程序电子计算机运行
timeline.title_en: Manchester Baby (SSEM) First Stored-Program Run
timeline.summary_zh:
1948 年 6 月 21 日下午，曼彻斯特大学的小型实验机器（Small Scale Experimental Machine，昵称 "Baby"）首次成功运行程序：Tom Kilburn 写的代码寻找 2^18 = 262,144 的最大因数，在 52 分钟内跑完约 350 万次运算并给出正确答案 131,072（指令数常见引用为约 3.5 million operations，精确数字待核实）。
这是人类历史上第一次让"程序本身"作为数据存进电子存储器、被电子方式读取并执行。
Baby 的存储器是 Freddie Williams 和 Tom Kilburn 联合发明的 Williams-Kilburn Tube（阴极射线管存储器），用单根 6 英寸 CRT 存下 2048 位——这是当时世界范围内最有效的随机存取电子存储器。
timeline.source_name: University of Manchester Digital60 / IEEE Milestones
timeline.card_summary_zh: Manchester Baby：首台存储程序电子计算机运行；AI 能成为程序、模型、系统，前提是机器能运行可更换的程序。
timeline.summary_en: On the afternoon of June 21, 1948, the University of Manchester’s Small Scale Experimental Machine (nicknamed "Baby") successfully ran its first program: code written by Tom Kilburn to find the highest factor of 2^18 = 262,144, which executed approximately 3.5 million operations (a commonly cited instruction count, though the exact number is to be verified) over 52 minutes to yield the correct answer of 131,072. This marked the first time in human history that a "program itself" was stored as data in electronic memory, electronically read, and executed. The Baby's memory was the Williams-Kilburn Tube (a cathode-ray tube memory co-invented by Freddie Williams and Tom Kilburn), which stored 2048 bits on a single 6-inch CRT—making it the world’s most effective random-access electronic memory at the time.
timeline.card_summary_en: AI exists as programs and models only because machines learned to run swappable software.
timeline.why_it_matters_en: AI can be a program, a model, a system only because machines can run replaceable programs. Stored-program architecture gave software a physical carrier: a program stopped being rewired cables and became data in memory. In 1986 IEEE listed the Baby as an international milestone, the first electronic computer to execute a stored program.
timeline.behind_scenes_en: Williams began CRT storage research at TRE in Malvern in July 1946, moved to the University of Manchester that December bringing Kilburn along, and Geoff Tootill joined in June 1947. By December 1, 1947 they could store 2048 bits reliably on a single tube and wrote an internal report circulated widely in Britain and America. The Baby was really a test bed for whether the Williams-Kilburn Tube could read and write arbitrary bits at electronic speed; since a machine had to be built to test the memory, they validated the stored-program architecture along the way. In February 1951 Ferranti shipped the Mark I, based on the Baby's successor Manchester Mark I, the world's first commercial electronic computer delivered to customers as a standard product.

timeline.title_zh: Shannon《A Mathematical Theory of Communication》发表
timeline.title_en: Shannon's Mathematical Theory of Communication
timeline.summary_zh:
1948 年 7 月和 10 月，Claude Shannon 在 Bell System Technical Journal 分两期发表 《A Mathematical Theory of Communication》。
论文首次给出"信息"的严格数学定义——信息量等于事件发生概率的对数倒数（H = -Σ p log₂ p），单位是 bit——这个词由同事 John Tukey 提出，Shannon 在本文中首次将其引入印刷文献。
他证明任何通信信道都有一个上限（信道容量 C = W log₂(1+S/N)），并给出 "source coding" 和 "channel coding" 分离定理：压缩和传输可以独立优化而不损失整体最优性。
timeline.source_name: Bell System Technical Journal 27(3):379-423, 27(4):623-656 / IEEE
timeline.card_summary_zh: 他证明任何通信信道都有一个上限（信道容量 C = W log₂(1+S/N)）；AI 处理的文字、图像、语音、代码本质上都是信息。
timeline.summary_en: In July and October 1948, Claude Shannon published "A Mathematical Theory of Communication" in two installments in the *Bell System Technical Journal*. The paper provided the first rigorous mathematical definition of "information"—defining it as the logarithm of the reciprocal of an event's probability (H = -Σ p log₂ p) and measured in "bits," a term coined by colleague John Tukey that Shannon first introduced to printed literature here. Shannon proved that any communication channel has an upper limit (channel capacity C = W log₂(1+S/N)) and established the separation theorem for "source coding" and "channel coding," demonstrating that compression and transmission can be optimized independently without losing overall optimality.
timeline.card_summary_en: He proved channels have capacity limits, and AI's text, images, and speech are all information.
timeline.why_it_matters_en: Everything AI processes, text, images, speech, code, is at bottom information. Information theory gave AI quantitative tools for uncertainty and representation: information gain in decision trees, cross-entropy as the standard classification loss, the KL divergence inside VAEs' ELBO, Transformer attention as soft information retrieval. These basic components of deep learning all trace back to Shannon's 1948 formula for H.
timeline.behind_scenes_en: Shannon's 1937 MIT master's thesis, A Symbolic Analysis of Relay and Switching Circuits, first applied Boolean algebra to circuit design, which Howard Gardner later called the most important master's thesis of the twentieth century. He joined Bell Labs in 1941 for wartime cryptographic work, exchanging ideas with Turing during Bell Labs visits, and his thoughts on communication, encryption, and noise converged into the 1948 paper. The 1949 book with Warren Weaver retitled it from A Mathematical Theory to The Mathematical Theory of Communication, marking information theory's rise from a possible tool to an established discipline.

timeline.title_zh: Hebb《The Organization of Behavior》：突触可塑性假说
timeline.title_en: Hebb's The Organization of Behavior
timeline.summary_zh:
1949 年，加拿大心理学家 Donald Hebb 在 McGill 大学出版《The Organization of Behavior》。
他提出一个后来被概括为 "Hebb's rule" 的假说："当细胞 A 的轴突足够接近细胞 B 并反复参与其激发时，A 到 B 的连接会被增强"——通俗表述是 "Cells that fire together, wire together"（一起激发的神经元会连接得更强）。
这是"学习 = 突触强度变化"这一神经网络核心思想的最早系统化陈述。
timeline.source_name: Wiley 1949 / Britannica - Donald O. Hebb
timeline.card_summary_zh: 他提出一个后来被概括为 "Hebb's rule" 的假说："当细胞 A 的轴突足够接近细胞 B 并反复参与其激发时；Hebb 法则让"学习"在神经层面有了"连接强度变化"的物理基础。
timeline.summary_en: In 1949, Canadian psychologist Donald Hebb published *The Organization of Behavior* at McGill University, proposing the hypothesis later known as "Hebb's rule": when the axon of cell A is close enough to cell B and repeatedly helps fire it, the connection from A to B is strengthened. Colloquially summarized as "cells that fire together, wire together," this was the earliest systematic formulation of the core neural network concept that learning equates to changes in synaptic strength.
timeline.card_summary_en: Hebb's rule gave learning a physical basis: connections strengthen when cells fire together.
timeline.why_it_matters_en: The Hebb rule grounded learning in physical changes of connection strength at the neural level. Backpropagation, spike-timing-dependent plasticity, and spiking neural networks are far more mathematical, but the core picture remains experience changing connections. It is also one of the oldest bridges between biology and AI.
timeline.behind_scenes_en: Hebb's immediate motive was to rebut Karl Lashley's mass action doctrine, which held from rat cortex-lesion experiments that the cortex is homogeneous, acts as a whole, and has no functional localization. Hebb disagreed: his own rat learning experiments in Montreal showed that activity patterns of specific cell groups do change with learning. The book also introduced cell assemblies, stable circuits formed by neurons that repeatedly fire together, as the physical basis of memory and concepts. These ideas informed Rosenblatt's 1958 perceptron, Hopfield's 1982 network, and the long-term potentiation discovered by Bliss and Lomo in 1973, later confirmed as a genuine synaptic Hebbian mechanism.

timeline.title_zh: Shannon 忒修斯迷宫鼠：机器记忆的最早物理演示
timeline.title_en: Shannon's Theseus Maze-Solving Mouse
timeline.summary_zh:
1950 年，Claude Shannon 在贝尔实验室制作了名为 Theseus（忒修斯）的电子机械鼠，装在 5×5 的迷宫地板下，通过继电器网络记录路径并能在下一次复用：第一次探索时碰壁、试错，第二次进入直接沿记忆的路径直达终点。
这是历史上第一次用机器演示"从经验中学习并改变后续行为"，比 Rosenblatt 感知机早 7 年，也比 Samuel 跳棋早 2 年。
timeline.source_name: Bell Labs / Shannon 1952 demonstration report
timeline.card_summary_zh: Claude Shannon 在贝尔实验室制作了名为 Theseus（忒修斯）的电子机械鼠；Theseus 把抽象的"学习"做成可以让人看见的物理过程。
timeline.summary_en: In 1950, Claude Shannon created an electromechanical mouse named Theseus at Bell Labs, using a relay network under a 5×5 maze floor to record and reuse its path—bumping into walls and trial-and-error on its first run, then heading straight to the goal on its second. This marked the first time in history a machine demonstrated "learning from experience and modifying subsequent behavior," predating Rosenblatt’s perceptron by 7 years and Samuel’s checkers by 2 years.
timeline.card_summary_en: Shannon's mechanical mouse turned abstract learning into something anyone could watch.
timeline.why_it_matters_en: Theseus made learning visible: relays as memory elements, maze as environment, trial and error as training. Those three elements remain the basic frame of reinforcement learning today. For ordinary readers, watching a machine mouse remember its way explains machine learning better than any definition.
timeline.behind_scenes_en: Shannon built the system around 1950 with about 90 relays, and public demonstrations drew coverage in Life and Time. He later recalled the relay mice cost about 200 dollars but that for the first time a machine appeared to think. He chose a mouse precisely to rebut skepticism about machine intelligence in the most vivid form, and for the same reasons his Bell Labs colleague Marvin Minsky built SNARC in 1951, the world's first neural-network learning machine, with 40 neurons and adjustable weights. These machines predate the perceptron, were long ignored, yet are the true starting points of the machine learning line.

timeline.title_zh: Turing《Computing Machinery and Intelligence》：图灵测试的起源
timeline.title_en: Computing Machinery and Intelligence
timeline.summary_zh:
1950 年 10 月，Alan Turing 在哲学期刊《Mind》第 59 卷第 236 期发表《Computing Machinery and Intelligence》（pp. 433-460）。
文章开头拒绝直接定义"机器"和"思考"，转而提出"模仿游戏"（imitation game）：如果一台机器在通过电传打字机进行对话时，能让提问者难以判断对方是人还是机器，是否就应当承认它能"思考"？
这就是后来被称作"图灵测试"（Turing Test）的思想实验。
Turing 在文中预测：到 2000 年，一台 10⁹ 位存储的计算机能在 5 分钟测试中骗过 30% 的裁判。
timeline.source_name: Mind, vol. LIX, no. 236, pp. 433-460 (October 1950)
timeline.card_summary_zh: 文章开头拒绝直接定义"机器"和"思考"，转而提出"模仿游戏"（imitation game）。
timeline.summary_en: In October 1950, Alan Turing published "Computing Machinery and Intelligence" (pp. 433-460) in the philosophy journal *Mind*, Vol. 59, No. 236. Opening by declining to directly define "machine" and "think," he instead proposed the "imitation game"—the thought experiment later known as the "Turing Test"—asking whether a machine should be recognized as capable of "thinking" if, when communicating via teleprinter, it makes it difficult for a questioner to determine whether it is human or machine. In the paper, Turing predicted that by 2000, a computer with 10⁹ bits of storage would be able to fool 30% of judges in a 5-minute test.
timeline.card_summary_en: Rather than define thinking, Turing proposed the imitation game, a test you can actually run.
timeline.why_it_matters_en: The paper recast the philosophical question of whether machines can think, unresolvable by definition, into the operational question of whether machines can behave in ways indistinguishable from humans, observable and comparable. Every chatbot benchmark, dialogue evaluation, and AGI yardstick today, from LLM red-teaming to Elo rankings to Turing test revivals, continues this move.
timeline.behind_scenes_en: Turing had just joined the Ferranti Mark 1 effort at the University of Manchester. His true adversary was the prevailing British philosophical line that machines cannot think, above all neurologist Geoffrey Jefferson's 1949 oration that no machine could write a sonnet because it thinks. Turing rebutted nine objections one by one, from theology and the ostrich stance through mathematics and consciousness, and closed with the child-program analogy: rather than program an adult mind, program one that learns like a child and let it grow up, a view that directly foreshadows today's pretrain, fine-tune, RLHF pipeline. In Turing's Vision (2016), Chris Bernhardt argued the deepest core argument is computational equivalence: if human thought is a kind of computation, machines will get there sooner or later.

timeline.title_zh: Prinz 棋程序：第一台商用计算机上的残局求解
timeline.title_en: Prinz Chess Program on the Ferranti Mark 1
timeline.summary_zh:
1951 年 11 月，Dietrich Prinz 在曼彻斯特大学的 Ferranti Mark 1（Manchester Mark 1 的商用版）上运行了第一个能在真实计算机上下完整国际象棋残局的程序。
Prinz 程序能解决"马象对单王"这类残局（具体步数与搜索细节待核对 Prinz 1952《Robot chess》原文），采用 Shannon 1950 年论文提出的 minimax 搜索思路实现。
这是世界上第一个跑在通用电子计算机上的棋类程序，比 Bernstein 1957 年完整棋局程序早 6 年。
timeline.source_name: Prinz, D. (1952). Robot chess. Research, 5, 261-266.
timeline.card_summary_zh: Prinz 棋程序：第一台商用计算机上的残局求解；Prinz 程序证明了"让机器下棋"不只是理论，而可以在通用计算机上真实运行。
timeline.summary_en: In November 1951, Dietrich Prinz ran the first program capable of playing complete chess endgames on a real computer, utilizing the University of Manchester’s Ferranti Mark 1 (the commercial version of the Manchester Mark 1). Implemented using the minimax search concept from Shannon’s 1950 paper, Prinz's program could solve endgames like knight and bishop against a lone king (specific steps and search details to be verified against the original text of Prinz's 1952 "Robot chess"). This was the world’s first game-playing program run on a general-purpose electronic computer, predating Bernstein’s 1957 full-game program by six years.
timeline.card_summary_en: Running on the first commercial computer, Prinz's endgame solver made machine chess real.
timeline.why_it_matters_en: The Prinz program proved machine chess was not mere theory but could genuinely run on a general-purpose computer. It fixed the paradigm of board as state space, moves as operators, outcome as evaluation function, a line extending straight to Deep Blue in 1997 and AlphaGo in 2016.
timeline.behind_scenes_en: Prinz was a Jewish-born mathematician who fled Germany for Britain and overlapped with Turing at Manchester. Borrowing Turing's Ferranti Mark 1 programming manual and encouraged by him, he built the endgame solver. Turing himself had drafted chess algorithms he never implemented, and the two often discussed search pruning together. The critical constraint was memory: the Ferranti Mark 1 could hold only a few board states, so endgames were all it could manage. That physical ceiling of memory determining how much chess you can play was gradually broken on Greenblatt's MacHack, Northwestern's Chess 4.x, Belle, and Deep Thought, until Deep Blue escaped it entirely with dedicated VLSI hardware in 1997.

timeline.title_zh: Samuel 跳棋程序第一版：IBM 701 上的规则玩家
timeline.title_en: Arthur Samuel's First Checkers Program on IBM 701
timeline.summary_zh:
1952 年，Arthur Samuel 在 IBM 701（IBM 第一台商用电子计算机，vacuum-tube，只生产 19 台）上写出第一个能下完整跳棋的程序。
这一版只能按规则走棋，尚未具备学习能力。
Samuel 之所以选择跳棋而非国际象棋，是因为跳棋的搜索空间虽然仍有 ~5×10²⁰ 种局面，但相对简单，可以聚焦研究"机器如何从对局中改进自己"。
timeline.source_name: Samuel, A. (1959). Some Studies in Machine Learning Using the Game of Checkers. IBM Journal of Research and Development, 3(3), 210-229.
timeline.card_summary_zh: Samuel 之所以选择跳棋而非国际象棋，是因为跳棋的搜索空间虽然仍有 ~5×10²⁰ 种局面，但相对简单。
timeline.summary_en: In 1952, Arthur Samuel wrote the first program capable of playing a complete game of checkers on the IBM 701, IBM's first commercial electronic computer—a vacuum-tube machine of which only 19 were ever produced. While this version could only follow the rules and lacked the ability to learn, Samuel chose checkers over chess because its search space, though still spanning ~5×10²⁰ positions, was simple enough to let him focus on how a machine could improve itself through play.
timeline.card_summary_en: Samuel chose checkers because even its vast search space was comparatively tractable.
timeline.why_it_matters_en: It was the first working game-learning research platform on a commercial computer, setting up the 1955 learning version, the 1956 television demonstration, and the 1959 paper that first defined machine learning. Samuel's series of efforts at IBM also seeded IBM's AI research tradition, later carried on in Deep Blue and Watson.
timeline.behind_scenes_en: Pressure on Samuel at IBM's Poughkeepsie laboratory came from two directions. Technically, the IBM 701's Williams-tube electrostatic storage held only 2048 words, not even one complete search table. Politically, Thomas Watson Sr. initially considered machine chess frivolous; formal support came only in 1954 after Watson saw a New York Times report on television. Samuel completed the first learning version in 1955 and demonstrated it live on CBS television on February 24, 1956. In 1962 the program beat self-styled checkers master Robert Nealey in one game, heavily promoted by IBM at the time although Nealey was no top player and lost the rematch the next year, after which IBM made it a flagship AI project. Samuel's alpha-beta pruning, temporal-difference learning, and self-play ideas were later formalized by Sutton and Barto.

timeline.title_zh: McCarthy-Minsky-Rochester-Shannon 提案："Artificial Intelligence" 一词的首次正式使用
timeline.title_en: A Proposal for the Dartmouth Summer Research Project on Artificial Intelligence
timeline.summary_zh:
1955 年 8 月 31 日，John McCarthy、Marvin Minsky、Nathaniel Rochester（IBM 701 总设计师）和 Claude Shannon 联名向洛克菲勒基金会提交了《A Proposal for the Dartmouth Summer Research Project on Artificial Intelligence》（打字稿，页数待核实）。
提案建议 1956 年夏在达特茅斯学院举办为期 2 个月、10 人参与的"人工智能"暑期研讨会。
这是 "Artificial Intelligence" 一词第一次出现在正式学术文档中。
提案核心论断："学习的每一个方面、智能的任何特征，原则上都可以被精确描述到机器能够模拟的程度"。
timeline.source_name: McCarthy, Minsky, Rochester, Shannon (1955). A Proposal for the Dartmouth Summer Research Project on Artificial Intelligence.
timeline.card_summary_zh: 提案建议 1956 年夏在达特茅斯学院举办为期 2 个月、10 人参与的"人工智能"暑期研讨会。
timeline.summary_en: On August 31, 1955, John McCarthy, Marvin Minsky, Nathaniel Rochester (chief designer of the IBM 701), and Claude Shannon jointly submitted "A Proposal for the Dartmouth Summer Research Project on Artificial Intelligence" (typescript, page count to be verified) to the Rockefeller Foundation, marking the first time the term "Artificial Intelligence" appeared in a formal academic document. The proposal pitched a two-month, 10-person summer workshop at Dartmouth College for 1956, built on the core assertion that "every aspect of learning or any other feature of intelligence can in principle be so precisely described that a machine can be made to simulate it."
timeline.card_summary_en: It planned the 1956 Dartmouth workshop and gave the field its name.
timeline.why_it_matters_en: The proposal did more than name AI; it scoped the field, covering language, abstraction, problem solving, and self-improvement, themes that remained core topics into the 2020s. McCarthy later recalled choosing artificial intelligence for its neutrality: it favored neither Wiener's cybernetics nor automata theory, and sidestepped disputes with Wiener.
timeline.behind_scenes_en: McCarthy was then a 27-year-old assistant professor of mathematics at Dartmouth. He wanted to organize a summer workshop but struggled to name it: cybernetics was fiercely guarded by Wiener, with whom relations were strained; automata theory felt too mathematical; complex information processing too engineering-flavored. He settled on artificial intelligence partly to avoid Wiener, then a famous MIT professor whose objections to anyone else using cybernetics carried real weight. Among the four co-authors, Rochester represented IBM's hardware resources, Shannon information theory's legitimacy, Minsky the neuroscience background, and McCarthy mathematical logic, a combination with both engineering traction and theoretical weight that ultimately secured 7,500 dollars from the Rockefeller Foundation.

timeline.title_zh: Selfridge Pandemonium 模型：并行特征检测的思想
timeline.title_en: Selfridge's Pandemonium Model
timeline.summary_zh:
1956 年，Oliver Selfridge（MIT，Dartmouth 参与者之一）提出 Pandemonium（群魔殿）模型——一个由"恶魔"（demons）层级组成的并行模式识别系统：图像恶魔把视网膜输入传给特征恶魔（每个检测一种边缘/曲率），认知恶魔对特征恶魔输出加权求和，决策恶魔选认知恶魔中最高响应者作为分类结果。
论文 1959 年在《Proceedings of the Symposium on the Mechanisation of Thought Processes》正式发表。
timeline.source_name: Selfridge, O. G. (1959). Pandemonium: A paradigm for learning. In Proceedings of the Symposium on Mechanisation of Thought Processes, 511-529.
timeline.card_summary_zh: Selfridge Pandemonium 模型：并行特征检测的思想。
timeline.summary_en: In 1956, Oliver Selfridge (MIT, one of the Dartmouth participants) proposed the Pandemonium model, a parallel pattern recognition system structured as a hierarchy of "demons." Within this system, image demons pass retinal inputs to feature demons (each detecting a specific edge or curvature), cognitive demons compute a weighted sum of the feature demons' outputs, and a decision demon selects the highest responder among the cognitive demons as the final classification. The paper was officially published in 1959 in the *Proceedings of the Symposium on the Mechanisation of Thought Processes*.
timeline.card_summary_en: Selfridge's Pandemonium introduced parallel feature detection, two years ahead of the perceptron.
timeline.why_it_matters_en: Pandemonium was among the first models to propose hierarchical feature detection, predating Rosenblatt's perceptron by two years. It fixed the paradigm of layered features plus weighted combination plus parallel computation that still underlies deep learning, and inspired Fukushima's Neocognitron in 1980 and LeCun's LeNet in 1989 with its conv-pooling-dense hierarchy.
timeline.behind_scenes_en: A student of Norbert Wiener, Selfridge worked on the earliest character-recognition systems at MIT Lincoln Laboratory. He named the model Pandemonium, the capital of demons in Milton's Paradise Lost, because each demon simultaneously shouts that it sees the pattern and the decision demon picks whichever shouts loudest, a metaphor so vivid that sixty years on it remains the most intuitive way to explain CNN feature maps. Selfridge was also a core participant at Dartmouth 1956, and Pandemonium appeared alongside the perceptron, but unlike Rosenblatt he never committed to a full hardware implementation, so history long credited the perceptron as the first neural network, even though Pandemonium was conceptually closer to the modern CNN.

timeline.title_zh: Dartmouth 暑期 AI 研讨会：人工智能作为学科的诞生
timeline.title_en: Dartmouth Summer Research Project on Artificial Intelligence
timeline.summary_zh:
1956 年 6 月 18 日至 8 月 17 日（约 8 周，据 Ray Solomonoff 当年笔记），Dartmouth Summer Research Project on Artificial Intelligence 在新罕布什尔州汉诺威的达特茅斯学院召开。
McCarthy、Minsky、Shannon、Rochester 四人为组织者，实际参与者包括 Ray Solomonoff、Oliver Selfridge、Trenchard More、Arthur Samuel、Allen Newell、Herbert Simon、John Holland 等。
这是 "Artificial Intelligence" 第一次作为正式学科名称出现，被普遍视为 AI 学科的诞生事件。
timeline.source_name: Solomonoff, R. (1956) Dartmouth notes; McCarthy 1956 attendee list to Rockefeller Foundation
timeline.card_summary_zh: 一群数学家与计算机科学家第一次把“人工智能”当作共同研究目标，一个新学科由此获得名字。
timeline.summary_en: From June 18 to August 17, 1956 (lasting about eight weeks, according to Ray Solomonoff's notes from that year), the Dartmouth Summer Research Project on Artificial Intelligence convened at Dartmouth College in Hanover, New Hampshire. Organized by McCarthy, Minsky, Shannon, and Rochester, the workshop's actual participants included Ray Solomonoff, Oliver Selfridge, Trenchard More, Arthur Samuel, Allen Newell, Herbert Simon, John Holland, and others. This marked the first time "Artificial Intelligence" appeared as a formal discipline name, and it is widely regarded as the birth of the AI field.
timeline.card_summary_en: A group of researchers adopted AI as a shared goal, and a new discipline got its name.
timeline.why_it_matters_en: Dartmouth gathered research scattered under cybernetics, automata theory, and complex information processing into one field and fixed its core questions: automatic computers, natural language, neural networks, computational theory, abstraction and creativity, self-improvement. Seventy years on these remain AI's main lines. The meeting also seeded the next two decades' leading forces, since the AI labs at MIT, CMU, Stanford, and IBM were nearly all founded by Dartmouth participants.
timeline.behind_scenes_en: Organization was loose: ten full-time participants were planned, but in practice only McCarthy, Minsky, and Solomonoff stayed throughout while others visited in different weeks. Newell and Simon attended only the first two weeks, reporting Logic Theorist remotely rather than demonstrating it in person. Solomonoff introduced algorithmic probability at the meeting, the source of Kolmogorov complexity, Solomonoff induction, and AIXI. Trenchard More arrived in the third week after replacing Rochester and kept extensive notes. The meeting fell short of its planned collective breakthrough but fixed the divide between symbols and neural nets and between logic and probability: after 1956 the symbolic camp at CMU and MIT dominated for thirty years, until backpropagation revived neural networks in the 1980s.

timeline.title_zh: Logic Theorist 在 Dartmouth 演示：第一个符号 AI 程序
timeline.title_en: Logic Theorist Demonstrated at Dartmouth
timeline.summary_zh:
1956 年 8 月 9 日，Allen Newell 和 Herbert Simon（RAND Corporation）联合程序员 Cliff Shaw，在 Dartmouth 研讨会上远程演示 Logic Theorist 程序。
该程序用 IPL-2（Information Processing Language II）实现，运行在 RAND 的 JOHNNIAC 计算机上，成功证明了 Whitehead 和 Russell《Principia Mathematica》第 2 章前 52 个定理中的 38 个，其中第 2.85 定理找到了比原书更简洁的证明——这是历史上第一个能让人类数学家承认"机器证得更好"的程序。
timeline.source_name: Newell, A., Simon, H. A. (1956). The Logic Theory Machine—A Complex Information Processing System. IRE Transactions on Information Theory, IT-2(3), 61-79.
timeline.card_summary_zh: 该程序用 IPL-2（Information Processing Language II）实现。
timeline.summary_en: On August 9, 1956, Allen Newell and Herbert Simon (RAND Corporation), alongside programmer Cliff Shaw, conducted a remote demonstration of the Logic Theorist program at the Dartmouth workshop. Running on RAND's JOHNNIAC computer and written in IPL-2 (Information Processing Language II), the program successfully proved 38 of the first 52 theorems in Chapter 2 of Whitehead and Russell's *Principia Mathematica*. Its proof for Theorem 2.85 was even more concise than the original book's, making it the first program in history to make human mathematicians admit that a "machine proved it better."
timeline.card_summary_en: Written in IPL-2, it proved machine reasoning could yield genuine mathematical proofs.
timeline.why_it_matters_en: Logic Theorist was the first genuinely running AI program, fixing the symbolic paradigm of intelligence as symbol manipulation plus search, and directly inspiring Newell and Simon's GPS in 1957, IPL in 1958, and the Prolog and expert-system era of the 1970s. Simon predicted computers would be world chess champions within a decade, thirty years late with Deep Blue in 1997, and would produce publishable mathematical theorems, partially realized in 2024's AI mathematical proof systems.
timeline.behind_scenes_en: Newell and Simon were never on Dartmouth's full roster, attending only the first two weeks as short-term visitors, with the demonstration conducted remotely by teleprinter, which places the August 9 date late in the meeting without conflicting with their visit. Logic Theorist ran on RAND's JOHNNIAC, and since the program was too large to transport they staged a remote demonstration, carrying printed output to Dartmouth. Simon recalled in his autobiography Models of My Life that when they mailed Russell their more elegant proof of theorem 2.85, Russell replied that he was delighted to know Principia Mathematica can now be done by machinery, writing in November 1956 at age 84.

timeline.title_zh: General Problem Solver（GPS）：首个目标导向的通用问题求解器
timeline.title_en: General Problem Solver
timeline.summary_zh:
1957 年，Allen Newell、Cliff Shaw、Herbert Simon 在 RAND Corporation 提出通用问题求解器 GPS。
GPS 不像 Logic Theorist 只能证明逻辑定理，而是用"手段-目的分析"（means-ends analysis）把任意问题分解为：当前状态、目标状态、可用算子、差异检测——通过不断"减小当前状态与目标状态之间的差异"来搜索解法。
该程序在 JOHNNIAC 上实现，能解逻辑定理、不定式积分、传教士与食人族过河等多种问题。
timeline.source_name: Newell, A., Shaw, J. C., Simon, H. A. (1959). Report on a general problem-solving program. Proceedings of the International Conference on Information Processing, 256-264.
timeline.card_summary_zh: General Problem Solver（GPS）：首个目标导向的通用问题求解器。
timeline.summary_en: In 1957, Allen Newell, Cliff Shaw, and Herbert Simon introduced the General Problem Solver (GPS) at the RAND Corporation. Unlike the Logic Theorist, which was limited to proving logical theorems, GPS utilized "means-ends analysis" to break any problem down into a current state, a goal state, available operators, and difference detection, searching for solutions by constantly reducing the gap between the current and goal states. Implemented on the JOHNNIAC, the program successfully solved a wide range of problems, including logical theorems, indefinite integrals, and the missionaries and cannibals puzzle.
timeline.card_summary_en: The first program built to be general on purpose, GPS framed problems as state-space search.
timeline.why_it_matters_en: GPS was the first AI program explicitly aiming at generality, establishing problem solving as state-space search, the paradigm that dominated AI for thirty years. Means-ends analysis remains a basic approach in planning, scheduling, and automated reasoning systems. Newell and Simon's 1975 Turing Award citation explicitly lists GPS as a principal contribution.
timeline.behind_scenes_en: GPS's real breakthrough lay less in the algorithm than in the methodology of turning human problem-solving thought into a machine algorithm. Through 1956 and 1957, Newell and Simon extensively observed human subjects thinking aloud, recording their chains of reasoning while solving logic problems, then abstracted those patterns into algorithms. That protocol-analysis methodology became a standard tool of cognitive science. GPS's failure matters too: it handled only moderately difficult problems and collapsed when state spaces exploded exponentially, stranding the whole route between 1965 and 1975 and serving as the main target of Dreyfus's 1972 What Computers Can't Do. The 1980s turn to narrow, deep expert systems like MYCIN was the product of GPS-style generality failing.

timeline.title_zh: Rosenblatt 感知机：可学习神经网络的首次实现
timeline.title_en: Rosenblatt's Perceptron
timeline.summary_zh:
1957 年 Frank Rosenblatt 在纽约 Buffalo 的 Cornell Aeronautical Laboratory（CAL）首次在 IBM 704 上仿真感知机算法（Project PARA），用 50 次训练让机器学会区分打孔卡的左标记与右标记——这是历史上第一次机器通过自身调整权重从例子中学习。
1958 年 7 月，美国海军研究办公室（ONR）在 CAL 公开演示，Rosenblatt 同年发表《The Perceptron: A Probabilistic Model for Information Storage and Organization in the Brain》（Psychological Review, 65(6), 386-408）。
1960 年 6 月 23 日，Mark I Perceptron 硬件演示——400 个光电管+512 个 association unit+8 个 response unit+电动可调电位器构成第一台可学习的物理神经网络机器。
timeline.source_name: Rosenblatt, F. (1958). The Perceptron: A Probabilistic Model for Information Storage and Organization in the Brain. Psychological Review, 65(6), 386-408.
timeline.card_summary_zh: 感知机第一次让机器根据样本自行调整权重，今天神经网络“从数据中学习”的基本轮廓由此出现。
timeline.summary_en: In 1957, Frank Rosenblatt first simulated the perceptron algorithm (Project PARA) on an IBM 704 at the Cornell Aeronautical Laboratory (CAL) in Buffalo, New York, using 50 training runs to teach the machine to distinguish left from right markings on punch cards—the first time in history a machine learned from examples by self-adjusting its weights. In July 1958, the Office of Naval Research (ONR) conducted a public demonstration at CAL, the same year Rosenblatt published "The Perceptron: A Probabilistic Model for Information Storage and Organization in the Brain" (Psychological Review, 65(6), 386-408). On June 23, 1960, the Mark I Perceptron hardware was demonstrated, utilizing 400 photocells, 512 association units, 8 response units, and motorized potentiometers to form the first learning physical neural network machine.
timeline.card_summary_en: It let a machine adjust its own weights from examples for the first time.
timeline.why_it_matters_en: The perceptron was the first programmable machine that could learn from experience, fixing the input-weight-activation-error-update frame still basic to neural networks. It directly inspired Widrow's Adaline in the 1960s, backpropagation in the 1980s, and deep learning in the 2010s; PyTorch's nn.Linear is still essentially Rosenblatt's perceptron. Rosenblatt died in a sailing accident on his 43rd birthday in 1971, never seeing the backpropagation revival.
timeline.behind_scenes_en: Rosenblatt attended the Bronx High School of Science one year behind Marvin Minsky. Their dispute of perceptron versus symbolic AI began in the late 1950s, and Minsky's 1969 Perceptrons with Seymour Papert used the XOR counterexample to prove single-layer perceptrons cannot learn linearly inseparable problems, a book widely seen as the fuse of the first AI winter. Recent historical research finds the Minsky-Papert critique was over-read: the book itself discusses multilayer possibilities, and Rosenblatt was already studying multilayer networks, lacking only an effective training algorithm. The real bottleneck was that backpropagation had not matured. Four years before his death, while his high school schoolmate Minsky wrote against his research line, Rosenblatt was even attempting bio-machine learning experiments, extracting material from trained rats' brains to inject into untrained ones.

timeline.title_zh: McCarthy 在 MIT 启动 Lisp：早期 AI 的母语诞生
timeline.title_en: McCarthy Begins Lisp Development at MIT
timeline.summary_zh:
1958 年秋，John McCarthy 离开达特茅斯到 MIT 任助理教授，与 Marvin Minsky 共同组建 MIT Artificial Intelligence Project。
McCarthy 试图用 IBM 704 上的 FORTRAN 处理 AI 列表操作（FLPL: FORTRAN List Processing Language），但发现 FORTRAN 缺少递归、条件表达式、动态内存分配——他决定发明一门新语言。
1958 年圣诞节至 1959 年初，他在 MIT 一个人的寒假里写出《Recursive Functions of Symbolic Expressions and Their Computation by Machine, Part I》草稿，首次定义 S-表达式、λ-演算、条件表达式、垃圾回收、eval 元循环解释器——这门语言被命名为 Lisp（LISt Processing）。
1959 年他的学生 Steve Russell 读完论文后说："等等，eval 是可以直接跑的"，于是把 McCarthy 纸上的伪代码敲进 IBM 704——Lisp 第一个真正运行的解释器由此诞生。
1960 年 4 月论文正式发表于 Communications of the ACM。
timeline.source_name: McCarthy, J. (1960). Recursive Functions of Symbolic Expressions and Their Computation by Machine, Part I. Communications of the ACM, 3(4), 184-195.
timeline.card_summary_zh: 1959 年他的学生 Steve Russell 读完论文后说："等等，eval 是可以直接跑的"；Lisp 是 AI 历史上最重要的一门语言。
timeline.summary_en: In the autumn of 1958, John McCarthy left Dartmouth for MIT as an assistant professor to co-found the MIT Artificial Intelligence Project with Marvin Minsky, but after finding that FORTRAN lacked recursion, conditional expressions, and dynamic memory allocation while trying to run AI list operations via FLPL (FORTRAN List Processing Language) on an IBM 704, he decided to invent his own language. During a solitary winter break at MIT from Christmas 1958 to early 1959, McCarthy drafted "Recursive Functions of Symbolic Expressions and Their Computation by Machine, Part I," first defining S-expressions, λ-calculus, conditional expressions, garbage collection, and the eval meta-circular interpreter for a language he named Lisp (LISt Processing).
