Frames, Schank's Scripts of 1975, and Bobrow's KRL of 1977 were ranked the three schools of 1970s knowledge representation, and the object-oriented knowledge bases of 1980s expert systems largely grew from frame thinking, Minsky's Frame concept a distant relative of OOP class inheritance.

timeline.title_zh: Werbos 反向传播:深度学习的数学起点
timeline.title_en: Werbos Backpropagation: Beyond Regression (1974 Harvard PhD)
timeline.summary_zh:
1974 年 8 月,Paul Werbos 在哈佛大学通过博士论文答辩,题目《Beyond Regression: New Tools for Prediction and Analysis in the Behavioral Sciences》。
论文第二章首次完整提出用链式法则从输出端往输入端反推偏导,在多层复合函数里“一次正向 + 一次反向”算出所有参数的梯度,并明确指出这套方法可以训练多层神经网络。
这是 backpropagation 算法在西方文献中的首次完整描述。
timeline.source_name: Werbos, P. (1974). Harvard PhD thesis; (1994) Wiley book The Roots of Backpropagation
timeline.card_summary_zh: 这是 backpropagation 算法在西方文献中的首次完整描述；BP 是整个深度学习的训练算法基石。
timeline.summary_en: In August 1974, Paul Werbos defended his PhD thesis at Harvard University, titled *Beyond Regression: New Tools for Prediction and Analysis in the Behavioral Sciences*. In the second chapter, he proposed for the first time in its entirety the use of the chain rule to reverse-propagate partial derivatives from the output to the input, calculating the gradients of all parameters in a multi-layer composite function via "one forward and one backward" pass, and explicitly pointed out that this method could train multi-layer neural networks. This marked the first complete description of the backpropagation algorithm in Western literature.
timeline.card_summary_en: BP's first complete description in Western literature, the training cornerstone of deep learning.
timeline.why_it_matters_en: Backpropagation is deep learning's foundational training algorithm. Every training loop inside GPT, Claude, Gemini, Stable Diffusion, and AlphaFold is essentially Werbos 1974: predict forward, compute gradients backward, update weights. That BP lay buried for twelve years after 1974 explains why Hinton's generation treats being misunderstood as ordinary research weather.
timeline.behind_scenes_en: By Werbos's 1974 defense, neural networks were academic forbidden ground; Minsky and Papert's 1969 Perceptrons had condemned the road, and nobody on the committee believed networks could revive. Werbos himself mostly wielded the math as a general forecasting tool, applying it to political prediction and energy modeling. Only after Rumelhart, Hinton, and Williams independently re-derived BP in Nature in 1986 and fixed the name backpropagation was the 1974 paper retroactively recognized. Werbos later observed that Freud's 1895 Project for a Scientific Psychology had described a similar backward learning signal.

timeline.title_zh: MYCIN:专家系统进入医学诊断
timeline.title_en: MYCIN: Medical Expert System
timeline.summary_zh:
1974 年 10 月,Edward Shortliffe 在斯坦福提交博士论文《MYCIN: A Rule-Based Computer Program for Advising Physicians Regarding Antimicrobial Therapy Selection》(CS-TR-74-465, AIM-251)。
MYCIN 用 ~600 条产生式规则,把感染科医生判断菌血症、选抗生素的经验编码进 LISP 程序。
它最重要的一项创新是把确定性推理改造成“确定性因子(Certainty Factor)”,在规则之间传递部分置信度,这是当时不确定性推理的代表作。
1979 年 Yu 等人评估:MYCIN 的抗生素选择 65% 被专家评为可接受,高于 9 名人类住院医师的中位数(具体比例与对照人数待核实)。
timeline.source_name: Shortliffe, E. H. (1974). PhD thesis, Stanford CS-TR-74-465; (1975) Comput Biomed Res 8(4)
timeline.card_summary_zh: MYCIN 用数百条规则辅助诊断感染和选择抗生素，展示了专家知识如何被编码进一套可解释系统。
timeline.summary_en: In October 1974, Edward Shortliffe submitted his Stanford PhD dissertation, "MYCIN: A Rule-Based Computer Program for Advising Physicians Regarding Antimicrobial Therapy Selection" (CS-TR-74-465, AIM-251), introducing a LISP program that encoded infectious disease specialists' expertise in diagnosing bacteremia and selecting antibiotics into roughly 600 production rules. Its key innovation was adapting deterministic reasoning into "Certainty Factors" to propagate partial confidence between rules, serving as a landmark achievement in uncertainty reasoning for the era. In 1979, an evaluation by Yu et al. found that MYCIN's antibiotic selections were deemed acceptable by experts 65% of the time, outperforming the median of nine human residents (though the exact ratio and control count are pending verification).
timeline.card_summary_en: MYCIN encoded hundreds of rules to diagnose infections and choose antibiotics, explainably.
timeline.why_it_matters_en: MYCIN was AI's earliest serious attempt at medicine, pushing explicit encoding of expert knowledge to its limit while exposing the exploding maintenance cost of rule bases. Today's LLM-based clinical assistants take the statistical road, but the question of what responsibility AI carries in medicine was posed in MYCIN's day and remains unresolved.
timeline.behind_scenes_en: MYCIN never actually entered clinical use, blocked not by performance but by law, liability, and upkeep: who answers for a wrong recommendation, who pays to keep the rules current as antibiotics change. Shortliffe later reflected that its true contribution was not medicine but the template handed to EMYCIN in 1979, PROSPECTOR, XCON, and successors: knowledge base plus inference engine plus explanation module. EMYCIN also introduced the domain-independent shell concept, directly shaping the 1980s expert-system industry.

timeline.title_zh: Altair 8800:个人计算机革命起点
timeline.title_en: Altair 8800: Personal Computer Revolution Begins
timeline.summary_zh:
1974 年 12 月 19 日,《Popular Electronics》1975 年 1 月号上市,封面故事是 Ed Roberts 和 Bill Yates 设计的 Altair 8800 微型计算机套件,封面标题“World's First Minicomputer Kit to Rival Commercial Models”。
整机基于 Intel 8080,套件 439 美元,组装版 621 美元。
Roberts 原本预计卖出 800 台,上市后 1 个月内收到 1000 多订单,MITS 公司从破产边缘翻身。
timeline.source_name: Roberts, H. E. & Yates, W. (1975). Popular Electronics Jan 1975; Computing History
timeline.card_summary_zh: Altair 8800 把可编程计算机带给个人爱好者，并直接催生微软，个人计算机产业由此点火。
timeline.summary_en: On December 19, 1974, the January 1975 issue of *Popular Electronics* hit newsstands, featuring a cover story on the Altair 8800 microcomputer kit designed by Ed Roberts and Bill Yates under the headline "World's First Minicomputer Kit to Rival Commercial Models." Powered by the Intel 8080, the machine cost $439 as a kit and $621 fully assembled. While Roberts initially expected to sell just 800 units, over 1,000 orders flooded in within a month of its release, pulling MITS back from the brink of bankruptcy.
timeline.card_summary_en: Altair 8800 put programmable computers in hobbyists' hands and started Microsoft and the PC era.
timeline.why_it_matters_en: Altair 8800 was the starting gun of the personal computer industry, directly producing Microsoft, IMSAI, and the 1976 Apple I, along with the Homebrew Computer Club where Jobs and Wozniak found their inspiration for the Apple I. For AI it made personal computing industrially real, paving the first road toward compute as a household commodity.
timeline.behind_scenes_en: The machine on the magazine cover was an empty shell: the prototype assembled and mailed in October 1974 was lost to a freight strike, so MITS propped up a bare box with LEDs for the January 1975 cover shoot. Harvard sophomore Bill Gates and Paul Allen wrote Altair BASIC, Micro-Soft's first business. Afterward a crowd of clones from IMSAI, Processor Technology, and Ohio Scientific appeared, and the PC industrial chain was underway.

timeline.title_zh: Holland 遗传算法:把进化变成算法
timeline.title_en: Holland Genetic Algorithm: Adaptation in Natural and Artificial Systems
timeline.summary_zh:
1975 年,密歇根大学 John Holland 出版《Adaptation in Natural and Artificial Systems》,提出遗传算法(Genetic Algorithm)。
GA 把“候选解”编码成二进制串,通过选择、交叉、变异三步迭代,在解空间里做“适者生存”式搜索。
Holland 在书中给出 Schema Theorem,试图从信息论角度证明GA 的“building block”会指数级增长。
1975 年同期的博士 Ken De Jong 用 GA 做函数优化,给出 GA 的首批实验基准。
timeline.source_name: Holland, J. H. (1975). Adaptation in Natural and Artificial Systems. U. Michigan Press
timeline.card_summary_zh: 遗传算法把选择、交叉与变异写成搜索程序，让“适者生存”第一次成为机器解决复杂问题的方法。
timeline.summary_en: In 1975, the University of Michigan’s John Holland published *Adaptation in Natural and Artificial Systems*, introducing the Genetic Algorithm (GA) to encode "candidate solutions" as binary strings and perform a "survival of the fittest" search through selection, crossover, and mutation. In the book, Holland presented the Schema Theorem to prove from an information-theory perspective that GA "building blocks" grow exponentially, while Ken De Jong, a PhD student at the same time in 1975, used GA for function optimization to establish the algorithm's first experimental benchmarks.
timeline.card_summary_en: Genetic algorithms wrote selection, crossover, and mutation down as search procedures.
timeline.why_it_matters_en: GA gave adaptation, as a concept, its earliest formalization inside AI, shaping evolutionary computation, reinforcement learning, and neuroevolution. Neural architecture search in AutoML, the evolution strategies OpenAI used early on, and DeepMind's structure searches after AlphaFold all show GA's shadow.
timeline.behind_scenes_en: Holland's inspirations were Darwin, Turing, and von Neumann's self-replicating machines, driven by one question: is adaptation the same mathematical process in organisms and machines? Through the 1970s GA and BP ran on parallel tracks, GA on discrete combinatorial optimization, BP on differentiable continuous optimization, hardly speaking. In the 1980s Holland's student Goldberg published Genetic Algorithms in Search, carrying GA into industry, where scheduling, structural design, and network-architecture search still use it routinely.

timeline.title_zh: 物理符号系统假说:Newell & Simon Turing 演讲
timeline.title_en: Physical Symbol System Hypothesis (Newell & Simon 1975 Turing Lecture)
timeline.summary_zh:
1975 年 10 月 20 日,Allen Newell 和 Herbert A. Simon 在明尼阿波利斯 ACM 年会上联合接受 1975 年 ACM Turing Award,演讲题为《Computer Science as Empirical Inquiry:Symbols and Search》,1976 年 3 月发表于 CACM 19(3)。
演讲正式提出物理符号系统假说(PSSH):“一个物理符号系统具备产生一般智能行为的必要和充分手段”。
他们把过去 20 年 Logic Theorist、GPS、NSS 的工作总结为两条原则:智能 = 符号操作 + 启发式搜索。
这是符号主义 AI 最完整的纲领性陈述。
timeline.source_name: Newell, A. & Simon, H. A. (1976). CACM 19(3):113-126
timeline.card_summary_zh: 演讲正式提出物理符号系统假说(PSSH):“一个物理符号系统具备产生一般智能行为的必要和充分手段”；PSSH 是符号主义的“宪法”。
timeline.summary_en: On October 20, 1975, Allen Newell and Herbert A. Simon jointly accepted the 1975 ACM Turing Award at the ACM Annual Conference in Minneapolis, delivering the lecture "Computer Science as Empirical Inquiry: Symbols and Search," which was published in March 1976 in CACM 19(3). The address formally proposed the Physical Symbol System Hypothesis (PSSH): "A physical symbol system has the necessary and sufficient means for general intelligent action." By summarizing the past 20 years of work on the Logic Theorist, GPS, and NSS into two principles—intelligence equals symbol manipulation plus heuristic search—they delivered the most complete programmatic statement of symbolic AI.
timeline.card_summary_en: Newell and Simon's Turing lecture declared symbol systems capable of general intelligent action.
timeline.why_it_matters_en: PSSH is symbolism's constitution, concentrating 1970s-80s AI effort on search, knowledge representation, and inference engines. Brooks's 1985 broadside for intelligence without representation, connectionism's 1990s revival, and the deep learning surge of the 2010s were all rebellions against it. Without understanding PSSH you cannot tell what each AI paradigm revolution was actually rejecting.
timeline.behind_scenes_en: Simon also collected the 1978 Nobel memorial prize in economics for bounded rationality, the only person ever to hold both a Turing Award and a Nobel. In the lecture Newell pressed the claim that computer science is an empirical discipline: AI cannot advance by pure mathematical derivation but must build machines, write programs, run experiments, and examine results. That stance stood then against Dijkstra's computer-science-as-mathematics, and deep learning's experience-driven research paradigm today is the Newell-Simon line carried forward.

timeline.title_zh: Lenat AM:机器自动做数学发现
timeline.title_en: Lenat AM: Automated Mathematical Discovery
timeline.summary_zh:
1975-1976 年,Douglas Lenat 在斯坦福完成博士论文《AM: An Artificial Intelligence Approachto Discovery in Mathematics》。
AM 用 ~250 个 Lisp 概念和 ~500 条启发式规则,从空集和集合论公理出发,自动“重新发现”了整数、加法、素数、唯一分解定理等数论概念。
AM 不会证明定理,但能“提出有趣的新概念并给评分”。
这是 AI 史上第一个被认真讨论的“自动发现系统”。
timeline.source_name: Lenat, D. (1976). Stanford PhD; (1977) IJCAI; (1982) Artificial Intelligence 21(1-2)
timeline.card_summary_zh: AM 从少量概念和启发式规则出发重新发现数学规律，成为机器参与科学发现的早期大胆实验。
timeline.summary_en: In 1975-1976, Douglas Lenat completed his Stanford PhD thesis, *AM: An Artificial Intelligence Approach to Discovery in Mathematics*. Using ~250 Lisp concepts and ~500 heuristic rules, AM started from the empty set and set theory axioms to automatically "rediscover" number theory concepts like integers, addition, prime numbers, and the unique factorization theorem. Although unable to prove theorems, it could "propose interesting new concepts and score them," marking it as the first "automated discovery system" to be seriously discussed in the history of AI.
timeline.card_summary_en: From a few concepts and heuristics, AM rediscovered mathematical patterns on its own.
timeline.why_it_matters_en: AM was AI's earliest automatic-scientific-discovery experiment, leaving the generate-concepts-plus-heuristic-evaluation frame to Graffiti in 1988, Colton's HR in 1999, and DeepMind's AlphaTensor in 2022 and FunSearch in 2023. Its successes and disputes frame AI for Science's central tension: does AI discover new things, or only extend human presets?
timeline.behind_scenes_en: The triumph quickly drew suspicion. In 1984 Ritchie and Hanna published AM: A Case Study in AI Methodology in Artificial Intelligence volume 23 number 3, pages 249-268, showing AM's discoveries had been quietly fed in by Lenat through Lisp function naming and heuristics, with every generated prime traceable to Lenat's own divisor-of rule. Lenat later conceded the heuristic evaluations were hand-tuned and pivoted to founding Cyc in 1984, explicitly encoding common sense, a project now forty years old. The dispute remains the reference case for whether discovery systems produce genuine novelty or only amplify their author's preset search directions.

timeline.title_zh: Apple II:个人计算机走入家庭
timeline.title_en: Apple II: Personal Computer Goes Consumer
timeline.summary_zh:
1977 年 4 月,Steve Wozniak 设计的 Apple II 在 West Coast Computer Faire 首次公开展示;6 月 10 日开始正式发售,起价 1298 美元。
Apple II 是第一款大规模商业成功的“开箱即用”个人电脑:主板 + 键盘 + 电源整合在塑料壳内,直接接家用电视当显示器,内置 BASIC 解释器,普通家庭就能上手。
1978 年 5.25 英寸软盘驱动器(DOS 3.1)推出,1980 年 VisiCalc 表格程序上市,Apple II 进入企业市场。
timeline.source_name: Wozniak, S. (1977) Apple II Reference Manual; Apple Inc. history
timeline.card_summary_zh: Apple II：个人计算机走入家庭；Apple II 让个人电脑从“极客玩具”变成“家用设备”。
timeline.summary_en: In April 1977, the Steve Wozniak-designed Apple II made its public debut at the West Coast Computer Faire, officially going on sale on June 10 at a starting price of $1,298. It became the first mass-market, commercially successful "out-of-the-box" personal computer, integrating a motherboard, keyboard, and power supply into a plastic case that plugged directly into a home TV and featured a built-in BASIC interpreter for ordinary families. The system broke into the enterprise market following the launch of a 5.25-inch floppy disk drive (DOS 3.1) in 1978 and the VisiCalc spreadsheet program in 1980.
timeline.card_summary_en: Apple II carried personal computers from hobbyist kits into family homes.
timeline.why_it_matters_en: Apple II turned the personal computer from a geek toy into a household appliance. For AI that meant computing entered homes and schools at scale, laying the hardware base for anyone-can-program in the 1980s-90s. Hinton's 1986 BP paper and LeCun's 1989 LeNet experiments both presupposed compute an ordinary researcher could buy and take home.
timeline.behind_scenes_en: Designing the Apple II, Wozniak still worked at HP and offered it there first; HP declined, citing no market for personal computers. Jobs sold his minivan, Woz sold his HP-65 calculator, and together they scraped 1,300 dollars for the first board. Its ready-to-run, fully assembled approach split decisively from the Altair 8800's solder-it-yourself kit route of 1975, defining the PC's commercial template. By the 1980s Apple IIs filled over a million seats in American schools, the entry machine for a generation of programmers and AI researchers.

timeline.title_zh: Anderson BPS:神经联想记忆早期模型
timeline.title_en: Anderson BPS: Brain-State-in-a-Box Associative Memory
timeline.summary_zh:
1977 年 7 月,James Anderson、Jack Silverstein、Stephen Ritz、Richard Jones 在Psychological Review 84(5) 发表《Distinctive Features, Categorical Perception,and Probability Learning: Some Applications of a Neural Model》。
提出 BPS 模型,后称 Brain-State-in-a-Box(BSB),用线性联想记忆 + 反馈 + 阈值函数,让向量在“盒子”里收敛到一个角点,实现“自动补全 / 类别收敛”。
这是 70 年代少数仍坚持神经路线的工作之一。
timeline.source_name: Anderson, Silverstein, Ritz, Jones (1977). Psychological Review 84(5):413-451
timeline.card_summary_zh: Anderson BPS：神经联想记忆早期模型；BPS 是连接主义在第一次寒冬里“地下存活”的代表。
timeline.summary_en: In July 1977, James Anderson, Jack Silverstein, Stephen Ritz, and Richard Jones published "Distinctive Features, Categorical Perception, and Probability Learning: Some Applications of a Neural Model" in *Psychological Review* 84(5). The paper introduced the BPS model, later known as Brain-State-in-a-Box (BSB), which used linear associative memory, feedback, and a threshold function to force vectors to converge to a corner inside the "box" to achieve "auto-completion / categorical convergence." It stood as one of the few research efforts during the 1970s that kept the neural network approach alive.
timeline.card_summary_en: Anderson's brain-state-in-a-box, an associative memory keeping connectionism alive underground.
timeline.why_it_matters_en: BPS is the emblem of connectionism surviving underground through the first winter. Alongside Kohonen's 1972 associative memory, Nakano's 1972 Associatron, and Fukushima's 1975 Neocognitron, it proved neural network research never truly died, only went marginalized. After Hopfield's 1982 paper the line revived fast, and Rumelhart-Hinton-Williams's 1986 backpropagation carried it to LeCun, Hinton, and Bengio's next starting point.
timeline.behind_scenes_en: Neural network research was quiet money in the 1970s, and Anderson and peers secured funding under cognitive psychology banners rather than AI ones. BPS and BSB are not Hopfield networks but kin in spirit: a feedback dynamical system attracting memories toward stable points. Hopfield's 1982 paper explicitly cited contemporaries Anderson, Kohonen, and Nakano, and looking back, those marginal late-70s works preserved the thread that Hopfield's revival picked up directly in 1982.

timeline.title_zh: PROSPECTOR:专家系统找到矿
timeline.title_en: PROSPECTOR: Expert System for Mineral Exploration
timeline.summary_zh:
1976-1980 年,Peter Hart、Richard Duda、Nils Nilsson 在 SRI International 开发 PROSPECTOR,用于辅助地质学家评估矿藏潜力。
1977 年 10 月 20 日 SRI Technical Note 155 公开发表首版系统。
PROSPECTOR 用“推理网络(inference network)”编码地质学家的判断,节点是地质断言,边是 Bayesian 概率传递。
1980 年 PROSPECTOR 推测华盛顿州 Mount Tolman 存在大型钼矿,后续钻探证实了预测,这是 AI 史上首次重大“商业级”预测成功案例。
timeline.source_name: Duda, Hart, Nilsson et al. (1977) SRI TN-155; (1978) SRI Final Report
timeline.card_summary_zh: 1977 年 10 月 20 日 SRI Technical Note 155 公开发表首版系统。
timeline.summary_en: Between 1976 and 1980, Peter Hart, Richard Duda, and Nils Nilsson at SRI International developed PROSPECTOR to assist geologists in assessing mineral potential, with the system's first version publicly released in SRI Technical Note 155 on October 20, 1977. The system used an "inference network" to encode geological expertise, utilizing nodes for geological assertions and edges for Bayesian probability propagation. In 1980, PROSPECTOR predicted a massive molybdenum deposit at Mount Tolman in Washington State, which subsequent drilling confirmed, marking the first major "commercial-grade" predictive success in AI history.
timeline.card_summary_en: SRI's Technical Note 155 published the system's first version on October 20, 1977.
timeline.why_it_matters_en: PROSPECTOR ranked among the expert-system era's killer applications, and with MYCIN, DENDRAL, and XCON it pushed AI from laboratory into industry and government. It also opened the probabilistic-reasoning-plus-knowledge-graph line that today's Bayesian networks, probabilistic graphical models, and causal inference tools all trace back to.
timeline.behind_scenes_en: The core technology was not rules but Bayesian probability propagation. Duda, Hart, Nilsson, and Pearl jointly advanced computable representations of uncertainty in the late 1970s, with PROSPECTOR the first industrial-grade deployment of that line. The Mount Tolman ore-prediction legend gets cited endlessly, though the commercial value of the drilled vein stayed contested. Afterward Duda and Hart's textbook era and Pearl's 1988 Probabilistic Reasoning in Intelligent Systems made Bayesian networks one of 1990s AI's mainstreams.

timeline.title_zh: Lamport 提出逻辑时钟——分布式系统的基石
timeline.title_en: Lamport's Logical Clocks
timeline.summary_zh: 1978 年，莱斯利·兰伯特发表论文《分布式系统中的时间、时钟与事件排序》。他证明了独立计算机之间不存在统一的「现在」——并提出用因果关系的「先发生于」替代物理时间。
timeline.source_name: Fireship - 10 Classic CS Papers
timeline.card_summary_zh: 他证明了独立计算机之间不存在统一的「现在」——并提出用因果关系的「先发生于」替代物理时间。
timeline.summary_en: In 1978, Leslie Lamport published his paper "Time, Clocks, and the Ordering of Events in a Distributed System." He proved that a unified "now" does not exist between independent computers, proposing instead to replace physical time with a causal "happened-before" relationship.
timeline.card_summary_en: No shared now exists across computers, so causality must replace physical time, Lamport showed.
timeline.why_it_matters_en: Without logical clocks there are no distributed databases and no synchronized training of large models across thousands of GPUs. Every cloud service you touch, every blockchain transaction, every distributed AI training run rests underneath on this paper.
timeline.behind_scenes_en: Lamport's insight was simple: if A may cause B to happen, treat A as occurring before B. That seemingly plain idea cracked one of computer science's nastiest synchronization problems, letting dozens or thousands of machines with private clocks agree without sharing a global clock. Training GPT-class models now demands tens of thousands of GPUs in parallel, and logical clocks are the mathematics keeping their steps in line.

timeline.title_zh: 西蒙获诺贝尔经济学奖：唯一同时拿图灵奖和诺贝尔奖的人
timeline.title_en: Herbert Simon Wins Nobel Prize in Economics
timeline.summary_zh:
1978 年 10 月 16 日，瑞典皇家科学院宣布将当年诺贝尔经济学奖授予赫伯特·西蒙，表彰他对经济组织决策过程的开创性研究。
西蒙提出的「有限理性」（Bounded Rationality）和「满意即可」（Satisficing）颠覆了传统经济学的完全理性假设。他指出：人在决策时信息有限、认知有限、时间有限，因此只会追求「够好」的方案而非「最优」方案。
这个思想为行为经济学奠基，也深刻影响了管理学和组织理论。
西蒙 1975 年已与纽厄尔共同获得图灵奖。他至今仍是历史上唯一同时获得图灵奖和诺贝尔奖的人。
timeline.source_name: Nobel Prize Official Website: Herbert A. Simon
timeline.card_summary_zh: 西蒙获诺贝尔经济学奖：唯一同时拿图灵奖和诺贝尔奖的人；诺贝尔奖的意义不止于西蒙个人。
timeline.summary_en: On October 16, 1978, the Royal Swedish Academy of Sciences awarded the Nobel Prize in Economics to Herbert Simon for his pioneering research into the decision-making processes within economic organizations. Simon’s concepts of "Bounded Rationality" and "Satisficing" upended traditional economics' assumption of perfect rationality by showing that humans, constrained by limited information, cognition, and time, seek "good enough" rather than "optimal" solutions—a breakthrough that laid the foundation for behavioral economics and deeply influenced management and organizational theory. Having already co-won the Turing Award with Newell in 1975, Simon remains the only person in history to win both the Turing Award and the Nobel Prize.
timeline.card_summary_en: Simon took the economics Nobel, the only person ever to hold both it and the Turing Award.
timeline.why_it_matters_en: The Nobel counted for more than Simon personally. It certified that AI research results, symbolic operation, heuristic search, bounded rationality, could spill beyond computing into genuine influence on economics and management. AI touching nearly every discipline today finds its earliest evidence here.
timeline.behind_scenes_en: Simon's cross-field path dazzles: political science doctor, then chairs in administration and economics, ending atop psychology and computer science. Behind the prize lies a neglected link: studying organizational decision-making at Carnegie Mellon really meant studying how humans optimize under limited resources, a framing that directly yielded bounded rationality and heuristic search. His Logic Theorist and GPS in AI simulated human problem-solving all along, his economics and AI research sharing one problem framework.

timeline.title_zh: Hofstadter《哥德尔、艾舍尔、巴赫》出版
timeline.title_en: Hofstadter GEB: An Eternal Golden Braid
timeline.summary_zh:
1979 年,Douglas Hofstadter 出版《Gödel, Escher, Bach: An Eternal Golden Braid》(Basic Books,777 页)。
书中通过哥德尔不完备定理、艾舍尔版画、巴赫赋格三个表面无关的领域,提取出共同结构“怪圈(Strange Loop)”:自指、层次缠绕、递归回旋。
Hofstadter 论证“意识”可能源于符号系统达到足够复杂度后的怪圈结构。
1980 年该书获普利策非小说类奖和美国国家图书奖(科学类)。
timeline.source_name: Hofstadter, D. R. (1979). Gödel, Escher, Bach. Basic Books. ISBN 0-465-02656-7
timeline.card_summary_zh: Hofstadter《哥德尔、艾舍尔、巴赫》出版；GEB 是 AI 与认知科学交界处影响最大的非教材书。
timeline.summary_en: In 1979, Douglas Hofstadter published *Gödel, Escher, Bach: An Eternal Golden Braid* (Basic Books, 777 pages), extracting a common structure called the "Strange Loop"—defined by self-reference, tangled hierarchies, and recursive looping—from the seemingly unrelated domains of Gödel's incompleteness theorem, Escher's prints, and Bach's fugues. Hofstadter argued that "consciousness" might emerge from these strange loop structures once a symbolic system reaches sufficient complexity. In 1980, the book won the Pulitzer Prize for General Nonfiction and the National Book Award (Science).
timeline.card_summary_en: Gödel, Escher, Bach appeared, the most influential non-textbook at AI's frontier.
timeline.why_it_matters_en: GEB loaded self-reference, emergence, levels, and formal systems into a generation of researchers' toolboxes. Today's arguments over whether LLMs understand, whether consciousness can emerge from Transformers, whether self-referential loops can produce a self, all turn within GEB's conceptual frame.
timeline.behind_scenes_en: Hofstadter was just past thirty, fresh from an Oregon physics doctorate and teaching at Indiana, when he wrote it. He complained for years afterward that the public filed GEB as a math-art-music popularization while his real target was how consciousness emerges from lifeless matter. It shaped a generation of AI researchers: his student Melanie Mitchell went on to Copycat, and DeepMind founder Demis Hassabis openly credits GEB as a key enlightenment. Critics charged it substituted analogy for proof, and Hofstadter granted part of the criticism in his 1999 twentieth-anniversary preface.

timeline.title_zh: Stanford Cart:5 小时穿越房间
timeline.title_en: Stanford Cart: 5-Hour Room Crossing
timeline.summary_zh:
1979 年 11 月,Hans Moravec 在斯坦福 AI Lab 完成 Stanford Cart 的标志性演示:在充满障碍物的房间内,小车靠双摄像头立体视觉“看 9 张图 - 选关键点 - 算视差 - 建 3D 地图 - 规划路径 - 走 1 米”循环,花了约 5 小时走完 20 米,中途没撞到任何椅子。
Cart 用一台 DEC KI-10 远程遥控,每轮计算要 15 分钟。
这是 AI 史上第一次让移动机器人在真实 cluttered 室内空间里完成自主导航。
timeline.source_name: Moravec, H. (1980). Stanford AIM-340; (1983) Vision Robot Navigation
timeline.card_summary_zh: 这是 AI 史上第一次让移动机器人在真实 cluttered 室内空间里完成自主导航；Stanford Cart 是自动驾驶和移动机器人的共同起点。
timeline.summary_en: In November 1979, Hans Moravec completed a landmark demonstration of the Stanford Cart at the Stanford AI Lab, steering it through an obstacle-filled room using a dual-camera stereo vision loop of taking 9 pictures, selecting keypoints, calculating disparity, building a 3D map, planning a path, and moving 1 meter. Remotely controlled by a DEC KI-10 that required 15 minutes of computation per round, the Cart took about 5 hours to travel 20 meters without hitting any chairs. This marked the first time in AI history that a mobile robot successfully achieved autonomous navigation in a real, cluttered indoor space.
timeline.card_summary_en: The Stanford Cart crossed a room alone in five hours, root of self-driving and mobile robots.
timeline.why_it_matters_en: It was the first time a mobile robot navigated a real cluttered indoor space autonomously, and the Cart is the common origin of autonomous driving and mobile robotics, its perceive-map-plan-control pipeline still running inside Waymo, Tesla FSD, and ROS navigation stacks. Moravec's paradox explains why chess fell in 1997 before driving in the 2020s and why the robot butler never arrived: physical perception-action loops are vastly harder than symbolic reasoning.
timeline.behind_scenes_en: Twenty meters in five hours reads like a joke today and was an engineering marvel in 1979. Moravec kept overnight vigils beside the cart while debugging, because a single collision meant recalibrating cameras. Across the 1970s machine vision was widely assumed a decade from solution; this cart first quantified the gap between seeing and understanding, 100 milliseconds to capture a frame versus hours of compute to label every pixel in it, the empirical starting point of the famous paradox that sensorimotor skills are far harder than reasoning.

timeline.title_zh: XCON/R1:专家系统首次大规模商用
timeline.title_en: XCON/R1: First Large-Scale Commercial Expert System
timeline.summary_zh:
1978-1980 年,John McDermott 在 CMU 为 DEC 公司开发 R1(后改名 XCON,eXpert CONfigurer)。
1980 年 4 月正式上线,任务是自动配置 VAX-11/780 计算机订单,把销售员勾选的硬件清单转成可投产的连接方案。
R1 用 OPS5 产生式规则编写,初始约 500 条规则,到 1986 年膨胀到上千至上万条。
DEC 报告每年节省约 2500 万美元,几乎消灭了订单配置错误。
XCON 是专家系统商业化时代的旗舰案例,直接催生 1981 年 DEC 内部 40+ 个专家系统项目,以及全球企业跟风上马专家系统的浪潮。
timeline.source_name: McDermott, J. (1982). R1: A rule-based configurer of computer systems. Artificial Intelligence 19(1):39-88
timeline.card_summary_zh: XCON 自动配置复杂计算机订单，每年为 DEC 节省数千万美元，专家系统第一次真正实现大规模商业回报。
timeline.summary_en: Between 1978 and 1980, John McDermott developed R1 (later renamed XCON, or eXpert CONfigurer) at CMU for DEC, launching it in April 1980 to automatically configure VAX-11/780 computer orders by converting salesperson-selected hardware lists into production-ready connection schemes. Built using OPS5 production rules, the system expanded from about 500 initial rules to thousands to tens of thousands by 1986, saving DEC an estimated $25 million annually and virtually eliminating order configuration errors. As the flagship success story of the commercial expert system era, XCON directly spawned 40+ internal expert system projects at DEC in 1981 and triggered a global wave of enterprises rushing to deploy their own expert systems.
timeline.card_summary_en: XCON configured complex computer orders automatically, saving DEC tens of millions yearly.
timeline.why_it_matters_en: XCON was AI history's first industrial deployment paying back in hard cash, proving AI can generate quantifiable economic value inside enterprises rather than demonstrations on paper. Yet its conditions for success were ignored and its conditions for failure underestimated, and the script of success story, blind imitation, collective crash replayed in the 2023-2025 LLM adoption wave.
timeline.behind_scenes_en: XCON succeeded under specific circumstances. Configuring VAX orders was highly structured, with crisp rule boundaries and no gray-area judgment. DEC's own engineers were the domain experts, so knowledge acquisition flowed. Order volumes were large enough that saving even five minutes per configuration repaid the effort. None of these conditions held in medicine, law, or prospecting, so the more XCON succeeded the more companies believed expert systems replicated without limit, and the mass failures after 1985 planted the seeds of the second AI winter.

timeline.title_zh: IBM PC:个人计算机标准化
timeline.title_en: IBM Personal Computer Released
timeline.summary_zh:
1981 年 8 月 12 日,IBM 发布 5150 Personal Computer,采用 Intel 8088 处理器(4.77 MHz)、微软 PC DOS 1.0 操作系统、16-256KB 内存。
售价 1565 美元起步,开放架构(open architecture)允许第三方厂商制造兼容机和扩展卡。
Don Estridge 带领的 IBM Boca Raton 实验室用 12 个月完成项目,打破 IBM 内部多年大型机研发节奏。
1982 年 IBM PC 成为《时代》年度机器,1983 年 PC 兼容机市场全面爆发。
timeline.source_name: IBM 5150 announcement (1981-08-12); Estridge, D. IBM Boca Raton
timeline.card_summary_zh: IBM PC 与开放兼容架构迅速形成行业标准，计算能力由少数机构进一步扩散到办公室与家庭。
timeline.summary_en: On August 12, 1981, IBM released the 5150 Personal Computer starting at $1,565, featuring an Intel 8088 processor (4.77 MHz), Microsoft PC DOS 1.0, 16-256KB of memory, and an open architecture that allowed third-party manufacturers to build compatible machines and expansion cards. Don Estridge led the IBM Boca Raton lab to complete the project in 12 months, breaking IBM's internal mainframe development pace of many years. The IBM PC became *Time*’s "Machine of the Year" in 1982, and the PC-compatible market fully exploded in 1983.
timeline.card_summary_en: An open, clonable architecture made the IBM PC the standard, pushing compute to office and home.
timeline.why_it_matters_en: The IBM PC was the hinge of compute democratization. Without PC standardization there are no 1990s graduate students training neural networks in dorm rooms and no indie AI laboratories in the 2000s. The hardware base letting anyone run LLM inference today traces back to the 1,565-dollar IBM 5150 of August 1981.
timeline.behind_scenes_en: The decisive choice was open architecture: IBM monopolized neither motherboard design, BIOS, nor operating system, taking off-the-shelf Intel CPUs and Microsoft DOS, converting the PC into a standard any third party could clone. Compaq, Dell, and HP rose as clone makers while Microsoft and Intel emerged as the greatest winners of the 1980s-90s. For AI, the IBM PC widened personally owned computing from the hacker circle to offices and families, creating soil for home experiments, independent developers, and open-source toolchains.

timeline.title_zh: Hopfield 网络:神经网络复苏的火花
timeline.title_en: Hopfield Network: Revival of Neural Networks
timeline.summary_zh:
1982 年 4 月,Caltech 物理学家 John Hopfield 在 PNAS 79(8):2554-2558 发表《Neural networks and physical systems with emergent collective computational abilities》。
他构造了一个对称全连接的二值神经元网络,并引入“能量函数”的概念,证明网络状态会沿能量梯度下降,最终收敛到吸引子(局部极小)。
把一个记忆存进网络 = 把吸引子刻进能量地形;给网络一个残缺输入 = 让小球滚回最近的洼地。
这一刻神经网络突然有了物理直觉,不再只是心理学模型。
timeline.card_summary_zh: Hopfield 用能量函数解释神经网络如何收敛到稳定记忆，连接主义由此重新获得数学上的可信度。
timeline.summary_en: In April 1982, Caltech physicist John Hopfield published "Neural networks and physical systems with emergent collective computational abilities" in *PNAS* 79(8):2554-2558. By constructing a symmetrically fully connected binary neural network and introducing an "energy function," he proved that network states would descend along the energy gradient to converge at an attractor (local minimum). Storing a memory meant carving an attractor into the energy landscape, while feeding the network a partial input was like letting a ball roll back into the nearest depression—suddenly giving neural networks physical intuition, rather than just psychological modeling.
timeline.card_summary_en: Hopfield used an energy function to explain how networks settle into stable memories.
timeline.why_it_matters_en: Hopfield networks were never the engineering workhorse, but they put the claim that neural networks can compute back on the table. Without that kick, Rumelhart-Hinton-Williams's 1986 backpropagation might have found no audience. Much of today's deep learning world has forgotten the line, yet Hopfield shared the 2024 Nobel Prize in Physics with Hinton precisely for this reconnection of physics and neural networks.
timeline.behind_scenes_en: Timing was decisive. 1982 sat near the end of the first AI winter, with neural networks all but forgotten in mainstream AI circles. Hopfield was a physicist, not an AI insider, and publishing in PNAS instead of an AI journal neatly bypassed the biases of symbolic reviewers. His continuous Hopfield network of 1984 and optimization-computation papers with Tank in 1985 brought networks back into mainstream view, paving the road straight to 1986's PDP volumes and backpropagation.

timeline.title_zh: 日本第五代计算机计划:国家级 AI 投入的范式样本
timeline.title_en: Japanese Fifth Generation Computer Systems Project
timeline.summary_zh:
1982 年 4 月,日本通产省(MITI)正式启动"第五代计算机系统(FGCS)"计划,由 ICOT(新一代计算机技术开发研究所)执行,总投入约 570 亿日元(约 3-4 亿美元),为期 10 年。
目标是用 Prolog 作为核心语言,把并行推理硬件化,造出能直接处理知识推理的"第五代计算机",超越冯诺依曼架构。
计划在 1992 年结束,达成硬件原型(PSI、PIM)和 KL1(Kernel Language 1)等 Prolog 编译器,但没有实现预期的"知识信息处理"突破。
timeline.source_name: Feigenbaum, E. A. & McCorduck, P. (1983). The Fifth Generation; ICOT Final Report 1992
timeline.card_summary_zh: 日本第五代计算机计划：国家级 AI 投入的范式样本；FGCS 是“国家级 AI 大投入 ≠ 技术路线正确”的典型样本。
timeline.summary_en: In April 1982, Japan's Ministry of International Trade and Industry (MITI) launched the 10-year "Fifth Generation Computer Systems" (FGCS) initiative, executed by the Institute for New Generation Computer Technology (ICOT) with a total investment of roughly 57 billion yen (about $300-400 million). The goal was to bypass the Von Neumann architecture by using Prolog as the core language to implement parallel inference in hardware, building a "fifth-generation computer" capable of directly processing knowledge inference. Although the project concluded in 1992 and yielded hardware prototypes (PSI, PIM) and Prolog compilers like KL1 (Kernel Language 1), it failed to deliver the anticipated breakthrough in "knowledge information processing."
timeline.card_summary_en: Japan poured national funding into logic-based AI hardware, and the Fifth Generation project became the classic lesson that big budgets do not guarantee the right technical route.
timeline.why_it_matters_en: FGCS is the textbook case of national-scale AI investment backing the wrong paradigm. It holds three warnings for today's government AI strategies: policy should not dictate technical routes, hardware bets should not be locked to one architecture, and concentrated resources do not always beat distributed exploration in basic research.
timeline.behind_scenes_en: FGCS is one of the most dramatic episodes in 1980s AI politics. When MITI opened the first FGCS conference in Tokyo in 1981, Western AI researchers felt a wave of panic about being overtaken, which directly pushed DARPA to launch its Strategic Computing Initiative in 1983 as a counterattack. The root cause of failure was a wrong technical bet: hardwiring symbolic inference was unrealistic given 1980s computing power and compiler technology, while Rumelhart's 1986 backpropagation work had already shifted the field toward statistical learning. The symbolic-inference-hardware line was simply abandoned by the times.

timeline.title_zh: DARPA 战略计算计划:美国国家级 AI 反击
timeline.title_en: DARPA Strategic Computing Initiative
timeline.summary_zh:
1983 年 10 月,DARPA 启动 Strategic Computing Initiative(SCI),为期 10 年,总预算 10 亿美元,是美国对日本 FGCS 计划的直接回应。
SCI 三个支柱:1. 智能武器(自主巡航导弹、坦克火控系统)2. 智能飞行员助手(语音交互、战术规划)3. 智能自主载具(Naval Battle Management)项目资助 CMU、MIT、斯坦福、SRI 等核心 AI 实验室,并推动 MIPS RISC、Warp 并行机、CMU 自主驾驶 Navlab 等硬件平台。
timeline.source_name: Kahn, R. (1983). Strategic Computing Plan, DARPA; Roland & Shiman (2002) Strategic Computing
timeline.card_summary_zh: DARPA 战略计算计划：美国国家级 AI 反击；SCI 是“国家级 AI 投入怎么有效、怎么失效”的早期样本。
timeline.summary_en: In October 1983, DARPA launched the Strategic Computing Initiative (SCI), a 10-year, $1 billion program serving as America’s direct response to Japan's FGCS project. The initiative targeted three pillars: autonomous weapons (autonomous cruise missiles, tank fire-control systems), an intelligent pilot associate (voice interaction, tactical planning), and smart autonomous vehicles (Naval Battle Management). It funded core AI labs at CMU, MIT, Stanford, and SRI, while driving hardware platforms like MIPS RISC, the Warp parallel machine, and CMU's autonomous driving Navlab.
timeline.card_summary_en: DARPA answered Japan's AI push with its own national program, and the Strategic Computing Initiative became an early case study in when state AI funding works and when it fails.
timeline.why_it_matters_en: SCI is an early sample of how national AI investment both succeeds and fails. It worked by funding a generation of AI researchers and pushing RISC hardware and autonomous-driving prototypes. It failed through grandiose goals and a fixation on symbolic AI at the expense of statistical learning. Today's national AI strategies across the US, EU, and China all repeat SCI's pattern, making its success and failure conditions worth studying.
timeline.behind_scenes_en: SCI was born under combined Cold War and economic pressure. After Japan announced FGCS in 1981, the American AI community panicked. Robert Kahn, then director of DARPA IPTO, led the writing of the SCI strategy document, elevating AI to a strategic technology on par with SDI. SCI's lavish funding from 1983 to 1988 carried the field through the approach of the second winter, but the Cold War ended in 1991 and SCI's evaluation came back poor. The deep cuts from 1991 to 1993 triggered the darkest phase of the second AI winter.

timeline.title_zh: Cyc 项目:常识知识库的漫长实验
timeline.title_en: Cyc Project: Long Experiment on Common Sense Knowledge Base
timeline.summary_zh:
1984 年 9 月,Douglas Lenat 在 MCC(Microelectronics and Computer Consortium)启动 Cyc 项目,目标是手工构建覆盖人类常识的百万级知识库。
Cyc 用谓词逻辑表达事实(“水是液体”“人会死”),用规则表达推理(“如果 X 是液体,则 X 会流动”)。
1995 年 Cyc 分拆出 Cycorp 公司,继续独立维护。
到 2024 年 Cyc 累计录入约 250 万条公理、3 万谓词,覆盖日常物理、生物、社会、法律等领域。
timeline.source_name: Lenat, D. B. & Guha, R. V. (1989). Building Large Knowledge-Based Systems; Cycorp 2024
timeline.card_summary_zh: Cyc 项目：常识知识库的漫长实验；Cyc 是“符号 AI 路线能做到什么程度”的极限测试。
timeline.summary_en: In September 1984, Douglas Lenat launched the Cyc project at the Microelectronics and Computer Consortium (MCC), aiming to manually build a million-scale knowledge base of human common sense. Cyc used predicate logic to represent facts (like "water is liquid" and "humans die") and rules to represent reasoning (such as "if X is a liquid, then X flows"). Spun off into Cycorp in 1995 for independent maintenance, the project had accumulated about 2.5 million axioms and 30,000 predicates by 2024, covering domains like everyday physics, biology, society, and law.
timeline.card_summary_en: Douglas Lenat began building Cyc, a commonsense knowledge base, and turned it into a forty-year stress test of how far symbolic AI can actually go.
timeline.why_it_matters_en: Cyc is the ultimate test of what the symbolic AI route can achieve. Its core failure was not weak technology but the discovery that common sense is fundamentally statistical rather than rule-based. Today's debates about knowledge bases versus neural networks and explicit versus implicit knowledge still lean on Cyc's four decades of comparative data. Understanding Cyc explains why mainstream AI pivoted entirely to data-driven methods after 2012.
timeline.behind_scenes_en: Cyc was the most ambitious engineering project of symbolic AI. In 1984 Lenat estimated it would take 30 years and 25 million rules to cover human common sense, a timetable never met. Through the 1990s Cyc faced repeated criticism: rule counts did not translate into reasoning quality, common sense resisted decomposition into discrete rules, and maintenance costs grew exponentially with scale. After 2000, LLMs solved the commonsense problem with big data and statistics, marginalizing Cyc in mainstream research. But Cycorp kept maintaining and extending it, now positioning Cyc as a knowledge-alignment tool for LLMs.

timeline.title_zh: 专家系统商业化受挫:规则维护成本失控
timeline.title_en: Expert System Commercialization Stalls: Rule Maintenance Costs Explode
timeline.summary_zh:
1985 年前后,大量模仿 XCON 的企业级专家系统项目开始集中暴露问题。
核心瓶颈是“知识获取瓶颈(Knowledge Acquisition Bottleneck)”:让工程师坐在医生、律师、地质学家身边,试图把他们的隐性经验拆成规则,几乎不可行。
领域专家自己说不清自己怎么判断,工程师抄出来的规则上线后,遇到边缘案例就崩溃。
XCON 自己的规则库到 1986 年已膨胀到上千至上万条,每条新规则都要检查和旧规则是否冲突,维护成本指数级上升。
timeline.source_name: Feigenbaum, E. A. (1977) IJCAI Keynote; Crevier (1993); Russell & Norvig AIAMA 1.4
timeline.card_summary_zh: 专家系统在真实环境中遭遇规则爆炸和维护失控，行业开始意识到把专家经验写成规则远比预想困难。
timeline.summary_en: Around 1985, numerous enterprise expert system projects mimicking XCON began to face widespread issues, driven by the "Knowledge Acquisition Bottleneck"—the near-impossible task of having engineers shadow doctors, lawyers, and geologists to translate their tacit experience into rules. Domain experts struggled to explain their own decision-making, and the rules engineers transcribed frequently crashed when encountering edge cases in production. By 1986, XCON’s own database had bloated to thousands to tens of thousands of rules, sending maintenance costs soaring exponentially as every new rule had to be checked for conflicts with existing ones.
timeline.card_summary_en: Expert systems hit a wall of exploding rule counts and maintenance costs, and the industry learned that encoding expert knowledge is far harder than expected.
timeline.why_it_matters_en: The knowledge acquisition bottleneck was the fatal flaw of symbolic AI, and the very reason connectionism and statistical learning rose. Today's LLM-based knowledge extraction, RAG systems, and agent toolchains are all detours around the trap of having humans hand-write rules. Seeing the 1985 failure clearly explains why the LLM route scales better in engineering than expert systems ever did.
timeline.behind_scenes_en: The bottleneck was not new. Feigenbaum had flagged knowledge engineering as AI's central obstacle in his 1977 IJCAI lecture, but XCON's success buried the warning. After 1985 companies discovered that a version-1.0 expert system could ship in three months, yet versions 2.0 and 3.0 demanded endless rule additions, edits, and conflict checks, with total costs blowing past budgets. The same trap later caught IBM Watson, Cyc, and other large-scale knowledge engineering projects.

timeline.title_zh: Quinlan ID3:决策树机器学习的工程起点
timeline.title_en: Quinlan ID3: Engineering Origin of Decision Tree Learning
timeline.summary_zh:
1986 年 3 月,Ross Quinlan 在 Machine Learning 1(1):81-106 发表《Induction of Decision Trees》。
ID3 用信息增益(Information Gain)选择分裂属性,递归构造决策树,把表格数据自动转成可解释的判断规则。
1993 年 Quinlan 扩展为 C4.5,处理连续属性、缺失值、剪枝,C4.5 成为基础机器学习教科书的核心算法。
决策树路线后来在 2001 年 Breiman Random Forest、2014 年 Chen XGBoost、2017 年 Ke LightGBM 上达到工业顶峰。
timeline.source_name: Quinlan, J. R. (1986). Machine Learning 1(1):81-106; (1993) C4.5: Programs for Machine Learning
timeline.card_summary_zh: ID3 用信息增益自动选择判断条件，让决策树成为易解释、可复现并能处理真实数据的机器学习工具。
timeline.summary_en: In March 1986, Ross Quinlan published "Induction of Decision Trees" in *Machine Learning* 1(1):81-106, introducing ID3, which used Information Gain to select splitting attributes and recursively construct decision trees that automatically converted tabular data into interpretable decision rules. Quinlan expanded this in 1993 into C4.5 to handle continuous attributes, missing values, and pruning, cementing it as a foundational algorithm in machine learning textbooks. The decision tree lineage eventually reached its industrial peak with Breiman's Random Forest in 2001, Chen's XGBoost in 2014, and Ke's LightGBM in 2017.
timeline.card_summary_en: Ross Quinlan's ID3 used information gain to pick decision conditions automatically, turning decision trees into interpretable machine learning that handles real data.
timeline.why_it_matters_en: ID3 was an early pillar of practical machine learning. During the second AI winter of the 1990s, decision trees became the most widely deployed models in banking, insurance, and retail precisely because they were explainable and easy to ship. Today's debates about black-box versus interpretable models still treat decision trees as the reference standard for explainable AI.
timeline.behind_scenes_en: Quinlan did this work at the University of Sydney, drawing on Hunt's 1979 CLS concept-learning system and his own frustration in a 1983 expert-system project where hand-extracting rules was painfully slow. His key insight: rather than having people write rules, let the machine induce them from examples. The idea fit the connectionist revival of 1986 but took a middle path of symbols plus learning, later growing into an important branch of explainable AI.

timeline.title_zh: PDP 两卷本:连接主义的认知科学宣言
timeline.title_en: Parallel Distributed Processing: Connectionism Manifesto
timeline.summary_zh:
1986 年 7 月,MIT Press 出版两卷本《Parallel Distributed Processing: Explorations in the Microstructure of Cognition》(Rumelhart, McClelland, PDP Research Group)。
Volume 1: Foundations, Volume 2: Psychological and Biological Models。
PDP 把认知建模、神经网络、心理实验、神经科学统一在一个框架下:知识分布在大量简单单元的连接里,学习 = 调整连接权重,记忆 = 网络状态吸引子,思维 = 多个模块并行协作。
这是连接主义对符号主义的一次正面宣言。
timeline.source_name: Rumelhart, D. E., McClelland, J. L., PDP Research Group (1986). MIT Press, 2 vols
timeline.card_summary_zh: 《并行分布式处理》为神经网络建立完整的认知科学叙事，连接主义不再只是零散算法。
timeline.summary_en: In July 1986, MIT Press published the two-volume *Parallel Distributed Processing: Explorations in the Microstructure of Cognition* (Rumelhart, McClelland, PDP Research Group), consisting of *Volume 1: Foundations* and *Volume 2: Psychological and Biological Models*. The PDP framework unified cognitive modeling, neural networks, psychological experiments, and neuroscience under a single premise: knowledge is distributed across connections of simple units, learning is adjusting connection weights, memory is network state attractors, and thinking is the parallel collaboration of multiple modules. This served as connectionism’s direct manifesto against symbolism.
timeline.card_summary_en: The two-volume Parallel Distributed Processing gave neural networks a full cognitive-science narrative, turning connectionism from scattered algorithms into a coherent movement.
timeline.why_it_matters_en: PDP gave neural networks an entire cognitive-science story, not just engineering tricks. It shaped every post-1990s research paradigm of distributed representation, learning, and emergence, including the emergence capabilities, representation alignment, and chain-of-thought discussions around today's LLMs. Understanding PDP explains why Hinton held onto the belief that intelligence is learned connection patterns for his entire career.
timeline.behind_scenes_en: PDP was not a paper collection but a paradigm revolution. Rumelhart and McClelland assembled the PDP Research Group at UCSD in the 1980s, with members including Hinton, Sejnowski, Smolensky, and Cleeremans, who would become connectionism's core force. The two most consequential chapters: Volume 1 Chapter 8, where Rumelhart, Hinton, and Williams published backpropagation months before the Nature paper, and Volume 2 Chapter 19, where McClelland simulated children overregularizing language with a PDP model. The latter directly challenged Chomsky's innate-grammar hypothesis, igniting the 1988-1990 connectionism-versus-symbolism war in cognitive science.

timeline.title_zh: Rumelhart-Hinton-Williams 反向传播:深度学习的工程起点
timeline.title_en: Rumelhart-Hinton-Williams Backpropagation Paper
timeline.summary_zh:
1986 年 10 月 9 日,Nature 323:533-536 发表《Learning representations by back-propagating errors》(Rumelhart, Hinton, Williams)。
论文把反向模式自动微分明确应用在多层神经网络上,给出干净的可计算梯度公式,让隐藏层权重可以用 SGD 更新。
虽然 Linnainmaa 1970 给过算法、Werbos 1974 在 PhD 里用过,但这篇 Nature 论文让 BP 成为 AI 圈共同语言,是深度学习工程化的真正起点。
timeline.source_name: Rumelhart, D. E., Hinton, G. E., Williams, R. J. (1986). Nature 323:533-536
timeline.card_summary_zh: 反向传播让多层神经网络能够系统地修正误差，沉寂已久的连接主义终于获得可训练的工程方法。
timeline.summary_en: On October 9, 1986, *Nature* 323:533-536 published "Learning representations by back-propagating errors" (Rumelhart, Hinton, Williams), which explicitly applied reverse-mode automatic differentiation to multilayer neural networks, providing a clean, computable gradient formula to update hidden layer weights via SGD. Although Linnainmaa had proposed the algorithm in 1970 and Werbos used it in his 1974 PhD, this paper made BP the common language of the AI community, marking the true starting point of deep learning engineering.
timeline.card_summary_en: Rumelhart, Hinton, and Williams published backpropagation in Nature, giving multilayer neural networks a systematic way to fix their errors and reviving connectionism.
timeline.why_it_matters_en: This four-page paper was ground zero for deep learning engineering. The training pipelines behind GPT, Stable Diffusion, and AlphaFold all extend that 1986 move of fitting reverse-mode automatic differentiation into neural networks. Tracing the three-step line of Linnainmaa 1970, Werbos 1974, and RHW 1986 shows why inventing backpropagation and making it matter were two different events.
timeline.behind_scenes_en: Before 1986 Rumelhart studied cognitive models within the PDP framework; backpropagation was originally meant to solve how multilayer networks learn internal representations. Hinton was working on Boltzmann machines and Williams on reinforcement learning when the three co-wrote the short paper as a byproduct of the PDP project. Publishing in Nature was decisive: it bypassed the symbolic bias of AI journal reviewers and pulled neural networks back into mainstream science. Hinton's 2024 Nobel Prize in Physics, shared with Hopfield, cited precisely this line of work.

timeline.title_zh: 第二次 AI 寒冬:LISP 机崩盘与专家系统时代结束
timeline.title_en: Second AI Winter: LISP Machine Collapse and End of Expert System Era
timeline.summary_zh:
1987-1993 年是 AI 史上最长的寒冬,起点是 1987 年下半年 LISP 机市场崩盘。
Symbolics、LMI 两家 LISP 机厂商销售额断崖式下跌,到 1988 年 Symbolics 破产保护,LMI 关闭;通用工作站(Sun、DEC、SGI)在性能价格比上全面碾压专用 LISP 硬件,AI 公司的硬件护城河一夜消失。
顶点是 1991 年 DARPA SCI 计划大幅削减 AI 通用资助,日本 FGCS 1992 年结算失败,结束点是 1993 年专家系统产业产值跌回 1980 年水平。
这六年间,CMU、MIT、斯坦福、SRI 的 AI 实验室经费腰斩,毕业生就业困难,大批研究者转向其他领域。
timeline.source_name: Crevier, G. (1993). AI: The Tumultuous History; Russell & Norvig AIAMA 4th ed Ch 1.4
timeline.card_summary_zh: LISP 机器市场崩盘、专家系统维护成本失控，AI 再次从资本宠儿跌入长期降温期。
timeline.summary_en: Triggered by the late-1987 collapse of the LISP machine market, the longest winter in AI history (1987–1993) saw sales at Symbolics and LMI plummet—leading to Symbolics' 1988 bankruptcy filing and LMI's closure—as general-purpose workstations from Sun, DEC, and SGI wiped out AI hardware moats overnight by dominating on price-performance. The crisis peaked when DARPA drastically cut general AI funding for its SCI program in 1991 and Japan’s FGCS concluded in failure in 1992, before finally ending in 1993 when the expert systems industry's output value fell back to 1980 levels. Over these six years, budgets at AI labs across CMU, MIT, Stanford, and SRI were halved, leaving graduates struggling to find jobs and driving a mass exodus of researchers to other fields.
timeline.card_summary_en: LISP machine prices collapsed and expert systems became unsustainable, dropping AI from capital-market darling into a long cooling period known as the second winter.
timeline.why_it_matters_en: The second winter moved AI's center of gravity from expert systems plus symbolic reasoning toward statistical learning and neural networks, and forged the low-profile culture of 1990-2010: no grand promises, prove a small use case first. That culture let Hinton's 2006 DBN and AlexNet in 2012 build up solidly instead of being hyped to death. Today's generative AI narrative looks nearly identical to the 1984 expert-system bubble, so understanding this winter helps recognize today's risk signals.
timeline.behind_scenes_en: It was a triple blow hitting simultaneously. Hardware: general workstations crushed LISP machines on price-performance, turning specialized hardware into dead weight. Business: XCON-style systems had been copied en masse into medicine, law, and finance by 1984-1986, where maintenance costs exploded, rule bases aged, and errors resisted diagnosis, so ROI failed and investors withdrew. Policy: DARPA settled accounts on SCI in 1991 and Japan's FGCS wound up unsuccessfully in 1992. The winter ran deeper than 1974 because the first was about unkept promises while this one was about broken business models. But seeds survived: LeCun's 1989 CNN, Scholkopf's 1995 SVM, and Hochreiter's 1997 LSTM were all written inside it.

timeline.title_zh: Pearl 贝叶斯网络:让概率推理进入 AI
timeline.title_en: Pearl Bayesian Networks: Probabilistic Reasoning Enters AI
timeline.summary_zh:
1985-1988 年,UCLA 的 Judea Pearl 系统化提出贝叶斯网络(Bayesian Network),1988 年 9 月由 Morgan Kaufmann 出版《Probabilistic Reasoning in Intelligent Systems: Networks of Plausible Inference》。
贝叶斯网络用有向无环图(DAG)表达变量间的条件依赖,节点 = 随机变量,边 = 条件概率关系。
推理 = 在 DAG 上做信念传播(Belief Propagation)。
这把概率推理从模糊的“不确定性”变成可计算、可可视化的结构。
timeline.source_name: Pearl, J. (1988). Probabilistic Reasoning in Intelligent Systems. Morgan Kaufmann; Turing Award 2011
timeline.card_summary_zh: 贝叶斯网络让机器能够在信息不完整时更新判断，概率推理从此进入 AI 的核心工具箱。
timeline.summary_en: Between 1985 and 1988, UCLA’s Judea Pearl systematized the Bayesian Network, culminating in the September 1988 publication of *Probabilistic Reasoning in Intelligent Systems: Networks of Plausible Inference* by Morgan Kaufmann. By representing conditional dependencies among variables using directed acyclic graphs (DAGs)—where nodes are random variables and edges represent conditional probability relationships—inference is executed through belief propagation on the DAG. This transformed probabilistic reasoning from a vague concept of "uncertainty" into a computable, visualizable structure.
timeline.card_summary_en: Judea Pearl's Bayesian networks let machines update judgments under incomplete information, bringing probabilistic reasoning into AI's core toolbox.
timeline.why_it_matters_en: Bayesian networks were the workhorse of probabilistic AI from 1990 to 2010, widely used in medical diagnosis, fault localization, language understanding, and recommendation. LLMs have absorbed many of those applications, but in high-stakes domains like healthcare, law, and insurance, Bayesian networks remain the first choice for explainable inference. Pearl's causal framework is also the theoretical coordinate system for today's debates about whether LLMs can do causal reasoning.
timeline.behind_scenes_en: Pearl introduced the Bayesian network framework at the UAI conference in 1985 and spent 1986-1988 publishing a dense series of papers completing the theory. His core insight: uncertainty in expert systems could not be fixed by bolting on confidence scores; causal structure and probabilistic reasoning had to be modeled separately. He later extended the framework into causal inference with do-calculus, winning the Turing Award in 2011. Much of the current discourse on correlation versus causation in LLMs still speaks Pearl's language.

timeline.title_zh: Watkins Q-learning:强化学习的核心算法
timeline.title_en: Watkins Q-learning: Core Algorithm of Reinforcement Learning
timeline.summary_zh:
1989 年,Christopher Watkins 在剑桥大学提交博士论文《Learning from Delayed Rewards》。
提出 Q-learning 算法:智能体在状态 s 下采取动作 a,观察到奖励 r 和下一状态 s',更新 Q(s,a) ← Q(s,a) + α[r + γ max Q(s',a') - Q(s,a)]。
这是 off-policy 时序差分学习的关键形式,在足够探索和衰减学习率下可证明收敛到最优 Q 函数。
Q-learning 与 Sutton 1984/1988 的 TD(λ) 同属时序差分家族,但二者有别:Q-learning 是 off-policy 的动作价值迭代,TD(λ) 是状态价值预测。1992 年 Tesauro 的 TD-Gammon 用的是 TD(λ)(而非 Q-learning)在西洋双陆棋上达到接近顶尖选手水平,让主流重新关注强化学习。
timeline.source_name: Watkins, C. J. C. H. (1989). PhD thesis, University of Cambridge; (1992) Machine Learning 8(3-4)
timeline.card_summary_zh: Q-learning 让智能体不必知道环境模型，也能通过试错逼近最优策略，成为强化学习最经典的起点之一。
timeline.summary_en: In 1989, Christopher Watkins submitted his University of Cambridge PhD thesis, *Learning from Delayed Rewards*, introducing the Q-learning algorithm, where an agent in state s takes action a, observes reward r and next state s', and updates Q(s,a) ← Q(s,a) + α[r + γ max Q(s',a') - Q(s,a)]. This key form of off-policy temporal difference learning provably converges to the optimal Q-function given sufficient exploration and a decaying learning rate. Though sharing the temporal difference family with Sutton’s 1984/1988 TD(λ), Q-learning differs as an off-policy action-value iteration rather than a state-value prediction; indeed, it was TD(λ) (not Q-learning) that revived mainstream interest in reinforcement learning when Tesauro’s TD-Gammon used it in 1992 to play backgammon at a level close to top-tier players.
timeline.card_summary_en: Chris Watkins' Q-learning let agents approach optimal strategies through trial and error without any model of the environment, becoming reinforcement learning's most classic starting point.
timeline.why_it_matters_en: Q-learning was ground zero for reinforcement learning engineering. PPO, the core algorithm of AlphaGo, AlphaStar, and ChatGPT's RLHF stage, all build on Q-learning's temporal-difference framework. Tracing Watkins' 1989 line makes clear that DQN in 2015 and PPO in 2017 were not sudden arrivals but the eruption of thirty years of RL engineering.
timeline.behind_scenes_en: Watkins wrote his 1989 thesis at the deepest point of the second AI winter, when reinforcement learning was a backwater built mainly on Bellman's 1957 dynamic programming, Sutton's 1984 TD(lambda), and Barto's 1983 actor-critic. Q-learning's key contribution was cleanly separating exploration from exploitation: off-policy learning lets an agent collect data with any behavior policy while the Q function still converges to optimal. DeepMind's DQN breakthrough on Atari from 2013 to 2015 was essentially Q-learning plus a neural network.

timeline.title_zh: Berners-Lee 提出万维网:AI 的语料基础
timeline.title_en: Berners-Lee Proposes the World Wide Web
timeline.summary_zh:
1989 年 3 月 12 日,Tim Berners-Lee 在 CERN 提交《Information Management: A Proposal》备忘录,提出用超链接把 CERN 内部散落的研究文档连成可浏览网络。
1990 年 12 月他与 Robert Cailliau 提交正式立项书,同月完成第一个 Web 服务器(info.cern.ch)和第一个浏览器(WorldWideWeb)。
1991 年 8 月 6 日 Web 正式对外公开,1993 年 CERN 宣布 Web 免费开放,1994 年 W3C 成立。
timeline.source_name: Berners-Lee, T. (1989). Information Management: A Proposal, CERN; (1990) WorldWideWeb: Proposal
timeline.card_summary_zh: Berners-Lee 提出万维网：AI 的语料基础，并成为这一阶段值得追踪的关键变化。
timeline.summary_en: On March 12, 1989, Tim Berners-Lee submitted his "Information Management: A Proposal" memo at CERN, proposing to link the organization's scattered research documents into a browsable network using hyperlinks. In December 1990, he and Robert Cailliau submitted a formal proposal, completing the first Web server (info.cern.ch) and first browser (WorldWideWeb) that same month. The Web officially went public on August 6, 1991, followed by CERN announcing it would be free to everyone in 1993, and the founding of the W3C in 1994.
timeline.card_summary_en: Tim Berners-Lee proposed the World Wide Web at CERN, laying the corpus foundation that large-scale AI would depend on decades later.
timeline.why_it_matters_en: Without the Web there is no Google, Wikipedia, or Stack Overflow, and none of the massive corpora LLM training requires. Today's debates about data scarcity, open versus closed models, and scraping compliance all rest on this infrastructure layer. The 1989 memo remains badly underrated in AI history: it was ground zero for the next thirty years of the AI data ecosystem.
timeline.behind_scenes_en: Berners-Lee's pain point was concrete: CERN's thousands of researchers came and went, with documents scattered across different machines, directories, and hands, so finding one experimental dataset often meant emailing half the lab. His manager called the proposal vague but exciting, and it only formally launched in 1990 after he hand-built a server and browser on a NeXT machine. Openness was the decisive choice: CERN dropped patent claims in 1993, making the Web public infrastructure, which is what later allowed search engines, Wikipedia, open-source code, and large-scale corpora to exist.

timeline.title_zh: LeCun 卷积网络:神经网走进银行与邮局
timeline.title_en: LeCun Convolutional Network for Handwriting Recognition
timeline.summary_zh:
1989 年冬,Yann LeCun 等人在 Neural Computation 1(4):541-551 发表《Backpropagation Applied to Handwritten Zip Code Recognition》。
这是第一个真正可用的工业级卷积神经网络,用于 USPS 邮政编码识别,输入 16×16 像素,3 个卷积隐藏层,约 1000 个神经元。
1993 年 LeCun 团队进一步在 AT&T 部署商业版本 LeNet,用于 NCR 的支票自动读取,美国 90% 的支票金额识别都跑在 LeNet 上。
这是神经网络第一次大规模进入生产环境。
timeline.source_name: LeCun, Y. et al. (1989). Neural Computation 1(4):541-551; (1998) Proc. IEEE 86(11)
timeline.card_summary_zh: LeCun 的卷积网络开始真实识别银行支票和邮政编码，神经网络第一次从论文走进日常工业系统。
timeline.summary_en: In the winter of 1989, Yann LeCun et al. published "Backpropagation Applied to Handwritten Zip Code Recognition" in *Neural Computation* 1(4):541-551, introducing the first truly usable, industrial-grade convolutional neural network, which recognized USPS zip codes using a 16x16 pixel input, three convolutional hidden layers, and about 1,000 neurons. By 1993, LeCun's team deployed a commercial version, LeNet, at AT&T for NCR's automatic check reading, with 90% of US check amount recognition running on LeNet. This marked the first time neural networks entered a production environment on a large scale.
timeline.card_summary_en: Yann LeCun's convolutional network started reading bank checks and postal codes in production, moving neural networks from papers into everyday industrial systems for the first time.
timeline.why_it_matters_en: LeCun's 1989 paper was ground zero for CNN engineering. It proved backpropagation-trained networks could run inside real businesses, giving connectionism a lifeline at the coldest moment of the second AI winter. AlexNet in 2012 was essentially LeNet scaled up and trained on GPUs; the technical route was already set in 1989 and simply waited for compute to catch up.
timeline.behind_scenes_en: LeCun finished his PhD under Hinton and joined AT&T Bell Labs in 1988, which had a USPS contract for handwritten ZIP code recognition. The traditional pipeline of hand-crafted features plus a classifier managed roughly 80% accuracy. LeCun fed raw pixels straight into a convolutional network trained with RHW backpropagation, and the first version hit above 95%, far beyond anything prior. The conv-pooling-fully-connected structure became the template for AlexNet and ResNet. When LeCun won the Turing Award in 2018, this line was the core citation.

timeline.title_zh: TD(λ) 与游戏强化学习路线确立
timeline.title_en: TD(λ) and Game Reinforcement Learning Established
timeline.summary_zh:
1990 年,Gerald Tesauro（IBM Thomas J. Watson 研究中心）在 IJCNN 发表《Neurogammon: A Neural Network Backgammon Program》,程序还赢得 1989 年首届 Computer Olympiad 西洋双陆棋组。
这是第一个用神经网络 + 监督学习达到中等水平西洋双陆棋的程序。
1992 年 8 月 Tesauro 在 AAAI Fall Symposium 报告 TD-Gammon 1.0,用 Sutton 1984 博士论文提出的 TD(λ) 时序差分学习规则,80 个隐藏单元的两层神经网络通过自我对弈约 30 万局,首次达到与人类专家持平的水平(WR 0.81)。
1993 年 TD-Gammon 2.0 加入监督学习预训练,达到世界级水平;1996 年 TD-Gammon 3.0 与世界冠军 Bill Robertie 对弈 100 局,平均每 100 局仅输 1-2 局,接近顶级人类水平。
TD-Gammon 是强化学习第一次在复杂策略游戏中达到人类顶级水平,为 2015 年 DeepMind DQN、2016 年 AlphaGo 铺平道路。
timeline.source_name: Tesauro, G. (1989) Computer Olympiad; (1990) IJCNN; (1992) AAAI Fall Symposium; (1995) Communications of the ACM 38(3):58-68; (1995) Machine Learning 15(3):205-230; Robertie, B. (1998) Inside Backgammon
timeline.card_summary_zh: TD(λ) 与游戏强化学习路线确立；TD-Gammon 是 AlphaGo 的史前版本。
timeline.summary_en: At IJCNN in 1990, Gerald Tesauro of the IBM Thomas J. Watson Research Center published "Neurogammon: A Neural Network Backgammon Program"—the first system to use neural networks and supervised learning to reach intermediate-level play, which also won the backgammon division at the inaugural 1989 Computer Olympiad. In August 1992, Tesauro presented TD-Gammon 1.0 at the AAAI Fall Symposium; using the TD(λ) temporal difference learning rule from Sutton’s 1984 PhD thesis, its two-layer, 80-hidden-unit neural network played about 300,000 self-play games to match human experts for the first time (WR 0.81), a benchmark later elevated by 1993's world-class TD-Gammon 2.0 (which added supervised pre-training) and 1996's TD-Gammon 3.0, which approached top human levels by losing just 1–2 games per 100 on average against world champion Bill Robertie. As the first instance of reinforcement learning achieving top-tier human performance in a complex strategy game, TD-Gammon paved the way for DeepMind's DQN in 2015 and AlphaGo in 2016.
timeline.card_summary_en: Gerald Tesauro's TD-Gammon learned backgammon purely by playing itself, proving self-play plus neural networks could master complex games, a preview of AlphaGo.
timeline.why_it_matters_en: TD-Gammon is AlphaGo's prehistoric ancestor. It proved that self-play, neural networks, and temporal-difference learning could master a strategic game and even discover strategies human experts had missed, the same core recipe behind AlphaGo, AlphaZero, and ChatGPT's RLHF. The 2016 breakthrough was not a sudden arrival but the eruption of twenty-five years of RL engineering.
timeline.behind_scenes_en: Tesauro built TD-Gammon at IBM Research as something close to a side project. TD(lambda) came from Sutton's 1984 dissertation; Tesauro combined it with a neural network so the program learned its evaluation function from scratch through win-loss feedback. With no human expert rules at all, it taught itself opening moves that experts considered mistakes, until analysis showed TD-Gammon's choices were actually stronger, reshaping human opening theory. That early case of AI surpassing expert intuition structurally resembles AlphaGo's move 37 in 2016. Through the 1990s it was RL's only widely cited success, carrying the field through the second winter.

timeline.title_zh: Loebner Prize 首届图灵测试竞赛
timeline.title_en: First Loebner Prize Turing Test Competition
timeline.summary_zh:
1991 年 11 月 8 日,首届 Loebner Prize 在波士顿计算机博物馆举办。
Hugh Loebner 赞助 10 万美元奖金,目标找一台能在文字对话中骗过人类裁判的机器。
首届冠军是 Joseph Weintraub 的 PC Therapist,靠“心理治疗师”设定回避实质问题,在“陌生人聊天”里骗到 5 名裁判中的 3 名。
Loebner Prize 之后每年举办直到 2019 年,从未有机器达到 Loebner 定义的“完全通过图灵测试”标准。
timeline.source_name: Loebner, H. (1991). Communications of the ACM 34(2); Shieber, S. (1994) AI Magazine 15(3)
timeline.card_summary_zh: Loebner Prize 首届图灵测试竞赛；Loebner Prize 是“图灵测试作为评测范式”的长期实验。
timeline.summary_en: On November 8, 1991, the inaugural Loebner Prize was held at the Boston Computer Museum, offering a $100,000 prize sponsored by Hugh Loebner to find a machine that could fool human judges in text-based conversations. The first winner was Joseph Weintraub's PC Therapist, which avoided substantive issues by adopting a "therapist" persona, fooling three out of five judges in a "stranger chat." The competition ran annually until 2019, but no machine ever met Loebner's criteria for "completely passing the Turing test."
timeline.card_summary_en: The first Loebner Prize turned the Turing test into an annual contest, beginning a long experiment in whether fooling humans can measure machine intelligence.
timeline.why_it_matters_en: The Loebner Prize tested the Turing test as an evaluation paradigm and showed its limits: using can-it-deceive-humans as the standard fails because humans are easily manipulated by social engineering. Today's LLMs far exceed Loebner-era programs on such tests, yet the field abandoned the Turing test as a benchmark in favor of quantifiable ones like MMLU, HumanEval, and SWE-Bench.
timeline.behind_scenes_en: The prize stayed controversial from the start. In 1995 Marvin Minsky joined more than ninety AI researchers signing a petition arguing the contest rewarded clever trickery rather than intelligence, urging Loebner to withdraw it. He refused, and the contest ran until his death in 2019. When the University of Reading organized Turing Test 2014, Eugene Goostman deceived 33% of judges behind a persona of a Ukrainian thirteen-year-old learning English, lowering the bar exactly the way PC Therapist's tricks did back in 1991.

timeline.title_zh: Mosaic 1.0 发布:Web 走出学术圈
timeline.title_en: Mosaic 1.0 Released: Web Goes Beyond Academia
timeline.summary_zh:
1993 年 4 月 22 日,NCSA 发布 Mosaic 1.0 for Windows 浏览器,由 Marc Andreessen 和 Eric Bina 在伊利诺伊大学开发。
Mosaic 是第一个支持图文混排、跨平台(Windows/Mac/Unix)、易安装的图形浏览器,把 Web 从 CERN 学术工具变成大众消费品。
1994 年 Andreessen 离开 NCSA 创办 Netscape,1994 年 12 月 Netscape Navigator 1.0 发布,1995 年 8 月 Netscape 上市,Internet 时代正式开启。
timeline.source_name: NCSA Mosaic 1.0 announcement (1993-04-22); Andreessen interviews
timeline.card_summary_zh: Mosaic 1.0 发布：Web 走出学术圈；Mosaic 是 Web 大众化的起点。
timeline.summary_en: On April 22, 1993, NCSA released the Mosaic 1.0 for Windows browser, developed by Marc Andreessen and Eric Bina at the University of Illinois. As the first easy-to-install, cross-platform (Windows/Mac/Unix) graphical browser to support inline text and images, Mosaic transformed the Web from a CERN academic tool into a mass consumer product. In 1994, Andreessen left NCSA to found Netscape, which released Netscape Navigator 1.0 in December 1994 and went public in August 1995, officially ushering in the Internet era.
timeline.card_summary_en: Mosaic 1.0 put images, forms, and links into one graphical browser, taking the Web out of academia and starting its path to mass adoption.
timeline.why_it_matters_en: Mosaic was where the Web went mainstream. Without Web adoption there would be no Google, Wikipedia, or Stack Overflow, and no massive corpora for training LLMs. Today's debates over the open internet versus closed data trace directly back to the premise Mosaic created in 1993 when it carried the Web beyond academic walls.
timeline.behind_scenes_en: Before Mosaic, browsers were essentially CERN's WorldWideWeb on NeXT and LineMode in plain text. Mosaic integrated pictures, forms, and hyperlinks in one GUI so ordinary users could go online without a command line, which was the key to mass adoption. The team then split in two directions: Andreessen founded Netscape, while NCSA licensed Mosaic to Spyglass, whose technology Microsoft bought in 1995 and evolved into Internet Explorer 1.0. Web popularization paved the way for search engines, Wikipedia, blogging, and social networks, and laid the foundation for the public corpora that LLMs train on.

timeline.title_zh: FERET 推动人脸识别评测基准
timeline.title_en: FERET Database Establishes Face Recognition Evaluation
timeline.summary_zh:
1993-1996 年,美国 DARPA 资助的 FERET(Facial Recognition Technology)项目在 Army Research Lab 收集 14126 张人脸图像,覆盖 1199 人,用于建立人脸识别算法的标准化评测基准。
1996 年 FERET Evaluation Protocol 定义了训练集 / Gallery / Probe 三段评测流程,成为后续 NIST FRVT 评测的母版。
FERET 直接催生 Eigenface、Fisherface、LBP 等经典人脸识别算法,并在 2000 年代演化为 FRGC、FRVT、MegaFace 等大规模评测。
timeline.source_name: Phillips, P. J. et al. (2000). FERET Database; NIST FRVT reports 2002-2024
timeline.card_summary_zh: FERET 推动人脸识别评测基准；FERET 是 AI 评测范式从“私有数据集”转向“公共基准”的起点。
timeline.summary_en: Between 1993 and 1996, the DARPA-funded FERET (Facial Recognition Technology) program collected 14,126 facial images of 1,199 individuals at the Army Research Lab to establish a standardized benchmark for facial recognition. In 1996, the FERET Evaluation Protocol introduced a three-stage evaluation workflow—Training Set, Gallery, and Probe—which served as the blueprint for subsequent NIST FRVT evaluations. This initiative directly catalyzed classic algorithms like Eigenface, Fisherface, and LBP, before evolving into massive 2000s-era benchmarks such as FRGC, FRVT, and MegaFace.
timeline.card_summary_en: FERET built the first shared face-recognition benchmark, moving AI evaluation from private datasets to public data plus protocol.
timeline.why_it_matters_en: FERET marked AI's shift from private datasets to public benchmarks. ImageNet, COCO, MMLU, and SWE-Bench all stand on the public-data-plus-protocol framework it established. It was also the earliest arena of surveillance and privacy controversy: today's legal and ethical debates about facial recognition return to this starting point.
timeline.behind_scenes_en: Before FERET, every face-recognition group tested on its own private dataset, so results were incomparable and reported accuracies mutually unverifiable. FERET bundled three things together, dataset, protocol, and evaluation service, letting DARPA objectively assess funded projects. The paradigm was inherited wholesale by ImageNet, COCO, and GLUE, becoming the source of standardized deep-learning evaluation. FERET was also an early source of AI ethics issues: from 2001 to 2003 its data powered Tampa's Super Bowl face-scanning system, one of the first cases of mass public surveillance by AI.

timeline.title_zh: Schmidhuber 长期记忆网络:神经网络记忆机制探索
timeline.title_en: Schmidhuber Long-Term Memory Network Exploration
timeline.summary_zh:
1995 年前后,Jürgen Schmidhuber 在 IDSIA 团队探索神经网络的长期记忆机制,包括 1991 年 Hochreiter 在他指导下发现梯度消失问题,1995-1997 年 Hochreiter-Schmidhuber 提出 LSTM,1995 年 Schmidhuber 还提出“自指网络(Self-Referential RNN)”让网络能写自己的权重。
Schmidhuber 团队在 90 年代是 RNN 研究的核心之一,和 Sutton、Jordan、Pearlmutter 等少数研究者共同支撑了 RL 和 RNN 的早期工作。
timeline.source_name: Schmidhuber, J. (1992-1997). IDSIA technical reports; Hochreiter master thesis 1991
timeline.card_summary_zh: Schmidhuber 长期记忆网络：神经网络记忆机制探索；Schmidhuber 路线是 LLM 时代前 RNN 的核心一支。
timeline.summary_en: Around 1995, Jürgen Schmidhuber’s team at IDSIA explored the long-term memory mechanisms of neural networks, which included Hochreiter’s 1991 discovery of the vanishing gradient problem under his guidance, Hochreiter and Schmidhuber's proposal of LSTM from 1995 to 1997, and Schmidhuber’s 1995 introduction of the "Self-Referential RNN" that allowed networks to write their own weights. In the 1990s, Schmidhuber's team was a core hub for RNN research, anchoring early work in RL and RNNs alongside a few other researchers like Sutton, Jordan, and Pearlmutter.
timeline.card_summary_en: Jurgen Schmidhuber's group explored memory mechanisms for recurrent networks, a line of work that became a central branch of sequence modeling before the LLM era.
timeline.why_it_matters_en: The Schmidhuber line was a core branch of RNN research before LLMs. Today's discussions of long-term memory, context windows, and vanishing gradients all build on the Hochreiter-Schmidhuber LSTM work of 1991-1997. Tracing this line reveals the engineering predicament of sequence modeling before Transformers, and why LSTM gave way so completely after 2017.
timeline.behind_scenes_en: Schmidhuber's situation in the 1990s reflected how marginal RNN researchers were during the second winter. IDSIA sat in Lugano, Switzerland, far from the CMU-MIT-Stanford core, and his group's papers drew little attention at NIPS and ICML through the decade. Only around 2009, when Sutskever and Hinton's teams broke speech recognition open with LSTM, did mainstream attention arrive. Schmidhuber has long harbored grievances toward the Hinton-LeCun-Bengio camp, arguing LSTM's contribution was undercredited in the 2018 Turing Award and publicly disputing how credit for deep learning was distributed. That dispute has never fully settled.

timeline.title_zh: Cortes-Vapnik SVM:统计学习的核心算法
timeline.title_en: Cortes-Vapnik Support Vector Machine
timeline.summary_zh:
1995 年 9 月,Corinna Cortes 和 Vladimir Vapnik 在 Machine Learning 20(3):273-297 发表《Support-Vector Networks》。
SVM 在特征空间中找一个最大间隔超平面分割两类,由距离边界最近的少数“支持向量”决定分类器。
通过核函数(kernel trick)把数据映射到高维空间,SVM 可以处理线性不可分问题。
常用核:线性、多项式、RBF(Gaussian)。
SVM 在 1996-2010 年是机器学习的主力算法,广泛应用于文本分类、生物信息、图像识别、金融风控。
timeline.source_name: Cortes, C. & Vapnik, V. (1995). Machine Learning 20(3):273-297; Vapnik (1995) The Nature of Statistical Learning Theory
timeline.card_summary_zh: 支持向量机用最大间隔寻找分类边界，在深度学习之前长期统治高维、小样本的机器学习任务。
timeline.summary_en: In September 1995, Corinna Cortes and Vladimir Vapnik published "Support-Vector Networks" in *Machine Learning* 20(3):273-297, introducing a classifier defined by a few boundary-adjacent "support vectors" that separate two classes using a maximum-margin hyperplane in a feature space.
