By leveraging the kernel trick—typically using linear, polynomial, or Gaussian RBF kernels—to map data into a high-dimensional space, SVM could successfully resolve linearly inseparable problems. This made SVM the workhorse algorithm of machine learning from 1996 to 2010, finding wide application in text classification, bioinformatics, image recognition, and financial risk control.
timeline.card_summary_en: Cortes and Vapnik's support vector machine found classification boundaries with maximum margin, dominating high-dimensional small-sample machine learning before deep learning.
timeline.why_it_matters_en: SVM was the mainstay of machine learning from the late 1990s into the 2000s, pushing statistical learning theory to its engineering peak. LLM-era systems no longer train on SVM, but maximum-margin thinking and kernel tricks still run wide in classification, clustering, and anomaly detection. Understanding SVM explains why Hinton's insistence on deep learning faced a decade of mainstream skepticism before acceptance.
timeline.behind_scenes_en: Vapnik developed SVM at AT&T Bell Labs, the same lab as LeCun, where the two carried on a long-running academic rivalry. Vapnik's statistical learning theory, published in Russian in 1979 and in English as The Nature of Statistical Learning Theory in 1995, proved generalization error bounds for finite samples, arming the small-data-strong-theory school of the late 1990s. The SVM-versus-neural-networks fights recurred at NIPS throughout the 2000s until AlexNet won ImageNet in 2012; SVM then retreated to second-line roles as a baseline model and teaching tool.

timeline.title_zh: Freund-Schapire Boosting:让弱学习器变强
timeline.title_en: Freund-Schapire Boosting Algorithm
timeline.summary_zh:
1996 年 Yoav Freund 和 Robert Schapire 在 COLT 上发表《Game Theory, On-line Prediction and Boosting》,期刊版 1999 年见诸 Games and Economic Behavior 29(1):79-103。
Boosting 算法的核心思想:训练多个“略好于随机”的弱学习器,按错误率加权组合成强学习器。
1997 年 Freund-Schapire 推出 AdaBoost(Adaptive Boosting),论文发表于 Journal of Computer and System Sciences 55(1):119-139。
Viola-Jones 2001 把 AdaBoost 用在人脸检测上,成为 2000-2010 年人脸检测的工业标准。
timeline.source_name: Freund, Y. & Schapire, R. (1996) COLT; (1997) JCSS 55(1):119-139; (1999) Games and Economic Behavior 29(1):79-103
timeline.card_summary_zh: Freund-Schapire Boosting：让弱学习器变强；Boosting 是表格数据机器学习的工程主力。
timeline.summary_en: Following Yoav Freund and Robert Schapire's 1996 COLT paper "Game Theory, On-line Prediction and Boosting" (journal version in *Games and Economic Behavior* 29(1):79-103, 1999), which defined "boosting" as combining multiple "slightly better than random" weak learners into a strong learner weighted by error rate, the duo debuted AdaBoost (Adaptive Boosting) in 1997 in the *Journal of Computer and System Sciences* 55(1):119-139. In 2001, Viola-Jones applied AdaBoost to face detection, cementing it as the industry standard for face detection from 2000 to 2010.
timeline.card_summary_en: Freund and Schapire's AdaBoost turned weak learners into strong ones, laying the theoretical base for the tree ensembles that still rule tabular data today.
timeline.why_it_matters_en: Boosting is the workhorse of tabular machine learning. The LLM world may not use AdaBoost directly, but XGBoost and LightGBM still dominate financial risk control, ad click-through, and recommendation systems. Understanding Boosting shows why deep learning took images and NLP after 2012 while tree models kept their grip on tabular problems.
timeline.behind_scenes_en: The origin is Schapire's 1989 MIT doctoral proof that within PAC learning any weak learner can be converted into a strong one. Freund collaborated with Schapire through the early 1990s, the first Boosting algorithm appeared in 1995, and the 1996 paper delivered the practical version. AdaBoost won the Godel Prize, one of theoretical computer science's highest honors, in 2003. Together with SVM and decision trees, Boosting formed the three mainstreams of late-1990s ML, later evolving into Friedman's gradient boosting in 1999, XGBoost in 2014, and LightGBM in 2017.

timeline.title_zh: IBM 深蓝击败卡斯帕罗夫:AI 的第一次大众胜利
timeline.title_en: IBM Deep Blue Defeats Kasparov
timeline.summary_zh:
1997 年 5 月 11 日,IBM 深蓝(Deep Blue)在纽约衡平中心(Equitable Center)6 局对抗赛中,以 3.5:2.5(2 胜 1 负 3 和)击败国际象棋世界冠军 Garry Kasparov。
深蓝由 Feng-hsiung Hsu、Joe Hoane、Murray Campbell 团队设计,运行在 IBM RS/6000 SP 超级计算机上(30 个节点,480 个专用 VLSI 象棋芯片),每秒搜索 2 亿个局面。
深蓝是“暴力搜索 + 人工评估函数”的极致,不学习,不适应,只靠算力碾压。
timeline.source_name: Hsu, F.-h. (2002). Behind Deep Blue; Campbell, M. et al. (2002) AI Journal 134(1-2):57-83
timeline.card_summary_zh: 深蓝在正式比赛中击败世界棋王，AI 第一次以全球公众都能理解的方式展示机器计算的压倒性力量。
timeline.summary_en: On May 11, 1997, IBM's Deep Blue defeated world chess champion Garry Kasparov 3.5 to 2.5 (with 2 wins, 1 loss, and 3 draws) in a six-game match at the Equitable Center in New York. Designed by the team of Feng-hsiung Hsu, Joe Hoane, and Murray Campbell, the system ran on an IBM RS/6000 SP supercomputer (configured with 30 nodes and 480 custom VLSI chess chips) that searched 200 million positions per second. As the ultimate realization of brute-force search and hand-crafted evaluation functions, Deep Blue did not learn or adapt, relying entirely on raw computing power to crush its opponent.
timeline.card_summary_en: Deep Blue beat Garry Kasparov in an official match, giving AI its first victory over a human champion that the whole world could understand at a glance.
timeline.why_it_matters_en: Deep Blue was the first AI event where a machine beat a human champion in full public view. It brought the field a mini-spring from 1997 to 2001 and made ordinary people believe computers could exceed humans on intellectual tasks for the first time. But brute-force search and deep learning are entirely different routes, which is why AlphaGo's 2016 breakthrough was fundamentally a different kind of win rather than Deep Blue's extension.
timeline.behind_scenes_en: The project began in 1985 when Feng-hsiung Hsu started ChipTest as a CMU PhD student, evolving through Deep Thought before IBM acquired his team in 1989. In February 1996 Deep Blue 1.0 lost its first match to Kasparov four games to two. In May 1997 the upgraded machine won when Kasparov resigned at move 36 of game six. Kasparov later complained the machine played like divine intervention and suspected cheating; IBM refused to release search details and dismantled the machine afterward. In his 2017 book Deep Thinking, Kasparov withdrew some accusations and admitted his own form was poor, though he still questioned IBM's conduct.

timeline.title_zh: IBM ViaVoice:连续语音识别进入消费市场
timeline.title_en: IBM ViaVoice Brings Continuous Speech Recognition to Consumers
timeline.summary_zh:
1997 年 10 月,IBM 发布 ViaVoice Gold,是最早一批面向消费市场的大词汇量连续语音识别(SLVCSR)产品之一(与同年 6–7 月上市的 Dragon NaturallySpeaking 并列,ViaVoice Gold 略晚于 Dragon)。
用户用普通语速说话,无需“字-字-停顿”,ViaVoice 在 Pentium 200MHz PC 上做到每分钟识别 100-140 词,错误率 5-10%(需 5 分钟声纹注册)。
ViaVoice 基于 IBM 30 年 HMM 语音识别积累,从 1971 年 DARPA Speech Understanding Research 项目继承下来。
1999 年 ViaVoice 在中国推出中文版本,是国内第一代语音输入法、银行电话客服的基础。
timeline.source_name: IBM ViaVoice Gold (1997); Jelinek, F. (1997) Statistical Methods for Speech Recognition
timeline.card_summary_zh: ViaVoice 让普通用户可以连续说话完成文字输入，语音识别第一次从实验室走进消费软件。
timeline.summary_en: In October 1997, IBM released ViaVoice Gold, arriving slightly after Dragon NaturallySpeaking's June–July debut to become one of the first consumer-market large vocabulary continuous speech recognition (SLVCSR) products. Powered by IBM’s 30 years of HMM speech recognition research tracing back to the 1971 DARPA Speech Understanding Research project, it enabled users to speak at normal speeds without pausing between words, delivering 100-140 words per minute with a 5-10% error rate on a Pentium 200MHz PC after a 5-minute voice enrollment. In 1999, IBM launched a Chinese version in China, which became the foundation for the country's first-generation voice input methods and bank telephone customer service systems.
timeline.card_summary_en: IBM ViaVoice let ordinary users dictate continuously to their PCs, moving speech recognition out of the lab and into consumer software for the first time.
timeline.why_it_matters_en: ViaVoice was AI's first large-scale entry into the consumer market, letting people operate computers by voice at home and paving the user-education path later walked by Siri, Alexa, and Xiao Ai. It also marked the engineering peak of HMM methods; today's end-to-end versus modular debate was already rehearsed in the transition from ViaVoice's modular HMM in 1997 to LSTM end-to-end systems in 2014.
timeline.behind_scenes_en: IBM had invested thirty years in speech recognition. It was a prime contractor on DARPA's SUR project in 1971, shipped the Tangora voice typewriter at T.J. Watson in 1984, and released VoiceType discrete-word recognition in 1992 before ViaVoice delivered continuous speech in 1997. The GMM-HMM paradigm of that era was the standard from 1980 to 2010, until Hinton's DNN-HMM displaced it around 2009-2011 and LSTM end-to-end models displaced it again in 2014. Whisper and wav2vec all stand on three decades of accumulated speech engineering.

timeline.title_zh: Hochreiter-Schmidhuber LSTM:序列建模的支柱
timeline.title_en: Hochreiter-Schmidhuber LSTM
timeline.summary_zh:
1997 年 11 月 15 日,Sepp Hochreiter 和 Jürgen Schmidhuber 在Neural Computation 9(8):1735-1780 发表《Long Short-Term Memory》。
LSTM 引入“细胞状态 + 输入门 + 输出门 + 恒定误差传送带(CEC)”的结构,解决 RNN 在反向传播中梯度消失问题,让网络能学习跨数百个时间步的长期依赖(1997 年原版只有输入门和输出门;遗忘门由 Gers、Schmidhuber、Cummins 在 2000 年《Learning to Forget》中补充,才形成今天的三门结构)。
LSTM 在 2009-2017 年是序列建模的主力,Google 翻译、Apple Siri、Amazon Alexa 第一代都跑在 LSTM 上,直到 2017 年 Transformer 出现才被替代。
timeline.source_name: Hochreiter, S. & Schmidhuber, J. (1997). Neural Computation 9(8):1735-1780
timeline.card_summary_zh: Hochreiter-Schmidhuber LSTM：序列建模的支柱；LSTM 是 Transformer 之前序列建模的支柱。
timeline.summary_en: On November 15, 1997, Sepp Hochreiter and Jürgen Schmidhuber published "Long Short-Term Memory" in *Neural Computation* 9(8):1735-1780, introducing a "cell state + input gate + output gate + Constant Error Carousel (CEC)" structure that solved the vanishing gradient problem in RNN backpropagation and allowed networks to learn long-term dependencies across hundreds of time steps (the 1997 original had only input and output gates, with the forget gate added by Gers, Schmidhuber, and Cummins in the 2000 paper "Learning to Forget" to form today's three-gate architecture). From 2009 to 2017, LSTM served as the workhorse of sequence modeling, powering the first generation of Google Translate, Apple Siri, and Amazon Alexa until the Transformer arrived in 2017 to replace it.
timeline.card_summary_en: Hochreiter and Schmidhuber published LSTM, whose gated memory made recurrent networks actually trainable and became the backbone of sequence modeling before Transformers.
timeline.why_it_matters_en: LSTM was the pillar of sequence modeling before the Transformer era. Long-term memory, attention-style gating, and context handling were all LSTM problems to solve until 2017. Understanding its gated-memory design clarifies why Transformer attention let LLMs cross the language understanding gap.
timeline.behind_scenes_en: The origin is Hochreiter's 1991 master's thesis, the first systematic description of vanishing gradients in RNNs and their role as the fundamental obstacle to training deep networks. He brought the thesis to Schmidhuber, and the two spent six years completing LSTM, finally publishing in Neural Computation in 1997. Early reception was muted; only after Sutskever and Hinton's teams proved in 2009 that LSTM crushed traditional HMMs on speech recognition and machine translation did industry adopt it widely. In 2024 Hochreiter was repeatedly mentioned alongside Hinton as a Nobel candidate, with LSTM's influence being reevaluated in the Transformer era.

timeline.title_zh: COMPAS 算法上线:算法治理最早典型案例
timeline.title_en: COMPAS Deployed: Earliest Landmark of Algorithmic Governance
timeline.summary_zh:
1998 年 4 月,Northpointe(后改 Equivant)推出COMPAS(Correctional Offender Management Profiling for Alternative Sanctions),用于美国法院量刑建议和假释风险评估。
COMPAS 用 137 个调查问题,把被告分为低/中/高三档再犯风险,法官在量刑时参考 COMPAS 分数。
2013 年 Eric Loomis 案首次把 COMPAS 推上法庭,2016 年 ProPublica 调查报告指出 COMPAS 对黑人被告的误判率是白人的 2 倍,引爆“算法歧视”全球讨论。
timeline.source_name: ProPublica (2016) Machine Bias; Loomis v. Wisconsin (2017) SCOTUS; Equivant COMPAS
timeline.card_summary_zh: COMPAS 算法上线：算法治理最早典型案例；COMPAS 是 AI 伦理与算法治理的最早现场。
timeline.summary_en: In April 1998, Northpointe (later Equivant) launched COMPAS (Correctional Offender Management Profiling for Alternative Sanctions) for sentencing recommendations and parole risk assessments in US courts. Using 137 survey questions, the system categorized defendants into low, medium, or high recidivism risks for judges to reference during sentencing. The Eric Loomis case first brought COMPAS to court in 2013, and a 2016 ProPublica investigative report revealing that its error rate for Black defendants was twice that of white defendants ignited a global debate on "algorithmic bias."
timeline.card_summary_en: The COMPAS risk-score algorithm entered courtrooms and became the earliest landmark case in AI ethics, exposing bias, opacity, and accountability questions that still shape policy today.
timeline.why_it_matters_en: COMPAS was the first live arena for algorithmic discrimination, black-box models, trade secrets versus judicial transparency, and statistical versus individual fairness, pushing these questions onto the legal stage. Today's debates about model bias, RLHF values, and algorithmic accountability all have early versions in this case. When the EU AI Act listed judicial sentencing as high-risk AI in 2024, the lesson traces straight back to COMPAS.
timeline.behind_scenes_en: Northpointe kept COMPAS's internals as trade secrets and refused to publish feature weights. Eric Loomis appealed to the Wisconsin Supreme Court, which upheld the sentence calling COMPAS a commonly used tool; the US Supreme Court declined to hear it. In 2016 ProPublica retro-scored more than 7,000 historical cases: Black defendants were falsely labeled high-risk at 44.9% versus 23.5% for white defendants, while white defendants were falsely labeled low-risk at 47.7% versus 28.0%. Northpointe countered that ProPublica's statistics were wrong, and academia argued the point into 2020 without consensus.

timeline.title_zh: Brin-Page Google:搜索 + 机器学习早期范式
timeline.title_en: Brin-Page Google: Early Search + Machine Learning
timeline.summary_zh:
1998 年 9 月 4 日,Larry Page 和 Sergey Brin 在加州 Menlo Park 车库注册 Google Inc。
Google 核心算法 PageRank 来自两人 1998 年 WWW7 会议论文《The Anatomy of a Large-Scale Hypertextual Web Search Engine》。
PageRank 把网页重要性建模为马尔可夫链的稳态分布,通过迭代计算得到每个页面的“权威度”。
1999-2004 年 Google 把 PageRank + 文本匹配 + 用户行为日志结合,构建了第一个工业级大规模搜索排序系统,直接定义了“机器学习 + 大规模数据 + 在线服务”的工程范式。
timeline.source_name: Brin, S. & Page, L. (1998). WWW7; Google IPO S-1 (2004)
timeline.card_summary_zh: PageRank 用链接关系计算网页权威度，Google 由此建立了数据驱动算法改变互联网入口的早期范式。
timeline.summary_en: On September 4, 1998, Larry Page and Sergey Brin incorporated Google Inc. in a Menlo Park, California garage, utilizing their core PageRank algorithm from their 1998 WWW7 paper, "The Anatomy of a Large-Scale Hypertextual Web Search Engine." PageRank modeled webpage importance as the stationary distribution of a Markov chain, iteratively calculating each page's "authority." From 1999 to 2004, Google combined PageRank with text matching and user behavior logs to build the first industrial-scale search ranking system, establishing the engineering paradigm of "machine learning + large-scale data + online services."
timeline.card_summary_en: PageRank ranked pages by who linked to them, and Google built the early industrial paradigm of data-driven algorithms reshaping how people find information online.
timeline.why_it_matters_en: Google was the earliest industrial paradigm of data-driven machine learning. The formula discussed around LLMs today, massive data plus simple architecture plus online optimization, had already been rehearsed inside Google's search and ad systems from 1998 to 2004. Google also became the academy of machine learning talent for 2000-2015; deep ties with Hinton, Sutskever, Dean, Ng, and LeCun directly produced Google Brain in 2012, the DeepMind acquisition in 2014, and Transformer in 2017.
timeline.behind_scenes_en: PageRank began as Brin and Page's Stanford doctoral project under the name BackRub, running on Stanford servers from 1996 to 1998 and consuming half the university's bandwidth. In 1998 they tried selling the algorithm for one million dollars to AltaVista, Excite, and other search engines, and were rejected across the board; Excite's CEO balked even at $750,000. They founded their own company that September, raised $25 million from KPCB and Sequoia in 1999, and IPOed in August 2004 at a $23 billion valuation. The paradigm of large-scale data plus simple models plus online learning was inherited wholesale by Netflix, LinkedIn, and Facebook, becoming modern internet ML's foundational engineering pattern.

timeline.title_zh: LeNet-5 论文:卷积网络的工程化文档
timeline.title_en: LeNet-5 Paper: Engineering Documentation of CNNs
timeline.summary_zh:
1998 年 11 月,Yann LeCun、Léon Bottou、Yoshua Bengio、Patrick Haffner 在Proceedings of the IEEE 86(11):2278-2324 发表《Gradient-Based Learning Applied to Document Recognition》。
论文系统化描述 LeNet-5 结构(7 层:Conv-Pool-Conv-Pool-FC-FC-Output),用反向传播端到端训练,直接吃原始像素,用于 MNIST 手写数字识别(错误率 0.95%)和银行支票金额识别。
LeNet-5 论文是 CNN 的工程化教科书,定义了 Conv→Pool→FC 的标准范式,2012 年 AlexNet 本质上是 LeNet-5 放大版 + GPU 训练 + ReLU 激活。
timeline.source_name: LeCun, Y. et al. (1998). Proc. IEEE 86(11):2278-2324; MNIST dataset
timeline.card_summary_zh: LeNet-5 固化了卷积、池化与全连接的组合方式，后来视觉神经网络的工程骨架由此成形。
timeline.summary_en: In November 1998, Yann LeCun, Léon Bottou, Yoshua Bengio, and Patrick Haffner published "Gradient-Based Learning Applied to Document Recognition" in *Proceedings of the IEEE* 86(11):2278-2324, systematically describing the 7-layer LeNet-5 architecture (Conv-Pool-Conv-Pool-FC-FC-Output) trained end-to-end via backpropagation to process raw pixels directly for MNIST handwritten digit recognition (0.95% error rate) and bank check amount recognition. As the engineering textbook for CNNs, the paper defined the standard Conv→Pool→FC paradigm; 2012's AlexNet was essentially a scaled-up LeNet-5 utilizing GPU training and ReLU activation.
timeline.card_summary_en: LeCun's LeNet-5 paper fixed the recipe of convolution, pooling, and fully connected layers, forming the engineering skeleton every later vision network would follow.
timeline.why_it_matters_en: LeNet-5 is the master template of deep learning engineering. Every CNN today stands on its paradigm of local receptive fields, shared weights, pooling, and fully connected heads. Reading LeNet-5 makes clear that AlexNet's 2012 breakthrough was not a sudden arrival but the eruption of fourteen years of engineering plus GPU compute plus ImageNet-scale data arriving together.
timeline.behind_scenes_en: The paper landed at the deepest point of the second AI winter. LeCun had already deployed LeNet in NCR check-reading systems at AT&T, with roughly 90% of US checks reading amounts through it, yet mainstream AI treated neural networks as an echo of a failed 1980s route. In the paper he wrote that he believed neural networks had matured into standard tools for pattern recognition, a judgment ignored in 1998 and proven right only in 2012. The paper also recorded hard-won details such as performance dropping without input normalization, lessons AlexNet rediscovered in 2012.

timeline.title_zh: NIST MNIST 数据集:机器学习标准基准
timeline.title_en: NIST MNIST Dataset: Standard ML Benchmark
timeline.summary_zh:
1999 年 9 月,Yann LeCun、Corinna Cortes、Christopher J.C. Burges 发布 MNIST 数据集,源自 NIST SD-3 和 SD-1 手写数字数据,经过混洗、归一化、居中处理,得到 60000 张训练图 + 10000 张测试图,28x28 灰度。
MNIST 把 LeCun 1998 LeNet-5 论文的实验数据集正式独立发布,成为 1999-2015 年机器学习算法的标准入门基准。
MNIST 错误率从 1998 年 LeNet 的 0.95% 一路降到 2012 年 CNN+dropout 的 0.23%,再到 2018 年 Rodriquez-Bengio 团队 0.18%,今天主流模型基本达到 0.20% 以下,MNIST 已基本被“解决”。
timeline.source_name: LeCun, Y. et al. (1998) Proc IEEE 86(11); MNIST database, LeCun.com
timeline.card_summary_zh: NIST MNIST 数据集：机器学习标准基准；MNIST 是机器学习基准范式的起点。
timeline.summary_en: In September 1999, Yann LeCun, Corinna Cortes, and Christopher J.C. Burges released the MNIST dataset, which shuffled, normalized, and centered handwritten digit data from NIST SD-3 and SD-1 to produce 60,000 training and 10,000 testing 28x28 grayscale images. This formal, independent release of the experimental dataset from LeCun's 1998 LeNet-5 paper went on to serve as the standard introductory benchmark for machine learning algorithms from 1999 to 2015. Over the years, the MNIST error rate plummeted from LeNet's 0.95% in 1998 to 0.23% using CNN+dropout in 2012, and reached 0.18% by the Rodriquez-Bengio team in 2018; today, with mainstream models consistently scoring below 0.20%, the dataset is considered essentially "solved."
timeline.card_summary_en: NIST's MNIST dataset of handwritten digits defined the train-test-error protocol that became machine learning's standard benchmark template.
timeline.why_it_matters_en: MNIST was the starting point of the machine learning benchmark paradigm. Today's debates about benchmark contamination, overfitting to benchmarks, and benchmark saturation were all rehearsed on MNIST first. Its twenty-five years of evolution explain why LLM evaluation keeps producing new benchmarks: once a benchmark saturates, it loses discriminating power.
timeline.behind_scenes_en: It defined the three-part protocol of training set, test set, and error rate, later inherited intact by CIFAR-10 in 2009, ImageNet in 2009, GLUE in 2018, MMLU in 2020, and SWE-Bench in 2023. MNIST was also the earliest industrial-grade practice of the public data plus protocol paradigm, reaching general ML algorithms even before FERET did for vision. Criticized today as too easy, it still serves widely as an entry benchmark and algorithm sanity check, cited dozens of times a month as recently as 2024.

timeline.title_zh: NVIDIA GeForce 256:GPU 时代开启
timeline.title_en: NVIDIA GeForce 256: GPU Era Begins
timeline.summary_zh:
1999 年 10 月 11 日,NVIDIA 发布 GeForce 256,售价 199 美元。
NVIDIA 把它宣传为“世界第一款 GPU(Graphics Processing Unit)”,首次把 Transform、Lighting、Setup、Rendering 四阶段整合到单芯片,支持硬件 T&L,集成 2300 万晶体管,核心 120MHz,显存 64MB DDR。
GeForce 256 同时是消费级显卡和并行计算硬件的开端,为 2006 年 CUDA、2012 年 AlexNet GPU 训练、2017 年 Transformer 大模型奠定算力基础。
timeline.source_name: NVIDIA GeForce 256 press release (1999-10-11); Buck, I. (2004) Stanford PhD
timeline.card_summary_zh: GeForce 256 把大规模并行图形计算带入消费市场，也为十多年后的深度学习算力革命埋下伏笔。
timeline.summary_en: On October 11, 1999, NVIDIA released the GeForce 256 for $199, marketing it as the "world's first GPU (Graphics Processing Unit)" for integrating the four stages of Transform, Lighting, Setup, and Rendering onto a single chip for the first time. Packing 23 million transistors, a 120MHz core, 64MB DDR memory, and hardware T&L support, it marked the beginning of both consumer graphics cards and parallel computing hardware. This breakthrough laid the computational foundation for CUDA in 2006, AlexNet GPU training in 2012, and Transformer large models in 2017.
timeline.card_summary_en: NVIDIA's GeForce 256 brought massively parallel graphics computing to consumers, quietly planting the seed of the GPU revolution deep learning would run on a decade later.
timeline.why_it_matters_en: Without GPUs there is no deep learning era. Nearly all LLM training compute today runs on NVIDIA GPUs, and GeForce 256 is the origin of that hardware line. Tracing the 1999-2009 transformation from graphics hardware to general parallel computing explains why AlexNet ignited deep learning in 2012 instead of stopping at LeNet's 1998 level.
timeline.behind_scenes_en: Only the graphics community and a few AI researchers saw the parallel-computing potential early. Ian Buck ran matrix multiplication on GPUs at Stanford in 2004; NVIDIA released CUDA in 2007, turning the GPU from graphics-specific silicon into general parallel compute. In 2009 Rajat Raina and Andrew Ng trained deep belief networks on GPUs at Stanford, cutting training from weeks to days, the direct reason Hinton's team chose GPUs for AlexNet in 2012. Today's H100 and B100 dominate LLM training, with GeForce 256 as the earliest point on this line.

timeline.title_zh: Nuance Dragon + Google 搜索:语音与机器学习进入消费市场
timeline.title_en: Nuance Dragon + Google Search: Speech and ML Enter Consumer Market
timeline.summary_zh:
2001 年前后,语音识别和搜索排序两条机器学习路线同时进入消费市场。
Nuance Dragon NaturallySpeaking 5.0 在 Pentium 4 PC 上做到连续语音听写,错误率 5-8%(英语),售价 199 美元。
Google 2001 年引入 PageRank + 链接分析的机器学习排序,配合 AdWords(2000-10)开始构建数据驱动广告系统,为后续 2011 年 Google Brain 团队铺路。
2001 年也是 MIT OpenCourseWare 启动的年份,AI 教育资源开始大规模开放,推动后续十年 AI 人才扩张。
timeline.source_name: Nuance Dragon NaturallySpeaking 5.0 (2001); Google AdWords (2000-10); MIT OCW (2001-04)
timeline.card_summary_zh: Nuance Dragon + Google 搜索：语音与机器学习进入消费市场；2001 年是 AI 从“研究室”转向“产品”的早期节点。
timeline.summary_en: Around 2001, machine learning entered the consumer market via two parallel tracks: speech recognition—with Nuance Dragon NaturallySpeaking 5.0 delivering continuous English dictation on Pentium 4 PCs with a 5-8% error rate for $199—and search ranking. That same year, Google introduced machine learning ranking combining PageRank and link analysis, pairing it with AdWords (2000-10) to build a data-driven advertising system that paved the way for the Google Brain team in 2011. 2001 also marked the launch of MIT OpenCourseWare, initiating the large-scale opening of AI educational resources that fueled the expansion of AI talent over the following decade.
timeline.card_summary_en: Dragon NaturallySpeaking and Google Search put speech recognition and web-scale machine learning into daily products, marking AI's early turn from research labs to consumer goods.
timeline.why_it_matters_en: 2001 was an early inflection point where AI moved from research rooms into products. The concepts debated around LLMs now, narrow AI versus general AI, data flywheels, model iteration, all had early versions in Dragon and Google. Understanding this moment explains why deep learning moved so fast from paper to product after AlexNet: consumers had already accepted the logic of AI products.
timeline.behind_scenes_en: AI was near the tail end of its second winter in 2001, yet the consumer market had already learned to accept narrow-AI products. Dragon ran GMM-HMM on PCs built on thirty years of speech engineering; Google ran PageRank on Linux clusters built on the algorithm plus massive compute. Together they proved AI did not need general intelligence to make money, that narrow scenarios plus big data plus machine learning could be a real business. That realization directly fueled the machine-learning boom of the Web 2.0 era from 2003 to 2010.

timeline.title_zh: iRobot Roomba 上市:家用机器人零时刻
timeline.title_en: iRobot Roomba Released: Home Robots Era Begins
timeline.summary_zh:
2002 年 9 月 17 日,iRobot 公司推出 Roomba 自动扫地机器人,售价 199 美元。
Roomba 第一代 8 小时充电、1 小时清扫、覆盖 3-4 个房间,用简单的随机游走 + 局部 SLAM 算法 + 红外避障,不需要地图,不需要云端,完全本地决策。
首年销量 50 万台,2004 年突破 100 万台,成为第一款真正大规模进入家庭的机器人。
timeline.source_name: iRobot Roomba launch (2002-09-17); Brooks, R. (1986) IEEE J. Robotics Automation RA-2(1)
timeline.card_summary_zh: Roomba 把自主导航机器人卖进普通家庭，具身智能第一次以百万级消费产品证明商业可行性。
timeline.summary_en: On September 17, 2002, iRobot launched the $199 Roomba automatic vacuum cleaning robot, which could cover 3-4 rooms with 1 hour of cleaning on an 8-hour charge. The first-generation device operated entirely on local decision-making without needing maps or the cloud, relying on a simple random walk, a local SLAM algorithm, and infrared obstacle avoidance. Selling 500,000 units in its first year and surpassing 1 million in 2004, it became the first robot to truly enter homes on a massive scale.
timeline.card_summary_en: iRobot shipped the Roomba vacuum robot, selling autonomous navigation to ordinary households and proving embodied AI could work as a mass-market product.
timeline.why_it_matters_en: Roomba was the first commercial success of embodied intelligence. It showed robots could enter homes without general intelligence, that narrow scenarios plus engineering polish plus behavior composition could be profitable. The engineering playbook of every household robot since, from floor cleaners to mowers to feeders, builds on Roomba. It also stands as behavior-based AI's last great engineering victory, leaving a reference point for the end-to-end embodied systems of the deep learning era.
timeline.behind_scenes_en: iRobot was founded by MIT AI Lab alumni Rodney Brooks, Colin Angle, and Helen Greiner, previously focused on military robots like PackBot. Brooks's 1986 paper on the Subsumption Architecture opposed symbolic AI's sense-plan-act pipeline and argued for directly coupling perception to action. Roomba was that philosophy's engineering peak: no elaborate planning, no world model, just composed behaviors completing the cleaning task.

timeline.title_zh: LinkedIn + Hinton RBM:社交数据与神经网络同时积累
timeline.title_en: LinkedIn + Hinton RBM: Social Data and Neural Networks Accumulate
timeline.summary_zh:
2003 年 5 月 5 日,Reid Hoffman 在 Mountain View 创办 LinkedIn,为 Web 2.0 时代的社交数据大爆发拉开序幕。
同年 Hinton 在多伦多发表论文《Modeling high-dimensional data with neural networks》,继续在第二次 AI 寒冬最深处坚持 Restricted Boltzmann Machine(RBM)研究。
Hinton 团队 2002-2006 年开发 Contrastive Divergence(CD)训练算法,为 2006 年 Deep Belief Network 突破做最后准备。
timeline.source_name: LinkedIn founding (2003-05-05); Hinton (2003) Modeling high-dimensional data
timeline.card_summary_zh: LinkedIn + Hinton RBM：社交数据与神经网络同时积累；2003 年是 AI 寒冬里最低调但最关键的一年。
timeline.summary_en: On May 5, 2003, Reid Hoffman founded LinkedIn in Mountain View, ushering in the Web 2.0 social data explosion. That same year in Toronto, Hinton published the paper "Modeling high-dimensional data with neural networks," persisting with Restricted Boltzmann Machine (RBM) research in the depths of the second AI winter. From 2002 to 2006, Hinton's team developed the Contrastive Divergence (CD) training algorithm, making final preparations for the 2006 Deep Belief Network breakthrough.
timeline.card_summary_en: LinkedIn launched while Hinton pushed restricted Boltzmann machines in Toronto, two quiet seeds of data and algorithms planted during AI winter's most overlooked year.
timeline.why_it_matters_en: 2003 was the quietest yet most consequential year of the AI winter. The data Web 2.0 would generate and the deep network algorithms LLMs need were both seeded this year. Seeing the accumulation inside the trough clarifies why AlexNet's apparent suddenness in 2012 was really ten years of data, algorithms, and compute maturing together.
timeline.behind_scenes_en: Statistical learning ruled 2003, SVMs and Boosting above all, while neural networks were written off as a failed 1980s route. Hinton in Toronto scraped by on small NSERC grants and student-built RBM implementations; from 1998 to 2006 his team was nearly the only group still committed to deep neural networks. Meanwhile Web 2.0 had users generating content through blogs, wikis, and social networks, laying the corpus base for future LLMs. The lines converged in 2006 when Hinton published his DBN paper in Science and Facebook opened registration the same year.

timeline.title_zh: Caltech 101 数据集:ImageNet 的前身
timeline.title_en: Caltech 101 Dataset: Precursor to ImageNet
timeline.summary_zh: 李飞飞在加州理工学院创建 Caltech 101 数据集，包含 101 个类别、超 9000 张图像，首次证明数据规模大于算法复杂度。
timeline.card_summary_zh: 李飞飞在加州理工学院创建 Caltech 101 数据集，包含 101 个类别、超 9000 张图像；Caltech 101 是 ImageNet 的前身。
timeline.summary_en: At Caltech, Fei-Fei Li created the Caltech 101 dataset, featuring 101 categories and over 9,000 images, proving for the first time that data scale outweighs algorithmic complexity.
timeline.card_summary_en: Fei-Fei Li built the Caltech 101 dataset at Caltech, 101 categories and over 9,000 images, an early prototype of the data-first thinking behind ImageNet.
timeline.why_it_matters_en: Caltech 101 was ImageNet's direct predecessor. It tested a proposition that would later reshape AI: what matters more than better algorithms may simply be more diverse data.
timeline.behind_scenes_en: The dataset's name was a private joke. Her advisor kept raising the count, first ten categories, then fifty, so she picked 101 to tease California's highway numbering. Within six months of release it became a standard industry benchmark.

timeline.title_zh: Spirit/Opportunity 火星车:AI 自主任务系统
timeline.title_en: Spirit/Opportunity Mars Rovers: AI Autonomous Systems
timeline.summary_zh:
2004 年 1 月 4 日,Spirit 火星车在 Gusev 陨石坑着陆,1 月 25 日 Opportunity 在 Meridiani Planum 着陆。
两台火星车设计寿命 90 个火星日,实际运行 6 年(Spirit)和 14 年(Opportunity)。
火星车搭载 NASA JPL 开发的 AI 自主任务系统,包括视觉里程计(Visual Odometry)、自动目标识别(AutoNav)、地形评估和路径规划,能在地球-火星 4-24 分钟通信延迟下自主完成路径选择和科学目标识别。
timeline.source_name: NASA JPL Mars Exploration Rovers Mission; Maimone, M. et al. (2007) J. Field Robotics 24(3)
timeline.card_summary_zh: 火星车必须在通信延迟下自主感知、规划和避障，AI 由此在最遥远、最严苛的环境中接受工程考验。
timeline.summary_en: On January 4, 2004, the Spirit rover landed in Gusev Crater, followed by Opportunity in Meridiani Planum on January 25. While designed for a lifespan of just 90 Martian days, the rovers ultimately operated for 6 years (Spirit) and 14 years (Opportunity). Both were powered by an AI autonomous mission system developed by NASA JPL—incorporating Visual Odometry, automatic target recognition (AutoNav), terrain assessment, and path planning—which allowed them to autonomously select paths and identify scientific targets despite a 4-to-24-minute Earth-Mars communication delay.
timeline.card_summary_en: The Spirit and Opportunity rovers had to sense, plan, and avoid hazards on their own across minutes-long communication delays, stress-testing AI in the harshest environment available.
timeline.why_it_matters_en: Mars rover AI was the engineering summit of the perceive-plan-act paradigm under extreme conditions. It proved AI needs no general intelligence to solve communication lag, unknown terrain, and long-duration missions when paired with strong engineering. The AI system designs of SpaceX Starship, interplanetary missions, and deep space probes all build on twenty years of rover engineering.
timeline.behind_scenes_en: The core challenge was delay plus unknown terrain. One-way Earth-Mars communication takes four to twenty-four minutes, so the rover cannot wait for instructions and must judge each step's safety itself. JPL generated 3D terrain maps from stereo cameras, planned the next meter of path within thirty seconds using automated planners, and accumulated position estimates through visual odometry. That system is why the rovers lasted fourteen years and became the AI foundation for Curiosity and Perseverance. Perseverance added AutoNav and terrain-relative navigation in 2020, reaching genuinely autonomous decision-making on Mars.

timeline.title_zh: Facebook 上线:社交数据基础设施启动
timeline.title_en: Facebook Launched: Social Data Infrastructure Begins
timeline.summary_zh:
2004 年 2 月 4 日,Mark Zuckerberg 在哈佛大学宿舍上线 TheFacebook.com,最初限制哈佛学生注册。
2005-2006 年扩展到 Ivy League、所有大学、所有 13 岁以上人群,2006 年 9 月 News Feed 上线,社交数据流动从“主动浏览”转为“被动推送”。
2012 年 5 月 Facebook IPO,估值 1040 亿美元,成为 Web 2.0 时代最大社交数据基础设施。
timeline.source_name: Facebook founding (2004-02-04); Zuckerberg Harvard years
timeline.card_summary_zh: Facebook 将现实关系搬到线上，并逐渐形成史无前例的社交行为数据基础设施。
timeline.summary_en: On February 4, 2004, Mark Zuckerberg launched TheFacebook.com from his Harvard dorm room, initially restricting registration to Harvard students. Between 2005 and 2006, the platform expanded to the Ivy League, all universities, and everyone over 13, shifting the flow of social data from "active browsing" to "passive push" with the launch of the News Feed in September 2006. Following its May 2012 IPO at a $104 billion valuation, Facebook became the largest social data infrastructure of the Web 2.0 era.
timeline.card_summary_en: Facebook moved real-world relationships online and began assembling an unprecedented infrastructure of social behavior data.
timeline.why_it_matters_en: Facebook was ground zero for social data infrastructure. Without the accumulation from Facebook, Twitter, and Instagram there would be no recommender systems of the 2010s, no corpus at scale for BERT in 2018, and none of today's debates about training on social data, personalized conversation, or filter bubbles. Understanding this role explains why Meta could stand as a third pillar beside Google and Microsoft in the LLM era.
timeline.behind_scenes_en: Facebook mattered to AI through its social graph plus behavioral data. The Graph API opened in 2007 let outside developers build on the social graph, spawning ecosystems like Zynga and Spotify; Open Graph in 2009 extended social data onto third-party web pages. Internally, Facebook founded FAIR in 2013 under Yann LeCun to compete with Google Brain and Microsoft Research for deep learning talent. Meta's LLaMA series is essentially the monetization of social data accumulation since 2004 plus FAIR's algorithmic investment since 2013.

timeline.title_zh: W3C OWL 标准:语义网的工程尝试
timeline.title_en: W3C OWL Standard: Semantic Web Engineering Attempt
timeline.summary_zh:
2004 年 2 月 10 日,W3C 发布 OWL(Web Ontology Language)推荐标准,由 Tim Berners-Lee 推动的语义网(Semantic Web)项目的核心组件。
OWL 用描述逻辑(Description Logic)在 RDF 三元组之上增加类、属性、约束、推理规则,目标让 Web 内容既能被人读,也能被机器理解。
OWL 2 在 2009 年发布,加入更复杂的表达力。
语义网在 2004-2012 年有过一波工业尝试(Google Rich Snippets、Facebook Open Graph),但大规模机器可读 Web 的愿景最终被 LLM 直接理解自然语言取代。
timeline.source_name: W3C OWL Recommendation (2004-02-10); Berners-Lee et al. (2001) Scientific American
timeline.card_summary_zh: OWL 试图让网页知识变得可被机器理解和推理，代表符号 AI 与开放网络结合的重要工程尝试。
timeline.summary_en: On February 10, 2004, the W3C released the OWL (Web Ontology Language) recommendation, the core component of Tim Berners-Lee's Semantic Web project. Designed to make Web content both human-readable and machine-understandable, OWL used Description Logic to add classes, properties, constraints, and reasoning rules on top of RDF triples, later gaining more complex expressivity with OWL 2 in 2009. While this sparked a wave of industry adoption from 2004 to 2012 through initiatives like Google Rich Snippets and Facebook Open Graph, the vision of a large-scale machine-readable Web was ultimately superseded by LLMs directly understanding natural language.
timeline.card_summary_en: The W3C published OWL hoping machines could understand and reason over web knowledge, one last major engineering push to fuse symbolic AI with the open web.
timeline.why_it_matters_en: OWL was the final engineering peak of the symbolic-AI-plus-web route. Its failure proved that asking people to hand-structure data does not scale on the web, clearing the way for machine learning from unstructured text. Today's debates about structured output, knowledge graphs versus LLMs, and RAG versus fine-tuning were all rehearsed in the OWL era.
timeline.behind_scenes_en: The Semantic Web vision came from Berners-Lee's 2001 Scientific American article: annotate web content with structure so machines can reason automatically, and OWL was that vision's technical skeleton, launched in 2004 amid high expectations. Engineering reality intervened: getting content producers to add structured markup cost too much, while search engines extracted information from raw text more cheaply. Google Knowledge Graph pivoted to machine learning plus entity recognition in 2012, marking the industrial end of the Semantic Web dream. LLMs after 2020 confirmed it further: understanding natural language directly scales far better than reading structured annotations.

timeline.title_zh: DARPA Grand Challenge 2004:无人驾驶第一次公开挑战
timeline.title_en: DARPA Grand Challenge 2004: First Public Autonomous Driving Challenge
timeline.summary_zh:
2004 年 3 月 13 日,DARPA 在 Mojave 沙漠举办第一届 Grand Challenge。
赛道 240 公里,奖金 100 万美元,要求无人驾驶车辆 10 小时内完成。
15 支队伍参赛,无人完成,最远的 Carnegie Mellon Sandstorm 跑了 11.78 公里就翻车。
但这次比赛第一次把"无人驾驶"从研究室推到公开竞技场,直接催生 2005 年 Grand Challenge(Stanford Stanley 夺冠,约 6 小时 54 分跑完 132 英里/约 212 公里)和 2007 年 Urban Challenge(CMU Boss 夺冠)。
timeline.source_name: DARPA Grand Challenge 2004 official report; Thrun et al. (2006) Journal of Field Robotics 23(9)
timeline.card_summary_zh: DARPA Grand Challenge 2004：无人驾驶第一次公开挑战；DARPA Grand Challenge 是现代无人驾驶的零时刻。
timeline.summary_en: On March 13, 2004, DARPA hosted the inaugural Grand Challenge in the Mojave Desert, offering a $1 million prize for autonomous vehicles to complete a 240-kilometer course within 10 hours. Though 15 teams competed and none finished—with the furthest contender, Carnegie Mellon's Sandstorm, rolling over after just 11.78 kilometers—the race successfully thrust "autonomous driving" from the lab into the public arena for the first time. This landmark event directly catalyzed the 2005 Grand Challenge (won by Stanford's Stanley, which completed the 132-mile/approx. 212-kilometer course in about 6 hours and 54 minutes) and the 2007 Urban Challenge (won by CMU's Boss).
timeline.card_summary_en: DARPA's first Grand Challenge sent autonomous vehicles across the Mojave for a public race, the ground-zero moment of modern self-driving.
timeline.why_it_matters_en: The Grand Challenge was modern autonomous driving's zero hour. The core engineers at Waymo, Cruise, Tesla FSD, WeRide, Pony.ai, and Mobileye mostly trained through the Grand Challenge series. Seeing the 2004 failure next to the 2005 success explains why self-driving industrialized quickly in the 2010s: the hard engineering problems were cracked inside three races from 2004 to 2007.
timeline.behind_scenes_en: The backdrop was Congress mandating in 2001 that a third of US ground forces be unmanned by 2015. DARPA program manager Ron Kurjanowicz designed the public-challenge-plus-big-prize format, breaking defense contractors' monopoly and inviting universities and startups. The 2004 failure exposed immature sensor fusion and real-time planning; in 2005 Stanford's Stanley team under Sebastian Thrun combined lidar, vision, and path planning to complete the 132-mile course, proving autonomy viable for the first time. Thrun went on to found Google's self-driving project, Chauffeur, in 2009.

timeline.title_zh: Boston Dynamics BigDog:动态四足机器人突破
timeline.title_en: Boston Dynamics BigDog: Dynamic Quadruped Breakthrough
timeline.summary_zh:
2004 年 12 月,Boston Dynamics 在 DARPA 资助下首次演示 BigDog 四足机器人。
BigDog 重 109 公斤,长 1 米,高 0.7 米,由 Marc Raibert 团队设计(Raibert 1986 年 MIT Leg Lab 创办)。
BigDog 用液压驱动 + 16 个关节 + 姿态控制算法,能携带 50 公斤负载在雪地、碎石、冰面、楼梯上行走,被人侧踢后能恢复平衡。
2008 年 BigDog YouTube 视频超过 1500 万次观看,是 AI 机器人史上第一个 viral 视频。
timeline.source_name: Raibert, M. et al. (2008) BigDog; Boston Dynamics press releases; Raibert (1986) Legged Robots That Balance
timeline.card_summary_zh: Boston Dynamics 在 DARPA 资助下首次演示 BigDog 四足机器人；BigDog 是“动态平衡机器人”从理论到工程的转折点。
timeline.summary_en: In December 2004, DARPA-funded Boston Dynamics first demonstrated the BigDog quadruped robot—a 109 kg, 1-meter-long, and 0.7-meter-tall machine designed by Marc Raibert’s team (Raibert founded the MIT Leg Lab in 1986). Driven by hydraulics, 16 joints, and attitude control algorithms, BigDog could carry a 50 kg payload across snow, gravel, ice, and stairs, and even recover its balance after being kicked from the side. In 2008, a YouTube video of the robot surpassed 15 million views, cementing it as the first viral video in AI robotics history.
timeline.card_summary_en: Boston Dynamics, funded by DARPA, demonstrated the BigDog quadruped, the turning point where dynamic-balance robots moved from theory into working hardware.
timeline.why_it_matters_en: BigDog was the turning point that took dynamically balancing robots from theory to engineering. It proved Marc Raibert's 1986 dynamic balance theory could be built, laying the foundation for Spot, Atlas, and Boston Dynamics' entire product line. Today's humanoid robot efforts, from Optimus to Figure to Atlas 2024, run on dynamic balance algorithms that ultimately rest on Raibert's thirty years of legged robotics research.
timeline.behind_scenes_en: Raibert wrote Legged Robots That Balance at MIT's Leg Lab in 1986, establishing the theoretical basis for dynamic balance in machines. In 1992 he left MIT to found Boston Dynamics, and BigDog in 2004 was the engineering summit of his thirty years of legged robot research. BigDog was driven by a two-stroke internal combustion engine powering hydraulic pumps and produced noise above 100 decibels, which is the direct reason SpotMini switched to electric actuators in 2016. Google acquired Boston Dynamics in 2013, sold it to SoftBank in 2017, and Hyundai took over in 2020 for $1.1 billion. The entire technology tree behind today's Spot and Atlas grows out of BigDog.

timeline.title_zh: Amazon/Netflix 推荐系统:协同过滤的工业高峰
timeline.title_en: Amazon/Netflix Recommender Systems: Industrial Peak of Collaborative Filtering
timeline.summary_zh:
2005 年前后,Amazon 推荐系统和 Netflix Cinematch 推荐系统同时达到工业高峰。
Amazon 用 item-based 协同过滤(Linden et al. 2003 IEEE Internet Computing),在 2005 年处理 2900 万活跃用户 + 数百万商品,推荐贡献 35% 销售额。
Netflix Cinematch 用 100M+ 用户评分预测用户对未看电影的评分,2006 年 Netflix Prize 比赛要求把 RMSE 从 0.9514 降到 0.8563,冠军 100 万美元。
timeline.source_name: Linden, G. et al. (2003) IEEE Internet Computing 7(3); Netflix Prize (2006-2009)
timeline.card_summary_zh: Amazon 与 Netflix 把协同过滤用于大规模个性化推荐，机器学习开始直接影响消费选择与平台收入。
timeline.summary_en: Around 2005, the recommendation systems of Amazon and Netflix's Cinematch simultaneously hit their industrial peaks. Amazon utilized item-based collaborative filtering (Linden et al. 2003 IEEE Internet Computing) to process 29 million active users and millions of products in 2005, with recommendations driving 35% of its sales. Meanwhile, Netflix Cinematch leveraged 100M+ user ratings to predict ratings for unseen movies, culminating in the 2006 Netflix Prize competition, which offered $1 million to the winner who could reduce the RMSE from 0.9514 to 0.8563.
timeline.card_summary_en: Amazon and Netflix ran collaborative filtering at industrial scale, and machine learning began directly shaping consumer choices and platform revenue.
timeline.why_it_matters_en: Recommender systems were the main engine of ML commercialization from 2005 to 2015. The data flywheels, personalization, and filter bubbles discussed around LLMs today all had early versions inside Amazon and Netflix recommendations in 2005. Understanding this era's narrow-AI-plus-big-data engineering paradigm clarifies both why deep learning entered recommendation quickly after 2012, and why LLMs have actually progressed slowly in recommendation scenarios since 2020.
timeline.behind_scenes_en: The key insight of 2005-era recommender systems was that data scale beats algorithmic complexity. Amazon's 2003 paper showed item-based collaborative filtering scales better in engineering than user-based CF, even at slightly lower accuracy. The Netflix Prize from 2006 to 2009 verified that ensembles plus large-scale engineering beat any single algorithm: the winning BellKor team combined over 100 models, including SVD, RBM, kNN, and AutoRec, to reach RMSE 0.8567. Koren's matrix factorization work during the competition, SVD++, became the workhorse of recommender systems from 2008 to 2016. That whole paradigm of data plus ensembles plus massive engineering was inherited intact by Facebook, LinkedIn, and YouTube recommendations, until deep learning recommendation models like Wide&Deep and DeepFM appeared in 2016.

timeline.title_zh: EPFL Blue Brain:脑模拟的长期工程启动
timeline.title_en: EPFL Blue Brain Project: Long-term Brain Simulation Launched
timeline.summary_zh:
2005 年 6 月 15 日,EPFL 神经科学家 Henry Markram 启动 Blue Brain Project,在 IBM Blue Gene 超算上模拟大鼠大脑皮层柱(Cortical Column)。
2005-2015 年项目模拟了约 1 万个神经元、3000 万个突触的皮层柱,2013 年扩展为欧盟 Human Brain Project(HBP),10 亿欧元预算。
HBP 在 2013-2023 年大规模模拟和神经信息基础设施上争议不断,Markram 2018 年离开 HBP,但 Blue Brain 至今仍在 EPFL 运行。
timeline.source_name: Markram, H. (2006) Nature Reviews Neuroscience 7(2); HBP 2013-2023 reports
timeline.card_summary_zh: EPFL Blue Brain：脑模拟的长期工程启动；Blue Brain 是“脑模拟路线”最雄心勃勃的工程。
timeline.summary_en: On June 15, 2005, EPFL neuroscientist Henry Markram launched the Blue Brain Project, simulating a rat cortical column on an IBM Blue Gene supercomputer. From 2005 to 2015, the project simulated a cortical column of about 10,000 neurons and 30 million synapses, expanding in 2013 into the European Union's €1 billion Human Brain Project (HBP). While the HBP was mired in controversy over its large-scale simulations and neuroinformatics infrastructure from 2013 to 2023—leading to Markram's departure in 2018—the Blue Brain Project continues to run at EPFL today.
timeline.card_summary_en: EPFL launched the Blue Brain Project, the most ambitious engineering attempt yet to simulate a brain digit by digit.
timeline.why_it_matters_en: Blue Brain is the most ambitious project on the brain-simulation route. Its core failure revealed that biological complexity exceeds what engineering can simulate, showing that intelligence does not necessarily require biological fidelity. The debates now running through LLM circles about emergence, scaling laws, and whether intelligence needs a body were all rehearsed in the Blue Brain era. Tracing this line explains why mainstream AI abandoned biological simulation entirely after 2012 and turned to statistical learning.
timeline.behind_scenes_en: Blue Brain represents one strand in AI history: biological reductionism. Markram claimed in his 2009 TED talk that a simulated human brain would arrive within ten years, drawing sharp criticism from neuroscience and AI alike. Critics pointed out that the brain is more than neurons and synapses; there are glial cells, neuromodulators, molecular dynamics, and even simulating every detail might not produce intelligence. The Human Brain Project saw constant internal conflict from 2013 to 2015, with eight neuroscientists publishing an open letter attacking Markram's route until the EU forced a management reorganization. Blue Brain and Hinton's distributed-representation-and-learning route were the two parallel paths of twenty-first-century AI, and the latter won decisively after AlexNet in 2012.

timeline.title_zh: Dartmouth AI@50 大会:AI 半世纪集体盘点
timeline.title_en: Dartmouth AI@50 Conference: Half-Century Collective Retrospective
timeline.summary_zh:
2006 年 7 月 13-15 日,Dartmouth College 举办 AI@50 大会,纪念 1956 年达特茅斯会议 50 周年。
会议邀请 McCarthy、Minsky、Simon、Newell 等 1956 原班人马,加上 Hinton、LeCun、Bengio、Russell、Norvig 等新一代领军,回顾 AI 50 年的命名、热潮、寒冬、专家系统、统计学习、机器人和重新升温。
会议讨论重点包括:深度学习是否可信、概率 AI vs 符号 AI、AI 伦理、AI 寒冬周期律等。
timeline.source_name: Dartmouth AI@50 Conference (2006-07); McCarthy et al. (2006) AI Magazine 27(4)
timeline.card_summary_zh: 会议讨论重点包括:深度学习是否可信、概率 AI vs 符号 AI、AI 伦理、AI 寒冬周期律等；AI@50 是 AI 圈承前启后的关键节点。
timeline.summary_en: From July 13 to 15, 2006, Dartmouth College hosted the AI@50 conference to commemorate the 50th anniversary of the 1956 Dartmouth conference. The event brought together the original 1956 cohort, including McCarthy, Minsky, Simon, and Newell, alongside a new generation of leaders like Hinton, LeCun, Bengio, Russell, and Norvig to reflect on 50 years of AI's naming, hypes, winters, expert systems, statistical learning, robotics, and resurgence. Key discussions focused on the trustworthiness of deep learning, probabilistic AI vs. symbolic AI, AI ethics, and the cyclical patterns of AI winters.
timeline.card_summary_en: Fifty years after Dartmouth 1956, AI researchers gathered for AI@50 to take stock of half a century of failures and quiet progress.
timeline.why_it_matters_en: AI@50 was the hinge moment where the field looked back before moving forward. It systematically inventoried fifty years of failures and accumulation from 1956 to 2006, letting a new generation see clearly which roads were dead ends, symbolic AI and expert systems, and which roads had been quietly accumulating, neural networks, statistical learning, GPUs. The similar retrospectives at AI@60 and AI@70 all stand on the collective-reflection tradition that AI@50 established.
timeline.behind_scenes_en: The mood was delicate. When McCarthy coined the term artificial intelligence in 1956 he predicted a summer would solve machine intelligence; fifty years later AI remained stuck at narrow tools. Hinton presented DBN pretraining results and drew skepticism from mainstream symbolic researchers asking whether neural networks were back again. Minsky held firm to the symbolic line and tensions with Hinton's group ran high. Moore was still pitching GPU general-purpose computing inside NVIDIA in 2006, and nobody attending foresaw that AlexNet would overturn everything six years later. AI@50's real significance was the stocktaking itself, a bridge summary ahead of the great explosion after 2012.

timeline.title_zh: Hinton-Salakhutdinov DBN:深度学习复兴起点
timeline.title_en: Hinton-Salakhutdinov DBN: Deep Learning Revival
timeline.summary_zh:
2006 年 7 月 28 日,Geoffrey Hinton 和 Ruslan Salakhutdinov 在Science 313(5786):504-507 发表《Reducing the Dimensionality of Data with Neural Networks》。
论文用 Restricted Boltzmann Machine 预训练 + 反向传播微调,在 MNIST 上把自编码器降维错误率从 PCA 的 14.8% 降到 6.4%。
这是 Deep Belief Network(DBN)的工程化论文,重新证明多层神经网络可以训练,也正式让“deep learning”一词进入主流。
同年 Hinton 在 NIPS 发表《A Fast Learning Algorithm for Deep Belief Nets》,进一步推广 DBN 训练方法。
timeline.source_name: Hinton, G. E. & Salakhutdinov, R. (2006) Science 313(5786):504-507; Hinton et al. (2006) NIPS
timeline.card_summary_zh: 深度置信网络证明多层神经网络仍然可以有效训练，“深度学习”由此重新回到主流研究视野。
timeline.summary_en: On July 28, 2006, Geoffrey Hinton and Ruslan Salakhutdinov published "Reducing the Dimensionality of Data with Neural Networks" in *Science* 313(5786):504-507, using Restricted Boltzmann Machine pre-training and backpropagation fine-tuning to slash the autoencoder dimensionality reduction error rate on MNIST from PCA's 14.8% to 6.4%. As the engineering paper for Deep Belief Networks (DBN), it proved once again that multi-layer neural networks could be trained, officially pushing the term "deep learning" into the mainstream. That same year, Hinton further popularized the DBN training method by publishing "A Fast Learning Algorithm for Deep Belief Nets" at NIPS.
timeline.card_summary_en: Hinton and Salakhutdinov published deep belief networks in Science, proving multilayer networks could still be trained effectively and bringing deep learning back into mainstream view.
timeline.why_it_matters_en: The 2006 DBN paper was ground zero for the deep learning era. The technology trees behind GPT, Stable Diffusion, and AlphaFold all grow from this breakthrough. Following the line of DBN 2006, DBN speech recognition in 2009, AlexNet in 2012, GAN in 2014, Transformer in 2017, and GPT-3 in 2020 makes clear that deep learning did not erupt from nowhere in 2012; it was the result of eight years of persistence by Hinton's team meeting maturing compute and data.
timeline.behind_scenes_en: Hinton's team developed the Contrastive Divergence training algorithm in Toronto from 2002 to 2006, solving the problem of slow RBM training. Getting published in Science mattered enormously: it bypassed the neural-networks-are-dead bias of AI journals and carried deep learning back into mainstream scientific view. In 2009 the team worked with Microsoft and Google to apply DBNs to speech recognition, and DNN-HMM cut TIMIT error rates from 24.8% to 16.0% across 2010-2011, directly setting up AlexNet's ImageNet breakthrough in 2012. When Hinton won the Nobel Prize in Physics with Hopfield in 2024, this line was the core citation.

timeline.title_zh: Netflix Prize 启动:机器学习众包比赛范式
timeline.title_en: Netflix Prize Launched: Crowdsourced ML Competition Paradigm
timeline.summary_zh:
2006 年 10 月 2 日,Netflix 启动 Netflix Prize,公开 1 亿条匿名电影评分(48 万用户 × 1.8 万电影),目标把 Cinematch 的 RMSE 0.9514 降低 10%(到 0.8563),冠军奖金 100 万美元。
比赛历时 3 年,吸引 5169 支队伍、186 个国家 4.1 万参与者,提交 4.4 万次预测。
2009 年 7 月 26 日 BellKor's Pragmatic Chaos 团队(Yehuda Koren、Robert Bell、Chris Volinsky + Martin Chabbert)以 0.8567 RMSE 险胜 The Ensemble,赢得 100 万美元。
timeline.source_name: Netflix Prize (2006-10-02 to 2009-09-21); Bell, Koren, Volinsky (2009) IEEE Computer 42(8)
timeline.card_summary_zh: Netflix Prize 启动：机器学习众包比赛范式；Netflix Prize 是“公开数据 + 众包比赛”范式的源头。
timeline.summary_en: On October 2, 2006, Netflix launched the Netflix Prize, releasing 100 million anonymous movie ratings (480,000 users × 18,000 movies) and offering a $1 million grand prize to anyone who could improve its Cinematch algorithm's RMSE of 0.9514 by 10% (to 0.8563). The three-year competition attracted 41,000 participants across 5,169 teams from 186 countries, yielding 44,000 prediction submissions. On July 26, 2009, the BellKor's Pragmatic Chaos team (Yehuda Koren, Robert Bell, Chris Volinsky, and Martin Chabbert) narrowly defeated The Ensemble with an RMSE of 0.8567 to claim the $1 million reward.
timeline.card_summary_en: Netflix put a million dollars and its movie ratings data on the table, launching the crowd-sourced ML competition format that evaluation still follows today.
timeline.why_it_matters_en: The Netflix Prize was the origin of the public-data-plus-crowd-competition paradigm. Kaggle, Hugging Face leaderboards, Chatbot Arena, and SWE-Bench rankings in LLM circles all stand on the format Netflix Prize established. Following the line from Netflix Prize 2006 to Kaggle 2010 to ImageNet 2010 to GLUE 2018 to Chatbot Arena 2024 shows how AI benchmarking evolved from private datasets into open competition.
timeline.behind_scenes_en: Netflix's internal Cinematch algorithm was an ensemble of SVD and kNN, and the final winning solution was an ensemble of more than 100 models including SVD, RBM, kNN, and AutoRec. Koren developed matrix factorization, SVD++, during the competition, which became recommender systems' mainstay algorithm from 2008 to 2016. Netflix cancelled the second Prize in 2010 over an FTC privacy lawsuit, but the competition format was inherited whole by Kaggle in 2010, ImageNet in 2010, KDD Cup, NIPS competitions, and NeurIPS 2020's RL track. Kaggle itself was founded in 2010 and acquired by Google in 2017, becoming the standard platform for machine learning competitions.

timeline.title_zh: NVIDIA CUDA 预览:GPU 通用计算开放给开发者
timeline.title_en: NVIDIA CUDA Preview: GPU General Computing Opens to Developers
timeline.summary_zh:
2006 年 11 月 8 日,NVIDIA 在 G80 芯片(GeForce 8800 GTX)发布时同步推出 CUDA(Compute Unified Device Architecture)预览版,让开发者用 C 语言直接编程 GPU 通用计算。
GeForce 8800 GTX 集成 128 个流处理器,核心 575MHz,显存 768MB GDDR3,是第一代支持 CUDA 的硬件。
CUDA 1.0 正式版 2007 年 2 月发布,配合 NVIDIA cuBLAS、cuFFT、cuDNN 等库逐步成熟,成为深度学习算力基础设施。
timeline.source_name: NVIDIA CUDA announcement (2006-11-08); Buck, I. (2004) Stanford PhD BrookGPU
timeline.card_summary_zh: CUDA 把 GPU 的并行能力开放给普通程序，后来训练深度神经网络所需的算力基础由此形成。
timeline.summary_en: On November 8, 2006, NVIDIA launched a preview of CUDA (Compute Unified Device Architecture) alongside its G80 chip (GeForce 8800 GTX), allowing developers to program GPUs directly for general-purpose computing using C. Packing 128 stream processors, a 575MHz core, and 768MB of GDDR3 memory, the GeForce 8800 GTX was the first-generation hardware to support CUDA. Following the official release of CUDA 1.0 in February 2007, the platform matured alongside libraries like NVIDIA cuBLAS, cuFFT, and cuDNN to become the foundational infrastructure for deep learning compute.
timeline.card_summary_en: NVIDIA previewed CUDA at SC06, opening the GPU's parallel power to ordinary programmers and forming the compute foundation deep learning would later train on.
timeline.why_it_matters_en: Without CUDA there is no deep learning era. Ninety-nine percent of LLM training today runs on NVIDIA GPUs through CUDA, and PyTorch, TensorFlow, and JAX are all built on top of it. Tracing CUDA's transformation from graphics-hardware add-on between 2006 and 2012 into AI-compute monopoly explains both NVIDIA's three-trillion-dollar market cap in 2024 and why LLM circles discuss compute chokepoints almost entirely in terms of the CUDA ecosystem.
timeline.behind_scenes_en: CUDA's development lead was Ian Buck, now NVIDIA's head of accelerated computing, who built BrookGPU during his Stanford PhD starting in 2004, turning GPU general-purpose computing into serious academic work. From 2004 to 2006 NVIDIA restructured its G70/G80 chip architecture, replacing fixed-function pipelines with unified shaders to give CUDA its hardware base. Early reception was lukewarm: game developers found it complex, and academia only discovered GPU training's value for neural networks between 2007 and 2009. When Rajat Raina and Andrew Ng trained deep belief networks on GPUs in 2009, cutting training time from weeks to days, that became the direct source of AlexNet's decision to use GPUs in 2012.

timeline.title_zh: ImageNet 项目启动:1400 万张图像的赌注
timeline.title_en: ImageNet Project Launched: 14M Images Bet
timeline.summary_zh: 2007 年李飞飞在普林斯顿大学启动 ImageNet 项目,计划构建 2.2 万个类别、1400 万张图像的巨型数据集,2009 年在 CVPR 正式发表论文。
timeline.card_summary_zh: ImageNet 以千万级标注图像建立视觉知识库，这场看似笨重的数据工程后来引爆深度学习革命。
timeline.summary_en: In 2007, Fei-Fei Li launched the ImageNet project at Princeton University, aiming to build a massive dataset of 14 million images across 22,000 categories. The paper was officially published at CVPR in 2009.
timeline.card_summary_en: Fei-Fei Li launched ImageNet, betting that tens of millions of labeled images would matter more than any clever algorithm.
timeline.why_it_matters_en: ImageNet's launch represented a fundamental wager: vision is the first step toward machine intelligence, and data is the key to winning that wager.
timeline.behind_scenes_en: Almost nobody supported it at the start. Li needed to download nearly a billion candidate images for screening, and her PhD student Jia Deng calculated that manual labeling would take nineteen years. They turned to Amazon Mechanical Turk crowdsourcing instead. Princeton professor Kai Li was the only one who extended a hand, donating a workstation.

timeline.title_zh: iPhone 发布:移动互联网与移动 AI 的起点
timeline.title_en: iPhone Launched: Mobile Internet and Mobile AI Era Begins
timeline.summary_zh:
2007 年 1 月 9 日,Steve Jobs 在 Macworld 发布 iPhone,6 月 29 日正式上市。
初代 iPhone 集成多点触控、3.5 英寸屏、Wi-Fi、EDGE、200 万像素相机、iOS 1(基于 Mac OS X),售价 499 美元(4GB)/599 美元(8GB)。
2008 年 7 月 App Store 上线,2010 年 iPhone 4 + Retina 屏,iPhone 成为移动互联网时代标准终端。
iPhone 对 AI 的意义在“移动 AI 推理”和“移动端数据采集”两件事:2017 年 Apple A11 仿生芯片集成 Neural Engine,2018 年 Core ML 让 iOS 开发者可以直接跑深度学习模型。
timeline.source_name: Apple iPhone announcement (2007-01-09); Apple A11 Bionic Neural Engine (2017)
timeline.card_summary_zh: iPhone 把传感器、网络和计算装进口袋，为语音助手、移动视觉和个性化 AI 创造了最大入口。
timeline.summary_en: On January 9, 2007, Steve Jobs unveiled the iPhone at Macworld before its official release on June 29, packing multi-touch, a 3.5-inch screen, Wi-Fi, EDGE, a 2-megapixel camera, and iOS 1 (based on Mac OS X) for $499 (4GB)/$599 (8GB). The July 2008 launch of the App Store and 2010's iPhone 4 with a Retina display solidified it as the standard terminal of the mobile internet era. The iPhone's significance to AI lies in "mobile AI inference" and "on-device data collection"—driven by the Apple A11 Bionic chip integrating the Neural Engine in 2017, and the release of Core ML in 2018, which allowed iOS developers to run deep learning models directly.
timeline.card_summary_en: The iPhone packed sensors, networking, and computing into a pocket device, creating the biggest single entry point for voice assistants, mobile vision, and personal AI.
timeline.why_it_matters_en: The iPhone was ground zero for mobile AI. The topics circulating in LLM circles today, on-device inference, model compression, privacy protection, edge AI, were all rehearsed along the line from the iPhone's 2007 launch through the Neural Engine in 2017 and Core ML in 2018. Grasping what the iPhone meant for AI clarifies why Apple insists on an on-device-first, cloud-supplement route in the LLM era, standing opposite Google's and Microsoft's cloud-first strategies.
timeline.behind_scenes_en: At launch in 2007 the iPhone had no SDK and only built-in apps. Jobs initially opposed third-party apps, fearing quality would spin out of control. Through 2007 and 2008 developers wrote third-party software via jailbreaks until Jobs opened the SDK and App Store in March 2008, transforming the iPhone into a platform for mobile AI compute plus data collection. Apple rolled out Core ML, Vision API, and Natural Language API across 2015-2017, integrated the Neural Engine into the A11 Bionic chip in 2017, and ran Face ID's CNN-based facial recognition entirely on-device in 2018. The iPhone also became the hardware foundation for Apple Intelligence in iOS 18 in 2024, with A17 Pro and M-series chips supporting on-device LLM inference.

timeline.title_zh: NVIDIA CUDA 1.0 正式发布:GPU 走入通用计算
timeline.title_en: NVIDIA CUDA 1.0 Released: GPU Goes General Purpose
timeline.summary_zh:
2007 年 2 月 14 日,NVIDIA 发布 CUDA 1.0 正式版,支持 GeForce 8 系列、Quadro FX 4600/5600、Tesla C870/G80 等硬件。
CUDA 1.0 包含 nvcc 编译器、CUDA Runtime、cuBLAS、cuFFT、CUDA GDB,让 C 语言开发者可以直接在 GPU 上编程矩阵乘、卷积、FFT 等高并行计算。
2007 年也是 NVIDIA Tesla GPU 计算品牌启动的年份,面向 HPC 和 AI 工作负载的专用产品线开始独立。
2007-2010 年 CUDA SDK 逐步完善,2010 年 cuDNN 前身 cuBLAS-XT、2014 年 cuDNN 1.0,成为深度学习框架的底层依赖。
timeline.source_name: NVIDIA CUDA 1.0 release (2007-02-14); NVIDIA Tesla brand launch (2007)
timeline.card_summary_zh: CUDA 让开发者可以直接调用 GPU 进行通用计算，训练神经网络所需的并行算力从此变得可编程。
timeline.summary_en: On February 14, 2007, NVIDIA officially released CUDA 1.0—supporting GeForce 8 series, Quadro FX 4600/5600, and Tesla C870/G80 hardware—which featured the nvcc compiler, CUDA Runtime, cuBLAS, cuFFT, and CUDA GDB to let C developers program highly parallel computations like matrix multiplication, convolution, and FFT directly on the GPU. That same year, NVIDIA also launched its Tesla GPU computing brand, establishing a dedicated, independent product line for HPC and AI workloads. As the CUDA SDK was gradually refined between 2007 and 2010, it set the stage for cuDNN's predecessor cuBLAS-XT in 2010 and cuDNN 1.0 in 2014, both of which became the foundational dependencies of deep learning frameworks.
timeline.card_summary_en: CUDA 1.0 shipped to developers, making GPU parallel power programmable for general computing and setting up the hardware story of neural network training.
timeline.why_it_matters_en: CUDA 1.0 was the pivot where NVIDIA turned from a gaming graphics company into an AI-compute monopolist. NVIDIA's three-trillion-dollar market cap today rests on the CUDA ecosystem as its core moat. Tracing the line from CUDA 1.0 in 2007 through AlexNet in 2012, cuDNN in 2014, and LLMs in 2020 shows why AMD, Intel, and Google TPU have all struggled to shake NVIDIA's grip on the LLM training market.
timeline.behind_scenes_en: When CUDA 1.0 shipped, NVIDIA's revenue came mainly from gaming graphics. CEO Jensen Huang treated CUDA as a ten-year strategic bet, pouring roughly $100 million a year into the CUDA ecosystem from 2007 to 2012 while commercial returns were nearly zero. The decision was contested inside the company, with investors repeatedly questioning whether the investment was worth it. In 2012 AlexNet trained ImageNet on GTX 580s, proving GPU-based deep network training worked, and the bet began paying off. cuDNN 1.0 in 2014, TensorFlow in 2015, and PyTorch in 2016 locked CUDA in as deep learning's compute monopoly, and Huang's thirty-year strategy cashed out completely in the 2020s.

timeline.title_zh: DARPA Urban Challenge:无人驾驶进入城市环境
timeline.title_en: DARPA Urban Challenge: Autonomous Driving Enters Urban Environment
timeline.summary_zh:
2007 年 11 月 3 日,DARPA 在加州 Victorville 举办 Urban Challenge。
赛道 96 公里城市道路,要求无人车遵守交通规则,在路口、环形交叉、并道、超车场景下与其他车辆和人类司机互动。
11 支队伍进入决赛,CMU Boss(Tartan Racing)第一,Stanford Junior 第二,Virginia Tech Odin 第三,MIT Talos 第六。
Boss 用 6 小时 53 分完成 96 公里,平均时速 14 公里。
这是无人车第一次在城市环境跑通完整交通规则。
timeline.source_name: DARPA Urban Challenge 2007 official report; Urmson et al. (2008) J. Field Robotics 25(10)
timeline.card_summary_zh: 无人车第一次在模拟城市道路中处理路口、并线和交通规则，自动驾驶从荒野测试进入真实交通逻辑。
timeline.summary_en: On November 3, 2007, DARPA held the Urban Challenge in Victorville, California, requiring autonomous vehicles to navigate a 96-kilometer urban course, obey traffic rules, and interact with other vehicles and human drivers at intersections, roundabouts, merging, and overtaking. Out of 11 finalist teams, CMU Boss (Tartan Racing) took first place—completing the 96 km in 6 hours and 53 minutes at an average speed of 14 km/h—followed by Stanford Junior in second, Virginia Tech Odin in third, and MIT Talos in sixth. This marked the first time autonomous vehicles successfully navigated a complete set of traffic rules in an urban environment.
timeline.card_summary_en: Six driverless cars finished the DARPA Urban Challenge, handling intersections, merges, and traffic rules for the first time in a simulated city.
timeline.why_it_matters_en: The Urban Challenge was the turning point that took self-driving from open desert into city streets. It proved autonomous vehicles could operate inside a real traffic system, paving the way for Google's 2009 self-driving project, Tesla Autopilot in 2014, Waymo's independence in 2016, and Cruise's venture funding in 2018. Most of today's autonomous driving technical leadership was trained through the three DARPA challenges from 2004 to 2007.
timeline.behind_scenes_en: The hard part of the Urban Challenge was decision-making in dynamic environments. The progression went: Grand Challenge failure in 2004, five finishers in 2005, six finishers in the urban setting of 2007, three giant strides in three years. CMU's Boss team, led by Chris Urmson, later Waymo's CEO, combined lidar, vision, radar, and path planning to handle intersection yielding, merging, and passing in city scenarios. Stanford Junior under Sebastian Thrun ran a similar approach but stayed more conservative on merge decisions and placed second. Both Urmson and Thrun joined Google Project Chauffeur in 2009; the Urban Challenge is Waymo's technical source.

timeline.title_zh: Hadoop + MapReduce + 机器学习:大数据工程范式成熟
timeline.title_en: Hadoop + MapReduce + ML: Big Data Engineering Paradigm Matures
timeline.summary_zh:
2008 年 4 月 Yahoo 发布 Hadoop 0.16,Apache Hadoop 项目正式独立;9 月 Hadoop 0.18 完善 HDFS + MapReduce,成为大数据处理标准。
同年 Google 在 CACM 51(1):107-113 发表 MapReduce 论文工程回顾,Cloudera(2009)、Hortonworks(2011)、MapR(2009)基于 Hadoop 创业,形成完整的大数据生态。
2008-2012 年 Hadoop + Hive + Pig + Mahout + Spark(2010) 让“大规模数据 + 简单机器学习算法”工程范式在互联网公司普及,Google、Facebook、LinkedIn、Twitter、Amazon 都跑着千节点 Hadoop 集群。
timeline.source_name: Dean, J. & Ghemawat, S. (2008) CACM 51(1):107-113; Apache Hadoop 0.18 (2008-09)
timeline.card_summary_zh: Hadoop + MapReduce + 机器学习：大数据工程范式成熟；Hadoop + MapReduce 是大数据机器学习的工程基础。
timeline.summary_en: In April 2008, Yahoo released Hadoop 0.16 as the Apache Hadoop project officially became independent, followed in September by Hadoop 0.18, which refined HDFS + MapReduce into the standard for big data processing. That same year, Google published its MapReduce paper engineering retrospective in CACM 51(1):107-113, while Cloudera (2009), Hortonworks (2011), and MapR (2009) launched startups based on Hadoop to form a complete big data ecosystem. Between 2008 and 2012, Hadoop + Hive + Pig + Mahout + Spark (2010) popularized the "massive data + simple machine learning algorithms" engineering paradigm across internet companies, with Google, Facebook, LinkedIn, Twitter, and Amazon all running thousand-node Hadoop clusters.
timeline.card_summary_en: Hadoop brought MapReduce out of Google's papers into open-source infrastructure, maturing the big-data engineering paradigm machine learning would scale on.
timeline.why_it_matters_en: Hadoop plus MapReduce is the engineering foundation of big-data machine learning. Today's data pipelines, distributed training, and feature stores behind LLM training were all rehearsed in the Hadoop era. Understanding the big-data engineering paradigm of 2008-2014 explains why Spark in 2014, TensorFlow in 2015, and Ray in 2018 could support deep learning engineering so quickly, and why the data flywheels, feature engineering, and online learning discussed around LLMs all stand on data infrastructure built in Hadoop's time.
timeline.behind_scenes_en: Hadoop came from Doug Cutting's work at Yahoo between 2003 and 2005. Drawing on Google's GFS paper of 2003, MapReduce paper of 2004, and Bigtable paper of 2006, he implemented an open-source version in Java and named it after his son's toy elephant. Yahoo poured engineers into perfecting Hadoop from 2006 to 2008, aiming to escape dependence on Google's closed infrastructure. During Hadoop's explosive growth from 2008 to 2012, Facebook shipped Hive in 2007, Yahoo Pig in 2008, Apache Mahout in 2010, and UC Berkeley Spark in 2010. Spark replaced MapReduce as the mainstream engine in 2014, but Hadoop's paradigm of distributed storage plus massive computation was inherited intact.

timeline.title_zh: Google Chrome 发布:Web 浏览器再革命
timeline.title_en: Google Chrome Released: Web Browser Revolution
timeline.summary_zh:
2008 年 9 月 2 日,Google 发布 Chrome 1.0 浏览器。
Chrome 用 V8 JavaScript 引擎(2010 年引入 Crankshaft JIT 优化编译器)突破 JS 性能瓶颈,用多进程架构隔离 Tab,用 Webkit(2013 年改 Blink)渲染引擎提高兼容性。
Chrome 2009 年 12 月超越 Safari,2010-2012 年超越 Firefox,2016 年超越 IE,2024 年全球市场份额 65%。
Chrome 对 AI 的意义是“Web 作为应用平台 + 数据采集层”:Web 应用从“静态页面”演化到“SPA + 持久化客户端”,为后续 LLM 圈的 Web Agent、ChatGPT Web 客户端、Notion AI 等基于 Web 的 AI 应用提供工程基础。
timeline.source_name: Google Chrome 1.0 release (2008-09-02); V8 engine (2008)
timeline.card_summary_zh: Google 发布 Chrome 1.0 浏览器；Chrome 是 Web 作为“AI 应用平台”的工程基础。
timeline.summary_en: On September 2, 2008, Google released Chrome 1.0, breaking JS performance bottlenecks with its V8 JavaScript engine (which added the Crankshaft JIT optimizing compiler in 2010), isolating tabs via a multi-process architecture, and leveraging the Webkit rendering engine (switched to Blink in 2013) to improve compatibility. The browser went on to overtake Safari in December 2009, Firefox between 2010 and 2012, and IE in 2016, ultimately commanding a 65% global market share by 2024. For AI, Chrome’s true significance lies in establishing "the Web as an application platform + data collection layer," driving the evolution of web apps from "static pages" to "SPAs + persistent clients" and paving the engineering foundation for LLM-era Web Agents, the ChatGPT web client, and Notion AI.
timeline.card_summary_en: Google launched Chrome 1.0 with the V8 engine, transforming the Web from pages into applications and building the platform layer most AI tools now run on.
timeline.why_it_matters_en: Chrome is the engineering foundation of the Web as an AI application platform. ChatGPT Web, Claude Web, Google Gemini Web, and Character.AI all run on Chrome and Chromium engines today. Understanding how Chrome turned the Web from documents into applications clarifies why web interfaces suit AI toolchains better than native apps in the LLM era, and why browser-operating paradigms like Browser Use, WebVoyager, and Anthropic Computer Use became mainstream in 2024.
timeline.behind_scenes_en: Chrome's development was led by Sundar Pichai, later Google's CEO, with a technical team including Lars Bak of the V8 engine plus Firefox veterans Ben Goodger and Darin Fisher. Google's original motive was that Microsoft's IE was dragging down web apps: Search, Gmail, and Google Maps ran painfully slow on IE 6 and 7. V8 lifted JavaScript performance tenfold and turned web applications from documents into programs. Chrome Web Store arrived in 2010, Chrome OS in 2011, Android Chrome in 2012, making Chrome the core of Google's cross-device platform strategy. Today's Web Agents, RPA tools, and browser automation all stand on Chrome and Chromium's universal adoption.

timeline.title_zh: Google Project Chauffeur:工业级自动驾驶启动
timeline.title_en: Google Project Chauffeur: Industrial Autonomous Driving Launched
timeline.summary_zh:
2009 年 1 月 17 日,Google X 启动 Project Chauffeur 自动驾驶项目,Sebastian Thrun(Stanford Junior 团队领军)和 Chris Urmson(CMU Boss 团队领军)共同主导。
团队最初 10 人,包括 DARPA Grand Challenge 老将 Mike Montemerlo、Anthony Levandowski、Bryan Salesky 等。
2010 年 10 月第一代无人车 Toyota Prius 改装版在旧金山公开路测,2012 年 5 月 Nevada 颁发第一张无人车牌照。
2016 年 12 月项目分拆为 Waymo 独立子公司,John Krafcik 任 CEO。
timeline.source_name: Google Project Chauffeur (2009-01); Waymo 2016 spin-off; Thrun interviews
timeline.card_summary_zh: Google 把自动驾驶从竞赛原型变成长期工业项目，后来独立成 Waymo 并开启商业无人驾驶路线。
timeline.summary_en: On January 17, 2009, Google X launched its Project Chauffeur self-driving project, co-led by Sebastian Thrun (leader of the Stanford Junior team) and Chris Urmson (leader of the CMU Boss team) with an initial 10-person crew including DARPA Grand Challenge veterans Mike Montemerlo, Anthony Levandowski, and Bryan Salesky. After public road tests of its first-generation modified Toyota Prius in San Francisco in October 2010, the project secured Nevada's first-ever autonomous vehicle license plate in May 2012. In December 2016, the project spun off into the independent subsidiary Waymo, with John Krafcik serving as CEO.
timeline.card_summary_en: Google turned Sebastian Thrun's competition success into Project Chauffeur, an industrial-scale self-driving program that would later become Waymo.
timeline.why_it_matters_en: Project Chauffeur was ground zero for industrial-grade autonomous driving. The technical backbone of Waymo, Cruise, Zoox, Pony.ai, and WeRide mostly came up through Chauffeur's ranks. The debates running through self-driving circles today about L2 versus L4, data flywheels versus algorithmic breakthroughs, incremental versus leapfrog strategies, were all rehearsed inside Google from 2009 to 2014.
timeline.behind_scenes_en: Larry Page drove the launch personally. After watching the 2007 Urban Challenge, Page invited Thrun to Google X in 2008 to evaluate whether self-driving could be commercialized within five years. Thrun's team concluded ten years, Page committed anyway, and Project Chauffeur started in January 2009. Google chose to go straight for fully driverless L4, skipping the L2/L3 incremental route, a decision that kept Waymo technically ahead from 2009 to 2018 while commercializing slowly, in contrast to Tesla Autopilot shipping L2 early in 2014 to accumulate data. In 2020 Waymo opened its driverless taxi service in Phoenix, reaching L4 commercial operation four years before Tesla FSD, though Waymo's expansion has lagged far behind Tesla FSD's user base.

timeline.title_zh: Rajat Raina + Andrew Ng:GPU 训练深度信念网络
timeline.title_en: Rajat Raina + Andrew Ng: GPU-Trained Deep Belief Networks
timeline.summary_zh:
2009 年 6 月,Stanford 的 Rajat Raina、Anand Madhavan、Andrew Ng 在 ICML 2009(第 26 届国际机器学习大会,6 月 14-18 日)发表论文《Large-scale Deep Unsupervised Learning using Graphics Processors》。
论文用 NVIDIA GTX 280 GPU(1GB 显存)训练 Deep Belief Network,在 MNIST 上把训练时间从 CPU 的约 19 天降到 GPU 的约 1 天,加速约 14 倍。
在稀疏编码/自编码器上加速最高约 70 倍量级。
这是"GPU 训练深度网络"最早的工程化论文,直接启发 2012 年 AlexNet 用 GTX 580 训练 ImageNet。
timeline.source_name: Raina, R., Madhavan, A., Ng, A. Y. (2009). ICML 2009: Proceedings of the 26th International Conference on Machine Learning; Google Brain cat neuron (2012 NYT)
timeline.card_summary_zh: Rajat Raina + Andrew Ng：GPU 训练深度信念网络；Raina-Ng 2009 论文是 GPU 深度学习工程化的关键节点。
timeline.summary_en: In June 2009, Stanford’s Rajat Raina, Anand Madhavan, and Andrew Ng presented their paper "Large-scale Deep Unsupervised Learning using Graphics Processors" at ICML 2009 (the 26th International Conference on Machine Learning, June 14-18).
