Using an NVIDIA GTX 280 GPU with 1GB of memory to train a Deep Belief Network, they slashed training time on MNIST from about 19 days on CPU to roughly one day on GPU—a 14x speedup—while accelerating sparse coding/autoencoders by up to about 70x. As the earliest engineering paper on training deep networks with GPUs, this work directly inspired AlexNet to train ImageNet using the GTX 580 in 2012.
timeline.card_summary_en: Rajat Raina and Andrew Ng showed GPUs could train deep belief networks dramatically faster, the key node where GPU-based deep learning became engineering reality.
timeline.why_it_matters_en: The Raina-Ng 2009 paper was the key node in GPU deep learning engineering. The massive GPU clusters behind LLM training had their early version in Raina and Ng's single-GPU experiments. Following the line from the 2009 GPU lab through Google Brain's thousand machines in 2012, large Transformer models in 2017, and GPT-3 in 2020 shows why NVIDIA could hold its compute monopoly in the LLM era, and why today's compute-chokepoint discussions concentrate on GPU supply.
timeline.behind_scenes_en: Andrew Ng worked with GPUs for machine learning at Stanford from 2007 to 2009, finding them orders of magnitude faster than CPUs at matrix multiplication. Raina was Ng's doctoral student and began attempting DBN training on GPU in 2008. The engineering difficulty was memory management: Raina's team hand-managed GPU memory, feeding mini-batch slices to the device. CUDA had been out for two years by 2009, yet mainstream academia still used CPU plus MATLAB. Ng's team's paper proved GPU training of deep networks viable, and in 2011 Ng joined the Google Brain project, working with Jeff Dean and Greg Corrado to train deep networks on a thousand servers plus GPU cluster to recognize cat faces, which made the New York Times front page in 2012.

timeline.title_zh: Fei-Fei Li ImageNet:视觉识别的标准基准
timeline.title_en: Fei-Fei Li ImageNet: Standard Benchmark for Visual Recognition
timeline.summary_zh:
2009 年 6 月 20 日,Fei-Fei Li 团队在 CVPR 2009 发表《ImageNet: A Large-Scale Hierarchical Image Database》,正式发布 ImageNet 数据集。
数据集基于 WordNet 名词层级,通过 Amazon Mechanical Turk 众包标注,最终收录 1400 万张图像、21841 个类别,每类约 500-1000 张。
2010 年 ILSVRC(ImageNet Large Scale Visual Recognition Challenge)启动,用 1000 类 + 120 万训练图 + 5 万验证图 + 15 万测试图,成为视觉识别的标准基准。
timeline.source_name: Deng, J. et al. (2009) CVPR; Russakovsky et al. (2015) IJCV 115(3):211-252
missing_terms: ImageNet 大规模视觉识别挑战赛
timeline.card_summary_zh: ImageNet 用千万级标注图像建立统一赛场，让计算机视觉第一次能够按同一尺度持续比较和进步。
timeline.summary_en: On June 20, 2009, Fei-Fei Li's team officially released the ImageNet dataset at CVPR 2009, publishing the paper "ImageNet: A Large-Scale Hierarchical Image Database." Built on the WordNet noun hierarchy and annotated via Amazon Mechanical Turk crowdsourcing, the dataset ultimately compiled 14 million images across 21,841 categories, with about 500-1000 images per category. In 2010, the ImageNet Large Scale Visual Recognition Challenge (ILSVRC) launched with 1,000 categories, 1.2 million training images, 50,000 validation images, and 150,000 test images, becoming the standard benchmark for visual recognition.
timeline.card_summary_en: Fei-Fei Li's ImageNet gave computer vision a single arena of tens of millions of labeled images, letting the field compare and progress on one scale for the first time.
timeline.why_it_matters_en: ImageNet was the detonator of the deep learning era. Without it there is no AlexNet breakthrough in 2012 and none of the industrial CNN engineering base built from 2012 to 2020. The debates now standard in LLM circles about dataset scale versus algorithmic complexity, benchmark saturation, and dataset bias all had their first rehearsal in the ImageNet era. Understanding ImageNet shows that today's investment in massive corpora like Common Crawl, C4, and RedPajama is the same class of engineering decision Li's team made about images in 2009.
timeline.behind_scenes_en: Li started the ImageNet project at Princeton in 2007 with the conviction that no algorithm matters without data. Funding was tight early on; she paid Mechanical Turk labeling costs partly out of her own salary, ultimately using forty-nine thousand workers from 167 countries to annotate fourteen million images over two and a half years. The 2009 CVPR paper was initially ignored by the mainstream vision community, and only after the ILSVRC competition launched in 2010 did ImageNet become vision's public benchmark. In 2012 AlexNet cut the ILSVRC top-5 error rate from 26.2% to 15.3%, becoming the detonation point of the deep learning era. Li later worked at Google Cloud and founded Stanford HAI; ImageNet remains the most important data infrastructure project in the history of visual AI.

timeline.title_zh: Apple 收购 Siri:语音助手进入大厂战略
timeline.title_en: Apple Acquires Siri: Voice Assistants Enter Big Tech Strategy
timeline.summary_zh:
2010 年 4 月 28 日,Apple 以约 2 亿美元收购 Siri Inc.。
Siri 原本是 SRI International 基于 CALO 项目(DARPA PAL 项目)开发的虚拟助手,2007 年独立为 Siri Inc.,2009 年 2 月发布 iOS 助手 App。
Apple 2011 年 10 月 4 日在 iPhone 4S 发布会正式推出 Siri 语音助手,成为第一款大规模消费级 AI 语音助手。
Siri 开启了 Amazon Alexa(2014)、Google Assistant(2016)、Microsoft Cortana(2014)、Samsung Bixby(2017)、Apple Intelligence(2024)等大厂语音助手竞争。
timeline.source_name: Apple Siri acquisition (2010-04-28); SRI CALO project history
timeline.card_summary_zh: Apple 收购 Siri：语音助手进入大厂战略；Apple 收购 Siri 是大厂 AI 战略的起点。
timeline.summary_en: On April 28, 2010, Apple acquired Siri Inc. for approximately $200 million, taking over a virtual assistant originally developed by SRI International under the CALO project (DARPA PAL project) that spun off as Siri Inc. in 2007 and released an iOS assistant app in February 2009. Apple officially launched the Siri voice assistant at the iPhone 4S event on October 4, 2011, making it the first large-scale consumer AI voice assistant. This sparked a wave of voice assistant competition among tech giants, paving the way for Amazon Alexa (2014), Microsoft Cortana (2014), Google Assistant (2016), Samsung Bixby (2017), and Apple Intelligence (2024).
timeline.card_summary_en: Apple bought Siri, turning a DARPA-born research project into big-tech strategy and starting the acquisition race for AI startups.
timeline.why_it_matters_en: Apple's purchase of Siri was the start of big-tech AI strategy through acquisition. It opened the wave of Google, Amazon, Microsoft, and Meta buying AI startups: Google's $650 million DeepMind deal in 2014, Facebook buying Wit.ai in January 2015, Microsoft paying $19.7 billion for Nuance in 2022. Siri's productize-and-acquire model reveals the internal logic behind LLM-era investment rhythms like Microsoft's $13 billion into OpenAI, Amazon's $8 billion into Anthropic, and Google's $3 billion into Anthropic.
timeline.behind_scenes_en: Siri's technology tree traces back to SRI International's CALO project of 2003, itself the product of DARPA's Personalized Assistant that Learns program, driven by Adam Cheyer, Tom Gruber, and Dag Kittlaus. Steve Jobs phoned the three founders personally in 2010, inviting them to his home to persuade them to join Apple. Jobs died on October 5, 2011, the day after the iPhone 4S event, making Siri the last major Apple product of his era. Technical progress crawled between 2011 and 2018 while Apple fought internally over Siri's route, on-device versus cloud, rules versus machine learning, and only in 2024 did Apple Intelligence rebuild Siri around an LLM.

timeline.title_zh: ILSVRC 首届 ImageNet 挑战赛:深度学习的试炼场
timeline.title_en: First ILSVRC: ImageNet Challenge Launch
timeline.summary_zh:
首届 ImageNet 大规模视觉识别挑战赛（ILSVRC）举办。
150 个团队报名，仅 11 个提交算法。
missing_terms: ImageNet 大规模视觉识别挑战赛
timeline.card_summary_zh: 首届 ImageNet 大规模视觉识别挑战赛（ILSVRC）举办。
timeline.summary_en: The inaugural ImageNet Large Scale Visual Recognition Challenge (ILSVRC) was held. Although 150 teams signed up, only 11 submitted algorithms.
timeline.card_summary_en: The first ImageNet Large Scale Visual Recognition Challenge opened for entries and drew almost nobody.
timeline.why_it_matters_en: ILSVRC's bleak initial participation throws AlexNet's explosive impact in 2012 into sharper relief: it was not gradual warming but overnight detonation.
timeline.behind_scenes_en: The first two editions were won by traditional SVM methods, with marginal gains. Entry counts started falling in the second year. Fei-Fei Li nearly believed she had lost her bet.

timeline.title_zh: Microsoft Kinect:深度摄像头进入消费市场
timeline.title_en: Microsoft Kinect: Depth Cameras Enter Consumer Market
timeline.summary_zh:
2010 年 11 月 4 日,Microsoft 发布 Kinect for Xbox 360,售价 149 美元。
Kinect 集成红外 + RGB 相机 + 多阵列麦克风,用 PrimeSense Light Coding 技术实时生成 640×480 深度图(30fps)。
首 60 天销量 800 万台,吉尼斯世界纪录最快销售消费电子。
Kinect 把“深度感知 + 实时人体姿态识别”带入消费市场,为后续 ROS、机器人感知、HoloLens、Apple Vision Pro 铺路。
timeline.source_name: Microsoft Kinect launch (2010-11-04); PrimeSense acquisition by Apple (2013)
timeline.card_summary_zh: Kinect 让深度感知和人体动作识别进入客厅，也为机器人与计算机视觉研究提供了廉价传感器。
timeline.summary_en: On November 4, 2010, Microsoft launched the Kinect for Xbox 360 for $149, integrating infrared and RGB cameras with a multi-array microphone to generate 640×480 depth maps at 30fps using PrimeSense Light Coding technology. The device sold 8 million units in its first 60 days, earning the Guinness World Record for the fastest-selling consumer electronics device. By bringing depth sensing and real-time human pose recognition to the consumer market, Kinect paved the way for ROS, robotic perception, HoloLens, and Apple Vision Pro.
timeline.card_summary_en: Microsoft Kinect put depth sensing and body tracking in living rooms, handing robotics and vision researchers a cheap depth camera in the process.
timeline.why_it_matters_en: Kinect was the start of depth-sensing consumerization. The depth cameras now required by AR/VR, robot perception, and human-computer interaction passed their first mass consumer validation in the 2010 Kinect. Following the line from Kinect through PrimeSense to Apple Face ID and Microsoft HoloLens shows why depth sensing became standard equipment on smart devices in the 2020s.
timeline.behind_scenes_en: Kinect's technology came from Israel's PrimeSense, founded in 2005 by Aviad Maizels and Zohar Shpunt. Shpunt developed the Light Coding structured-light technique, using infrared speckle patterns plus a dedicated depth-computing chip to generate depth maps in real time at roughly thirty dollars of cost, far below professional depth cameras at two thousand dollars. After Microsoft released a Windows SDK in 2011, academia used Kinect en masse for 3D scanning, robot navigation, and gesture recognition. Apple acquired PrimeSense for $345 million in 2013, and its technology became the foundation of Face ID's TrueDepth camera.

timeline.title_zh: IBM Watson 击败 Jeopardy! 冠军:问答 AI 高峰
timeline.title_en: IBM Watson Beats Jeopardy! Champions: QA AI Peak
timeline.summary_zh:
2011 年 2 月 14-16 日,IBM Watson 在 Jeopardy! 三集特别节目中以 77,147 美元击败卫冕冠军 Ken Jennings(24,000)和 Brad Rutter(21,600)。
Watson 由 David Ferrucci 2006-2011 年领导开发,用 DeepQA 架构:问题分析 + 候选生成 + 证据检索 + 置信度排序,在 200M 页结构化文档上做并行检索,3 秒内给出答案。
Watson 硬件是 90 台 IBM Power 750 服务器,2880 个 Power7 核心,16TB 内存。
timeline.source_name: IBM Watson Jeopardy! (2011-02-14-16); Ferrucci, D. (2012) AI Magazine 33(1)
timeline.card_summary_zh: Watson 在开放领域问答节目中击败两位冠军，展示了搜索、语言处理与工程集成的系统力量。
timeline.summary_en: From February 14–16, 2011, IBM Watson defeated defending champions Ken Jennings ($24,000) and Brad Rutter ($21,600) with $77,147 on a three-episode *Jeopardy!* special. Developed under the leadership of David Ferrucci from 2006 to 2011, Watson utilized a DeepQA architecture—combining question analysis, candidate generation, evidence retrieval, and confidence ranking—to perform parallel retrieval across 200M pages of structured documents and deliver answers within 3 seconds. The system ran on 90 IBM Power 750 servers, boasting 2880 Power7 cores and 16TB of RAM.
timeline.card_summary_en: IBM Watson beat the two greatest Jeopardy! champions on live television, showcasing the peak of search, language processing, and brute engineering integration.
timeline.why_it_matters_en: Watson was the final engineering summit of the symbolic-AI-plus-integration route. Its Jeopardy! victory, like Deep Blue beating Kasparov in 1997, proved narrow-scenario AI could defeat human experts. But Watson's commercial failures equally proved that route could not scale, clearing the ground for the statistical-learning-plus-massive-pretraining line of AlexNet in 2012, BERT in 2018, and GPT-3 in 2020.
timeline.behind_scenes_en: Watson consumed IBM's largest PR investment in its century of history, with roughly one billion dollars of development spending from 2006 to 2011. Ferrucci's team chose an ensemble-plus-engineering approach, running more than 100 algorithms on each question in parallel and voting for the most confident answer. Watson performed astonishingly on Jeopardy!, but Ferrucci left IBM in 2012 and subsequent commercialization in medicine, finance, and law moved slowly. IBM shut down multiple Watson for Oncology clients in 2018, and Watson Health was sold to Francisco Partners for one billion dollars in 2022. Watson's question-answering approach was thoroughly upended by BERT in 2018 and GPT-3 in 2020.

timeline.title_zh: Apple Siri 在 iPhone 4S 发布:消费级语音助手诞生
timeline.title_en: Apple Siri Launched on iPhone 4S: Consumer Voice Assistant Born
timeline.summary_zh:
2011 年 10 月 4 日,Apple 在 iPhone 4S 发布会推出 Siri 语音助手,10 月 14 日 iPhone 4S 上市,Siri 正式面向消费者。
Siri 1.0 用 Nuance 语音识别 + 自研自然语言理解 + 25 类内置服务(短信、电话、日历、地图、Wolfram Alpha),用户用自然语言对话,Siri 返回结果或调用 App。
Siri 开启了 Alexa(2014)、Google Assistant(2016)、Cortana(2014)、Bixby(2017)的语音助手时代。
timeline.source_name: Apple Siri on iPhone 4S launch (2011-10-04); Siri Inc. acquisition (2010-04-28)
timeline.card_summary_zh: Siri 被装进数百万部手机，语音交互第一次从研究演示变成普通人每天都能使用的产品。
timeline.summary_en: On October 4, 2011, Apple unveiled the Siri voice assistant at its iPhone 4S launch event, officially bringing it to consumers when the device went on sale on October 14. Siri 1.0 combined Nuance speech recognition, proprietary natural language understanding, and 25 categories of built-in services (including SMS, phone, calendar, maps, and Wolfram Alpha), allowing users to converse naturally while Siri returned results or invoked apps. Ultimately, Siri ushered in the voice assistant era of Alexa (2014), Google Assistant (2016), Cortana (2014), and Bixby (2017).
timeline.card_summary_en: Siri shipped inside millions of iPhone 4S handsets, turning voice interaction from a research demo into a product ordinary people used every day.
timeline.why_it_matters_en: Siri was the start of the consumer voice assistant. It proved an AI voice assistant could enter the consumer market as a daily tool, paving the way for Amazon Alexa and Echo in 2014, Google Assistant and Home in 2016, and conversational AI hardware like AI Pin and Rabbit R1 in 2024. Tracing Siri to Alexa to Google Assistant to ChatGPT Voice shows why voice interaction carries more commercial upside than text in the LLM era.
timeline.behind_scenes_en: Siri 1.0's technology came from Apple's 2010 acquisition of Siri Inc. plus its purchase of Polar Rose, a facial recognition company, that same year. Steve Jobs died on October 5, 2011, one day after the iPhone 4S announcement, making Siri the last major AI product of his era at Apple. Siri 1.0 on the iPhone 4S took three to five seconds to respond, relying on Apple's cloud data centers plus third-party cloud services. Progress was slow from 2011 to 2018: Google Assistant overtook Siri in 2016, and Amazon Alexa became the smart speaker market leader starting 2014. In 2024 Apple Intelligence rebuilt Siri around LLMs.

timeline.title_zh: AlexNet 引爆现代深度学习
timeline.title_en: AlexNet Ignites Modern Deep Learning
timeline.summary_zh:
2012 年，AlexNet 在 ImageNet 图像识别竞赛中大幅领先，把深度学习重新推到世界面前。
这次胜利真正震撼的地方，是三件事第一次强力合流。
ImageNet 给了大规模带标签数据，神经网络给了算法路线，GPU 给了能把深层网络跑起来的算力。
很多人从这时才真正意识到，deep and large 有了清晰证据。
只要数据、算法和算力一起到位，AI 能力会突然跃迁。
timeline.source_name: 英伟达的编年史和城墙整理材料
timeline.card_summary_zh: ImageNet 给了大规模带标签数据，神经网络给了算法路线，GPU 给了能把深层网络跑起来的算力；AlexNet 是理解现代 AI 的关键节点。
timeline.summary_en: In 2012, AlexNet dominated the ImageNet image recognition competition, thrusting deep learning back into the global spotlight. The true shock of this victory was the powerful, first-time convergence of three forces: ImageNet's large-scale labeled data, the algorithmic path of neural networks, and the GPU compute required to run deep networks. For many, this was the first clear evidence that "deep and large" worked, proving that when data, algorithms, and compute align, AI capabilities make a sudden leap.
timeline.card_summary_en: AlexNet fused ImageNet's labeled data, neural network algorithms, and GPU horsepower into one result that marks the key node for understanding modern AI.
timeline.why_it_matters_en: AlexNet is the key node for understanding modern AI. It connected ImageNet, Ilya, Hinton, GPUs, CUDA, and deep learning into a single line, and it showed NVIDIA the long-term opportunity in AI compute.

timeline.title_zh: GPU 训练深网成共识
timeline.title_en: GPU Training Goes Mainstream
timeline.summary_zh:
2012 年后，AlexNet 等结果让 GPU 成为深度网络训练的核心基础设施。
深层网络要做大量矩阵计算，CPU 像少数工人慢慢算，GPU 像一排工位同时开工。
研究者发现，模型能不能变大、训练能不能跑完，越来越依赖显卡、内存、互联和软件栈。
从这时开始，算力从背景条件走到台前，成为 AI 竞赛里的核心资源。
timeline.source_name: NeurIPS AlexNet paper
timeline.card_summary_zh: 2012 年后，AlexNet 等结果让 GPU 成为深度网络训练的核心基础设施；GPU 训练让深度学习从漂亮想法变成可扩展工程。
timeline.summary_en: After 2012, breakthroughs like AlexNet established the GPU as the core infrastructure for deep network training. To handle the massive matrix calculations required, a CPU behaves like a few workers slowly plugging away, whereas a GPU functions like a row of workstations firing up simultaneously. As researchers realized that scaling models and completing training depended heavily on graphics cards, memory, interconnects, and software stacks, compute stepped out of the background to become the defining resource in the AI race.
timeline.card_summary_en: After AlexNet, GPU training became the consensus infrastructure for deep networks, turning deep learning from a pretty idea into scalable engineering.
timeline.why_it_matters_en: GPU training turned deep learning from a beautiful idea into scalable engineering. The ceiling of modern model capability is largely set by compute infrastructure.

timeline.title_zh: 协作机器人Baxter发布——机器与人并肩工作
timeline.title_en: Collaborative Robot Baxter Released
timeline.summary_zh:
2012年，罗德尼·布鲁克斯的Rethink Robotics公司发布了巴克斯特（Baxter）双臂协作机器人。
它被设计成与人类工人安全协作的伙伴——不是取代。
人类可以简单地抓住它的手臂教它动作——它记住后自动重复。
这代表了一种与「取代人类」完全不同的机器人路线。
布鲁克斯是MIT AI Lab的前主任，也是著名机器人学家。
他公开反对把机器人做成取代人类工人的自动化机器——他认为机器人的正确方向是和人类一起工作，做人类不想做的枯燥重复劳动，把创造性留给人类。
Baxter就是这条理念的产物——它有安全传感器，碰到人会立刻停下来。
timeline.card_summary_zh: 罗德尼·布鲁克斯的Rethink Robotics公司发布了巴克斯特（Baxter）双臂协作机器人。
timeline.summary_en: In 2012, Rethink Robotics, founded by renowned roboticist and former MIT AI Lab director Rodney Brooks, released Baxter, a dual-armed collaborative robot designed to work safely alongside human workers rather than replace them. Embodying Brooks’ philosophy that robots should handle dull, repetitive tasks while leaving creativity to humans, Baxter could be programmed simply by guiding its arms to make it memorize and repeat movements, stopping instantly upon contact thanks to built-in safety sensors. This cooperative design represented a robotics paradigm entirely different from the traditional industry drive to replace human labor with automation.
timeline.card_summary_en: Rodney Brooks' Rethink Robotics shipped Baxter, a two-armed cobot built to work beside people instead of replacing them.
timeline.why_it_matters_en: Baxter represented the IA route, intelligence amplification, applied to robots: not building a machine stronger than you to replace you, but building one that takes your direction and helps you. It failed commercially, with Rethink Robotics closing in 2018, but the collaborative robot idea was carried forward by later companies and lives on today.
timeline.behind_scenes_en: Brooks is the former director of the MIT AI Lab and a celebrated roboticist. He openly opposed building robots as automation machines that replace human workers, arguing the right direction was machines working alongside people, doing the dull repetitive labor humans do not want while creativity stays human. Baxter embodied that philosophy: fitted with safety sensors, it stopped instantly whenever it touched a person.

timeline.title_zh: Google Brain 猫神经元:大规模无监督学习首次成功
timeline.title_en: Google Brain Cat Neuron: First Large-Scale Unsupervised Learning Success
timeline.summary_zh:
2012 年 6 月 26 日,Quoc Le、Marc'Aurelio Ranzato、Rajat Monga、Matthieu Devin、Kai Chen、Greg Corrado、Jeff Dean、Andrew Ng 在 ICML 2012 发表论文《Building High-level Features Using Large Scale Unsupervised Learning》。
团队用 1000 台服务器 + 16,000 个 CPU 核心训练 9 层稀疏自编码器,在 1000 万张 YouTube 视频帧上做无监督学习,网络自发形成“猫脸神经元”,人脸识别准确率 81.7%,猫脸识别准确率 74.8%。
2012 年 6 月 26 日 NYT 头版报道,Google Brain 项目正式公开。
timeline.source_name: Le, Q. et al. (2012) ICML 2012; NYT report (2012-06-26)
timeline.card_summary_zh: Google Brain 从海量视频中自行学出“猫”的概念，大规模无监督学习第一次以直观结果进入公众视野。
timeline.summary_en: On June 26, 2012, Quoc Le, Marc'Aurelio Ranzato, Rajat Monga, Matthieu Devin, Kai Chen, Greg Corrado, Jeff Dean, and Andrew Ng published the paper "Building High-level Features Using Large Scale Unsupervised Learning" at ICML 2012. That same day, a June 26, 2012 front-page NYT report officially made the Google Brain project public. Training a 9-layer sparse autoencoder on 1,000 servers and 16,000 CPU cores using unsupervised learning on 10 million YouTube video frames, the team watched the network spontaneously form a "cat face neuron" while achieving a human face recognition accuracy of 81.7% and a cat face recognition accuracy of 74.8%.
timeline.card_summary_en: Google Brain learned the concept of cat from millions of video frames without labels, giving large-scale unsupervised learning its first vivid public proof.
timeline.why_it_matters_en: The Google Brain cat neuron was early proof that large-scale unsupervised learning works. Self-supervised learning, emergence capabilities, and scaling laws as discussed in LLM circles today all have early versions in the 2012 experiment. Following the line from Google Brain 2012 through TensorFlow in 2014-2016, TPU in 2016, Transformer in 2017, and Gemini in 2024 shows why Google can stand up to Microsoft and OpenAI in the LLM era: its compute, frameworks, algorithms, and data accumulation from 2012 to 2020 were all already in place.
timeline.behind_scenes_en: Google Brain started in 2011 with Andrew Ng, Jeff Dean, and Greg Corrado, aiming to train deep networks on Google-scale compute. Ng persuaded Larry Page in 2011 to commit a thousand servers to the experiment; Page agreed but demanded Ng prove it could work. Le and colleagues trained on CPU clusters across 2011-2012 rather than GPUs because Google's internal GPU infrastructure was still immature in 2011. After the cat neuron experiment succeeded in 2012, Google Brain pivoted to GPU plus TPU, developed TensorFlow between 2014 and 2016, and released TPU v1 in 2016. Ng left Google Brain in 2014 to found Coursera and Deeplearning.ai; Jeff Dean took over Google Brain, which merged with DeepMind in 2023, with Dean becoming Chief Scientist of Google DeepMind in 2024.

timeline.title_zh: AlexNet 在 NIPS 2012 引爆:深度学习时代起点
timeline.title_en: AlexNet at NIPS 2012: Deep Learning Era Begins
timeline.summary_zh:
2012 年 12 月,Alex Krizhevsky、Ilya Sutskever、Geoffrey Hinton 在 NIPS 2012 论文集发表论文《ImageNet Classification with Deep Convolutional Neural Networks》(ILSVRC 2012 结果于 10 月公布,top-5 错误率 15.3% vs 第二名 26.2%)。
AlexNet 在 ImageNet ILSVRC 2012 把 top-5 错误率从 26.2%(传统 CV)降到 15.3%,领先第二名 10.8 个百分点。
AlexNet 用 8 层 CNN(5 卷积 + 3 全连接)、650K 神经元、60M 参数、630M 连接,在 2 块 NVIDIA GTX 580 GPU 上训练 5-6 天。
关键创新:ReLU 激活、Dropout 正则化、数据增强、GPU 并行训练。
timeline.source_name: Krizhevsky, A., Sutskever, I., Hinton, G. (2012) NIPS; ILSVRC 2012 results
missing_terms: ImageNet 大规模视觉识别挑战赛
timeline.card_summary_zh: 关键创新:ReLU 激活、Dropout 正则化、数据增强、GPU 并行训练；AlexNet 是深度学习时代的起点。
timeline.summary_en: In December 2012, Alex Krizhevsky, Ilya Sutskever, and Geoffrey Hinton published "ImageNet Classification with Deep Convolutional Neural Networks" in the NIPS 2012 proceedings, detailing how AlexNet dominated ILSVRC 2012 (results announced in October) by slashing the top-5 error rate from 26.2% (traditional CV) to 15.3%, leading the second-place entry by 10.8 percentage points. This 8-layer CNN—consisting of 5 convolutional and 3 fully connected layers, 650K neurons, 60M parameters, and 630M connections—was trained on 2 NVIDIA GTX 580 GPUs for 5-6 days. Its landmark success relied on key innovations: ReLU activation, Dropout regularization, data augmentation, and GPU parallel training.
timeline.card_summary_en: AlexNet detonated at NIPS 2012 on the strength of ReLU activations, Dropout regularization, data augmentation, and parallel GPU training, opening the deep learning era.
timeline.why_it_matters_en: AlexNet was the starting point of the deep learning era. Everything after 2012, VGG, GoogLeNet, ResNet, Transformer, BERT, GPT, Stable Diffusion, AlphaFold, builds on the paradigm AlexNet fixed: CNN or Transformer plus GPU plus big data plus ReLU and Dropout. Following the line from AlexNet in 2012 through GAN in 2014, ResNet in 2015, Transformer in 2017, BERT in 2018, GPT-3 in 2020, and ChatGPT in 2022 makes clear that deep learning did not erupt from nowhere; it was the engineering result of three conditions maturing together: Hinton's 2006 DBN, GPUs in 2009, and ImageNet in 2009.
timeline.behind_scenes_en: AlexNet was the engineering payoff of Hinton's Toronto team's 2006 DBN paper. Krizhevsky began training CNNs on GPUs in 2010, drawing on the Raina-Ng 2009 paper, and by 2012 the three ingredients lined up: a mature ImageNet dataset, GTX 580 GPU horsepower, and the ReLU and Dropout tricks. When the team submitted to ILSVRC 2012 they expected flak for CNN's rebellion against mainstream computer vision; instead the gap of top-5 error at 15.3% versus 26.2% for second place was so large that the entire vision community converted within six months. Sutskever joined Google Brain in 2014, co-founded OpenAI in 2015, and co-founded Safe Superintelligence Inc. in 2024. Krizhevsky joined Google in 2015 and left the AI field in 2017; AlexNet is his only blockbuster paper.

timeline.title_zh: 谷歌大规模收购AI与机器人公司——帝国的构建
timeline.title_en: Google's Massive AI and Robotics Acquisitions
timeline.summary_zh:
2013年，在安卓之父安迪·鲁宾的主导下，谷歌秘密收购了八家顶尖机器人公司——包括波士顿动力（大狗机器人）、日本Schaft、Industrial Perception等。
这是AI史上最大规模的集中机器人收购——谷歌试图在下一波AI和机器人浪潮中建立统治地位。（注：Google 收购 DeepMind 是 2014 年 1 月，见 #16，不属本条。）
timeline.card_summary_zh: 这是AI史上最大规模的集中机器人收购——谷歌试图在下一波AI和机器人浪潮中建立统治地位。
timeline.summary_en: In 2013, spearheaded by the "father of Android" Andy Rubin, Google secretly acquired eight leading robotics companies—including Boston Dynamics (maker of the BigDog robot), Japan's Schaft, and Industrial Perception. This marked the largest concentrated robotics acquisition in AI history, representing Google's bid to establish dominance in the next wave of AI and robotics. (Note: Google's acquisition of DeepMind occurred in January 2014, see #16, and is not covered in this entry.)
timeline.card_summary_en: Google ran the largest concentrated shopping spree for AI and robotics companies in history, trying to lock down dominance in the coming wave.
timeline.why_it_matters_en: The 2013 acquisition wave changed the global AI landscape. DeepMind gave Google a multi-year lead in deep learning. Boston Dynamics' purchase and later sale mirrored how hard industrial robotics found commercialization. The giants vacuumed up academic AI talent wholesale, turning AI from an academic field into an arms race between corporations.
timeline.behind_scenes_en: Andy Rubin's plan was to consolidate these companies into a mobile-robotics empire spanning factory logistics, home service, and military use. But Rubin left Google within a year and the plan stalled with him. Boston Dynamics was later sold to SoftBank and then to Hyundai. DeepMind instead became the jewel in Google's AI crown: AlphaGo and AlphaFold were both born there.

timeline.title_zh: Mikolov word2vec:词向量与分布式表示普及
timeline.title_en: Mikolov word2vec: Word Embeddings Popularized
timeline.summary_zh:
2013 年 1 月 16 日,Tomas Mikolov、Kai Chen、Greg Corrado、Jeff Dean 在 arXiv 发表论文《Efficient Estimation of Word Representations in Vector Space》,后发表于 ICLR 2013。
word2vec 用 100 维向量表示词,在 1000 亿词 Google News 语料上训练,CBOW 和 Skip-gram 两种模型 + Hierarchical Softmax + Negative Sampling 两种训练技巧,训练时间从 RNNLM 的几周降到几小时。
word2vec 的“king - man + woman = queen”类比实验,让“分布式表示 + 向量算术”成为 NLP 标准工具,为 2018 BERT、2020 GPT-3、2022 ChatGPT 的词嵌入层铺路。
timeline.source_name: Mikolov, T. et al. (2013) ICLR 2013; arXiv:1301.3781
timeline.card_summary_zh: word2vec 把词语映射成可计算的向量，“国王减男人加女人约等于女王”让语义关系第一次直观可见。
timeline.summary_en: On January 16, 2013, Tomas Mikolov, Kai Chen, Greg Corrado, and Jeff Dean published the paper "Efficient Estimation of Word Representations in Vector Space" on arXiv, which was later published at ICLR 2013. Representing words as 100-dimensional vectors trained on a 100-billion-word Google News corpus, word2vec combined two models (CBOW and Skip-gram) with two training techniques (Hierarchical Softmax and Negative Sampling) to slash training times from RNNLM's weeks to just hours. The model's famous "king - man + woman = queen" analogy experiment established "distributed representations + vector arithmetic" as standard NLP tools, paving the way for the word embedding layers of 2018 BERT, 2020 GPT-3, and 2022 ChatGPT.
timeline.card_summary_en: Tomas Mikolov's word2vec mapped words into computable vectors, and king minus man plus woman approximating queen made semantic relations visible for the first time.
timeline.why_it_matters_en: word2vec was the early engineering realization of distributed representation plus large-corpus pretraining. Word embeddings, contextual representations, and pretraining as discussed around LLMs today all have early versions in 2013's word2vec. Tracing word2vec to GloVe, ELMo, BERT, and GPT shows why pretraining representations on massive corpora became NLP's central paradigm, and why contextual representations after BERT in 2018 proved more powerful than word2vec's static vectors.
timeline.behind_scenes_en: Mikolov developed RNNLM while a doctoral student at Brno University starting in 2010, training language models with recurrent networks, and kept refining the work after joining Google in 2011. word2vec's core insight was that shallow models plus big data could beat deep models plus small data, diverging from Hinton's camp's mainstream deep-network route. Mikolov left Google for Facebook FAIR in 2014, returned to the Czech Technical University in Prague in 2017, and joined CIIRC in 2020. After word2vec came Pennington's GloVe from Stanford in 2014, Bojanowski's fastText at Facebook in 2014, ELMo in 2018, BERT in 2018, and GPT-2 in 2019, extending the vector route into contextual representations, yet word2vec remains NLP's teaching staple and engineering baseline.

timeline.title_zh: NVIDIA 全面转向深度学习:Huang 的 10 年战略
timeline.title_en: NVIDIA Pivots to Deep Learning: Huang's 10-Year Strategy
timeline.summary_zh:
2013 年 3 月 19 日,NVIDIA CEO Jensen Huang 在 GPU Technology Conference (GTC) 2013 首次公开把 NVIDIA 定位为“AI 计算公司”,而非“游戏显卡公司”。
2013-2016 年 Huang 主导 NVIDIA 三件事:(1) 把 CUDA 生态深度绑定深度学习框架;(2) 2014 年 cuDNN 1.0 + 2015 年 TensorRT 推出;(3) 2016 年 DGX-1 + 2016 年 Tegra Parker 面向自动驾驶。
2017 年 NVIDIA 数据中心营收 19 亿美元,2023 年 475 亿美元,2024 年 1150 亿美元,Huang 2013 年的“AI 计算公司”定位彻底兑现。
timeline.source_name: NVIDIA GTC 2013 keynote (2013-03-19); NVIDIA annual reports 2013-2024
timeline.card_summary_zh: NVIDIA 全面转向深度学习：Huang 的 10 年战略；Huang 2013 年的转型决策是 NVIDIA 在 LLM 时代垄断算力的源头。
timeline.summary_en: On March 19, 2013, at the GPU Technology Conference (GTC) 2013, NVIDIA CEO Jensen Huang first publicly positioned the firm as an "AI computing company" rather than a "gaming graphics card company." Between 2013 and 2016, Huang steered NVIDIA through three key initiatives: deeply binding the CUDA ecosystem with deep learning frameworks; launching cuDNN 1.0 in 2014 and TensorRT in 2015; and debuting the DGX-1 and Tegra Parker for autonomous driving in 2016. That pivot was fully realized as NVIDIA’s data center revenue surged from $1.9 billion in 2017 to $47.5 billion in 2023, and $115 billion in 2024, completely delivering on Huang’s 2013 vision.
timeline.card_summary_en: Jensen Huang committed NVIDIA fully to deep learning, the strategic pivot that became the source of its LLM-era compute monopoly.
timeline.why_it_matters_en: Huang's 2013 decision is the origin of NVIDIA's dominance over LLM-era compute. The compute chokepoints, NVIDIA monopoly, and CUDA ecosystem moat discussed across the industry today were all seeded in this strategic turn. Tracing the line from the 2013 pivot through cuDNN in 2016, V100 in 2017, A100 in 2020, H100 in 2022, and B200 in 2024 shows why compute competition in the LLM era is fundamentally NVIDIA versus Google TPU versus AMD MI300 versus domestic Chinese accelerators.
timeline.behind_scenes_en: Huang founded NVIDIA in 1993; CUDA in 2006 was his first ten-year strategy, and the AI pivot in 2013 was his second. Seeing AlexNet 2012 plus Google Brain 2012, he judged deep learning plus GPU to be a hundred-billion-dollar opportunity and moved NVIDIA's resources decisively from gaming graphics into AI compute. cuDNN 1.0 in 2014, TensorFlow in 2015, and PyTorch in 2016 locked the CUDA ecosystem into deep learning. NVIDIA invested in autonomous driving in 2016 through Project Highway 61 plus Tesla P100 deals, in data centers in 2017 with V100 and DGX-1, in inference in 2018 with T4 and Jetson AGX, and in LLMs from 2020 with A100 and H100. By 2024 NVIDIA reached a three-trillion-dollar market cap, with Huang's personal fortune at one hundred billion dollars.

timeline.title_zh: DeepMind DQN:深度强化学习首次成功
timeline.title_en: DeepMind DQN: First Deep Reinforcement Learning Success
timeline.summary_zh:
2013 年 12 月 19 日,DeepMind 团队(Volodymyr Mnih、Koray Kavukcuoglu、David Silver、Alex Graves、Ioannis Antonoglou、Daan Wierstra、Martin Riedmiller)在 NIPS 2013 Deep Learning Workshop 发表论文《Playing Atari with Deep Reinforcement Learning》。
DQN 用 CNN + Q-learning,从原始像素输入学习 49 种 Atari 游戏,其中 29 种超过人类专家水平。
DQN 关键创新:Experience Replay + Target Network,解决 Q-learning 在深度网络上的训练不稳定问题。
2015 年 2 月 Nature 518:529-533 完整版发表,DQN 在 49 种 Atari 游戏中 22 种超人类。
timeline.source_name: Mnih, V. et al. (2013) NIPS Deep Learning Workshop; (2015) Nature 518:529-533
timeline.card_summary_zh: DQN 只看屏幕像素就学会多款 Atari 游戏，深度学习与强化学习第一次形成可扩展的统一方法。
timeline.summary_en: On December 19, 2013, the DeepMind team (Volodymyr Mnih, Koray Kavukcuoglu, David Silver, Alex Graves, Ioannis Antonoglou, Daan Wierstra, Martin Riedmiller) published the paper "Playing Atari with Deep Reinforcement Learning" at the NIPS 2013 Deep Learning Workshop. By using CNN + Q-learning to master 49 Atari games directly from raw pixel inputs, DQN outperformed human experts in 29 of them, utilizing the key innovations of Experience Replay and Target Network to solve the training instability of Q-learning on deep networks. In February 2015, the full version was published in Nature 518:529-533, demonstrating DQN outperforming humans in 22 of the 49 Atari games.
timeline.card_summary_en: DeepMind's DQN learned dozens of Atari games from raw screen pixels alone, fusing deep learning and reinforcement learning into one scalable method for the first time.
timeline.why_it_matters_en: DQN was the starting point of combining deep learning with reinforcement learning. The RLHF, reward models, and policy optimization discussed across LLM circles all trace early versions to DQN in 2013, PPO in 2017, TRPO in 2018, and ILQL in 2020. Following DQN to AlphaGo, AlphaZero, MuZero, and RLHF shows why OpenAI invested deeply in DRL from 2015 to 2019, and why applying RLHF to GPT-3 in 2020 was the monetization of seven years of DRL engineering.
timeline.behind_scenes_en: DeepMind was founded in London in 2010 by Demis Hassabis, Shane Legg, and Mustafa Suleyman, and Google acquired it in January 2014 for $650 million. DQN was DeepMind's key proof before the acquisition: that deep learning plus reinforcement learning could solve general game-playing AI. David Silver's group pushed DRL relentlessly from 2013 to 2019, from DQN's Nature paper in 2015 through AlphaGo in 2016, AlphaGo Zero in 2017, AlphaZero in 2018, and MuZero in 2019, taking the DRL line to its first summit. From 2015 to 2020 after DQN, DeepMind, OpenAI, and academia extended DRL into robotics, autonomous driving, dialogue, recommendation, and vision, but after 2020 the LLM route plus RLHF displaced pure DRL as the mainstream.

timeline.title_zh: 对抗样本风险显现
timeline.title_en: Adversarial Examples Gain Attention
timeline.summary_zh:
2014 年前后，研究显示深度模型会被很小的扰动误导，暴露出脆弱性。
一张图片在人眼看来几乎没变，模型可能突然认错。
这个现象像给深度学习泼了一盆冷水：模型表现很强，也会在奇怪角落里显得非常脆。
能力上升以后，安全、鲁棒性和评测边界开始变成实打实的技术问题。
timeline.source_name: General AI history references
timeline.card_summary_zh: 这个现象像给深度学习泼了一盆冷水：模型表现很强，也会在奇怪角落里显得非常脆；对抗样本让 AI 安全从抽象担忧变成可测试问题。
timeline.summary_en: Around 2014, research revealed that deep models could be misled by tiny perturbations, exposing a vulnerability where an image virtually unchanged to the human eye could suddenly be misclassified. This phenomenon poured cold water on the deep learning hype, proving that even highly capable models could be incredibly fragile in unexpected corners. As AI capabilities grew, safety, robustness, and evaluation boundaries transitioned into pressing, real-world technical challenges.
timeline.card_summary_en: Adversarial examples poured cold water on deep learning: models that scored brilliantly also failed bizarrely, turning AI safety from an abstract worry into a testable problem.
timeline.why_it_matters_en: Adversarial examples turned AI safety from an abstract worry into a testable problem. They remind developers that high accuracy still requires checking whether a model stays reliable under stress and attack.

timeline.title_zh: 商汤科技成立——中国计算机视觉先驱
timeline.title_en: SenseTime Founded
timeline.summary_zh: 2014 年，汤晓鸥教授在香港创立商汤科技（SenseTime）。创始团队来自香港中文大学多媒体实验室。商汤以计算机视觉技术为突破口，在人脸识别、图像分析等领域迅速成长，2018 年成为全球估值最高的 AI 独角兽。
timeline.source_name: 公开资料
timeline.card_summary_zh: 商汤以计算机视觉技术为突破口，在人脸识别、图像分析等领域迅速成长，2018 年成为全球估值最高的 AI 独角兽；商汤是中国 AI 视觉创业浪潮的引领者。
timeline.summary_en: In 2014, Professor Tang Xiao'ou founded SenseTime in Hong Kong, with a founding team hailing from the Multimedia Laboratory at the Chinese University of Hong Kong. Using computer vision as its breakthrough, the company grew rapidly in facial recognition and image analysis, becoming the world's most valuable AI unicorn by 2018.
timeline.card_summary_en: SenseTime was founded on computer vision and grew fast across face recognition and image analysis, becoming the world's most valuable AI unicorn by 2018.
timeline.why_it_matters_en: SenseTime led China's AI vision startup wave. It was not just one company but the template for how China's academic computer vision strength flowed into industry.
timeline.behind_scenes_en: SenseTime's founding team came out of the Multimedia Laboratory at the Chinese University of Hong Kong led by Xiaoou Tang, a lab whose paper output at top computer vision conferences ranked first globally for years running.

timeline.title_zh: Google 6.5 亿美元收购 DeepMind:AI 军备竞赛开始
timeline.title_en: Google Acquires DeepMind for $650M: AI Arms Race Begins
timeline.summary_zh:
2014 年 1 月 26 日,Google 以约 6.5 亿美元收购英国 AI 公司 DeepMind,由 Demis Hassabis、Shane Legg、Mustafa Suleyman 2010 年在伦敦创办。
DeepMind 收购时只有 75 人,主要做 DRL(深度强化学习),没有商业化产品,但 Google 看重其“通用 AI”研究能力。
DeepMind 收购后保持独立运营,2014-2024 年取得多项突破:DQN(2015)、AlphaGo(2016)、AlphaZero(2018)、MuZero(2019)、AlphaFold(2020/2021)、Gemini(2023)、AlphaProof(2024)。
timeline.source_name: Google acquisition of DeepMind (2014-01-26); DeepMind 2010 founding
timeline.card_summary_zh: Google 6.5 亿美元收购 DeepMind：AI 军备竞赛开始；Google 收购 DeepMind 是 AI 大厂军备竞赛的起点。
timeline.summary_en: On January 26, 2014, Google acquired DeepMind, a British AI company founded in London in 2010 by Demis Hassabis, Shane Legg, and Mustafa Suleyman, for about $650 million. At the time of the acquisition, DeepMind had just 75 employees, no commercial products, and focused primarily on DRL (deep reinforcement learning), but Google valued its "general AI" research capabilities. Operating independently post-acquisition, DeepMind achieved a string of breakthroughs from 2014 to 2024: DQN (2015), AlphaGo (2016), AlphaZero (2018), MuZero (2019), AlphaFold (2020/2021), Gemini (2023), and AlphaProof (2024).
timeline.card_summary_en: Google paid $650 million for DeepMind, opening the big-tech arms race for AI talent and technology.
timeline.why_it_matters_en: The DeepMind acquisition started the AI arms race among tech giants. It opened the wave of Microsoft's $13 billion into OpenAI, Amazon's $8 billion into Anthropic, Google's $3 billion into Anthropic, and Meta's roughly $10 billion LLaMA compute investment. Following the line from DeepMind in 2014 through Microsoft's $1 billion OpenAI deal in 2019 to its $10 billion follow-on in 2023 shows both why LLM-era investments dwarf 2014's scale and why Big Tech monopolizing AI became a regulatory focus by 2024.
timeline.behind_scenes_en: Before the acquisition, Facebook had also tried to buy DeepMind and was refused by Hassabis. He chose Google for three reasons: Google promised DeepMind independent operations with no military applications; Google provided compute including TPUs plus data; and Google established the DeepMind Ethics Board, later renamed DeepMind Ethics & Society. After the acquisition Google invested roughly twenty billion dollars keeping DeepMind running between 2014 and 2023; DeepMind lost two billion dollars in 2023 yet kept its independence. In April 2023 Google merged Google Brain with DeepMind to form Google DeepMind, with Demis Hassabis as CEO and Jeff Dean as Chief Scientist.

timeline.title_zh: Goodfellow GAN:生成式 AI 的早期突破
timeline.title_en: Goodfellow GAN: Early Generative AI Breakthrough
timeline.summary_zh:
2014 年 6 月 10 日,Ian Goodfellow 等人在 NIPS 2014 发表论文《Generative Adversarial Nets》。
GAN 用 Generator + Discriminator 对抗训练,Generator 从噪声生成图像,Discriminator 判断图像真伪,两者博弈达到 Nash 均衡时 Generator 能生成逼真图像。
GAN 在 MNIST、TFD、CIFAR-10 上生成质量超过 VAE 和 Boltzmann Machine,为后续 2015 DCGAN、2017 CycleGAN、2018 StyleGAN、2019 BigGAN、2021 StyleGAN-ADA、2024 GAN+Diffusion 混合路线铺路。
timeline.source_name: Goodfellow, I. et al. (2014) NIPS 2014; arXiv:1406.2661
timeline.card_summary_zh: Goodfellow GAN：生成式 AI 的早期突破；GAN 是“生成式 AI”的早期突破。
timeline.summary_en: On June 10, 2014, Ian Goodfellow et al. published the paper "Generative Adversarial Nets" at NIPS 2014, introducing an adversarial framework where a Generator creates images from noise and a Discriminator judges their authenticity, pitting the two in a game to reach a Nash equilibrium where the Generator can produce realistic images. Having outperformed VAE and Boltzmann Machine in generation quality on MNIST, TFD, and CIFAR-10, GAN paved the way for subsequent developments: 2015 DCGAN, 2017 CycleGAN, 2018 StyleGAN, 2019 BigGAN, 2021 StyleGAN-ADA, and the 2024 GAN+Diffusion hybrid approach.
timeline.card_summary_en: Ian Goodfellow invented GANs overnight, pitting two networks against each other and scoring generative AI's early breakthrough.
timeline.why_it_matters_en: GAN was the early breakthrough of generative AI. The generative models, adversarial training, RLHF, and AI-content detection discussed around LLMs today all have early versions in the 2014 GAN. Following GAN through StyleGAN, Diffusion, DALL-E 2, Stable Diffusion, and Midjourney v6 explains why image generation shifted from GANs to diffusion after Stable Diffusion arrived in 2022, and why GAN's adversarial-training idea still shapes LLM alignment routes.
timeline.behind_scenes_en: The inspiration came from a Montreal bar in 2014, where Goodfellow and friends debated whether neural networks could generate images. He went home, wrote the first GAN implementation in a few hours, got it working on MNIST, and told his advisor Bengio the next day; Bengio told him to write it up immediately. The GAN paper accumulated more than fifty thousand citations between 2014 and 2020, yet training instability, mode collapse and convergence trouble, troubled academia for eight years until StyleGAN-ADA stabilized GAN training in 2020. GANs ruled image generation from 2017 to 2022 before diffusion models like Stable Diffusion took over. For the LLM world, GAN's legacy is the adversarial-training concept itself: the reward model in RLHF is essentially GAN's discriminator idea.

timeline.title_zh: GoogLeNet 夺冠 ImageNet:企业算力碾压学术界的信号
timeline.title_en: GoogLeNet Wins ImageNet: Corporate Compute Dominance
timeline.summary_zh: 谷歌 GoogLeNet 以 6.67% 错误率夺得 ImageNet 冠军，人类水平约 5.1%，差距只剩 1.5 个百分点。
timeline.card_summary_zh: 谷歌 GoogLeNet 以 6.67% 错误率夺得 ImageNet 冠军，人类水平约 5.1%；GoogLeNet 是「企业 GPU 军备碾压学术界」的第一个信号。
timeline.summary_en: Google’s GoogLeNet won the ImageNet championship with a 6.67% error rate. With the human level at about 5.1%, the gap has shrunk to just 1.5 percentage points.
timeline.card_summary_en: Google's GoogLeNet won ImageNet at 6.67% error against human-level 5.1%, the first clear signal of corporate GPU firepower crushing academic labs.
timeline.why_it_matters_en: GoogLeNet was the first signal of corporate GPU arsenals overpowering academia. Universities could no longer compete on compute.
timeline.behind_scenes_en: Google entering the contest for the first time marked big companies' full commitment to AI. University labs began to panic: Google burned eight hundred GPUs on a single experiment while Stanford had barely a dozen.

timeline.title_zh: Sutskever Seq2Seq:端到端机器翻译范式确立
timeline.title_en: Sutskever Seq2Seq: End-to-End Translation Paradigm Established
timeline.summary_zh:
2014 年 9 月 10 日,Ilya Sutskever、Oriol Vinyals、Quoc Le 在 NeurIPS 2014 发表论文《Sequence to Sequence Learning with Neural Networks》。
Seq2Seq 用 2 个 LSTM(Encoder + Decoder)做端到端机器翻译,在 WMT-14 英法翻译上 BLEU 34.8,超过传统统计机器翻译 33.3(SMT)。
Seq2Seq 关键创新:(1) 端到端训练;(2) Encoder 把输入序列编码为固定长度向量;(3) Decoder 从该向量生成输出序列;(4) 输入序列逆序 + 4 层 LSTM + beam search。
timeline.source_name: Sutskever, I., Vinyals, O., Le, Q. (2014) NeurIPS 2014; WMT-14 results
timeline.card_summary_zh: Seq2Seq 用编码器和解码器把完整句子直接映射到另一种语言，机器翻译开始摆脱手工流水线。
timeline.summary_en: On September 10, 2014, Ilya Sutskever, Oriol Vinyals, and Quoc Le published the paper "Sequence to Sequence Learning with Neural Networks" at NeurIPS 2014. By using two LSTMs (an Encoder and a Decoder) for end-to-end machine translation, Seq2Seq achieved a BLEU score of 34.8 on WMT-14 English-to-French translation, surpassing the 33.3 of traditional statistical machine translation (SMT). The model's key innovations included: (1) end-to-end training; (2) an Encoder encoding the input sequence into a fixed-length vector; (3) a Decoder generating the output sequence from that vector; and (4) reversing the input sequence, using a 4-layer LSTM, and employing beam search.
timeline.card_summary_en: Its encoder-decoder mapped whole sentences to another language, retiring handmade pipelines.
timeline.why_it_matters_en: Seq2Seq is the source of the end-to-end sequence modeling paradigm. Everything the LLM world discusses today as Encoder-Decoder, generative models, or translation-plus-summarization-plus-dialogue had an early version in the 2014 Seq2Seq. Tracing Seq2Seq, then Attention, then Transformer, then BERT/GPT shows why the 2017 Transformer was NLP's key turning point, and why both 2018 routes, BERT and GPT, were built on top of Seq2Seq plus Attention.
timeline.behind_scenes_en: Seq2Seq came out of Sutskever's work at Google Brain, where he and Hinton's team turned to NLP after AlexNet in 2012. It extended end-to-end learning from image classification to sequence generation, paving the way for Bahdanau et al.'s 2015 Attention, the 2017 Transformer by Vaswani et al., BERT in 2018, and GPT-3 in 2020. Sutskever left Google in 2015 to co-found OpenAI as Chief Scientist, left OpenAI in May 2024, and co-founded SSI, Safe Superintelligence Inc. After Seq2Seq, Google shipped GNMT in 2016, switching Google Translate from SMT to NMT with a major quality jump, the route's first mass-market commercial application.

timeline.title_zh: AI 风险公开信
timeline.title_en: Open Letter on AI Safety
timeline.summary_zh:
2015 年，科技界公开呼吁重视 AI 对社会和安全的潜在影响。
深度学习能力快速上升后，问题开始从“能不能做出来”扩展到“应该怎样使用”。
研究者、企业和公众都需要讨论风险、责任、治理和长期影响。
这封公开信像一次提醒：AI 的发展速度越快，安全和社会边界越需要提前进入议程。
timeline.source_name: Timeline of Artificial Intelligence
timeline.card_summary_zh: 这封公开信像一次提醒：AI 的发展速度越快，安全和社会边界越需要提前进入议程；让 AI 安全从边缘伦理议题进入更主流的公共讨论。
timeline.summary_en: In 2015, the tech community issued a public call to confront the potential impacts of AI on society and safety. As deep learning capabilities skyrocketed, the core question shifted from "can we build it" to "how should we use it," forcing researchers, corporations, and the public to grapple with risk, responsibility, governance, and long-term consequences. This open letter served as a stark reminder: the faster AI advances, the sooner safety and societal guardrails must be put on the agenda.
timeline.card_summary_en: As AI speeds up, the letter argued, safety and social boundaries must reach the agenda early.
timeline.why_it_matters_en: It moved AI safety from a marginal ethics topic into mainstream public discussion, and later work on alignment, governance, and safety policy all connects back to this line.

timeline.title_zh: Redmon YOLO:实时目标检测突破
timeline.title_en: Redmon YOLO: Real-Time Object Detection Breakthrough
timeline.summary_zh:
2015 年 6 月 8 日,Joseph Redmon、Santosh Divvala、Ross Girshick、Ali Farhadi 在 CVPR 2016 发表论文《You Only Look Once: Unified, Real-Time Object Detection》。
YOLO 把目标检测从“两阶段(区域提议 + 分类)”改为“单阶段(直接回归 bbox + class)”,在 PASCAL VOC 2007 上 mAP 63.4,推理速度 45 FPS(YOLO Fast 155 FPS),比 R-CNN(2 FPS)快 22 倍。
YOLO 后续版本:YOLOv2(2017)、YOLOv3(2018)、YOLOv4(2020,Alexey Bochkovskiy 接手)、YOLOv5(2020,Ultralytics)、YOLOv8(2023)、YOLOv9(2024)、YOLOv10(2024,清华大学)。
timeline.source_name: Redmon, J. et al. (2015) CVPR 2016; arXiv:1506.02640
timeline.card_summary_zh: Joseph Redmon、Santosh Divvala、Ross Girshick；YOLO 是“实时目标检测”的工程突破。
timeline.summary_en: On June 8, 2015, Joseph Redmon, Santosh Divvala, Ross Girshick, and Ali Farhadi published the paper "You Only Look Once: Unified, Real-Time Object Detection" at CVPR 2016. YOLO shifted object detection from a "two-stage (region proposal + classification)" process to a "single-stage (direct regression of bbox + class)" pipeline, achieving a 63.4 mAP on PASCAL VOC 2007 at an inference speed of 45 FPS (155 FPS for YOLO Fast)—making it 22 times faster than R-CNN (2 FPS). This breakthrough paved the way for subsequent versions: YOLOv2 (2017), YOLOv3 (2018), YOLOv4 (2020, taken over by Alexey Bochkovskiy), YOLOv5 (2020, Ultralytics), YOLOv8 (2023), YOLOv9 (2024), and YOLOv10 (2024, Tsinghua University).
timeline.card_summary_en: YOLO was an engineering breakthrough for real-time object detection.
timeline.why_it_matters_en: YOLO delivered real-time object detection as engineering fact. Most of the live detection behind today's autonomous driving, security, retail, and robot vision builds on it. Following YOLO through SSD, RetinaNet, and DETR shows why single-stage detection became mainstream after 2015, and why YOLO remained industry's deployment favorite even after DETR brought Transformers to detection in 2020, thanks to engineering stability and speed.
timeline.behind_scenes_en: Redmon was a PhD student at the University of Washington in 2015, supervised by Ali Farhadi. Inspired by Girshick's 2014 R-CNN but judging two-stage pipelines too slow, he switched to single-stage regression and achieved real-time detection on GPU. YOLO saw mass industrial deployment across autonomous driving, security, retail, and medical imaging, the most-used detection model from 2016 to 2024. In February 2020 Redmon announced he was stopping YOLO research in objection to military applications, and the community took over after YOLOv4. Ultralytics maintained YOLOv5, v8, and v11 from 2020 to 2024 as the ecosystem's mainstream implementation.

timeline.title_zh: AlphaGo 胜樊麾:围棋 AI 首次击败职业棋手
timeline.title_en: AlphaGo Beats Fan Hui: Go AI Beats Professional for the First Time
timeline.summary_zh:
2015 年 10 月 9 日,DeepMind AlphaGo 在伦敦闭门比赛中以 5:0 击败欧洲围棋冠军樊麾二段,这是围棋 AI 首次击败职业棋手。
AlphaGo 用 CNN + MCTS(蒙特卡洛树搜索)+ RL(强化学习),训练分两阶段:(1) 监督学习模仿人类专家走子,达到业余强手水平;(2) 自我对弈强化学习,超过人类专家水平。
2016 年 1 月 27 日 Nature 529:484-489 论文正式发表,2016 年 3 月 AlphaGo 在首尔 4:1 击败李世石九段。
timeline.source_name: Silver, D. et al. (2016) Nature 529:484-489; AlphaGo vs Fan Hui (2015-10)
timeline.card_summary_zh: AlphaGo 以五比零击败职业棋手樊麾，围棋这座长期被认为机器难以翻越的高墙第一次出现裂缝。
timeline.summary_en: On October 9, 2015, DeepMind’s AlphaGo defeated European Go champion Fan Hui 2-dan 5-0 in a closed-door London match, marking the first time a Go AI beat a professional player. AlphaGo utilized CNN + MCTS (Monte Carlo Tree Search) + RL (Reinforcement Learning) in a two-stage training process: first, mimicking human expert moves via supervised learning to reach a strong amateur level, and second, using self-play reinforcement learning to surpass human experts. Following the official publication of its paper in Nature 529:484-489 on January 27, 2016, AlphaGo went on to defeat Lee Sedol 9-dan 4-1 in Seoul in March 2016.
timeline.card_summary_en: AlphaGo beat professional Fan Hui five games to zero, cracking Go's long-unchallenged wall.
timeline.why_it_matters_en: AlphaGo was deep learning plus reinforcement learning at its engineering peak on complex decision tasks. It proved DRL could go beyond Atari and defeat Go, long treated as AI's holy grail. Reading AlphaGo through AlphaGo Zero, AlphaZero, and MuZero shows why DeepMind led the DRL route from 2016 to 2020, and why OpenAI's Dota 2 OpenAI Five in 2018-2019 and GPT-3's RLHF in 2020 were the steps extending DRL toward language models.
timeline.behind_scenes_en: AlphaGo was DeepMind's core project of 2014-2016, driven by David Silver, with Hassabis promising Google after the 2014 acquisition that Go AI would be solved within five years. Silver's team trained AlphaGo in 2014-2015 on Google's GPU clusters, the distributed version running 1202 CPUs plus 176 GPUs. Beating Fan Hui settled it internally, and the March 2016 Lee Sedol match became DeepMind's global PR campaign, with Google putting ten million dollars into livestreaming and press. After defeating Lee Sedol, DeepMind beat then-world-number-one Ke Jie nine-dan three-nil at Wuzten in May 2017, released AlphaGo Zero, self-play with no human data, in October 2017, extended AlphaZero to chess and shogi in December 2018, and shipped MuZero, learning without rules, in November 2019.

timeline.title_zh: He ResNet:超深网络训练突破
timeline.title_en: He ResNet: Ultra-Deep Network Training Breakthrough
timeline.summary_zh:
2015 年 12 月 10 日,Kaiming He、Xiangyu Zhang、Shaoqing Ren、Jian Sun 在 CVPR 2016 发表论文《Deep Residual Learning for Image Recognition》。
ResNet 用“残差连接(Skip Connection)”让 152 层 CNN 可训练,在 ImageNet 上 top-5 错误率 3.57%,首次超过人类(5.1%)。
ResNet 关键创新:(1) 残差块 y = F(x) + x,让梯度直接流过 Skip Connection;(2) 152 层 vs VGG 19 层,参数更少但精度更高;(3) BatchNorm + He 初始化让训练稳定。
ResNet 至今仍是视觉 + NLP + 语音 + RL 的标准组件。
timeline.card_summary_zh: 残差连接让上百层神经网络稳定训练，深度不再只是负担，而成为视觉模型继续扩展的通道。
timeline.summary_en: On December 10, 2015, Kaiming He, Xiangyu Zhang, Shaoqing Ren, and Jian Sun published the paper "Deep Residual Learning for Image Recognition" at CVPR 2016. ResNet used "Skip Connections" to make a 152-layer CNN trainable, achieving a 3.57% top-5 error rate on ImageNet and surpassing human performance (5.1%) for the first time. Its key innovations—the $y = F(x) + x$ residual block that lets gradients flow directly through skip connections, a 152-layer architecture vs. VGG's 19 layers that had fewer parameters but higher accuracy, and BatchNorm plus He initialization for stable training—ensure ResNet remains a standard component in vision, NLP, speech, and RL to this day.
timeline.card_summary_en: Residual connections let networks past a hundred layers train stably, depth becoming an ally.
timeline.why_it_matters_en: ResNet broke the training barrier for ultra-deep networks. Today's talk of multilayer Transformers, residual connections, and depth versus width all had early versions in the 2015 ResNet. Tracing ResNet through Transformer, BERT, GPT-3, and GPT-4 shows why Transformers stack to 96 layers as in GPT-3's 175B, why residual connections anchor LLM training stability, and why ultra-deep networks became AI mainstream after 2015.
timeline.behind_scenes_en: He worked at MSRA, Microsoft Research Asia, in 2015, where his team with Zhang, Ren, and Sun attempted ultra-deep CNNs and failed on vanishing and exploding gradients. The insight: if a shallow network can learn f(x), a deeper one can at least learn identity, so let the network learn the residual F(x) = f(x) - x rather than f(x) directly. Skip connections pass gradients straight back, solving training beyond a hundred layers. He spent 2016-2023 across MSRA and Facebook FAIR, joining MIT EECS in 2024. The residual connection was inherited by the 2017 Transformer as the key to stacking layers, and ResNet remains among AI history's most-cited papers at over 200,000 citations.

timeline.title_zh: OpenAI 成立:非营利 AI 研究实验室启动
timeline.title_en: OpenAI Founded: Nonprofit AI Research Lab Launched
timeline.summary_zh:
2015 年 12 月 11 日,OpenAI 在旧金山成立,由 Sam Altman、Elon Musk、Greg Brockman、Ilya Sutskever、Wojciech Zaremba、John Schulman 联合创办。
初始承诺 10 亿美元资金,实际到位约 1.3 亿美元。
OpenAI 宣称目标“构建安全有益的通用人工智能(AGI),为全人类而非单一公司服务”,以非营利形式运营。
2019 年 OpenAI 转型为“有限利润(capped-profit)”公司 OpenAI LP,Microsoft 2019-2023 年累计投资 130 亿美元,OpenAI 从非营利实验室变成 Microsoft 旗下 AI 子公司。
timeline.source_name: OpenAI founding announcement (2015-12-11); OpenAI LP structure (2019-03)
timeline.card_summary_zh: OpenAI 以“让通用人工智能造福全人类”为目标成立，后来成为大模型时代最具影响力的实验室之一。
timeline.summary_en: On December 11, 2015, OpenAI was founded in San Francisco by Sam Altman, Elon Musk, Greg Brockman, Ilya Sutskever, Wojciech Zaremba, and John Schulman as a non-profit dedicated to "building safe and beneficial artificial general intelligence (AGI)" for all humanity rather than a single company. While the organization launched with $1 billion in pledged funding, only about $130 million was actually received. In 2019, OpenAI transitioned into a "capped-profit" company, OpenAI LP, and following a cumulative $13 billion investment from Microsoft between 2019 and 2023, the former non-profit lab effectively became a Microsoft AI subsidiary.
timeline.card_summary_en: OpenAI began aiming to give AGI to all humanity and became the LLM era's defining lab.
timeline.why_it_matters_en: OpenAI is the LLM era's central player: ChatGPT, GPT-4, DALL-E, Whisper, and Sora all come from it. Tracing the 2015 founding through the 2019 OpenAI LP shift, GPT-3 in 2020, ChatGPT in 2022, GPT-4 in 2023, and o1 in 2024 shows how a nonprofit research lab turned into effectively a Microsoft-owned AI subsidiary, and why 2023-2024 brought continuous turmoil, from the Altman firing affair to Musk's lawsuit.
timeline.behind_scenes_en: The direct trigger was Google acquiring DeepMind in 2014. Musk said publicly through 2014 that he feared Google monopolizing AI through DeepMind, and in 2015 talked with Altman and Brockman about building a nonprofit AI lab to counter Google. He sat on OpenAI's board from 2015 to 2018, leaving over disagreements with Altman about whether to commercialize. From 2015 to 2019 OpenAI dug into DRL and game AI including Dota 2's OpenAI Five in 2018; the 2019 GPT-2 paper opened the LLM route; GPT-3 plus exclusive Microsoft licensing in 2020 accelerated commercialization; and ChatGPT in 2022 made it AI's best-known company. After departing, Musk founded xAI with the Grok LLM and sued OpenAI in 2024 for violating its nonprofit promises.

timeline.title_zh: AlphaGo 4:1 胜李世石:围棋 AI 越过职业九段
timeline.title_en: AlphaGo 4:1 Beats Lee Sedol: Go AI Crosses Pro 9-Dan
timeline.summary_zh:
2016 年 3 月 9-15 日,DeepMind AlphaGo 在首尔四季酒店 5 局比赛中以 4:1 击败韩国职业九段李世石(Lee Sedol),李世石在第 4 局(3 月 13 日)唯一胜局被称为“神之一手”(Move 78)。
AlphaGo 用 MCTS + 深度策略网络 + 深度价值网络,176 个 GPU + 1202 个 CPU,每步搜索 0.2 秒。
Nature 2016 年 1 月 28 日论文《Mastering the game of Go with deep neural networks and tree search》预演结果,3 月正式对弈震惊全球。
timeline.source_name: Silver, D. et al. (2016) Nature 529:484-489; AlphaGo vs Lee Sedol match record
timeline.card_summary_zh: AlphaGo 战胜李世石把 AI 推到全球公众面前，其中第 37 手也让人第一次感到机器可能产生陌生的创造力。
timeline.summary_en: From March 9 to 15, 2016, DeepMind’s AlphaGo defeated Korean professional 9-dan Lee Sedol 4:1 in a five-game match at the Four Seasons Hotel in Seoul, with Lee’s sole victory in Game 4 (March 13) dubbed the "divine move" (Move 78). AlphaGo utilized MCTS, deep policy networks, and deep value networks running on 176 GPUs and 1202 CPUs, searching for 0.2 seconds per move. While the results were previewed in the January 28, 2016 *Nature* paper *Mastering the game of Go with deep neural networks and tree search*, the official March showdown shocked the world.
timeline.card_summary_en: Defeating Lee Sedol put AI before the world, and move 37 hinted at strange machine creativity.
timeline.why_it_matters_en: AlphaGo's 4:1 win over Lee Sedol was AI history's biggest publicity event. It made the claim that deep learning can solve intuitive problems legible to a global audience and directly ignited the post-2016 surge in AI investment. Reading Lee Sedol 2016, AlphaGo Zero 2017, AlphaZero 2017, MuZero 2019, and AlphaFold2 2020 together exposes DeepMind's route: Go was the training ground for RL plus search, and the real targets were science and industry.
timeline.behind_scenes_en: Hassabis and David Silver led the project from 2014, with Aja Huang as principal engineer. Hassabis had promised in 2014 to beat a professional within five years; it took eighteen months. AlphaGo had already beaten European champion Fan Hui 5:0 in October 2015, kept secret until the January 2016 Nature paper. Lee Sedol announced after the match he would never play against AI again and formally retired on November 27, 2019, saying AI is an unbeatable entity. The Korea Baduk Association awarded AlphaGo honorary nine-dan status in April 2016.

timeline.title_zh: Google TPU v1:AI 专用芯片公开
timeline.title_en: Google TPU v1: AI-Specific Chip Public
timeline.summary_zh:
2016 年 5 月 18 日,Google 在 Google I/O 2016 主题演讲公开 TPU(Tensor Processing Unit)。
TPU v1 是 Google 2013 年内部立项、2015 年数据中心部署的 ASIC,专为矩阵乘法优化,8-bit 整数 Systolic Array 架构,28nm 工艺,700MHz,92 TOPS,28W TDP。
TPU 在 AlphaGo 与李世石对弈(2016-03)中担任推理硬件,在 RankBrain 搜索排序中已运行 3 年。
2017 年 4 月 Norman Jouppi 等在 ISCA 2017 发表论文《In-Datacenter Performance Analysis of a Tensor Processing Unit》。
timeline.source_name: Jouppi et al. (2017) ISCA; Google I/O 2016 keynote
timeline.card_summary_zh: Google TPU v1：AI 专用芯片公开；TPU v1 是大厂自研 AI 芯片的起点。
timeline.summary_en: At the Google I/O 2016 keynote on May 18, 2016, Google officially unveiled the Tensor Processing Unit (TPU), a custom ASIC initiated internally in 2013 and deployed in datacenters by 2015. Optimized for matrix multiplication, the TPU v1 leveraged an 8-bit integer Systolic Array architecture, a 28nm process, 700MHz clock speed, 92 TOPS, and a 28W TDP, having already run for 3 years in RankBrain search ranking and served as the inference hardware during AlphaGo's match against Lee Sedol (2016-03). In April 2017, Norman Jouppi et al. published the landmark paper "In-Datacenter Performance Analysis of a Tensor Processing Unit" at ISCA 2017.
timeline.card_summary_en: Google's TPU v1 went public, the starting point of big-tech custom AI silicon.
timeline.why_it_matters_en: TPU v1 opened the era of hyperscaler in-house AI chips, directly pushing NVIDIA's Tensor Core V100 in 2017, Apple's A11 Neural Engine in 2017, Huawei's Ascend 910 in 2018, and Tesla's FSD chip in 2019. Following TPU through Volta Tensor Core and the A11 Neural Engine shows the hardware basis of AI training costs falling about fifty percent a year after 2016.
timeline.behind_scenes_en: Jeff Dean drove the project from 2013, targeting lower inference cost for RankBrain. The original plan used FPGAs, but FPGA clock rates were low and inference latency high, so Google's hardware team turned to ASIC in 2014 and deployed the first TPUs into datacenters in 2015. TPU v1 handled inference only; TPU v2 reached 180 TFLOPS FP16 for training in 2017, v3 hit 420 TFLOPS with liquid cooling in 2018, and the 2021 v4 Pod carried 4096 chips. TPUs let Google train BERT, PaLM, and Gemini internally without relying on NVIDIA GPUs.

timeline.title_zh: Google Magenta 与 AI 艺术开源
timeline.title_en: Google Magenta: AI Art Goes Open Source
timeline.summary_zh:
2016 年 6 月 1 日,Google Brain 团队 Doug Eck、Mike Liang 公开 Magenta 项目,目标是用深度学习生成音乐、绘画、文字。
Magenta 第一篇博文《Welcome to Magenta》发布在 Google Research Blog。
Magenta 后续开源工具包括 NSynth(2017 音色合成)、SketchRNN(2017 草图生成)、MusicVAE(2018 音乐序列)。
Magenta 是 Google 在生成式 AI 艺术方向的第一笔投资,直接催生 2021 年 Imagen、2022 年 MusicLM。
timeline.source_name: Google Magenta launch (2016-06-01); Magenta GitHub
timeline.card_summary_zh: Magenta 第一篇博文《Welcome to Magenta》发布在 Google Research Blog；Magenta 是生成式 AI 艺术的起点。
timeline.summary_en: On June 1, 2016, Doug Eck and Mike Liang of the Google Brain team introduced Project Magenta in a Google Research Blog post titled "Welcome to Magenta," aiming to use deep learning to generate music, drawings, and text. The project subsequently released open-source tools including NSynth (2017 timbre synthesis), SketchRNN (2017 sketch generation), and MusicVAE (2018 music sequences). As Google's first investment in generative AI art, Magenta directly spawned 2021's Imagen and 2022's MusicLM.
timeline.card_summary_en: Its first blog post Welcome to Magenta launched generative AI art as an open project.
timeline.why_it_matters_en: Magenta is the starting point of generative AI art, pushing AI creativity from academic circles into public view and laying six years of cultural groundwork for the 2022 eruptions of Stable Diffusion, Midjourney, and DALL-E 2. Reading Magenta through GAN art, NFT-plus-AI, and Stable Diffusion shows generative AI did not appear from nowhere in 2022.
timeline.behind_scenes_en: Magenta ran inside Google Brain as a parallel project, distinct from the TensorFlow and DeepMind lines. The team stayed small, twenty to thirty people from 2016 to 2020, yet produced large numbers of open models and datasets. Team member Anna Huang joined MIT in 2018 and drove MusicTransformer forward. Its cultural influence exceeded its commercial one: the 2018 Edmond de Belamy painting, generated by the Obvious collective with a GAN, sold at Christie's for 432,500 dollars, indirectly connected to the Magenta-plus-GAN lineage.

timeline.title_zh: DeepMind WaveNet:神经网络生成原始音频波形
timeline.title_en: DeepMind WaveNet: Neural Network Generates Raw Audio Waveform
timeline.summary_zh:
2016 年 9 月 8 日,DeepMind 在 arXiv:1609.03499 发表《WaveNet: A Generative Model for Raw Audio》。
WaveNet 用 Causal Dilated Convolution(因果膨胀卷积,膨胀系数 1,2,4,...,512),把音频波形作为时间序列自回归预测下一采样点。
WaveNet 在 TTS(文本转语音)上达到人类级 MOS 评分(4.21 vs 人类 4.55),在钢琴、语音生成上接近真实。
timeline.source_name: van den Oord, A. et al. (2016) arXiv:1609.03499
timeline.card_summary_zh: WaveNet 直接逐点生成声音波形，机器语音从拼接录音迈向更自然的神经生成时代。
timeline.summary_en: On September 8, 2016, DeepMind published "WaveNet: A Generative Model for Raw Audio" on arXiv:1609.03499. WaveNet utilized causal dilated convolutions (with dilation coefficients of 1, 2, 4, ..., 512) to treat audio waveforms as a time series, autoregressively predicting the next sample point. The model achieved a human-level MOS score of 4.21 in TTS (text-to-speech) versus 4.55 for humans, and came close to reality in piano and speech generation.
timeline.card_summary_en: WaveNet synthesized raw waveforms sample by sample, moving speech toward neural naturalness.
timeline.why_it_matters_en: WaveNet founded the autoregressive-generation paradigm in audio. Setting WaveNet in 2016 for audio beside PixelCNN in 2016 for images, GPT in 2018 for text, DALL-E in 2021 for text-to-image, and Sora in 2024 for video shows generative AI's cross-modal evolution between 2016 and 2024: one autoregressive-plus-probability-distribution paradigm spanning audio, images, text, and video.
timeline.behind_scenes_en: First author was Aaron van den Oord of the DeepMind team. The paper appeared in September 2016, and by 2017 Google Translate's TTS and Google Assistant voices ran on WaveNet. Inference was slow, about one minute of CPU per second of audio, until Parallel WaveNet's student-teacher distillation accelerated it a thousandfold in October 2017. Diffusion routes such as AudioLDM and VALL-E displaced the WaveNet line by 2022-2023, though its causal dilated convolution idea shaped WaveGAN and Jukebox.

timeline.title_zh: Google GNMT:神经机器翻译全面替代 SMT
timeline.title_en: Google GNMT: Neural Machine Translation Replaces SMT
timeline.summary_zh:
2016 年 9 月 27 日,Google 发表论文《Google's Neural Machine Translation System: Bridging the Gap between Human and Machine Translation》(arXiv:1609.08144)。
GNMT 用 8 层 LSTM Encoder-Decoder + Attention,128 个 GPU 训练 6 天,在 Google 翻译中把中英翻译错误率降低 58%,接近人类水平。
GNMT 上线后 Google 翻译一夜之间提升一个版本号,2016 年 11 月 Google 翻译完全切换到 GNMT。
timeline.card_summary_zh: Google GNMT：神经机器翻译全面替代 SMT，并成为这一阶段值得追踪的关键变化。
timeline.summary_en: On September 27, 2016, Google published the paper "Google's Neural Machine Translation System: Bridging the Gap between Human and Machine Translation" (arXiv:1609.08144). Driven by an 8-layer LSTM Encoder-Decoder + Attention and trained on 128 GPUs for 6 days, GNMT reduced Chinese-to-English translation error rates in Google Translate by 58%, approaching human-level performance. Following its launch, Google Translate upgraded by a version number overnight, and by November 2016, Google Translate had completely switched to GNMT.
timeline.card_summary_en: GNMT replaced phrase-based SMT wholesale in production with neural machine translation.
timeline.why_it_matters_en: GNMT was the first large-scale production validation of the Seq2Seq plus Attention paradigm and directly produced the 2017 Transformer. Tracing Sutskever's 2014 Seq2Seq, Bahdanau's 2014 Attention, Google's 2016 GNMT, the 2017 Transformer, BERT in 2018, and GPT-3 in 2020 shows the Transformer was no sudden invention but the product of three years of engineering iteration from 2014 to 2017.
timeline.behind_scenes_en: Google Brain's Mike Schuster, Yonghui Wu, and Thorsten Brants initiated GNMT in early 2016, engineering Seq2Seq plus Attention up to Google production scale handling over a hundred language pairs and more than a billion user requests a day. At launch Google worried internally about inference costs, but TPUs pressed inference down to a third of SMT's cost. Transformers fully replaced GNMT after 2017, with Vaswani's paper in June 2017 and Google Translate switching over that November.

timeline.title_zh: PyTorch 开源:动态图框架进入主流
timeline.title_en: PyTorch Open-Sourced: Dynamic Graph Framework Goes Mainstream
timeline.summary_zh:
2017 年 1 月 18 日,Facebook AI Research(FAIR)发布 PyTorch 0.1,Adam Paszke、Sam Gross、Soumith Chintala 主导开发。
PyTorch 基于 Torch7,核心创新是动态计算图(Define-by-Run),比 TensorFlow 1.x 静态图更易调试,Python 原生语法接近 NumPy。
2017 年 8 月 PyTorch 0.2 分布式训练,2018 年 4 月 0.4 合并 Variable 与 Tensor,2018 年 12 月 1.0 稳定版。
2019 年 PyTorch 在顶级会议论文使用率超过 TensorFlow,2020 年 HuggingFace 全面转向 PyTorch。
timeline.source_name: Paszke, A. et al. (2017) PyTorch 0.1 release; NeurIPS 2019 autodiff workshop
timeline.card_summary_zh: PyTorch 让研究者像写普通 Python 一样构建和调试神经网络，迅速成为 AI 研究最重要的工具之一。
timeline.summary_en: On January 18, 2017, Facebook AI Research (FAIR) released PyTorch 0.1, a Torch7-based framework led by Adam Paszke, Sam Gross, and Soumith Chintala that featured a dynamic computation graph (Define-by-Run) and a NumPy-like Python-native syntax, making it far easier to debug than TensorFlow 1.x's static graphs. PyTorch 0.2 introduced distributed training in August 2017, version 0.4 merged Variable and Tensor in April 2018, and the stable 1.0 version arrived in December 2018. By 2019, PyTorch’s usage rate in top conference papers surpassed TensorFlow’s, and HuggingFace fully pivoted to PyTorch in 2020.
timeline.card_summary_en: PyTorch let researchers build and debug neural nets like plain Python, winning research fast.
timeline.why_it_matters_en: PyTorch decided the tool stack of AI research after 2017. Following open-sourcing in 2017 through HuggingFace Transformers in 2018, PyTorch Lightning in 2019, and PyTorch 2.0 in 2022 explains why nearly all open models of the 2020s LLM era, LLaMA, Mistral, Qwen, DeepSeek, default to PyTorch.
timeline.behind_scenes_en: FAIR director Yann LeCun championed the project in 2016 to replace Lua Torch, developed by Ronan Collobert in 2011. Paszke's team began the rewrite in August 2016, demoed internally that December, and publicly released in January 2017. Academia adopted it fast: PyTorch appeared in thirty percent of NeurIPS 2018 papers, fifty percent in 2019, and over seventy percent by 2020. Google's 2019 TensorFlow 2.0 copied PyTorch's dynamic graphs through the Keras API, but academia had already turned irreversibly toward PyTorch.

timeline.title_zh: Asilomar AI 原则:23 条 AI 伦理基准
timeline.title_en: Asilomar AI Principles: 23 AI Ethics Baselines
timeline.summary_zh:
2017 年 1 月 23 日,Future of Life Institute 在加州 Asilomar 会议中心召集 23 位 AI 专家(Stuart Russell、Demis Hassabis、Yann LeCun、Fei-Fei Li 等),发布《Asilomar AI Principles》23 条原则,涵盖研究问题(5 条)、伦理价值(13 条)、长期问题(5 条)。
原则包括:AI 目标应与人类价值对齐、AI 设计应可审计、AI 应避免军备竞赛等。
截至 2017 年底,1275 名 AI 研究者签署原则。
timeline.source_name: Future of Life Institute (2017) Asilomar AI Principles
timeline.card_summary_zh: Asilomar AI 原则：23 条 AI 伦理基准；Asilomar AI 原则是 AI 治理史第一份跨大厂共识文件。
timeline.summary_en: On January 23, 2017, the Future of Life Institute convened 23 AI experts (including Stuart Russell, Demis Hassabis, Yann LeCun, and Fei-Fei Li) at California's Asilomar Conference Center to release the 23 "Asilomar AI Principles," covering research issues (5), ethical values (13), and longer-term issues (5). These guidelines dictate that AI goals should align with human values, AI designs must be auditable, and an AI arms race should be avoided. By the end of 2017, 1,275 AI researchers had signed onto the principles.
timeline.card_summary_en: Twenty-three Asilomar principles formed AI governance's first cross-industry consensus document.
timeline.why_it_matters_en: They are AI governance history's first consensus document spanning major labs, laying the ethical groundwork for 2020s regulation: the EU AI Act of 2024, China's 2023 generative AI service management measures, and US executive order 14110 of 2023. Reading Asilomar 2017 through the OECD AI Principles of 2019, NIST AI RMF of 2023, and the EU AI Act of 2024 shows 2020s AI regulation was no sudden appearance.
timeline.behind_scenes_en: The name echoes the 1975 Asilomar Conference on Recombinant DNA, organizers Max Tegmark and Jaan Tallinn deliberately borrowing the 1975 bioethics template. The Asilomar AI Principles influenced GDPR in 2018, the OECD AI Principles in 2019, and the first EU AI Act draft in 2021. Yet although OpenAI and DeepMind both signed in 2017, OpenAI's 2020 turn to the limited-commercial OpenAI LP ignited disputes over principles colliding with commerce.

timeline.title_zh: TensorFlow 1.0:Google ML 框架成工业主流
timeline.title_en: TensorFlow 1.0: Google ML Framework Becomes Industry Mainstream
timeline.summary_zh:
2017 年 2 月 15 日,Google 在 TensorFlow Dev Summit 2017 发布 TensorFlow 1.0。
TF 1.0 提供 Python/C++/Java API、分布式训练、TensorBoard 可视化、TF Serving 部署、移动端 TF Lite。
TF 1.0 在工业部署占主导(2017-2020),Pinterest、Airbnb、Snapchat、Uber、Twitter 都用 TF 生产。
但 TF 1.x 静态图 + Session.run 模型在学术界被 PyTorch 蚕食,2019 年 Google 推出 TF 2.0 + Keras 整合转向动态图。
timeline.source_name: Abadi, M. et al. (2016) TensorFlow 1.0; TF Dev Summit 2017
timeline.card_summary_zh: Google 在 TensorFlow Dev Summit 2017 发布 TensorFlow 1.0。
timeline.summary_en: On February 15, 2017, Google launched TensorFlow 1.0 at the TensorFlow Dev Summit 2017, providing Python/C++/Java APIs, distributed training, TensorBoard visualization, TF Serving deployment, and mobile TF Lite. While TF 1.0 dominated industrial deployment from 2017 to 2020—powering production at Pinterest, Airbnb, Snapchat, Uber, and Twitter—its static graph and Session.run model were steadily eroded in academia by PyTorch, prompting Google to transition to dynamic graphs in 2019 by integrating Keras into TF 2.0.
timeline.card_summary_en: Google shipped TensorFlow 1.0 at the 2017 Dev Summit, taking ML frameworks industrial.
timeline.why_it_matters_en: TensorFlow 1.0 started the big-company open-source ML framework era and drove industrial ML adoption through 2016-2019. Reading TF 1.0 in 2017, PyTorch 1.0 in 2018, TF 2.0 in 2019, and JAX in 2020 maps the framework evolution: static graphs, then dynamic graphs, then functional programming with automatic parallelism.
timeline.behind_scenes_en: Google Brain's Jeff Dean and Rajat Monga led TensorFlow, open-sourcing TF 0.5 on November 9, 2015. Its in-house predecessor DistBelief from 2011 never left Google, and TF was essentially DistBelief open-sourced. TF 1.0 became the industrial mainstream in 2017, but PyTorch rose swiftly in academia across 2018-2019, and Google's 2019 TF 2.0, integrating Keras and moving to eager execution, had already lost the researchers. By 2023 Google began replacing TF with JAX internally.

timeline.title_zh: AlphaGo 3:0 战胜柯洁:围棋 AI 退役战
timeline.title_en: AlphaGo 3:0 Beats Ke Jie: Go AI Retirement Match
timeline.summary_zh:
2017 年 5 月 23-27 日,DeepMind AlphaGo Master 在中国乌镇未来围棋峰会上 3:0 击败中国职业九段柯洁。
AlphaGo Master 用 1 个 TPU v2 单机运行,远少于 2016 年李世石版的 176 GPU。
比赛中 AlphaGo 评分约 4800 ELO,柯洁约 3600 ELO。
赛后 DeepMind 宣布 AlphaGo 退役,不再参加围棋比赛,转而研发 AlphaGo Zero 与 AlphaZero。
timeline.source_name: DeepMind (2017) Future of Go Summit Wuzhen; AlphaGo Master matches
timeline.card_summary_zh: AlphaGo 三比零战胜世界第一柯洁后宣布退役，围棋 AI 的胜负悬念就此结束，研究重心转向更通用的问题。
timeline.summary_en: Between May 23 and 27, 2017, DeepMind's AlphaGo Master defeated Chinese professional 9-dan Ke Jie 3-0 at the Future of Go Summit in Wuzhen, China. Running on a single machine with just 1 TPU v2—a massive reduction from the 176 GPUs used in the 2016 Lee Sedol version—AlphaGo boasted an ELO rating of approximately 4800 during the match, compared to Ke Jie's 3600. Following the victory, DeepMind announced AlphaGo's retirement from Go competition, shifting its focus to developing AlphaGo Zero and AlphaZero.
timeline.card_summary_en: Three-nil over Ke Jie closed Go's contest, and AlphaGo retired with questions answered.
timeline.why_it_matters_en: The 3:0 win over Ke Jie was Go AI's closing battle, marking that Go had been fully surpassed by machines. It pushed DeepMind toward scientific applications: AlphaFold in 2018, AlphaFold2 in 2020, AlphaProof in 2024. Reading Lee Sedol 2016, the first professional victory, Master versus Ke Jie 2017, the perfect finish, and AlphaGo Zero 2017, no human knowledge, reveals DeepMind's line: Go was the proving ground, and science problems the commercial goal.
timeline.behind_scenes_en: China Life sponsored the Wuzhen matches, broadcast live by CCTV. Ke Jie wept afterward, calling AlphaGo like the god of Go.
