DeepMind also arranged a team match of AlphaGo against five Chinese professionals and a pair match pairing AlphaGo with two players holding colors between them, AlphaGo winning both. On May 27 Hassabis announced AlphaGo's retirement, with DeepMind turning to AlphaZero for general board games in December 2017 and AlphaFold for proteins in 2018.

timeline.title_zh: Transformer 论文:Attention Is All You Need
timeline.title_en: Transformer Paper: Attention Is All You Need
timeline.summary_zh:
2017 年 6 月 12 日,Ashish Vaswani 等 8 位 Google Brain/Google Research 研究员在 NeurIPS 2017 发表《Attention Is All You Need》(arXiv:1706.03762)。
Transformer 抛弃 RNN/CNN,只用 Self-Attention(Q/K/V 点积注意力) + Positional Encoding + Feed-Forward 层 + 残差连接 + LayerNorm。
原论文在 WMT 2014 英德/英法翻译上达到 SOTA,训练成本是当时最好的 RNN 模型的 1/10。
timeline.source_name: Vaswani, A. et al. (2017) NeurIPS; arXiv:1706.03762
timeline.card_summary_zh: Transformer 用注意力机制取代循环结构，让模型更容易并行扩展，并成为后来大语言模型的共同底座。
timeline.summary_en: On June 12, 2017, Ashish Vaswani and 8 other Google Brain/Google Research researchers published "Attention Is All You Need" (arXiv:1706.03762) at NeurIPS 2017. The Transformer ditched RNN/CNN, relying only on Self-Attention (Q/K/V dot-product attention), Positional Encoding, Feed-Forward layers, residual connections, and LayerNorm. The original paper achieved SOTA on WMT 2014 English-German/English-French translation, at just 1/10 the training cost of the best RNN models at the time.
timeline.card_summary_en: Attention replaced recurrence, letting models scale in parallel and grounding all future LLMs.
timeline.why_it_matters_en: The Transformer is the base architecture of every LLM after 2017. Reading Transformer 2017, GPT 2018 decoder-only, BERT 2018 encoder-only, GPT-3 2020 scaling, ChatGPT 2022 RLHF, GPT-4 2023 multimodal, and Gemini/Claude/Llama 2024-2025 shows that AI history after 2017 is largely the history of scaling the Transformer.
timeline.behind_scenes_en: Eight authors signed the paper: Ashish Vaswani, Noam Shazeer, Niki Parmar, Jakob Uszkoreit, Llion Jones, Aidan N. Gomez, Łukasz Kaiser, Illia Polosukhin, declared equal contributors with randomized name order. The core idea grew from Shazeer and Kaiser's discussions that attention could replace the RNN. First submitted to ICML 2017 and rejected, it was accepted at NeurIPS 2017. Within a year of publication BERT and GPT built on it, followed by T5 in 2019 and ViT in 2020. From 2021 onward the authors left Google one after another to found Adept, Character.AI, Essential AI, Sakana AI, and other companies.

timeline.title_zh: fast.ai 成立:深度学习教育平民化
timeline.title_en: fast.ai Founded: Democratizing Deep Learning Education
timeline.summary_zh:
2017 年 8 月 3 日,Jeremy Howard、Rachel Thomas 创办 fast.ai(非营利,旧金山大学 USF Data Institute)。
fast.ai 推出「Practical Deep Learning for Coders」免费 MOOC,7 周 8 节课用 PyTorch + fastai 库教零基础程序员做图像分类、NLP、推荐、表格学习。
fast.ai 2018-2020 年学员超 50 万,2020 年学员 ULMFiT、AWD-LSTM 影响 HuggingFace、Stability AI。
timeline.source_name: Howard, J. & Thomas, R. (2017) fast.ai launch; Practical Deep Learning MOOC
timeline.card_summary_zh: fast.ai 成立：深度学习教育平民化，并成为这一阶段值得追踪的关键变化。
timeline.summary_en: On August 3, 2017, Jeremy Howard and Rachel Thomas founded fast.ai (a non-profit at the USF Data Institute) and launched "Practical Deep Learning for Coders," a free, 7-week, 8-lesson MOOC using PyTorch and the fastai library to teach zero-background programmers image classification, NLP, recommendation, and tabular learning. Between 2018 and 2020, fast.ai amassed over 500,000 students, and by 2020, its students, ULMFiT, and AWD-LSTM had influenced HuggingFace and Stability AI.
timeline.card_summary_en: fast.ai opened deep learning education to everyone outside the PhD circle.
timeline.why_it_matters_en: fast.ai is where the democratization of deep learning education began, directly fueling the 2018-2022 explosion of deep learning teaching. Reading fast.ai 2017 through the HuggingFace Course 2021, DeepLearning.AI 2022, and Karpathy's Neural Networks: Zero to Hero 2022 traces the shift from PhD-only knowledge to something every engineer keeps at hand.
timeline.behind_scenes_en: Jeremy Howard was Kaggle's former president and chief scientist; Rachel Thomas holds a mathematics doctorate from USF. The site launched in August 2017, the fastai library reached v0.7 in January 2018 and v2 on PyTorch 1.x in August 2020. Students included Sebastian Raschka, Sylvain Gugger of HuggingFace, and Gordon Boldini. Its top-down teaching method, get the code running first and explain theory after, shaped every deep-learning course that followed after 2018.

timeline.title_zh: 阿里巴巴达摩院成立——中国 AI 基础研究重镇
timeline.title_en: Alibaba DAMO Academy Founded
timeline.summary_zh: 2017 年 10 月，阿里巴巴宣布成立达摩院（DAMO Academy），计划三年投入超 1000 亿人民币。达摩院在全球设立实验室，覆盖机器视觉、NLP、自动驾驶、量子计算等方向。这是中国互联网公司最大规模的 AI 基础研究投资。
timeline.source_name: 公开资料
timeline.card_summary_zh: 阿里巴巴宣布成立达摩院（DAMO Academy），计划三年投入超 1000 亿人民币；达摩院的成立标志着中国科技公司从应用创新走向基础研究的转折。
timeline.summary_en: In October 2017, Alibaba announced the establishment of the DAMO Academy, planning to invest over 100 billion RMB over three years. Setting up laboratories globally to cover fields like machine vision, NLP, autonomous driving, and quantum computing, this marked the largest investment in basic AI research by a Chinese internet company.
timeline.card_summary_en: Alibaba announced DAMO Academy, three years and 100 billion yuan, a pivot to fundamental research.
timeline.why_it_matters_en: Its founding marks the turn of Chinese tech companies from applied innovation toward basic research. Its operating model of corporate funding, academic freedom, and global layout offered a new paradigm for Chinese AI research.
timeline.behind_scenes_en: The name comes from the Damo Yuan, the scripture-keeping hall of the Shaolin Temple. The first cohort of scholars brought in included world-class computer vision experts and IEEE Fellows, and DAMO's output later directly produced the Tongyi Qianwen Qwen large-model family.

timeline.title_zh: AlphaGo Zero:从零自学击败旧版 AlphaGo
timeline.title_en: AlphaGo Zero: Self-Play Beats Old AlphaGo from Scratch
timeline.summary_zh:
2017 年 10 月 18 日,DeepMind 在 Nature 550:354-359 发表《Mastering the game of Go without human knowledge》。
AlphaGo Zero 完全不用人类棋谱,只用自我对弈 + RL,从随机落子开始 3 天击败 2016 年胜李世石的 AlphaGo Lee,21 天击败 2017 年 60 连胜 Master 版本,40 天训练达到超越所有人类围棋 AI 的水平。
AlphaGo Zero 用单一残差网络同时输出策略和价值,简化了原 AlphaGo 双网络结构。
timeline.source_name: Silver, D. et al. (2017) Nature 550:354-359; AlphaZero arXiv:1712.01815
timeline.card_summary_zh: AlphaGo Zero 不再学习人类棋谱，只靠自我对弈超越旧版系统，机器第一次展示出摆脱人类经验上限的路径。
timeline.summary_en: On October 18, 2017, DeepMind published "Mastering the game of Go without human knowledge" in Nature 550:354-359. Training solely on self-play and reinforcement learning without human game records, AlphaGo Zero started from random moves to defeat the 2016 Lee Sedol-beating AlphaGo Lee in 3 days, conquer the 60-win 2017 Master version in 21 days, and surpass all human and Go AI levels in 40 days. It simplified the original AlphaGo's dual-network structure by using a single residual network to simultaneously output policy and value.
timeline.card_summary_en: Trained on no human games, Zero beat its ancestor by self-play, escaping the human ceiling.
timeline.why_it_matters_en: AlphaGo Zero started the self-play-plus-RL paradigm. It proved AI needs no human data to reach superhuman level on complex tasks, directly producing MuZero without rules in 2019 and AlphaProof in 2024. Reading AlphaGo Lee 2016 supervised, AlphaGo Zero 2017 pure RL, AlphaZero 2017 general board games, and MuZero 2019 rule-free shows DeepMind's conviction: stripping away human knowledge is the necessary road toward general intelligence.
timeline.behind_scenes_en: David Silver was first author of the AlphaGo Zero paper, stressing in Nature that AI can learn from itself without human data. Training used only four TPUv2s, far less than AlphaGo Lee's 176 GPUs plus 1202 CPUs. On December 5 the same year DeepMind published AlphaZero, arXiv 1712.01815, extending the same algorithm to chess and shogi, defeating Stockfish in four hours and Elmo in two.

timeline.title_zh: NVIDIA V100 Tensor Core:LLM 训练硬件主力
timeline.title_en: NVIDIA V100 Tensor Core: LLM Training Hardware Workhorse
timeline.summary_zh:
2018 年 3 月 27 日,NVIDIA 在 GTC 2018 推出 DGX-1 with V100。
V100 是 Volta 架构 GPU,16nm FFET 工艺,815mm² die,21.1B 晶体管,16GB/32GB HBM2,900 GB/s 显存带宽,640 个 Tensor Core(FP16 100 TFLOPS / FP32 15.7 TFLOPS)。
V100 引入 Tensor Core,用混合精度训练(Mixed Precision Training)把 LLM 训练成本降低 2-3 倍。
DGX-1 V100 8 卡版约 149,000 美元,2018-2020 年是 OpenAI、DeepMind、FAIR 训练主力。
timeline.source_name: NVIDIA Volta whitepaper (2017); NVIDIA DGX-1 V100 (2018)
timeline.card_summary_zh: NVIDIA 在 GTC 2018 推出 DGX-1 with V100；V100 Tensor Core 是 LLM 训练硬件的起点。
timeline.summary_en: On March 27, 2018, NVIDIA introduced the DGX-1 with V100 at GTC 2018, featuring a Volta-architecture GPU with a 16nm FFET process, an 815mm² die, 21.1B transistors, 16GB/32GB HBM2, 900 GB/s memory bandwidth, and 640 Tensor Cores (FP16 100 TFLOPS / FP32 15.7 TFLOPS). The V100 introduced Tensor Cores, leveraging Mixed Precision Training to reduce LLM training costs by 2-3 times. Priced at approximately $149,000 for the 8-card version, the DGX-1 V100 served as the primary training workhorse for OpenAI, DeepMind, and FAIR from 2018 to 2020.
timeline.card_summary_en: NVIDIA's V100 Tensor Cores opened the hardware era of LLM training.
timeline.why_it_matters_en: V100 Tensor Core was the starting point of LLM training hardware. Reading V100 in 2017-2018 through A100 in 2020, H100 in 2022, and B100/200 in 2024 shows the hardware basis of LLM training costs falling about fifty percent a year. The Tensor Core route directly shaped the hardware investment rhythm of OpenAI, Anthropic, and Google's TPU program alike.
timeline.behind_scenes_en: V100 actually debuted at GTC on May 10, 2017, reaching volume shipments as the training mainstay in 2018. NVIDIA engineer Jack Choquette's team designed the Volta-architecture Tensor Core, inspired by Google's TPU v1 of May 2016. The Tensor Core uses 4x4 matrix multiply-add units, completing an FP16 multiply plus FP32 add in a single clock cycle. Every LLM from 2018 to 2020 trained on V100s: GPT-2 at 1.5B, BERT-Large at 340M, T5 at 11B, and part of GPT-3's 175B. A100 on Ampere succeeded it in 2020 and H100 on Hopper in 2022.

timeline.title_zh: GLUE 基准:NLP 任务评测标准化
timeline.title_en: GLUE Benchmark: NLP Evaluation Standardization
timeline.summary_zh:
2018 年 4 月 22 日,纽约大学 Alex Wang、Samuel Bowman 等在 arXiv:1804.07461 发表《GLUE: A Multi-Task Benchmark and Analysis Platform for Testing Natural Language Understanding Systems》。
GLUE 包含 9 个 NLU 任务:CoLA、SST-2、MRPC、STS-B、QQP、MNLI、QNLI、RTE、WNLI,涵盖情感、相似度、蕴含、问答。
GLUE 排行榜 2018-2019 年 BERT、RoBERTa、T5、ALBERT 接力刷新,2020 年 1 月 SuperGLUE 诞生,2021 年 GLUE 饱和(模型超过人类)。
timeline.source_name: Wang, A. et al. (2018) arXiv:1804.07461; GLUE benchmark
timeline.card_summary_zh: GLUE 排行榜 2018-2019 年 BERT、RoBERTa、T5。
timeline.summary_en: On April 22, 2018, New York University’s Alex Wang, Samuel Bowman, and others published "GLUE: A Multi-Task Benchmark and Analysis Platform for Testing Natural Language Understanding Systems" on arXiv:1804.07461. The benchmark comprises 9 NLU tasks—CoLA, SST-2, MRPC, STS-B, QQP, MNLI, QNLI, RTE, and WNLI—covering sentiment, similarity, entailment, and question answering. After the GLUE leaderboard was successively shattered by BERT, RoBERTa, T5, and ALBERT between 2018 and 2019, SuperGLUE was born in January 2020, and GLUE reached saturation in 2021 as models surpassed human performance.
timeline.card_summary_en: GLUE standardized NLP evaluation, and its leaderboard carried BERT, RoBERTa, and T5 in 2018-2019.
timeline.why_it_matters_en: GLUE started the standardization of NLP evaluation and directly spurred pretrained models like BERT, RoBERTa, and T5. Reading GLUE 2018 through SuperGLUE 2019, MMLU 2021, BIG-bench 2022, and HELM 2022 traces NLP evaluation's evolution from a single benchmark to benchmark suites to multi-task meta-benchmarks.
timeline.behind_scenes_en: NYU's Sam Bowman team launched GLUE in 2017 to give NLU tasks an ImageNet-style unified benchmark; first author Alex Wang presented it at an ICLR Workshop in 2018. BERT first approached human level on the leaderboard in October 2018, RoBERTa comprehensively exceeded humans in July 2019, and SuperGLUE launched in January 2020. GLUE's saturation triggered NLP's evaluation crisis, and BIG-bench with 208 tasks took over the GLUE route in 2022.

timeline.title_zh: OpenAI GPT-1:预训练 + 微调范式确立
timeline.title_en: OpenAI GPT-1: Pre-training + Fine-tuning Paradigm Established
timeline.summary_zh:
2018 年 6 月 11 日,OpenAI 在论文《Improving Language Understanding by Generative Pre-Training》发布 GPT-1。
GPT-1 用 12 层 Transformer Decoder(768 维隐藏层,12 头,117M 参数),在 BookCorpus(7000+ 本未出版小说)上无监督预训练,然后在 12 个 NLP 任务上微调。
GPT-1 在 9/12 任务上达到 SOTA,证明“无监督预训练 + 有监督微调”范式可行。
timeline.source_name: Radford, A. et al. (2018) OpenAI blog; GPT-1 paper
timeline.card_summary_zh: GPT-1 证明同一个预训练语言模型可以适配多种任务，后来大模型“先通学、再专用”的路线由此起步。
timeline.summary_en: On June 11, 2018, OpenAI introduced GPT-1 in the paper "Improving Language Understanding by Generative Pre-Training." The model, featuring a 12-layer Transformer decoder (with a 768-dimensional hidden layer, 12 heads, and 117M parameters), underwent unsupervised pre-training on BookCorpus (7000+ unpublished novels) before being fine-tuned on 12 NLP tasks. By achieving SOTA on 9/12 tasks, GPT-1 proved the viability of the "unsupervised pre-training + supervised fine-tuning" paradigm.
timeline.card_summary_en: One pretrained LM adapting to many tasks: GPT-1 started the pretrain-then-finetune road.
timeline.why_it_matters_en: GPT-1 opened the GPT line and laid the foundation of OpenAI's next six years of technology. Reading GPT-1 117M in 2018 through GPT-2 1.5B in 2019, GPT-3 175B in 2020, InstructGPT with RLHF in 2022, ChatGPT, and GPT-4 in 2023 shows OpenAI's bet: Decoder-only plus Scaling Laws as the core wager of the LLM era.
timeline.behind_scenes_en: Alec Radford was first author, and the paper skipped conferences entirely, published straight on OpenAI's website. Its inspirations were predecessors like Howard and Ruder's 2018 ULMFiT, the 2017 Transformer, and ELMo from February 2018; note that GPT-1 landed in June 2018, before BERT in October 2018, so it cannot have taken inspiration from BERT. Radford's team chose the Decoder-only route, standing opposite Google's Encoder-only BERT. GPT-1's 117M parameters were far smaller than BERT-Large's 340M, but GPT-2 scaled to 1.5B in February 2019 and GPT-3 to 175B in May 2020, validating the Decoder-only-plus-scaling route.

timeline.title_zh: 李飞飞国会作证:以人为本 AI 的政策时刻
timeline.title_en: Fei-Fei Li Testifies to Congress: Human-Centered AI
timeline.summary_zh: 李飞飞赴美国国会就「以人为本 AI」作证，母亲病危中坚持出席，提出 AI 发展的动机永远应该是以人为本。
timeline.card_summary_zh: 李飞飞赴美国国会就「以人为本 AI」作证，母亲病危中坚持出席，提出 AI 发展的动机永远应该是以人为本。
timeline.summary_en: Insisting on testifying before the U.S. Congress on "human-centered AI" even while her mother was critically ill, Fei-Fei Li argued that the motivation behind AI development must always be human-centered.
timeline.card_summary_en: Fei-Fei Li testified for human-centered AI while her mother lay critically ill at home.
timeline.why_it_matters_en: The hearing stands as a key moment in AI policy history: a woman scientist standing before Congress, in the middle of personal crisis, defending the humanistic value of AI.
timeline.behind_scenes_en: The night before testifying she was still keeping vigil at her mother's hospital bedside. Her mother said that barely twenty years after coming to America she could see her own daughter testify before Congress, words that became Fei-Fei Li's reason for attending.

timeline.title_zh: 华为昇腾 910 发布——国产 AI 训练芯片里程碑
timeline.title_en: Huawei Ascend 910 AI Chip Released
timeline.summary_zh: 2018 年 10 月，华为在 HUAWEI CONNECT 大会上首次发布昇腾（Ascend）系列 AI 芯片——昇腾 910 训练芯片和昇腾 310 推理芯片。昇腾基于自研达芬奇（Da Vinci）架构，这是中国在 AI 训练芯片领域从零到一的突破。
timeline.source_name: 公开资料
timeline.card_summary_zh: 华为昇腾 910 发布——国产 AI 训练芯片里程碑；昇腾的发布发生在中美科技竞争加剧的背景下。
timeline.summary_en: In October 2018, Huawei unveiled its Ascend series of AI chips at the HUAWEI CONNECT conference, debuting the Ascend 910 training chip and the Ascend 310 inference chip. Built on the self-developed Da Vinci architecture, the launch marked China's zero-to-one breakthrough in the AI training chip field.
timeline.card_summary_en: Huawei's Ascend 910 marked a milestone for domestic AI training chips amid rising tech rivalry.
timeline.why_it_matters_en: The Ascend launch came as US-China tech competition intensified. Once the A100 and H100 were cut off, Ascend became one of the few training chips available for domestic large models. Without Ascend, China's goal of self-sufficient AI training compute would sit much further away.
timeline.behind_scenes_en: Before Ascend, Huawei had already accumulated NPU experience through its Kirin phone SoCs, first integrating an AI processing unit in the 2017 Kirin 970. Ascend extended Huawei's on-chip AI capability from the device edge to cloud-scale training. Meituan's Longmao 2.0 in 2026 runs fifty thousand domestic compute cards with Ascend as the mainstay.

timeline.title_zh: HuggingFace 创立:NLP 开源社区中心
timeline.title_en: HuggingFace Founded: NLP Open Source Community Hub
timeline.summary_zh:
2018 年 10 月 10 日,HuggingFace(2016 年由 Clément Delangue、Julien Chaumond、Thomas Wolf 在纽约创立,最初做面向青少年的聊天机器人 App)发布 pytorch-pretrained-bert 库(后改名 transformers),把 BERT/GPT 等预训练模型整合为统一接口。
2019-04 与 OpenAI GPT-2、Google BERT 整合。
2020 年 Model Hub 上线,2021 年 5 月 4000 万美元 A 轮,2023 年 2.35 亿美元 D 轮估值 45 亿美元,Google、Amazon、NVIDIA、Salesforce、IBM 全部参投。
timeline.source_name: HuggingFace founding (2018-10); transformers library (2018-11)
timeline.card_summary_zh: HuggingFace 创立：NLP 开源社区中心；HuggingFace 是开源 LLM 时代的中心基础设施。
timeline.summary_en: On October 10, 2018, Hugging Face—founded in New York in 2016 by Clément Delangue, Julien Chaumond, and Thomas Wolf as a teenage chatbot app—released the pytorch-pretrained-bert library (later renamed transformers), unifying pre-trained models like BERT and GPT into a single interface. After integrating OpenAI GPT-2 and Google BERT in April 2019, the company launched its Model Hub in 2020. This set the stage for a $40 million Series A in May 2021 and a $235 million Series D in 2023 at a $4.5 billion valuation, with Google, Amazon, NVIDIA, Salesforce, and IBM all participating.
timeline.card_summary_en: HuggingFace became the central infrastructure of the open-source LLM era.
timeline.why_it_matters_en: Reading transformers 2018 through Model Hub 2020, Datasets 2021, Spaces 2022, and the LLaMA/Stable Diffusion/Mistral/Qwen/DeepSeek wave of 2023-2025 explains why the open LLM ecosystem lives on HuggingFace rather than GitHub.
timeline.behind_scenes_en: The three founders moved from France to New York in 2014 and first built chatbots aimed at teenagers; the 2018 pivot came when Thomas Wolf, using BERT for a chatbot, found the NLP tool chain scattered. In November 2018 Wolf consolidated BERT, GPT, GPT-2, Transformer-XL, and XLNet into the transformers library, adding dual PyTorch and TensorFlow backend support by April 2019. Once Model Hub launched in 2020, open models like LLaMA, Stable Diffusion, and Whisper defaulted to releasing on HuggingFace from 2021. By 2023 it hosted 500,000 models, 50,000 datasets, and 50,000 demos.

timeline.title_zh: Google BERT:双向预训练 NLP 范式确立
timeline.title_en: Google BERT: Bidirectional Pre-training NLP Paradigm Established
timeline.summary_zh:
2018 年 10 月 11 日,Google AI 在 arXiv:1810.04805 发表《BERT: Pre-training of Deep Bidirectional Transformers for Language Understanding》。
BERT 用 24 层 Transformer Encoder(340M 参数),在 BookCorpus + English Wikipedia(3.3B 词)上用 Masked Language Model(MLM) + Next Sentence Prediction(NSP)预训练。
BERT 在 11 个 NLP 任务上刷新 SOTA,包括 GLUE(7.7% 提升)、SQuAD v1.1(1.5% F1)、SQuAD v2.0(4.6% F1)。
timeline.source_name: Devlin, J. et al. (2018) arXiv:1810.04805; NAACL 2019
timeline.card_summary_zh: BERT 同时读取词语左右两侧的上下文，一举刷新多项语言任务，并迅速成为 NLP 的标准底座。
timeline.summary_en: On October 11, 2018, Google AI published "BERT: Pre-training of Deep Bidirectional Transformers for Language Understanding" on arXiv:1810.04805. The model, featuring a 24-layer Transformer Encoder with 340M parameters, was pre-trained on BookCorpus and English Wikipedia (3.3B words) using Masked Language Model (MLM) and Next Sentence Prediction (NSP). BERT went on to set new state-of-the-art benchmarks across 11 NLP tasks, including GLUE (7.7% improvement), SQuAD v1.1 (1.5% F1), and SQuAD v2.0 (4.6% F1).
timeline.card_summary_en: Bidirectional context lifted BERT past task after task, making it NLP's default foundation.
timeline.why_it_matters_en: BERT was the standard NLP paradigm of 2018-2020. Reading BERT 2018 through RoBERTa 2019, T5's encoder-decoder in 2019, GPT-3's decoder-only in 2020, and ChatGPT's decoder-only-plus-RLHF in 2022 maps the paradigm shift: BERT mainstream in 2018, GPT-3 overtaking by 2020, ChatGPT winning outright by 2022. BERT still carries heavy deployment in industrial NLU for search, recommendation, and customer service.
timeline.behind_scenes_en: First author Jacob Devlin led the Google AI Language team. His October 2018 paper stood opposite OpenAI's GPT-1 from June 2018: GPT autoregressive and Decoder-only, BERT bidirectional MLM and Encoder-only. The paper drew over a hundred citations within twenty-four hours, and Google Search shipped BERT on October 25, 2019, affecting roughly ten percent of English search queries. Through 2019 Facebook's RoBERTa, Google's ALBERT, HuggingFace's DistilBERT, and Stanford's ELECTRA all built on BERT, before the GPT route of Decoder-only plus scaling gradually displaced it after 2020.

timeline.title_zh: AlphaFold 1:CASP13 蛋白质结构预测初突破
timeline.title_en: AlphaFold 1: CASP13 Protein Structure Prediction Breakthrough
timeline.summary_zh:
2018 年 12 月 3-7 日,CASP13(第 13 届 Critical Assessment of Protein Structure Prediction)会议在墨西哥 Cancun 举办,DeepMind AlphaFold 1 在 13 届比赛中第一次达到“实验级精度”。
AlphaFold 1 用 Deep Learning 预测蛋白质距离矩阵 + 梯度下降优化 3D 结构。
CASP13 中 AlphaFold 在 GDT_TS 评分中位 60,远超第二名 40。
timeline.source_name: Senior, A. et al. (2019) Nature 577:706-710; CASP13 results
timeline.card_summary_zh: AlphaFold 1 用 Deep Learning 预测蛋白质距离矩阵 + 梯度下降优化 3D 结构。
timeline.summary_en: At the CASP13 (13th Critical Assessment of Protein Structure Prediction) conference in Cancun, Mexico, from December 3–7, 2018, DeepMind’s AlphaFold 1 reached "experimental accuracy" for the first time in the 13th competition. By using deep learning to predict protein distance matrices and gradient descent to optimize 3D structures, AlphaFold achieved a median GDT_TS score of 60 at CASP13, far outstripping the runner-up's score of 40.
timeline.card_summary_en: Deep learning predicted protein distance matrices, gradient descent assembled the 3D structure.
timeline.why_it_matters_en: AlphaFold 1 was DeepMind's first battle turning from game AI toward science AI. It proved the RL-plus-DL route could crack biological structure, directly producing AlphaFold2 at experimental-grade accuracy in 2020, the AlphaFold DB of 200 million protein structures in 2021, and AlphaFold 3's protein-small-molecule interactions in 2024. Reading AlphaFold 1 in 2018, AlphaFold 2 in 2020, AlphaFold-Multimer in 2021, and AlphaFold 3 in 2024 reveals DeepMind's commercial route: science problems plus public databases plus commercial APIs.
timeline.behind_scenes_en: Veteran DeepMind scientist Andrew Senior led the project, credited as Senior et al., Nature 577:706-710, with John Jumper already on the team before taking over as lead for AlphaFold2. The AlphaFold 1 group was small, five to ten people, entering CASP13 anonymously in 2018 and announcing itself as DeepMind after the contest. The paper followed in Nature on January 15, 2020. But AlphaFold 1 still fell short of experimental accuracy, driving Jumper's team to rewrite the architecture through 2019-2020, and at CASP14 AlphaFold2 posted a median GDT of 92.4, experiment-grade precision.

timeline.title_zh: OpenAI GPT-2:大规模生成预训练首次披露
timeline.title_en: OpenAI GPT-2: Large-Scale Generative Pre-training Disclosed
timeline.summary_zh:
2019 年 2 月 14 日,OpenAI 在博客《Better Language Models and Their Implications》发布 GPT-2 论文《Language Models are Unsupervised Multitask Learners》(Radford 等)。
GPT-2 用 48 层 Transformer Decoder,1.5B 参数,在 WebText(4500 万网页,40GB)上训练。
GPT-2 在零样本(zero-shot)下完成翻译、问答、摘要、写作等 7 个任务。
OpenAI 以“恶意使用风险”为由,分阶段发布:2019-02-14 发布 117M 小模型,2019-05 发布 345M,2019-08 发布 774M,2019-11-05 发布完整 1.5B 模型。
timeline.source_name: Radford, A. et al. (2019) GPT-2 paper; OpenAI blog
timeline.card_summary_zh: GPT-2 展示连贯长文本生成能力，也因潜在滥用风险分阶段开放，模型发布第一次与安全治理正面相撞。
timeline.summary_en: On February 14, 2019, OpenAI published the GPT-2 paper "Language Models are Unsupervised Multitask Learners" (Radford et al.) alongside its blog post "Better Language Models and Their Implications." Built with a 48-layer Transformer decoder and 1.5B parameters, GPT-2 was trained on WebText (45 million webpages, 40GB) and demonstrated the ability to perform seven zero-shot tasks, including translation, Q&A, summarization, and writing. Citing "malicious use risks," OpenAI opted for a staged rollout: releasing the 117M model on February 14, 2019, the 345M in May 2019, the 774M in August 2019, and the complete 1.5B model on November 5, 2019.
timeline.card_summary_en: Coherent generation met staged release over misuse risk, publishing colliding with safety.
timeline.why_it_matters_en: GPT-2 began the era when AI safety shaped product decisions in the LLM age. Reading GPT-2's 2019 1.5B staged release through GPT-3's 2020 API-controlled 175B, ChatGPT's 2022 RLHF full launch, and GPT-4's 2023 multimodality with red-teaming traces OpenAI's evolution from cautious release to open API to consumer product.
timeline.behind_scenes_en: Alec Radford was first author on the OpenAI team, and the paper again skipped conferences for direct release on OpenAI's site. The staged rollout was OpenAI's first case of AI safety steering a product decision and set off fierce community argument: AllenAI and HuggingFace attacked it as marketing theater while DeepMind and Anthropic defended cautious release. Sentiment reversed internally by September 2019, the full model shipped in November, and the 2020 GPT-3 paper dropped staging altogether. GPT-2 also ignited 2019 regulatory debate over deepfake-plus-text generation, feeding directly into the EU AI Act's general-purpose AI system category of 2023.

timeline.title_zh: OpenAI LP 设立: capped-profit 转型
timeline.title_en: OpenAI LP: Capped-Profit Transition
timeline.summary_zh:
2019 年 3 月 11 日,OpenAI 宣布成立 OpenAI LP(Limited Partnership),从非营利转为“capped-profit”架构。
原 OpenAI Inc.(非营利)成为 OpenAI LP 的唯一控制方,Microsoft 投 10 亿美元,投资回报上限 100 倍。
架构设计:投资者回报达到上限后,剩余利润归原 OpenAI Inc.(非营利)。
理由是“训练大模型需要超大规模资本,纯非营利无法支撑”。
2019-2023 年 Microsoft 累计投资 130 亿美元。
timeline.source_name: OpenAI (2019) OpenAI LP announcement; Microsoft investment
timeline.card_summary_zh: OpenAI LP 设立： capped-profit 转型；OpenAI LP 是 LLM 时代大厂投资的范式模板。
timeline.summary_en: On March 11, 2019, OpenAI announced the creation of OpenAI LP (Limited Partnership), transitioning from a non-profit to a “capped-profit” structure because training large models requires massive capital that a pure non-profit cannot sustain. Solely controlled by the original non-profit OpenAI Inc., the new entity secured a $1 billion investment from Microsoft with returns capped at 100x, after which any remaining profits revert to OpenAI Inc. Between 2019 and 2023, Microsoft’s cumulative investment reached $13 billion.
timeline.card_summary_en: OpenAI LP created the capped-profit blueprint for big-tech investment in frontier labs.
timeline.why_it_matters_en: OpenAI LP became the paradigm template for LLM-era corporate investment. Reading the 2019 LP through Microsoft's thirteen billion dollars in 2023, Amazon's eight billion into Anthropic in 2024, and xAI's six billion in 2024 shows the LLM era's three architectures for routing big money around pure-nonprofit limits: capped-profit, BCORP, and strategic partnership.
timeline.behind_scenes_en: Before the LP, fundraising under the nonprofit model struggled from 2015 to 2018: Y Combinator, Reid Hoffman, and Peter Thiel contributed about a billion dollars cumulatively, while training GPT-2 and GPT-3 required five hundred million to a billion dollars of compute each year. OpenAI negotiated with Microsoft for six months across 2018-2019 and designed the capped-profit architecture to route around the bar on nonprofit dividends. Elon Musk left the OpenAI board in February 2018 citing conflicts of interest with Tesla's autonomous-driving AI, in reality conflicts bound up with disagreements over direction. After Sam Altman's November 2023 firing episode, OpenAI planned a restructuring into a PBC, a Public Benefit Corporation, removing the capped-profit ceiling.

timeline.title_zh: NVIDIA Megatron-LM:大模型并行训练范式
timeline.title_en: NVIDIA Megatron-LM: Large Model Parallel Training Paradigm
timeline.summary_zh:
2019 年 9 月 19 日,NVIDIA 在 arXiv:1909.08053 发表《Megatron-LM: Training Multi-Billion Parameter Language Models Using Model Parallelism》。
Megatron-LM 用 Tensor Parallelism(把每层 Attention/FFN 矩阵切到多 GPU)+ Pipeline Parallelism(把不同层放到不同 GPU),在 512 个 V100 GPU 上训练 8.3B 参数 GPT-2,达到 52% 单 GPU 训练效率。
Megatron-LM 直接催生 NVIDIA NeMo Megatron、Microsoft DeepSpeed、Megatron-DeepSpeed。
timeline.source_name: Shoeybi, M. et al. (2019) arXiv:1909.08053
timeline.card_summary_zh: Megatron-LM 直接催生 NVIDIA NeMo Megatron、Microsoft DeepSpeed；Megatron-LM 是大模型并行训练的起点。
timeline.summary_en: On September 19, 2019, NVIDIA published "Megatron-LM: Training Multi-Billion Parameter Language Models Using Model Parallelism" on arXiv (arXiv:1909.08053). By combining Tensor Parallelism (splitting each layer's Attention/FFN matrices across multiple GPUs) and Pipeline Parallelism (placing different layers on different GPUs), Megatron-LM trained an 8.3B parameter GPT-2 on 512 V100 GPUs, achieving a 52% single-GPU training efficiency. This breakthrough directly spawned NVIDIA NeMo Megatron, Microsoft DeepSpeed, and Megatron-DeepSpeed.
timeline.card_summary_en: Megatron-LM started large-model parallel training and seeded NeMo Megatron and DeepSpeed.
timeline.why_it_matters_en: Megatron-LM is the origin point of large-model parallel training. Reading Megatron-LM 2019 through DeepSpeed ZeRO 2020, Megatron-DeepSpeed 2021, FSDP 2022, and Sequence Parallelism 2023 explains how LLM training scaled from 1B to 540B, 175B, and 1.8T parameters after 2020.
timeline.behind_scenes_en: First author Mohammad Shoeybi worked at NVIDIA's Silicon Valley research arm. His team partnered with Stanford and Berkeley in 2019 and merged with Microsoft's DeepSpeed ZeRO line into Megatron-DeepSpeed in 2020. The Megatron-LM papers shaped every large training effort of 2020-2023: GPT-3 at 175B, PaLM at 540B, LLaMA at 65B, Megatron-Turing NLG at 530B. In 2024 NVIDIA folded the route into the NeMo framework plus Megatron-LM 2.0.

timeline.title_zh: Google T5:Text-to-Text Transfer Transformer
timeline.title_en: Google T5: Text-to-Text Transfer Transformer
timeline.summary_zh:
2019 年 10 月 10 日,Google 在 JMLR 21 发表《Exploring the Limits of Transfer Learning with a Unified Text-to-Text Transformer》(arXiv:1910.10683)。
T5(Text-to-Text Transfer Transformer)用 Encoder-Decoder Transformer,把所有 NLP 任务统一为“文本输入 → 文本输出”格式。
T5 11B 在 GLUE、SuperGLUE、SQuAD、CNN-DM 等 30+ 任务上达到 SOTA。
T5 论文同时发布 C4(Colossal Clean Crawled Corpus)750GB 预训练数据集。
timeline.source_name: Raffel, C. et al. (2019) arXiv:1910.10683; JMLR 21
timeline.card_summary_zh: T5 论文同时发布 C4(Colossal Clean Crawled Corpus)750GB 预训练数据集。
timeline.summary_en: On October 10, 2019, Google published "Exploring the Limits of Transfer Learning with a Unified Text-to-Text Transformer" (arXiv:1910.10683) in JMLR 21, introducing T5 (Text-to-Text Transfer Transformer) to unify all NLP tasks into a "text input → text output" format using an Encoder-Decoder Transformer. T5 11B achieved SOTA on 30+ tasks, including GLUE, SuperGLUE, SQuAD, and CNN-DM. The paper also released the 750GB C4 (Colossal Clean Crawled Corpus) pre-training dataset.
timeline.card_summary_en: T5's paper shipped C4, a 750GB clean crawled corpus, beside its text-to-text recipe.
timeline.why_it_matters_en: T5 started the unified-text-interface paradigm and fed directly into the 2022 instruction-tuning-plus-RLHF route. Reading T5's 2019 text-to-text through FLAN's 2021 instruction tuning, InstructGPT's 2022 RLHF, and ChatGPT in 2022 maps LLM task unification: Encoder-Decoder with BERT and T5, Decoder-only with GPT, Decoder-only plus RLHF with ChatGPT.
timeline.behind_scenes_en: First author Colin Raffel led the Google Brain team. Across 2018-2019 they ran over a hundred experiments comparing Encoder-only, Decoder-only, and Encoder-Decoder architectures, concluding that Encoder-Decoder transferred most stably across multiple tasks. At 11B parameters T5 was the largest public LLM of 2019 until GPT-3's 175B overtook it in 2020. The T5 line shaped Google's internal LaMDA, PaLM, and Flan-T5 after 2020, and Google Bard initially ran on the T5/LaMDA route when it launched in 2023.

timeline.title_zh: DeepMind AlphaStar:星际争霸 II 超大师级
timeline.title_en: DeepMind AlphaStar: StarCraft II Grandmaster Level
timeline.summary_zh:
2019 年 10 月 30 日,DeepMind 在 Nature 575:350-354 发表《Grandmaster level in StarCraft II using multi-agent reinforcement learning》。
AlphaStar 用 Transformer + Pointer Network + LSTM + Multi-Agent RL,在 StarCraft II Battle.net 上达到大师级(欧洲服务器前 0.2%)。
AlphaStar 训练用 200 年人类游戏 + 14 天自我对弈,League 训练模式让智能体互相竞争进化。
timeline.source_name: Vinyals, O. et al. (2019) Nature 575:350-354; AlphaStar blog
timeline.card_summary_zh: AlphaStar 在信息不完全、操作复杂的即时战略游戏中达到超大师级，强化学习跨入更接近现实决策的环境。
timeline.summary_en: On October 30, 2019, DeepMind published "Grandmaster level in StarCraft II using multi-agent reinforcement learning" in *Nature* (575:350-354). By combining Transformers, Pointer Networks, LSTMs, and multi-agent reinforcement learning, AlphaStar achieved Grandmaster status on StarCraft II's Battle.net, ranking in the top 0.2% of the European server. The agent was trained on 200 years of human gameplay followed by 14 days of self-play, utilizing a "League" training mode where agents competed to drive their own evolution.
timeline.card_summary_en: Grandmaster-level StarCraft II play took reinforcement learning closer to real-world decisions.
timeline.why_it_matters_en: AlphaStar grounded complex multi-agent RL, ranking alongside AlphaGo's perfect information and MuZero's rule-free generality. Reading AlphaGo 2016 perfect information, AlphaStar 2019 imperfect-information multi-agent, MuZero 2019 general planning, and AlphaFold2 2020 science problems shows DeepMind's RL route: from board games to games to science, each step widening the paradigm into a new domain.
timeline.behind_scenes_en: David Silver and Oriol Vinyals led the project at DeepMind from 2017 to 2019, Vinyals himself a Spanish former professional StarCraft player. AlphaStar defeated MaNa and TLO in January 2019, Serral and Bunny in June 2019, and the paper followed in October 2019. It proved RL workable in the demanding combination of imperfect information, long-horizon planning, and multi-agent play, but after 2020 DeepMind pivoted to AlphaFold2 and the AlphaStar line was not continued.

timeline.title_zh: NVIDIA A100:LLM 训练硬件主力 4 年
timeline.title_en: NVIDIA A100: LLM Training Hardware Workhorse for 4 Years
timeline.summary_zh:
2020 年 5 月 14 日,NVIDIA CEO Jensen Huang 在 GTC 2020 Keynote(厨房录制,COVID 期间)发布 A100 GPU。
A100 是 Ampere 架构,7nm 工艺,826mm² die,54.2B 晶体管,40GB/80GB HBM2e,1.55TB/s 显存带宽,108 个 SM,432 个 Tensor Core(FP16 312 TFLOPS / TF32 156 TFLOPS / BF16 312 TFLOPS)。
DGX A100 8 卡版约 199,000 美元,2020-2024 年是 GPT-3、PaLM、LLaMA、GPT-4 训练主力。
timeline.source_name: NVIDIA Ampere whitepaper (2020); NVIDIA GTC 2020 keynote
timeline.card_summary_zh: A100 将张量计算、显存带宽和多卡互联推向新水平，成为早期大语言模型扩张的核心训练硬件。
timeline.summary_en: On May 14, 2020, NVIDIA CEO Jensen Huang unveiled the A100 GPU during his GTC 2020 Keynote, which was recorded in his kitchen during the COVID pandemic. Built on the Ampere architecture, the 7nm chip features an 826mm² die, 54.2B transistors, 40GB/80GB HBM2e with 1.55TB/s memory bandwidth, 108 SMs, and 432 Tensor Cores (FP16 312 TFLOPS / TF32 156 TFLOPS / BF16 312 TFLOPS). The 8-card DGX A100 version, priced at around $199,000, served as the primary training workhorse for GPT-3, PaLM, LLaMA, and GPT-4 from 2020 to 2024.
timeline.card_summary_en: A100 raised tensor compute, memory bandwidth, and interconnect, anchoring early LLM expansion.
timeline.why_it_matters_en: A100 anchored 2020-2024 as the LLM era's hardware bedrock, with GPT-3, PaLM, LLaMA, and others trained on A100 clusters. Against the V100 it combined four levers, architecture, process node, HBM2e memory, and third-generation Tensor Core with TF32, to push training costs down about fifty percent a year, setting the route for the H100 in 2022 and B100/200 in 2024, with generational detail covered in entry 13.
timeline.behind_scenes_en: The A100 project started in 2017, completed design through 2019-2020, and launched in May 2020. Ampere's third-generation Tensor Core introduced the TF32 datatype, automatically running FP32 matrix operations at 19-bit TF32 precision for an eightfold FP32 training speedup. The 80GB variant arrived in November 2021, doubling memory for training models at 175B and beyond. A100 remained the de facto standard for LLM training through 2020-2024, still carrying inference loads after the H100 shipped in 2022. Blackwell B100/200 launched in March 2024 with volume deployments following in 2025.

timeline.title_zh: Lewis RAG:检索增强生成范式提出
timeline.title_en: Lewis RAG: Retrieval-Augmented Generation Paradigm Proposed
timeline.summary_zh:
2020 年 5 月 22 日,Facebook AI Research Patrick Lewis 等在 NeurIPS 2020 发表《Retrieval-Augmented Generation for Knowledge-Intensive NLP Tasks》(arXiv:2005.11401)。
RAG 用「检索器(Dense Passage Retrieval)+ 生成器(BART)」两阶段:检索器从知识库召回 top-k 文档,生成器基于检索文档生成答案。
RAG 在 OpenQA、Jeopardy QG、TriviaQA 上达到 SOTA,且知识库可热更新。
timeline.source_name: Lewis, P. et al. (2020) arXiv:2005.11401; NeurIPS 2020
timeline.card_summary_zh: RAG 让语言模型先检索外部知识再生成答案，为模型接入最新资料和私有数据提供了通用方法。
timeline.summary_en: On May 22, 2020, Patrick Lewis and others at Facebook AI Research published "Retrieval-Augmented Generation for Knowledge-Intensive NLP Tasks" (arXiv:2005.11401) at NeurIPS 2020. RAG uses a two-stage process pairing a retriever (Dense Passage Retrieval) and a generator (BART), where the retriever recalls top-k documents from a knowledge base and the generator generates answers based on those retrieved documents. The framework achieved SOTA on OpenQA, Jeopardy QG, and TriviaQA, while allowing the underlying knowledge base to be hot-updated.
timeline.card_summary_en: Retrieve first, answer second: RAG gave LLMs a universal door to fresh and private knowledge.
timeline.why_it_matters_en: RAG is where knowledge access in the LLM era began. Reading RAG 2020 through RETRO, DeepMind's 7B retrieval-augmented model of 2021, Toolformer's 2023 tool calls, ChatGPT Plugins in 2023, and Anthropic's MCP model-context protocol of 2024 traces the evolution of LLM knowledge access: bolted-on retrieval, embedded retrieval, tool calling, standard protocols.
timeline.behind_scenes_en: Patrick Lewis of FAIR was first author, building RAG in 2019-2020 on Karpukhin's DPR dense passage retrieval plus Lewis's own BART. The paper appeared in May 2020, and RAG returned to attention after ChatGPT arrived in 2022: through 2023 LangChain, LlamaIndex, Pinecone, Weaviate, and other companies built LLM application stacks around it, and by 2024 RAG had become the standard pattern for enterprise LLM deployment.

timeline.title_zh: OpenAI GPT-3 175B:Scaling Laws 验证
timeline.title_en: OpenAI GPT-3 175B: Scaling Laws Validated
timeline.summary_zh:
2020 年 5 月 28 日,OpenAI 在 arXiv:2005.14165 发表《Language Models are Few-Shot Learners》。
GPT-3 用 96 层 Transformer Decoder,175B 参数,在 Common Crawl(499B token)+ WebText2 + Books1 + Books2 + Wikipedia 上训练。
GPT-3 首次展示“in-context learning”:不需微调,只在 prompt 中给 0/few-shot 示例就能完成翻译、问答、编程、推理等 50+ 任务。
GPT-3 论文引用 2024 年超 3 万次,是 LLM 时代奠基论文。
timeline.source_name: Brown, T. et al. (2020) arXiv:2005.14165; NeurIPS 2020
timeline.card_summary_zh: GPT-3 用 1750 亿参数展示规模扩张带来的涌现能力，“把模型做大”由此成为行业主航道。
timeline.summary_en: On May 28, 2020, OpenAI published "Language Models are Few-Shot Learners" on arXiv:2005.14165, introducing GPT-3, a model trained on Common Crawl (499B tokens), WebText2, Books1, Books2, and Wikipedia using a 96-layer Transformer Decoder and 175B parameters. GPT-3 first demonstrated "in-context learning," performing over 50 tasks like translation, Q&A, programming, and reasoning without fine-tuning, using only zero- or few-shot examples in the prompt. With over 30,000 citations by 2024, it remains a foundational paper of the LLM era.
timeline.card_summary_en: At 175 billion parameters GPT-3 showed scale brings emergent skill, making size the mainline.
timeline.why_it_matters_en: GPT-3 validated the LLM era's scaling hypothesis. Reading Kaplan's Scaling Laws of January 2020, GPT-3 175B that May, Chinchilla's 70B correction on data versus parameters in 2022, PaLM 540B in 2022, the rumored 1.8T GPT-4 of 2023, and Llama 3 405B in 2024 shows the decade's core wagers: scaling laws, in-context learning, and RLHF as the three pillars of 2020s LLMs.
timeline.behind_scenes_en: Tom Brown led authorship on the OpenAI team. The project trained through 2019-2020 on V100 clusters at a cost of roughly twelve million dollars. GPT-3 validated Kaplan's January 2020 Scaling Laws paper, arXiv 2001.08361, showing loss falling as a power law in parameters, data, and compute. The API entered public beta on June 11, 2020 and turned paid in September 2021. GPT-3 directly produced DALL-E, ChatGPT, and Codex behind GitHub Copilot in 2022, and GPT-4 in 2023; everything OpenAI shipped after 2020 extended the GPT-3 line.

timeline.title_zh: OpenAI API:LLM-as-a-Service 商业模式启动
timeline.title_en: OpenAI API: LLM-as-a-Service Business Model Launched
timeline.summary_zh:
2020 年 6 月 11 日,OpenAI 发布《OpenAI API》博客,推出 GPT-3 商用 API(private beta)。
API 端点统一为「text-in text-out」,价格按 token 计费(初期 0.06 美元/1K token)。
API 不卖模型权重,只卖推理服务,这是 LLM 时代「LLM-as-a-Service」商业模式起点。
2021-09 公测,2022-08 Codex API(GitHub Copilot),2022-11-30 ChatGPT 上线,2023-03 GPT-4 API。
timeline.source_name: OpenAI (2020-06-11) OpenAI API blog; private beta launch
timeline.card_summary_zh: OpenAI 把 GPT-3 能力封装成 API，开发者无需训练模型即可构建产品，大模型即服务的商业模式由此成立。
timeline.summary_en: On June 11, 2020, OpenAI published its "OpenAI API" blog post to launch the commercial GPT-3 API in private beta, featuring a unified "text-in, text-out" endpoint priced initially at $0.06 per 1K tokens. By selling only inference services rather than model weights, this move marked the beginning of the LLM era's "LLM-as-a-Service" business model, which paved the way for a public beta in September 2021, the Codex API (GitHub Copilot) in August 2022, the launch of ChatGPT on November 30, 2022, and the GPT-4 API in March 2023.
timeline.card_summary_en: OpenAI packaged GPT-3's capabilities into an API so developers could build products without training a model themselves, and the LLM-as-a-Service business model was thus established.
timeline.why_it_matters_en:
The OpenAI API was the starting point of LLM-era business models, directly defining how LLM companies made money from 2022 to 2025.
Following the line OpenAI API (2020-06) → Codex / Copilot (2022) → ChatGPT (2022-11) → GPT-4 API (2023-03) → GPT-4o (2024-05), you can see the path of LLM commercialization: keep the model weights private → metered API billing → ChatGPT subscriptions → enterprise editions plus multimodality.
timeline.behind_scenes_en:
The OpenAI API project was driven from 2019 to 2020 by Sam Altman, Greg Brockman, and Mira Murati.
Right after setting up OpenAI LP in March 2019, Altman pushed API commercialization.
The API design borrowed from the Stripe API (simple endpoints plus billing); not selling weights avoided both weight leakage and safety risks.
During the private beta OpenAI rejected 70% of applications, and across 2020-2021 more than 300 applications connected in total.
The API route exploded after ChatGPT launched in 2022, passing $1 billion ARR in 2023 and over $3 billion ARR in 2024.

timeline.title_zh: OpenAI iGPT:图像自回归预训练探索
timeline.title_en: OpenAI iGPT: Image Autoregressive Pre-training Exploration
timeline.summary_zh:
2020 年 6 月 24 日,OpenAI 在 arXiv:2012.12656 发表《Generative Pretraining from Pixels》(实际 2020-06 公开 blog)。
iGPT(Image GPT)把 GPT-2 自回归架构扩展到图像:把 32×32 图像展开为 1024 序列,用 Transformer Decoder 自回归预测下一个像素。
iGPT-XL(6.8B 参数)在 ImageNet 上半监督分类达 72.0% top-1,接近 SimCLR 等 contrastive 路线。
timeline.source_name: Chen, M. et al. (2020) arXiv:2012.12656; OpenAI iGPT blog
timeline.card_summary_zh: OpenAI iGPT：图像自回归预训练探索；iGPT 是「统一 Transformer 架构」思想在视觉领域的探索。
timeline.summary_en: On June 24, 2020, OpenAI published "Generative Pretraining from Pixels" on arXiv:2012.12656 (having originally debuted the work in a June 2020 blog post), introducing iGPT (Image GPT) to adapt the autoregressive architecture of GPT-2 for computer vision by flattening 32×32 images into a sequence of 1024 and using a Transformer Decoder to predict the next pixel. The model's largest variant, iGPT-XL (6.8B parameters), achieved a 72.0% top-1 accuracy on ImageNet under semi-supervised classification, bringing it close to contrastive learning approaches like SimCLR.
timeline.card_summary_en: OpenAI iGPT: an exploration of autoregressive pretraining for images; iGPT carried the idea of a unified Transformer architecture into the visual domain.
timeline.why_it_matters_en:
iGPT was the exploration of the unified Transformer architecture idea in the visual domain.
Following the line iGPT (2020) → ViT (2020-10) → DALL-E (2021-01) → Sora (2024-02, DiT autoregressive + Diffusion), you can see how visual AI in the 2020s shifted from CNN-dominated to Transformer-dominated.
timeline.behind_scenes_en:
iGPT's lead author was Mark Chen of the OpenAI team.
iGPT was published as a blog post in June 2020, with the arXiv paper following in December.
The iGPT paper proved that the autoregressive pretraining paradigm could extend from text to images, but its training cost far exceeded ViT (2020-10).
The iGPT route was replaced by ViT + MAE (2021-11) in 2021, but in 2024 Sora, VAR, and LlamaGen picked the image autoregression route back up.

timeline.title_zh: AlphaFold2:CASP14 蛋白质结构预测达到实验级精度
timeline.title_en: AlphaFold2: CASP14 Protein Structure Prediction Reaches Experimental Accuracy
timeline.summary_zh:
2020 年 11 月 30 日,CASP14(第 14 届 Critical Assessment of Protein Structure Prediction)会议公布结果,DeepMind AlphaFold2 在 GDT_TS 中位 92.4,远超第二名 75.6,首次达到实验级精度(X-ray 晶体学误差范围内)。
AlphaFold2 用 Evoformer + Structure Module,用 MSA(Multiple Sequence Alignment)+ Pair Representation 联合表征。
Nature 2021-07 15 发表 AlphaFold2 论文《Highly accurate protein structure prediction with AlphaFold》。
timeline.source_name: Jumper, J. et al. (2021) Nature 596:583-589; CASP14 results (2020-11)
timeline.card_summary_zh: AlphaFold2 将蛋白质结构预测推进到接近实验精度，证明 AI 不只生成内容，也能改变科学发现的方法。
timeline.summary_en: On November 30, 2020, the results of the 14th Critical Assessment of Protein Structure Prediction (CASP14) were announced, showing DeepMind’s AlphaFold2 achieving a median GDT_TS of 92.4—far outstripping the runner-up's 75.6—to reach experimental-grade accuracy (within the margin of error of X-ray crystallography) for the first time. AlphaFold2 utilizes Evoformer and Structure Module, employing MSA (Multiple Sequence Alignment) and Pair Representation for joint representation. On July 15, 2021, *Nature* published the AlphaFold2 paper, "Highly accurate protein structure prediction with AlphaFold."
timeline.card_summary_en: AlphaFold2 pushed protein structure prediction to near experimental accuracy, proving that AI does more than generate content: it can change the very method of scientific discovery.
timeline.why_it_matters_en:
AlphaFold2 was the biggest breakthrough in the history of AI for Science, directly changing the paradigm of protein research.
Following the line AlphaFold2 (2020) → AlphaFold-Multimer (2021) → AlphaFold DB with 200 million proteins (2021) → ESMFold (2022, Meta's 60x speedup) → AlphaFold 3 (2024, protein-small molecule), you can see how AI for Science in the 2020s shifted from problem-driven to AI-driven.
timeline.behind_scenes_en:
AlphaFold2's lead author was John Jumper of the DeepMind team.
From 2018 to 2020 Jumper rewrote the AlphaFold 1 architecture, introducing the Evoformer (self-attention + axial attention) and a Structure Module (SE(3)-equivariant Transformer).
At CASP14 AlphaFold2 stunned the biology community; the Nature paper came out in July 2021, and Science named it the #1 scientific breakthrough of 2021.
In July 2021 DeepMind released the AlphaFold DB covering 200 million protein structures, and by 2023 it expanded to 214 million proteins plus all eukaryotes.
By 2024 the AlphaFold2 paper had been cited more than 20,000 times, making it the biggest breakthrough in the history of AI for Science.

timeline.title_zh: OpenAI CLIP + DALL·E:多模态预训练范式确立
timeline.title_en: OpenAI CLIP + DALL·E: Multimodal Pre-training Paradigm Established
timeline.summary_zh:
2021 年 1 月 5 日,OpenAI 同时发布 CLIP(Contrastive Language-Image Pre-training,arXiv:2103.00020,实际 2021-02-26 arXiv)和 DALL·E(arXiv:2102.12092,2021-01-05 blog)。
CLIP 用 4 亿图文对训练双塔模型,把图像和文本映射到同一 512 维空间,在 30+ 视觉分类任务上 zero-shot 接近监督 SOTA。
DALL·E 用 120 亿参数 dVAE + Transformer,文本生成图像。
两篇论文奠定「多模态统一表征」路线。
timeline.source_name: Radford, A. et al. (2021) CLIP arXiv:2103.00020; Ramesh, A. et al. DALL·E arXiv:2102.12092
timeline.card_summary_zh: CLIP 与 DALL·E 把语言和图像放进同一学习框架，文本理解开始能够直接驱动视觉识别与生成。
timeline.summary_en: On January 5, 2021, OpenAI simultaneously released CLIP (Contrastive Language-Image Pre-training, arXiv:2103.00020, actually 2021-02-26 arXiv) and DALL·E (arXiv:2102.12092, 2021-01-05 blog). CLIP trained a dual-tower model on 400 million image-text pairs to map images and text into the same 512-dimensional space, approaching supervised SOTA on 30+ visual classification tasks via zero-shot learning, while DALL·E employed a 12-billion-parameter dVAE + Transformer for text-to-image generation. Together, these two papers laid the foundation for the "unified multimodal representation" pathway.
timeline.card_summary_en: CLIP and DALL·E put language and images into a single learning framework, letting text understanding directly drive visual recognition and generation.
timeline.why_it_matters_en:
CLIP + DALL·E marked the start of the unified vision-language paradigm, directly giving rise to Stable Diffusion, Midjourney, and DALL·E 2 in 2022.
Following the line CLIP (2021) → DALL·E 2 (2022-04) → Stable Diffusion (2022-08) → Imagen (2022-05) → Sora (2024-02), you can see that the common foundation of multimodal AI in the 2020s is CLIP-style contrastive pretraining combined with Diffusion or Transformer decoding.
timeline.behind_scenes_en:
CLIP's lead author was Alec Radford and DALL·E's lead author was Aditya Ramesh, both on the OpenAI team.
CLIP drew inspiration from earlier work such as VirTex and CONVIRT; its key idea was contrastive learning over massive noisy image-text pairs.
The CLIP paper hit arXiv in February 2021 and was accepted at ICML in March 2021.
CLIP served as the text encoder in Stable Diffusion (2022) and as a foundational component in Sora, DALL-E 3, and Midjourney v6.
The DALL·E line advanced to DALL·E 2 (diffusion) in April 2022 and DALL·E 3 (GPT-4 + prompt rewriting) in October 2023.

timeline.title_zh: Hu LoRA:低秩适配器开启高效微调时代
timeline.title_en: Hu LoRA: Low-Rank Adapters Enable Efficient Fine-tuning Era
timeline.summary_zh:
2021 年 6 月 17 日,Microsoft Edward Hu 等在 arXiv:2106.09685 发表《LoRA: Low-Rank Adaptation of Large Language Models》。
LoRA 把权重更新 ΔW 分解为两个低秩矩阵 BA(B∈r×d,A∈d×r,r≪d),只训练 BA 不动原权重,可训练参数降低 1000-10000 倍。
LoRA 在 GPT-3 175B 上把微调参数从 175B 降到 4.7M(0.003%),性能持平或略优。
timeline.card_summary_zh: LoRA 只训练极少量附加参数就能改造大模型，让普通团队也有机会低成本完成定制微调。
timeline.summary_en: On June 17, 2021, Microsoft’s Edward Hu and others published "LoRA: Low-Rank Adaptation of Large Language Models" on arXiv:2106.09685. LoRA decomposes the weight update ΔW into two low-rank matrices BA (B∈r×d, A∈d×r, r≪d), training only BA while keeping the original weights frozen, which slashes trainable parameters by 1,000 to 10,000 times. On GPT-3 175B, this method reduced fine-tuning parameters from 175B to just 4.7M (0.003%) while delivering comparable or slightly superior performance.
timeline.card_summary_en: LoRA adapts large models by training only a tiny set of added parameters, giving ordinary teams a realistic low-cost path to custom fine-tuning.
timeline.why_it_matters_en:
LoRA was the starting point of parameter-efficient fine-tuning, directly defining the open-source LLM fine-tuning paradigm from 2022 to 2025.
Following the line LoRA (2021-06) → Prefix Tuning (2021-07) → QLoRA (2023-05) → DoRA (2024-02), you can see why a consumer GPU like the 4090 can now fine-tune a 70B LLM.
timeline.behind_scenes_en:
LoRA's lead author was Edward Hu at Microsoft Research.
It began as Hu's 2021 internship project, inspired by Aghajanyan's 2020 intrinsic dimension paper.
The LoRA paper hit arXiv in June 2021 and was accepted at ICLR in October 2022.
From 2022 to 2023 LoRA became the de facto standard for open-source LLM fine-tuning: Stable Diffusion LoRA models, HuggingFace PEFT, LoRA + QLoRA (2023-05), and LoRA + DPO (2023-05).
Commercial impact: companies such as Runway and Civitai built marketplaces around trading LoRA models.

timeline.title_zh: GitHub Copilot 公测:AI 编程助手进入主流
timeline.title_en: GitHub Copilot Public Beta: AI Coding Assistant Goes Mainstream
timeline.summary_zh:
2021 年 6 月 29 日,GitHub 与 OpenAI 联合宣布 GitHub Copilot Technical Preview 公测。
Copilot 基于 OpenAI Codex(GPT-3 微调版,代码训练 159GB GitHub 代码),在 VS Code 中提供行级 / 函数级代码补全,月费 10 美元。
2022-06-21 正式版上线,2023-03 推出 Copilot X(GPT-4 + Chat),2024-12 推出 Copilot Workspace(任务级 Agent)。
timeline.source_name: GitHub (2021-06-29) Copilot preview announcement; OpenAI Codex
timeline.card_summary_zh: Copilot 把代码生成嵌入编辑器，程序员第一次大规模体验与模型并肩写代码的日常工作方式。
timeline.summary_en: On June 29, 2021, GitHub and OpenAI jointly announced the public beta of GitHub Copilot Technical Preview. Powered by OpenAI Codex—a fine-tuned version of GPT-3 trained on 159GB of GitHub code—Copilot provides line-level and function-level code completion in VS Code for $10 a month. It officially launched on June 21, 2022, followed by the debuts of Copilot X (GPT-4 + Chat) in March 2023 and Copilot Workspace (a task-level Agent) in December 2024.
timeline.card_summary_en: Copilot embedded code generation into the editor, giving programmers their first mass experience of writing code side by side with a model as daily work.
timeline.why_it_matters_en:
Copilot was the consumer zero-moment for AI coding assistants, defining the shape of AI programming products from 2022 to 2025.
Following the line Copilot (2021) → Cursor (2023) → Devin (2024) → Claude Code (2025) → Codex Cloud Agent (2025), you can see AI coding evolve from completion to conversation to agents.
timeline.behind_scenes_en:
The Copilot project was led from 2020 to 2021 by OpenAI's Mark Chen and GitHub's Oege de Moor.
The Codex model was a code-specialized version of GPT-3, fine-tuned on public GitHub code that OpenAI collected in 2020-2021.
Before the public beta there was internal controversy at GitHub: developers worried about code copyright and job replacement.
In November 2022 the Authors Guild filed a class-action lawsuit against GitHub; in January 2024 the court partially dismissed it.
Copilot reached 1 million subscribers in 2023 and 1.8 million paying users in 2024, with ARR exceeding $200 million.

timeline.title_zh: OpenAI Codex API:代码 LLM 商业化
timeline.title_en: OpenAI Codex API: Code LLM Commercialization
timeline.summary_zh:
2021 年 8 月 10 日,OpenAI 发布 Codex API 私测。
Codex 是 GPT-3 的代码专精版,在 OpenAI 收集的 159GB GitHub 公开代码(2021 年论文)上微调,支持 Python、JavaScript、Go、C++ 等 12+ 语言。
Codex API 端点 /v1/completions(code-davinci-001 模型),按 token 计费 0.06 美元/1K。
Codex 是 GitHub Copilot 背后模型,2022-08 Codex 退役,被 GPT-3.5 / GPT-4 取代。
timeline.source_name: Chen, M. et al. (2021) arXiv:2107.03374; OpenAI Codex API blog
timeline.card_summary_zh: OpenAI 发布 Codex API 私测，并成为这一阶段值得追踪的关键变化。
timeline.summary_en: On August 10, 2021, OpenAI launched the private beta of its Codex API, a code-specialized version of GPT-3 fine-tuned on 159GB of public GitHub code (from its 2021 paper) that supports 12+ languages including Python, JavaScript, Go, and C++. The API endpoint `/v1/completions` (using the code-davinci-001 model) was priced at $0.06/1K tokens. Serving as the underlying model for GitHub Copilot, Codex was retired in August 2022 and replaced by GPT-3.5 and GPT-4.
timeline.card_summary_en: OpenAI launched the Codex API private beta, a key change worth tracking in this period.
timeline.why_it_matters_en:
Codex was the starting point of commercializing code LLMs, directly spawning GitHub Copilot and every code LLM that followed.
Following the line Codex (2021-08) → Copilot GA (2022-06) → Code Llama (2023-08) → DeepSeek-Coder (2024) → Claude Sonnet 4.5 (2025), you can see code AI evolve from completion to conversation to agents.
timeline.behind_scenes_en:
The Codex project was led from 2020 to 2021 by Mark Chen's team at OpenAI; the Codex paper arXiv:2107.03374, 'Evaluating Large Language Models Trained on Code,' was published in July 2021.
On the HumanEval benchmark Codex scored 28.8% pass@1 (versus 0% for GPT-3), and Codex-12B reached 37.7%.
More than 700 developers joined during the Codex API private beta, and GitHub Copilot went GA in June 2022.
The Codex models were retired in March 2023, replaced by GPT-3.5 / GPT-4, but the Codex dataset and HumanEval benchmark shaped code LLM training through 2022-2024 (StarCoder, Code Llama, DeepSeek-Coder, Qwen Coder).

timeline.title_zh: InstructGPT 论文:RLHF 路线工业落地
timeline.title_en: InstructGPT Paper: RLHF Industrialized
timeline.summary_zh:
2022 年 3 月 4 日,OpenAI 在 arXiv:2203.02155 发表《Training language models to follow instructions with human feedback》。
InstructGPT 用三阶段训练:1) SFT(监督微调,演示数据) 2) RM(奖励模型,偏好数据) 3) PPO(强化学习优化)。
1.3B InstructGPT 输出优于 175B GPT-3,证明 RLHF 比 scaling 更有效。
timeline.source_name: Ouyang, L. et al. (2022) arXiv:2203.02155; NeurIPS 2022
timeline.card_summary_zh: InstructGPT 用人类反馈训练模型遵循意图，小模型甚至胜过更大的 GPT-3，ChatGPT 的对齐路线由此成熟。
timeline.summary_en: On March 4, 2022, OpenAI published "Training language models to follow instructions with human feedback" on arXiv:2203.02155, training InstructGPT via three stages: 1) SFT (supervised fine-tuning, demonstration data), 2) RM (reward model, preference data), and 3) PPO (reinforcement learning optimization). The resulting 1.3B InstructGPT outperformed the 175B GPT-3, proving that RLHF is more effective than scaling.
timeline.card_summary_en: InstructGPT used human feedback to train models to follow human intent; a small model even beat the larger GPT-3, and the alignment route behind ChatGPT matured here.
timeline.why_it_matters_en:
InstructGPT laid the foundation for industrializing the RLHF route and directly gave rise to ChatGPT.
Following the line InstructGPT (2022-03) → ChatGPT (2022-11) → Claude (2023-03) → Llama 2 Chat (2023-07) → DeepSeek-R1 (2025-01, RL + cold start), you can see the evolution of LLM post-training paradigms: SFT → RLHF → DPO (2023-05) → RLAIF (2024).
timeline.behind_scenes_en:
InstructGPT's lead author was Long Ouyang of the OpenAI team.
The paper was completed internally in January 2022 and published on arXiv in March 2022.
The RLHF route grew out of Christiano's 2017 Deep RL from Human Preferences and Stiennon's 2020 summarization work.
In March 2022 InstructGPT shipped in the GPT-3 API (text-davinci-002 / 003); when ChatGPT launched on November 30, 2022 it used the same architecture (GPT-3.5 + RLHF).
By 2023 the RLHF route had become standard equipment for every LLM: Anthropic Constitutional AI (2022-12), Llama 2 Chat (2023-07), DeepSeek-R1 (2025-01).

timeline.title_zh: LAION-5B:58 亿图文对开源数据集发布
timeline.title_en: LAION-5B: 5.8B Image-Text Pairs Open Dataset Released
timeline.summary_zh:
2022 年 3 月 31 日,德国非营利组织 LAION(Large-scale Artificial Intelligence Open Network)在 arXiv:2210.08402 发表 LAION-5B 数据集。
LAION-5B 包含 58.5 亿英文 / 多语种图文对(2.3B 英文 + 2.3B 多语种 + 1.2B 未知语言),240TB 数据,从 Common Crawl 抓取,CLIP 过滤。
LAION-5B 直接训练 Stable Diffusion 1.x / 2.x,是 2022-2024 年开源文生图模型基础。
timeline.source_name: Schuhmann, C. et al. (2022) arXiv:2210.08402; LAION-5B
timeline.card_summary_zh: LAION-5B：58 亿图文对开源数据集发布，并成为这一阶段值得追踪的关键变化。
timeline.summary_en: On March 31, 2022, the German non-profit LAION (Large-scale Artificial Intelligence Open Network) published the LAION-5B dataset on arXiv:2210.08402. Scraped from Common Crawl and filtered using CLIP, the 240TB dataset contains 5.85 billion English/multilingual image-text pairs (comprising 2.3B English, 2.3B multilingual, and 1.2B unknown language pairs). LAION-5B directly trained Stable Diffusion 1.x / 2.x, serving as the foundation for open-source text-to-image models from 2022 to 2024.
timeline.card_summary_en: LAION-5B: release of the open dataset of 5.8 billion image-text pairs, a key change worth tracking in this period.
timeline.why_it_matters_en:
LAION-5B laid the groundwork for open multimodal data, directly defining open-source text-to-image models from 2022 to 2025.
Following the line LAION-400M (2021) → LAION-5B (2022-03) → Stable Diffusion 1.4 (2022-08) → SDXL (2023-07) → Flux (2024-08), you can see why open-source text-to-image exploded in 2022: open data, open code, and open weights all came together at once.
timeline.behind_scenes_en:
LAION was founded in 2021 by Christoph Schuhmann, Richard Vencu, Romain Beaumont, and others; it released LAION-400M in March 2021 and LAION-5B in March 2022.
Compute for LAION-5B was funded by Stability AI, championed by Miles Brundage and Emad Mostaque.
The LAION datasets directly spawned Stable Diffusion 1.4 (2022-08), 1.5 (2022-10), and 2.0 (2022-11).
In December 2023 LAION-5B was partially taken down over child-image and privacy controversies, and in 2024 LAION-Aesthetics v2.6 took its place.

timeline.title_zh: Google PaLM 540B:Pathways 大模型训练框架
timeline.title_en: Google PaLM 540B: Pathways Large Model Training Framework
timeline.summary_zh:
2022 年 4 月 4 日,Google 在 arXiv:2204.02311 发表《PaLM: Scaling Language Modeling with Pathways》。
PaLM 540B 用 6144 个 TPU v4 训练,780B token(社交媒体 + 网页 + 代码 + 多语种)。
PaLM 在 BIG-bench 上 144 任务超越人类平均,在多语种、推理、代码任务上达 SOTA。
PaLM 是 Pathways 系统首次大规模应用,支持跨 TPU Pod 训练。
timeline.source_name: Chowdhery, A. et al. (2022) arXiv:2204.02311; PaLM 540B
timeline.card_summary_zh: PaLM 用 Pathways 跨越大规模 TPU 集群训练 5400 亿参数模型，展示单一模型向多任务扩展的工程路线。
timeline.summary_en: On April 4, 2022, Google published "PaLM: Scaling Language Modeling with Pathways" on arXiv:2204.02311, detailing PaLM 540B, which was trained on 6144 TPU v4 chips across 780B tokens of social media, web pages, code, and multilingual data. Representing the first large-scale deployment of the Pathways system to support training across TPU Pods, the model achieved SOTA results in multilingual, reasoning, and coding tasks while beating the human average on 144 BIG-bench tasks.
timeline.card_summary_en: PaLM used Pathways to train a 540-billion-parameter model across massive TPU clusters, demonstrating an engineering route for scaling a single model toward many tasks.
timeline.why_it_matters_en:
PaLM laid the foundation of Google's LLM line, directly countering OpenAI's GPT-3 / GPT-4.
Following the line PaLM (2022-04) → PaLM 2 (2023-05) → Gemini 1.0 (2023-12) → Gemini 1.5 (2024-02) → Gemini 2.0 (2024-12), you can see Google's LLM route: from the Pathways training system to PaLM's single Transformer to Gemini's MoE multimodality.
timeline.behind_scenes_en:
PaLM's lead author was Aakanksha Chowdhery of the Google Brain team.
PaLM trained through 2021-2022 on 6,144 TPU v4 chips (two pods, 4,096 + 2,048), at a training cost of roughly $100 million.
From 2022 to 2023 the PaLM route became Google's flagship: PaLM-E (2023-03, robotics), Med-PaLM 2 (2023-05, healthcare), and PaLM 2 (2023-05, 392B, mid-size multilingual).
PaLM directly gave rise to Gemini 1.0 in December 2023, with the Mixture-of-Experts route replacing PaLM's single Transformer.

timeline.title_zh: DeepMind Chinchilla:数据-参数标度律修正
timeline.title_en: DeepMind Chinchilla: Data-Parameter Scaling Law Correction
timeline.summary_zh:
2022 年 4 月 12 日,DeepMind 在 arXiv:2203.15556 发表《Training Compute-Optimal Large Language Models》。
Chinchilla 70B(70B 参数 + 1.4T token 训练)在 MMLU、BIG-bench、阅读理解上击败 GPT-3 175B(175B 参数 + 300B token)。
Chinchilla 论文核心结论:Kaplan 2020 Scaling Laws 高估参数、低估数据,最优 compute-optimal 训练是「token 数 ≈ 20 × 参数数」。
timeline.source_name: Hoffmann, J. et al. (2022) arXiv:2203.15556; NeurIPS 2022
timeline.card_summary_zh: Chinchilla 70B(70B 参数 + 1.4T token 训练)在 MMLU、BIG-bench。
timeline.summary_en: On April 12, 2022, DeepMind published "Training Compute-Optimal Large Language Models" on arXiv:2203.15556, demonstrating that Chinchilla 70B (70B parameters + 1.4T tokens training) beat GPT-3 175B (175B parameters + 300B tokens) on MMLU, BIG-bench, and reading comprehension. The paper's core conclusion is that the Kaplan 2020 Scaling Laws overestimated parameters and underestimated data, asserting that compute-optimal training requires "number of tokens ≈ 20 × number of parameters."
timeline.card_summary_en: Chinchilla 70B (70B parameters trained on 1.4T tokens) on MMLU and BIG-bench.
timeline.why_it_matters_en:
Chinchilla laid the groundwork for correcting scaling laws in the LLM era, directly changing large-model training strategy from 2022 to 2025.
Following the line Kaplan Scaling Laws (2020-01, GPT-3) → Chinchilla (2022-04, data-parameter balance) → Llama 2 (2023, 2T tokens) → Llama 3 (2024, 15T tokens) → DeepSeek V3 (2024, 14.8T tokens), you can see LLM training shift from parameters-are-king to data-is-king.
timeline.behind_scenes_en:
Chinchilla's lead author was Jordan Hoffmann of the DeepMind team.
The paper hit arXiv in March 2022 and was accepted at NeurIPS in April 2022.
The Chinchilla paper influenced the training of every large model from 2022 to 2024: Llama 2 (2023, 2T tokens), Llama 3 (2024, 15T tokens), Mistral 7B (2023, 8T tokens), DeepSeek V2 (2024, 8.1T tokens).
The Chinchilla route shifted the focus of LLM training from growing parameters to growing data, giving rise to the synthetic-data and data-quality routes of 2023.

timeline.title_zh: Tri Dao FlashAttention:注意力 IO 优化奠基
timeline.title_en: Tri Dao FlashAttention: Attention IO Optimization Foundation
timeline.summary_zh:
2022 年 5 月 27 日,Tri Dao、Daniel Fu 在 arXiv:2205.14135 发表《FlashAttention: Fast and Memory-Efficient Exact Attention with IO-Awareness》(后 NeurIPS 2022 接收)。
FlashAttention 用 tiling + recomputation 优化 GPU SRAM/HBM IO,把 attention 计算从 O(N²) 显存降到 O(N),速度提升 2-4 倍,支持 16K+ 长上下文训练。
FlashAttention 开源后 2023 年成所有 LLM 训练标配。
timeline.source_name: Dao, T. & Fu, D. (2022) arXiv:2205.14135; NeurIPS 2022
timeline.card_summary_zh: FlashAttention 从显存读写而非纯算力入手重写注意力，让大模型训练更快，也为长上下文扩展清除瓶颈。
timeline.summary_en: On May 27, 2022, Tri Dao and Daniel Fu published "FlashAttention: Fast and Memory-Efficient Exact Attention with IO-Awareness" on arXiv (arXiv:2205.14135), which was later accepted by NeurIPS 2022. By optimizing GPU SRAM/HBM IO through tiling and recomputation, FlashAttention slashed attention memory consumption from O(N²) to O(N), delivered a 2- to 4-fold speedup, and enabled 16K+ long-context training. Following its open-source release, FlashAttention became the standard for all LLM training in 2023.
timeline.card_summary_en: FlashAttention rewrote attention around memory reads and writes rather than raw compute, making large-model training faster and clearing away the bottleneck for long-context scaling.
timeline.why_it_matters_en:
FlashAttention laid the foundation of long-context LLM training, directly defining the long-context route from 2023 to 2025.
Following the line FlashAttention (2022-06) → FlashAttention-2 (2023-07) → RingAttention (2023-12) → FlashAttention-3 (2024-07) → Mamba / Linear Attention (2024), you can see why LLM context windows grew from 4K to over 1M tokens in 2024.
timeline.behind_scenes_en:
FlashAttention's lead author was Tri Dao, a Stanford postdoc advised by Christopher Ré and Stefano Ermon.
From 2021 to 2022 Dao studied the GPU memory hierarchy and found that attention's bottleneck was HBM bandwidth, not FLOPs.
The FlashAttention paper hit arXiv in May 2022 and was accepted at NeurIPS in June 2022.
FlashAttention-2 (2023-07) improved parallelism; FlashAttention-3 (2024-07) used Hopper TMA + WGMMA for a 2x speedup.
Dao founded Together AI in August 2024; FlashAttention became core infrastructure for open-source LLM training.

timeline.title_zh: Midjourney v3 公测:订阅制文生图商业化
timeline.title_en: Midjourney v3 Beta: Subscription Text-to-Image Commercialization
timeline.summary_zh:
2022 年 7 月 12 日,David Holz 创立的 Midjourney 推出 v3 公测,通过 Discord 订阅(10/30/60 美元/月)。
Midjourney v3 用 Latent Diffusion + 自有数据集,在艺术风格、人脸、构图上优于 Stable Diffusion 1.x。
2022-08 OpenAI DALL·E 2、Stability SD 1.4、Midjourney v3 三家在 1 个月内集中发布,2022 年成「文生图元年」。
timeline.source_name: Midjourney (2022-07) v3 beta launch; David Holz interviews
timeline.card_summary_zh: Midjourney v3 公测：订阅制文生图商业化，并成为这一阶段值得追踪的关键变化。
timeline.summary_en: On July 12, 2022, David Holz’s Midjourney launched its v3 public beta via Discord subscriptions ($10/$30/$60 per month), using Latent Diffusion and a proprietary dataset to outperform Stable Diffusion 1.x in artistic style, faces, and composition. In August 2022, the concentrated release of OpenAI’s DALL·E 2, Stability’s SD 1.4, and Midjourney v3 within a single month cemented 2022 as the inaugural year of text-to-image generation.
timeline.card_summary_en: Midjourney v3 public beta: subscription-based commercialization of text-to-image generation, a key change worth tracking in this period.
timeline.why_it_matters_en:
Midjourney laid the foundation of subscription-based text-to-image generation and, together with Stable Diffusion (open source) and DALL·E 2 (API), formed a three-way contest in 2022.
Following the line Midjourney v3 (2022-07) → SD 1.4 (2022-08) → DALL·E 2 (2022-04, actually earlier) → SDXL (2023-07) → Flux (2024-08), you can see the three commercialization paths for text-to-image in 2022: subscription (Midjourney), open source (SD), and API (DALL·E).
timeline.behind_scenes_en:
Midjourney the company was founded in August 2021 by David Holz (co-founder of Leap Motion) with an 11-person team and no outside investment.
Holz chose Discord as the product vehicle: users type /imagine in a channel to trigger the model.
Midjourney v3 entered public beta in July 2022, followed by v5 in March 2023 (hand fixes), v6 in December 2023 (text rendering), v6.1 in August 2024, and v7 in April 2025.
In 2024 Midjourney posted $200 million ARR with a 5-person core team, $40 million per head.

timeline.title_zh: Stability AI Stable Diffusion 1.4:开源文生图爆发
timeline.title_en: Stability AI Stable Diffusion 1.4: Open Text-to-Image Era Begins
timeline.summary_zh:
2022 年 8 月 22 日,Stability AI 在 GitHub / HuggingFace 发布 Stable Diffusion 1.4 模型权重(CreativeML Open RAIL-M 许可)。
SD 1.4 用 Latent Diffusion(Rombach 2022 CVPR)+ CLIP text encoder,在 LAION-5B 子集上训练,512×512 图像生成,可在消费级 GPU(8GB VRAM)运行。
SD 1.4 上线 1 周内 HuggingFace 下载超 10 万次,2022-10 SD 1.5 改进版发布。
timeline.source_name: Rombach, R. et al. (2022) arXiv:2112.10752; Stability AI SD 1.4 release
timeline.card_summary_zh: Stable Diffusion 把高质量文生图模型开放给个人设备，生成图像第一次形成大规模民间创作生态。
timeline.summary_en: On August 22, 2022, Stability AI released the Stable Diffusion 1.4 model weights on GitHub / HuggingFace under the CreativeML Open RAIL-M license. Built on Latent Diffusion (Rombach 2022 CVPR) and a CLIP text encoder, SD 1.4 was trained on a subset of LAION-5B for 512×512 image generation and could run on consumer-grade GPUs with 8GB VRAM. Within one week of its launch, SD 1.4 surpassed 100,000 downloads on HuggingFace, followed by the release of the improved SD 1.5 in October 2022.
timeline.card_summary_en: Stable Diffusion opened high-quality text-to-image models up to personal devices, and image generation saw its first large-scale grassroots creation ecosystem.
timeline.why_it_matters_en:
Stable Diffusion was the starting point of open-source text-to-image generation, directly defining the open-source generative AI ecosystem from 2022 to 2025.
Following the line SD 1.4 (2022-08) → SD 2.0 (2022-11) → SDXL (2023-07) → SD3 (2024-06) → Flux (2024-08, Black Forest Labs), you can see why open-source generative AI exploded in 2022: open data (LAION-5B), open code (Latent Diffusion), and open weights (SD 1.4) all came together at once.
timeline.behind_scenes_en:
The SD project was developed from 2021 to 2022 by the LMU Munich / Runway / CompVis teams (Rombach, Blattmann), with Stability AI funding $6 million of training compute.
The SD paper, arXiv:2112.10752 'High-Resolution Image Synthesis with Latent Diffusion Models,' was published in April 2022.
After SD 1.4 went open source on August 22, 2022 came SD 1.5 in October 2022 (better faces), SD 2.0 in November 2022 (OpenCLIP, NSFW removal, 768x768), SDXL at 1024x1024 in July 2023, and SD3 (Flow Matching) in June 2024.
The SD open-source release directly fueled Midjourney's commercial competition, the Civitai LoRA ecosystem, and ControlNet 1.x.

timeline.title_zh: OpenAI Whisper:开源语音识别奠基
timeline.title_en: OpenAI Whisper: Open-Source Speech Recognition Foundation
timeline.summary_zh:
2022 年 9 月 21 日,OpenAI 在 arXiv:2212.04356 发表《Robust Speech Recognition via Large-Scale Weak Supervision》。
Whisper 用 68 万小时多语种音频训练(65% 英文 + 17% 非英文 + 18% 翻译对),Encoder-Decoder Transformer,在 0-shot 跨语种语音识别上接近监督 SOTA。
Whisper 模型权重开源( MIT 许可),tiny / base / small / medium / large 5 个版本。
timeline.source_name: Radford, A. et al. (2022) arXiv:2212.04356; Whisper GitHub
timeline.card_summary_zh: Whisper 以大规模多语言数据训练并开放权重，让可靠的语音识别与翻译迅速进入无数应用。
timeline.summary_en: On September 21, 2022, OpenAI published "Robust Speech Recognition via Large-Scale Weak Supervision" on arXiv:2212.04356. Trained on 680,000 hours of multilingual audio (65% English, 17% non-English, and 18% translation pairs), the Encoder-Decoder Transformer-based Whisper approached supervised SOTA in zero-shot cross-lingual speech recognition. Its model weights were open-sourced under the MIT license in five versions: tiny, base, small, medium, and large.
timeline.card_summary_en: Whisper was trained on massive multilingual data and released with open weights, quickly bringing reliable speech recognition and translation into countless applications.
timeline.why_it_matters_en:
Whisper laid the foundation of open-source speech recognition, directly defining the open-source speech stack from 2023 to 2025.
Following the line Whisper (2022-09) → Whisper Large v3 (2023-11) → SeamlessM4T (2023) → Voxtral (2025), you can see why every speech application in 2023, from captions to transcription, translation, and voice assistants, defaulted to Whisper.
timeline.behind_scenes_en:
Whisper's lead author was Alec Radford of the OpenAI team.
Whisper trained through 2021-2022 on data scraped from YouTube, podcasts, and multilingual audio, using weak supervision (automatic transcripts with imperfect labels).
The Whisper paper hit arXiv in September 2022 and was accepted at ICML in January 2023.
After open-sourcing, Whisper became the de facto standard for speech recognition in 2023: faster-whisper (CTranslate2 acceleration), whisper.cpp (C++ inference), WhisperX (word-level timestamps), and Whisper Large v3 (2023-11).
The Whisper line extended in 2024 toward Voxtral (2025) and SeamlessM4T (Meta, 2023).

timeline.title_zh: LangChain 开源:LLM 应用框架奠基
timeline.title_en: LangChain Open-Sourced: LLM Application Framework Foundation
timeline.summary_zh:
2022 年 10 月 20 日,Harrison Chase 在 GitHub 开源 LangChain v0.0.1。
LangChain 提供 Prompt 模板、Memory、Chains、Agents、Tools、VectorStores 抽象,让开发者用 Python / JS 构建端到端 LLM 应用。
LangChain 2023 年成 LLM 应用框架事实标准,2023-07 LangChain + LangSmith + LangServe 三件套,2024 年 ARR 5000 万美元,估值 11 亿美元。
timeline.source_name: Chase, H. (2022) LangChain v0.0.1 GitHub release
timeline.card_summary_zh: LangChain 把提示词、模型、记忆和外部工具连接成组件，大模型应用第一次拥有通用的开发脚手架。
timeline.summary_en: On October 20, 2022, Harrison Chase open-sourced LangChain v0.0.1 on GitHub, offering abstractions for Prompt templates, Memory, Chains, Agents, Tools, and VectorStores to let developers build end-to-end LLM applications using Python / JS. LangChain became the de facto standard LLM application framework in 2023—introducing its LangChain + LangSmith + LangServe trio in July 2023—before reaching a $50 million ARR and a $1.1 billion valuation in 2024.
timeline.card_summary_en: LangChain wired prompts, models, memory, and external tools together as components, giving LLM applications their first general-purpose development scaffold.
timeline.why_it_matters_en:
LangChain was the starting point of the LLM application framework, directly fueling the LLM application ecosystem of 2023-2025.
Following the line LangChain (2022-10) → LlamaIndex (2022-11) → AutoGen (2023-08) → CrewAI (2024-01) → LangGraph (2024-01) → MCP (2024-11), you can see LLM application frameworks evolve from Chains to Agents to Graphs to standard protocols.
timeline.behind_scenes_en:
LangChain was created in October 2022 by Harrison Chase, formerly an engineer at Robust Intelligence.
In September 2022, after seeing the Notion AI beta, Chase set out to build an application framework for LLMs.
After ChatGPT exploded in February 2023, LangChain's user base jumped from 1,000 to 50,000.
The LangChain route influenced LlamaIndex (2022-11), Semantic Kernel (2023-02, Microsoft), AutoGen (2023-08, Microsoft), and CrewAI (2024-01).
In 2024 LangChain drew criticism for over-abstraction and hard debugging, with LlamaIndex and DSPy partially displacing it.

timeline.title_zh: OpenAI ChatGPT:AI 的 iPhone 时刻
timeline.title_en: OpenAI ChatGPT: AI's iPhone Moment
timeline.summary_zh:
2022 年 11 月 30 日,OpenAI 在 blog 发布 ChatGPT(chat.openai.com),免费公测。
ChatGPT 基于 GPT-3.5(2020 年 GPT-3 + 2022 年 InstructGPT RLHF 微调),支持多轮对话、上下文记忆、代码生成、写作、翻译。
5 天用户破 100 万(史上最快),2 个月 MAU 1 亿(TikTok 9 个月、Instagram 2.5 年),2023-01 月估值 290 亿美元,2023-04 ChatGPT Plus 上线,2024 年 ARR 超 30 亿美元。
timeline.source_name: OpenAI (2022-11-30) ChatGPT launch blog
timeline.card_summary_zh: ChatGPT 把大模型从实验室带进日常对话，五天吸引百万用户，也让生成式 AI 成为全球公众议题。
timeline.summary_en: On November 30, 2022, OpenAI released ChatGPT (chat.openai.com) on its blog for a free public beta. Powered by GPT-3.5 (combining 2020's GPT-3 and 2022's InstructGPT RLHF fine-tuning), the chatbot supports multi-turn conversation, contextual memory, code generation, writing, and translation. It quickly became the fastest-growing service in history, hitting 1 million users in 5 days and 100 million MAUs in 2 months (compared to TikTok's 9 months and Instagram's 2.5 years), leading to a $29 billion valuation in January 2023, the launch of ChatGPT Plus in April 2023, and an ARR exceeding $3 billion by 2024.
timeline.card_summary_en: ChatGPT carried large models out of the lab and into everyday conversation, drawing a million users in five days and turning generative AI into a global public issue.
timeline.why_it_matters_en:
