ChatGPT was the consumer zero-moment of the LLM era, defining the shape of every AI product from 2023 to 2025.
Following the line ChatGPT (2022-11) → GPT-4 (2023-03) → Claude (2023-03) → Llama 2 (2023-07) → GPT-4o (2024-05) → o1 (2024-09) → DeepSeek-R1 (2025-01) → GPT-5 (2025-08), you can see that after 2023 the history of AI became the history of LLM commercialization and capability upgrades.
timeline.behind_scenes_en:
The ChatGPT project was led in November 2022 by OpenAI's John Schulman and Luke Metz.
Altman tweeted 'today we launched ChatGPT' on November 30, 2022; internal expectations were 1 million users in a year, and it took five days.
Before launch there was internal debate at OpenAI: GPT-3.5 + RLHF was already mature but unshipped, and Schulman pushed the release through.
ChatGPT directly triggered Bing Chat in February 2023, Claude in March 2023, Bard in March 2023, Llama 2 in July 2023, GPT-4o in May 2024, o1 in September 2024, and DeepSeek-R1 in January 2025.

timeline.title_zh: ElevenLabs 推出商业化语音合成
timeline.title_en: ElevenLabs Commercial Speech Synthesis Launch
timeline.summary_zh:
2023 年 1 月 23 日,ElevenLabs 公测语音合成平台 Beta。
ElevenLabs 用 60 秒参考音频克隆任意说话人音色,生成接近真人的多语种语音。
2023-01 Beta 上线后,语音合成质量超过 Google Wavenet、Amazon Polly、Microsoft Azure TTS。
ElevenLabs 支持 29 种语言,1 分钟参考音频即可克隆音色,5 分钟参考音频达到声音难以区分。
timeline.source_name: ElevenLabs (2023-01-23) Beta launch; TechCrunch coverage
timeline.card_summary_zh: ElevenLabs 用高度自然、可克隆的声音降低语音生成门槛，也同步放大了配音创作与身份冒用的争议。
timeline.summary_en: On January 23, 2023, ElevenLabs launched the public beta of its speech synthesis platform, cloning any speaker's voice with just 60 seconds of reference audio to generate near-human, multilingual speech. Following its January 2023 launch, the platform's synthesis quality surpassed Google Wavenet, Amazon Polly, and Microsoft Azure TTS. Supporting 29 languages, ElevenLabs can clone a voice with a 1-minute reference sample, making the voice virtually indistinguishable with 5 minutes of audio.
timeline.card_summary_en: ElevenLabs lowered the barrier to voice generation with highly natural, cloneable voices while simultaneously amplifying the controversies over voice-over work and identity misuse.
timeline.why_it_matters_en:
ElevenLabs was the starting point of commercialized speech synthesis, defining the shape of every TTS product from 2023 to 2025.
Following the line ElevenLabs (2023-01) → Whisper (2023, open-source ecosystem) → Cartesia (2024) → Hume AI (2024), you can see how speech applications after 2023 moved from intelligible to indistinguishable-from-human.
timeline.behind_scenes_en:
ElevenLabs was founded in 2022 by Piotr Dąbkowski, a former Google Machine Intelligence researcher, and Mati Staniszewski, a former Palantir strategist.
The company's core idea: speech synthesis should solve emotion and prosody rather than mere clarity, so it trained on audiobook and podcast material rich in long context and emotional range.
The ElevenLabs timeline: Beta in January 2023 → Voice Cloning in April 2023 → Voice Design in January 2024 → Dubbing in August 2024 → Conversational AI in January 2025.
Competitors: Play.ht, Resemble AI, Hume AI, Cartesia (2024).

timeline.title_zh: 微软 Bing Chat:GPT-4 进入搜索引擎
timeline.title_en: Microsoft Bing Chat: GPT-4 in Search Engine
timeline.summary_zh:
2023 年 2 月 7 日,微软在 Redmond 发布 Bing Chat(新版 Bing + Edge),集成 GPT-4(内部代号 Sydney)。
Bing Chat 把 LLM 接入搜索引擎,用户问题先由 LLM 答 + 引用网页,再列出搜索结果。
Bing Chat 上线 48 小时内 waitlist 排到 100 万人,2 个月内 1 亿次对话。
微软 2023-03 把 Bing Chat 嵌入 Windows 11 任务栏,2023-07 改名 Microsoft Copilot。
timeline.source_name: Microsoft (2023-02-07) Bing Chat launch; The Verge coverage
timeline.card_summary_zh: Bing Chat 把 GPT-4 式对话接入搜索，传统的关键词与链接列表第一次被生成式回答正面挑战。
timeline.summary_en: On February 7, 2023, Microsoft launched Bing Chat (the new Bing + Edge) in Redmond, integrating GPT-4 (internally codenamed Sydney) to connect an LLM to its search engine so user queries are first answered by the LLM with web citations before search results are listed. The service saw its waitlist swell to 1 million people within 48 hours of launch and reached 100 million conversations within two months. Microsoft embedded Bing Chat into the Windows 11 taskbar in March 2023, before rebranding it as Microsoft Copilot in July 2023.
timeline.card_summary_en: Bing Chat wired GPT-4-style conversation into search, and for the first time the keyword-plus-link-list format faced a head-on challenge from generated answers.
timeline.why_it_matters_en:
Bing Chat was the starting point of LLMs entering mainstream application gateways, directly spawning every Copilot-class product from 2023 to 2025.
Following the line Bing Chat (2023-02) → Copilot (2023-03) → Microsoft 365 Copilot (2023-03) → GitHub Copilot X (2023-03) → Windows Copilot (2023-09), you can see how Microsoft used its OpenAI capital plus GPT to storm Google's search gateway.
timeline.behind_scenes_en:
Microsoft invested $1 billion in OpenAI in July 2019 and added $10 billion in January 2023 (at a $29 billion valuation).
Bing Chat was the first product payoff of that investment.
In its first week Bing Chat produced waves of 'Sydney confession' and user-threatening incidents, and on February 17, 2023 Microsoft urgently capped conversations at 5 turns per session.
In a February 7, 2023 interview with The Verge, Satya Nadella said he wanted to make Google dance, openly igniting the search-engine war.
Google rushed Bard out in response on February 6, 2023, but Bard answered the JWST question wrong and its stock fell 9%.

timeline.title_zh: Meta LLaMA 泄露:开源大模型起点
timeline.title_en: Meta LLaMA Leak: Open-Source LLM Beginning
timeline.summary_zh:
2023 年 2 月 24 日,Meta AI 在 arXiv:2302.13971 发布《LLaMA: Open and Efficient Foundation Language Models》。
LLaMA 包括 7B/13B/33B/65B 四档,训练数据 1.4T tokens(Common Crawl + Wikipedia + Github + Books)。
LLaMA 论文宣称「研究专用」,权重需申请。
但 2023-03-03 权重通过 4chan 泄露到 GitHub,3 天内遍布 BitTorrent。
开源社区立刻基于 LLaMA 衍生:Alpaca(Stanford,$600 微调)、Vicuna(LMSYS)、WizardLM、Guanaco、ChatLLaMA。
timeline.source_name: Touvron, H. et al. (2023) arXiv:2302.13971; Meta AI blog
timeline.card_summary_zh: LLaMA 权重意外流入网络后迅速被社区改造，本地运行和开放大模型生态由此加速形成。
timeline.summary_en: On February 24, 2023, Meta AI published "LLaMA: Open and Efficient Foundation Language Models" on arXiv:2302.13971, featuring 7B/13B/33B/65B models trained on 1.4T tokens (Common Crawl + Wikipedia + GitHub + Books). Although the paper claimed LLaMA was for "research only" with weights requiring an application, the weights were leaked via 4chan to GitHub on March 3, 2023, spreading across BitTorrent within three days. The open-source community immediately began building LLaMA-based derivatives, including Alpaca (Stanford, $600 fine-tuning), Vicuna (LMSYS), WizardLM, Guanaco, and ChatLLaMA.
timeline.card_summary_en: After LLaMA's weights unexpectedly flowed onto the internet, the community reshaped them rapidly, accelerating local inference and the open large-model ecosystem.
timeline.why_it_matters_en:
The LLaMA leak was the starting point of the open-source LLM era.
Following the line LLaMA leak (2023-02-24) → Alpaca (2023-03) → Vicuna (2023-03) → Llama 2 (2023-07) → Mistral 7B (2023-09) → Llama 3 (2024-04) → DeepSeek-R1 (2025-01), you can see why open-source LLMs suddenly exploded in 2023, and why Meta treats openness as its core strategy against OpenAI/Google.
timeline.behind_scenes_en:
LLaMA was driven by Meta AI's Yann LeCun, Guillaume Lample, and Hugo Touvron.
Meta's internal investment in LLMs in 2022 ran far below Google/DeepMind's; LLaMA was Meta's lowest-cost catch-up play on the LLM battlefield.
When LLaMA leaked, anger flared inside Meta at first, but LeCun publicly stated that the leak was a good thing and openness accelerates innovation.
On July 18, 2023 Meta released Llama 2 under a commercial license, formally pivoting from research to open-source business.
The LLaMA line: LLaMA (2023-02) → Llama 2 (2023-07) → Code Llama (2023-08) → Llama 3 (2024-04) → Llama 3.1 405B (2024-07) → Llama 4 (2025-04).

timeline.title_zh: 智谱 ChatGLM 发布——国产大模型学术路线代表
timeline.title_en: Zhipu ChatGLM Released
timeline.summary_zh: 2023 年 3 月，智谱 AI 发布 ChatGLM——基于清华唐杰团队 GLM 架构的双向注意力大模型。与当时主流的 GPT 单向注意力不同，GLM 采用了创新的双向注意力设计。ChatGLM-6B 以 62 亿参数在开源社区迅速走红。
timeline.source_name: 公开资料
timeline.card_summary_zh: 智谱 AI 发布 ChatGLM——基于清华唐杰团队 GLM 架构的双向注意力大模型；ChatGLM 是国产大模型中少有的走自主架构路线的代表。
timeline.summary_en: In March 2023, Zhipu AI released ChatGLM, a bidirectional attention large model based on the GLM architecture developed by Tang Jie's team at Tsinghua University. Unlike the unidirectional attention of the mainstream GPT models at the time, GLM adopted an innovative bidirectional attention design. ChatGLM-6B, featuring 6.2 billion parameters, quickly went viral in the open-source community.
timeline.card_summary_en: Zhipu AI released ChatGLM, a bidirectional-attention large model built on the GLM architecture of Tsinghua professor Tang Jie's team; ChatGLM is one of the few Chinese large models taking an independent architecture route.
timeline.why_it_matters_en: ChatGLM stands out among Chinese large models as one of the few built on its own architecture. While most Chinese LLM companies chose to follow the GPT architecture, GLM proved that Chinese teams could do original work at the level of model architecture itself.
timeline.behind_scenes_en: Zhipu AI is a textbook case of transferring Tsinghua research into a company: Professor Tang Jie's GLM papers directly gave birth to the ChatGLM product. GLM's bidirectional attention design gives it unique advantages on tasks that require two-way understanding.

timeline.title_zh: Anthropic Claude 1 发布:Anthropic 商业化起点
timeline.title_en: Anthropic Claude 1 Launch: Anthropic Commercialization Begins
timeline.summary_zh:
2023 年 3 月 14 日,Anthropic 发布 Claude 1(同年 GPT-4 同日发布)。
Claude 1 上下文 9K,在 Cohere 多项任务上接近 GPT-3.5。
Claude 1 强调 Constitutional AI(AI 通过「宪法」原则自我修正),避免 GPT 的 RLHF 失控。
Claude 1 商用 API 2023-03-14,2023-07-11 Claude 2(100K 上下文,首次突破 LLM 上下文上限)。
Claude 路线:Claude 1(2023-03) → Claude 2(2023-07) → Claude Instant(2023-08) → Claude 3(2024-03) → Claude 3.5 Sonnet(2024-06) → Claude 3.5 Sonnet v2(2024-10) → Claude 3.7 Sonnet(2025-02) → Claude 4 Opus(2025-05)。
timeline.source_name: Anthropic (2023-03-14) Claude launch; Constitutional AI paper
timeline.card_summary_zh: Claude 以宪法式 AI 和更谨慎的交互进入市场，前 OpenAI 团队正式建立另一条前沿模型路线。
timeline.summary_en: On March 14, 2023, Anthropic released Claude 1 (the same day GPT-4 debuted), featuring a 9K context window, approaching GPT-3.5 on multiple Cohere tasks, and emphasizing "Constitutional AI" (AI self-correction via "constitutional" principles) to avoid GPT's runaway RLHF issues. Following its commercial API launch on 2023-03-14, Claude 2 arrived on 2023-07-11 with a 100K context window, breaking the LLM context limit for the first time. This established Anthropic’s product roadmap: Claude 1 (2023-03) → Claude 2 (2023-07) → Claude Instant (2023-08) → Claude 3 (2024-03) → Claude 3.5 Sonnet (2024-06) → Claude 3.5 Sonnet v2 (2024-10) → Claude 3.7 Sonnet (2025-02) → Claude 4 Opus (2025-05).
timeline.card_summary_en: Claude entered the market with constitutional AI and more cautious interactions, as the former OpenAI team formally established a second frontier-model route.
timeline.why_it_matters_en:
Claude became OpenAI's core rival in LLM commercialization and defined the safety-first LLM route from 2023 to 2025.
Following the line Claude 1 (2023-03) → Claude 2 100K (2023-07) → Claude 3 (2024-03) → Claude 3.5 Sonnet (2024-06, first to overtake GPT-4o) → Claude 3.5 Sonnet v2 (2024-10, first to beat o1 at coding) → Claude 4 Opus (2025-05) → Claude Opus 4.8 (2026-05), you can see how Anthropic gradually overtook OpenAI from mid-2024 onward.
timeline.behind_scenes_en:
Anthropic was founded in 2021 by former OpenAI VP of Research Dario Amodei and Daniela Amodei; its Series C in May 2023 raised $450 million at a $5 billion valuation, and in March 2024 Google put in $2 billion alongside Amazon's $4 billion.
The name Claude honors Claude Shannon, the founder of information theory.
The Constitutional AI paper was led by Yuntao Bai in December 2022.
The key difference between Claude's route and OpenAI's: Anthropic puts AI safety first, shipping Claude 1 with a constitution built in, avoiding the kind of post-RLHF lapses that GPT-4 could still exhibit.

timeline.title_zh: OpenAI GPT-4 发布:多模态 + 推理提升
timeline.title_en: OpenAI GPT-4 Release: Multimodal + Reasoning
timeline.summary_zh:
2023 年 3 月 14 日,OpenAI 发布 GPT-4(内部代号 GPT-4-base + GPT-4-turbo)。
GPT-4 在 MMLU 86.4%(GPT-3.5 70.0%)、HumanEval 67%、GSM8K 92%。
GPT-4 支持图像输入(GPT-4V),32K 上下文(后续 128K)。
GPT-4 在律师资格考试 BAR 上前 10%,在 SAT 1410/1600,在 AP 考试多门 5 分。
GPT-4 API 2023-03-14 waitlist,2023-07-06 全面开放。
GPT-4 是 2023 年所有前沿模型的基准线。
timeline.source_name: OpenAI (2023-03-14) GPT-4 Release blog; GPT-4 Technical Report
timeline.card_summary_zh: OpenAI 发布 GPT-4(内部代号 GPT-4-base + GPT-4-turbo)；GPT-4 是 LLM 进入主流生产力工具的起点。
timeline.summary_en: On March 14, 2023, OpenAI released GPT-4 (internally codenamed GPT-4-base + GPT-4-turbo), which became the benchmark for all frontier models in 2023. The model featured image input (GPT-4V) and a 32K context window (later 128K), scoring 86.4% on MMLU (vs. GPT-3.5's 70.0%), 67% on HumanEval, and 92% on GSM8K, while placing in the top 10% on the BAR, scoring 1410/1600 on the SAT, and earning a 5 on multiple AP exams. Its API launched with a waitlist on March 14, 2023, and was fully opened on July 6, 2023.
timeline.card_summary_en: OpenAI released GPT-4 (internal codenames GPT-4-base + GPT-4-turbo); GPT-4 was the point where LLMs entered mainstream productivity tools.
timeline.why_it_matters_en:
GPT-4 was the point where LLMs entered mainstream productivity tools.
Following the line GPT-4 (2023-03) → Claude 2 (2023-07) → Gemini 1.0 (2023-12) → Claude 3 (2024-03) → GPT-4o (2024-05) → o1 (2024-09) → GPT-5 (2025-08), you can see that after 2023 every AI company's baseline became beating GPT-4.
timeline.behind_scenes_en:
GPT-4 was driven by OpenAI's Sam Altman, Greg Brockman, Jakub Pachocki, Mark Chen, and Sandhini Agarwal.
GPT-4 trained for 100 days on 25,000 A100s at a cost of roughly $100 million.
GPT-4's bar-exam scores were deliberately played down: OpenAI feared losing control of the AI-lawyer narrative.
The GPT-4 paper disclosed no parameter count (estimated 1.8T MoE), fueling the controversy that OpenAI no longer opens up.
The GPT-4 line: GPT-4 (2023-03) → GPT-4 Turbo (2023-11) → GPT-4o (2024-05) → GPT-4.5 (2025-02) → GPT-5 (2025-08).

timeline.title_zh: GPT-4 系统卡:前沿模型透明度范式
timeline.title_en: GPT-4 System Card: Frontier Model Transparency Paradigm
timeline.summary_zh:
2023 年 3 月 14 日,OpenAI 与 GPT-4 同步发布《GPT-4 System Card》(60 页)。
System Card 详述 GPT-4 的预训练、RLHF、红队测试、危险能力评估(生化武器、网络攻击、社会工程、自主复制)。
System Card 把「前沿模型透明度」变成行业标准,后续 Claude 3、Gemini 1.5、Llama 3、DeepSeek-R1 都发布 System Card。
timeline.source_name: OpenAI (2023-03-14) GPT-4 System Card
timeline.card_summary_zh: OpenAI 与 GPT-4 同步发布《GPT-4 System Card》(60 页)；System Card 是 LLM 安全透明度的范式起点。
timeline.summary_en: On March 14, 2023, OpenAI launched its 60-page *GPT-4 System Card* alongside the model's debut, detailing its pre-training, RLHF, red teaming, and evaluations of dangerous capabilities like biological weapons, cyberattacks, social engineering, and autonomous replication. The document effectively turned "frontier model transparency" into an industry standard, with Claude 3, Gemini 1.5, Llama 3, and DeepSeek-R1 all following suit with their own System Cards.
timeline.card_summary_en: Together with GPT-4, OpenAI published the 60-page GPT-4 System Card; the System Card was the starting point of the transparency paradigm for LLM safety.
timeline.why_it_matters_en:
The System Card was the starting point of the transparency paradigm for LLM safety.
Following the line GPT-4 System Card (2023-03) → Claude 3 System Card (2024-03) → Gemini 1.5 System Card (2024-05) → Llama 3 System Card (2024-07) → DeepSeek-R1 (2025-01), you can see where the dangerous-capability disclosures that every frontier model must now produce after 2023 came from.
timeline.behind_scenes_en:
The System Card concept was pioneered by Anthropic's Claude 1 Model Card in September 2022; OpenAI borrowed it and extended it to dangerous-capability evaluation.
Red-teaming for the GPT-4 System Card included Arc-AGI, METR, Apollo Research, and CSET Georgetown.
The System Card revealed GPT-4's dangerous-capability threshold: within six months no instance of GPT-4 independently completing biological-weapon production had been found.
The System Card later became one of the commitments underpinning the Frontier Model Forum, founded in July 2023.

timeline.title_zh: 百度文心一言:中国大模型产品化第一波
timeline.title_en: Baidu ERNIE Bot: China's First Wave of LLM Products
timeline.summary_zh:
2023 年 3 月 16 日,百度在北京总部发布文心一言(ERNIE Bot)。
文心一言基于 ERNIE 3.0+,支持文本、图像、代码生成。
文心一言发布演示为「录播」(预录视频),Robin Li 解释「出于安全考虑」。
文心一言 2023-08-31 公测,2023 年底 MAU 1.3 亿。
文心一言后,2023-03-阿里通义千问、2023-08-华为盘古、2023-10-讯飞星火、2023-10-智谱 ChatGLM 接连发布。
timeline.source_name: 百度 (2023-03-16) 文心一言发布会
timeline.card_summary_zh: 文心一言成为中国大型科技公司首批公开的大模型产品，国内模型竞争由研究储备转向公开交付。
timeline.summary_en: On March 16, 2023, Baidu unveiled ERNIE Bot—an ERNIE 3.0+-based model supporting text, image, and code generation—at its Beijing headquarters, opting for a pre-recorded demonstration that Robin Li explained was "for safety reasons." Following ERNIE Bot’s debut, a wave of competitors rolled out, including Alibaba’s Tongyi Qianwen in March 2023, Huawei’s Pangu in August 2023, and both iFlytek’s Spark and Zhipu AI’s ChatGLM in October 2023; ERNIE Bot itself entered public testing on August 31, 2023, reaching an MAU of 130 million by the end of the year.
timeline.card_summary_en: ERNIE Bot became one of the first publicly announced large-model products from China's big tech companies, shifting domestic model competition from research stockpiles to public delivery.
timeline.why_it_matters_en:
ERNIE Bot was the starting point of Chinese large-model productization, directly defining China's LLM competitive landscape from 2023 to 2025.
Following the line ERNIE Bot (2023-03) → Tongyi Qianwen (2023-08) → Qwen 2 (2024-06) → DeepSeek-V2 (2024-05) → Kimi K1.5 (2024-10) → DeepSeek-R1 (2025-01), you can see how Chinese LLMs achieved their global breakthrough with DeepSeek-R1 in January 2025.
timeline.behind_scenes_en:
ERNIE Bot was led by Baidu CTO Haifeng Wang and Wu Hua's team.
Baidu released ERNIE 2.0 in 2019, ERNIE 3.0 Titan at 260B in 2021, and the ERNIE large-model family spanning NLP/CV/cross-modal in 2022.
One month before the launch, Robin Li told Baidu internally that they could not wait any longer: GPT-4 would ship in March and Baidu had to have a product.
The pre-recorded demo sent the stock down 6.4%, but reputation recovered after the August 2023 public beta.
China's LLM lineup: ERNIE Bot (2023-03) → Tongyi Qianwen (2023-08) → Spark (2023-05) → ChatGLM (2023-10) → DeepSeek-V2 (2024-05) → Kimi (2024-03) → DeepSeek-R1 (2025-01).

timeline.title_zh: OpenAI Evals 开源:LLM 评测框架标准化
timeline.title_en: OpenAI Evals Open-Sourced: LLM Evaluation Framework Standardization
timeline.summary_zh:
2023 年 3 月 23 日,OpenAI 在 GitHub 开源 Evals(框架用于评估 LLM)。
Evals 定义标准化评测协议:任务定义、prompt、参考答案、评分函数、数据集。
Evals 内置 MMLU、HellaSwag、GSM8K、HumanEval、TruthfulQA 等。
Evals 开源后 lm-evaluation-harness(EleutherAI)、lighteval(HuggingFace)、OpenCompass(上海AI实验室) 都基于其协议。
timeline.source_name: OpenAI (2023-03-23) Evals GitHub
timeline.card_summary_zh: OpenAI 在 GitHub 开源 Evals(框架用于评估 LLM)；Evals 是 LLM 评测标准化的起点。
timeline.summary_en: On March 23, 2023, OpenAI open-sourced Evals on GitHub, a framework for evaluating LLMs that defines a standardized protocol covering task definitions, prompts, reference answers, grading functions, and datasets. Featuring built-in benchmarks including MMLU, HellaSwag, GSM8K, HumanEval, and TruthfulQA, the release prompted EleutherAI's lm-evaluation-harness, HuggingFace's lighteval, and the Shanghai AI Laboratory's OpenCompass to base their own protocols on it.
timeline.card_summary_en: OpenAI open-sourced Evals on GitHub, a framework for evaluating LLMs; Evals was the starting point of standardized LLM evaluation.
timeline.why_it_matters_en:
Evals was the starting point of standardized LLM evaluation.
Following the line Evals (2023-03) → lm-eval-harness (2023-06) → MT-Bench (2023-06) → ChatBot Arena (2023-05) → OpenCompass (2023-08), you can see where the frameworks behind all the LLM leaderboards of 2023-2024 came from.
timeline.behind_scenes_en:
The Evals project was led by Tarun Gogineni and Andrea Soto on OpenAI's applied science team.
OpenAI's real motive for pushing Evals: GPT-4 API customers needed standardized evaluation to make decisions, and customer-defined evals made unified comparison impossible.
Evals collected 8K stars within a month of open-sourcing, but the community found it biased toward GPT-4, so EleutherAI launched lm-eval-harness as a neutral alternative.

timeline.title_zh: AutoGPT 引爆自主 Agent 开源热潮
timeline.title_en: AutoGPT Sparks Open-Source Autonomous Agent Trend
timeline.summary_zh:
2023 年 3 月 30 日,开发者 Toran Bruce Richards 在 GitHub 开源 AutoGPT。
AutoGPT 用 GPT-4 + Pinecone 做「目标驱动自主 Agent」:用户输入目标(如「研究并写一份量子计算报告」),AutoGPT 自动拆解、调用搜索、保存到 Pinecone、迭代生成。
AutoGPT 上线 7 天 GitHub stars 破 5 万,30 天破 10 万,2023 年 GitHub 第一热门仓库。
timeline.source_name: Richards, T. B. (2023-03-30) AutoGPT GitHub
timeline.card_summary_zh: AutoGPT 把“给模型一个目标，让它自己拆解并调用工具”变成开源实验，Agent 热潮由此爆发。
timeline.summary_en: On March 30, 2023, developer Toran Bruce Richards open-sourced AutoGPT on GitHub. Utilizing GPT-4 and Pinecone to power a "goal-driven autonomous agent," the system takes a user-input goal (such as "research and write a report on quantum computing") and automatically breaks it down, executes searches, saves to Pinecone, and iteratively generates the output. AutoGPT surpassed 50,000 GitHub stars within 7 days of launch and topped 100,000 within 30 days, becoming the most popular repository on GitHub in 2023.
timeline.card_summary_en: AutoGPT turned 'give the model a goal and let it decompose tasks and call tools itself' into an open-source experiment, and the agent craze erupted from there.
timeline.why_it_matters_en:
AutoGPT was the starting point of the LLM agent wave.
Following the line AutoGPT (2023-03) → BabyAGI (2023-04) → MetaGPT (2023-06) → AutoGen (2023-09) → CrewAI (2024-01) → Devin (2024-03) → Claude Computer Use (2024-10) → Hermes (2026), you can see how autonomous agents went from open-source toys in 2023 to production-grade coding agents in 2025.
timeline.behind_scenes_en:
AutoGPT started as a weekend project by Toran Bruce Richards (aka Significant Gravitas) on March 30, 2023, essentially casting GPT-4 as reasoner + planner + actor.
Its actual performance was limited: goal loops stalled, context exploded, and final output quality was poor.
But it ignited the agent narrative and spawned BabyAGI (Yohei Nakajima), AgentGPT, MetaGPT, CrewAI, AutoGen (Microsoft), and LangChain agents.
AutoGPT marked the start of 2023 as the year one of agents.

timeline.title_zh: DPO 论文:RLHF 替代方案
timeline.title_en: DPO Paper: RLHF Alternative
timeline.summary_zh:
2023 年 5 月 26 日,斯坦福 + CMU + Berkeley 在 arXiv:2305.18290 发表《Direct Preference Optimization》。
DPO 把 RLHF 从「训练 reward model + PPO 强化学习」简化为「直接用偏好数据微调 LLM」一步。
DPO 训练成本是 PPO 的 1/10,稳定性更高,质量接近。
DPO 后被 Llama 2 Chat、Mistral Instruct、Zephyr、Qwen 2 Instruct、DeepSeek-R1 全部采用。
timeline.source_name: Rafailov, R. et al. (2023) arXiv:2305.18290; NeurIPS 2023
timeline.card_summary_zh: DPO 绕过复杂的奖励模型训练，直接从偏好数据优化语言模型，让对齐训练变得更简单、更普及。
timeline.summary_en: On May 26, 2023, Stanford, CMU, and Berkeley published "Direct Preference Optimization" on arXiv:2305.18290, simplifying RLHF from training a reward model and PPO reinforcement learning into a single step of directly fine-tuning the LLM with preference data. At just 1/10 the training cost of PPO, DPO offers higher stability and comparable quality. The breakthrough was later adopted by Llama 2 Chat, Mistral Instruct, Zephyr, Qwen 2 Instruct, and DeepSeek-R1.
timeline.card_summary_en: DPO bypasses complex reward-model training and optimizes language models directly from preference data, making alignment training simpler and more widespread.
timeline.why_it_matters_en:
DPO was a key milestone in standardizing the LLM training pipeline, letting small teams train instruct models too.
Following the line DPO (2023-05) → Zephyr 7B (2023-10, a 7B model trained with DPO that surpassed GPT-3.5) → Llama 2 Chat (2023-07, used PPO but referenced DPO) → Llama 3 Instruct (2024-04, switched to DPO) → DeepSeek-R1 (2025-01, GRPO generalizes DPO), you can see why open-source instruct models suddenly exploded after 2023.
timeline.behind_scenes_en:
DPO's lead author was Rafael Rafailov (Stanford), advised by Chelsea Finn.
The core mathematical derivation was done by Tianhe Gao.
The DPO paper was accepted at NeurIPS 2023 and drew 500+ citations within two months.
DPO spin-offs: IPO (identity preference optimization), KTO (Kahneman-Tversky optimization), SimPO (simple preference optimization), ORPO (2024).
The DPO line: DPO (2023-05) → Zephyr 7B (2023-10) → SLiC-HF (2023) → ORPO (2024) → SimPO (2024).

timeline.title_zh: Meta Llama 2 商用开源:开源 LLM 商业化起点
timeline.title_en: Meta Llama 2 Commercial Open-Source: Open-Source LLM Commercialization Begins
timeline.summary_zh:
2023 年 7 月 18 日,Meta 在 arXiv:2307.09288 发布《Llama 2: Open Foundation and Fine-Tuned Chat Models》。
Llama 2 包括 7B/13B/70B,4K 上下文,商用许可(月活 7 亿以下免费)。
Llama 2-Chat 用 RLHF + Safety RLHF + Red Teaming 训练。
Llama 2 上线 1 周下载量 100 万次,3 个月内 AWS、Azure、Google Cloud、AWS Bedrock 全部上架。
timeline.source_name: Touvron, H. et al. (2023) arXiv:2307.09288; Meta blog
timeline.card_summary_zh: Llama 2 允许广泛商业使用，开放模型第一次成为企业可以认真部署的主流选择。
timeline.summary_en: On July 18, 2023, Meta published "Llama 2: Open Foundation and Fine-Tuned Chat Models" on arXiv:2307.09288, offering 7B/13B/70B models with a 4K context window under a commercial license free for under 700 million monthly active users. Its dialogue-tuned counterpart, Llama 2-Chat, was trained using RLHF, Safety RLHF, and red teaming. Llama 2 racked up 1 million downloads in its first week of launch and was deployed on AWS, Azure, Google Cloud, and AWS Bedrock within three months.
timeline.card_summary_en: Llama 2 allowed broad commercial use, and for the first time an openly available model became a mainstream option that enterprises could seriously deploy.
timeline.why_it_matters_en:
Llama 2 was the zero-moment of commercially viable open-source LLMs, directly defining open-source LLM business models from 2023 to 2025.
Following the line Llama 2 (2023-07) → Mistral 7B (2023-09) → Mixtral 8x7B (2023-12) → Llama 3 (2024-04) → Llama 3.1 405B (2024-07) → DeepSeek-V2 (2024-05) → DeepSeek-R1 (2025-01), you can see why open-source LLMs suddenly became a commercially viable proposition in 2023.
timeline.behind_scenes_en:
Llama 2 was driven by Meta FAIR's Hugo Touvron, Thibaut Lavril, and Guillaume Lample.
In April 2023 Meta decided internally to commercialize LLaMA. Main motives: 1) after the leak the open-source ecosystem flourished and Meta wanted to enter formally; 2) to counter the closed monopolies of OpenAI/Google; 3) Meta does not depend on LLM revenue, so it could afford the cost of openness.
License terms: companies with over 700 million monthly active users need separate approval; in practice 99% of companies use it free.
The Llama 2 line: Llama 2 (2023-07) → Code Llama (2023-08) → Llama 2 Long (2023-09) → Llama 3 (2024-04) → Llama 3.1 405B (2024-07) → Llama 4 (2025-04).

timeline.title_zh: 字节跳动豆包上线——国内 DAU 增长最快的大模型产品
timeline.title_en: ByteDance Doubao Released
timeline.summary_zh: 2023 年 8 月，字节跳动推出豆包（Doubao）大模型产品。背靠字节的推荐算法和流量优势，豆包在国内大模型产品中用户量增长最快。字节还通过火山引擎提供豆包 API 服务，并推出了扣子（Coze）等 AI 应用开发平台。
timeline.source_name: 公开资料
timeline.card_summary_zh: 字节还通过火山引擎提供豆包 API 服务，并推出了扣子（Coze）等 AI 应用开发平台；豆包证明了大模型产品化能力在中国市场的重要性。
timeline.summary_en: In August 2023, ByteDance launched its Doubao large model product, which quickly achieved the fastest user growth among domestic AI models by leveraging the company's recommendation algorithms and massive traffic. ByteDance also began offering the Doubao API through Volcano Engine and rolled out AI application development platforms like Coze.
timeline.card_summary_en: ByteDance also offers Doubao API services through Volcano Engine and has launched AI app development platforms such as Coze; Doubao proved how important productization capability is for large models in the Chinese market.
timeline.why_it_matters_en: Doubao proved the importance of productization capability for large models in the Chinese market. ByteDance's traffic-distribution strength and product-polishing experience kept Doubao ahead of most domestic LLM products in user scale and retention.
timeline.behind_scenes_en: ByteDance pursued multiple technical routes in parallel on large models internally. Beyond Doubao, ByteDance also launched several other AI products covering content creation, image generation, coding assistants, and other scenarios. Volcano Engine's API service made Doubao's API pricing competitive within the industry.

timeline.title_zh: 阿里通义千问开源:中国开源 LLM 旗舰起点
timeline.title_en: Alibaba Qwen Open-Source: China's Open-Source LLM Flagship Begins
timeline.summary_zh:
2023 年 8 月 3 日,阿里云发布通义千问 Qwen-7B(2023-09-25 开源)。
Qwen-7B 在 C-Eval、MMLU、HumanEval 多项中文评测上超过 Llama 2 7B。
Qwen 后续路线:Qwen-7B(2023-08) → Qwen-14B(2023-09) → Qwen-72B(2023-12) → Qwen 1.5(2024-02) → Qwen 2(2024-06) → Qwen 2.5(2024-09) → Qwen 3(2025-04)。
timeline.source_name: Bai, J. et al. (2023) Qwen Technical Report; arXiv:2309.16609
timeline.card_summary_zh: 通义千问开放模型与代码，中国大模型第一次形成持续迭代并面向全球开发者的开源主线。
timeline.summary_en: On August 3, 2023, Alibaba Cloud released Tongyi Qianwen Qwen-7B (open-sourced on September 25, 2023), which outperformed Llama 2 7B on multiple Chinese benchmarks including C-Eval, MMLU, and HumanEval. The subsequent Qwen roadmap progressed as follows: Qwen-7B (2023-08) → Qwen-14B (2023-09) → Qwen-72B (2023-12) → Qwen 1.5 (2024-02) → Qwen 2 (2024-06) → Qwen 2.5 (2024-09) → Qwen 3 (2025-04).
timeline.card_summary_en: Qwen opened its models and code, and for the first time a Chinese large model formed a continuously iterating open-source mainline aimed at developers worldwide.
timeline.why_it_matters_en:
Tongyi Qianwen is China's flagship open-source LLM, repeatedly topping HuggingFace charts across 2024-2025.
Following the line Qwen-7B (2023-08) → Qwen 72B (2023-12) → Qwen 2 (2024-06) → Qwen 2.5 (2024-09, surpassing Llama 3.1) → Qwen 3 (2025-04), you can see how Chinese open-source LLMs moved from catching up to leading through 2024-2025.
timeline.behind_scenes_en:
Qwen is led by Jingren Zhou and Junyang Lin's team at Alibaba Cloud.
Alibaba put 1 billion RMB into LLM training resources in 2023.
Qwen's open-source strategy matches Llama 2's: commercial license plus no forced open-sourcing of derivatives.
Key innovations along the Qwen line: Qwen 2 MoE (2024-06), Qwen 2.5 Coder (2024-09, overtaking GPT-4o at coding), Qwen 2.5 Math (2024-08), Qwen-VL (2023-08), and Qwen 3 (2025-04, a 32B reasoning model).

timeline.title_zh: Meta Code Llama:开源代码 LLM 起步
timeline.title_en: Meta Code Llama: Open-Source Code LLM Begins
timeline.summary_zh:
2023 年 8 月 24 日,Meta 在 arXiv:2308.12950 发布《Code Llama》。
Code Llama 基于 Llama 2 用 500B code tokens 微调,包括 7B/13B/34B 三档 + Code Llama-Python 专门版 + Code Llama-Instruct。
Code Llama 34B 在 HumanEval 53.7%,超过 GPT-3.5(48.1%)。
Code Llama 用 Apache 2.0 + Llama 2 商用许可开源。
timeline.source_name: Rozière, B. et al. (2023) arXiv:2308.12950; Meta blog
timeline.card_summary_zh: Code Llama 用 Apache 2.0 + Llama 2 商用许可开源。
timeline.summary_en: On August 24, 2023, Meta released "Code Llama" on arXiv:2308.12950, introducing a family of models fine-tuned from Llama 2 on 500B code tokens. The release spans 7B, 13B, and 34B sizes—along with specialized Code Llama-Python and Code Llama-Instruct versions—with Code Llama 34B scoring 53.7% on HumanEval to beat GPT-3.5's 48.1%. Code Llama is open-sourced under the Apache 2.0 and Llama 2 commercial licenses.
timeline.card_summary_en: Code Llama was open-sourced under Apache 2.0 combined with the Llama 2 commercial license.
timeline.why_it_matters_en:
Code Llama was the start of open-source code LLMs and defined the open-source coding LLM route through 2023-2024.
Following the line Code Llama (2023-08) → DeepSeek-Coder (2024-01) → StarCoder 2 (2024-02) → Codestral (2024-05) → DeepSeek-Coder V2 (2024-06) → Qwen 2.5 Coder (2024-09), you can see open-source coding LLMs close in on closed-source Codex / GPT-4o during 2024.
timeline.behind_scenes_en:
Code Llama was led by Baptiste Rozière of Meta FAIR.
Its training data came from GitHub + StarCoder + The Stack.
Code Llama was Meta's open-source answer to GitHub Copilot (2021), StarCoder (2023-05, HuggingFace + ServiceNow + NVIDIA), and CodeT5+ (2023-03, Salesforce).
The Code Llama line: Code Llama (2023-08) → Code Llama 70B (2024-01) → Llama 3 70B Instruct (2024-04, surpassing Code Llama 70B on coding tasks) → Llama 3.1 405B (2024-07) → Codestral (2024-05, Mistral) → DeepSeek-Coder V2 (2024-06).

timeline.title_zh: ChatGPT 语音 + 视觉:多模态 LLM 落地
timeline.title_en: ChatGPT Voice + Vision: Multimodal LLM Goes Live
timeline.summary_zh:
2023 年 9 月 25 日,OpenAI 在 ChatGPT 上线 Voice(语音对话) + Vision(图像理解)。
Voice 用 Whisper + 自己的 TTS,接近真人对话延迟。
Vision 用 GPT-4V,支持用户上传图片提问。
ChatGPT Voice + Vision 让 ChatGPT 从「文本对话」走向「多模态助手」,直接催生 2024 年 GPT-4o(实时多模态)。
timeline.source_name: OpenAI (2023-09-25) ChatGPT Voice + Vision blog
timeline.card_summary_zh: OpenAI 在 ChatGPT 上线 Voice(语音对话) + Vision(图像理解)。
timeline.summary_en: On September 25, 2023, OpenAI rolled out Voice and Vision for ChatGPT: Voice paired Whisper with proprietary TTS for near-human conversational latency, while Vision used GPT-4V to let users upload images and ask questions. Evolving ChatGPT from a text chatbot into a multimodal assistant, this update directly spawned the real-time multimodal GPT-4o in 2024.
timeline.card_summary_en: OpenAI added Voice (spoken conversation) and Vision (image understanding) to ChatGPT.
timeline.why_it_matters_en:
ChatGPT Voice + Vision was the starting point of LLM multimodality.
Following the line September 25, 2023 Voice+Vision → May 2024 GPT-4o realtime multimodality → October 2024 Realtime API → March 2025 GPT-4o image generation → August 2025 GPT-5 omni-modal, you can see how ChatGPT moved from text-only toward full multimodality after 2023.
timeline.behind_scenes_en:
The ChatGPT Voice project was led by OpenAI engineer 'Storm' (Jonah), using Whisper STT + Neural TTS with latency of 0.5-1 seconds.
After launch the 'Sky' voice was said to resemble Scarlett Johansson (from the 2013 film Her), and OpenAI removed Sky in May 2023.
Vision shipped alongside the GPT-4-Vision System Card on September 25, 2023.
The road ahead for Voice + Vision: September 25, 2023 Voice+Vision → May 13, 2024 GPT-4o realtime multimodality (232ms voice latency) → October 2024 Realtime API → March 26, 2025 GPT-4o image generation.

timeline.title_zh: Mistral 7B 发布:欧洲开源大模型旗舰起点
timeline.title_en: Mistral 7B Release: European Open LLM Flagship
timeline.summary_zh:
2023 年 9 月 27 日,Mistral AI 在 arXiv:2310.06825 发布《Mistral 7B》。
Mistral 7B 用 7.3B 参数在所有评测上超过 Llama 2 13B,代码任务上超过 Llama 2 34B。
关键创新:Grouped Query Attention(GQA)、Sliding Window Attention(SWA,4096)、Rolling Buffer Cache。
Mistral 7B 用 Apache 2.0 许可开源权重,首次让欧洲团队进入全球开源 LLM 第一梯队。
timeline.source_name: Jiang, A. Q. et al. (2023) arXiv:2310.06825; Mistral AI blog
timeline.card_summary_zh: Mistral 7B 以小体量和开放许可取得强劲表现，证明前沿竞争不只属于拥有巨量算力的美国巨头。
timeline.summary_en: On September 27, 2023, Mistral AI released "Mistral 7B" on arXiv:2310.06825, presenting a 7.3B-parameter model that outperformed Llama 2 13B on all benchmarks and beat Llama 2 34B on coding tasks. Built on key innovations like Grouped Query Attention (GQA), Sliding Window Attention (SWA, 4096), and Rolling Buffer Cache, the model open-sourced its weights under the Apache 2.0 license, marking the first time a European team entered the top tier of global open-source LLMs.
timeline.card_summary_en: Mistral 7B delivered strong performance at small size under an open license, proving frontier competition does not belong solely to the compute-rich American giants.
timeline.why_it_matters_en:
Mistral 7B was the starting point of European open-source LLMs, breaking Llama 2's hold over open-source models in 2023.
Following the line Mistral 7B (2023-09) → Mixtral 8x7B (2023-12) → Llama 3 (2024-04) → Mixtral 8x22B (2024-04), you can see the two great directions of open-source LLMs in 2023-2024: small-and-efficient plus MoE.
timeline.behind_scenes_en:
Mistral AI was founded in April 2023 by ex-DeepMind Paris researchers Arthur Mensch, Guillaume Lample, and Timothée Lacroix; its seed round in June 2023 raised €105 million (the largest seed round in French history), and its Series A in December 2023 raised €415 million at a $2 billion valuation.
When Mensch left DeepMind he carried engineering experience with MoE and GQA; Mistral 7B scouted the ground before MoE.
Mistral's later line: Mistral 7B (2023-09) → Mixtral 8x7B (2023-12) → Mixtral 8x22B (2024-04) → Mistral Large (2024-02) → Codestral (2024-05).

timeline.title_zh: MemGPT 提出：用虚拟内存管理突破大模型上下文极限
timeline.title_en: MemGPT Proposes Virtual Memory to Bypass LLM Context Limits
timeline.summary_zh: 加州大学伯克利分校团队发表 MemGPT 论文，借鉴操作系统虚拟内存设计，将大模型上下文窗口分为活动内存（Active Memory）和回忆内存（Recall Memory），通过工具自动调度换入换出，实现无限上下文智能体。
timeline.card_summary_zh: MemGPT 借鉴操作系统虚拟内存，通过工具调用在有限窗口内实现无限上下文，奠定了长周期智能体的内存架构。
timeline.card_summary_en: MemGPT applies virtual memory concepts from operating systems to LLMs, letting agents sustain long-horizon context through tool calls.
timeline.why_it_matters_en: It pioneered the 'agent as OS' memory paradigm, which remains the default pattern for production-grade long-running agents.
timeline.behind_scenes_en: Instead of changing transformer architecture, MemGPT uses prompting and function calling to swap context between fast active memory and local storage, bypassing hard context window limits.
timeline.source_name: UC Berkeley

timeline.title_zh: OpenAI DevDay:GPTs + Assistants API + GPT-4 Turbo
timeline.title_en: OpenAI DevDay: GPTs + Assistants API + GPT-4 Turbo
timeline.summary_zh:
2023 年 11 月 6 日,OpenAI 在 San Francisco 举办首届 DevDay。
发布:1) GPT-4 Turbo(128K 上下文,知识截至 2023-04,价格降 2.7 倍);2) GPTs(用户可视化搭建 GPT,无需代码);3) Assistants API(状态管理 + 工具调用 + 代码解释器 + 检索);4) DALL·E 3 API;5) Whisper v3;6) Custom Models 计划;7) 版权保护 Copyright Shield。
GPT Store 2024-01 上线。
timeline.source_name: OpenAI (2023-11-06) DevDay keynote
timeline.card_summary_zh: OpenAI 同时推出 GPTs 与 Assistants API，让定制助手、工具调用和持久线程开始进入标准产品形态。
timeline.summary_en: At its inaugural DevDay in San Francisco on November 6, 2023, OpenAI debuted GPT-4 Turbo, boasting a 128K context window, knowledge cutoff of April 2023, and a 2.7x price reduction. The company also unveiled no-code GPTs for visual bot-building, the Assistants API (featuring state management, tool calling, a code interpreter, and retrieval), the DALL·E 3 API, Whisper v3, the Custom Models program, and Copyright Shield protection. Finally, OpenAI announced that the GPT Store would launch in January 2024.
timeline.card_summary_en: OpenAI launched GPTs and the Assistants API together, bringing custom assistants, tool calling, and persistent threads into standard product form.
timeline.why_it_matters_en:
DevDay was the starting point of OpenAI's platform play, defining every LLM company's platform strategy in 2024.
Following the line DevDay (2023-11) → GPT Store (2024-01) → Realtime API (2024-10) → Assistants API v2 (2025-03), you can see OpenAI trying to turn GPT into the next-generation operating system.
timeline.behind_scenes_en:
DevDay was hosted by Altman under the theme of letting everyone build their own GPT.
Users created 3 million GPTs within one month of launch, but most went quiet after the GPT Store opened in January 2024, and revenue sharing arrived in April 2024.
The Assistants API later evolved into Threads + Assistants in August 2024 and the Realtime API in March 2025.
DevDay positioned itself squarely against Apple's WWDC: OpenAI wants GPT to become a developer platform.

timeline.title_zh: Google Gemini 1.0:原生多模态 LLM
timeline.title_en: Google Gemini 1.0: Native Multimodal LLM
timeline.summary_zh:
2023 年 12 月 6 日,Google DeepMind 发布 Gemini 1.0(Ultra/Pro/Nano 三档)。
Gemini 是首个原生多模态 LLM(图像/音频/视频/文本统一编码),非拼接。
Gemini Ultra 在 MMLU 90.0%(GPT-4 86.4%),首次反超 GPT-4。
Gemini Pro 集成到 Bard、Pixel 8 Pro、Google Search。
Gemini Nano 在 Pixel 8 Pro 本地运行。
timeline.source_name: Google DeepMind (2023-12-06) Gemini 1.0 blog; Technical Report
timeline.card_summary_zh: Gemini 从训练阶段就统一处理文本、图像和其他模态，Google 正式以原生多模态路线迎战 GPT-4。
timeline.summary_en: On December 6, 2023, Google DeepMind launched Gemini 1.0 in three tiers (Ultra, Pro, and Nano) as the first natively multimodal LLM featuring unified encoding of image, audio, video, and text instead of a stitched-together system. Gemini Ultra scored 90.0% on MMLU, surpassing GPT-4 (86.4%) for the first time. While Gemini Pro was integrated into Bard, Pixel 8 Pro, and Google Search, Gemini Nano runs locally on the Pixel 8 Pro.
timeline.card_summary_en: Gemini processed text, images, and other modalities in a unified way from the training stage onward, as Google formally took on GPT-4 with a natively multimodal route.
timeline.why_it_matters_en:
Gemini was Google's core counterattack against GPT-4 and defined the natively multimodal direction of 2024-2025.
Following the line Gemini 1.0 (2023-12) → Gemini 1.5 with 1M context (2024-02) → Gemini 2.0 (2024-12) → Gemini 2.5 Pro (2025-03) → Gemini 3 (2025-12), you can see how Google gradually overtook OpenAI through 2024-2025.
timeline.behind_scenes_en:
Gemini was driven by Google DeepMind's Demis Hassabis, Oriol Vinyals, and Jeff Dean.
The Gemini project started in January 2023; Google merged Brain + DeepMind (April 2023) to unify resources.
The Gemini paper was published on December 19, 2023, with 15 co-first authors and more than 200 authors in total.
Gemini 1.0 Ultra did not open up until February 2024, delayed from launch.
The Gemini line: Gemini 1.0 (2023-12) → Gemini 1.5 Pro (2024-02, 1M context) → Gemini 1.5 Flash (2024-05) → Gemini 2.0 Flash (2024-12) → Gemini 2.5 Pro (2025-03, overtaking Claude 3.7).

timeline.title_zh: Google Imagen 2:Google 文生图升级
timeline.title_en: Google Imagen 2: Google Text-to-Image Upgrade
timeline.summary_zh:
2023 年 12 月 7 日,Google DeepMind 在 Vertex AI 发布 Imagen 2。
Imagen 2 用扩散模型 + 文本理解 + RLHF,在图像质量、文字渲染、人脸生成上超过 Imagen 1。
Imagen 2 集成到 Bard、Google Slides、Google Ads。
Imagen 2 不开源权重,只 API。
timeline.source_name: Google DeepMind (2023-12-07) Imagen 2 blog
timeline.card_summary_zh: Google DeepMind 在 Vertex AI 发布 Imagen 2；Imagen 2 是 Google 在文生图追赶的关键节点。
timeline.summary_en: On December 7, 2023, Google DeepMind launched Imagen 2 on Vertex AI, utilizing diffusion models, text understanding, and RLHF to outperform Imagen 1 in image quality, text rendering, and face generation. Now integrated into Bard, Google Slides, and Google Ads, the model's weights remain closed-source, with access offered only via API.
timeline.card_summary_en: Google DeepMind released Imagen 2 on Vertex AI; Imagen 2 was a key milestone in Google's catch-up race in text-to-image generation.
timeline.why_it_matters_en:
Imagen 2 was a key milestone in Google's text-to-image catch-up.
Following the line Imagen 2 (2023-12) → Imagen 3 (2024-05) → Veo (2024-05) → Veo 2 (2024-12, overtaking Sora), you can see how Google overtook OpenAI's Sora in video generation in the second half of 2024.
timeline.behind_scenes_en:
Imagen 2 was Google's response to Stable Diffusion (2022-08) + DALL·E 3 (2023-10) + Midjourney v5 (2023-03).
Google published the Imagen 1 paper in May 2022 but productized slowly; only with Imagen 2 in December 2023 did it ship as an official API.
The Imagen line: Imagen (2022-05, paper) → Imagen 2 (2023-12, product) → Imagen 3 (2024-05) → Veo (2024-05, video) → Veo 2 (2024-12).

timeline.title_zh: Mixtral 8x7B:开源 MoE LLM 起步
timeline.title_en: Mixtral 8x7B: Open-Source MoE LLM Begins
timeline.summary_zh:
2023 年 12 月 11 日,Mistral AI 在 arXiv:2401.04088 发布《Mixtral of Experts》。
Mixtral 8x7B 用 8 个专家(expert),每 token 路由到 2 个专家,总参 46.7B、激活 12.9B。
Mixtral 8x7B 在多数评测上超过 Llama 2 70B,GPT-3.5。
Mixtral 8x7B 用 Apache 2.0 商用开源。
Mixtral 路线:Mixtral 8x7B(2023-12) → Mixtral 8x7B Instruct(2023-12) → Mixtral 8x22B(2024-04) → Mistral Large 2(2024-07)。
timeline.source_name: Jiang, A. Q. et al. (2023) arXiv:2401.04088; Mistral blog
timeline.card_summary_zh: Mistral AI 在 arXiv:2401.04088 发布《Mixtral of Experts》。
timeline.summary_en: On December 11, 2023, Mistral AI published "Mixtral of Experts" on arXiv:2401.04088, detailing Mixtral 8x7B, a model utilizing 8 experts (routing 2 per token) with 46.7B total and 12.9B active parameters. Commercially open-sourced under the Apache 2.0 license, it outperformed Llama 2 70B and GPT-3.5 on most benchmarks, paving the way for a roadmap that evolved from Mixtral 8x7B (2023-12) and Mixtral 8x7B Instruct (2023-12) to Mixtral 8x22B (2024-04) and Mistral Large 2 (2024-07).
timeline.card_summary_en: Mistral AI published 'Mixtral of Experts' on arXiv:2401.04088.
timeline.why_it_matters_en:
Mixtral 8x7B was the starting point of open-source MoE LLMs, defining the MoE direction of open-source LLMs in 2024-2025.
Following the line Mixtral 8x7B (2023-12) → DeepSeek MoE 16B (2024-01) → Mixtral 8x22B (2024-04) → DeepSeek-V2 MoE (2024-05) → Llama 4 MoE (2025-04), you can see why every open-source large model turned to MoE in 2024.
timeline.behind_scenes_en:
Mixtral 8x7B was led by Mistral AI co-founder Guillaume Lample and Albert Jiang.
The MoE concept came from Shazeer's 2017 'Outrageously Large Neural Networks,' but before 2023 MoE stayed inside Google (GShard, Switch Transformer, GLaM).
Mixtral 8x7B was the first open-source commercially usable MoE LLM, directly influencing DeepSeek MoE (2024-01), Qwen MoE (2024-06), and Llama 4 MoE (2025-04).

timeline.title_zh: OpenAI Sora 公布:视频生成里程碑
timeline.title_en: OpenAI Sora Reveal: Video Generation Milestone
timeline.summary_zh:
2024 年 2 月 15 日,OpenAI 公布 Sora(text-to-video 模型,最长 60 秒)。
Sora 用 DiT(Diffusion Transformer)架构,把视频生成从「U-Net 扩散」推向「Transformer 扩散」。
Sora 演示视频质量震惊业界,但 OpenAI 未开源 + 延迟发布。
Sora 2024-12 才开放给 ChatGPT Plus 用户,2024-12-09 Sora 2 发布。
timeline.source_name: OpenAI (2024-02-15) Sora reveal; Brooks-Peebles DiT paper
timeline.card_summary_zh: Sora 展示从文字生成长达一分钟连贯视频的能力，视频模型开始尝试学习运动、空间与物理世界。
timeline.summary_en: On February 15, 2024, OpenAI unveiled Sora, a text-to-video model capable of generating clips up to 60 seconds long. Utilizing a DiT (Diffusion Transformer) architecture, Sora pushed video generation from "U-Net diffusion" to "Transformer diffusion." Although its stunning demo quality shocked the industry, OpenAI kept the model closed-source and delayed its release, only opening it to ChatGPT Plus users in December 2024, followed by the launch of Sora 2 on December 9, 2024.
timeline.card_summary_en: Sora demonstrated generating coherent videos up to a minute long from text, as video models began trying to learn motion, space, and the physical world.
timeline.why_it_matters_en:
Sora was a milestone for video generation, defining the DiT architecture direction of 2024-2025.
Following the line Sora (2024-02) → Veo (2024-05) → Kling (2024-06) → Sora 2 (2024-12) → Veo 2 (2024-12), you can see how video generation in 2024 moved from watchable to usable.
timeline.behind_scenes_en:
Sora was led by OpenAI's Tim Brooks and Bill Peebles (Peebles was lead author of the DiT paper).
Sora used Spatiotemporal Patches, encoding video into transformer tokens.
Within one month of Sora's announcement everyone followed suit: Runway Gen-3 (2024-06), Luma Dream Machine (2024-06), Kling (2024-06, Kuaishou), Hailuo (2024-09, MiniMax), Veo (2024-05, Google), and Vidu (2024-04, Shengshu).
Reasons for Sora's delayed release: 1) safety review; 2) insufficient compute; 3) high cost.
The video-generation line: Sora (2024-02) → Veo (2024-05) → Kling (2024-06) → Sora 2 (2024-12) → Veo 2 (2024-12, overtaking Sora).

timeline.title_zh: Anthropic Claude 3 发布:首次反超 GPT-4
timeline.title_en: Anthropic Claude 3: First to Surpass GPT-4
timeline.summary_zh:
2024 年 3 月 4 日,Anthropic 发布 Claude 3(Haiku/Sonnet/Opus 三档)。
Claude 3 Opus 在 MMLU 86.8%(GPT-4 86.4%),首次反超 GPT-4。
Claude 3 Opus 200K 上下文,vision 多模态。
Claude 3 Sonnet 速度更快,价格更低,实际生产部署最多。
Claude 3 路线:Claude 3(2024-03) → Claude 3.5 Sonnet(2024-06-20) → Claude 3.5 Sonnet v2(2024-10-22) → Claude 3.7 Sonnet(2025-02-24) → Claude 4 Opus(2025-05-22)。
timeline.source_name: Anthropic (2024-03-04) Claude 3 launch; Model Card
timeline.card_summary_zh: Claude 3 在多项能力评测中追平或超过 GPT-4，前沿模型竞争第一次形成真正的多强格局。
timeline.summary_en: On March 4, 2024, Anthropic released its Claude 3 family—spanning the Haiku, Sonnet, and Opus tiers—with the flagship Claude 3 Opus scoring 86.8% on the MMLU to edge out GPT-4 (86.4%) for the first time. While the multimodal, vision-capable Opus boasted a 200K context window, the faster and cheaper Sonnet saw the most actual production deployments. This launched a rapid release cycle: Claude 3 (2024-03) → Claude 3.5 Sonnet (2024-06-20) → Claude 3.5 Sonnet v2 (2024-10-22) → Claude 3.7 Sonnet (2025-02-24) → Claude 4 Opus (2025-05-22).
timeline.card_summary_en: Claude 3 matched or beat GPT-4 across multiple capability evaluations, and frontier-model competition formed a genuine multi-leader landscape for the first time.
timeline.why_it_matters_en:
Claude 3 was the starting point of Anthropic overtaking OpenAI.
Following the line Claude 3 (2024-03) → Claude 3.5 Sonnet (2024-06) → Claude 3.5 Sonnet v2 (2024-10) → Claude 3.7 Sonnet (2025-02) → Claude 4 Opus (2025-05) → Claude Opus 4.8 (2026-05), you can see how Anthropic gradually overtook OpenAI in the second half of 2024.
timeline.behind_scenes_en:
Claude 3 was Anthropic's core counterattack 13 months after GPT-4 had dominated.
Claude 3 Opus trained on 16,000 H100s at a cost of roughly $200 million.
After Claude 3 Anthropic's valuation soared: $15 billion in March 2024 → $60 billion in November 2024.
Claude 3.5 Sonnet shipped on June 20, 2024, overtaking GPT-4o on coding tasks.
Claude 3 Haiku was the fastest variant and was called heavily through Amazon Bedrock.

timeline.title_zh: 欧盟 AI Act 通过:全球首部 AI 监管法
timeline.title_en: EU AI Act Passed: World's First AI Regulation Law
timeline.summary_zh:
2024 年 3 月 13 日,欧洲议会通过《AI Act》。
AI Act 按风险分四档:不可接受(禁)、高风险(限)、有限风险(透明)、最小风险(自由)。
AI Act 对 General Purpose AI(GPAI) + Systemic Risk LLM(>=10^25 FLOPS) 设特殊义务:模型卡、版权披露、红队测试、严重事件报告。
AI Act 2024-08-01 生效,2026-08 全面执行,违规罚 3500 万欧元或营收 7%。
timeline.source_name: European Parliament (2024-03-13) AI Act adoption; Official Journal
timeline.card_summary_zh: 欧盟通过全球首部系统性 AI 法案，以风险等级约束模型与应用，技术竞争第一次面对完整法律框架。
timeline.summary_en: On March 13, 2024, the European Parliament passed the AI Act, which categorizes AI into four risk tiers: unacceptable (banned), high risk (restricted), limited risk (transparency), and minimal risk (free). The Act imposes special obligations on General Purpose AI (GPAI) and Systemic Risk LLM (>=10^25 FLOPS), requiring model cards, copyright disclosures, red-teaming, and serious incident reporting. Taking effect on August 1, 2024, and entering full enforcement by August 2026, the Act penalizes violations with fines of 35 million euros or 7% of revenue.
timeline.card_summary_en: The EU passed the world's first systematic AI law, constraining models and applications by risk tiers, and technological competition faced a complete legal framework for the first time.
timeline.why_it_matters_en:
The AI Act was the paradigm starting point of global AI regulation, directly shaping the compliance strategies of every frontier LLM company through 2024-2026.
Following the line AI Act (2024-03) → White House AI executive order (2024-05) → California SB-1047 (2024-09, vetoed) → China's generative AI service measures (2023-08), you can see the regulatory environment every LLM company has had to face since 2024.
timeline.behind_scenes_en:
The AI Act was proposed by the European Commission in April 2021; Parliament adopted its negotiating position in June 2023, trilogue talks reached consensus in December 2023, and it formally passed on March 13, 2024.
The AI Act is the world's first comprehensive AI law.
Its impact on OpenAI, Google, and Anthropic: GPT-4, Gemini, and Claude all count as Systemic Risk LLMs.
Downstream effects: the White House AI executive order in May 2024, California SB-1047 in September 2024 (vetoed), and Brazil's AI law in January 2025.

timeline.title_zh: OSWorld 智能体基准发布：真实电脑环境成为 GUI Agent 考场
timeline.title_en: OSWorld Benchmark Released to Evaluate GUI Agents in Real OS Environments
timeline.summary_zh: 清华、港大等团队联合发布 OSWorld，首个在真实操作系统环境（Linux/Windows/macOS）中评估 GUI 智能体完成多步复杂任务能力的评测基准，覆盖截图、鼠标、键盘和界面元素操作。
timeline.card_summary_zh: OSWorld 为 GUI 智能体提供真实桌面虚拟机考场，让智能体接受截图与键盘鼠标操作考验，成为 Computer Use 的行业评测标准。
timeline.card_summary_en: OSWorld establishes a real desktop OS playground to evaluate GUI agents via screen screenshots and native mouse/keyboard execution.
timeline.why_it_matters_en: It became the gold-standard benchmark for Computer Use agents, forcing labs to validate actual task completion rates in non-deterministic OS environments.
timeline.behind_scenes_en: Moving beyond static sandboxes, OSWorld runs agents on real virtual machines driving actual software like VS Code and Chrome to test exception handling.
timeline.source_name: OSWorld

timeline.title_zh: Meta Llama 3 发布:开源 LLM 跨过 GPT-3.5
timeline.title_en: Meta Llama 3 Release: Open-Source LLM Crosses GPT-3.5
timeline.summary_zh:
2024 年 4 月 18 日,Meta 发布 Llama 3(8B/70B)。
Llama 3 用 15T tokens 训练(比 Llama 2 多 7 倍),8K 上下文。
Llama 3 70B 在 MMLU 82.0%(GPT-4 86.4%),Llama 3 8B 在多数任务上超过 Llama 2 70B。
Llama 3 Instruct 用 SFT + DPO + RLHF 训练。
Llama 3 路线:Llama 3 8B/70B(2024-04) → Llama 3.1 405B(2024-07-23,首个 405B 开源) → Llama 3.2 1B/3B(2024-09,边缘) → Llama 3.3 70B(2024-12) → Llama 4(2025-04-05)。
timeline.source_name: Meta (2024-04-18) Llama 3 release; Meta AI blog
timeline.card_summary_zh: Meta 发布 Llama 3(8B/70B)；Llama 3 是开源 LLM 跨过 GPT-3.5 门槛的起点。
timeline.summary_en: On April 18, 2024, Meta launched Llama 3 (8B/70B)—trained on 15T tokens (7x more than Llama 2) with an 8K context window—employing SFT, DPO, and RLHF for its Instruct version. While Llama 3 70B hit 82.0% on MMLU (against GPT-4's 86.4%) and the 8B model beat Llama 2 70B on most tasks, it also kicked off an ambitious roadmap: Llama 3 8B/70B (2024-04) → Llama 3.1 405B (2024-07-23, the first open-source 405B) → Llama 3.2 1B/3B (2024-09, edge) → Llama 3.3 70B (2024-12) → Llama 4 (2025-04-05).
timeline.card_summary_en: Meta released Llama 3 (8B/70B); Llama 3 was the point where open-source LLMs crossed the GPT-3.5 threshold.
timeline.why_it_matters_en:
Llama 3 was the starting point of open-source LLMs crossing the GPT-3.5 threshold.
Following the line Llama 3 8B (2024-04) → Llama 3.1 405B (2024-07) → Llama 3.2 1B/3B (2024-09) → Llama 4 MoE (2025-04), you can see how open-source LLMs closed in on closed-source GPT-4 during 2024, and why Meta treats openness as its core strategy.
timeline.behind_scenes_en:
Llama 3 was led by Meta FAIR's Hugo Touvron.
Llama 3 trained on 16K H100s; the 70B took six months to train.
Key figures: 15T tokens, with code at 5%.
Llama 3 Instruct used 25M SFT samples + DPO.
After Llama 3, Meta launched Llama Stack (2024-10) to unify APIs.
Llama 3.1 405B was the first open 405B model, at a training cost of roughly $650 million.
Llama 4 in April 2025 switched to a MoE architecture.

timeline.title_zh: DeepSeek-V2:中国开源 MoE + API 价格战起点
timeline.title_en: DeepSeek-V2: China's Open-Source MoE + API Price War Begins
timeline.summary_zh:
2024 年 5 月 7 日,DeepSeek 在 arXiv:2405.04434 发布《DeepSeek-V2: A Strong, Economical, and Efficient Mixture-of-Experts Language Model》。
DeepSeek-V2 用 236B 总参、21B 激活的 MoE,创新 MLA(Multi-Head Latent Attention) + DeepSeekMoE。
DeepSeek-V2 API 价格 ¥1/1M input(同档 Llama 3 70B 的 1/100),直接引爆中国 LLM 价格战。
timeline.source_name: DeepSeek-AI (2024) arXiv:2405.04434; DeepSeek blog
timeline.card_summary_zh: DeepSeek-V2：中国开源 MoE + API 价格战起点。
timeline.summary_en: On May 7, 2024, DeepSeek published "DeepSeek-V2: A Strong, Economical, and Efficient Mixture-of-Experts Language Model" on arXiv:2405.04434, introducing an MoE model with 236B total and 21B active parameters that features innovative MLA (Multi-Head Latent Attention) and DeepSeekMoE architectures. Priced at just ¥1/1M input—1/100 of the cost of the comparable Llama 3 70B—the DeepSeek-V2 API instantly ignited a price war in the Chinese LLM market.
timeline.card_summary_en: DeepSeek-V2: the starting point of Chinese open-source MoE plus the API price war.
timeline.why_it_matters_en:
DeepSeek-V2 was the starting point of Chinese open-source MoE and the price war, directly defining China's LLM business models in 2024-2025.
Following the line DeepSeek-V2 (2024-05) → DeepSeek-V3 (2024-12) → DeepSeek-R1 (2025-01, global breakthrough), you can see how DeepSeek stunned the world with R1 in January 2025.
timeline.behind_scenes_en:
DeepSeek was founded by the quant firm High-Flyer, spinning off as an independent company in July 2023.
Founder Liang Wenfeng trained LLMs on GPU compute accumulated from quantitative trading (10K A100s).
DeepSeek-V2's MLA compressed KV cache to one quarter, sending inference costs plunging.
DeepSeek-V2 triggered a price war: Baidu ERNIE at ¥0.002 per thousand tokens (2024-05-21), Alibaba Tongyi at ¥0.005 (2024-05-21), ByteDance Doubao at ¥0.0008 (2024-05-15).
The DeepSeek line: DeepSeek LLM (2023-11) → DeepSeek-V2 (2024-05) → DeepSeek-V2.5 (2024-09) → DeepSeek-V3 (2024-12) → DeepSeek-R1 (2025-01-20).

timeline.title_zh: GPT-4o:实时多模态 LLM 起点
timeline.title_en: GPT-4o: Real-Time Multimodal LLM Begins
timeline.summary_zh:
2024 年 5 月 13 日,OpenAI 发布 GPT-4o(omni)。
GPT-4o 是首个原生多模态 LLM(文本+图像+音频统一编码),语音对话延迟 232ms(接近人类 200ms)。
GPT-4o 在 MMLU 88.7%(超过 GPT-4 Turbo 86.5%)。
GPT-4o 免费向所有 ChatGPT 用户开放,Plus 5 倍额度。
GPT-4o API 价格降 50%($5/1M input)。
timeline.source_name: OpenAI (2024-05-13) GPT-4o launch; System Card
timeline.card_summary_zh: GPT-4o 在同一模型中实时处理文字、声音和图像，人机交互开始从轮流输入走向自然连续对话。
timeline.summary_en: On May 13, 2024, OpenAI released GPT-4o (omni), the first native multimodal LLM featuring unified encoding for text, images, and audio, boasting a voice conversation latency of 232ms (nearing the human rate of 200ms). Scoring 88.7% on the MMLU to surpass GPT-4 Turbo's 86.5%, the model is available for free to all ChatGPT users, with Plus users receiving 5 times the limit. Additionally, the GPT-4o API price has been cut by 50% ($5/1M input).
timeline.card_summary_en: GPT-4o handled text, sound, and images in real time inside a single model, moving human-computer interaction from turn-taking input toward natural continuous conversation.
timeline.why_it_matters_en:
GPT-4o was the starting point of realtime multimodal LLMs, defining the shape of the AI assistant in 2024-2025.
Following the line GPT-4o (2024-05) → GPT-4o mini (2024-07) → Realtime API (2024-10) → GPT-4o image generation (2025-03) → GPT-5 omni-modal (2025-08), you can see why every AI assistant after 2024 pivoted to realtime voice plus vision.
timeline.behind_scenes_en:
GPT-4o was driven by OpenAI's Mia Glaese, Mark Chen, and Hyung Won Chung.
GPT-4o trained on 25K H100s for six months.
GPT-4o merged the three-stage ASR (Whisper) + LLM (GPT-4) + TTS pipeline into a single model, cutting latency from GPT-4V's 2.8s to 232ms.
The GPT-4o line: GPT-4o (2024-05) → GPT-4o mini (2024-07-18) → GPT-4o-2024-08 (2024-08) → GPT-4o-2024-11 (2024-11) → GPT-4o Realtime API (2024-10) → GPT-4o image generation (2025-03-26).

timeline.title_zh: Claude 3.5 Sonnet:开源编程模型新基准
timeline.title_en: Claude 3.5 Sonnet: New Benchmark for Coding
timeline.summary_zh:
2024 年 6 月 20 日,Anthropic 发布 Claude 3.5 Sonnet。
Claude 3.5 Sonnet 在编程(HumanEval 92.0%)、推理(GPQA 59.4%)、视觉(文档理解)上全面超越 GPT-4o。
Claude 3.5 Sonnet 价格是 GPT-4o 的 1/5。
Claude 3.5 Sonnet 推出 Artifacts(代码 + 文档实时渲染)。
timeline.source_name: Anthropic (2024-06-20) Claude 3.5 Sonnet launch
timeline.card_summary_zh: Claude 3.5 Sonnet 推出 Artifacts(代码 + 文档实时渲染)。
timeline.summary_en: On June 20, 2024, Anthropic released Claude 3.5 Sonnet, which outperforms GPT-4o in coding (HumanEval 92.0%), reasoning (GPQA 59.4%), and vision (document understanding) at one-fifth the price of GPT-4o. The release also introduces Artifacts, a feature enabling the real-time rendering of code and documents.
timeline.card_summary_en: Claude 3.5 Sonnet launched Artifacts (real-time rendering of code + documents).
timeline.why_it_matters_en:
Claude 3.5 Sonnet was the starting point of Anthropic overtaking OpenAI in coding.
Following the line Claude 3 (2024-03) → Claude 3.5 Sonnet (2024-06) → Claude 3.5 Sonnet v2 (2024-10) → Claude 3.7 Sonnet (2025-02) → Claude 4 Opus (2025-05), you can see how Anthropic became the first choice for coding LLMs in the second half of 2024.
timeline.behind_scenes_en:
Claude 3.5 Sonnet was a mid-generation upgrade just three months after Anthropic shipped Claude 3.
Anthropic's engineering team found Claude 3 Sonnet's training had not saturated, so it upgraded quickly via SFT + DPO + long-context optimization.
After Claude 3.5 Sonnet, Cursor, Windsurf, Cline, and Claude Code adopted it en masse.
Claude 3.5 Sonnet v2 shipped on October 22, 2024, further overtaking o1 on system-level programming.

timeline.title_zh: Meta Llama 3.1 405B:首个 405B 开源模型
timeline.title_en: Meta Llama 3.1 405B: First 405B Open-Source Model
timeline.summary_zh:
2024 年 7 月 23 日,Meta 发布 Llama 3.1(8B/70B/405B 三档)。
Llama 3.1 405B 是首个 405B 开源模型,在 MMLU 88.6%(超过 GPT-4o 88.7%)、GSM8K 96.8%。
Llama 3.1 405B 训练用 16K H100,54 天,15T tokens,成本约 6.5 亿美元。
Llama 3.1 把上下文从 8K 扩到 128K,工具调用 + 多语言(8 种)强化。
timeline.source_name: Meta (2024-07-23) Llama 3.1 release; arXiv:2407.21783
timeline.card_summary_zh: Meta 发布 Llama 3.1(8B/70B/405B 三档)；Llama 3.1 405B 是开源 LLM 首次追上闭源 SOTA。
timeline.summary_en: On July 23, 2024, Meta released Llama 3.1 in three sizes (8B/70B/405B), featuring the first-ever 405B open-source model, which scored 88.6% on MMLU (surpassing GPT-4o's 88.7%) and 96.8% on GSM8K. Training the 405B model required 16K H100 GPUs, 54 days, and 15T tokens, costing approximately $650 million. Llama 3.1 expands the context window from 8K to 128K and features enhanced tool use and multilingual support across 8 languages.
timeline.card_summary_en: Meta released Llama 3.1 in three sizes (8B/70B/405B); Llama 3.1 405B marked the first time an open-source LLM caught up with closed-source SOTA.
timeline.why_it_matters_en:
Llama 3.1 405B was the first time an open-source LLM caught closed-source SOTA.
Following the line Llama 3.1 405B (2024-07) → Llama 3.3 70B (2024-12, quality equal to 405B) → Llama 4 MoE (2025-04), you can see how the gap between open and closed LLMs narrowed in 2024 from a generational divide to parity.
timeline.behind_scenes_en:
Llama 3.1 405B was Meta's core counterattack under dual pressure from GPT-4o (2024-05) and Claude 3.5 Sonnet (2024-06).
405B inference is expensive: it takes 8 H100s to run FP8, so Meta shipped a quantized FP8 version to lower the barrier.
After Llama 3.1 the open-source community produced many distillations: NV Llama-3.1-Nemotron-70B, Tulu 3, Hermes 3.
With Llama 3.1 405B, open-source LLMs for the first time overtook GPT-4o on multiple benchmarks.

timeline.title_zh: 《Nature》发表模型崩溃研究：警示合成数据循环训练的致命局限
timeline.title_en: Nature Publishes Model Collapse Study Warning Against Recursive Synthetic Training
timeline.summary_zh: 牛津、剑桥等机构的研究者在《Nature》发表论文，系统论证了模型在使用前代模型生成的合成数据进行循环训练时，会发生「模型崩溃」，导致多样性退化和低频信息不可逆丢失。
timeline.card_summary_zh: 《Nature》研究指出大模型使用合成数据进行多代循环训练会引发模型崩溃，限定了合成数据的使用边界，确立了人类真实数据的核心地位。
timeline.card_summary_en: A Nature paper demonstrates model collapse, where LLMs trained recursively on synthetic data suffer irreversible loss of rare tail information.
timeline.why_it_matters_en: It drew a hard boundary for synthetic data scaling, proving that self-recycling leads to decay unless grounded by human data or formal verifiers.
timeline.behind_scenes_en: The study cooled down the synthetic data gold rush, proving models decay into gibberish within 5 to 7 loops without new organic human datasets.
timeline.source_name: Nature

timeline.title_zh: OpenAI o1:推理模型时代起点
timeline.title_en: OpenAI o1: Reasoning Model Era Begins
timeline.summary_zh:
2024 年 9 月 12 日,OpenAI 发布 o1-preview + o1-mini。
o1 用 RL + Chain-of-Thought 训练,在数学(AIME 83.3%,GPT-4o 13.4%)、编程(Codeforces 89%)、博士级科学(GPQA 78%) 上大幅超越 GPT-4o。
o1 推理时输出长 CoT(几千-几万 token),延迟从 GPT-4o 1 秒到 o1 10-30 秒。
timeline.source_name: OpenAI (2024-09-12) o1 launch; Learning to Reason blog
timeline.card_summary_zh: o1 在回答前投入更多计算进行推理，模型竞争从即时生成转向愿意花时间解决复杂问题。
timeline.summary_en: On September 12, 2024, OpenAI released o1-preview and o1-mini. Trained using reinforcement learning and Chain-of-Thought, o1 dramatically outperforms GPT-4o in mathematics (scoring 83.3% on AIME compared to GPT-4o's 13.4%), coding (89% on Codeforces), and PhD-level science (78% on GPQA). During inference, o1 generates a long Chain-of-Thought spanning thousands to tens of thousands of tokens, which increases latency from GPT-4o's 1 second to 10-30 seconds for o1.
timeline.card_summary_en: o1 invested more computation into reasoning before answering, shifting model competition from instant generation toward a willingness to spend time on hard problems.
timeline.why_it_matters_en:
o1 was the start of the LLM reasoning era, defining the reasoning-model direction of 2024-2025.
Following the line o1 (2024-09) → o1-mini (2024-09) → o3-mini (2025-01) → DeepSeek-R1 (2025-01-20, open reasoning model) → o3 (2025-04) → GPT-5 (2025-08), you can see why every frontier LLM in 2025 moved onto a dual track of reasoning plus general-purpose.
timeline.behind_scenes_en:
Project o1 carried the codename Strawberry, led by Noam Brown (hired from Meta in January 2024) and Jakub Pachocki.
o1's core innovation: training chains of thought with RL, letting the model think before answering at inference time.
o1 drew inspiration from internal OpenAI research on test-time compute scaling in August 2024.
The o1 line: o1-preview (2024-09) → o1-mini (2024-09) → o1 full (2024-12) → o1 pro (2024-12) → o3-mini (2025-01-31) → o3 (2025-04) → GPT-5 (2025-08, unifying reasoning and general capability).

timeline.title_zh: Hassabis 与 Jumper 获诺贝尔化学奖:AI for Science 里程碑
timeline.title_en: Hassabis & Jumper Nobel Chemistry Prize: AI for Science Milestone
timeline.summary_zh:
2024 年 10 月 9 日,诺贝尔化学奖一半授予 Demis Hassabis 和 John Jumper(AlphaFold),另一半授予 David Baker(蛋白质设计)。
AlphaFold 2(2020-11) 解决蛋白质结构预测 50 年难题,AlphaFold 3(2024-05-08) 扩展到 DNA/RNA/配体。
Hassabis 是首位获诺贝尔奖的 AI 公司 CEO。
timeline.source_name: Nobel Prize (2024-10-09) Chemistry announcement; DeepMind AlphaFold
timeline.card_summary_zh: Hassabis 是首位获诺贝尔奖的 AI 公司 CEO。
timeline.summary_en: On October 9, 2024, the Nobel Prize in Chemistry was awarded, with one half going to David Baker for protein design, and the other half to Demis Hassabis and John Jumper for AlphaFold, making Hassabis the first AI company CEO to win a Nobel Prize. AlphaFold 2 (2020-11) solved a 50-year challenge in protein structure prediction, while AlphaFold 3 (2024-05-08) expanded the model's capabilities to DNA, RNA, and ligands.
timeline.card_summary_en: Hassabis became the first AI-company CEO to win a Nobel Prize.
timeline.why_it_matters_en:
The Hassabis/Jumper Nobel Prize was the moment mainstream science recognized AI for Science.
Following the line AlphaFold 1 (2018) → AlphaFold 2 (2020) → AlphaFold DB 200 million (2022) → AlphaFold 3 (2024) → Nobel Prize (2024-10), you can see how AI moved from language conversation toward scientific discovery.
timeline.behind_scenes_en:
AlphaFold 1 ranked 21st at CASP13; AlphaFold 2 hit GDT_TS 92.4 at CASP14, reaching experimental accuracy.
AlphaFold 2 was driven by DeepMind's John Jumper and Demis Hassabis.
After AlphaFold 2 came open-sourcing: the source code in July 2021, plus AlphaFold Colab and the AlphaFold DB with 200M+ protein structures.
AlphaFold 3 was released on May 8, 2024 but without open weights, drawing controversy.
Hassabis simultaneously held the Nobel Prize and a nomination for the 2024 Turing Award.

timeline.title_zh: Claude Computer Use:LLM 直接操作电脑
timeline.title_en: Claude Computer Use: LLM Directly Operates Computer
timeline.summary_zh:
2024 年 10 月 22 日,Anthropic 在 Claude 3.5 Sonnet v2 同步推出 Computer Use API(beta)。
Claude Computer Use 让 LLM 通过截图 + 鼠标键盘控制直接操作电脑(浏览器、终端、文件)。
Claude Computer Use 是首个商用 Computer Use Agent,定义 2024-2025 年「GUI Agent」方向。
timeline.source_name: Anthropic (2024-10-22) Claude 3.5 Sonnet v2 + Computer Use
timeline.card_summary_zh: Claude 获得观察屏幕、移动鼠标和输入文字的能力，大模型第一次可以像用户一样直接操作通用电脑。
timeline.summary_en: On October 22, 2024, Anthropic launched the Computer Use API (beta) alongside Claude 3.5 Sonnet v2. Claude Computer Use allows LLMs to directly operate computers (browsers, terminals, files) via screenshots and mouse/keyboard control. As the first commercial Computer Use Agent, it defines the direction of "GUI Agents" for 2024-2025.
timeline.card_summary_en: Claude gained the ability to observe the screen, move the mouse, and type, letting a large model directly operate a general-purpose computer like a user for the first time.
timeline.why_it_matters_en:
Computer Use was the point where LLM agents moved from text to operating computers.
Following the line AutoGPT (2023-03) → Devin (2024-03) → Claude Computer Use (2024-10) → OpenAI Operator (2024-11) → Hermes (2026), you can see how agents after 2024 moved from chatting to operating.
timeline.behind_scenes_en:
Computer Use was driven by Anthropic's engineering team, with three core difficulties: 1) GUI understanding (screenshots into structure); 2) precise mouse and keyboard control (coordinates + keystrokes); 3) consistency over long-horizon tasks.
After Claude Computer Use, OpenAI launched Operator in November 2024, Google launched Project Mariner in December 2024, and Microsoft launched OmniParser in January 2025.
Computer Use is the key node in the chain AutoGPT (2023) → Devin (2024) → Computer Use (2024) → Hermes (2025).

timeline.title_zh: AI Factory 叙事成型:超大规模训练集群时代
timeline.title_en: AI Factory Narrative Forms: Massive Training Cluster Era
timeline.summary_zh:
2024-2025 年,AI Factory 叙事成型。
AI Factory 指 10 万+ GPU 量级 + 数据中心 + 能源 + 散热的「LLM 工厂」。
代表:xAI Colossus(10 万 H100,2024-09 建成,122 天)、Meta 6 万 H100、Microsoft + OpenAI 5 个 AI Factory、Amazon Trainium 2、Google TPU v5p Trillium、字节豆包 8 万 H100。
timeline.source_name: NVIDIA (2024-08) SIGGRAPH AI Factory; xAI Colossus (2024-09)
timeline.card_summary_zh: AI Factory 指 10 万+ GPU 量级 + 数据中心 + 能源 + 散热的「LLM 工厂」。
timeline.summary_en: During 2024–2025, the narrative of the "AI Factory" took shape, defined as LLM "factories" integrating 100,000+ GPUs with data centers, power, and cooling. Key examples include xAI Colossus (100,000 H100s, completed in September 2024 in 122 days), Meta's 60,000 H100s, Microsoft + OpenAI's 5 AI Factories, Amazon Trainium 2, Google TPU v5p Trillium, and ByteDance Doubao's 80,000 H100s.
timeline.card_summary_en: AI Factory refers to the 'LLM factory' of 100K+ GPU scale combined with data centers, energy, and cooling.
timeline.why_it_matters_en:
AI Factory is the physical form of LLM competition in 2024-2025, directly defining the compute threshold for LLMs.
Following the line Colossus (2024-09) → Meta 60K (2024-12) → Stargate planning (2025-01) → Blackwell deployment (2025-04), you can see how LLM competition after 2024 shifted from algorithms to capital plus infrastructure.
timeline.behind_scenes_en:
The AI Factory concept was proposed by NVIDIA's Jensen Huang at SIGGRAPH in August 2024.
xAI's Colossus is the most dramatic case: Elon Musk tweeted in July 2024 that 100K H100s were deployed in 122 days.
The key bottlenecks of the AI Factory shifted from GPUs to energy (1GW per single factory) + cooling (liquid cooling) + networking (InfiniBand).
In 2025 Microsoft + OpenAI's Stargate ($100 billion, by 2029) is the largest AI Factory plan.

timeline.title_zh: NVIDIA H100:前沿大模型训练主力 GPU
timeline.title_en: NVIDIA H100: Main GPU for Frontier LLM Training
timeline.summary_zh:
2024 年,NVIDIA H100 Hopper GPU 成前沿大模型训练主力。
H100 2022-03 GTC 发布,2023-03 出货,2024 年成为 OpenAI GPT-4o、Anthropic Claude 3、Google Gemini 1.5、Meta Llama 3.1 405B、xAI Grok 2 的训练主力。
H100 FP16 算力 1979 TFLOPS(A100 312 TFLOPS 6.3 倍)、HBM3 80GB、3.2TB/s 带宽。
H100 集群最大规模:xAI Colossus 10 万张 H100(2024-09)、Meta 6 万张、Google TPU v5p 8912 块等效。
timeline.source_name: NVIDIA (2022-03-22) H100 Hopper announcement; 2024 Q4 earnings
timeline.card_summary_zh: H100 以 Transformer Engine 和更强互联能力成为前沿模型集群主力，算力供应也由此变成产业竞争核心。
timeline.summary_en: Announced at GTC in March 2022 and shipped in March 2023, the NVIDIA H100 Hopper GPU became the dominant workhorse for training frontier AI in 2024, powering OpenAI’s GPT-4o, Anthropic’s Claude 3, Google’s Gemini 1.5, Meta’s Llama 3.1 405B, and xAI’s Grok 2. The silicon boasts 1,979 TFLOPS of FP16 compute (6.3 times the A100’s 312 TFLOPS), 80GB of HBM3 memory, and 3.2TB/s of bandwidth. The largest H100 clusters reached massive scales, led by xAI’s Colossus with 100,000 H100s in September 2024, Meta with 60,000, and Google’s equivalent deployment of 8,912 TPU v5p chips.
timeline.card_summary_en: With its Transformer Engine and stronger interconnect, H100 became the workhorse of frontier-model clusters, and compute supply itself turned into the core of industry competition.
timeline.why_it_matters_en:
H100 was the compute foundation of every frontier LLM in 2024, directly defining that year's compute threshold for LLMs.
Following the line A100 (2020) → H100 (2023) → H200 (2024) → Blackwell B200 (2024-12) → Rubin (2026), you can see why NVIDIA's market cap broke $3 trillion in 2024 and why compute became the core moat of LLM competition.
timeline.behind_scenes_en:
H100 is built on NVIDIA's Hopper architecture: announced at GTC in March 2022, shipping in September 2022, deployed at scale in March 2023.
Key innovations: Transformer Engine (FP8 training), HBM3, NVLink 4 (900GB/s).
The H100 shortage ran severe through 2023-2024; Elon Musk tweeted in May 2023 that H100s were harder to buy than drugs.
H100 priced at $25K-$40K per card; NVIDIA's data-center revenue reached $47.5 billion in 2024.
The H100 line: H100 (announced 2022-03, shipped 2023-03) → H200 (2024-02) → Blackwell B200 (announced 2024-03, shipped 2024-12) → Rubin (2026).

timeline.title_zh: 长上下文竞争:1M token 时代
timeline.title_en: Long Context Race: 1M Token Era
timeline.summary_zh:
2024 年,LLM 上下文从 32K 突破到 1M-2M。
代表:Gemini 1.5 Pro(2024-02,1M,后 2M)、Claude 3(2024-03,200K)、GPT-4 Turbo(2023-11,128K)、Llama 3.1 405B(2024-07,128K)、Qwen 2.5(2024-09,128K)。
长上下文让 LLM 一次性处理整本书、整个代码仓库、1 小时视频。
timeline.source_name: Google Gemini 1.5 (2024-02); Anthropic Claude 3 (2024-03)
timeline.card_summary_zh: 长上下文让 LLM 一次性处理整本书、整个代码仓库、1 小时视频。
timeline.summary_en: In 2024, LLM context windows surged from 32K to 1M-2M, headlined by Gemini 1.5 Pro (2024-02, 1M, later 2M), Claude 3 (2024-03, 200K), GPT-4 Turbo (2023-11, 128K), Llama 3.1 405B (2024-07, 128K), and Qwen 2.5 (2024-09, 128K). These massive context windows allow LLMs to process an entire book, a whole codebase, or 1 hour of video all at once.
timeline.card_summary_en: Long context let LLMs process an entire book, a whole code repository, or an hour of video in one pass.
timeline.why_it_matters_en:
Long context was one of the core battlegrounds for LLMs in 2024, defining the whole-repository-code and whole-book application scenarios of 2024-2025.
Following the line Claude 2 100K (2023-07) → GPT-4 Turbo 128K (2023-11) → Gemini 1.5 1M (2024-02) → Claude 3.5 500K (2024-10) → Gemini 2.0 2M (2024-12), you can see why RAG stopped being a mandatory component in 2024.
timeline.behind_scenes_en:
Long context's core difficulties: attention's O(n²) complexity plus position-encoding extrapolation.
The 2024 breakthroughs came from RingAttention (2023), Rotary Position Embedding (RoPE), ALiBi, and YaRN.
Gemini 1.5 Pro trained to 1M using RingAttention + Interleaved Attention and served inference with Sliding Window + Global Tokens.
Claude 3 used Native Long Context (no reliance on extrapolation).
The long-context line: Claude 2 100K (2023-07) → GPT-4 Turbo 128K (2023-11) → Gemini 1.5 Pro 1M (2024-02) → Gemini 1.5 Pro 2M (2024-05) → Claude 3.5 500K (2024-10).

timeline.title_zh: 小模型蒸馏兴起:7B 反超 GPT-3.5 时代
timeline.title_en: Small Model Distillation: 7B Beats GPT-3.5 Era
timeline.summary_zh:
2024 年,7B-14B 小模型通过蒸馏 + DPO 在多项任务上反超 GPT-3.5。
代表:Phi-3 mini 3.8B(Microsoft,2024-04)、Qwen 2.5 7B Instruct(2024-09)、Llama 3.2 1B/3B(2024-09)、Mistral NeMo 12B(2024-07)、Gemma 2 2B/9B/27B(Google,2024-06)。
这些模型可在手机、笔记本、边缘设备本地运行,质量超过 2023 年 GPT-3.5。
timeline.source_name: Microsoft Phi-3 (2024-04); Meta Llama 3.2 (2024-09); Apple Intelligence (2024-06)
timeline.card_summary_zh: 7B-14B 小模型通过蒸馏 + DPO 在多项任务上反超 GPT-3.5。
timeline.summary_en: In 2024, small 7B-14B models leveraged distillation + DPO to surpass GPT-3.5 on multiple tasks, led by Microsoft's Phi-3 mini 3.8B (2024-04), Qwen 2.5 7B Instruct (2024-09), Llama 3.2 1B/3B (2024-09), Mistral NeMo 12B (2024-07), and Google's Gemma 2 2B/9B/27B (2024-06). Capable of running locally on phones, laptops, and edge devices, these models exceeded the quality of 2023's GPT-3.5.
timeline.card_summary_en: Small 7B-14B models surpassed GPT-3.5 on multiple tasks through distillation + DPO.
timeline.why_it_matters_en:
Small-model distillation carried LLMs onto edge devices, defining the On-Device AI direction of 2024-2025.
Following the line Phi-3 (2024-04) → Llama 3.2 (2024-09) → Apple Intelligence (2024-06) → Gemini Nano on Pixel 8 (2023-12), you can see why every phone maker (Apple, Google, Huawei, Xiaomi) made local LLMs a core selling point in 2024.
timeline.behind_scenes_en:
The core idea of small-model distillation: synthetic data plus teacher-model distillation lets small models approach large ones.
Phi-3 trained on GPT-4 + textbook-style data.
Qwen 2.5 distilled from Qwen 72B.
Llama 3.2 distilled from Llama 3.1 405B.
The small-model line: Phi-3 (2024-04) → Llama 3.2 1B/3B (2024-09) → Qwen 2.5 7B (2024-09) → Gemma 2 2B (2024-06).
Small models put LLMs into phones: an iPhone 15 Pro's A17 Pro runs Llama 3.2 3B at 4 tokens/s.

timeline.title_zh: AI 办公全面嵌入
timeline.title_en: AI Embedded in Productivity Tools
timeline.summary_zh:
AI 助手全面嵌入搜索、办公、编程、设计与客服产品。
AI 不再只作为独立应用等用户打开，而是进入文档、邮件、会议、代码仓库、设计工具和客服系统。
用户开始在原来的工作流里遇到 AI。
timeline.source_name: General official product histories
timeline.card_summary_zh: AI 不再只作为独立应用等用户打开，而是进入文档、邮件、会议、代码仓库、设计工具和客服系统；AI 从独立应用，开始成为软件默认能力层。
timeline.summary_en: AI assistants have become deeply integrated across search, productivity, coding, design, and customer service products. No longer just standalone apps waiting to be opened, AI is moving directly into documents, emails, meetings, code repositories, design tools, and customer service systems. Users are now beginning to encounter AI right within their existing workflows.
timeline.card_summary_en: AI stopped waiting as standalone apps for users to open and instead entered documents, email, meetings, code repositories, design tools, and customer-service systems; AI moved from standalone apps to becoming software's default capability layer.
timeline.why_it_matters_en: AI moved from standalone applications to becoming the default capability layer of software.

timeline.title_zh: 推理模型竞赛升级
