timeline.title_en: Reasoning Model Competition Escalates
timeline.summary_zh:
前沿模型竞争重点进一步转向可验证推理、工具调用和复杂任务完成率。
这件事把 industry、reasoning、agent 推到更显眼的位置。
它让研究者和产品团队重新安排下一步投入。
timeline.source_name: OpenAI / Google / Meta release histories
timeline.card_summary_zh: 这件事把 industry、reasoning、agent 推到更显眼的位置。
timeline.summary_en: The competitive focus for frontier models has shifted further toward verifiable reasoning, tool calling, and complex task completion rates. This shift has propelled "industry," "reasoning," and "agents" into the spotlight, prompting researchers and product teams to reallocate their next-phase investments.
timeline.card_summary_en: This event pushed industry, reasoning, and agents into sharper focus.
timeline.why_it_matters_en: It changed the yardstick for products, shifting from single-turn answer quality to agent success rates, cost, and controllability.

timeline.title_zh: 本地模型部署扩散
timeline.title_en: Local Model Deployment Expands
timeline.summary_zh:
量化、小模型和端侧推理推动本地部署生态持续扩大。
这些节点讲的是大模型工程路线的变化。
模型变强之后，行业开始围绕成本、可控性、知识更新、上下文长度和部署位置做取舍。
timeline.source_name: Meta AI / open model ecosystem
timeline.card_summary_zh: 模型变强之后，行业开始围绕成本、可控性、知识更新、上下文长度和部署位置做取舍。
timeline.summary_en: Quantization, small models, and on-device inference continue to expand the local deployment ecosystem. These milestones trace the shifting engineering pathways of large models. As these models grew more powerful, the industry began making trade-offs around cost, controllability, knowledge updates, context length, and deployment location.
timeline.card_summary_en: Once models grew stronger, the industry began making trade-offs around cost, controllability, knowledge freshness, context length, and where to deploy.
timeline.why_it_matters_en: It made privacy, offline use, and low token cost realistic choices rather than total dependence on cloud APIs.

timeline.title_zh: NVIDIA AI 硬件平台化
timeline.title_en: NVIDIA turns AI hardware into a full platform
timeline.summary_zh:
NVIDIA 从 GPU 厂商，逐步变成 AI 计算平台公司：芯片、CUDA、服务器、互联、软件库和开发者生态一起构成底座。
AI 能力看起来在模型层爆发，底下却是一条算力基础设施线。
CUDA、AlexNet 的 GPU 训练、V100、A100、H100、Blackwell 和 ProjectDIGITS，都应该放在 NVIDIA 二级时间线里看。
timeline.source_name: NVIDIA AI
timeline.card_summary_zh: NVIDIA 从 GPU 厂商，逐步变成 AI 计算平台公司：芯片、CUDA、服务器、互联；理解 NVIDIA，才能理解大模型时代为什么会出现算力竞争、芯片管制。
timeline.summary_en: NVIDIA has evolved from a GPU manufacturer into an AI computing platform company, with chips, CUDA, servers, interconnects, software libraries, and a developer ecosystem forming its foundation. While AI capabilities appear to explode at the model layer, they are driven by this underlying compute infrastructure. Milestones like CUDA, GPU training for AlexNet, the V100, A100, H100, Blackwell, and ProjectDIGITS should all be viewed within this secondary NVIDIA timeline.
timeline.card_summary_en: NVIDIA evolved step by step from a GPU vendor into an AI computing platform company: chips, CUDA, servers, interconnect; understanding NVIDIA is the key to understanding why the large-model era saw compute races and chip controls.
timeline.why_it_matters_en: Understanding NVIDIA is the key to understanding why the large-model era produced compute races, chip export controls, data-center expansion, and local AI deployment.

timeline.title_zh: DeepSeek-R1 发布及技术报告开源
timeline.title_en: DeepSeek-R1 Release & Technical Report Open-sourced
timeline.summary_zh:
2025 年 1 月 20 日,DeepSeek 发布 R1 推理模型;1 月 22 日公开技术报告,补充训练、强化学习、蒸馏与评测细节。
R1 以强推理表现和高关注度把推理模型竞争推到全球讨论中心:模型能不能把复杂问题拆开、检查、推演和修正。
它还带来一个更现实的刺激——如果更低成本也能做出强推理模型,前沿模型竞争的经济账就要重新算。
timeline.source_name: DeepSeek API Docs / Technical Report
timeline.card_summary_zh: DeepSeek-R1 以开放技术报告和低成本推理震动行业，证明前沿推理能力不必只属于封闭模型。
timeline.summary_en: On January 20, 2025, DeepSeek launched the R1 reasoning model, following up on January 22 with a technical report detailing its post-training, reinforcement learning, distillation, and evaluation. Driven by strong reasoning performance and immense attention, R1 thrust the reasoning model race into the center of global discussion: can models deconstruct, verify, reason through, and correct complex problems? It also delivered a more pragmatic shock—if powerful reasoning models can be built at a lower cost, the economic math of the frontier model race must be recalculated.
timeline.card_summary_en: DeepSeek-R1 shook the industry with its open technical report and low-cost inference, proving frontier-level reasoning need not belong only to closed models.
timeline.why_it_matters_en:
DeepSeek-R1 changed the angle from which the frontier-model race is watched.
Researchers look at the reasoning route, developers look at deployment and cost, and the industry watches how far China's open-source, high-value-for-money model route can go.
timeline.behind_scenes_en:
On January 20, 2025, DeepSeek released the R1 reasoning model, and on January 22, it published the technical report, detailing its additional training, reinforcement learning, distillation, and evaluation. With its strong reasoning performance and high level of attention, R1 pushed the competition over reasoning models to the center of global discussion: whether a model can break down, verify, deduce, and correct complex problems. It also delivered a more practical jolt—if a powerful reasoning model can be built at a lower cost, the economics of the frontier model race will have to be recalculated.

The viral spread of R1 did not stem solely from leaderboards, but from the question: "Must reasoning capabilities rely on expensive, closed-source models?" The simultaneous release of the technical report, open weights, and highly competitive API pricing enabled developers worldwide to personally deploy, distill, and verify this approach. It also marked the first time a Chinese model entered the center of global discussion through the combined impact of its methodology, cost, and openness.

timeline.title_zh: Vibe Coding 概念提出
timeline.title_en: Vibe Coding Coined
timeline.summary_zh:
2025 年 2 月 Andrej Karpathy 在 X 上发推提出 Vibe Coding——用自然语言描述需求让 LLM 写代码、不再手写。
你在跟 Cursor 或 Claude Code 对话，AI 替你写代码。
跑起来不满意继续描述继续改。
**背后现场**：Karpathy 自己说他的编程方式已经彻底变了——他不写代码了，只在 IDE 里跟 AI 对话。
这个词戳中了千万开发者的共同体验——2024 年以后写代码的方式真的变了。
**为何重要**：据 YC 对该届创业公司的调查统计,约 25% 的公司代码库中 95% 的代码由 AI 生成——这是 Vibe Coding 范式在早期创业团队渗透率的一个调查样本,并非 Vibe Coding 概念本身的定义。
编程的范式从手写转向了跟 AI 对话——Vibe Coding 是这个转变的名字。
**关联卡片**：Vibe Coding、Karpathy
timeline.card_summary_zh: Vibe Coding 概念提出，并成为这一阶段值得追踪的关键变化。
timeline.summary_en: In February 2025, Andrej Karpathy tweeted on X to propose "Vibe Coding"—a paradigm shift from hand-coding to describing requirements in natural language so LLMs write the code, allowing developers to converse with tools like Cursor or Claude Code and iteratively modify the output. This struck a chord with millions of developers whose workflows transformed after 2024, with Karpathy himself stating he no longer writes code but only talks to AI in his IDE. Highlighting the paradigm's penetration in early startups rather than defining the concept itself, a YC survey of that batch revealed that about 25% of the companies had 95% of their codebase generated by AI (Related cards: Vibe Coding, Karpathy).
timeline.card_summary_en: The concept of Vibe Coding was coined, becoming a key change worth tracking in this period.
timeline.why_it_matters_en: Vibe Coding marks the shift of programming from handwriting to conversing with AI: in 2025, 25% of YC startups had 95% of their code generated by AI.

timeline.title_zh: GPT-4.5 研究预览
timeline.title_en: GPT-4.5 Research Preview
timeline.summary_zh:
OpenAI 于 2025 年 2 月 26 日发布 GPT-4.5 研究预览，并强调预训练与后训练继续扩展。
GPT-4.5 更像一次能力边界测试：继续扩大预训练能带来什么，后训练怎样改善聊天、写作、创造性和复杂任务表现。
前沿竞争仍在探索规模、数据和对齐之间的配比。
timeline.source_name: OpenAI - Introducing GPT-4.5
timeline.card_summary_zh: OpenAI 于 2025 年 2 月 26 日发布 GPT-4.5 研究预览，并强调预训练与后训练继续扩展。
timeline.summary_en: On February 26, 2025, OpenAI released the GPT-4.5 research preview, emphasizing the continued scaling of both pre-training and post-training. The model serves as a test of capability boundaries, exploring what further pre-training can unlock and how post-training improves performance in chatting, writing, creativity, and complex tasks. Meanwhile, the frontier competition continues to search for the optimal mix of scale, data, and alignment.
timeline.card_summary_en: On February 26, 2025, OpenAI released the GPT-4.5 research preview, stressing that pretraining and post-training both continue to scale.
timeline.why_it_matters_en: It showed that frontier-model competition still leans on large-scale pretraining while also reinforcing chat and creative capabilities.

timeline.title_zh: 4o 图像生成上线
timeline.title_en: 4o Image Generation
timeline.summary_zh:
OpenAI 于 2025 年 3 月 24 日推出 4o 图像生成，使图像生成进一步融入聊天工作流。
生成式 AI 的扩张已经扩展到文字里。
图像、视频、声音和文本逐步接到同一套模型能力上，创作工具和内容生产流程也跟着被重写。
timeline.source_name: OpenAI - Introducing 4o Image Generation
timeline.card_summary_zh: OpenAI 于 2025 年 3 月 24 日推出 4o 图像生成，使图像生成进一步融入聊天工作流；代表生成图像功能正从独立模型品牌转向统一多模态助手体验。
timeline.summary_en: On March 24, 2025, OpenAI launched 4o image generation, further embedding image creation into chat workflows. The expansion of generative AI has already stretched into text. As images, video, audio, and text are gradually hooked into the same set of model capabilities, creative tools and content production workflows are being rewritten.
timeline.card_summary_en: On March 24, 2025, OpenAI launched 4o image generation, folding image creation further into chat workflows; it marked image generation moving from a standalone model brand toward a unified multimodal assistant experience.
timeline.why_it_matters_en: This marked image generation moving from standalone model brands toward a unified multimodal assistant experience.

timeline.title_zh: Llama 4 发布
timeline.title_en: Llama 4 Release
timeline.summary_zh:
Meta 于 2025 年 4 月 4 日发布 Llama 4 开源模型 Scout 和 Maverick，并强调原生多模态与超长上下文。
开放模型继续把战场推向多模态、长上下文和更复杂的任务执行。
Llama 4 的意义在于让开放生态继续参与最前沿的产品能力竞争。
timeline.source_name: Meta AI - Llama 4
timeline.card_summary_zh: Meta 于 2025 年 4 月 4 日发布 Llama 4 开源模型 Scout 和 Maverick；显示开放模型在多模态和超长 context 上继续追赶前沿闭源系统。
timeline.summary_en: On April 4, 2025, Meta released its Llama 4 open-source models, Scout and Maverick, placing a heavy focus on native multimodality and ultra-long context. The release pushes the open-model battlefield further into multimodality, long contexts, and complex task execution. Ultimately, Llama 4's significance lies in keeping the open ecosystem competitive at the absolute frontier of product capabilities.
timeline.card_summary_en: On April 4, 2025, Meta released the open models Llama 4 Scout and Maverick; it showed open models continuing to chase frontier closed systems on multimodality and ultra-long context.
timeline.why_it_matters_en: It showed open models continuing to chase frontier closed systems on multimodality and ultra-long context.

timeline.title_zh: OpenAI 推出 Codex 云端编程 Agent
timeline.title_en: OpenAI Codex Cloud Coding Agent
timeline.summary_zh:
2025 年 4-5 月,OpenAI 把 Codex 从模型推进到完整的云端软件工程 Agent 产品线:读取仓库、规划改动、运行命令、改文件、验证结果,把模型、工具调用、沙箱、测试和人类审阅连成一条工程链路。
人提出目标和边界,Agent 读取项目、拆任务、动手改、跑检查,再把结果交回给人审阅。
timeline.source_name: OpenAI - Introducing Codex
timeline.card_summary_zh: Codex 从代码补全走向云端代理：它能读取仓库、运行测试并并行处理任务，软件开发开始进入委托模式。
timeline.summary_en: Between April and May 2025, OpenAI evolved Codex from a standalone model into a complete cloud-based software engineering agent product line, linking models, tool calls, sandboxes, testing, and human review into a unified engineering pipeline that reads repositories, plans changes, runs commands, modifies files, and verifies results. Under this workflow, humans define the goals and boundaries, while the agent ingests the project, breaks down tasks, executes the edits, and runs checks before handing the results back for human review.
timeline.card_summary_en: Codex went from code completion to cloud agent: it reads repositories, runs tests, and handles tasks in parallel, moving software development into delegation mode.
timeline.why_it_matters_en:
Codex moved coding agents from demo capability to product lines, turning AI programming from one-off conversations into sustained engineering collaboration.
Permissions, security, testing, handoffs, and traceability will matter more and more.
timeline.behind_scenes_en:
In April-May 2025, OpenAI advanced Codex from a model to a complete cloud-based software engineering Agent product line: reading repositories, planning changes, running commands, modifying files, and verifying results, linking the model, tool calls, sandboxes, testing, and human review into a single engineering pipeline. Humans set the goals and boundaries, while the Agent reads the project, breaks down tasks, executes the modifications, runs checks, and then hands the results back to humans for review.

The key change for Codex was shifting the work from a chat window to an isolated cloud environment. The agent can read repositories, run commands and tests, and then hand the modifications back to humans for review; this requires the product to simultaneously handle permissions, network access, logging, failure recovery, and code ownership. As a result, programming assistants have evolved from "completing the next line" to "taking on the next task."

timeline.title_zh: 2025 前沿模型与 Agent 集中显形
timeline.title_en: Frontier models and agents become unmistakable in 2025
timeline.summary_zh:
2025 年，前沿模型、推理模型和 Agent 产品密集出现，AI 从聊天窗口继续走向工作流执行。
这一年很多发布都围绕同一个方向展开：模型要更会推理，工具要更会协作，产品要更接近真实工作。
用户看到的变化，是 AI 开始从“回答问题”走向“接住任务”。
timeline.source_name: OpenAI / Google DeepMind / Qwen / Anthropic
timeline.card_summary_zh: 模型不再只回答问题，而是开始浏览、编码、调用工具并持续执行，2025 成为 Agent 从概念走向工作流的一年。
timeline.summary_en: In 2025, a flurry of frontier models, reasoning models, and AI agents arrived, pushing AI past the chat window and into workflow execution. The year’s releases converged on a singular path: models that reason better, tools that collaborate more effectively, and products that mirror real-world work. For users, the shift was unmistakable—AI was moving from answering questions to taking on tasks.
timeline.card_summary_en: Models stopped merely answering questions and began browsing, coding, calling tools, and executing continuously, making 2025 the year agents moved from concept to workflow.
timeline.why_it_matters_en: It gathers the frontier names most worth seeing first in 2025 into one place, letting the timeline present the main battlefield of contemporary AI before unfolding the details.
timeline.behind_scenes_en:
In 2025, frontier models, reasoning models, and AI agents emerged in rapid succession, as AI continued to move beyond the chat window and into workflow execution. Many of the year's releases centered around a single direction: models must reason better, tools must collaborate better, and products must align closer to real-world work. The shift visible to users was AI transitioning from "answering questions" to "taking on tasks."

This milestone was not marked by a single product launch, but rather served as a chronological signpost of the year's shifting direction: browsers, terminals, code repositories, enterprise applications, and long-term memory began to be integrated around the models. Vendors no longer just showcased Q&A benchmark scores, but instead demonstrated whether agents could operate continuously in complex environments. It is best viewed as a defining chapter of an era, rather than product news from any single company.

timeline.title_zh: AlphaEvolve 发布
timeline.title_en: AlphaEvolve Announced
timeline.summary_zh:
2025 年 5 月，Google DeepMind 发布 AlphaEvolve，用 AI 辅助发现和改进算法。
它关注的是算法本身怎样被提出、测试和优化。
系统会生成候选方案，再通过评估筛掉弱结果，把更有希望的方案继续推进。
这个过程像把研究中的试错循环交给机器加速。
timeline.source_name: Google DeepMind - AlphaEvolve
timeline.card_summary_zh: Google DeepMind 发布 AlphaEvolve，用 AI 辅助发现和改进算法。
timeline.summary_en: In May 2025, Google DeepMind released AlphaEvolve, using AI to help discover and refine algorithms by focusing on how they are proposed, tested, and optimized. The system generates candidate solutions, filters out weak results through evaluation, and advances the most promising options. This process is like handing the research trial-and-error loop over to machines for acceleration.
timeline.card_summary_en: Google DeepMind released AlphaEvolve, using AI to assist in discovering and improving algorithms.
timeline.why_it_matters_en:
AlphaEvolve advanced AI from using existing algorithms to helping discover them.
This will affect fields that demand long-horizon trial and error, such as compilers, chips, mathematics, and engineering optimization.

timeline.title_zh: GLM-5.2 发布
timeline.title_en: GLM-5.2 Released
timeline.summary_zh:
智谱AI发布GLM-5.2——清华系国产大模型的最新旗舰。
在编程、多模态和Agent能力上全面升级，网上开发者评价普遍高于同期MiniMax-M3。
GLM系列一直走不同于GPT的双向注意力架构路线。
timeline.card_summary_zh: 智谱AI发布GLM-5.2——清华系国产大模型的最新旗舰；2026年国产大模型集中爆发——MiniMax-M3、GLM-5.2相继发布。
timeline.summary_en: Zhipu AI has released GLM-5.2, the latest flagship of the Tsinghua-affiliated domestic large models. Boasting comprehensive upgrades in coding, multimodal, and agent capabilities, its reception among online developers has generally surpassed that of its contemporary, MiniMax-M3. Unlike GPT, the GLM series has always carved out a different path by utilizing a bidirectional attention architecture.
timeline.card_summary_en: Zhipu AI released GLM-5.2, the latest flagship of the Tsinghua-lineage domestic large models; in 2026 Chinese large models burst forth in concentration, with MiniMax-M3 and GLM-5.2 arriving one after another.
timeline.why_it_matters_en:
Chinese large models burst forth together in 2026, with MiniMax-M3 and GLM-5.2 released one after another.
GLM-5.2 won developer praise for its distinctive architecture (bidirectional attention + autoregression) and well-rounded coding, multimodal, and Agent capabilities, showing that domestic models are not limited to following GPT's road: they are doing their own architectural exploration too.
timeline.behind_scenes_en:
Zhipu AI was founded by Tsinghua professor Tang Jie; from GLM-130B to GLM-4 and on to GLM-5, it has persisted with an architecture different from GPT's unidirectional one—GLM combines BERT-style bidirectional encoding with GPT-style unidirectional generation, seeking balance between understanding tasks and generation tasks.
GLM-5.2 is what this route has produced upon reaching its fifth major version.

timeline.title_zh: 聊天转向工作流自动化
timeline.title_en: Shift to Workflow Automation
timeline.summary_zh:
到 2026 年，行业重点从单轮聊天转向能调用工具、读写文件、浏览网页、执行多步任务的工作流系统。
用户开始关心模型能不能接住一个真实任务：读资料、做计划、用工具、留记录、遇到问题再回来确认。
这条线把 Deep Research、Codex、Claude Code、Hermes、OpenClaw 等产品和社区线索放到同一张图里：AI 正在从聊天框，走向可执行的工作流。
timeline.source_name: Current frontier AI product direction
timeline.card_summary_zh: AI 产品的中心正从“陪你聊天”转向“替你完成一串任务”，模型、工具和权限被编排成连续工作流。
timeline.summary_en: By 2026, the industry's focus shifted from single-turn chat to workflow systems capable of calling tools, reading and writing files, browsing the web, and executing multi-step tasks. Users began to care whether a model could handle a real-world task: reading materials, making plans, using tools, keeping logs, and looping back to double-check when encountering problems. This trajectory connects products and community projects like Deep Research, Codex, Claude Code, Hermes, and OpenClaw into a single picture: AI is moving out of the chat box and into executable workflows.
timeline.card_summary_en: The center of gravity of AI products is shifting from keeping you company in chat to finishing a string of tasks for you, with models, tools, and permissions orchestrated into continuous workflows.
timeline.why_it_matters_en: The standard for evaluating AI began shifting from answer quality to execution success rate, latency, cost, permission boundaries, and auditability.

timeline.title_zh: OpenClaw 进入开源个人 Agent 线索
timeline.title_en: OpenClaw enters the open personal-agent track
timeline.summary_zh:
OpenClaw 把个人 Agent 从聊天框推进到工作台。
以前你问一句，AI 回一句；
答案有用，最后还是你自己开网页、翻文件、接消息、跑流程。
龙虾之后，Agent 开始有手有脚。
它可以接消息入口，可以看你的电脑，可以连浏览器、文件、脚本和工具，把“我给你一个答案”推进到“我替你把这件事往前做”。
这指向生产力入口变化：AI 从对话窗口走进工作现场，连接资料、工具、任务和流程，帮人把事情继续往前推进。
timeline.source_name: 用户下载材料与本地快讯
timeline.card_summary_zh: 开源个人 Agent 开始连接文件、浏览器与本地工具，私人工作流不必完全依赖封闭平台。
timeline.summary_en: OpenClaw pushed personal agents out of the chat box and onto the workbench, moving past the era where AI merely answered questions while leaving the manual labor—opening web pages, digging through files, and running workflows—to the user. After Lobster, agents gained hands and feet, integrating with message feeds, reading screens, and connecting to browsers, files, scripts, and tools to transition from "here is your answer" to "let me get this done for you." This signals a shift in the productivity interface: AI is leaving the chat window to enter the actual workspace, linking data, tools, tasks, and workflows to keep projects moving forward.
timeline.card_summary_en: Open-source personal agents began connecting files, browsers, and local tools, so private workflows no longer have to depend entirely on closed platforms.
timeline.why_it_matters_en:
OpenClaw puts the key change of the personal agent plainly: AI must not only chat, it must receive messages, see the computer, connect tools, and run processes.
Whoever hooks this set of hands and feet onto the personal desktop may change how ordinary people use AI.

timeline.title_zh: Hermes Agent 进入自我改进 Agent 线索
timeline.title_en: Hermes Agent enters the self-improving agent track
timeline.summary_zh:
Hermes Agent 代表一种长期协作型 Agent：工具调用、记忆、Skill 和自我改进不再分散，而是在一次次任务里形成循环。
普通 Agent 做完一次任务就结束。
Hermes 这类系统更关心另一件事：这次踩过的坑、形成的流程、用户确认过的偏好，能不能沉淀下来，下次少解释、少犯错、做得更顺。
这和词典里讲的 Learning Loop、Skill、Memory Consolidation 是同一条线。
AI 在长期协作里逐步沉淀工作习惯。
timeline.source_name: 本地 Hermes 资料与正式词典卡片
timeline.card_summary_zh: 这和词典里讲的 Learning Loop、Skill、Memory Consolidation 是同一条线。
timeline.summary_en: Unlike ordinary agents that shut down after a single task, the Hermes Agent represents a long-term collaborative agent where tool calling, memory, Skill, and self-improvement form a continuous loop across tasks. Systems like Hermes focus on whether past pitfalls, established workflows, and user-confirmed preferences can be retained to minimize explanation, prevent mistakes, and run smoother next time—aligning with the concepts of a Learning Loop, Skill, and Memory Consolidation. Through this long-term collaboration, the AI gradually solidifies its own work habits.
timeline.card_summary_en: This runs along the same line as Learning Loop, Skill, and Memory Consolidation described in the dictionary.
timeline.why_it_matters_en:
Hermes pushed the focus of agents from being able to call tools to being able to accumulate experience.
If this line works out, personal AI assistants will become more like long-term partners, cutting the repeated explaining that starts from zero every time.

timeline.title_zh: GPT-5.5 成为 OpenAI 当前主力模型线
timeline.title_en: GPT-5.5 becomes OpenAI’s current frontier model line
timeline.summary_zh:
GPT-5.5 是 OpenAI 在 GPT-5 系列之后继续推进的当前主力模型线，连接 ChatGPT、Codex、API、推理、编码和工具使用。
这条主轴不能停在 GPT-5。
GPT-5、5.1、5.2、5.4 更适合放进二级迭代线，GPT-5.5 才能代表当前 OpenAI 模型线的最新方向。
timeline.source_name: OpenAI
timeline.card_summary_zh: GPT-5.5 将长程推理、工具调用与专业工作整合进主力模型线，Agent 能力开始成为默认配置。
timeline.summary_en: GPT-5.5 is OpenAI's current flagship model line succeeding the GPT-5 series, linking ChatGPT, Codex, APIs, reasoning, coding, and tool use. This core trajectory cannot stop at GPT-5; while GPT-5, 5.1, 5.2, and 5.4 are better suited for secondary iteration lines, it is GPT-5.5 that represents the true frontier of OpenAI's current model lineup.
timeline.card_summary_en: GPT-5.5 folded long-horizon reasoning, tool calling, and professional work into the flagship model line, making agent capability part of the default configuration.
timeline.why_it_matters_en:
GPT-5.5 shows that frontier-model competition has entered a stage of continuous system iteration.
A timeline must capture the current flagship nodes while avoiding stretching every minor version onto the main axis.

timeline.title_zh: Claude Opus 4.8 发布——Agent和长程编程再升级
timeline.title_en: Claude Opus 4.8 Released
timeline.summary_zh:
2026年5月Anthropic发布Claude Opus 4.8——在编码、Agent任务和长程工作流稳定性上进一步提升。
Opus 4.8特别优化了长时间多步骤任务中的一致性——减少中途丢失上下文和偏离任务的问题。
Opus 4.8的重点不在跑分——在稳定性。
Anthropic的客户反馈说之前的模型在短任务上表现很好但跑几个小时后容易跑偏。
4.8把长程一致性当作第一优先级——这正好是Agent应用最需要的东西——不是一次性的聪明——是持续好几个小时的可靠。
timeline.card_summary_zh: 2026年5月Anthropic发布Claude Opus 4.8——在编码。
timeline.summary_en: In May 2026, Anthropic released Claude Opus 4.8, delivering further improvements in coding, agent tasks, and long-range workflow stability. Focusing on stability rather than benchmark scores, the update optimizes consistency in long, multi-step tasks to reduce context loss and mid-way task drift. This addresses customer feedback that previous models performed well on short tasks but drifted after running for hours, prioritizing the sustained, hours-long reliability that agent applications need over one-off cleverness.
timeline.card_summary_en: In May 2026 Anthropic released Claude Opus 4.8, upgrading agents and long-horizon coding.
timeline.why_it_matters_en: Opus 4.8 represents AI's engineered evolution from short conversations to long-running tasks: agents are not a party trick, they must run multi-hour jobs stably and without errors.
timeline.behind_scenes_en: Opus 4.8 continued the Constitutional-AI-plus-long-horizon-tool-calling route Anthropic established with Claude 4 Opus from 2025, adding large amounts of RL data drawn from multi-step agent trajectories on the training side, and introducing context-compression plus mid-run checkpoint mechanisms on the engineering side to suppress drift across hours-long tasks. Internally Anthropic defined this generation as reliability ahead of peak capability, standing in deliberate contrast to the benchmark-chasing lines of OpenAI's GPT-5 and Google's Gemini 2.5 Pro.

timeline.title_zh: 《史记》开源知识库发布：验证智能体本体构建新范式
timeline.title_en: Shiji Knowledge Base Released, Validating Agentic Ontology Paradigm
timeline.summary_zh: 鲍捷正式发布《史记》知识库（shiji-kb），用 AI 智能体将整个《史记》57万字转换为包含 1.4 万个实体、12.6 万次标注和 3,198 个历史事件的交互式知识图谱。项目未用传统代码，完全由 Agent 读写「SKILL」指令并历经 5 轮反思修正构建，验证了「智能体本体构建」的可行性。
timeline.card_summary_zh: 《史记》开源知识库发布，展示如何利用 AI 智能体与结构化指令（SKILL）在短时间内构建大规模高精度古籍知识图谱。
timeline.card_summary_en: The Shiji Knowledge Base is released, demonstrating how autonomous agents and structured instructions (SKILLs) can build massive ancient texts into KGs.
timeline.why_it_matters_en: It provides a reusable framework for digital humanities and agentic knowledge engineering, scaling ancient texts into verified structured networks.
timeline.behind_scenes_en: Driven by a Butler agent executing 12k runs, the system leveraged multi-layer reflections (workflow, schema, audit) to prune 20k annotation anomalies.
timeline.source_name: GitHub

timeline.title_zh: Co-Scientist 公开
timeline.title_en: Co-Scientist Announced
timeline.summary_zh:
Google DeepMind 于 2026 年 5 月公开 AI 科研协作系统（Co-Scientist），多智能体科研辅助系统方向已进入公开展示阶段。
Co-Scientist 这类系统把 AI 从单个助手推向科研流程里的多角色协作：提假设、查资料、设计实验、互相质疑。
它的意义是探索科研工作能否被拆成多个 Agent 可以辅助推进的环节。
timeline.source_name: Google DeepMind - Co-Scientist
timeline.card_summary_zh: Co-Scientist 用多个专门 Agent 共同提出、批评和筛选假设，AI 开始参与科学研究的完整推理循环。
timeline.summary_en: In May 2026, Google DeepMind unveiled Co-Scientist, an AI scientific collaboration system that brings multi-agent research assistants into the public demonstration phase. Rather than acting as a single assistant, systems like Co-Scientist push AI into multi-role collaboration across the research workflow—formulating hypotheses, searching literature, designing experiments, and challenging one another. Its significance lies in exploring whether scientific research can be broken down into discrete steps that multiple AI agents can help drive forward.
timeline.card_summary_en: Co-Scientist let specialist agents propose, critique, and filter hypotheses together.
timeline.why_it_matters_en: It shows AI upgrading from single-model question answering to multi-agent collaboration, coming closer to real research and the division of labor in complex tasks.
timeline.behind_scenes_en:
In May 2026, Google DeepMind unveiled its AI scientific research collaboration system, Co-Scientist, signaling that the field of multi-agent scientific research assistant systems has entered the public demonstration stage. Systems like Co-Scientist push AI from a single assistant toward multi-role collaboration within the scientific research process: proposing hypotheses, searching literature, designing experiments, and challenging one another. Its significance lies in exploring whether scientific research work can be broken down into multiple steps that agents can help advance.

Rather than having a single model play the role of a scientist on its own, Co-Scientist distributes generation, criticism, ranking, and validation among multiple agents, with human researchers setting the problems and checking the results. This structure draws on peer discussions in real scientific research, yet it still relies on high-quality tools, experimental feedback, and expert judgment.

timeline.title_zh: MiniMax-M3 开源发布
timeline.title_en: MiniMax M3 Open Source Release
timeline.summary_zh:
MiniMax 发布并开源 M3——把编程能力、100万 token 长上下文和视觉理解放进同一个模型。
国产模型首次在单一开源模型中同时解决代码、长文和看图三个场景，不再需要为不同任务切换模型。
timeline.card_summary_zh: MiniMax 发布并开源 M3——把编程能力、100万 token 长上下文和视觉理解放进同一个模型。
timeline.summary_en: MiniMax has released and open-sourced M3, packing coding capabilities, a 1-million-token long context, and visual understanding into a single model. This marks the first time a domestic model has tackled coding, long-text, and image-viewing scenarios within a single open-source model, eliminating the need to switch models for different tasks.
timeline.card_summary_en: MiniMax open-sourced M3, putting coding, million-token context, and vision in one model.
timeline.why_it_matters_en: It solved a long-standing pain point of the domestic model ecosystem: strong coders could not read long documents, long-document readers could not process images, and image models could not write code. M3 merged all three using its self-developed MSA sparse attention architecture, at a self-hosting cost lower than calling closed-source APIs, delivering practical value for teams facing compound scenarios like contract analysis and codebase comprehension.
timeline.behind_scenes_en: MiniMax poured long-term R&D into sparse attention architecture: MSA is not a simple variant bolted onto the standard Transformer but a sparse attention mechanism designed from the ground up, holding clear advantages over equally sized dense models in memory use and speed on long texts. Behind it sits the shift of Chinese AI companies from following others to designing their own architectures.

timeline.title_zh: Claude Fable 5 与 Mythos 5 发布
timeline.title_en: Claude Fable 5 and Mythos 5 released
timeline.summary_zh:
Anthropic 发布 Claude Fable 5 和 Claude Mythos 5，把 Mythos-class 能力带入两个不同访问层级。
Fable 5 是面向一般使用的公开版本，带有更保守的 safeguards；
Mythos 5 是同一底层模型的受限访问版本，先面向网络防御者和基础设施提供方，通过 Project Glasswing 推进。
最新补充：2026-06-13，据 The Verge 等媒体报道，Anthropic 在美国政府以国家安全为由发布出口管制指令后，暂停 Fable 5 和 Mythos 5 对外国用户的访问；
这让这条新闻从“分层发布”进一步变成“高能力模型会被政策和安全边界迅速收紧”的案例。
这条线的重点不是多一个模型名，而是强模型发布方式变了：能力、安全护栏、访问资格、用途审计和政策边界开始被一起设计。
timeline.source_name: Anthropic / The Verge
timeline.card_summary_zh: Anthropic 将更长程的知识工作与安全边界推向新一代模型，能力提升与部署限制第一次如此紧密地并置。
timeline.summary_en: Anthropic released Claude Fable 5 and Claude Mythos 5, bringing Mythos-class capabilities to two distinct access tiers: Fable 5, a general-use public version with conservative safeguards, and Mythos 5, a restricted-access version of the same underlying model deployed initially to cyber defenders and infrastructure providers via Project Glasswing. However, on June 13, 2026, outlets including The Verge reported that Anthropic suspended foreign access to both models following a US national security export control directive, shifting the narrative from a tiered release to a case study in how policy and security boundaries are rapidly tightening around high-capability AI. The key takeaway is not just a new model name, but a fundamental shift in how powerful models are deployed, with capability, safeguards, access credentials, usage audits, and policy boundaries now being designed in unison.
timeline.card_summary_en: Anthropic carried longer-horizon knowledge work and safety limits into its newest models.
timeline.why_it_matters_en: Fable 5 and Mythos 5 demonstrated high-capability models entering a release structure of public edition plus trusted-access edition. Future frontier competition will weigh not only capability but who can design safety boundaries, access plans, and actual uses most clearly.

timeline.title_zh: Claude Sonnet 5 发布：Agent 工作流进入更低成本区间
timeline.title_en: Claude Sonnet 5 Released for Agentic Workflows
timeline.summary_zh: Anthropic 发布 Claude Sonnet 5，强调其规划、工具调用和自主执行能力。模型面向 Claude、Claude Code 与 Claude Platform 提供，首发优惠价格为每百万输入 token 2 美元、输出 token 10 美元。
timeline.source_name: Anthropic
timeline.card_summary_zh: Sonnet 5 把规划、终端和浏览器操作下放到更低成本层级，持续运行 Agent 不再只能依赖最贵模型。
timeline.summary_en: Anthropic released Claude Sonnet 5, highlighting its planning, tool-use and autonomous execution capabilities. The model is available across Claude, Claude Code and the Claude Platform, with a launch price of $2 per million input tokens and $10 per million output tokens.
timeline.card_summary_en: Sonnet 5 moved planning, terminal, and browser work to a cheaper tier for always-on agents.
timeline.why_it_matters_en: Frontier model competition has begun turning away from chasing maximum capability alone, toward balance among capability, cost, and sustainable operation.
timeline.behind_scenes_en: The point of this release was not benchmark scores but pushing agent workflows that previously required larger models down to Sonnet level, making continuously running coding, browser, and terminal tasks far easier to keep within budget.

timeline.title_zh: 寒武纪市值突破 1 万亿人民币——科创板首家万亿公司
timeline.title_en: Cambricon Reaches 1 Trillion RMB Market Cap
timeline.summary_zh:
2026 年 6 月 30 日，寒武纪股价涨近 8%，突破历史新高，总市值正式突破 1 万亿人民币，成为科创板历史上第一家万亿市值公司。
这一天碰巧和美团长猫 2.0 的发布同一天——模型侧证明了国产芯片能训万亿参数的前沿模型，芯片侧证明了这个市场大到足以撑起万亿市值。
一个万亿是国产算力训出来的模型参数，一个万亿是二级市场给国产算力的估值。
timeline.card_summary_zh: 寒武纪股价涨近 8%，突破历史新高，总市值正式突破 1 万亿人民币，成为科创板历史上第一家万亿市值公司。
timeline.summary_en: On June 30, 2026, Cambricon’s stock surged nearly 8% to a record high, pushing its total market cap past 1 trillion RMB and making it the first-ever trillion-yuan company on the STAR Market. This milestone coincided with the debut of Meituan’s Changmao 2.0—proving on the model side that domestic chips can train trillion-parameter frontier AI, and on the chip side that the market is vast enough to sustain a trillion-yuan valuation. One trillion represents the parameters trained on domestic compute; the other is the valuation awarded to domestic compute by the secondary market.
timeline.card_summary_en: Cambricon shares rose near eight percent to record highs, market cap topping one trillion yuan.
timeline.why_it_matters_en: Cambricon's trillion-yuan capitalization marks domestic AI chips completing the whole path from laboratory concept to trillion-scale valuation. Intertwined with Meituan's trillion-parameter LongCat, this same-day collision of supply and demand carries a peculiar sense of history.
timeline.behind_scenes_en: Cambricon was founded in 2016 by brothers Chen Tianshi and Chen Yunji of the Chinese Academy of Sciences' Institute of Computing Technology. It made its name in 2017 when Huawei's Kirin 970 shipped carrying its NPU, listed on the STAR Market in 2020 as the first domestic AI chip stock, and saw its market cap pass one trillion yuan on June 30, 2026. From 2016 to 2026, exactly ten years.

timeline.title_zh: 美团发布并开源 LongCat-2.0
timeline.title_en: Meituan Releases and Open-Sources LongCat-2.0
timeline.summary_zh: 美团发布 LongCat-2.0：总参数 1.6T、平均激活约 48B，原生支持 1M 上下文，并宣布对外开源。官方称其全流程训练与推理运行在五万卡国产算力集群上，重点面向 Agentic Coding。
timeline.source_name: 美团技术团队
timeline.card_summary_zh: LongCat-2.0 在国产五万卡集群上完成万亿参数训练并开放权重，展示了另一套前沿模型基础设施路径。
timeline.summary_en: Meituan released and open-sourced LongCat-2.0: 1.6T total parameters with about 48B activated on average, native 1M-token context. The company said the entire training and inference pipeline ran on a 50,000-GPU domestic compute cluster, with Agentic Coding as the primary focus.
timeline.card_summary_en: Trained on fifty thousand domestic cards, LongCat-2.0 opened its trillion-parameter weights.
timeline.why_it_matters_en: It was at once an open-model event and a public demonstration of the engineering capability of China's large-scale AI infrastructure.
timeline.behind_scenes_en: LongCat-2.0 placed model architecture, domestic compute clusters, and coding-agent scenarios inside a single engineering system, demonstrating ultra-large sparse models put into practice on non-NVIDIA training infrastructure.

timeline.title_zh: JADEPUFFER：自主 Agent 串联完整勒索攻击链
timeline.title_en: JADEPUFFER Demonstrates Agentic Ransomware
timeline.summary_zh: Sysdig 披露 JADEPUFFER：一个由 AI Agent 驱动的数据库勒索行动。研究人员观察到 600 多个具有连贯目的的 payload，攻击过程覆盖初始入侵、横向移动、持久化与数据库破坏。
timeline.source_name: Sysdig Threat Research Team
timeline.card_summary_zh: JADEPUFFER 将侦察、横向移动和数据库破坏串成自主攻击链，Agent 的安全风险从辅助工具升级为执行主体。
timeline.summary_en: Sysdig disclosed JADEPUFFER, a database ransomware campaign driven by AI agents. Researchers observed more than 600 payloads working toward a coherent goal, covering initial intrusion, lateral movement, persistence and database destruction.
timeline.card_summary_en: JADEPUFFER chained recon, lateral movement, and database damage into autonomous attack.
timeline.why_it_matters_en: AI security risk advanced from assisted attack to autonomously orchestrated attack chains, requiring defenders to monitor model capability, tool permissions, and runtime isolation all at once.
timeline.behind_scenes_en: No individual technique was novel; the change was that an agent could chain years-old known vulnerabilities and tools into a complete pipeline, adjusting its next move according to results as it ran.

timeline.title_zh: GPT-5.6 面向 ChatGPT、Codex 与 API 推出
timeline.title_en: OpenAI Launches GPT-5.6 Across ChatGPT, Codex, and API
timeline.summary_zh: OpenAI 发布 GPT-5.6 系列 Sol、Terra 与 Luna，并开始在 ChatGPT、Codex 和 API 中全球上线。三个层级分别面向高难度专业工作、日常平衡型任务和低成本高速推理。
timeline.source_name: OpenAI
timeline.card_summary_zh: GPT-5.6 以 Sol、Terra、Luna 三档覆盖能力、速度和成本，前沿模型开始按 Agent 任务精细分层。
timeline.summary_en: OpenAI released the GPT-5.6 family — Sol, Terra and Luna — rolling them out globally across ChatGPT, Codex and the API. The three tiers target demanding professional work, everyday balanced tasks, and low-cost high-speed reasoning respectively.
timeline.card_summary_en: GPT-5.6 arrived in Sol, Terra, and Luna tiers spanning capability, speed, and cost.
timeline.why_it_matters_en: Model competition entered a stage of capability tiering plus agent deployment, and Codex also became an important launch surface for frontier models.
timeline.behind_scenes_en: OpenAI no longer covers all work with a single flagship model, instead splitting capability, speed, and cost into clean tiers so agent workflows can choose inference resources matched to task difficulty.

timeline.title_zh: Apple 起诉 OpenAI，指控其窃取商业机密
timeline.title_en: Apple Sues OpenAI Over Alleged Trade Secret Theft
timeline.summary_zh: Apple 在加州联邦法院起诉 OpenAI，指控其招募的前 Apple 员工带走与 AI 硬件相关的机密资料。这标志着双方从 2024 年的产品合作进一步走向竞争与法律冲突。
timeline.source_name: AP News
timeline.card_summary_zh: Apple 在加州联邦法院起诉 OpenAI，指控其招募的前 Apple 员工带走与 AI 硬件相关的机密资料。
timeline.summary_en: Apple sued OpenAI in federal court in California, alleging that former Apple employees it recruited walked away with confidential materials related to AI hardware. The suit marks a further slide from the two companies' 2024 product partnership into competition and legal conflict.
timeline.card_summary_en: Apple sued OpenAI in California federal court over ex-employees leaving with hardware secrets.
timeline.why_it_matters_en: As AI companies push into hardware and consumer entry points, the fight for talent is evolving into a matter of intellectual property and industrial alliances.
timeline.behind_scenes_en: The litigation focuses on talent movement, hardware R&D, and the boundaries of trade secrets rather than plain model competition.

timeline.title_zh: Thinking Machines 发布首个开放权重模型 Inkling
timeline.title_en: Thinking Machines Releases Open-Weights Model Inkling
timeline.summary_zh: Thinking Machines Lab 发布 Inkling，这是该实验室首个开放权重模型。团队称模型从头训练，并同时开放原始检查点与面向 NVIDIA Blackwell 的 NVFP4 检查点。
timeline.source_name: Thinking Machines Lab
timeline.card_summary_zh: Thinking Machines 以开放权重推出首个模型 Inkling，前 OpenAI 核心成员的新实验室正式进入模型竞争。
timeline.summary_en: Thinking Machines Lab released Inkling, the lab's first open-weight model. The team said it was trained from scratch, with both the original checkpoint and an NVFP4 checkpoint for NVIDIA Blackwell hardware made public.
timeline.card_summary_en: Thinking Machines launched its first model Inkling with open weights, entering the model race.
timeline.why_it_matters_en: Competition among frontier labs no longer happens only through proprietary APIs; it extends to open weights, training tools, and developer ecosystems.
timeline.behind_scenes_en: The lab founded by Mira Murati chose to release its first model as open weights, paired with inference and reinforcement-learning tooling, emphasizing customizability and reproducibility.

timeline.title_zh: Kimi K3 发布：首个开放的 3T 级模型
timeline.title_en: Kimi K3 Introduced as an Open 3T-Class Model
timeline.summary_zh: 月之暗面发布 Kimi K3：总参数 2.8T、896 个专家中激活 16 个，支持 100 万 token 上下文，面向长程编程、知识工作与推理。官方计划在 7 月 27 日前发布完整权重。
timeline.source_name: Kimi / Moonshot AI
timeline.card_summary_zh: Kimi K3 将 2.8 万亿参数、百万上下文和长程编程结合，开放权重模型首次迈入 3T 规模。
timeline.summary_en: Moonshot AI released Kimi K3: 2.8T total parameters with 16 of 896 experts activated per token, 1M-token context, aimed at long-horizon coding, knowledge work and reasoning. Full weights were slated for release by July 27.
timeline.card_summary_en: Kimi K3 joined 2.8T parameters, million-token context, and long coding, opening the 3T era.
timeline.why_it_matters_en: Open-weight models continue advancing toward frontier scale, offering researchers and developers another route besides closed-source APIs.
timeline.behind_scenes_en: Kimi K3 combined Kimi Delta Attention, Attention Residuals, and Stable LatentMoE to bring together model scale, sparse activation, and long context.

timeline.title_zh: Claude Opus 5 发布，强化长程 Agent 与研究能力
timeline.title_en: Anthropic Releases Claude Opus 5
timeline.summary_zh: Anthropic 发布 Claude Opus 5，重点提升长程 Agent、调试、科学研究和复杂知识工作能力。模型在 Claude 各平台与 API 上线，价格与 Opus 4.8 相同。
timeline.source_name: Anthropic
timeline.card_summary_zh: Opus 5 强化验证、调试和长时间持续执行，旗舰模型的竞争焦点进一步转向可靠的长程 Agent。
timeline.summary_en: Anthropic released Claude Opus 5, with major gains in long-horizon agents, debugging, scientific research and complex knowledge work. The model went live across Claude platforms and the API at the same price as Opus 4.8.
timeline.card_summary_en: Opus 5 sharpened verification, debugging, and sustained execution for dependable long-run agents.
timeline.why_it_matters_en: The reliability, cost, and consistency of long-horizon agents are becoming the core metrics of flagship-model competition.
timeline.behind_scenes_en: Anthropic stressed the model's stability in verifying its own work, iterating continuously, and sustaining complex open-ended tasks, reflecting frontier models shifting from one-shot answers to long-duration execution.

timeline.title_zh: MCP 2026-07-28 规范发布：核心转向无状态架构
timeline.title_en: MCP 2026-07-28 Specification Moves to a Stateless Core
timeline.summary_zh: Model Context Protocol 发布第五版规范，核心传输转向无状态设计，同时强化授权机制，并推动官方扩展进入稳定阶段。Anthropic 同日宣布在 Claude 产品中支持新版规范。
timeline.source_name: Model Context Protocol / Anthropic
timeline.card_summary_zh: 新版 MCP 转向无状态核心并强化授权，让 Agent 连接外部工具的开放协议更适合大规模生产部署。
timeline.summary_en: Model Context Protocol published its fifth specification revision, moving core transport to a stateless design, hardening authorization, and ushering official extensions toward stability. Anthropic announced same-day support for the new spec across Claude products.
timeline.card_summary_en: The new MCP spec went stateless with hardened authorization, fit for production-scale agents.
timeline.why_it_matters_en: MCP is growing from a single company's connection scheme into a more scalable open protocol for connecting agents to external tools.
timeline.behind_scenes_en: A stateless core removes session constraints on MCP servers during load balancing, failure recovery, and large-scale deployment, a key adjustment as the agent tool ecosystem moves from experimentation toward infrastructure.

timeline.title_zh: OpenAI 大幅下调 GPT-5.6 Luna 与 Terra 价格
timeline.title_en: OpenAI Cuts GPT-5.6 Luna and Terra Prices
timeline.summary_zh: OpenAI 将 GPT-5.6 Luna 的价格下调 80%，Terra 下调 20%，并为 Sol API 增加更快的推理选项。
timeline.source_name: OpenAI
timeline.card_summary_zh: GPT-5.6 发布数周后即大幅降价，Agent 竞争从能力榜单迅速延伸到每个任务的真实运行成本。
timeline.summary_en: OpenAI cut the price of GPT-5.6 Luna by 80% and Terra by 20%, and added a faster inference option for the Sol API.
timeline.card_summary_en: Weeks after GPT-5.6 launched, prices fell sharply, competition spreading to true per-task costs.
timeline.why_it_matters_en: Lower inference costs directly widen the feasible range of agents, automation, and high-frequency API workflows.
timeline.behind_scenes_en: Cutting prices significantly just weeks after a frontier model launch shows the competitive focus rapidly extending from capability leaderboards to per-task cost and inference efficiency.

timeline.title_zh: DeepSeek-V4-Flash-0731 更新开放权重模型
timeline.title_en: DeepSeek Updates Its Open-Weights V4 Flash Model
timeline.summary_zh: DeepSeek 更新 V4 Flash 开放权重模型。Hugging Face 官方集合显示 DeepSeek-V4-Flash-0731 已发布，模型规模约 304B 参数。
timeline.source_name: DeepSeek / Hugging Face
timeline.card_summary_zh: DeepSeek 继续以开放权重快速迭代 V4 Flash，前沿模型的更新节奏正在接近持续交付的软件产品。
timeline.summary_en: DeepSeek updated its V4 Flash open-weight model. The official Hugging Face collection shows DeepSeek-V4-Flash-0731 is out, at roughly 304B parameters.
timeline.card_summary_en: DeepSeek kept iterating V4 Flash in open weights, frontier updates nearing continuous delivery.
timeline.why_it_matters_en: Continuous iteration of open-weight models lets researchers and developers evaluate, deploy, and improve frontier models on their own.
timeline.behind_scenes_en: The update continues DeepSeek's route of fast iteration through public weights and model collections, and makes it easy for developers to track version changes directly.

timeline.title_zh: Claude Code 支持在企业自有基础设施运行云端会话
timeline.title_en: Claude Code Adds Self-Hosted Cloud Session Environments
timeline.summary_zh: Anthropic 推出 Claude Code 自托管环境公测，允许团队把云端编码会话路由到自己管理的计算基础设施。
timeline.source_name: Anthropic / Claude
timeline.card_summary_zh: Claude Code 可以把云端编码任务路由到企业自有计算环境，Agent 开始进入可控、可审计的生产基础设施。
timeline.summary_en: Anthropic opened a public beta of a self-hosted Claude Code environment, letting teams route cloud coding sessions to infrastructure they manage themselves.
timeline.card_summary_en: Claude Code routes cloud coding sessions onto enterprises' own compute, auditable and contained.
timeline.why_it_matters_en: Coding agents are moving from personal development tools into production environments that enterprise infrastructure and security policy can govern.
timeline.behind_scenes_en: Enterprises can control network egress, runtime environment, and isolation policies themselves while keeping the asynchronous working style of cloud agents.

timeline.title_zh: OpenAI 更新 GPT-5.6 Sol，并向免费用户扩展 Luna
timeline.title_en: OpenAI Updates GPT-5.6 Sol and Expands Luna Access
timeline.summary_zh: OpenAI 更新 ChatGPT 中的 GPT-5.6 Sol，强调更聚焦的回答、更可靠的事实表现和更一致的推理体验，同时向免费用户扩大 GPT-5.6 Luna 的访问。
timeline.source_name: OpenAI
timeline.card_summary_zh: OpenAI 一边提高 Sol 的事实可靠性，一边向免费用户开放 Luna，新一代能力开始从专业层向大众扩散。
timeline.summary_en: OpenAI updated GPT-5.6 Sol in ChatGPT, touting sharper answers, more reliable factual performance and a more consistent reasoning experience, while expanding free-user access to GPT-5.6 Luna.
timeline.card_summary_en: OpenAI raised Sol's factual reliability while extending Luna to free users, diffusion downward.
timeline.why_it_matters_en: Broader free access spreads new-generation model capability from professional users out to everyday use cases.
timeline.behind_scenes_en: Rapid iteration after a frontier launch shows model releases are no longer one-time events but an ongoing product process of tuning quality, speed, and coverage.

timeline.title_zh: Mojo 编译器开源——面向 AI 硬件的语言交出完整工具链
timeline.title_en: Mojo Compiler Open-Sourced: The AI-Hardware Language Ships Its Full Toolchain
timeline.summary_zh: 2026 年 8 月，Modular 将 Mojo 编译器、工具链和构建所需源代码公开，采用 Apache 2.0 许可证并附 LLVM 例外。此前 Mojo 的标准库已开放，但负责把源码编译为机器代码的核心编译器始终封闭；此次开源使开发者可以从源码构建、审计并 fork 这门面向 CPU、GPU 等异构硬件的语言。
timeline.summary_en: In August 2026, Modular published the Mojo compiler, toolchain and the sources needed to build it under Apache 2.0 (with an LLVM exception). The standard library had been open before, but the core compiler that turns Mojo source into machine code remained closed; developers can now build, audit and fork the language aimed at CPUs, GPUs and other heterogeneous hardware from source.
timeline.why_it_matters_en: AI infrastructure depends not only on models but on who controls the compiler layer. Mojo combines Python-like expressiveness, MLIR compilation foundations and GPU-class performance targets; with the compiler open, the language toolchain around AI kernels, inference optimization and heterogeneous hardware finally qualifies as public infrastructure.
timeline.card_summary_zh: Modular 开源 Mojo 编译器：面向 AI 硬件的语言从可用但不可审计，变成可阅读、可构建、可 fork 的公共基础设施。
timeline.card_summary_en: Modular open-sourced the Mojo compiler, turning an AI-hardware language that was usable but unauditable into readable, buildable, forkable public infrastructure.
timeline.source_name: Modular Blog

timeline.title_zh: Artificial Analysis 发布 Search Index：检索质量第一次按全链路成本排名
timeline.title_en: Artificial Analysis Launches Search Index, Ranking Retrieval by Total Task Cost
timeline.summary_zh: Artificial Analysis 上线 Search Index，在固定 harness 中用 GPT-5.6 Luna 驱动开源 Stirrup 评测各家检索服务：Parallel 以 75 分居首，Exa 74 分、Firecrawl 73 分随后，模型直连基线只有 33 分。
timeline.source_name: Artificial Analysis
timeline.card_summary_zh: Search Index 把检索从玄学拉回可复现评测，并揭示更好的检索反而压低任务总成本。
timeline.summary_en: Artificial Analysis launched Search Index, using GPT-5.6 Luna to drive the open-source Stirrup harness in evaluating retrieval providers under fixed conditions: Parallel led at 75, followed by Exa at 74 and Firecrawl at 73, with the model-only baseline at just 33.
timeline.card_summary_en: Search Index made retrieval measurable again, and showed better search lowers total task cost.
timeline.why_it_matters_en: Retrieval finally has a reproducible, price-comparable full-pipeline benchmark, letting teams building production agents judge whether searching more accurately beats scaling the model bigger on total cost.
timeline.behind_scenes_en: The evaluation found stronger retrieval costs more per request but suppressed model token consumption enough to bring total task cost down; wherever retrieval can replace reasoning steps, the money moves from the model to the retrieval stack.

timeline.title_zh: Public AI Observatory 上线：真实 AI 使用第一次被独立丈量
timeline.title_en: Public AI Observatory Launches to Measure Real-World AI Use
timeline.summary_zh: MIT、Stanford 等机构共建的 Public AI Observatory 上线，公开 24,521 段经用户同意的对话、52 个模型、近 10 万轮次与 145 个标注维度，覆盖 2023 至 2026 年的真实使用。
timeline.source_name: Public AI Observatory
timeline.card_summary_zh: 公共 AI 观测站用 2.4 万段真实对话给行业一把共同的尺子，AI 使用第一次可被独立丈量。
timeline.summary_en: Public AI Observatory, built by MIT, Stanford and other institutions, went live — releasing 24,521 consented conversations, 52 models, nearly 100,000 turns and 145 annotation dimensions covering real-world usage from 2023 to 2026.
timeline.card_summary_en: Twenty-four thousand real conversations gave the industry one shared ruler for actual AI usage.
timeline.why_it_matters_en: Applied research gained usage-side data infrastructure independent of vendor reporting for the first time, so the real state of AI use can be continuously verified by third parties.
timeline.behind_scenes_en: The dataset stresses auditability and independence from vendor claims, pulling the question of how AI is actually used out of dueling self-reports and back into publicly checkable measurement.

timeline.title_zh: Mistral 发布 Agentic Search——企业检索从召回文本变成核验文档
timeline.title_en: Mistral Ships Agentic Search: Enterprise Retrieval Becomes Document Verification
timeline.summary_zh: 2026 年 8 月，Mistral 发布 Agentic Search，为已有企业索引加入 search、open、navigate、read、grep 五种工具。模型不再只能依据首次召回的 top-k 文本块作答，而能继续打开文档、定位页码、读取表格、比对多份来源后再回答。官方报告称 FinanceBench 正确率从 26.7% 升至 86%，OfficeQA Pro 较一次性 RAG 提高 45.6 个百分点。
timeline.summary_en: In August 2026, Mistral released Agentic Search, adding five tools — search, open, navigate, read and grep — to existing enterprise indexes. Instead of answering from first-recalled top-k chunks, the model can open documents, locate pages, read tables and cross-check multiple sources before answering; Mistral reports FinanceBench accuracy rising from 26.7% to 86%, and OfficeQA Pro improving by 45.6 points over one-shot RAG.
timeline.why_it_matters_en: This moves the object of enterprise-RAG optimization from chunks, embeddings and rerankers to a full retrieve-inspect-verify workflow. For cross-document questions over filings, contracts and scanned PDFs, retrieval stops being context feeding and becomes a tool layer the model can operate repeatedly, leaving evidence trails.
timeline.card_summary_zh: Agentic Search 把企业检索从一次召回变成多步核验，复杂文档问答的准确率上限被重新定义。
timeline.card_summary_en: Agentic Search turns enterprise retrieval from one-shot recall into multi-step verification, redefining the accuracy ceiling for complex document QA.
timeline.source_name: Mistral AI
timeline.behind_scenes_en: The evaluation found stronger retrieval costs more per request but suppressed model token consumption enough to bring total task cost down; wherever retrieval can replace reasoning steps, the money moves from the model to the retrieval stack.

timeline.title_zh: 阿里发布 Qwen-UI-Agent——GUI 智能体开始以真实设备为共同基座
timeline.title_en: Alibaba Releases Qwen-UI-Agent: GUI Agents Get a Real-Device Foundation
timeline.summary_zh: 2026 年 8 月，阿里发布 Qwen-UI-Agent：统一覆盖手机、电脑、浏览器和 DeepSearch 的 GUI 智能体基座模型，以 Apache 2.0 开源。它面向真实设备上的屏幕理解与点击、输入、滑动操作，而非只在模拟器中执行；官方报告 MobileWorld 得分 82.1%、真机环境 MobileWorld-Real 达 92.2%，训练评测基于 100 多台真实手机、150 多个应用构成的移动环境。
timeline.summary_en: In August 2026, Alibaba released Qwen-UI-Agent, a GUI agent foundation model unified across mobile, desktop, browser and DeepSearch, open-sourced under Apache 2.0. It targets on-screen understanding and touch, typing and swiping on real devices rather than simulators; the technical report gives 82.1% on MobileWorld and 92.2% on the real-device MobileWorld-Real, trained and evaluated in a mobile environment of 100+ physical phones and 150+ apps.
timeline.why_it_matters_en: Most software exposes no API for agents; the screen remains the universal interface of the digital world. Putting mobile, desktop and browser operations into one model with a real-device evaluation regime means agent execution boundaries are expanding from calling tools to operating off-the-shelf software.
timeline.card_summary_zh: Qwen-UI-Agent 用一个模型统一四类屏幕操作并以真机数据验证，GUI 智能体从单平台演示走向通用基座。
timeline.card_summary_en: Qwen-UI-Agent unifies four kinds of screen operation in one model validated on real devices, moving GUI agents from single-platform demos to a general foundation.
timeline.source_name: Qwen-UI-Agent Technical Report
timeline.behind_scenes_en: The evaluation found stronger retrieval costs more per request but suppressed model token consumption enough to bring total task cost down; wherever retrieval can replace reasoning steps, the money moves from the model to the retrieval stack.
